```bash

# Copy to .env and adjust. Vite only exposes variables prefixed with VITE_.

# Base URL of the backend API.

# ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team.

VITE_API_BASE_URL=

# DEV FIXTURES: answer API calls from src/mocks instead of the network.

# This is a simulation, not an integration. Never enable it against real customers or real money.

# Leave it unset and `npm run dev` still uses the fixtures while VITE_API_BASE_URL is empty;

# set it to false (with a base URL) to talk to a real backend.
VITE_USE_MOCK_API=true
```

## `README.md`

````markdown

# Shipper.com — frontend

React 19 + Vite storefront and admin dashboard for Shipper.com. This repository contains the frontend only;
authentication, pricing, payments (Razorpay), inventory and India Post integration are backend work.
The visual reference is `design/shipper-figma.pdf.pdf` (24 artboards: storefront desktop and mobile, admin 1440 × 900).

## Requirements

- Node.js `^20.19.0` or `>=22.12.0` (required by Vite 8)
- npm 10+

## Getting started

```

bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env # Windows PowerShell: Copy-Item .env.example .env
npm run dev

```
`.env.example` turns the mock API on (`VITE_USE_MOCK_API=true`), so the whole app works without a backend. If you skip
the `.env` file, `npm run dev` still uses the mock while `VITE_API_BASE_URL` is empty; production builds never do.
| Script | Purpose |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `npm run dev` | Start the Vite dev server |
| `npm run build` | Production build into `dist/` |
| `npm run preview` | Serve the production build locally |
| `npm run lint` | ESLint (also enforces the `@/` alias) |

## Mock mode (development fixtures)

With `VITE_USE_MOCK_API=true` every API call is answered in the browser from `src/mocks` (a custom Axios adapter:
126 products, 40 customers, 291 orders, addresses, wallet ledger, reports). **This is a simulation, not an integration.**
Data lives in memory and resets on reload; a yellow "Mock data" badge is shown whenever it is on. Never enable it
against real customers or real money. Every rule it applies (GST split, shipping charge, wallet and coupon limits,
payment outcomes, stock queues) is an **ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team**.
Demo sign-ins (password `Shipper@123`):
| Area | Sign in at | Account |
| -------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Customer | `/login` | Aditi Sharma — `9876543210` or `aditi.sharma@gmail.com`, wallet ₹250 |
| Admin | `/admin/login` | Pawan Yadav — `pawan.yadav@shipper.com` or `9811122334` |
The demo session is kept in `sessionStorage` (mock mode only) so a reload does not sign you out. In the mock a UPI ID
starting with `fail@` shows a declined payment; any other UPI ID succeeds. Coupons: `HELLO10`, `SHIPPER50`.
To connect a real backend: set `VITE_USE_MOCK_API=false` and `VITE_API_BASE_URL`. Every endpoint the UI calls is
declared once in `src/app/services/endpoints.js` (composed from `src/app/services/endpointGroups/*`), and every path,
payload and response shape there is an assumption to confirm with the backend team.

## Routes

Storefront: `/`, `/shop`, `/category/:slug`, `/products/:slug`, `/offers`, `/cart`, `/login`, `/signup`, `/checkout`,
`/checkout/confirmation/:orderNumber`, `/account/profile`, `/account/orders`, `/account/orders/:orderNumber`,
`/account/wallet`, `/account/saved`, `/track`, `/policies/:slug`.
Admin (`/admin/...`, administrators only): `login`, `dashboard`, `purchases`, `purchases/new`, `orders`,
`orders/:orderNumber`, `products`, `reports`, `reports/financial`, `customers`, `customers/:code`, `users`, `roles`,
`store-operation/:tab` (`new-orders`, `to-pick`, `to-pack`, `ready-to-dispatch`, `dispatched`, `delayed`), `shipping`,
`restock`, `profile`. In development, `/dev/components` shows the component gallery.
Route guards (`RequireAuth`, `RequireAdmin`, `RedirectIfAuthenticated`) are **UX only**; real authorisation is the
backend's job.

## Environment

| Variable | Meaning |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VITE_API_BASE_URL` | Backend base URL. **ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team.** |
| `VITE_USE_MOCK_API` | `true`/`false`. `true` answers API calls from `src/mocks` (development fixtures); unset means "yes in `npm run dev` while no backend URL is set". A simulation, not an integration. |

## Structure

```

src/app providers, router (routes, guards, paths), Redux store (auth, cart, ui), services (Axios, endpoints), config
src/components atoms → molecules → organisms shared by both apps
src/features one folder per domain: catalog, cart, checkout, auth, profile, orders, tracking, wallet, policies,
saved, addresses, dashboard, products, purchases, inventory, store-operations, shipping,
admin-lists, admin-orders, customers, users, reports, admin-auth, admin-profile
src/layouts StorefrontLayout, AdminLayout
src/pages route-level screens (storefront/, admin/)
src/mocks development fixtures and handlers (never imported outside the lazy mock chunk)
src/lib formatting, validators, storage, address helpers, downloads, lazy Excel (exceljs)
src/styles tokens, CSS variables, Bootstrap mapping, mixins

```

## Conventions

- **Imports:** use the `@/` alias for anything under `src`. Parent-relative imports (`../`) are a lint error.
- **Styling:** component styles sit beside the component as `Name.module.scss` (CSS Modules, camelCase class names only —
`.app-shell` would be exported as `styles.appShell`). Read design tokens through CSS variables
(`var(--sh-color-primary)`); import breakpoint mixins with `@use '@/styles/mixins' as *;`.
- **Tokens:** `src/styles/_tokens.scss` is the single source of truth; `_root.scss` publishes it as `--sh-*` variables and
`_bootstrap.scss` maps Bootstrap's theme onto it. The admin area is denser than the storefront in the design, so
`_root.scss` re-points the type tokens under `:root[data-area='admin']` (set by `AdminLayout`).
- **Bootstrap:** grid, containers and utilities only. No Reboot, no component CSS, no Bootstrap JavaScript.
- **Icons:** Bootstrap Icons font (`<i className="bi bi-box-seam" />`) through the `Icon` atom.
- **Component hierarchy:** atoms → molecules → organisms (`src/components`), domain components in `src/features/<name>`,
route-level composition in `src/pages` and `src/layouts`.
- **Money:** the frontend displays backend-confirmed values. It never computes authoritative GST, discounts, shipping,
wallet deductions or order totals; checkout shows the quote the backend returns.
- **State:** server data in TanStack Query, shared client state (auth, cart, UI) in Redux Toolkit, forms in React Hook
Form + Zod. Only the cart and UI preferences are persisted; the access token never is.

## Out of scope here (frontend integration points only)

Live Razorpay payments, India Post tracking and label generation, invoice PDFs, Excel import validation, real
authentication and permissions, inventory reservation and stock enforcement, server-side reports, policy copy. Each has a
clearly labelled mock adapter and an endpoint declaration to replace.

## Fonts

The design uses Inter, loaded from Google Fonts in `index.html`. Self-hosting needs a dependency approval.

## Excel

Excel export uses `exceljs`, always loaded through `@/lib/excel` with a dynamic `import()` so it stays out of the main bundle.
```

`

## `src/app/config/env.js`

```javascript
// Single access point for build-time environment variables. Import { env } from here instead of
// reading import.meta.env directly so every setting is documented in one place.
const toBoolean = (value) => String(value).toLowerCase() === 'true'
const apiBaseUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL ?? ''
const mockSetting = import.meta.env.VITE_USE_MOCK_API ?? ''
// DEV FIXTURES: an explicit VITE_USE_MOCK_API always wins. When it is unset, `npm run dev` with no backend URL
// configured has nothing real to call, so the fixtures are used (the "Mock data" badge shows). Production builds
// never default to them.
const useMockApi = mockSetting === '' ? import.meta.env.DEV && apiBaseUrl === '' : toBoolean(mockSetting)
export const env = Object.freeze({
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: base URL of the API.
apiBaseUrl,
// DEV FIXTURES: when true, API calls are answered from src/mocks (a simulation, not an integration).
useMockApi,
isDevelopment: import.meta.env.DEV,
})
```

## `src/app/initializeApp.js`

```javascript
import { env } from '@/app/config/env'
import { configureHttp, http, queryClient } from '@/app/services'
import { selectAccessToken, signedOut, store } from '@/app/store'
/** One-time wiring that must finish before the first render. */
export async function initializeApp() {
configureHttp({
getAuthToken: () => selectAccessToken(store.getState()),
onUnauthorized: () => {
store.dispatch(signedOut())
queryClient.clear()
},
})
if (env.useMockApi) {
// Loaded lazily so development fixtures are a separate chunk that real builds never fetch.
const { installMockApi } = await import('@/mocks')
installMockApi(http)
}
}
```

import { Provider as ReduxProvider } from 'react-redux'
import { QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { ToastContainer } from 'react-toastify'
import { queryClient } from '@/app/services'
import { store } from '@/app/store'
/** Redux, TanStack Query and toast notifications. The router is composed inside App. */
export default function AppProviders({ children }) {
return (
<ReduxProvider store={store}>
<QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
{children}
<ToastContainer position="top-right" autoClose={4000} limit={3} newestOnTop closeOnClick pauseOnHover />
</QueryClientProvider>
</ReduxProvider>
)
}

## `src/app/router/guards.jsx`

```jsx
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'
import { selectCurrentUser, selectIsAuthenticated } from '@/app/store'
import { paths } from './paths'
// These guards only decide which screens the UI shows. They are NOT security: every API call is
// authorised by the backend, which must reject requests the signed-in user may not make.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: user.role is 'customer' | 'admin'.
/** Customer areas (account, checkout). Sends anonymous visitors to the login page and back again. */
export function RequireAuth() {
const isAuthenticated = useSelector(selectIsAuthenticated)
const location = useLocation()
if (!isAuthenticated) return <Navigate to={paths.login} replace state={{ from: location }} />
return <Outlet />
}
/** Admin dashboard. Anonymous visitors go to the admin login; customers are sent to the storefront. */
export function RequireAdmin() {
const user = useSelector(selectCurrentUser)
const location = useLocation()
if (!user) return <Navigate to={paths.admin.login} replace state={{ from: location }} />
if (user.role !== 'admin') return <Navigate to={paths.home} replace />
return <Outlet />
}
/** Login and signup pages: signed-in users have nothing to do there. */
export function RedirectIfAuthenticated() {
const isAuthenticated = useSelector(selectIsAuthenticated)
const location = useLocation()
if (isAuthenticated) return <Navigate to={location.state?.from?.pathname ?? paths.profile} replace />
return <Outlet />
}
```

```jsx
import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { Outlet, ScrollRestoration, useMatches } from 'react-router-dom'
const SITE_NAME = 'Shipper.com'
/** Top-level route element: sets the document title from route `handle.title` and restores scroll. */
export default function RootRoute() {
const matches = useMatches()
const title = [...matches].reverse().find((match) => match.handle?.title)?.handle.title
useEffect(() => {
document.title = title ? `${title} · ${SITE_NAME}` : SITE_NAME
}, [title])
return (
<>
<Outlet />
<ScrollRestoration />
</>
)
}
```

## `src/app/services/apiError.js`

```javascript
import axios from 'axios'
/** Normalised error thrown by every HTTP call, so UI code never inspects raw Axios errors. */
export class ApiError extends Error {
constructor(message, { status = null, code = null, details = null, cause } = {}) {
super(message, { cause })
this.name = 'ApiError'
this.status = status
this.code = code
this.details = details
}
get isNetworkError() {
return this.code === 'NETWORK_ERROR'
}
get isUnauthorized() {
return this.status === 401
}
}
const STATUS_MESSAGES = {
400: 'That request could not be processed. Please check the details and try again.',
401: 'Please log in to continue.',
403: "You don't have permission to do that.",
404: "We couldn't find what you were looking for.",
409: 'This was changed by someone else. Please refresh and try again.',
422: 'Please check the highlighted fields and try again.',
429: 'Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.',
}
function defaultMessage(status) {
if (STATUS_MESSAGES[status]) return STATUS_MESSAGES[status]
return status >= 500 ? 'Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.' : 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'
}
/**
* Converts anything thrown by Axios into an ApiError. Cancellations pass through untouched so that
* TanStack Query can recognise them.
* * ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: error bodies look like { message, code, errors }.
* Until agreed, only a string `message` is trusted; otherwise a status-based default is used.
*/
export function toApiError(error) {
if (error instanceof ApiError || axios.isCancel(error)) return error
if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
const { response } = error
if (!response) {
return new ApiError('Unable to reach the server. Check your connection and try again.', {
code: 'NETWORK_ERROR',
cause: error,
})
}
const body = response.data
return new ApiError(typeof body?.message === 'string' ? body.message : defaultMessage(response.status), {
status: response.status,
code: typeof body?.code === 'string' ? body.code : null,
details: body?.errors ?? body?.details ?? null,
cause: error,
})
}
return new ApiError(error?.message || 'Something went wrong. Please try again.', { cause: error })
}
/** Message safe to show in a toast or inline error. */
export function getErrorMessage(error, fallback = 'Something went wrong. Please try again.') {
return error instanceof ApiError && error.message ? error.message : fallback
}
```

## `src/app/services/http.js`

```javascript
import axios from 'axios'
import { env } from '@/app/config/env'
import { ApiError, toApiError } from './apiError'
/**
* The single Axios instance for the app. Feature services import `http` and nothing else from
* Axios. Credentials and 401 handling are injected through configureHttp() at start-up, so this
* module never imports the Redux store.
*/
export const http = axios.create({
baseURL: env.apiBaseUrl,
timeout: 20_000,
headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
})
const handlers = {
getAuthToken: () => null,
onUnauthorized: () => {},
}
export function configureHttp(next) {
Object.assign(handlers, next)
}
http.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
const token = handlers.getAuthToken()
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: bearer token vs httpOnly cookie. If the backend uses
// cookies, drop this header and set `withCredentials: true` on the instance instead.
if (token) config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`
return config
})
// A dev server or proxy answers unknown API paths with its index.html (status 200). Treat that as a failed request
// instead of handing a string to code that expects JSON; downloads (blob/arraybuffer) are not checked.
const isHtmlDocument = (response) =>
typeof response.data === 'string' &&
[undefined, 'json'].includes(response.config?.responseType) &&
/^\s*<(!doctype html|html)/i.test(response.data)
http.interceptors.response.use(
(response) => {
if (isHtmlDocument(response)) {
return Promise.reject(
new ApiError(
'The server did not return data. Check VITE_API_BASE_URL, or set VITE_USE_MOCK_API=true to use the development fixtures.',
{ status: response.status, code: 'INVALID_RESPONSE' },
),
)
}
return response
},
(error) => {
const apiError = toApiError(error)
if (apiError.status === 401) handlers.onUnauthorized(apiError)
return Promise.reject(apiError)
},
)
```

## `src/app/services/queryClient.js`

```javascript
import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
// Client errors (4xx) will not succeed on retry; network and server errors get two more attempts.
function shouldRetry(failureCount, error) {
const status = error?.status
if (status >= 400 && status < 500) return false
return failureCount < 2
}
export const queryClient = new QueryClient({
defaultOptions: {
queries: {
staleTime: 30_000,
retry: shouldRetry,
refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
},
mutations: {
retry: 0,
},
},
})
```

```javascript
import { configureStore } from '@reduxjs/toolkit'
import authReducer from './slices/authSlice'
import cartReducer from './slices/cartSlice'
import uiReducer from './slices/uiSlice'
import { createPersistenceMiddleware, loadPersistedState } from './persistence'
export function createAppStore(preloadedState) {
const persistence = createPersistenceMiddleware()
return configureStore({
reducer: { auth: authReducer, cart: cartReducer, ui: uiReducer },
preloadedState,
middleware: (getDefaultMiddleware) => getDefaultMiddleware().prepend(persistence.middleware),
})
}
export const store = createAppStore(loadPersistedState())
export * from './slices/authSlice'
export * from './slices/cartSlice'
export * from './slices/uiSlice'
```

## `src/app/store/persistence.js`

```javascript
import { createListenerMiddleware } from '@reduxjs/toolkit'
import { env } from '@/app/config/env'
import { readJson, readSessionJson, removeSessionItem, writeJson, writeSessionJson } from '@/lib/storage'
import { initialUiState } from './slices/uiSlice'
// Only the cart and UI preferences are persisted. Session state is not: authentication belongs to
// the backend and the access token is never written to storage.
//
// DEV FIXTURES ONLY: when the mock API is on, the *demo* sign-in (user summary) is kept in
// sessionStorage so a page reload does not log the reviewer out, and a first visit starts with the
// cart shown in the design. The mock access token is derived from the user id (`mock-token-<id>`), so
// no secret is ever stored. None of this is used with a real backend.
const STORAGE_KEYS = {
cart: 'shipper.cart.v1',
ui: 'shipper.ui.v1',
}
const MOCK_SESSION_KEY = 'shipper.mock-session.v1'
// DEV FIXTURE: matches the delivery location shown in the design.
const MOCK_DELIVERY_LOCATION = { pin: '226010', city: 'Lucknow' }
// DEV FIXTURE: the cart in the design (Cart and Checkout artboards).
const MOCK_CART_ITEMS = [
{ productCode: 'HL001', quantity: 2, savedForLater: false },
{ productCode: 'SH002', quantity: 1, savedForLater: false },
{ productCode: 'PC003', quantity: 1, savedForLater: false },
]
// Stored data is untrusted (older versions, manual edits), so each slice is rebuilt field by field.
const sanitizers = {
cart(raw) {
if (!raw || !Array.isArray(raw.items)) return undefined
const items = raw.items
.filter((item) => item && typeof item.productCode === 'string' && item.productCode !== '')
.map((item) => ({
productCode: item.productCode,
quantity: Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(item.quantity)) || 1),
savedForLater: item.savedForLater === true,
}))
return { items }
},
ui(raw) {
if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return undefined
const location = raw.deliveryLocation
const validLocation =
location && /^\d{6}$/.test(String(location.pin)) && typeof location.city === 'string'
? { pin: String(location.pin), city: location.city }
: null
return {
...initialUiState,
adminSidebarCollapsed: raw.adminSidebarCollapsed === true,
deliveryLocation: validLocation,
}
},
}
function loadMockSession() {
const user = readSessionJson(MOCK_SESSION_KEY)?.user
if (!user || typeof user.id !== 'string' || typeof user.name !== 'string') return undefined
const text = (value) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value : '')
return {
status: 'authenticated',
accessToken: `mock-token-${user.id}`,
user: { id: user.id, name: user.name, email: text(user.email), mobile: text(user.mobile), role: user.role === 'admin' ? 'admin' : 'customer' },
}
}
export function loadPersistedState() {
const state = {}
Object.entries(STORAGE_KEYS).forEach(([slice, key]) => {
const value = sanitizers[slice](readJson(key))
if (value) state[slice] = value
})
if (env.useMockApi) {
const session = loadMockSession()
if (session) state.auth = session
if (!state.ui) state.ui = { ...initialUiState, deliveryLocation: MOCK_DELIVERY_LOCATION }
if (!state.cart) state.cart = { items: MOCK_CART_ITEMS }
}
return state
}
export function createPersistenceMiddleware() {
const listener = createListenerMiddleware()
listener.startListening({
predicate: (_action, current, previous) => current.cart !== previous.cart || current.ui !== previous.ui,
effect: (_action, api) => {
const { cart, ui } = api.getState()
writeJson(STORAGE_KEYS.cart, cart)
writeJson(STORAGE_KEYS.ui, ui)
},
})
if (env.useMockApi) {
listener.startListening({
predicate: (_action, current, previous) => current.auth !== previous.auth,
effect: (_action, api) => {
const { auth } = api.getState()
if (auth.status === 'authenticated') writeSessionJson(MOCK_SESSION_KEY, { user: auth.user })
else removeSessionItem(MOCK_SESSION_KEY)
},
})
}
return listener
}
```

```javascript
import { createSlice } from '@reduxjs/toolkit'
// UI-facing session state only. Real authentication, token issuing and authorization are backend
// work. ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: bearer token held in memory (below) vs httpOnly
// cookie. If cookies are used, `accessToken` is removed. The token is deliberately not persisted.
const initialState = {
status: 'anonymous', // 'anonymous' | 'authenticated'
user: null, // { id, name, email, mobile, role, ... } as returned by the backend
accessToken: null,
}
const authSlice = createSlice({
name: 'auth',
initialState,
reducers: {
signedIn(state, { payload }) {
state.status = 'authenticated'
state.user = payload.user
state.accessToken = payload.accessToken ?? null
},
signedOut() {
return initialState
},
userUpdated(state, { payload }) {
if (state.user) state.user = { ...state.user, ...payload }
},
},
})
export const { signedIn, signedOut, userUpdated } = authSlice.actions
export default authSlice.reducer
export const selectIsAuthenticated = (state) => state.auth.status === 'authenticated'
export const selectCurrentUser = (state) => state.auth.user
export const selectAccessToken = (state) => state.auth.accessToken
```

## `src/app/store/slices/cartSlice.js`

```javascript
import { createSelector, createSlice } from '@reduxjs/toolkit'
// Client-side cart intent: which products and how many. Prices, GST, shipping, wallet and totals are
// never stored or derived here; they come from the backend quote for these lines.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: a line is identified by product code (e.g. HL001).
const initialState = {
items: [], // [{ productCode, quantity, savedForLater }]
}
const toQuantity = (value) => Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(value)) || 1)
const cartSlice = createSlice({
name: 'cart',
initialState,
reducers: {
itemAdded(state, { payload: { productCode, quantity = 1 } }) {
const line = state.items.find((item) => item.productCode === productCode)
if (line) {
line.quantity += toQuantity(quantity)
line.savedForLater = false
} else {
state.items.push({ productCode, quantity: toQuantity(quantity), savedForLater: false })
}
},
quantityChanged(state, { payload: { productCode, quantity } }) {
const line = state.items.find((item) => item.productCode === productCode)
if (line) line.quantity = toQuantity(quantity)
},
itemRemoved(state, { payload: productCode }) {
state.items = state.items.filter((item) => item.productCode !== productCode)
},
savedForLaterToggled(state, { payload: productCode }) {
const line = state.items.find((item) => item.productCode === productCode)
if (line) line.savedForLater = !line.savedForLater
},
cartCleared() {
return initialState
},
},
})
export const { itemAdded, quantityChanged, itemRemoved, savedForLaterToggled, cartCleared } = cartSlice.actions
export default cartSlice.reducer
const selectItems = (state) => state.cart.items
export const selectActiveCartItems = createSelector([selectItems], (items) =>
items.filter((item) => !item.savedForLater),
)
export const selectSavedForLaterItems = createSelector([selectItems], (items) =>
items.filter((item) => item.savedForLater),
)
/** Units in the cart: the number shown in the header, "Cart (4)". */
export const selectCartUnitCount = createSelector([selectActiveCartItems], (items) =>
items.reduce((total, item) => total + item.quantity, 0),
)
```

import clsx from 'clsx'
import styles from './Avatar.module.scss'
function getInitials(name = '') {
const words = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
if (words.length === 0) return '?'
return (words[0][0] + (words.length > 1 ? words[words.length - 1][0] : '')).toUpperCase()
}
/** Round initials badge ("PY" for Pawan Yadav), or the image when `src` is provided. */
export default function Avatar({ name, src, size = 'md', className }) {
return (
<span role="img" aria-label={name || 'User'} className={clsx(styles.avatar, styles[size], className)}>
{src ? <img src={src} alt="" className={styles.image} /> : getInitials(name)}
</span>
)
}

## `src/components/atoms/Button/Button.jsx`

```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Spinner from '@/components/atoms/Spinner'
import styles from './Button.module.scss'
/**
* variant: primary | secondary | ghost | danger | link size: sm | md | lg
* Render as a router link with `as={Link} to="/cart"`; a disabled non-button is made inert.
*/
export default function Button({
as: Component = 'button',
variant = 'primary',
size = 'md',
fullWidth = false,
loading = false,
disabled = false,
leftIcon,
rightIcon,
className,
children,
type,
onClick,
...rest
}) {
const isNativeButton = Component === 'button'
const isDisabled = disabled || loading
const handleClick = (event) => {
if (isDisabled) {
event.preventDefault()
return
}
onClick?.(event)
}
const stateProps = isNativeButton
? { type: type ?? 'button', disabled: isDisabled }
: { 'aria-disabled': isDisabled || undefined, tabIndex: isDisabled ? -1 : undefined }
return (
<Component
className={clsx(styles.button, styles[variant], styles[size], fullWidth && styles.fullWidth, className)}
aria-busy={loading || undefined}
onClick={handleClick}
{...stateProps}
{...rest}
>
{loading ? <Spinner size="sm" decorative /> : leftIcon && <Icon name={leftIcon} />}
{children}
{!loading && rightIcon && <Icon name={rightIcon} />}
</Component>
)
}
```

import { useId } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import styles from './Card.module.scss'
const PADDING_CLASS = { none: styles.paddingNone, sm: styles.paddingSm, md: styles.paddingMd, lg: styles.paddingLg }
const RADIUS_CLASS = { md: styles.radiusMd, lg: styles.radiusLg }
/**
* Bordered surface used for checkout sections, order cards, admin panels and summaries.
* padding: none | sm | md | lg radius: md (admin) | lg (storefront)
* `title` renders a heading (level via `titleAs`) and labels the section for assistive tech.
*/
export default function Card({
as: Component = 'section',
title,
titleAs: Title = 'h2',
actions,
padding = 'md',
radius = 'lg',
className,
children,
...rest
}) {
const titleId = useId()
return (
<Component
className={clsx(styles.card, PADDING_CLASS[padding], RADIUS_CLASS[radius], className)}
aria-labelledby={title ? titleId : undefined}
{...rest}
>
{(title || actions) && (
<header className={styles.header}>
{title && (
<Title id={titleId} className={styles.title}>
{title}
</Title>
)}
{actions && <div className={styles.actions}>{actions}</div>}
</header>
)}
{children}
</Component>
)
}

```jsx
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { mergeRefs } from '@/lib/mergeRefs'
import styles from './Checkbox.module.scss'
/**
* Checkbox with an optional visible label. When there is no `label` (for example a table row
* selector) pass `aria-label` so the control still has an accessible name.
*/
export default function Checkbox({ ref, label, hint, indeterminate = false, invalid = false, className, id, ...rest }) {
const generatedId = useId()
const inputId = id ?? generatedId
const innerRef = useRef(null)
const setRefs = useMemo(() => mergeRefs(innerRef, ref), [ref])
useEffect(() => {
if (innerRef.current) innerRef.current.indeterminate = indeterminate
}, [indeterminate])
return (
<span className={clsx(styles.root, className)}>
<input
ref={setRefs}
id={inputId}
type="checkbox"
className={clsx(styles.control, invalid && styles.invalid)}
aria-invalid={invalid || undefined}
{...rest}
/>
{label && (
<label htmlFor={inputId} className={styles.label}>
{label}
{hint && <span className={styles.hint}> {hint}</span>}
</label>
)}
</span>
)
}
```

## `src/components/atoms/Radio/Radio.jsx`

```jsx
import { useId } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import styles from './Radio.module.scss'
/** Radio button with an optional visible label; give related radios the same `name`. */
export default function Radio({ ref, label, hint, className, id, ...rest }) {
const generatedId = useId()
const inputId = id ?? generatedId
return (
<span className={clsx(styles.root, className)}>
<input ref={ref} id={inputId} type="radio" className={styles.control} {...rest} />
{label && (
<label htmlFor={inputId} className={styles.label}>
{label}
{hint && <span className={styles.hint}> {hint}</span>}
</label>
)}
</span>
)
}
```

.root {
display: inline-flex;
align-items: flex-start;
gap: 0.5rem;
}
.control {
flex: none;
width: 16px;
height: 16px;
margin: 0.125rem 0 0;
border: 1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sh-color-muted) 55%, white);
border-radius: 50%;
background: var(--sh-color-white);
cursor: pointer;
appearance: none;
transition:
background-color var(--sh-transition),
border-color var(--sh-transition);
&:hover:not(:disabled) {
border-color: var(--sh-color-primary);
}
&:checked {
border-color: var(--sh-color-primary);
background: var(--sh-color-primary);
box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--sh-color-white);
}
&:disabled {
cursor: not-allowed;
opacity: 0.55;
}
}
.label {
color: var(--sh-color-ink);
font-size: var(--sh-font-size-base);
line-height: 1.4;
cursor: pointer;
}
.hint {
color: var(--sh-color-muted);
}

import clsx from 'clsx'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import styles from './Select.module.scss'
/**
* Native <select> with the Shipper control look; use it for short, simple lists.
* For searchable, multi or prefixed dropdowns use the SelectField molecule (react-select).
*/
export default function Select({
ref,
size = 'lg',
variant = 'outline',
invalid = false,
className,
wrapperClassName,
children,
...rest
}) {
return (
<div
className={clsx(styles.wrapper, styles[size], variant === 'filled' && styles.filled, invalid && styles.invalid, wrapperClassName)}
>
<select ref={ref} className={clsx(styles.select, className)} aria-invalid={invalid || undefined} {...rest}>
{children}
</select>
<Icon name="chevron-down" className={styles.chevron} />
</div>
)
}

}

}

```jsx
import { STATUS_META } from '@/app/config/statuses'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
function humanize(key = '') {
const text = String(key).replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ').trim()
return text.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + text.slice(1)
}
/** Badge driven by the status vocabulary: <StatusBadge status="in_transit" />. Unknown keys render neutral. */
export default function StatusBadge({ status, label, ...rest }) {
const meta = STATUS_META[status]
return (
<Badge tone={meta?.tone ?? 'neutral'} {...rest}>
{label ?? meta?.label ?? humanize(status)}
</Badge>
)
}
```

import clsx from 'clsx'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import styles from './Thumbnail.module.scss'
const SIZES = { xs: 32, sm: 40, md: 56, lg: 72, xl: 96 }
/**
* Square product picture with a placeholder glyph when there is no image.
* size: xs 32 | sm 40 (admin tables) | md 56 | lg 72 | xl 96 — or a number of pixels
* Images are decorative by default (the product name is next to them); pass `alt` to describe one.
*/
export default function Thumbnail({ src, alt = '', size = 'sm', className }) {
const dimension = typeof size === 'number' ? size : (SIZES[size] ?? SIZES.sm)
return (
<span className={clsx(styles.thumbnail, className)} style={{ '--thumbnail-size': `${dimension}px` }}>
{src ? <img src={src} alt={alt} loading="lazy" className={styles.image} /> : <Icon name="box-seam" />}
</span>
)
}
```

import clsx from 'clsx'
import { formatAddress, formatMobile } from '@/lib/address'
import styles from './AddressSummary.module.scss'
/**
* Read-only delivery address: name · mobile on the first line, then the address as one muted block.
* Used by checkout, profile, order detail and the admin order panels.
* showContact: show "Aditi Sharma · +91 98765 43210" above the address (default true)
*/
export default function AddressSummary({ address, showContact = true, includeLandmark = false, className }) {
if (!address) return null
const contact = [address.name, address.mobile ? formatMobile(address.mobile) : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')
return (
<div className={clsx(styles.summary, className)}>
{showContact && contact && <p className={styles.contact}>{contact}</p>}
<p className={styles.address}>{formatAddress(address, { includeLandmark })}</p>
</div>
)
}
```

## `src/components/molecules/Alert/Alert.jsx`

```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import IconButton from '@/components/atoms/IconButton'
import styles from './Alert.module.scss'
const DEFAULT_ICONS = {
info: 'info-circle-fill',
success: 'check-circle-fill',
warning: 'exclamation-triangle-fill',
danger: 'exclamation-octagon-fill',
}
/**
* Inline banner. tone: info | success | warning | danger. Warning and danger are announced
* immediately (role="alert"); info and success politely (role="status").
*/
export default function Alert({ tone = 'info', title, icon, action, onDismiss, className, children }) {
return (
<div role={tone === 'danger' || tone === 'warning' ? 'alert' : 'status'} className={clsx(styles.alert, styles[tone], className)}>
<Icon name={icon ?? DEFAULT_ICONS[tone]} className={styles.icon} />
<div className={styles.body}>
{title && <p className={styles.title}>{title}</p>}
{children && <div className={styles.message}>{children}</div>}
</div>
{action && <div className={styles.action}>{action}</div>}
{onDismiss && <IconButton icon="x-lg" label="Dismiss" size="sm" onClick={onDismiss} />}
</div>
)
}
```

## `src/components/molecules/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumbs.jsx`

```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import styles from './Breadcrumbs.module.scss'
/**
* Trail of locations; the last item is the current page and is not a link.
* <Breadcrumbs items={[{ label: 'Home', to: '/' }, { label: 'Haldi', to: '/c/haldi' }, { label: 'Haldi Powder 500g' }]} />
*/
export default function Breadcrumbs({ items, className }) {
return (
<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" className={className}>
<ol className={styles.list}>
{items.map((item, index) => {
const isCurrent = index === items.length - 1
return (
<li key={`${item.label}-${index}`} className={clsx(styles.item, isCurrent && styles.current)}>
{isCurrent || !item.to ? (
<span aria-current={isCurrent ? 'page' : undefined}>{item.label}</span>
) : (
<Link to={item.to} className={styles.link}>
{item.label}
</Link>
)}
{!isCurrent && <Icon name="chevron-right" className={styles.separator} />}
</li>
)
})}
</ol>
</nav>
)
}
```

* as `children`. Renders nothing for an empty selection.

<div className={styles.actions}>{children}</div>
</div>
)
}

## `src/components/molecules/FormField/FormField.jsx`

```jsx
import { useId } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import styles from './FormField.module.scss'
/**
* Label + control + hint/error/success wiring. `children` is a render function that receives the
* accessibility props to spread onto the control (Input, Select, Checkbox, SelectField):
* * <FormField label="Mobile number" required error={errors.mobile?.message}>
* {(control) => <Input {...control} {...register('mobile')} />}
* </FormField>
* * `control` = { id, invalid, 'aria-invalid', 'aria-describedby', 'aria-required' }.
*/
export default function FormField({ label, hint, error, success, required = false, htmlFor, className, children }) {
const baseId = useId()
const controlId = htmlFor ?? `${baseId}-control`
const hintId = `${baseId}-hint`
const messageId = `${baseId}-message`
const showHint = Boolean(hint) && !error
const showSuccess = Boolean(success) && !error
const describedBy = [showHint && hintId, (error || showSuccess) && messageId].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || undefined
const control = {
id: controlId,
invalid: Boolean(error),
'aria-invalid': error ? true : undefined,
'aria-describedby': describedBy,
'aria-required': required || undefined,
}
return (
<div className={clsx(styles.field, className)}>
{label && (
<label htmlFor={controlId} className={styles.label}>
{label}
{required && (
<span aria-hidden="true" className={styles.required}>
{' '}
* </span>
)}
</label>
)}
{typeof children === 'function' ? children(control) : children}
{showHint && (
<p id={hintId} className={styles.hint}>
{hint}
</p>
)}
{error && (
<p id={messageId} role="alert" className={styles.error}>
{error}
</p>
)}
{showSuccess && (
<p id={messageId} className={styles.success}>
<Icon name="check2" /> {success}
</p>
)}
</div>
)
}
```

## `src/components/molecules/Pagination/Pagination.jsx`

```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import { getPageRange } from '@/lib/pagination'
import styles from './Pagination.module.scss'
/** Page buttons: ‹ 1 2 3 ›. Renders nothing when there is a single page. */
export function Pagination({ page, pageCount, onPageChange, siblingCount = 1, className }) {
if (pageCount <= 1) return null
return (
<nav aria-label="Pagination" className={className}>
<ul className={styles.list}>
<li>
<button
type="button"
className={styles.item}
aria-label="Previous page"
disabled={page <= 1}
onClick={() => onPageChange(page - 1)}
>
<Icon name="chevron-left" />
</button>
</li>
{getPageRange(page, pageCount, siblingCount).map((entry) =>
typeof entry === 'string' ? (
<li key={entry} aria-hidden="true" className={styles.ellipsis}>
…
</li>
) : (
<li key={entry}>
<button
type="button"
className={clsx(styles.item, entry === page && styles.active)}
aria-label={`Page ${entry}`}
aria-current={entry === page ? 'page' : undefined}
onClick={() => onPageChange(entry)}
>
{entry}
</button>
</li>
),
)}
<li>
<button
type="button"
className={styles.item}
aria-label="Next page"
disabled={page >= pageCount}
onClick={() => onPageChange(page + 1)}
>
<Icon name="chevron-right" />
</button>
</li>
</ul>
</nav>
)
}
/**
* Footer for grids and tables: "Showing 1–6 of 126 products" on the left, page buttons on the right.
* Page numbers are 1-based. The backend owns paging; `totalItems` comes from its response.
*/
export default function PaginationBar({ page, pageSize, totalItems, onPageChange, itemLabel = 'items', className }) {
const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalItems / pageSize))
const from = totalItems === 0 ? 0 : (page - 1) * pageSize + 1
const to = Math.min(page * pageSize, totalItems)
return (
<div className={clsx(styles.bar, className)}>
<p className={styles.summary} aria-live="polite">
{totalItems === 0
? `No ${itemLabel}`
: `Showing ${formatNumber(from)}–${formatNumber(to)} of ${formatNumber(totalItems)} ${itemLabel}`}
</p>
<Pagination page={page} pageCount={pageCount} onPageChange={onPageChange} />
</div>
)
}
```

## `src/components/molecules/Popover/Popover.jsx`

```jsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import { useOnClickOutside } from '@/hooks/useOnClickOutside'
import styles from './Popover.module.scss'
/**
* Anchored panel for menus, pickers and small forms. Closes on outside click and Escape, and returns
* focus to the trigger when the panel had it.
* * <Popover align="end" trigger={({ props, isOpen }) => <button {...props}>Account</button>}>
* {({ close }) => <nav>…</nav>}
* </Popover>
* * `trigger` receives { props, isOpen }. Spread `props` (ref, onClick and the aria attributes) onto
* the button; use `isOpen` for styling.
*/
export default function Popover({ trigger, children, align = 'start', panelClassName, className }) {
const { isOpen, close, toggle } = useDisclosure()
const rootRef = useRef(null)
const triggerRef = useRef(null)
const panelId = useId()
useOnClickOutside(rootRef, close, isOpen)
// When the panel closes while it held focus, focus would fall back to <body>; return it to the
// trigger instead. If the user clicked elsewhere, focus is already there and is left alone.
useEffect(() => {
if (!isOpen) return undefined
const trigger = triggerRef.current
return () => {
if (document.activeElement === document.body) trigger?.focus()
}
}, [isOpen])
const handleKeyDown = (event) => {
if (event.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
event.stopPropagation()
close()
}
}
const triggerProps = {
ref: triggerRef,
onClick: toggle,
'aria-expanded': isOpen,
'aria-haspopup': 'true',
'aria-controls': isOpen ? panelId : undefined,
}
return (
<div ref={rootRef} className={clsx(styles.root, className)} onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}>
{trigger({ props: triggerProps, isOpen })}
{isOpen && (
<div id={panelId} className={clsx(styles.panel, align === 'end' && styles.alignEnd, panelClassName)}>
{typeof children === 'function' ? children({ close }) : children}
</div>
)}
</div>
)
}
```

## `src/components/molecules/PriceDisplay/PriceDisplay.jsx`
 
```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { formatINR, formatPercent, toNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './PriceDisplay.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Selling price, struck-through MRP and discount badge. Every figure is backend-supplied; nothing
 * is calculated here. The MRP is shown only when it differs from the selling price and the badge
 * only when `discountPercent` is provided.
 *
 * size: md (cards, cart lines) | lg (product page)
 * `mrpLabel="MRP"` and `uppercaseDiscount` reproduce the product-page treatment: ₹120 MRP ₹150 20% OFF.
 */
export default function PriceDisplay({
  sellingPrice,
  mrp,
  discountPercent,
  size = 'md',
  mrpLabel,
  uppercaseDiscount = false,
  className,
}) {
  const selling = toNumber(sellingPrice)
  const maxRetail = toNumber(mrp)
  const discount = toNumber(discountPercent)
  const showMrp = maxRetail !== null && selling !== null && maxRetail > selling
 
  return (
    <div className={clsx(styles.price, styles[size], className)}>
      <span className={styles.selling}>{formatINR(sellingPrice)}</span>
      {showMrp && (
        <span className={styles.mrp}>
          {mrpLabel && <span>{mrpLabel} </span>}
          <s>
            <span className="visually-hidden">Original price </span>
            {formatINR(mrp)}
          </s>
        </span>
      )}
      {discount !== null && discount > 0 && (
        <span className={clsx(styles.discount, uppercaseDiscount && styles.uppercase)}>
          {formatPercent(discount, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })} off
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/components/molecules/QuantityStepper/QuantityStepper.jsx`
 
```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import styles from './QuantityStepper.module.scss'
 
/**
 * "− 1 +" control. `max` is an optional UI limit supplied by the caller (for example the
 * backend-reported purchase limit); this component does not know about stock.
 * The number is typeable: it commits on blur or Enter and reverts if the entry is not a number.
 */
export default function QuantityStepper({
  value,
  onChange,
  min = 1,
  max,
  size = 'md',
  disabled = false,
  label = 'Quantity',
  className,
}) {
  const clamp = (number) => Math.min(max ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, Math.max(min, number))
 
  const commit = (event) => {
    const parsed = Number.parseInt(event.target.value, 10)
    const next = Number.isNaN(parsed) ? value : clamp(parsed)
    if (next === value) {
      event.target.value = String(value)
      return
    }
    onChange(next)
  }
 
  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={label} className={clsx(styles.stepper, styles[size], disabled && styles.disabled, className)}>
      <button
        type="button"
        className={styles.button}
        aria-label="Decrease quantity"
        disabled={disabled || value <= min}
        onClick={() => onChange(clamp(value - 1))}
      >
        <Icon name="dash" />
      </button>
      <input
        key={value}
        className={styles.input}
        inputMode="numeric"
        pattern="[0-9]*"
        aria-label={label}
        defaultValue={value}
        disabled={disabled}
        onBlur={commit}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === 'Enter') event.currentTarget.blur()
        }}
      />
      <button
        type="button"
        className={styles.button}
        aria-label="Increase quantity"
        disabled={disabled || (max !== undefined && value >= max)}
        onClick={() => onChange(clamp(value + 1))}
      >
        <Icon name="plus" />
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/components/molecules/RatingStars/RatingStars.jsx`
 
```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import { formatNumber, toNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './RatingStars.module.scss'
 
const STAR_COUNT = 5
 
function starName(index, rating) {
  if (rating >= index + 1) return 'star-fill'
  if (rating >= index + 0.5) return 'star-half'
  return 'star'
}
 
/** Read-only rating. tone: primary (testimonials) | warning (filters). `count` shows review volume. */
export default function RatingStars({ value, count, showValue = false, tone = 'primary', size = 'md', className }) {
  const rating = Math.min(STAR_COUNT, Math.max(0, toNumber(value) ?? 0))
  const countNumber = toNumber(count)
 
  return (
    <span className={clsx(styles.rating, styles[tone], styles[size], className)}>
      <span role="img" aria-label={`Rated ${rating} out of ${STAR_COUNT}`} className={styles.stars}>
        {Array.from({ length: STAR_COUNT }, (_, index) => (
          <Icon key={index} name={starName(index, rating)} />
        ))}
      </span>
      {showValue && <span className={styles.value}>{rating.toFixed(1)}</span>}
      {countNumber !== null && <span className={styles.count}>({formatNumber(countNumber)})</span>}
    </span>
  )
}
```

import IconButton from '@/components/atoms/IconButton'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
 
/**
 * Controlled search box with a leading icon and a clear button. Submit with Enter via `onSubmit`.
 * Pass `aria-label` (or render a visible label) so the field has an accessible name.
 */
export default function SearchField({
  value,
  onChange,
  onSubmit,
  placeholder = 'Search',
  size = 'lg',
  variant = 'outline',
  className,
  ...rest
}) {
  return (
    <form
      role="search"
      className={className}
      onSubmit={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault()
        onSubmit?.(value)
      }}
    >
      <Input
        type="search"
        size={size}
        variant={variant}
        leftIcon="search"
        value={value}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
        rightSlot={
          value ? <IconButton icon="x-lg" label="Clear search" size="sm" onClick={() => onChange('')} /> : null
        }
        {...rest}
      />
    </form>
  )
}

## `src/components/molecules/SelectField/SelectField.jsx`
 
```jsx
import ReactSelect, { components } from 'react-select'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
 
const HEIGHTS = {
  sm: 'var(--sh-control-h-sm)',
  md: 'var(--sh-control-h-md)',
  lg: 'var(--sh-control-h-lg)',
}
 
function DropdownIndicator(props) {
  return (
    <components.DropdownIndicator {...props}>
      <Icon name="chevron-down" size="0.75rem" />
    </components.DropdownIndicator>
  )
}
 
// Toolbar filters read "Category: All", so an optional prefix is rendered inside the value.
function SingleValue({ children, ...props }) {
  const prefix = props.selectProps.prefixLabel
  return (
    <components.SingleValue {...props}>
      {prefix ? `${prefix} ${children}` : children}
    </components.SingleValue>
  )
}
 
// Average glyph width of Inter semibold in em, and the space the control spends on padding and the chevron.
// Good enough to size a toolbar pill to its text without measuring the DOM.
const FIT_CHAR_WIDTH_EM = 0.6
const FIT_CHROME = '2.5rem'
 
function fitWidthFor(prefixLabel, selected) {
  const characters = (prefixLabel ? prefixLabel.length + 1 : 0) + (selected?.label?.length ?? 0)
  return `calc(${(characters * FIT_CHAR_WIDTH_EM).toFixed(2)}em + ${FIT_CHROME})`
}
 
function buildStyles({ size, invalid, variant, fitWidth }) {
  const borderColor = (state) => {
    if (invalid) return 'var(--sh-color-danger)'
    return state.isFocused ? 'var(--sh-color-primary)' : variant === 'filled' ? 'transparent' : 'var(--sh-color-border)'
  }
 
  const controlFontSize = 'var(--sh-control-font-size, var(--sh-font-size-base))'
 
  return {
    // `fit` pills are sized in em, so the container needs the control's font size to resolve them.
    container: (base) => (fitWidth ? { ...base, width: fitWidth, minWidth: '6rem', maxWidth: '100%', fontSize: controlFontSize } : base),
    control: (base, state) => ({
      ...base,
      minHeight: HEIGHTS[size],
      borderRadius: 'var(--sh-radius-sm)',
      borderColor: borderColor(state),
      backgroundColor: variant === 'filled' ? 'var(--sh-color-surface)' : 'var(--sh-color-white)',
      boxShadow: state.isFocused ? 'var(--sh-focus-ring)' : 'none',
      fontSize: controlFontSize,
      cursor: 'pointer',
      '&:hover': { borderColor: invalid ? 'var(--sh-color-danger)' : 'var(--sh-color-primary)' },
    }),
    valueContainer: (base) => ({ ...base, padding: fitWidth ? '0 0 0 0.625rem' : '0 0.75rem' }),
    placeholder: (base) => ({ ...base, color: 'var(--sh-color-muted)' }),
    singleValue: (base) => ({
      ...base,
      color: 'var(--sh-color-ink)',
      fontWeight: fitWidth ? 'var(--sh-font-weight-semibold)' : 'var(--sh-font-weight-medium)',
    }),
    input: (base) => ({ ...base, color: 'var(--sh-color-ink)' }),
    dropdownIndicator: (base) => ({ ...base, padding: fitWidth ? '0 0.5rem 0 0.25rem' : '0 0.75rem', color: 'var(--sh-color-muted)' }),
    clearIndicator: (base) => ({ ...base, padding: '0 0.25rem' }),
    menu: (base) => ({
      ...base,
      overflow: 'hidden',
      border: '1px solid var(--sh-color-border)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--sh-radius-md)',
      boxShadow: 'var(--sh-shadow-md)',
    }),
    menuPortal: (base) => ({ ...base, zIndex: 'var(--sh-z-popover)' }),
    option: (base, state) => ({
      ...base,
      fontSize: 'var(--sh-control-font-size, var(--sh-font-size-base))',
      cursor: 'pointer',
      color: state.isSelected ? 'var(--sh-color-white)' : 'var(--sh-color-ink)',
      backgroundColor: state.isSelected
        ? 'var(--sh-color-primary)'
        : state.isFocused
          ? 'var(--sh-color-primary-tint)'
          : 'transparent',
      '&:active': { backgroundColor: 'var(--sh-color-primary-tint)' },
    }),
    multiValue: (base) => ({ ...base, borderRadius: 'var(--sh-radius-xs)', backgroundColor: 'var(--sh-color-primary-tint)' }),
    multiValueLabel: (base) => ({ ...base, color: 'var(--sh-color-primary)', fontWeight: 'var(--sh-font-weight-medium)' }),
  }
}
 
/**
 * react-select styled with the Shipper tokens. `value` and `onChange` use plain option values
 * (not option objects), so it works directly with React Hook Form's Controller.
 *
 *   <SelectField options={[{ value: 'haldi', label: 'Haldi' }]} value={category} onChange={setCategory} />
 *   <SelectField prefixLabel="Category:" … />   // toolbar filter reading "Category: All"
 *
 * `fit` sizes a single select to its current text (the compact filter pills in the admin design) instead of
 * filling its container, so the wrapper must not stretch it.
 */
export default function SelectField({
  ref,
  options,
  value,
  onChange,
  isMulti = false,
  isSearchable = false,
  size = 'lg',
  variant = 'outline',
  invalid = false,
  prefixLabel,
  fit = false,
  id,
  ...rest
}) {
  const selected = isMulti
    ? options.filter((option) => (value ?? []).includes(option.value))
    : (options.find((option) => option.value === value) ?? null)
 
  const handleChange = (next) => {
    if (isMulti) onChange?.((next ?? []).map((option) => option.value))
    else onChange?.(next ? next.value : null)
  }
 
  return (
    <ReactSelect
      ref={ref}
      inputId={id}
      options={options}
      value={selected}
      onChange={handleChange}
      isMulti={isMulti}
      isSearchable={isSearchable}
      prefixLabel={prefixLabel}
      components={{ DropdownIndicator, SingleValue, IndicatorSeparator: null }}
      styles={buildStyles({ size, invalid, variant, fitWidth: fit && !isMulti ? fitWidthFor(prefixLabel, selected) : undefined })}
      menuPortalTarget={typeof document === 'undefined' ? undefined : document.body}
      menuPosition="fixed"
      aria-invalid={invalid || undefined}
      {...rest}
    />
  )
}
```

```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import styles from './StatCard.module.scss'
 
/**
 * KPI tile. `value` and `delta` arrive already formatted (formatINR, formatNumber, …) and come
 * from the backend; nothing is derived here.
 *
 * layout: stacked (dashboard: label / value / delta) | inline (filter cards: label left, number right)
 * size: md (default) | lg (admin dashboard headline figures: 28px value, roomier rows)
 * Pass `onClick` to make the tile a toggle button (for example "Delayed orders" filters); `selected`
 * then shows the tinted state.
 * deltaTone: success | danger | neutral
 */
export default function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  delta,
  deltaTone = 'neutral',
  hint,
  icon,
  layout = 'stacked',
  size = 'md',
  selected = false,
  onClick,
  className,
}) {
  const Component = onClick ? 'button' : 'div'
  const interactiveProps = onClick ? { type: 'button', onClick, 'aria-pressed': selected } : {}
 
  return (
    <Component
      className={clsx(styles.card, styles[layout], size === 'lg' && styles.sizeLg, onClick && styles.interactive, selected && styles.selected, className)}
      {...interactiveProps}
    >
      {icon && (
        <span className={styles.icon}>
          <Icon name={icon} />
        </span>
      )}
      <span className={styles.body}>
        <span className={styles.label}>{label}</span>
        <span className={styles.value}>{value}</span>
        {delta && <span className={clsx(styles.delta, styles[deltaTone])}>{delta}</span>}
        {hint && <span className={styles.hint}>{hint}</span>}
      </span>
    </Component>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import styles from './Stepper.module.scss'
 
/** Horizontal progress (e.g. Address → Payment → Review). `currentIndex` is zero-based. */
export default function Stepper({ steps, currentIndex, className }) {
  return (
    <ol className={clsx(styles.stepper, className)}>
      {steps.map((step, index) => {
        const state = index < currentIndex ? 'done' : index === currentIndex ? 'current' : 'upcoming'
        return (
          <li key={step.key} className={clsx(styles.step, styles[state])} aria-current={state === 'current' ? 'step' : undefined}>
            <span className={styles.marker}>{state === 'done' ? <Icon name="check-lg" /> : index + 1}</span>
            <span className={styles.label}>
              {step.label}
              <span className="visually-hidden">{state === 'done' ? ' (completed)' : state === 'current' ? ' (current step)' : ''}</span>
            </span>
          </li>
        )
      })}
    </ol>
  )
}
```

import clsx from 'clsx'
import styles from './SummaryRows.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Label / value list for order and checkout summaries.
 *   rows: [{ label, value, tone?: 'success' | 'danger' | 'muted', emphasis?: boolean, hint? }]
 *
 * `value` is displayed exactly as given. Every figure (subtotal, GST, shipping, wallet, total) is
 * calculated and returned by the backend; this component never adds or subtracts anything.
 * An `emphasis` row is the grand total: it gets a divider above and heavier type.
 */
export default function SummaryRows({ rows, className }) {
  return (
    <dl className={clsx(styles.rows, className)}>
      {rows.map((row, index) => (
        <div key={`${row.label}-${index}`} className={clsx(styles.row, row.emphasis && styles.emphasis, row.tone && styles[row.tone])}>
          <dt className={styles.label}>
            {row.label}
            {row.hint && <span className={styles.hint}>{row.hint}</span>}
          </dt>
          <dd className={styles.value}>{row.value}</dd>
        </div>
      ))}
    </dl>
  )
}

## `src/components/molecules/Tabs/Tabs.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useId, useRef } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './Tabs.module.scss'
 
/**
 * items: [{ key, label, count?, to? }]. variant: underline | pill (the Store Operation tab bar).
 *
 * Two behaviours, chosen by the items:
 *  - no `to`  → in-page tabs (role="tablist"). Pair each with <TabPanel id=… tabKey=… value=…>.
 *  - with `to` → route navigation rendered as links (aria-current="page"), for tabs that are URLs.
 */
export function TabPanel({ id, tabKey, value, children, className }) {
  if (tabKey !== value) return null
  return (
    <div role="tabpanel" id={`${id}-panel-${tabKey}`} aria-labelledby={`${id}-tab-${tabKey}`} tabIndex={0} className={className}>
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}
 
function TabLabel({ item }) {
  return (
    <>
      {item.label}
      {item.count !== undefined && item.count !== null && <span className={styles.count}>{formatNumber(item.count)}</span>}
    </>
  )
}
 
export default function Tabs({ items, value, onChange, id, variant = 'underline', label, className }) {
  const generatedId = useId()
  const baseId = id ?? generatedId
  const listRef = useRef(null)
  const rootClass = clsx(styles.tabs, styles[variant], className)
 
  if (items.some((item) => item.to)) {
    return (
      <nav aria-label={label} className={rootClass}>
        <ul className={styles.list}>
          {items.map((item) => (
            <li key={item.key}>
              <Link
                to={item.to}
                className={clsx(styles.tab, item.key === value && styles.active)}
                aria-current={item.key === value ? 'page' : undefined}
              >
                <TabLabel item={item} />
              </Link>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </nav>
    )
  }
 
  const handleKeyDown = (event) => {
    const currentIndex = Math.max(0, items.findIndex((item) => item.key === value))
    const nextIndexByKey = {
      ArrowRight: (currentIndex + 1) % items.length,
      ArrowLeft: (currentIndex - 1 + items.length) % items.length,
      Home: 0,
      End: items.length - 1,
    }
    const nextIndex = nextIndexByKey[event.key]
    if (nextIndex === undefined) return
 
    event.preventDefault()
    onChange(items[nextIndex].key)
    listRef.current?.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]')[nextIndex]?.focus()
  }
 
  return (
    <div className={rootClass}>
      <div ref={listRef} role="tablist" aria-label={label} className={styles.list} onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}>
        {items.map((item) => {
          const selected = item.key === value
          return (
            <button
              key={item.key}
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              id={`${baseId}-tab-${item.key}`}
              aria-selected={selected}
              aria-controls={`${baseId}-panel-${item.key}`}
              tabIndex={selected ? 0 : -1}
              className={clsx(styles.tab, selected && styles.active)}
              onClick={() => onChange(item.key)}
            >
              <TabLabel item={item} />
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import styles from './Timeline.module.scss'
 
const STATUS_TEXT = { done: 'Completed', current: 'Current step', upcoming: 'Upcoming' }
 
/**
 * Vertical progress list for order and shipment tracking.
 *   items: [{ key, title, description?, timestamp?, status: 'done' | 'current' | 'upcoming' }]
 * Statuses and timestamps come from the backend (the order status history / tracking events).
 * `timestamp` is displayed as given; format it with formatDateTime before passing it in.
 */
export default function Timeline({ items, className }) {
  return (
    <ol className={clsx(styles.timeline, className)}>
      {items.map((item) => (
        <li key={item.key} className={clsx(styles.item, styles[item.status])} aria-current={item.status === 'current' ? 'step' : undefined}>
          <span className={styles.dot} aria-hidden="true" />
          <div className={styles.content}>
            <p className={styles.title}>
              {item.title}
              <span className="visually-hidden"> — {STATUS_TEXT[item.status]}</span>
            </p>
            {item.description && <p className={styles.description}>{item.description}</p>}
            {item.timestamp && <p className={styles.timestamp}>{item.timestamp}</p>}
          </div>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  )
}
```

.timeline {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
 
.item {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.875rem;

  &:last-child {
    padding-bottom: 0;
  }
 
  // Connector to the next step: blue after a completed step, light otherwise.
  &:not(:last-child)::before {

.done .dot,

```jsx
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Modal from '@/components/organisms/Modal'
 
/**
 * Yes/no confirmation. Focus starts on Cancel so Enter never confirms by accident. While `loading`
 * (the caller's pending mutation) the dialog cannot be dismissed.
 *
 *   <ConfirmDialog open={open} onClose={close} onConfirm={remove} tone="danger"
 *     title="Remove item?" message="This item will be removed from your cart." confirmLabel="Remove" />
 */
export default function ConfirmDialog({
  open,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
  title,
  message,
  confirmLabel = 'Confirm',
  cancelLabel = 'Cancel',
  tone = 'primary',
  loading = false,
}) {
  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      size="sm"
      title={title}
      closeOnBackdrop={!loading}
      closeOnEscape={!loading}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" data-autofocus disabled={loading} onClick={onClose}>
            {cancelLabel}
          </Button>
          <Button variant={tone === 'danger' ? 'danger' : 'primary'} loading={loading} onClick={onConfirm}>
            {confirmLabel}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div>{message}</div>
    </Modal>
  )
}
```

## `src/components/organisms/DataTable/DataTable.jsx`
```jsx
import { useMemo } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import { PaginationBar } from '@/components/molecules/Pagination'
import styles from './DataTable.module.scss'
const NEXT_DIRECTION = { none: 'asc', asc: 'desc', desc: null }
const SORT_ARIA = { none: 'none', asc: 'ascending', desc: 'descending' }
const SORT_ICON = { none: 'arrow-down-up', asc: 'arrow-up', desc: 'arrow-down' }
const INTERACTIVE_SELECTOR = 'a, button, input, select, textarea, label, [role="button"]'
/**
* Presentational table for admin lists. Paging, sorting and filtering are owned by the backend:
* this component displays the current page and reports user intent through callbacks.
*
* columns: [{ key, header, cell?(row), sortable?, align?: 'left'|'right'|'center', width?, className? }]
*   `cell` defaults to row[key]. A sortable column cycles ascending → descending → cleared.
* sort:    { key, direction: 'asc' | 'desc' } | null          onSortChange(sort | null)
* selection (optional): selectable + selectedIds + onSelectionChange(ids). "Select all" acts on the
*   rows currently shown and keeps selections made on other pages.
* rowActions(row): node rendered in a trailing column (IconButtons, a menu trigger, …).
* onRowClick(row): mouse convenience; keep a real link or button in the row for keyboard users.
* pagination: { page, pageSize, totalItems, onPageChange, itemLabel }
* maxHeight: gives the table its own vertical scroll area and keeps the header pinned.
*/
export default function DataTable({
  caption,
  columns,
  rows,
  getRowId = (row) => row.id,
  selectable = false,
  selectedIds = [],
  onSelectionChange,
  getRowLabel,
  sort = null,
  onSortChange,
  rowActions,
  actionsHeader = 'Actions',
  onRowClick,
  loading = false,
  loadingRows = 6,
  emptyState,
  pagination,
  maxHeight,
  minWidth = '720px',
  className,
}) {
  const selected = useMemo(() => new Set(selectedIds), [selectedIds])
  const pageIds = useMemo(() => rows.map(getRowId), [rows, getRowId])
  const allSelected = pageIds.length > 0 && pageIds.every((id) => selected.has(id))
  const someSelected = pageIds.some((id) => selected.has(id))
  const columnCount = columns.length + (selectable ? 1 : 0) + (rowActions ? 1 : 0)
  const toggleAll = () => {
    const next = new Set(selected)
    pageIds.forEach((id) => (allSelected ? next.delete(id) : next.add(id)))
    onSelectionChange?.([...next])
  }
  const toggleRow = (id) => {
    const next = new Set(selected)
    if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id)
    else next.add(id)
    onSelectionChange?.([...next])
  }
  const cycleSort = (key) => {
    const current = sort?.key === key ? sort.direction : 'none'
    const direction = NEXT_DIRECTION[current]
    onSortChange?.(direction ? { key, direction } : null)
  }
  const handleRowClick = (event, row) => {
    if (event.target.closest(INTERACTIVE_SELECTOR)) return
    onRowClick(row)
  }
  return (
<div className={clsx(styles.root, className)}>
<div className={styles.scroll} style={{ maxHeight }}>
<table className={styles.table} style={{ minWidth }} aria-busy={loading || undefined}>
<caption className="visually-hidden">{caption}</caption>
<thead>
<tr>
              {selectable && (
<th scope="col" className={styles.selectCell}>
<Checkbox
                    aria-label="Select all rows on this page"
                    checked={allSelected}
                    indeterminate={someSelected && !allSelected}
                    disabled={loading || pageIds.length === 0}
                    onChange={toggleAll}
                  />
</th>
              )}
              {columns.map((column) => {
                const direction = sort?.key === column.key ? sort.direction : 'none'
                return (
<th
                    key={column.key}
                    scope="col"
                    aria-sort={column.sortable ? SORT_ARIA[direction] : undefined}
                    className={clsx(styles[column.align], column.className)}
                    style={{ width: column.width }}
>
                    {column.sortable ? (
<button
                        type="button"
                        className={clsx(styles.sortButton, direction !== 'none' && styles.sorted)}
                        onClick={() => cycleSort(column.key)}
>
                        {column.header}
<Icon name={SORT_ICON[direction]} />
</button>
                    ) : (
                      column.header
                    )}
</th>
                )
              })}
              {rowActions && (
<th scope="col" className={styles.actionsCell}>
                  {actionsHeader}
</th>
              )}
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
            {loading &&
              Array.from({ length: loadingRows }, (_, rowIndex) => (
<tr key={`loading-${rowIndex}`}>
                  {Array.from({ length: columnCount }, (_, cellIndex) => (
<td key={cellIndex}>
<Skeleton height="0.875rem" width={`${55 + ((rowIndex * 7 + cellIndex * 13) % 40)}%`} />
</td>
                  ))}
</tr>
              ))}
            {!loading && rows.length === 0 && (
<tr>
<td colSpan={columnCount} className={styles.empty}>
                  {emptyState ?? (
<EmptyState
                      compact
                      icon="search"
                      title="No results found"
                      description="Try changing or clearing your filters."
                    />
                  )}
</td>
</tr>
            )}
            {!loading &&
              rows.map((row) => {
                const id = getRowId(row)
                const isSelected = selected.has(id)
                return (
<tr
                    key={id}
                    className={clsx(isSelected && styles.selectedRow, onRowClick && styles.clickable)}
                    onClick={onRowClick ? (event) => handleRowClick(event, row) : undefined}
>
                    {selectable && (
<td className={styles.selectCell}>
<Checkbox
                          aria-label={getRowLabel ? `Select ${getRowLabel(row)}` : 'Select row'}
                          checked={isSelected}
                          onChange={() => toggleRow(id)}
                        />
</td>
                    )}
                    {columns.map((column) => (
<td key={column.key} className={clsx(styles[column.align], column.className)}>
                        {column.cell ? column.cell(row) : row[column.key]}
</td>
                    ))}
                    {rowActions && <td className={styles.actionsCell}>{rowActions(row)}</td>}
</tr>
                )
              })}
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
      {pagination && (
<div className={styles.footer}>
<PaginationBar {...pagination} />
</div>
      )}
</div>
  )
}
```

## `src/components/organisms/Overlay/Overlay.jsx`
```jsx
import { useId, useRef } from 'react'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import IconButton from '@/components/atoms/IconButton'
import { useOverlay } from '@/hooks/useOverlay'
import styles from './Overlay.module.scss'
/**
* Internal base for Modal and Drawer; import those instead.
*
* Rendered through a portal and layered with the z-index tokens (drawer < modal < popover < toast)
* rather than the browser top layer, so react-select menus and toasts stay visible above it.
*/
export default function Overlay({
  open,
  onClose,
  placement,
  size,
  title,
  description,
  footer,
  closeOnBackdrop = true,
  closeOnEscape = true,
  className,
  children,
}) {
  const panelRef = useRef(null)
  const titleId = useId()
  const descriptionId = useId()
  useOverlay({ open, onClose, containerRef: panelRef, closeOnEscape })
  if (!open) return null
  return createPortal(
<div
      className={clsx(styles.root, styles[placement])}
      onMouseDown={(event) => {
        if (closeOnBackdrop && event.target === event.currentTarget) onClose()
      }}
>
<div
        ref={panelRef}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby={titleId}
        aria-describedby={description ? descriptionId : undefined}
        tabIndex={-1}
        className={clsx(styles.panel, size && styles[size], className)}
>
<header className={styles.header}>
<div className={styles.heading}>
<h2 id={titleId} className={styles.title}>
              {title}
</h2>
            {description && (
<p id={descriptionId} className={styles.description}>
                {description}
</p>
            )}
</div>
<IconButton icon="x-lg" label="Close" onClick={onClose} />
</header>
<div className={styles.body} data-overlay-body>
          {children}
</div>
        {footer && <footer className={styles.footer}>{footer}</footer>}
</div>
</div>,
    document.body,
  )
}
```

```scss
@use '@/styles/mixins' as *;
.root {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  background: var(--sh-color-scrim);
  animation: fade-in 160ms ease;
}
.panel {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--sh-color-white);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-shadow-lg);
  outline: none;
}
.header {
  display: flex;
  flex: none;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sh-color-border);
}
.heading {
  min-width: 0;
}
.title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-lg);
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.description {
  margin: 0.25rem 0 0;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-base);
}
.body {
  min-height: 0;
  flex: 1;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.footer {
  display: flex;
  flex: none;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--sh-color-border);
}
// ── Centered modal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.center {
  z-index: var(--sh-z-modal);
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1rem;
  .panel {
    width: 100%;
    max-height: calc(100dvh - 2rem);
    border-radius: var(--sh-radius-xl);
    animation: pop-in 180ms ease;
  }
  .sm {
    max-width: 440px;
  }
  .md {
    max-width: 640px;
  }
  .lg {
    max-width: var(--sh-modal-w);
  }
  @include down('sm') {
    padding: 0.5rem;
    .header,
    .body,
    .footer {
      padding-right: 1rem;
      padding-left: 1rem;
    }
  }
}
// ── Side drawer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.right {
  z-index: var(--sh-z-drawer);
  justify-content: flex-end;
  .panel {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: var(--sh-drawer-w);
    height: 100dvh;
    animation: slide-in-right 220ms ease;
  }
}
// ── Bottom sheet (mobile filters and pickers) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
.bottom {
  z-index: var(--sh-z-drawer);
  align-items: flex-end;
  .panel {
    width: 100%;
    max-height: 88dvh;
    border-radius: var(--sh-radius-xl) var(--sh-radius-xl) 0 0;
    animation: slide-in-up 220ms ease;
  }
}
@keyframes fade-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}
@keyframes pop-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px) scale(0.98);
  }
}
@keyframes slide-in-right {
  from {
    transform: translateX(100%);
  }
}
@keyframes slide-in-up {
  from {
    transform: translateY(100%);
  }
}
```
