## `src/components/organisms/ProductCard/ProductCard.jsx`
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import PriceDisplay from '@/components/molecules/PriceDisplay'
import QuantityStepper from '@/components/molecules/QuantityStepper'
import { useAddToCart } from './useAddToCart'
import styles from './ProductCard.module.scss'
const STOCK_TONE = { in_stock: 'inStock', low_stock: 'lowStock', out_of_stock: 'soldOut' }
function stockLabel({ stockStatus, lowStockLeft }) {
  if (stockStatus === 'out_of_stock') return 'Out of stock'
  return stockStatus === 'low_stock' ? `Only ${lowStockLeft} left · incl. GST` : 'In stock · incl. GST'
}
/**
* Storefront product tile: picture, "Category · size", name, price, availability, quantity and the
* Add to Cart / Buy Now actions. `product` is a catalogue summary (see features/catalog services).
* Pass `onToggleSaved` (and `isSaved`) to show the heart; it is hidden otherwise.
*/
export default function ProductCard({ product, isSaved = false, onToggleSaved, className }) {
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1)
  const { addToCart, buyNow } = useAddToCart()
  const soldOut = product.stockStatus === 'out_of_stock'
  const handleAdd = () => {
    addToCart(product, quantity)
    setQuantity(1)
  }
  return (
<article className={clsx(styles.card, soldOut && styles.unavailable, className)}>
<div className={styles.media}>
<img src={product.image} alt={product.name} className={styles.image} loading="lazy" />
        {soldOut && (
<Badge tone="neutral" className={styles.soldOutBadge}>
            Sold out
</Badge>
        )}
        {onToggleSaved && (
<button
            type="button"
            className={clsx(styles.save, isSaved && styles.saved)}
            aria-pressed={isSaved}
            aria-label={isSaved ? `Remove ${product.name} from saved products` : `Save ${product.name}`}
            onClick={() => onToggleSaved(product.code)}
>
<Icon name={isSaved ? 'heart-fill' : 'heart'} />
</button>
        )}
</div>
<p className={styles.meta}>
        {product.categoryLabel} · {product.unit}
</p>
<h3 className={styles.name}>
<Link to={paths.product(product.slug)} className={styles.nameLink}>
          {product.name}
</Link>
</h3>
<PriceDisplay
        className={styles.price}
        sellingPrice={product.sellingPrice}
        mrp={product.mrp}
        discountPercent={product.discountPercent}
      />
<p className={clsx(styles.stock, styles[STOCK_TONE[product.stockStatus]])}>{stockLabel(product)}</p>
<div className={styles.controls}>
<div className={styles.quantity}>
<span className={styles.quantityLabel}>Qty</span>
<QuantityStepper
            size="sm"
            value={quantity}
            onChange={setQuantity}
            max={product.purchaseLimit}
            disabled={soldOut}
            label={`Quantity of ${product.name}`}
          />
</div>
<div className={styles.actions}>
<Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={soldOut} onClick={handleAdd}>
            Add to Cart
</Button>
<Button size="sm" disabled={soldOut} onClick={() => buyNow(product, quantity)}>
            Buy Now
</Button>
</div>
</div>
</article>
  )
}
```
## `src/components/organisms/ProductCard/ProductCard.module.scss`
 
```scss
@use '@/styles/mixins' as *;
 
// Anatomy measured at the 1440 artboard (13px padding, 218px picture, name reserved to two lines) and
// the 390 artboard (10px padding, 145px picture, stacked buttons).
.card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 0.625rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--sh-color-border);
  border-radius: var(--sh-radius-lg);
  background: var(--sh-color-white);
  transition:
    border-color var(--sh-transition),
    box-shadow var(--sh-transition);
 
  &:hover,
  &:focus-within {
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sh-color-primary) 30%, var(--sh-color-border));
    box-shadow: var(--sh-shadow-md);
  }
 
  @include up('md') {
    padding: 0.8125rem;
  }
}
 
.media {
  position: relative;
  height: 145px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--sh-radius-md);
  background: var(--sh-color-surface);
 
  @include up('md') {
    height: 218px;
  }
}
 
.image {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}
 
.unavailable .image {
  opacity: 0.55;
  filter: grayscale(0.6);
}
 
.soldOutBadge {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.5rem;
  left: 0.5rem;
}
 
.save {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 2;
  top: 0.5rem;
  right: 0.5rem;
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sh-color-white) 92%, transparent);
  color: var(--sh-color-ink);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-shadow-sm);
  transition:
    color var(--sh-transition),
    transform var(--sh-transition);
 
  &:hover {
    color: var(--sh-color-danger);
    transform: scale(1.06);
  }
}
 
.saved {
  color: var(--sh-color-danger);
}
 
.meta {
  margin: 0.625rem 0 0;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  line-height: 1rem;
 
  @include up('md') {
    font-size: var(--sh-font-size-2xs);
  }
}
 
.name {
  // Two lines are always reserved so prices line up across a row of cards.
  min-height: calc(2 * 1.3em);
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-sm);
  line-height: 1.3;
 
  @include up('md') {
    margin-top: 0.6875rem;
    font-size: var(--sh-font-size-md);
  }
}
 
.nameLink {
  color: var(--sh-color-navy);
 
  // Stretches the link over the whole card; the controls below sit above it.
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
  }
 
  &:hover {
    color: var(--sh-color-primary);
  }
 
  &:focus-visible {
    outline: none;
    box-shadow: none;
 
    &::after {
      box-shadow: var(--sh-focus-ring);
    }
  }
}
 
.price {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
 
  @include up('md') {
    margin-top: 1rem;
  }
}
 
// The phone artboard sets the price one step smaller than the desktop one (specificity beats PriceDisplay's size class).
.card .price {
  @include down('md') {
    > :first-child {
      font-size: var(--sh-font-size-lg);
    }
 
    > :not(:first-child) {
      font-size: 0.625rem;
    }
  }
}
 
.stock {
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-2xs);
  line-height: 1.125rem;
 
  @include up('md') {
    margin-top: 0.75rem;
  }
}
 
.inStock {
  color: var(--sh-color-success);
}
 
.lowStock {
  color: var(--sh-color-warning);
}
 
.soldOut {
  color: var(--sh-color-danger);
  font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-medium);
}
 
.controls {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 0.5rem;
 
  @include up('md') {
    padding-top: 0.5625rem;
  }
}
 
.quantity {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
 
.quantityLabel {
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-xs);
}
 
.actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-top: 0.6875rem;
}

## `src/components/organisms/ProductCard/useAddToCart.js`
 
```javascript
import { useCallback } from 'react'
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { itemAdded } from '@/app/store'
 
/**
 * Cart intent for product tiles and the product page. Prices and totals come from the backend quote,
 * so only the product code and quantity are stored.
 *   addToCart(product, quantity)  adds the line and confirms with a toast
 *   buyNow(product, quantity)     adds the line and opens checkout (signed-out visitors are sent to login by the route guard)
 */
export function useAddToCart() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
 
  const addToCart = useCallback(
    (product, quantity = 1) => {
      dispatch(itemAdded({ productCode: product.code, quantity }))
      toast.success(quantity > 1 ? `${quantity} × ${product.name} added to your cart.` : `${product.name} added to your cart.`)
    },
    [dispatch],
  )
 
  const buyNow = useCallback(
    (product, quantity = 1) => {
      dispatch(itemAdded({ productCode: product.code, quantity }))
      navigate(paths.checkout)
    },
    [dispatch, navigate],
  )
 
  return { addToCart, buyNow }
}
```

function SearchGalleryDemo() {

    </div>
  )

function PaginationDemo() {

  return <PaginationBar page={page} pageSize={6} totalItems={126} onPageChange={setPage} itemLabel="products" />

function TabsDemo() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('all')

      <Tabs id="gallery-store" label="Store operation" variant="pill" items={STORE_TABS} value={storeTab} onChange={setStoreTab} />
    </div>

}
 
function StatCardDemo() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(true)
  return (
    <div className={styles.stack}>
      <StatCard layout="inline" label="All products" value="126" selected={selected} onClick={() => setSelected((value) => !value)} />
      <StatCard layout="inline" label="Delayed orders" value="7" onClick={() => {}} />
    </div>
  )
}
 
export default function ComponentGallery() {
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <header className={styles.header}>
        <div className="sh-container">
          <h1>Component gallery</h1>
          <p>Development reference with placeholder data. Not part of the customer or admin apps.</p>
        </div>
      </header>
      <nav className={styles.nav} aria-label="Gallery sections">
        <div className="sh-container d-flex gap-4">
          {['tokens', 'buttons', 'badges', 'forms', 'commerce', 'navigation', 'feedback', 'overlays', 'table'].map((id) => (
            <a key={id} href={`#${id}`}>
              {id}
            </a>
          ))}
        </div>
      </nav>
      <main className="sh-container">
        <AtomSections />
        <OrganismSections />
      </main>
    </div>
  )
}

}

    cell: (row) => (
      <>
        <strong>{row.name}</strong>
        <div className="text-secondary small">{row.code}</div>
      </>
    ),
  },
  { key: 'category', header: 'Category', sortable: true },
  { key: 'price', header: 'Selling price', align: 'right', sortable: true, cell: (row) => formatINR(row.price) },
  { key: 'stock', header: 'Stock', align: 'right' },
  { key: 'status', header: 'Status', cell: (row) => <StatusBadge status={row.status} /> },
]
 
const CATEGORY_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'haldi', label: 'Haldi' },
  { value: 'shampoo', label: 'Shampoo' },
  { value: 'cosmetics', label: 'Cosmetics' },
]
 
function TableDemo() {
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState(['P-1002'])
  const [sort, setSort] = useState({ key: 'name', direction: 'asc' })
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1)
  const [mode, setMode] = useState('data')
 
  // Demo only: the real table is sorted by the backend; this keeps the specimen interactive.
  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    if (mode === 'empty') return []
    if (!sort) return SAMPLE_PRODUCTS
    const factor = sort.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1
    return [...SAMPLE_PRODUCTS].sort((a, b) => (a[sort.key] > b[sort.key] ? factor : -factor))
  }, [mode, sort])
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.stack}>
      <div className={styles.row}>
        {['data', 'loading', 'empty'].map((option) => (
          <Button key={option} size="sm" variant={mode === option ? 'primary' : 'secondary'} onClick={() => setMode(option)}>
            {option}
          </Button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <BulkActionBar selectedCount={selectedIds.length} itemLabel="product" onClear={() => setSelectedIds([])}>
        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary">
          Mark inactive
        </Button>
      </BulkActionBar>
      <DataTable
        caption="Sample products"
        columns={PRODUCT_COLUMNS}
        rows={rows}
        loading={mode === 'loading'}
        selectable
        selectedIds={selectedIds}
        onSelectionChange={setSelectedIds}
        getRowLabel={(row) => row.name}
        sort={sort}
        onSortChange={setSort}
        rowActions={(row) => (
          <>
            <IconButton icon="eye" label={`View ${row.name}`} size="sm" />
            <IconButton icon="pencil" label={`Edit ${row.name}`} size="sm" />
          </>
        )}
        pagination={{ page, pageSize: 5, totalItems: 126, onPageChange: setPage, itemLabel: 'products' }}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
 
function OverlayDemo() {
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false)
  const [drawerOpen, setDrawerOpen] = useState(false)
  const [sheetOpen, setSheetOpen] = useState(false)
  const [confirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false)
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('haldi')
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.row}>
      <Button onClick={() => setModalOpen(true)}>Open modal</Button>
      <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(true)}>
        Open drawer
      </Button>
      <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setSheetOpen(true)}>
        Open bottom sheet
      </Button>
      <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(true)}>
        Confirm dialog
      </Button>
 
      <Modal
        open={modalOpen}
        onClose={() => setModalOpen(false)}
        title="Add product"
        description="The select menu below must render above this dialog."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(true)}>Save product</Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="row g-3">
          <div className="col-md-6">
            <FormField label="Product name" required>
              {(control) => <Input {...control} placeholder="Haldi Powder 500g" />}
            </FormField>
          </div>
          <div className="col-md-6">
            <FormField label="Category" required>
              {(control) => <SelectField id={control.id} options={CATEGORY_OPTIONS} value={category} onChange={setCategory} />}
            </FormField>
          </div>
          <div className="col-12" style={{ minHeight: '28rem' }} />
        </div>
      </Modal>
 
      <Drawer
        open={drawerOpen}
        onClose={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}
        title="Edit address"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}>Save address</Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <FormField label="Full name" required>
          {(control) => <Input {...control} defaultValue="Pawan Yadav" />}
        </FormField>
      </Drawer>
 
      <Drawer open={sheetOpen} onClose={() => setSheetOpen(false)} placement="bottom" title="Filters">
        <p className="mb-0">Bottom sheet content.</p>
      </Drawer>
 
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirmOpen}
        onClose={() => setConfirmOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={() => setConfirmOpen(false)}
        tone="danger"
        title="Remove item?"
        message="This item will be removed from your cart."
        confirmLabel="Remove"
      />
    </div>
  )
}
 
export default function OrganismSections() {
  return (
    <>
      <Section id="overlays" title="Modal, drawer and confirm dialog" description="Esc closes the top-most overlay; Tab stays inside it; focus returns to the trigger.">
        <Specimen label="Triggers" wide>
          <OverlayDemo />
        </Specimen>
      </Section>
      <Section id="table" title="DataTable" description="Selection, sorting, row actions, sticky header, pagination, loading and empty states.">
        <Specimen label="Products" wide>
          <TableDemo />
        </Specimen>
      </Section>
    </>
  )
}

## `src/features/addresses/components/AddressDrawer/AddressDrawer.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { State } from 'country-state-city'
import { Controller, useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import Drawer from '@/components/organisms/Drawer'
import { useSaveAddress } from '@/features/addresses/hooks/useAddresses'
import { addressSchema } from '@/features/addresses/schemas/addressSchema'
import { useServiceabilityCheck } from '@/features/storefront/hooks/useServiceabilityCheck'
import { formatMobile } from '@/lib/address'
import styles from './AddressDrawer.module.scss'
 
const STATE_OPTIONS = State.getStatesOfCountry('IN').map((state) => ({ value: state.name, label: state.name }))
const PIN_PATTERN = /^[1-9]\d{5}$/
 
const emptyAddress = (defaults) => ({
  label: '',
  name: defaults?.name ?? '',
  mobile: defaults?.mobile ?? '',
  line1: '',
  line2: '',
  landmark: '',
  city: '',
  pin: '',
  state: '',
  isDefault: false,
})
 
function AddressForm({ address, defaults, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const save = useSaveAddress()
  const serviceability = useServiceabilityCheck()
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    getValues,
    setValue,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(addressSchema),
    defaultValues: address
      ? { ...address, mobile: formatMobile(address.mobile).replace('+91 ', ''), landmark: address.landmark ?? '' }
      : emptyAddress(defaults),
  })
 
  const pin = useWatch({ control, name: 'pin' })
  // A fresh answer for this exact PIN wins; otherwise an unchanged PIN keeps the saved address's status.
  const checked = serviceability.data && serviceability.data.pin === pin ? serviceability.data : null
  const deliveryAvailable = checked ? checked.serviceable : address && address.pin === pin ? address.verified : null
 
  // City and state are filled for a serviceable PIN the customer has not typed them for yet.
  const handlePinChange = (event) => {
    const value = event.target.value.trim()
    if (!PIN_PATTERN.test(value)) return
    serviceability.mutate(value, {
      onSuccess: (result) => {
        if (!result.serviceable) return
        if (!getValues('city')) setValue('city', result.city, { shouldValidate: true })
        if (!getValues('state')) setValue('state', result.state, { shouldValidate: true })
      },
    })
  }
 
  const onSubmit = handleSubmit((values) => {
    save.mutate(
      { ...values, id: address?.id },
      {
        onSuccess: (saved) => {
          toast.success('Address saved.')
          onSaved?.(saved)
          onClose()
        },
        onError: (error) => toast.error(error.message || 'We could not save this address. Please try again.'),
      },
    )
  })
 
  return (
    <form id="address-form" className={styles.form} onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
      {save.isError && <Alert tone="danger">{save.error.message}</Alert>}
 
      <FormField label="Address label" error={errors.label?.message}>
        {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('label')} autoComplete="off" placeholder="Home, Office…" />}
      </FormField>
 
      <div className={styles.row}>
        <FormField label="Full name" error={errors.name?.message}>
          {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('name')} autoComplete="name" />}
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Mobile" error={errors.mobile?.message}>
          {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('mobile')} inputMode="numeric" autoComplete="tel-national" />}
        </FormField>
      </div>
 
      <FormField label="House / flat / building" error={errors.line1?.message}>
        {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('line1')} autoComplete="address-line1" />}
      </FormField>
 
      <FormField label="Street / area" error={errors.line2?.message}>
        {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('line2')} autoComplete="address-line2" />}
      </FormField>
 
      <FormField label="Landmark (optional)" error={errors.landmark?.message}>
        {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('landmark')} />}
      </FormField>
 
      <div className={styles.row}>
        <FormField label="City" error={errors.city?.message}>
          {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('city')} autoComplete="address-level2" />}
        </FormField>
        <FormField
          label="PIN code"
          error={errors.pin?.message ?? (deliveryAvailable === false ? 'We do not deliver to this PIN code yet.' : undefined)}
          success={deliveryAvailable ? 'Delivery available' : undefined}
        >
          {(field) => (
            <Input {...field} {...register('pin', { onChange: handlePinChange })} inputMode="numeric" maxLength={6} autoComplete="postal-code" />
          )}
        </FormField>
      </div>
 
      <FormField label="State" error={errors.state?.message}>
        {(field) => (
          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="state"
            render={({ field: { value, onChange } }) => (
              <SelectField
                id={field.id}
                options={STATE_OPTIONS}
                value={value}
                onChange={onChange}
                isSearchable
                invalid={field.invalid}
                placeholder="Select state"
              />
            )}
          />
        )}
      </FormField>
 
      <Checkbox label="Set as default delivery address" {...register('isDefault')} />
 
      <div className={styles.actions}>
        <Button variant="secondary" size="lg" onClick={onClose}>
          Cancel
        </Button>
        <Button type="submit" size="lg" loading={save.isPending}>
          Save address
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  )
}
 
/**
 * Add / edit address drawer, shared by the profile and checkout screens.
 *   address: the address being edited, or null to add a new one
 *   defaults: { name, mobile } pre-filled for a new address
 *   onSaved(address): called with the address returned by the backend
 * The form is rendered only while the drawer is open, so every opening starts from fresh values.
 */
export default function AddressDrawer({ open, onClose, address = null, defaults, onSaved }) {
  return (
    <Drawer
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={address ? 'Edit address' : 'Add new address'}
      description="Keep your delivery details up to date."
    >
      <AddressForm key={address?.id ?? 'new'} address={address} defaults={defaults} onClose={onClose} onSaved={onSaved} />
    </Drawer>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/addresses/hooks/useAddresses.js`
 
```javascript
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { cartKeys } from '@/features/cart'
import {
  createAddress,
  deleteAddress,
  listAddresses,
  setDefaultAddress,
  updateAddress,
} from '@/features/addresses/services/addressService'
 
export const addressKeys = {
  all: ['addresses'],
  list: () => ['addresses', 'list'],
}
 
/** Saved addresses of the signed-in customer, default address first. */
export function useAddresses({ enabled = true } = {}) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: addressKeys.list(),
    queryFn: listAddresses,
    enabled,
    select: (items) => [...items].sort((a, b) => Number(b.isDefault) - Number(a.isDefault)),
  })
}
 
// Any address change can alter delivery fees and ETAs, so cart quotes are refreshed too.
function useAddressMutation(mutationFn) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn,
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: addressKeys.all })
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: cartKeys.all })
    },
  })
}
 
/** Creates a new address, or updates one when the payload contains an `id`. */
export const useSaveAddress = () => useAddressMutation((payload) => (payload.id ? updateAddress(payload) : createAddress(payload)))
export const useDeleteAddress = () => useAddressMutation(deleteAddress)
export const useSetDefaultAddress = () => useAddressMutation(setDefaultAddress)
```

import { z } from 'zod'
import { mobileSchema, pinCodeSchema, requiredText } from '@/lib/validation'
 
// Shape and length checks for a better form experience; the backend validates and verifies the address.
export const addressSchema = z.object({
  label: requiredText('Give this address a label, for example Home or Office').max(24, 'Use 24 characters or fewer'),
  name: requiredText('Enter the full name of the person receiving the order'),
  mobile: mobileSchema,
  line1: requiredText('Enter the house, flat or building'),
  line2: requiredText('Enter the street or area'),
  landmark: z.string().trim().max(80, 'Use 80 characters or fewer'),
  city: requiredText('Enter the city'),
  pin: pinCodeSchema,
  state: requiredText('Select the state'),
  isDefault: z.boolean(),
})

## `src/features/addresses/services/addressService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. An address is
//   { id, label, name, mobile, line1, line2, landmark, city, state, pin, isDefault, verified }
// `verified` means the backend confirmed the PIN code is serviceable. Creating or editing returns the saved address.
 
export async function listAddresses() {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.addresses.list)
  return data.items
}
 
export async function createAddress(payload) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.addresses.list, payload)
  return data
}
 
export async function updateAddress({ id, ...payload }) {
  const { data } = await http.put(endpoints.addresses.item(id), payload)
  return data
}
 
export async function deleteAddress(id) {
  await http.delete(endpoints.addresses.item(id))
}
 
export async function setDefaultAddress(id) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.addresses.setDefault(id))
  return data
}
```
 
## `src/features/admin-auth/components/AdminLoginView/AdminLoginView.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useId } from 'react'
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { Link, Navigate, useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { selectCurrentUser } from '@/app/store'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import Logo from '@/components/atoms/Logo'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import PasswordInput from '@/components/molecules/PasswordInput'
import { useAdminLogin } from '@/features/admin-auth/hooks/useAdminLogin'
import { adminLoginDefaults, adminLoginSchema } from '@/features/admin-auth/schemas/adminLoginSchema'
import styles from './AdminLoginView.module.scss'
 
/** Where to go after signing in: the admin route the guard remembered, otherwise the dashboard. */
function getDestination(location) {
  const from = location.state?.from
  return from?.pathname?.startsWith(paths.admin.root) && from.pathname !== paths.admin.login
    ? `${from.pathname}${from.search ?? ''}`
    : paths.admin.dashboard
}
 
/**
 * Standalone admin sign-in (no admin layout): logo card, email or mobile plus password, an error
 * banner for refused sign-ins, and a way back to the storefront. A signed-in admin is sent straight on.
 */
export default function AdminLoginView() {
  const formId = useId()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const location = useLocation()
  const user = useSelector(selectCurrentUser)
  const login = useAdminLogin()
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(adminLoginSchema), defaultValues: adminLoginDefaults, mode: 'onTouched' })
 
  if (user?.role === 'admin' && !login.isPending) return <Navigate to={getDestination(location)} replace />
 
  const onSubmit = (values) => {
    login.mutate(values, { onSuccess: () => navigate(getDestination(location), { replace: true }) })
  }
 
  return (
    <main className={styles.page}>
      <div className={styles.card}>
        <Logo size="lg" className={styles.logo} />
        <h1 className={styles.title}>Admin sign in</h1>
        <p className={styles.description}>Sign in to manage products, orders and store operations.</p>
 
        <form id={formId} noValidate className={styles.form} onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
          {login.isError && (
            <Alert tone="danger" title={login.error.status === 403 ? 'No admin access' : 'Could not sign in'}>
              {login.error.message}
            </Alert>
          )}
          <FormField label="Email or mobile number" required error={errors.identifier?.message}>
            {(field) => (
              <Input
                {...field}
                {...register('identifier')}
                leftIcon="person"
                autoComplete="username"
                autoFocus
                placeholder="you@shipper.com or 10-digit mobile"
              />
            )}
          </FormField>
          <FormField label="Password" required error={errors.password?.message}>
            {(field) => <PasswordInput {...field} {...register('password')} placeholder="Enter your password" />}
          </FormField>
          <Button type="submit" size="lg" fullWidth loading={login.isPending}>
            Sign in
          </Button>
        </form>
      </div>
 
      <Link to={paths.home} className={styles.back}>
        <Icon name="arrow-left" /> Back to storefront
      </Link>
    </main>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/admin-auth/hooks/useAdminLogin.js`
 
```javascript
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux'
import { signedIn } from '@/app/store'
import { adminLogin } from '@/features/admin-auth/services/adminAuthService'
 
/** Signs an admin in. Cached data from any previous session is dropped before the new one starts. */
export function useAdminLogin() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
 
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: adminLogin,
    onSuccess: ({ user, accessToken }) => {
      queryClient.clear()
      dispatch(signedIn({ user, accessToken }))
    },
  })
}
```

```javascript
import { z } from 'zod'
import { emailSchema, mobileSchema } from '@/lib/validation'
 
// Shape checks only; the backend decides whether the account exists and may use the admin area.
export const adminLoginSchema = z.object({
  identifier: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, 'Enter your email address or mobile number')
    .refine(
      (value) => (value.includes('@') ? emailSchema.safeParse(value).success : mobileSchema.safeParse(value).success),
      'Enter a valid email address or 10-digit mobile number',
    ),
  password: z.string().min(1, 'Enter your password'),
})
 
export const adminLoginDefaults = { identifier: '', password: '' }
```
 
## `src/features/admin-auth/services/adminAuthService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
/**
 * ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: POST /auth/login { identifier, password, scope: 'admin' }
 * → { user: { id, name, email, mobile, role }, accessToken }. `scope: 'admin'` makes the backend refuse
 * non-admin accounts with 403, so a customer's credentials never open the admin area. `identifier` is
 * an email address or a 10-digit mobile number.
 */
export async function adminLogin({ identifier, password }) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.auth.login, { identifier, password, scope: 'admin' })
  return data
}
```
 
## `src/features/admin-lists/components/DateRangeFilter/DateRangeFilter.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useId, useState } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import Popover from '@/components/molecules/Popover'
import { formatDate, formatDateRange } from '@/lib/date'
import styles from './DateRangeFilter.module.scss'
 
/** "01–28 Oct 2026" when both days share a month, otherwise the full range. */
function compactRange(from, to) {
  const [fromDay, fromMonth, fromYear] = formatDate(from).split(' ')
  const [toDay, toMonth, toYear] = formatDate(to).split(' ')
  if (fromMonth !== toMonth || fromYear !== toYear) return formatDateRange(from, to)
  return fromDay === toDay ? formatDate(to) : `${fromDay}–${toDay} ${toMonth} ${toYear}`
}
 
function CustomRange({ initialFrom, initialTo, onApply }) {
  const [from, setFrom] = useState(initialFrom)
  const [to, setTo] = useState(initialTo)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const errorId = useId()
 
  const apply = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault()
    if (!from || !to || from > to) {
      setError('Choose a start date that is on or before the end date.')
      return
    }
    onApply({ from, to })
  }
 
  return (
    <form className={styles.custom} onSubmit={apply} noValidate>
      <p className={styles.customTitle}>Custom range</p>
      <div className={styles.customFields}>
        <label className={styles.customField}>
          From
          <Input size="sm" type="date" value={from} aria-describedby={error ? errorId : undefined} onChange={(event) => setFrom(event.target.value)} />
        </label>
        <label className={styles.customField}>
          To
          <Input size="sm" type="date" value={to} aria-describedby={error ? errorId : undefined} onChange={(event) => setTo(event.target.value)} />
        </label>
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p id={errorId} role="alert" className={styles.error}>
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <Button type="submit" size="sm" fullWidth>
        Apply
      </Button>
    </form>
  )
}
 
/**
 * Date-range button with a popover of preset ranges and a custom From / To range.
 *
 *   value:   { range, from, to }       the active preset key, or 'custom' with its two ISO dates
 *   period:  { from, to } | null       the range the backend resolved the preset to; shown on the button
 *   onChange({ range, from, to })      a preset passes empty dates, Apply passes range 'custom'
 *   presets: [{ value, label }]        see constants/dateRanges
 * The browser never works out "last 7 days" itself: it sends the preset key and the backend resolves it.
 */
export default function DateRangeFilter({ value, period, presets, onChange, label = 'Date range', prefix, compact = false, className }) {
  const preset = presets.find((entry) => entry.value === value.range)
  const resolved = period ?? (value.range === 'custom' && value.from && value.to ? value : null)
  const text = resolved ? (compact ? compactRange(resolved.from, resolved.to) : formatDateRange(resolved.from, resolved.to)) : (preset?.label ?? 'Custom range')
 
  return (
    <Popover
      className={className}
      align="end"
      panelClassName={styles.panel}
      trigger={({ props, isOpen }) => (
        <button type="button" className={clsx(styles.trigger, isOpen && styles.open)} aria-label={`${label}: ${text}`} {...props}>
          {prefix && <span className={styles.prefix}>{prefix}</span>}
          {text}
          <Icon name="chevron-down" />
        </button>
      )}
    >
      {({ close }) => (
        <>
          <ul className={styles.presets}>
            {presets.map((entry) => (
              <li key={entry.value}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={clsx(styles.preset, entry.value === value.range && styles.selected)}
                  aria-pressed={entry.value === value.range}
                  onClick={() => {
                    onChange({ range: entry.value, from: '', to: '' })
                    close()
                  }}
                >
                  {entry.label}
                  {entry.value === value.range && <Icon name="check-lg" />}
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <CustomRange
            initialFrom={value.range === 'custom' ? value.from : (period?.from ?? '')}
            initialTo={value.range === 'custom' ? value.to : (period?.to ?? '')}
            onApply={(range) => {
              onChange({ range: 'custom', ...range })
              close()
            }}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </Popover>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import SearchField from '@/components/molecules/SearchField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import styles from './ListToolbar.module.scss'
 
/**
 * The filter row above an admin list (see the Products screen): a search box, any number of toolbar selects
 * ("Status: All") and trailing actions such as Export. State comes from useListParams.
 *
 *   search:  { value, onChange }, plus `label` and `placeholder` for the field
 *   filters: [{ key, label, prefix, options, value, onChange(value), searchable? } | { key, node }]
 *   `label` names the select for assistive technology; `prefix` is the visible "Status:" text;
 *   `node` places a custom control (the date-range button) among the selects.
 * `onClear` shows a "Clear filters" button while `hasActiveFilters` is true.
 */
export default function ListToolbar({ search, filters = [], hasActiveFilters = false, onClear, children, className }) {
  return (
    <div className={clsx(styles.toolbar, className)}>
      <SearchField
        size="sm"
        className={styles.search}
        aria-label={search.label}
        placeholder={search.placeholder}
        value={search.value}
        onChange={search.onChange}
      />
      {filters.map((filter) =>
        filter.node ? (
          <div key={filter.key} className={styles.node}>
            {filter.node}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div key={filter.key} className={styles.filter}>
            <SelectField
              size="sm"
              fit
              aria-label={filter.label}
              prefixLabel={filter.prefix}
              options={filter.options}
              value={filter.value}
              onChange={(value) => filter.onChange(value ?? '')}
              isSearchable={filter.searchable}
            />
          </div>
        ),
      )}
      {hasActiveFilters && onClear && (
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" leftIcon="x-lg" onClick={onClear}>
          Clear filters
        </Button>
      )}
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}
```

// Preset date ranges the list and report filters offer. The backend resolves each key against its own
// calendar ("today"), so the browser never does date arithmetic. ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: the keys.
const PRESETS = [
  { value: 'today', label: 'Today' },
  { value: 'yesterday', label: 'Yesterday' },
  { value: 'last_7_days', label: 'Last 7 days' },
  { value: 'last_30_days', label: 'Last 30 days' },
  { value: 'this_month', label: 'This month' },
  { value: 'last_month', label: 'Last month' },
]
 
/** Reports always cover a period. */

/** Lists can also show everything. */
export const LIST_DATE_RANGES = [{ value: 'all', label: 'All time' }, ...PRESETS]

## `src/features/admin-lists/hooks/useExcelExport.js`
 
```javascript
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { exportToExcel } from '@/lib/excel'
 
/**
 * Downloads an .xlsx of rows the screen already shows or can fetch.
 *   const exporter = useExcelExport()
 *   exporter.mutate({ fileName, sheetName, title, columns, getRows: async () => rows })
 * `getRows` is called when the button is pressed, so a list can fetch every matching page first.
 */
export function useExcelExport() {
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ getRows, ...sheet }) => {
      const rows = await getRows()
      await exportToExcel({ ...sheet, rows })
      return rows.length
    },
    onSuccess: (count) => toast.success(`Excel file downloaded with ${count} ${count === 1 ? 'row' : 'rows'}.`),
    onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error, 'We could not create the Excel file. Please try again.')),
  })
}
```
 
## `src/features/admin-lists/hooks/useListParams.js`
 
```javascript
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
 
const SEARCH_DELAY_MS = 350
const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 10
 
const parseSort = (sort) => (sort ? { key: sort.replace(/^-/, ''), direction: sort.startsWith('-') ? 'desc' : 'asc' } : null)
 
/**
 * Keeps a list screen's search, filters, sort and page in the URL, so a filtered view can be bookmarked,
 * shared and survives a refresh. Every change replaces the history entry and returns to page 1.
 *
 *   const list = useListParams({ filters: { status: '', payment: '' }, pageSize: 10 })
 *   list.filters.status            resolved value (URL value, else the default)
 *   list.apiParams                 { q, page, pageSize, sort, ...filters } without empty values, for the request
 *   list.sortState / list.setSort  DataTable's { key, direction } | null
 *
 * `filters` declares the filter keys and their defaults. A filter set to '' falls back to its default.
 * Pass `pageSize: null` for a screen that is not paged (the reports overview).
 */
export function useListParams({ filters: filterDefaults = {}, pageSize = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE } = {}) {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams()
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(null)
 
  const urlSearch = searchParams.get('q') ?? ''
  const page = Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(searchParams.get('page'), 10) || 1)
  const sort = searchParams.get('sort') ?? ''
  const filters = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(filterDefaults).map(([key, fallback]) => [key, searchParams.get(key) || fallback]))
 
  const update = useCallback(
    (changes) =>
      setSearchParams(
        (previous) => {
          const next = new URLSearchParams(previous)
          Object.entries(changes).forEach(([key, value]) => (value ? next.set(key, String(value)) : next.delete(key)))
          if (!('page' in changes)) next.delete('page')
          return next
        },
        { replace: true },
      ),
    [setSearchParams],
  )
 
  // Typing updates the box at once; the URL (and so the request) follows once typing pauses.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (draft === null || draft.trim() === urlSearch) return undefined
    const timer = setTimeout(() => update({ q: draft.trim() }), SEARCH_DELAY_MS)
    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [draft, urlSearch, update])
 
  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setDraft(null)
    setSearchParams({}, { replace: true })
  }, [setSearchParams])
 
  const setFilter = useCallback((key, value) => update({ [key]: value }), [update])
  const setPage = useCallback((next) => update({ page: next > 1 ? next : null }), [update])
  const setSort = useCallback((next) => update({ sort: next ? `${next.direction === 'desc' ? '-' : ''}${next.key}` : null }), [update])
 
  const hasActiveFilters = urlSearch !== '' || Object.entries(filterDefaults).some(([key, fallback]) => filters[key] !== fallback)
 
  return {
    search: {
      value: draft !== null && draft.trim() !== urlSearch ? draft : urlSearch,
      onChange: setDraft,
    },
    filters,
    page,
    pageSize,
    sortState: parseSort(sort),
    apiParams: Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries({ q: urlSearch, ...(pageSize === null ? {} : { page, pageSize }), sort, ...filters }).filter(([, value]) => value !== ''),
    ),
    hasActiveFilters,
    setFilter,
    setFilters: update,
    setPage,
    setSort,
    reset,
  }
}
```

## `src/features/admin-lists/lib/fetchAllPages.js`
 
```javascript
/**
 * Collects every page of a paged list response ({ items, pageCount }) so an export covers all rows that match
 * the current filters, not just the page on screen. `fetchPage(page)` requests one page.
 */
export async function fetchAllPages(fetchPage) {
  const first = await fetchPage(1)
  const items = [...first.items]
  for (let page = 2; page <= first.pageCount; page += 1) {
    const next = await fetchPage(page)
    items.push(...next.items)
  }
  return items
}
 
/** The largest page the list endpoints serve (ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team). */
export const EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE = 100
```
 
## `src/features/admin-orders/components/CancelOrderModal/CancelOrderModal.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Select from '@/components/atoms/Select'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import Modal from '@/components/organisms/Modal'
import { CANCEL_REASON_OPTIONS } from '@/features/admin-orders/constants/orderOptions'
import { useCancelOrder } from '@/features/admin-orders/hooks/useAdminOrders'
import { cancelOrderSchema } from '@/features/admin-orders/schemas/cancelOrderSchema'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './CancelOrderModal.module.scss'
 
const FORM_ID = 'cancel-order-form'
const money = (value) => formatINR(value, { decimals: 2 })
 
function CancelForm({ order, cancel, onClose }) {
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(cancelOrderSchema), defaultValues: { reason: '' } })
 
  const onSubmit = handleSubmit(({ reason }) =>
    cancel.mutate(
      { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, reason },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          toast.success(`Order ${order.orderNumber} was cancelled.`)
          onClose()
        },
        onError: (error) => toast.error(error.message),
      },
    ),
  )
 
  return (
    <form id={FORM_ID} className={styles.form} onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
      {order.paymentStatus === 'paid' ? (
        <Alert tone="info">
          {money(order.summary.payable)} goes back to the customer&rsquo;s original payment method
          {order.summary.walletApplied > 0 && `, and ${money(order.summary.walletApplied)} returns to their wallet`}. The refund is recorded on the order.
        </Alert>
      ) : (
        <Alert tone="info">No payment was received for this order, so nothing needs to be refunded.</Alert>
      )}
      <FormField label="Reason" required error={errors.reason?.message}>
        {(field) => (
          <Select {...field} {...register('reason')}>
            <option value="">Choose a reason</option>
            {CANCEL_REASON_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
              <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                {option.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        )}
      </FormField>
    </form>
  )
}
 
/** Cancel dialog for a new or to-pick order. The backend decides whether the cancellation is allowed. */
export default function CancelOrderModal({ order, open, onClose }) {
  const cancel = useCancelOrder()
 
  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      size="sm"
      title={`Cancel order ${order.orderNumber}?`}
      description="Orders can only be cancelled before they are packed."
      closeOnBackdrop={!cancel.isPending}
      closeOnEscape={!cancel.isPending}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" disabled={cancel.isPending} onClick={onClose}>
            Keep order
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" form={FORM_ID} variant="danger" loading={cancel.isPending}>
            Cancel order
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <CancelForm order={order} cancel={cancel} onClose={onClose} />
    </Modal>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/admin-orders/components/OrderDetail/OrderDetail.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import CancelOrderModal from '@/features/admin-orders/components/CancelOrderModal'
import OrderItemsCard from '@/features/admin-orders/components/OrderItemsCard'
import OrderShipmentCard from '@/features/admin-orders/components/OrderShipmentCard'
import OrderSidePanels from '@/features/admin-orders/components/OrderSidePanels'
import OrderSummaryCard from '@/features/admin-orders/components/OrderSummaryCard'
import { useAdminOrder } from '@/features/admin-orders/hooks/useAdminOrders'
import { downloadInvoice } from '@/features/orders'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import { formatDate, formatTime } from '@/lib/date'
import styles from './OrderDetail.module.scss'
 
function DetailSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className={styles.columns} aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading order">
      <div className={styles.stack}>
        <Skeleton height="14rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
        <Skeleton height="16rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
      </div>
      <div className={styles.stack}>
        <Skeleton height="10rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
        <Skeleton height="10rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
 
/**
 * Admin order detail. Read-only apart from cancelling a new or to-pick order; verify, pick, pack and
 * dispatch stay in Store Operation (linked from the fulfilment panel).
 */
export default function OrderDetail({ orderNumber }) {
  const { data: order, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useAdminOrder(orderNumber)
  const cancelDialog = useDisclosure()
  const invoice = useMutation({
    mutationFn: downloadInvoice,
    onError: (failure) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(failure, 'We could not download the invoice. Please try again.')),
  })
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <PageHeader
        title={`Order ${orderNumber}`}
        description={order ? `Placed ${formatDate(order.placedAt)} at ${formatTime(order.placedAt)} · ${order.channel === 'web' ? 'Website' : order.channel}` : undefined}
        actions={
          <>
            <Button as={Link} to={paths.admin.orders} variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="arrow-left">
              All orders
            </Button>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="download" disabled={!order} loading={invoice.isPending} onClick={() => invoice.mutate(orderNumber)}>
              Download invoice
            </Button>
            {order?.canCancel && (
              <Button variant="danger" size="sm" onClick={cancelDialog.open}>
                Cancel order
              </Button>
            )}
          </>
        }
      />
 
      {isError && (
        <ErrorState
          title="We could not open this order"
          message={getErrorMessage(error)}
          onRetry={error.status === 404 ? undefined : refetch}
        />
      )}
 
      {isPending && <DetailSkeleton />}
 
      {order && (
        <>
          <div className={styles.statusRow}>
            <StatusBadge status={order.status} />
            <StatusBadge status={order.paymentStatus} label={`Payment ${order.paymentStatus === 'paid' ? 'received' : order.paymentStatus}`} />
            {order.onHold && <Badge tone="warning">On hold</Badge>}
          </div>
 
          {order.delay && (
            <Alert
              tone="warning"
              title={`Delayed: ${order.delay.label}`}
              action={
                <Button as={Link} to={paths.admin.storeTab('delayed')} variant="secondary" size="sm">
                  Resolve in Store Operation
                </Button>
              }
            >
              {order.delay.detail}
            </Alert>
          )}
 
          <div className={styles.columns}>
            <div className={styles.stack}>
              <OrderItemsCard lines={order.lines} />
              <OrderSummaryCard summary={order.summary} paymentStatus={order.paymentStatus} />
              <OrderShipmentCard shipment={order.shipment} timeline={order.timeline} />
            </div>
            <OrderSidePanels order={order} />
          </div>
 
          <CancelOrderModal order={order} open={cancelDialog.isOpen} onClose={cancelDialog.close} />
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Thumbnail from '@/components/atoms/Thumbnail'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import { formatINR, formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './OrderItemsCard.module.scss'
 
const money = (key) => (line) => formatINR(line[key], { decimals: 2 })
 
const COLUMNS = [
  {
    key: 'name',
    header: 'Product',
    width: '30%',
    cell: (line) => (
      <span className={styles.product}>
        <Thumbnail src={line.image} size="sm" />
        <span className={styles.productText}>
          <span className={styles.productName}>{line.name}</span>
          <span className={styles.secondary}>
            {line.unit} · {line.productCode}
          </span>
        </span>
      </span>
    ),
  },
  { key: 'hsn', header: 'HSN' },
  { key: 'gstPercent', header: 'GST', cell: (line) => `${line.gstPercent}%` },
  { key: 'quantity', header: 'Qty', cell: (line) => formatNumber(line.quantity) },
  { key: 'unitPrice', header: 'Unit price', align: 'right', cell: money('unitPrice') },
  { key: 'taxable', header: 'Taxable', align: 'right', cell: money('taxable') },
  { key: 'gst', header: 'GST amount', align: 'right', cell: money('gst') },
  { key: 'lineTotal', header: 'Amount', align: 'right', cell: money('lineTotal') },
]
 
/** The lines of an order exactly as stored on the order (prices include GST). */
export default function OrderItemsCard({ lines }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Items" padding="md" radius="md">
      <DataTable caption="Items on this order" columns={COLUMNS} rows={lines} getRowId={(line) => line.productCode} minWidth="46rem" />
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/admin-orders/components/OrderShipmentCard/OrderShipmentCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import SummaryRows from '@/components/molecules/SummaryRows'
import Timeline from '@/components/molecules/Timeline'
import { formatDate, formatDateTime, formatShortDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatWeightKg } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './OrderShipmentCard.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Shipment details and the order's progress timeline. The steps, their states and timestamps are produced by
 * the backend; the card only formats them.
 */
export default function OrderShipmentCard({ shipment, timeline }) {
  const steps = timeline.map((step) => ({
    key: step.key,
    title: step.title,
    description: step.note,
    timestamp: step.at ? formatShortDateTime(step.at) : undefined,
    status: step.state,
  }))
  const rows = shipment
    ? [
        { label: 'Carrier', value: `${shipment.carrier} · ${shipment.service}` },
        { label: 'Consignment ID', value: shipment.consignmentId },
        { label: 'Status', value: <StatusBadge status={shipment.status} /> },
        { label: 'Weight', value: formatWeightKg(shipment.weightKg) },
        { label: 'Dimensions', value: `${shipment.dimensionsCm.length} × ${shipment.dimensionsCm.width} × ${shipment.dimensionsCm.height} cm` },
        { label: 'Dispatched', value: formatDateTime(shipment.dispatchedAt) },
        { label: shipment.deliveredAt ? 'Delivered' : 'Expected delivery', value: shipment.deliveredAt ? formatDateTime(shipment.deliveredAt) : formatDate(shipment.expectedDelivery) },
      ]
    : null
 
  return (
    <Card title="Shipment & tracking" padding="md" radius="md">
      <div className={styles.body}>
        {rows ? <SummaryRows rows={rows} className={styles.rows} /> : <p className={styles.empty}>This order has not been handed to the carrier yet.</p>}
        <Timeline items={steps} />
      </div>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/admin-orders/components/OrderSidePanels/OrderSidePanels.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import AddressSummary from '@/components/molecules/AddressSummary'
import SummaryRows from '@/components/molecules/SummaryRows'
import { CANCEL_REASON_OPTIONS } from '@/features/admin-orders/constants/orderOptions'
import { formatMobile } from '@/lib/address'
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './OrderSidePanels.module.scss'
 
const money = (value) => formatINR(value, { decimals: 2 })
const dash = (value) => value || '—'
 
function Customer({ order }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Customer" padding="md" radius="md">
      <SummaryRows
        rows={[
          { label: 'Name', value: <Link to={paths.admin.customer(order.customerCode)} className={styles.link}>{order.customerName}</Link> },
          { label: 'Customer code', value: order.customerCode },
          { label: 'Mobile', value: formatMobile(order.customerMobile) },
          { label: 'Email', value: order.customerEmail },
        ]}
      />
    </Card>
  )
}
 
function Delivery({ order }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Delivery address" padding="md" radius="md" actions={order.address.label && <Badge tone="info">{order.address.label}</Badge>}>
      <AddressSummary address={order.address} includeLandmark />
      {order.deliveryInstructions && <p className={styles.note}>Note: {order.deliveryInstructions}</p>}
    </Card>
  )
}
 
function Payment({ order }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Payment" padding="md" radius="md">
      <SummaryRows
        rows={[
          { label: 'Status', value: <StatusBadge status={order.paymentStatus} /> },
          { label: 'Method', value: `${order.paymentMethod} via Razorpay` },
          { label: 'Razorpay payment ID', value: dash(order.razorpayPaymentId) },
          { label: 'Invoice', value: dash(order.invoiceNumber) },
        ]}
      />
    </Card>
  )
}
 
function Fulfilment({ order }) {
  const f = order.fulfilment
  return (
    <Card title="Fulfilment" padding="md" radius="md">
      <SummaryRows
        rows={[
          { label: 'Warehouse', value: f.warehouse },
          { label: 'Assigned to', value: dash(f.assignee) },
          { label: 'Pick batch', value: dash(f.pickBatch) },
          { label: 'Priority', value: <StatusBadge status={f.priority} /> },
          { label: 'Packed by', value: dash(f.packedBy) },
          { label: 'Packaging', value: dash(f.packaging) },
        ]}
      />
      {order.fulfilmentTab && (
        <Button as={Link} to={paths.admin.storeTab(order.fulfilmentTab)} variant="secondary" size="sm" rightIcon="arrow-right" className={styles.action}>
          Open in Store Operation
        </Button>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}
 
function Refund({ refund }) {
  const reason = CANCEL_REASON_OPTIONS.find((option) => option.value === refund.reason)?.label
  return (
    <Card title="Refund" padding="md" radius="md">
      <SummaryRows
        rows={[
          { label: 'Amount', value: money(refund.amount) },
          { label: 'Refunded to', value: refund.to === 'wallet' ? 'Shipper wallet' : refund.to },
          ...(refund.walletAmount > 0 ? [{ label: 'Wallet part returned', value: money(refund.walletAmount) }] : []),
          { label: 'Date', value: formatDateTime(refund.at) },
          ...(reason ? [{ label: 'Reason', value: reason }] : []),
        ]}
      />
    </Card>
  )
}
 
/** The right-hand column of the order detail: customer, address, payment, fulfilment and (if any) refund. */
export default function OrderSidePanels({ order }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.stack}>
      <Customer order={order} />
      <Delivery order={order} />
      <Payment order={order} />
      <Fulfilment order={order} />
      {order.refund && <Refund refund={order.refund} />}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/admin-orders/components/OrdersList/OrdersList.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import StatCard from '@/components/molecules/StatCard'
import { DateRangeFilter, EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE, fetchAllPages, LIST_DATE_RANGES, ListToolbar, StatGrid, useExcelExport, useListParams } from '@/features/admin-lists'
import OrdersTable from '@/features/admin-orders/components/OrdersTable'
import { ORDER_STATUS_OPTIONS, PAYMENT_STATUS_OPTIONS } from '@/features/admin-orders/constants/orderOptions'
import { useAdminOrders } from '@/features/admin-orders/hooks/useAdminOrders'
import { ordersSheet, ordersSheetRows } from '@/features/admin-orders/lib/ordersSheet'
import { listAdminOrders } from '@/features/admin-orders/services/adminOrderService'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './OrdersList.module.scss'
 
// The summary cards are shortcuts to the same status filter as the "Status" select.
const SUMMARY_CARDS = [
  { status: '', label: 'All orders', count: 'all' },
  { status: 'new', label: 'New', count: 'new' },
  { status: 'in_transit', label: 'In transit', count: 'in_transit' },
  { status: 'delivered', label: 'Delivered', count: 'delivered' },
]
 
/** The admin Orders screen: every order with search, filters, sort, paging and Excel export. */
export default function OrdersList() {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const list = useListParams({ pageSize: 10, filters: { status: '', payment: '', range: 'all', from: '', to: '' } })
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useAdminOrders(list.apiParams)
  const exporter = useExcelExport()
 
  const exportOrders = () =>
    exporter.mutate({
      ...ordersSheet,
      getRows: async () => ordersSheetRows(await fetchAllPages((page) => listAdminOrders({ ...list.apiParams, page, pageSize: EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE }))),
    })
 
  const toolbarFilters = [
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Order status',
      prefix: 'Status:',
      options: ORDER_STATUS_OPTIONS,
      value: list.filters.status,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('status', value),
    },
    {
      key: 'payment',
      label: 'Payment status',
      prefix: 'Payment:',
      options: PAYMENT_STATUS_OPTIONS,
      value: list.filters.payment,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('payment', value),
    },
    {
      key: 'range',
      node: (
        <DateRangeFilter
          label="Order date"
          prefix="Date:"
          value={{ range: list.filters.range, from: list.filters.from, to: list.filters.to }}
          presets={LIST_DATE_RANGES}
          onChange={list.setFilters}
        />
      ),
    },
  ]
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <PageHeader title="Orders" description="Search every order, check its payment and delivery status, and open the full details." />
 
      <StatGrid>
        {SUMMARY_CARDS.map((card) => (
          <StatCard
            key={card.label}
            layout="inline"
            label={card.label}
            value={data ? formatNumber(data.counts[card.count] ?? 0) : '—'}
            selected={list.filters.status === card.status}
            onClick={() => list.setFilter('status', list.filters.status === card.status ? '' : card.status)}
          />
        ))}
      </StatGrid>
 
      <ListToolbar
        search={{ ...list.search, label: 'Search orders', placeholder: 'Search order, customer or mobile' }}
        filters={toolbarFilters}
        hasActiveFilters={list.hasActiveFilters}
        onClear={list.reset}
      >
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="download" disabled={!data} loading={exporter.isPending} onClick={exportOrders}>
          Export
        </Button>
      </ListToolbar>
 
      {isError ? (
        <ErrorState message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} />
      ) : (
        <OrdersTable
          rows={data?.items ?? []}
          loading={isPending}
          sort={list.sortState}
          onSortChange={list.setSort}
          onOpen={(orderNumber) => navigate(paths.admin.order(orderNumber))}
          emptyState={
            <EmptyState
              compact
              icon="clipboard-x"
              title="No orders match these filters"
              description="Try a different search, or clear the filters to see every order."
              action={
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={list.reset}>
                  Clear filters
                </Button>
              }
            />
          }
          pagination={
            data && { page: data.page, pageSize: data.pageSize, totalItems: data.totalItems, onPageChange: list.setPage, itemLabel: 'orders' }
          }
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import { formatDate, formatTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR, formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './OrdersTable.module.scss'
 
const stacked = (first, second) => (
  <span className={styles.stacked}>
    <span>{first}</span>
    <span className={styles.secondary}>{second}</span>
  </span>
)
 
const COLUMNS = [
  {
    key: 'placedAt',
    header: 'Order / placed',
    sortable: true,
    cell: (row) =>
      stacked(
        <Link to={paths.admin.order(row.orderNumber)} className={styles.orderLink}>
          {row.orderNumber}
        </Link>,
        `${formatDate(row.placedAt)}, ${formatTime(row.placedAt)}`,
      ),
  },
  { key: 'customerName', header: 'Customer', sortable: true, cell: (row) => stacked(row.customerName, `${row.customerCode} · ${row.customerMobile}`) },
  { key: 'units', header: 'Units', sortable: true, cell: (row) => formatNumber(row.units) },
  { key: 'grossAmount', header: 'Amount', sortable: true, cell: (row) => formatINR(row.grossAmount, { decimals: 2 }) },
  {
    key: 'paymentStatus',
    header: 'Payment',
    cell: (row) => (
      <span className={styles.badges}>
        <StatusBadge status={row.paymentStatus} />
        <span className={styles.secondary}>{row.paymentMethod}</span>
      </span>
    ),
  },
  {
    key: 'status',
    header: 'Status',
    sortable: true,
    cell: (row) => (
      <span className={styles.badges}>
        <StatusBadge status={row.status} />
        {row.delayed && <Badge tone="danger">Delayed</Badge>}
        {row.onHold && <Badge tone="warning">On hold</Badge>}
      </span>
    ),
  },
]
 
/** The admin order list. Paging, sorting and filtering are the backend's; this shows the current page. */
export default function OrdersTable({ rows, loading, sort, onSortChange, pagination, emptyState, onOpen }) {
  return (
    <DataTable
      caption="Orders"
      columns={COLUMNS}
      rows={rows}
      getRowId={(row) => row.orderNumber}
      loading={loading}
      sort={sort}
      onSortChange={onSortChange}
      pagination={pagination}
      emptyState={emptyState}
      onRowClick={(row) => onOpen(row.orderNumber)}
      rowActions={(row) => (
        <Link to={paths.admin.order(row.orderNumber)} className={styles.viewLink} aria-label={`View order ${row.orderNumber}`}>
          View
          <Icon name="chevron-right" />
        </Link>
      )}
      actionsHeader="Details"
      minWidth="52rem"
    />
  )
}
```

## `src/features/admin-orders/components/OrderSummaryCard/OrderSummaryCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import SummaryRows from '@/components/molecules/SummaryRows'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
 
const money = (value) => formatINR(value, { decimals: 2 })
 
/** The amounts stored on the order. Every figure was calculated by the backend when the order was placed. */
export default function OrderSummaryCard({ summary, paymentStatus }) {
  const gstRows = summary.igst > 0 ? [{ label: 'IGST', value: money(summary.igst) }] : [{ label: 'CGST', value: money(summary.cgst) }, { label: 'SGST', value: money(summary.sgst) }]
  const rows = [
    { label: 'Taxable subtotal', value: money(summary.taxableSubtotal) },
    ...gstRows,
    { label: 'Shipping', value: summary.shipping > 0 ? money(summary.shipping) : 'Free' },
    ...(summary.couponDiscount > 0 ? [{ label: 'Coupon discount', value: `−${money(summary.couponDiscount)}`, tone: 'success' }] : []),
    { label: 'Gross amount', value: money(summary.grossAmount) },
    ...(summary.walletApplied > 0 ? [{ label: 'Wallet applied', value: `−${money(summary.walletApplied)}`, tone: 'success' }] : []),
    { label: paymentStatus === 'paid' ? 'Paid via Razorpay' : 'Payable via Razorpay', value: money(summary.payable), emphasis: true },
  ]
 
  return (
    <Card title="Order summary" padding="md" radius="md">
      <SummaryRows rows={rows} />
    </Card>
  )
}
```
 
## `src/features/admin-orders/constants/orderOptions.js`
 
```javascript
import { STATUS_META } from '@/app/config/statuses'
 
const ORDER_STATUSES = ['new', 'to_pick', 'to_pack', 'packed', 'dispatched', 'in_transit', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered', 'returned', 'cancelled']
const PAYMENT_STATUSES = ['paid', 'pending', 'failed', 'refunded']
 
/** "All" plus every order status, in lifecycle order, labelled from the shared status vocabulary. */
export const ORDER_STATUS_OPTIONS = [{ value: '', label: 'All' }, ...ORDER_STATUSES.map((value) => ({ value, label: STATUS_META[value].label }))]
 
export const PAYMENT_STATUS_OPTIONS = [{ value: '', label: 'All' }, ...PAYMENT_STATUSES.map((value) => ({ value, label: STATUS_META[value].label }))]
 
export const CANCEL_REASON_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'customer_request', label: 'Customer asked to cancel' },
  { value: 'payment_issue', label: 'Payment problem' },
  { value: 'out_of_stock', label: 'Item out of stock' },
  { value: 'duplicate_order', label: 'Duplicate order' },
  { value: 'other', label: 'Other reason' },
]
 
export const statusLabel = (status) => STATUS_META[status]?.label ?? status
```
 
## `src/features/admin-orders/hooks/useAdminOrders.js`
 
```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { cancelAdminOrder, getAdminOrder, listAdminOrders } from '@/features/admin-orders/services/adminOrderService'
 
export const adminOrderKeys = {
  all: ['admin', 'orders'],
  list: (params) => ['admin', 'orders', 'list', params],
  detail: (orderNumber) => ['admin', 'orders', 'detail', orderNumber],
}
 
export const useAdminOrders = (params) =>
  useQuery({ queryKey: adminOrderKeys.list(params), queryFn: () => listAdminOrders(params), placeholderData: keepPreviousData })
 
export const useAdminOrder = (orderNumber) => useQuery({ queryKey: adminOrderKeys.detail(orderNumber), queryFn: () => getAdminOrder(orderNumber) })
 
// Cancelling frees stock, queues and wallet balances elsewhere in the admin, so every admin query is refreshed.
export function useCancelOrder() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: cancelAdminOrder,
    onSuccess: (order) => {
      queryClient.setQueryData(adminOrderKeys.detail(order.orderNumber), order)
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['admin'] })
    },
  })
}
```

```javascript
import { statusLabel } from '@/features/admin-orders/constants/orderOptions'
 
const COLUMNS = [
  { header: 'Order', key: 'orderNumber', width: 12 },
  { header: 'Placed', key: 'placedAt', format: 'date', width: 14 },
  { header: 'Customer code', key: 'customerCode', width: 14 },
  { header: 'Customer', key: 'customerName', width: 22 },
  { header: 'Mobile', key: 'customerMobile', format: 'text', width: 14 },
  { header: 'Units', key: 'units', format: 'number', width: 8 },
  { header: 'Gross amount', key: 'grossAmount', format: 'inr', width: 15 },
  { header: 'Wallet applied', key: 'walletApplied', format: 'inr', width: 15 },
  { header: 'Paid via gateway', key: 'payable', format: 'inr', width: 16 },
  { header: 'Payment status', key: 'paymentStatus', width: 16 },
  { header: 'Payment method', key: 'paymentMethod', width: 16 },
  { header: 'Status', key: 'status', width: 18 },
]
 
/** Excel sheet definition for the order list (every order matching the filters, not only the page on screen). */
export const ordersSheet = { fileName: 'Shipper-orders', sheetName: 'Orders', title: 'Orders', columns: COLUMNS }
 
export const ordersSheetRows = (rows) =>
  rows.map((row) => ({ ...row, status: statusLabel(row.status), paymentStatus: statusLabel(row.paymentStatus) }))
```

## `src/features/admin-orders/services/adminOrderService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. An order list row is
//   { orderNumber, placedAt, customerCode, customerName, customerMobile, units, grossAmount, walletApplied, payable,
//     paymentStatus, paymentMethod, status, delayed, onHold }
 
/**
 * GET orders (q: order number, customer name / code / mobile · status · payment · range: all | today | … | custom
 * with from and to · sort: 'field' | '-field' · page · pageSize) →
 *   { items, page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount, counts: { all, new, to_pick, … } }
 * `counts` are per status for the search, payment and date filters (ignoring the status filter), for the summary cards.
 */
export async function listAdminOrders(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.orders.list, { params })
  return data
}
 
/**
 * GET one order → the stored order (lines with HSN, GST and amounts, summary, address, payment, fulfilment,
 * shipment, timestamps) plus
 *   timeline: [{ key, title, at, note, state: 'done' | 'current' | 'upcoming' }],
 *   refund: { amount, to, at, reason, walletAmount } | null,
 *   canCancel: boolean            (the backend's rule: only new and to-pick orders),
 *   fulfilmentTab: string | null  (the Store Operation tab the order is in).
 */
export async function getAdminOrder(orderNumber) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.orders.item(orderNumber))
  return data
}
 
/** POST cancel { reason: customer_request | payment_issue | out_of_stock | duplicate_order | other } → the updated order. 409 when it is too late. */
export async function cancelAdminOrder({ orderNumber, reason }) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.admin.orders.cancel(orderNumber), { reason })
  return data
}
```
