## `src/features/admin-orders/components/OrderDetail/OrderDetail.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import CancelOrderModal from '@/features/admin-orders/components/CancelOrderModal'
import OrderItemsCard from '@/features/admin-orders/components/OrderItemsCard'
import OrderShipmentCard from '@/features/admin-orders/components/OrderShipmentCard'
import OrderSidePanels from '@/features/admin-orders/components/OrderSidePanels'
import OrderSummaryCard from '@/features/admin-orders/components/OrderSummaryCard'
import { useAdminOrder } from '@/features/admin-orders/hooks/useAdminOrders'
import { downloadInvoice } from '@/features/orders'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import { formatDate, formatTime } from '@/lib/date'
import styles from './OrderDetail.module.scss'
 
function DetailSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className={styles.columns} aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading order">
      <div className={styles.stack}>
        <Skeleton height="14rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
        <Skeleton height="16rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
      </div>
      <div className={styles.stack}>
        <Skeleton height="10rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
        <Skeleton height="10rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
 
/**
 * Admin order detail. Read-only apart from cancelling a new or to-pick order; verify, pick, pack and
 * dispatch stay in Store Operation (linked from the fulfilment panel).
 */
export default function OrderDetail({ orderNumber }) {
  const { data: order, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useAdminOrder(orderNumber)
  const cancelDialog = useDisclosure()
  const invoice = useMutation({
    mutationFn: downloadInvoice,
    onError: (failure) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(failure, 'We could not download the invoice. Please try again.')),
  })
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <PageHeader
        title={`Order ${orderNumber}`}
        description={order ? `Placed ${formatDate(order.placedAt)} at ${formatTime(order.placedAt)} · ${order.channel === 'web' ? 'Website' : order.channel}` : undefined}
        actions={
          <>
            <Button as={Link} to={paths.admin.orders} variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="arrow-left">
              All orders
            </Button>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="download" disabled={!order} loading={invoice.isPending} onClick={() => invoice.mutate(orderNumber)}>
              Download invoice
            </Button>
            {order?.canCancel && (
              <Button variant="danger" size="sm" onClick={cancelDialog.open}>
                Cancel order
              </Button>
            )}
          </>
        }
      />
 
      {isError && (
        <ErrorState
          title="We could not open this order"
          message={getErrorMessage(error)}
          onRetry={error.status === 404 ? undefined : refetch}
        />
      )}
 
      {isPending && <DetailSkeleton />}
 
      {order && (
        <>
          <div className={styles.statusRow}>
            <StatusBadge status={order.status} />
            <StatusBadge status={order.paymentStatus} label={`Payment ${order.paymentStatus === 'paid' ? 'received' : order.paymentStatus}`} />
            {order.onHold && <Badge tone="warning">On hold</Badge>}
          </div>
 
          {order.delay && (
            <Alert
              tone="warning"
              title={`Delayed: ${order.delay.label}`}
              action={
                <Button as={Link} to={paths.admin.storeTab('delayed')} variant="secondary" size="sm">
                  Resolve in Store Operation
                </Button>
              }
            >
              {order.delay.detail}
            </Alert>
          )}
 
          <div className={styles.columns}>
            <div className={styles.stack}>
              <OrderItemsCard lines={order.lines} />
              <OrderSummaryCard summary={order.summary} paymentStatus={order.paymentStatus} />
              <OrderShipmentCard shipment={order.shipment} timeline={order.timeline} />
            </div>
            <OrderSidePanels order={order} />
          </div>
 
          <CancelOrderModal order={order} open={cancelDialog.isOpen} onClose={cancelDialog.close} />
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Thumbnail from '@/components/atoms/Thumbnail'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import { formatINR, formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './OrderItemsCard.module.scss'
 
const money = (key) => (line) => formatINR(line[key], { decimals: 2 })
 
const COLUMNS = [
  {
    key: 'name',
    header: 'Product',
    width: '30%',
    cell: (line) => (
      <span className={styles.product}>
        <Thumbnail src={line.image} size="sm" />
        <span className={styles.productText}>
          <span className={styles.productName}>{line.name}</span>
          <span className={styles.secondary}>
            {line.unit} · {line.productCode}
          </span>
        </span>
      </span>
    ),
  },
  { key: 'hsn', header: 'HSN' },
  { key: 'gstPercent', header: 'GST', cell: (line) => `${line.gstPercent}%` },
  { key: 'quantity', header: 'Qty', cell: (line) => formatNumber(line.quantity) },
  { key: 'unitPrice', header: 'Unit price', align: 'right', cell: money('unitPrice') },
  { key: 'taxable', header: 'Taxable', align: 'right', cell: money('taxable') },
  { key: 'gst', header: 'GST amount', align: 'right', cell: money('gst') },
  { key: 'lineTotal', header: 'Amount', align: 'right', cell: money('lineTotal') },
]
 
/** The lines of an order exactly as stored on the order (prices include GST). */
export default function OrderItemsCard({ lines }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Items" padding="md" radius="md">
      <DataTable caption="Items on this order" columns={COLUMNS} rows={lines} getRowId={(line) => line.productCode} minWidth="46rem" />
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/admin-orders/components/OrderShipmentCard/OrderShipmentCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import SummaryRows from '@/components/molecules/SummaryRows'
import Timeline from '@/components/molecules/Timeline'
import { formatDate, formatDateTime, formatShortDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatWeightKg } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './OrderShipmentCard.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Shipment details and the order's progress timeline. The steps, their states and timestamps are produced by
 * the backend; the card only formats them.
 */
export default function OrderShipmentCard({ shipment, timeline }) {
  const steps = timeline.map((step) => ({
    key: step.key,
    title: step.title,
    description: step.note,
    timestamp: step.at ? formatShortDateTime(step.at) : undefined,
    status: step.state,
  }))
  const rows = shipment
    ? [
        { label: 'Carrier', value: `${shipment.carrier} · ${shipment.service}` },
        { label: 'Consignment ID', value: shipment.consignmentId },
        { label: 'Status', value: <StatusBadge status={shipment.status} /> },
        { label: 'Weight', value: formatWeightKg(shipment.weightKg) },
        { label: 'Dimensions', value: `${shipment.dimensionsCm.length} × ${shipment.dimensionsCm.width} × ${shipment.dimensionsCm.height} cm` },
        { label: 'Dispatched', value: formatDateTime(shipment.dispatchedAt) },
        { label: shipment.deliveredAt ? 'Delivered' : 'Expected delivery', value: shipment.deliveredAt ? formatDateTime(shipment.deliveredAt) : formatDate(shipment.expectedDelivery) },
      ]
    : null
 
  return (
    <Card title="Shipment & tracking" padding="md" radius="md">
      <div className={styles.body}>
        {rows ? <SummaryRows rows={rows} className={styles.rows} /> : <p className={styles.empty}>This order has not been handed to the carrier yet.</p>}
        <Timeline items={steps} />
      </div>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/admin-orders/components/OrderSidePanels/OrderSidePanels.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import AddressSummary from '@/components/molecules/AddressSummary'
import SummaryRows from '@/components/molecules/SummaryRows'
import { CANCEL_REASON_OPTIONS } from '@/features/admin-orders/constants/orderOptions'
import { formatMobile } from '@/lib/address'
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './OrderSidePanels.module.scss'
 
const money = (value) => formatINR(value, { decimals: 2 })
const dash = (value) => value || '—'
 
function Customer({ order }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Customer" padding="md" radius="md">
      <SummaryRows
        rows={[
          { label: 'Name', value: <Link to={paths.admin.customer(order.customerCode)} className={styles.link}>{order.customerName}</Link> },
          { label: 'Customer code', value: order.customerCode },
          { label: 'Mobile', value: formatMobile(order.customerMobile) },
          { label: 'Email', value: order.customerEmail },
        ]}
      />
    </Card>
  )
}
 
function Delivery({ order }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Delivery address" padding="md" radius="md" actions={order.address.label && <Badge tone="info">{order.address.label}</Badge>}>
      <AddressSummary address={order.address} includeLandmark />
      {order.deliveryInstructions && <p className={styles.note}>Note: {order.deliveryInstructions}</p>}
    </Card>
  )
}
 
function Payment({ order }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Payment" padding="md" radius="md">
      <SummaryRows
        rows={[
          { label: 'Status', value: <StatusBadge status={order.paymentStatus} /> },
          { label: 'Method', value: `${order.paymentMethod} via Razorpay` },
          { label: 'Razorpay payment ID', value: dash(order.razorpayPaymentId) },
          { label: 'Invoice', value: dash(order.invoiceNumber) },
        ]}
      />
    </Card>
  )
}
 
function Fulfilment({ order }) {
  const f = order.fulfilment
  return (
    <Card title="Fulfilment" padding="md" radius="md">
      <SummaryRows
        rows={[
          { label: 'Warehouse', value: f.warehouse },
          { label: 'Assigned to', value: dash(f.assignee) },
          { label: 'Pick batch', value: dash(f.pickBatch) },
          { label: 'Priority', value: <StatusBadge status={f.priority} /> },
          { label: 'Packed by', value: dash(f.packedBy) },
          { label: 'Packaging', value: dash(f.packaging) },
        ]}
      />
      {order.fulfilmentTab && (
        <Button as={Link} to={paths.admin.storeTab(order.fulfilmentTab)} variant="secondary" size="sm" rightIcon="arrow-right" className={styles.action}>
          Open in Store Operation
        </Button>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}
 
function Refund({ refund }) {
  const reason = CANCEL_REASON_OPTIONS.find((option) => option.value === refund.reason)?.label
  return (
    <Card title="Refund" padding="md" radius="md">
      <SummaryRows
        rows={[
          { label: 'Amount', value: money(refund.amount) },
          { label: 'Refunded to', value: refund.to === 'wallet' ? 'Shipper wallet' : refund.to },
          ...(refund.walletAmount > 0 ? [{ label: 'Wallet part returned', value: money(refund.walletAmount) }] : []),
          { label: 'Date', value: formatDateTime(refund.at) },
          ...(reason ? [{ label: 'Reason', value: reason }] : []),
        ]}
      />
    </Card>
  )
}
 
/** The right-hand column of the order detail: customer, address, payment, fulfilment and (if any) refund. */
export default function OrderSidePanels({ order }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.stack}>
      <Customer order={order} />
      <Delivery order={order} />
      <Payment order={order} />
      <Fulfilment order={order} />
      {order.refund && <Refund refund={order.refund} />}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/admin-orders/components/OrdersList/OrdersList.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import StatCard from '@/components/molecules/StatCard'
import { DateRangeFilter, EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE, fetchAllPages, LIST_DATE_RANGES, ListToolbar, StatGrid, useExcelExport, useListParams } from '@/features/admin-lists'
import OrdersTable from '@/features/admin-orders/components/OrdersTable'
import { ORDER_STATUS_OPTIONS, PAYMENT_STATUS_OPTIONS } from '@/features/admin-orders/constants/orderOptions'
import { useAdminOrders } from '@/features/admin-orders/hooks/useAdminOrders'
import { ordersSheet, ordersSheetRows } from '@/features/admin-orders/lib/ordersSheet'
import { listAdminOrders } from '@/features/admin-orders/services/adminOrderService'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './OrdersList.module.scss'
 
// The summary cards are shortcuts to the same status filter as the "Status" select.
const SUMMARY_CARDS = [
  { status: '', label: 'All orders', count: 'all' },
  { status: 'new', label: 'New', count: 'new' },
  { status: 'in_transit', label: 'In transit', count: 'in_transit' },
  { status: 'delivered', label: 'Delivered', count: 'delivered' },
]
 
/** The admin Orders screen: every order with search, filters, sort, paging and Excel export. */
export default function OrdersList() {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const list = useListParams({ pageSize: 10, filters: { status: '', payment: '', range: 'all', from: '', to: '' } })
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useAdminOrders(list.apiParams)
  const exporter = useExcelExport()
 
  const exportOrders = () =>
    exporter.mutate({
      ...ordersSheet,
      getRows: async () => ordersSheetRows(await fetchAllPages((page) => listAdminOrders({ ...list.apiParams, page, pageSize: EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE }))),
    })
 
  const toolbarFilters = [
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Order status',
      prefix: 'Status:',
      options: ORDER_STATUS_OPTIONS,
      value: list.filters.status,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('status', value),
    },
    {
      key: 'payment',
      label: 'Payment status',
      prefix: 'Payment:',
      options: PAYMENT_STATUS_OPTIONS,
      value: list.filters.payment,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('payment', value),
    },
    {
      key: 'range',
      node: (
        <DateRangeFilter
          label="Order date"
          prefix="Date:"
          value={{ range: list.filters.range, from: list.filters.from, to: list.filters.to }}
          presets={LIST_DATE_RANGES}
          onChange={list.setFilters}
        />
      ),
    },
  ]
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <PageHeader title="Orders" description="Search every order, check its payment and delivery status, and open the full details." />
 
      <StatGrid>
        {SUMMARY_CARDS.map((card) => (
          <StatCard
            key={card.label}
            layout="inline"
            label={card.label}
            value={data ? formatNumber(data.counts[card.count] ?? 0) : '—'}
            selected={list.filters.status === card.status}
            onClick={() => list.setFilter('status', list.filters.status === card.status ? '' : card.status)}
          />
        ))}
      </StatGrid>
 
      <ListToolbar
        search={{ ...list.search, label: 'Search orders', placeholder: 'Search order, customer or mobile' }}
        filters={toolbarFilters}
        hasActiveFilters={list.hasActiveFilters}
        onClear={list.reset}
      >
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="download" disabled={!data} loading={exporter.isPending} onClick={exportOrders}>
          Export
        </Button>
      </ListToolbar>
 
      {isError ? (
        <ErrorState message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} />
      ) : (
        <OrdersTable
          rows={data?.items ?? []}
          loading={isPending}
          sort={list.sortState}
          onSortChange={list.setSort}
          onOpen={(orderNumber) => navigate(paths.admin.order(orderNumber))}
          emptyState={
            <EmptyState
              compact
              icon="clipboard-x"
              title="No orders match these filters"
              description="Try a different search, or clear the filters to see every order."
              action={
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={list.reset}>
                  Clear filters
                </Button>
              }
            />
          }
          pagination={
            data && { page: data.page, pageSize: data.pageSize, totalItems: data.totalItems, onPageChange: list.setPage, itemLabel: 'orders' }
          }
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import { formatDate, formatTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR, formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './OrdersTable.module.scss'
 
const stacked = (first, second) => (
  <span className={styles.stacked}>
    <span>{first}</span>
    <span className={styles.secondary}>{second}</span>
  </span>
)
 
const COLUMNS = [
  {
    key: 'placedAt',
    header: 'Order / placed',
    sortable: true,
    cell: (row) =>
      stacked(
        <Link to={paths.admin.order(row.orderNumber)} className={styles.orderLink}>
          {row.orderNumber}
        </Link>,
        `${formatDate(row.placedAt)}, ${formatTime(row.placedAt)}`,
      ),
  },
  { key: 'customerName', header: 'Customer', sortable: true, cell: (row) => stacked(row.customerName, `${row.customerCode} · ${row.customerMobile}`) },
  { key: 'units', header: 'Units', sortable: true, cell: (row) => formatNumber(row.units) },
  { key: 'grossAmount', header: 'Amount', sortable: true, cell: (row) => formatINR(row.grossAmount, { decimals: 2 }) },
  {
    key: 'paymentStatus',
    header: 'Payment',
    cell: (row) => (
      <span className={styles.badges}>
        <StatusBadge status={row.paymentStatus} />
        <span className={styles.secondary}>{row.paymentMethod}</span>
      </span>
    ),
  },
  {
    key: 'status',
    header: 'Status',
    sortable: true,
    cell: (row) => (
      <span className={styles.badges}>
        <StatusBadge status={row.status} />
        {row.delayed && <Badge tone="danger">Delayed</Badge>}
        {row.onHold && <Badge tone="warning">On hold</Badge>}
      </span>
    ),
  },
]
 
/** The admin order list. Paging, sorting and filtering are the backend's; this shows the current page. */
export default function OrdersTable({ rows, loading, sort, onSortChange, pagination, emptyState, onOpen }) {
  return (
    <DataTable
      caption="Orders"
      columns={COLUMNS}
      rows={rows}
      getRowId={(row) => row.orderNumber}
      loading={loading}
      sort={sort}
      onSortChange={onSortChange}
      pagination={pagination}
      emptyState={emptyState}
      onRowClick={(row) => onOpen(row.orderNumber)}
      rowActions={(row) => (
        <Link to={paths.admin.order(row.orderNumber)} className={styles.viewLink} aria-label={`View order ${row.orderNumber}`}>
          View
          <Icon name="chevron-right" />
        </Link>
      )}
      actionsHeader="Details"
      minWidth="52rem"
    />
  )
}

## `src/features/admin-orders/components/OrderSummaryCard/OrderSummaryCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import SummaryRows from '@/components/molecules/SummaryRows'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
 
const money = (value) => formatINR(value, { decimals: 2 })
 
/** The amounts stored on the order. Every figure was calculated by the backend when the order was placed. */
export default function OrderSummaryCard({ summary, paymentStatus }) {
  const gstRows = summary.igst > 0 ? [{ label: 'IGST', value: money(summary.igst) }] : [{ label: 'CGST', value: money(summary.cgst) }, { label: 'SGST', value: money(summary.sgst) }]
  const rows = [
    { label: 'Taxable subtotal', value: money(summary.taxableSubtotal) },
    ...gstRows,
    { label: 'Shipping', value: summary.shipping > 0 ? money(summary.shipping) : 'Free' },
    ...(summary.couponDiscount > 0 ? [{ label: 'Coupon discount', value: `−${money(summary.couponDiscount)}`, tone: 'success' }] : []),
    { label: 'Gross amount', value: money(summary.grossAmount) },
    ...(summary.walletApplied > 0 ? [{ label: 'Wallet applied', value: `−${money(summary.walletApplied)}`, tone: 'success' }] : []),
    { label: paymentStatus === 'paid' ? 'Paid via Razorpay' : 'Payable via Razorpay', value: money(summary.payable), emphasis: true },
  ]
 
  return (
    <Card title="Order summary" padding="md" radius="md">
      <SummaryRows rows={rows} />
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/admin-orders/hooks/useAdminOrders.js`
 
```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { cancelAdminOrder, getAdminOrder, listAdminOrders } from '@/features/admin-orders/services/adminOrderService'
 
export const adminOrderKeys = {
  all: ['admin', 'orders'],
  list: (params) => ['admin', 'orders', 'list', params],
  detail: (orderNumber) => ['admin', 'orders', 'detail', orderNumber],
}
 
export const useAdminOrders = (params) =>
  useQuery({ queryKey: adminOrderKeys.list(params), queryFn: () => listAdminOrders(params), placeholderData: keepPreviousData })
 
export const useAdminOrder = (orderNumber) => useQuery({ queryKey: adminOrderKeys.detail(orderNumber), queryFn: () => getAdminOrder(orderNumber) })
 
// Cancelling frees stock, queues and wallet balances elsewhere in the admin, so every admin query is refreshed.
export function useCancelOrder() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: cancelAdminOrder,
    onSuccess: (order) => {
      queryClient.setQueryData(adminOrderKeys.detail(order.orderNumber), order)
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['admin'] })
    },
  })
}
```

## `src/features/admin-orders/services/adminOrderService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. An order list row is
//   { orderNumber, placedAt, customerCode, customerName, customerMobile, units, grossAmount, walletApplied, payable,
//     paymentStatus, paymentMethod, status, delayed, onHold }
 
/**
 * GET orders (q: order number, customer name / code / mobile · status · payment · range: all | today | … | custom
 * with from and to · sort: 'field' | '-field' · page · pageSize) →
 *   { items, page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount, counts: { all, new, to_pick, … } }
 * `counts` are per status for the search, payment and date filters (ignoring the status filter), for the summary cards.
 */
export async function listAdminOrders(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.orders.list, { params })
  return data
}
 
/**
 * GET one order → the stored order (lines with HSN, GST and amounts, summary, address, payment, fulfilment,
 * shipment, timestamps) plus
 *   timeline: [{ key, title, at, note, state: 'done' | 'current' | 'upcoming' }],
 *   refund: { amount, to, at, reason, walletAmount } | null,
 *   canCancel: boolean            (the backend's rule: only new and to-pick orders),
 *   fulfilmentTab: string | null  (the Store Operation tab the order is in).
 */
export async function getAdminOrder(orderNumber) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.orders.item(orderNumber))
  return data
}
 
/** POST cancel { reason: customer_request | payment_issue | out_of_stock | duplicate_order | other } → the updated order. 409 when it is too late. */
export async function cancelAdminOrder({ orderNumber, reason }) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.admin.orders.cancel(orderNumber), { reason })
  return data
}
```

## `src/features/auth/hooks/useLogin.js`
 
```javascript
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { ApiError } from '@/app/services'
import { useStartSession } from '@/features/auth/hooks/useStartSession'
import { login } from '@/features/auth/services/authService'
 
/** Customer login. Admin accounts are sent to the admin login instead of being signed in here. */
export function useLogin() {
  const startSession = useStartSession()
 
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (credentials) => {
      const session = await login({ ...credentials, scope: 'customer' })
      if (session.user.role !== 'customer') {
        throw new ApiError('This is an admin account. Please use the admin login.', { status: 403 })
      }
      return session
    },
    onSuccess: startSession,
  })
}
```
 
## `src/features/auth/hooks/useLogout.js`
 
```javascript
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { signedOut } from '@/app/store'
import { logout } from '@/features/auth/services/authService'
 
/**
 * Ends the session. The UI signs out even when the request fails (offline, expired session), so a
 * user is never stuck looking signed in. Cached server data is cleared so nothing leaks to the next user.
 */
export function useLogout({ redirectTo }) {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
 
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: logout,
    onSettled: () => {
      dispatch(signedOut())
      queryClient.clear()
      navigate(redirectTo, { replace: true })
    },
  })
}
```

/** Whether a (valid, normalised) mobile number is free to register. Pass '' to skip the check. */

## `src/features/auth/hooks/useStartSession.js`
 
```javascript
import { useCallback } from 'react'
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom'
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux'
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { signedIn } from '@/app/store'
 
/**
 * Returns `startSession(session)`: signs the customer in and sends them back to the page the route guard
 * remembered in `location.state.from` (cart, checkout, account…), or to the home page.
 *
 * The login and signup routes redirect signed-in users on their own, to `from.pathname` or the profile,
 * which would drop the query string (for example an applied coupon). Flushing the sign-in first lets that
 * redirect run before ours, so the navigation below is the one that sticks.
 */
export function useStartSession() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const location = useLocation()
  const from = location.state?.from
 
  return useCallback(
    (session) => {
      flushSync(() => dispatch(signedIn(session)))
      navigate(from ? { pathname: from.pathname, search: from.search, hash: from.hash } : paths.home, { replace: true })
    },
    [dispatch, navigate, from],
  )
}
```

## `src/features/auth/schemas/authSchemas.js`
 
```javascript
import { z } from 'zod'
import { emailSchema, mobileSchema, normalizeMobile, passwordSchema, requiredText } from '@/lib/validation'
 
const MOBILE = /^[6-9]\d{9}$/
 
// The login field takes either a mobile number or an email address; the backend decides who the person is.
const identifierSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(1, 'Enter your mobile number or email')
  .refine((value) => MOBILE.test(normalizeMobile(value)) || z.email().safeParse(value).success, 'Enter a valid mobile number or email address')
 
export const loginSchema = z.object({
  identifier: identifierSchema,
  // Not checked for strength here: an older account may predate today's password rules.
  password: z.string().min(1, 'Enter your password'),
  rememberMe: z.boolean(),
})
 
export const signupSchema = z.object({
  name: requiredText('Enter your full name').max(80, 'Use 80 characters or fewer'),
  mobile: mobileSchema,
  email: emailSchema,
  password: passwordSchema,
  acceptTerms: z.boolean().refine((accepted) => accepted, 'Accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to create an account'),
  marketingOptIn: z.boolean(),
})
```
 
## `src/features/auth/services/authService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
/** ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: POST /auth/logout invalidates the session. */
export async function logout() {
  await http.post(endpoints.auth.logout)
}
 
/**
 * ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. Request: { identifier (mobile or email), password, rememberMe, scope: 'customer' }.
 * Response: { user: { id, name, email, mobile, role }, accessToken }. Wrong credentials answer 401 with a message.
 */
export async function login(credentials) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.auth.login, credentials)
  return data
}
 
/**
 * ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. Request: { name, mobile, email, password, acceptedTerms, marketingOptIn }.
 * Response (201): the same session as login. A mobile number that already has an account answers 409.
 */
export async function signup(details) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.auth.signup, details)
  return data
}
 
/** ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. GET /auth/mobile-availability?mobile=9876543210 → { mobile, available }. */
export async function checkMobileAvailability(mobile) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.auth.mobileAvailability, { params: { mobile } })
  return data
}
```
 
## `src/features/cart/components/CartLineItem/CartLineItem.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Thumbnail from '@/components/atoms/Thumbnail'
import QuantityStepper from '@/components/molecules/QuantityStepper'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './CartLineItem.module.scss'
 
/** Stock note for a cart line, from the backend quote (`stockStatus`, `lowStockLeft`, `maxQuantity`). */
function StockBadge({ line, quantity }) {
  if (line.maxQuantity === 0) return <Badge tone="danger">Out of stock</Badge>
  if (quantity > line.maxQuantity) return <Badge tone="danger">Only {line.maxQuantity} available</Badge>
  if (line.stockStatus === 'low_stock') return <Badge tone="warning">Only {line.lowStockLeft} left</Badge>
  return <Badge tone="success">In stock</Badge>
}
 
/**
 * One cart row. `quantity` is the customer's choice (kept in the cart), the rest comes from the quote line.
 * The stepper stops at the backend `maxQuantity`; the backend still validates stock when the order is placed.
 */
export default function CartLineItem({ line, quantity, onQuantityChange, onSaveForLater, onRemove }) {
  const unavailable = line.maxQuantity === 0
 
  return (
    <li className={styles.item}>
      <Link to={paths.product(line.slug)} className={styles.imageLink} tabIndex={-1} aria-hidden="true">
        <Thumbnail src={line.image} size={130} className={styles.thumb} />
      </Link>
 
      <div className={styles.info}>
        <h3 className={styles.name}>
          <Link to={paths.product(line.slug)}>{line.name}</Link>
        </h3>
        <p className={styles.meta}>
          {line.unit} · {line.productCode}
        </p>
        <StockBadge line={line} quantity={quantity} />
        <div className={styles.actions}>
          <Button variant="link" size="sm" onClick={onSaveForLater}>
            Save for later
          </Button>
          <button type="button" className={styles.remove} onClick={onRemove}>
            Remove<span className="visually-hidden"> {line.name}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
 
      <div className={styles.pricing}>
        <div className={styles.price}>
          <p className={styles.total}>
            <span className="visually-hidden">Line total </span>
            {formatINR(line.lineTotal)}
          </p>
          <p className={styles.each}>{formatINR(line.unitPrice)} each</p>
        </div>
        <QuantityStepper
          value={quantity}
          onChange={onQuantityChange}
          max={Math.max(1, line.maxQuantity)}
          disabled={unavailable}
          label={`Quantity of ${line.name}`}
          className={styles.stepper}
        />
      </div>
    </li>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/cart/components/CartScreen/CartScreen.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { STOREFRONT } from '@/app/config/storefront'
import {
  itemRemoved,
  quantityChanged,
  savedForLaterToggled,
  selectActiveCartItems,
  selectDeliveryLocation,
  selectIsAuthenticated,
  selectSavedForLaterItems,
} from '@/app/store'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Breadcrumbs from '@/components/molecules/Breadcrumbs'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import CartLineItem from '@/features/cart/components/CartLineItem'
import CouponCard from '@/features/cart/components/CouponCard'
import DeliveryEstimate from '@/features/cart/components/DeliveryEstimate'
import OrderSummaryCard from '@/features/cart/components/OrderSummaryCard'
import SavedForLater from '@/features/cart/components/SavedForLater'
import { useCartQuote } from '@/features/cart/hooks/useCartQuote'
import { couponSearch, useCouponCode } from '@/features/cart/hooks/useCouponCode'
import { lineHasStockProblem } from '@/features/cart/lib/lineStock'
import { formatINR, pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import CartSkeleton from './CartSkeleton'
import styles from './CartScreen.module.scss'
 
const BREADCRUMBS = [{ label: 'Home', to: paths.home }, { label: 'Your cart' }]
 
/**
 * The cart: lines, saved-for-later items, coupon and the order summary. The customer's choices (which
 * products, how many, saved or not) live in the cart store; every price, tax, shipping and wallet figure
 * on screen comes from the backend quote for those lines.
 */
export default function CartScreen() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const activeItems = useSelector(selectActiveCartItems)
  const savedItems = useSelector(selectSavedForLaterItems)
  const isAuthenticated = useSelector(selectIsAuthenticated)
  const deliveryLocation = useSelector(selectDeliveryLocation)
  const [couponCode, setCouponCode] = useCouponCode()
 
  // The wallet is previewed for signed-in customers, as in the design; the backend skips it for a coupon.
  const quote = useCartQuote({ couponCode, useWallet: isAuthenticated, pin: deliveryLocation?.pin })
  const savedQuote = useCartQuote({ items: savedItems })
 
  const lineByCode = new Map([...(savedQuote.data?.lines ?? []), ...(quote.data?.lines ?? [])].map((line) => [line.productCode, line]))
  const lines = activeItems.map((item) => lineByCode.get(item.productCode)).filter(Boolean)
  const savedLines = savedItems.map((item) => lineByCode.get(item.productCode)).filter(Boolean)
  const quantityOf = new Map(activeItems.map((item) => [item.productCode, item.quantity]))
 
  const removeItem = (line) => {
    dispatch(itemRemoved(line.productCode))
    toast.success(`${line.name} removed from your cart.`)
  }
 
  const hasActiveItems = activeItems.length > 0
  const summary = quote.data?.summary
  const stockProblem = lines.some((line) => lineHasStockProblem(line, quantityOf.get(line.productCode)))
  const savedSection = savedLines.length > 0 && (
    <SavedForLater
      lines={savedLines}
      onMoveToCart={(productCode) => dispatch(savedForLaterToggled(productCode))}
      onRemove={(productCode) => dispatch(itemRemoved(productCode))}
    />
  )
  const checkoutSearch = couponSearch(quote.data?.coupon?.valid ? couponCode : '')
 
  let content
  if (!hasActiveItems) {
    content = (
      <Card padding="none">
        <EmptyState
          icon="bag"
          title="Your cart is empty"
          description="Add a few everyday essentials and they will show up here."
          action={
            <Button as={Link} to={paths.shop}>
              Start shopping
            </Button>
          }
        />
      </Card>
    )
  } else if (quote.isError && !quote.data) {
    content = <ErrorState title="We couldn’t load your cart" message={getErrorMessage(quote.error)} onRetry={quote.refetch} />
  } else if (!quote.data) {
    content = <CartSkeleton />
  } else {
    content = (
      <div className={styles.layout}>
        <div className={styles.main}>
          {summary.awayFromFreeShipping === null ? (
            <p className={`${styles.notice} ${styles.noticeSuccess}`} role="status">
              Your order qualifies for free shipping.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <p className={styles.notice} role="status">
              You’re {formatINR(summary.awayFromFreeShipping)} away from free shipping. Keep the goodness coming.
            </p>
          )}
 
          <Card>
            <DeliveryEstimate delivery={quote.data.delivery} />
            <ul>
              {lines.map((line) => (
                <CartLineItem
                  key={line.productCode}
                  line={line}
                  quantity={quantityOf.get(line.productCode)}
                  onQuantityChange={(quantity) => dispatch(quantityChanged({ productCode: line.productCode, quantity }))}
                  onSaveForLater={() => dispatch(savedForLaterToggled(line.productCode))}
                  onRemove={() => removeItem(line)}
                />
              ))}
            </ul>
          </Card>
 
          {!stockProblem && (
            // ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: the backend reserves stock while a customer checks out;
            // this reassurance is shown only when the quote reports every line as available.
            <p className={`${styles.notice} ${styles.noticeSuccess}`}>
              <Icon name="check2" /> All {pluralize(summary.units, 'unit')} are reserved while you complete checkout.
            </p>
          )}
 
          {savedSection}
 
          <Button as={Link} to={paths.shop} variant="secondary" size="lg" leftIcon="arrow-left" className={styles.continue}>
            Continue shopping
          </Button>
        </div>
 
        <aside className={styles.aside} aria-label="Order summary and coupon">
          <OrderSummaryCard quote={quote.data} busy={quote.isFetching}>
            <Button
              as={Link}
              to={{ pathname: paths.checkout, search: checkoutSearch }}
              size="lg"
              leftIcon="lock"
              rightIcon="arrow-right"
              disabled={stockProblem}
              className={styles.checkout}
            >
              Continue to checkout
            </Button>
            {stockProblem && (
              <p className={styles.problem} role="alert">
                Update or remove the items marked above to continue.
              </p>
            )}
            <p className={styles.secure}>Secure payments by Razorpay. Prices include all applicable taxes.</p>
          </OrderSummaryCard>
 
          <CouponCard
            key={couponCode}
            code={couponCode}
            coupon={quote.data.coupon}
            applying={Boolean(couponCode) && quote.isPlaceholderData}
            onApply={setCouponCode}
            onRemove={() => setCouponCode('')}
          />
 
          <p className={styles.help}>
            Easy help when you need it: <a href={`mailto:${STOREFRONT.supportEmail}`}>{STOREFRONT.supportEmail}</a>
          </p>
        </aside>
      </div>
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.screen}>
      <Breadcrumbs items={BREADCRUMBS} />
      <header className={styles.header}>
        <h1 className={styles.title}>{hasActiveItems ? 'A few good things in your cart' : 'Your cart'}</h1>
        {hasActiveItems && summary && (
          <p className={styles.subtitle}>
            {pluralize(summary.products, 'product')} · {pluralize(summary.units, 'unit')} · All prices inclusive of GST
          </p>
        )}
      </header>
      {content}
      {!hasActiveItems && <div className={styles.savedOnly}>{savedSection}</div>}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/cart/components/CouponCard/CouponCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import { couponSchema } from '@/features/cart/schemas/couponSchema'
import styles from './CouponCard.module.scss'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with business team: promotional copy shown under the field.
const COUPON_HINT = 'HELLO10 is valid on your first order. Wallet and coupon offers cannot be combined.'
 
/**
 * Coupon entry. `code` is the code currently applied to the quote and `coupon` the backend's verdict on it
 * ({ valid, message }); the message is shown as the backend wrote it. Render with `key={code}` so the field
 * starts from the applied code after Apply or Remove.
 */
export default function CouponCard({ code, coupon, applying, onApply, onRemove }) {
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(couponSchema), defaultValues: { code } })
 
  const verdict = code && !applying ? coupon : null
  const error = errors.code?.message ?? (verdict && !verdict.valid ? verdict.message : undefined)
 
  return (
    <Card title="Have a little extra savings?">
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(({ code: next }) => onApply(next))} noValidate>
        <div aria-live="polite">
          <FormField
            label="Coupon code"
            hint={verdict?.valid ? undefined : COUPON_HINT}
            error={error}
            success={verdict?.valid ? verdict.message : undefined}
          >
            {(control) => (
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <Input {...control} {...register('code')} autoComplete="off" autoCapitalize="characters" placeholder="Enter code" />
                <Button type="submit" variant="secondary" size="sm" loading={applying}>
                  Apply
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </FormField>
        </div>
        {code && (
          <Button variant="link" size="sm" className={styles.remove} onClick={onRemove}>
            Remove coupon
          </Button>
        )}
      </form>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import DeliveryLocation from '@/features/storefront/components/DeliveryLocation'
import { formatShortDate } from '@/lib/date'
import styles from './DeliveryEstimate.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Where the cart is going and when it should arrive: the PIN picker plus the backend's serviceability and
 * ETA for that PIN (`quote.delivery`). The PIN itself is a UI preference shared with the header.
 */
export default function DeliveryEstimate({ delivery }) {
  const notServiceable = delivery?.serviceable === false
  const arrives = delivery?.serviceable ? `${formatShortDate(delivery.etaFrom)} – ${formatShortDate(delivery.etaTo)}` : null
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.row}>
      <DeliveryLocation variant="inline" />
      <p className={notServiceable ? styles.problem : styles.eta} role={notServiceable ? 'alert' : undefined}>
        {notServiceable && (
          <>
            <Icon name="exclamation-circle" /> We don’t deliver to {delivery.pin} yet. Try another PIN code.
          </>
        )}
        {arrives && (
          <>
            <Icon name="truck" /> Arrives {arrives}
          </>
        )}
        {!delivery?.pin && 'Add your PIN code to see delivery dates.'}
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}
```

import clsx from 'clsx'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import QuoteSummary from '@/features/cart/components/QuoteSummary'
import styles from './OrderSummaryCard.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Card around the backend quote: title, optional product lines, the figures and an action area
 * (`children`) such as "Continue to checkout" or "Pay securely". It dims while a newer quote is loading.
 * `compact` is the phone layout: tighter padding and the phone artboard's order of rows.
 */
export default function OrderSummaryCard({ quote, title = 'Order summary', showLines = false, compact = false, busy = false, className, children }) {
  return (
    <Card title={title} padding={compact ? 'sm' : 'md'} className={clsx(styles.card, busy && styles.busy, className)} aria-busy={busy || undefined}>
      {showLines && (
        <ul className={styles.lines}>
          {quote.lines.map((line) => (
            <li key={line.productCode} className={styles.line}>
              <span>
                {line.name} <span aria-hidden="true">×</span>
                <span className="visually-hidden">quantity </span>
                {line.quantity}
              </span>
              <span className={styles.amount}>{formatINR(line.lineTotal)}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      <QuoteSummary quote={quote} compact={compact} />
      {children}
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/cart/components/QuoteSummary/QuoteSummary.jsx`
 
```jsx
import SummaryRows from '@/components/molecules/SummaryRows'
import { formatINR, pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './QuoteSummary.module.scss'
 
const money = (value) => formatINR(value, { decimals: 2 })
const deduction = (value) => `− ${money(value)}`
 
/**
 * Every figure of a backend cart quote: items, taxable subtotal, GST, shipping, gross amount, coupon,
 * wallet and "To pay". Nothing is calculated here; the rows only format what `quote.summary` says.
 * Rows that do not apply (no coupon, no wallet) are left out, free shipping reads "Free". A placed order's
 * `summary` has the same figures, so it can be shown the same way with `totalLabel="Total paid"`.
 * `compact` is the phone artboard: taxable subtotal and GST first, then what they add up to, in one unbroken list.
 */
export default function QuoteSummary({ quote, totalLabel = 'To pay', compact = false }) {
  const { summary, coupon } = quote
 
  const taxableRow = { label: 'Taxable subtotal', value: money(summary.taxableSubtotal) }
  const gstRow = { label: 'GST', value: money(summary.gstTotal) }
  const itemsRow = {
    label: compact ? 'Items incl. GST' : `Items (${pluralize(summary.units, 'unit')}) · incl. GST`,
    value: money(summary.itemsTotal),
  }
  const shippingRow = { label: 'Shipping', value: summary.shipping > 0 ? money(summary.shipping) : 'Free', tone: summary.shipping > 0 ? undefined : 'success' }
  const itemRows = compact ? [taxableRow, gstRow, itemsRow, shippingRow] : [itemsRow, taxableRow, gstRow, shippingRow]
 
  const adjustmentRows = [
    { label: 'Gross amount', value: money(summary.grossAmount) },
    summary.couponDiscount > 0 && { label: coupon?.code ? `Coupon ${coupon.code}` : 'Coupon discount', value: deduction(summary.couponDiscount), tone: 'success' },
    summary.walletApplied > 0 && { label: 'Wallet applied', value: deduction(summary.walletApplied) },
  ].filter(Boolean)
 
  return (
    <div>
      {compact ? (
        <SummaryRows rows={[...itemRows, ...adjustmentRows]} />
      ) : (
        <>
          <SummaryRows rows={itemRows} />
          <SummaryRows rows={adjustmentRows} className={styles.group} />
        </>
      )}
      <div className={styles.total}>
        <span className={styles.totalLabel}>{totalLabel}</span>
        <strong className={styles.totalValue}>{money(summary.payable)}</strong>
      </div>
      <span className="visually-hidden" role="status">
        {totalLabel} {money(summary.payable)}
      </span>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/cart/components/SavedForLater/SavedForLater.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useId } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Thumbnail from '@/components/atoms/Thumbnail'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './SavedForLater.module.scss'
 
/** Products set aside from the cart. `lines` are quote lines for those products. */
export default function SavedForLater({ lines, onMoveToCart, onRemove }) {
  const headingId = useId()
 
  return (
    <Card as="section" aria-labelledby={headingId} className={styles.card}>
      <h2 id={headingId} className={styles.title}>
        Saved for later ({lines.length})
      </h2>
      <ul>
        {lines.map((line) => {
          const unavailable = line.maxQuantity === 0
          return (
            <li key={line.productCode} className={styles.item}>
              <Thumbnail src={line.image} size={64} className={styles.thumb} />
              <div className={styles.info}>
                <h3 className={styles.name}>
                  <Link to={paths.product(line.slug)}>{line.name}</Link>
                </h3>
                <p className={styles.meta}>
                  {line.unit} · {line.productCode} · {formatINR(line.unitPrice)}
                </p>
                {unavailable && <Badge tone="danger">Out of stock</Badge>}
              </div>
              <div className={styles.actions}>
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={unavailable} onClick={() => onMoveToCart(line.productCode)}>
                  Move to cart<span className="visually-hidden"> {line.name}</span>
                </Button>
                <button type="button" className={styles.remove} onClick={() => onRemove(line.productCode)}>
                  Remove<span className="visually-hidden"> {line.name} from saved items</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ul>
    </Card>
  )
}
```
 
## `src/features/cart/components/SavedForLater/SavedForLater.module.scss`

## `src/features/cart/hooks/useCartQuote.js`
 
```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { selectActiveCartItems } from '@/app/store'
import { getCartQuote } from '@/features/cart/services/cartService'
 
export const cartKeys = {
  all: ['cart'],
  quote: (payload) => ['cart', 'quote', payload],
}
 
/**
 * Backend quote for the active (not saved-for-later) cart lines. Pass `couponCode`, `useWallet`, `pin`
 * or `addressId` to price the checkout; `items` overrides the cart lines (for example "Buy now").
 * The previous quote stays on screen while a new one loads so totals do not flicker.
 */
export function useCartQuote({ items, couponCode, useWallet = false, pin, addressId, enabled = true } = {}) {
  const cartItems = useSelector(selectActiveCartItems)
  const lines = (items ?? cartItems).map(({ productCode, quantity }) => ({ productCode, quantity }))
  const payload = { items: lines, couponCode: couponCode || undefined, useWallet, pin: pin || undefined, addressId: addressId || undefined }
 
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: cartKeys.quote(payload),
    queryFn: () => getCartQuote(payload),
    enabled: enabled && lines.length > 0,
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
  })
}
```
 
## `src/features/cart/hooks/useCouponCode.js`
 
```javascript
import { useCallback } from 'react'
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
 
const COUPON_PARAM = 'coupon'
 
/**
 * The coupon the customer applied, kept in the URL (`?coupon=HELLO10`) so it survives a refresh and the
 * login redirect between cart and checkout. The backend quote decides whether the code is valid.
 */
export function useCouponCode() {
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams()
  const code = (params.get(COUPON_PARAM) ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()
 
  const setCode = useCallback(
    (next) =>
      setParams(
        (current) => {
          const updated = new URLSearchParams(current)
          if (next) updated.set(COUPON_PARAM, next.trim().toUpperCase())
          else updated.delete(COUPON_PARAM)
          return updated
        },
        { replace: true },
      ),
    [setParams],
  )
 
  return [code, setCode]
}
 
/** Query string that carries a valid coupon to the next screen: `?coupon=HELLO10`, or '' without one. */
export const couponSearch = (code) => (code ? `?${COUPON_PARAM}=${encodeURIComponent(code)}` : '')
```

## `src/features/cart/lib/lineStock.js`
 
```javascript
/**
 * True when a cart line cannot be bought as it stands: the product is out of stock, or the customer asked
 * for more than the backend allows (`maxQuantity` on the quote line).
 */
export function lineHasStockProblem(line, quantity) {
  return line.maxQuantity === 0 || quantity > line.maxQuantity
}
```

// Shape check only; the backend quote decides whether a code exists and applies to this cart.
export const couponSchema = z.object({
  code: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, 'Enter a coupon code')
    .max(24, 'Use 24 characters or fewer')
    .regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$/, 'Coupon codes use letters and numbers only'),
})

## `src/features/cart/services/cartService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
/**
 * Quote for the cart (or a checkout / purchase). The backend calculates every figure; the client only
 * sends what the customer chose.
 * ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team (B-01, B-03, B-04). Request:
 *   { items: [{ productCode, quantity }], couponCode?, useWallet?, pin?, addressId? }
 * Response: { lines[], summary{ units, products, itemsTotal, taxableSubtotal, gstTotal, cgst, sgst, igst,
 *   shipping, grossAmount, couponDiscount, walletApplied, payable, freeShippingThreshold, awayFromFreeShipping },
 *   wallet{ balance, eligible, maxPerOrder, applied, balanceAfter }, coupon{ code, valid, message, discount } | null,
 *   delivery{ pin, serviceable, city, method, fee, etaFrom, etaTo } }
 */
export async function getCartQuote(payload) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.cart.quote, payload)
  return data
}
```

import clsx from 'clsx'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import styles from './ActiveFilters.module.scss'
 
/** Applied filters as removable text chips ("In stock ×"), with an optional "Clear" for all of them. */
export default function ActiveFilters({ filters, onRemove, onClear, className }) {
  if (filters.length === 0) return null
 
  return (
    <ul className={clsx(styles.list, className)} aria-label="Applied filters">
      {filters.map((filter) => (
        <li key={filter.id}>
          <button type="button" className={styles.chip} aria-label={`Remove filter: ${filter.label}`} onClick={() => onRemove(filter)}>
            {filter.label}
            <Icon name="x-lg" />
          </button>
        </li>
      ))}
      {onClear && (
        <li>
          <button type="button" className={styles.clear} onClick={onClear}>
            Clear
          </button>
        </li>
      )}
    </ul>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/catalog/components/CategoryChips/CategoryChips.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Link, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { CATEGORIES } from '@/app/config/categories'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import styles from './CategoryChips.module.scss'
 
/** Phone-width category switcher. Switching category keeps the search and filters but returns to page 1. */
export default function CategoryChips({ activeSlug, className }) {
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams()
  const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams)
  next.delete('page')
  const search = next.toString() ? `?${next}` : ''
 
  const items = [{ slug: null, label: 'All', to: paths.shop }, ...CATEGORIES.map((category) => ({ ...category, to: paths.category(category.slug) }))]
 
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Shop by category" className={className}>
      <ul className={styles.list}>
        {items.map((item) => {
          const isActive = (activeSlug ?? null) === item.slug
          return (
            <li key={item.label}>
              <Link
                to={{ pathname: item.to, search }}
                className={clsx(styles.chip, isActive && styles.active)}
                aria-current={isActive ? 'page' : undefined}
              >
                {item.label}
              </Link>
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ul>
    </nav>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/catalog/components/CategoryTiles/CategoryTiles.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import SectionHeader from '@/features/catalog/components/SectionHeader'
import ResponsiveText from '@/features/catalog/components/ResponsiveText'
import { useCategories } from '@/features/catalog/hooks/useCatalog'
import styles from './CategoryTiles.module.scss'
 
const PHONE_TILE_COUNT = 3
 
/** "Everyday goodness, all in one place": a photo tile per category. Phones show three tiles and chips for the rest. */
export default function CategoryTiles() {
  const { data: categories, isPending, isError } = useCategories()
 
  if (isError) return null
 
  return (
    <section className={clsx('sh-container', styles.section)} aria-labelledby="category-tiles-heading">
      <SectionHeader
        id="category-tiles-heading"
        title={<ResponsiveText desktop="Everyday goodness, all in one place." mobile="Shop your everyday." />}
        description="Explore the essentials that make your day."
      />
 
      <ul className={styles.grid}>
        {isPending
          ? Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, index) => (
              <li key={index} className={index >= PHONE_TILE_COUNT ? styles.desktopOnly : undefined}>
                <Skeleton height="var(--tile-image-height)" radius="var(--sh-radius-lg)" />
              </li>
            ))
          : categories.map((category, index) => (
              <li key={category.slug} className={index >= PHONE_TILE_COUNT ? styles.desktopOnly : undefined}>
                <Link to={paths.category(category.slug)} className={styles.tile}>
                  <span className={styles.picture}>
                    <img src={category.image} alt="" loading="lazy" className={styles.image} />
                  </span>
                  <span className={styles.label}>
                    {category.name}
                    <Icon name="arrow-up-right" className={styles.arrow} />
                  </span>
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
      </ul>
 
      {categories && (
        <ul className={styles.chips}>
          {categories.slice(PHONE_TILE_COUNT).map((category) => (
            <li key={category.slug}>
              <Link to={paths.category(category.slug)} className={styles.chip}>
                {category.name}
                <Icon name="arrow-right" />
              </Link>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/catalog/components/CouponCard/CouponCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import { useCopyToClipboard } from '@/features/catalog/hooks/useCopyToClipboard'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './CouponCard.module.scss'
 
const COPIED_LABEL_MS = 2000
 
/**
 * One coupon on the offers page: what it gives, its conditions and a copy-code button. The coupon is
 * applied in the cart, where the backend decides whether it is valid for the order.
 * tone: primary | sand
 */
export default function CouponCard({ coupon, tone = 'primary' }) {
  const copy = useCopyToClipboard()
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)
 
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!copied) return undefined
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), COPIED_LABEL_MS)
    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [copied])
 
  const handleCopy = async () => {
    if (await copy(coupon.code)) {
      setCopied(true)
      toast.success(`${coupon.code} copied. Apply it in your cart.`, { toastId: `coupon-copied-${coupon.code}` })
    } else {
      toast.error(`We couldn’t copy it for you. Your code is ${coupon.code}.`, { toastId: `coupon-copy-failed-${coupon.code}` })
    }
  }
 
  return (
    <article className={clsx(styles.card, styles[tone])}>
      <div className={styles.details}>
        <p className={styles.eyebrow}>{coupon.firstOrderOnly ? 'First order only' : 'Every order'}</p>
        <h3 className={styles.title}>{coupon.title}</h3>
        <p className={styles.description}>{coupon.description}</p>
        <ul className={styles.terms}>
          <li>Min. order {formatINR(coupon.minOrderValue)}</li>
          {coupon.maxDiscount !== null && <li>Up to {formatINR(coupon.maxDiscount)} off</li>}
        </ul>
      </div>
 
      <div className={styles.redeem}>
        <p className={styles.code}>
          <span className={styles.codeLabel}>Code</span>
          {coupon.code}
        </p>
        <Button
          variant={copied ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
          size="lg"
          leftIcon={copied ? 'check2' : 'copy'}
          onClick={handleCopy}
          aria-label={copied ? `${coupon.code} copied` : `Copy code ${coupon.code}`}
        >
          {copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy code'}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </article>
  )
}
```

import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'

import pantryImage from '@/assets/storefront/pantry.jpg'

import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import ResponsiveText from '@/features/catalog/components/ResponsiveText'
import styles from './EditorialBanner.module.scss'
 
/** "Rooted in goodness": the grocery promo, copy left and photograph right (photograph on top on phones). */
export default function EditorialBanner() {
  return (
    <section className={clsx('sh-container', styles.section)} aria-labelledby="pantry-banner-title">
      <div className={styles.banner}>
        <div className={styles.media}>
          <img src={pantryImage} alt="" loading="lazy" className={styles.image} />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.copy}>
          <p className={styles.eyebrow}>From our pantry to yours</p>
          <h2 id="pantry-banner-title" className={styles.title}>
            <span className={styles.line}>Rooted in goodness.</span>
            <span className={clsx(styles.line, 'd-none d-md-block')}>Made for your kitchen.</span>
          </h2>
          <p className={styles.lead}>
            <ResponsiveText desktop="Honest ingredients. Everyday nourishment." mobile="Honest ingredients for your kitchen." />
          </p>
          <Button as={Link} to={paths.category('grocery')} size="lg" rightIcon="arrow-right" className={styles.action}>
            Explore grocery
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}

```scss
@use '@/styles/mixins' as *;
 
.section {
  padding-top: 2rem;
 
  @include up('md') {
    padding-top: 3.75rem;
  }
}
 
.banner {
  display: grid;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--sh-radius-lg);
  background: var(--sh-color-sand);
 
  @include up('md') {
    border-radius: var(--sh-radius-xl);
    grid-template-columns: 650fr 662fr;
  }
}
 
.media {
  position: relative;
  height: 180px;
 
  @include up('md') {
    height: auto;
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 1;
  }
}
 
// Absolutely placed so the copy, not the photograph's proportions, sets the banner height.
.image {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}
 
.copy {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1.375rem 1.25rem 1.25rem;

}

## `src/features/catalog/components/FilterPanel/FilterPanel.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useId } from 'react'
import { CATEGORIES } from '@/app/config/categories'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import Radio from '@/components/atoms/Radio'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import RatingStars from '@/components/molecules/RatingStars'
import PriceRangeSlider from '@/features/catalog/components/PriceRangeSlider'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './FilterPanel.module.scss'
 
const MIN_RATING = 4
const MIN_DISCOUNT = 20
 
function Section({ title, children }) {
  const headingId = useId()
  return (
    <section className={styles.section} aria-labelledby={headingId}>
      <h3 id={headingId} className={styles.heading}>
        {title}
      </h3>
      {children}
    </section>
  )
}
 
/**
 * Category, price, availability, rating and offer filters. Controlled by the URL query: it reports
 * changes through `onChange(patch)` (URL params) and `onCategoryChange(slug | null)`.
 * `facets` come from the catalogue response; until they arrive the categories show without counts.
 */
export default function FilterPanel({ query, facets, onChange, onCategoryChange }) {
  const groupName = useId()
  const counts = new Map((facets?.categories ?? []).map((category) => [category.slug, category.count]))
  const total = facets ? facets.categories.reduce((sum, category) => sum + category.count, 0) : null
  const withCount = (label, count) => (count === undefined || count === null ? label : `${label} (${formatNumber(count)})`)
  const bounds = facets?.priceBounds
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.panel}>
      <Section title="Category">
        <div className={styles.options}>
          <Radio
            name={`${groupName}-category`}
            label={withCount('All essentials', total)}
            checked={!query.category}
            onChange={() => onCategoryChange(null)}
          />
          {CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
            <Radio
              key={category.slug}
              name={`${groupName}-category`}
              label={withCount(category.label, counts.get(category.slug))}
              checked={query.category === category.slug}
              onChange={() => onCategoryChange(category.slug)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Section>
 
      <Section title="Price">
        {bounds && bounds.max > bounds.min ? (
          <PriceRangeSlider
            key={`${bounds.min}-${bounds.max}-${query.minPrice}-${query.maxPrice}`}
            bounds={bounds}
            value={{ min: query.minPrice, max: query.maxPrice }}
            onCommit={({ min, max }) => onChange({ minPrice: min, maxPrice: max })}
          />
        ) : (
          <Skeleton height="3.5rem" />
        )}
      </Section>
 
      <Section title="Availability">
        <div className={styles.options}>
          <Radio name={`${groupName}-stock`} label="In stock" checked={Boolean(query.inStock)} onChange={() => onChange({ inStock: true })} />
          <Radio
            name={`${groupName}-stock`}
            label="Include sold out"
            checked={!query.inStock}
            onChange={() => onChange({ inStock: undefined })}
          />
        </div>
      </Section>
 
      <Section title="Customer rating">
        <Checkbox
          label={
            <span className={styles.rating}>
              <RatingStars value={MIN_RATING} tone="warning" size="sm" /> &amp; above
            </span>
          }
          checked={query.minRating === MIN_RATING}
          onChange={(event) => onChange({ minRating: event.target.checked ? MIN_RATING : undefined })}
        />
      </Section>
 
      <Section title="Offers">
        <div className={styles.options}>
          <Checkbox
            label={`${MIN_DISCOUNT}% off or more`}
            checked={query.minDiscount === MIN_DISCOUNT}
            onChange={(event) => onChange({ minDiscount: event.target.checked ? MIN_DISCOUNT : undefined })}
          />
          <Checkbox
            label="Wallet rewards"
            checked={Boolean(query.walletRewards)}
            onChange={(event) => onChange({ walletRewards: event.target.checked || undefined })}
          />
        </div>
      </Section>
    </div>
  )
}
```

import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Drawer from '@/components/organisms/Drawer'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './FilterSheet.module.scss'
 
/** Mobile filter panel as a bottom sheet. Filters apply as they are chosen; the footer button just closes it. */
export default function FilterSheet({ open, onClose, resultCount, canClear, onClear, children }) {
  return (
    <Drawer
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      placement="bottom"
      title="Filters"
      footer={
        <div className={styles.footer}>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClear} disabled={!canClear}>
            Clear all
          </Button>
          <Button className={styles.apply} onClick={onClose}>
            {resultCount === undefined ? 'Show products' : `Show ${formatNumber(resultCount)} products`}
          </Button>
        </div>
      }
    >
      {children}
    </Drawer>
  )
}
```

    <section className={styles.hero} aria-labelledby="home-hero-title">

## `src/features/catalog/components/NewsletterSignup/NewsletterSignup.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import { useNewsletterSignup } from '@/features/catalog/hooks/useCatalog'
import { newsletterSchema } from '@/features/catalog/schemas/newsletterSchema'
import styles from './NewsletterSignup.module.scss'
 
/** "Good things in your inbox": email sign-up. */
export default function NewsletterSignup() {
  const signup = useNewsletterSignup()
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    reset,
    setError,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(newsletterSchema), defaultValues: { email: '' } })
 
  const submit = ({ email }) =>
    signup.mutate(email, {
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success('Thank you! You’re on the list for fresh finds and offers.')
        reset()
      },
      onError: (error) => setError('email', { message: getErrorMessage(error) }),
    })
 
  return (
    <section className={styles.section} aria-labelledby="newsletter-title">
      <div className={styles.band}>
        <div className={styles.text}>
          <h2 id="newsletter-title" className={styles.title}>
            Good things in your inbox.
          </h2>
          <p className={styles.description}>Fresh finds, thoughtful offers, and a little everyday inspiration.</p>
        </div>
        <form className={styles.form} onSubmit={handleSubmit(submit)} noValidate>
          <FormField label="Your email" error={errors.email?.message} className={styles.field}>
            {(control) => (
              <Input {...control} type="email" autoComplete="email" placeholder="Enter your email address" {...register('email')} />
            )}
          </FormField>
          <Button type="submit" size="lg" rightIcon="arrow-right" loading={signup.isPending} className={styles.submit}>
            Count me in
          </Button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}
```
