## `src/features/catalog/components/OffersCatalog/OffersCatalog.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useRef } from 'react'
import { Link, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import Breadcrumbs from '@/components/molecules/Breadcrumbs'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import { Pagination } from '@/components/molecules/Pagination'
import CouponCard from '@/features/catalog/components/CouponCard'
import FreeShippingNote from '@/features/catalog/components/FreeShippingNote'
import ProductGrid from '@/features/catalog/components/ProductGrid'
import ResultsSummary from '@/features/catalog/components/ResultsSummary'
import { useOffers, useProducts } from '@/features/catalog/hooks/useCatalog'
import { useSaveProduct } from '@/features/catalog/hooks/useSaveProduct'
import styles from './OffersCatalog.module.scss'
 
const DEALS_PAGE_SIZE = 8
const DEALS_MIN_DISCOUNT = 20
const COUPON_TONES = ['primary', 'sand']
 
function readPage(searchParams) {
  const page = Math.floor(Number(searchParams.get('page')))
  return Number.isFinite(page) && page > 0 ? page : 1
}
 
/** /offers — coupons, the free-delivery rule and the best-discounted products (catalogue API, `minDiscount`, biggest discount first). */
export default function OffersCatalog() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams()
  const page = readPage(searchParams)
  const dealsRef = useRef(null)
  const offers = useOffers()
  const deals = useProducts(
    { minDiscount: DEALS_MIN_DISCOUNT, sort: 'discount', page, pageSize: DEALS_PAGE_SIZE },
    { keepPrevious: true },
  )
  const save = useSaveProduct()
 
  const goToPage = (nextPage) => {
    setSearchParams((previous) => {
      const next = new URLSearchParams(previous)
      if (nextPage > 1) next.set('page', String(nextPage))
      else next.delete('page')
      return next
    })
    dealsRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' })
  }
 
  let coupons
  if (offers.isError) {
    coupons = <ErrorState compact message={getErrorMessage(offers.error)} onRetry={offers.refetch} />
  } else if (offers.isPending) {
    coupons = (
      <div className={styles.coupons} aria-busy="true">
        <Skeleton height="13.5rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-lg)" />
        <Skeleton height="13.5rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-lg)" />
      </div>
    )
  } else {
    coupons = (
      <ul className={styles.coupons}>
        {offers.data.coupons.map((coupon, index) => (
          <li key={coupon.code}>
            <CouponCard coupon={coupon} tone={COUPON_TONES[index % COUPON_TONES.length]} />
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    )
  }
 
  const { data } = deals
  let results
  if (deals.isError) {
    results = <ErrorState message={getErrorMessage(deals.error)} onRetry={deals.refetch} />
  } else if (deals.isPending) {
    results = <ProductGrid variant="shelf" loading skeletonCount={DEALS_PAGE_SIZE} />
  } else if (data.items.length === 0) {
    results = (
      <EmptyState
        icon="tag"
        title="No deals right now"
        description="Check back soon, or browse everything we have."
        action={
          <Button as={Link} to={paths.shop}>
            Shop all products
          </Button>
        }
      />
    )
  } else {
    results = (
      <ProductGrid
        variant="shelf"
        label="Discounted products"
        products={data.items}
        isSaved={save.isSaved}
        onToggleSaved={save.onToggleSaved}
      />
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <div className={clsx('sh-container', styles.page)}>
      <header className={styles.intro}>
        <Breadcrumbs
          className={styles.breadcrumbs}
          items={[{ label: 'Home', to: paths.home }, { label: 'Today’s offers' }]}
        />
        <h1 className={styles.title}>Today’s offers</h1>
        <p className={styles.description}>Coupons, free delivery and the best prices on everyday essentials.</p>
      </header>
 
      <section className={styles.section} aria-labelledby="coupons-title">
        <h2 id="coupons-title" className={styles.sectionTitle}>
          Coupons for you
        </h2>
        {coupons}
      </section>
 
      {offers.data && (
        <div className={styles.section}>
          <FreeShippingNote threshold={offers.data.freeShippingThreshold} />
        </div>
      )}
 
      <section ref={dealsRef} className={styles.section} aria-labelledby="deals-title">
        <h2 id="deals-title" className={styles.sectionTitle}>
          Best prices right now
        </h2>
        <p className={styles.sectionDescription}>Products with {DEALS_MIN_DISCOUNT}% off or more, biggest savings first.</p>
 
        <div
          className={clsx(styles.deals, deals.isPlaceholderData && styles.refreshing)}
          aria-busy={deals.isFetching || undefined}
        >
          {results}
        </div>
 
        {data && data.pageCount > 1 && (
          <div className={styles.footer}>
            <ResultsSummary page={data.page} pageSize={data.pageSize} totalItems={data.totalItems} />
            <Pagination page={data.page} pageCount={data.pageCount} onPageChange={goToPage} />
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

## `src/features/catalog/components/PriceRangeSlider/PriceRangeSlider.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useId, useState } from 'react'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './PriceRangeSlider.module.scss'
 
const STEP = 5
 
/**
 * Two-handle price range. `bounds` is the catalogue's price range for the current search (from the API);
 * `value` is the applied range, either side may be undefined. Dragging only updates the thumbs;
 * the range is committed (and the catalogue re-queried) when the handle is released, so a drag is one request.
 * Give it a `key` built from the applied range and bounds so it resets when the URL changes.
 */
export default function PriceRangeSlider({ bounds, value, onCommit }) {
  const captionId = useId()
  const applied = { low: value.min ?? bounds.min, high: value.max ?? bounds.max }
  const [range, setRange] = useState(applied)
  const span = Math.max(1, bounds.max - bounds.min)
  const toPercent = (amount) => ((amount - bounds.min) / span) * 100
 
  const commit = () => {
    if (range.low === applied.low && range.high === applied.high) return
    onCommit({ min: range.low <= bounds.min ? undefined : range.low, max: range.high >= bounds.max ? undefined : range.high })
  }
  const moveLow = (event) => setRange((current) => ({ ...current, low: Math.min(Number(event.target.value), current.high - STEP) }))
  const moveHigh = (event) => setRange((current) => ({ ...current, high: Math.max(Number(event.target.value), current.low + STEP) }))
 
  const shared = { type: 'range', className: styles.input, min: bounds.min, max: bounds.max, step: STEP, 'aria-describedby': captionId, onPointerUp: commit, onKeyUp: commit, onBlur: commit }
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.slider}>
      <div className={styles.row}>
        <span className={styles.end}>{formatINR(bounds.min)}</span>
        <div className={styles.track}>
          <span className={styles.fill} style={{ left: `${toPercent(range.low)}%`, right: `${100 - toPercent(range.high)}%` }} />
          <input {...shared} value={range.low} onChange={moveLow} aria-label="Minimum price" />
          <input {...shared} value={range.high} onChange={moveHigh} aria-label="Maximum price" />
        </div>
        <span className={styles.end}>{formatINR(bounds.max)}</span>
      </div>
      <p id={captionId} className={styles.caption} aria-live="polite">
        Range: {formatINR(range.low)} – {formatINR(range.high)}
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}
```

$thumb: 16px;
 
.slider {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}
 
.row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}
 
.end {
  color: var(--sh-color-ink);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-sm);
}
 
.track {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  height: $thumb;
  margin-inline: calc($thumb / 2);
 
  &::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    right: calc($thumb / -2);
    left: calc($thumb / -2);
    height: 4px;
    border-radius: var(--sh-radius-pill);
    background: var(--sh-color-border);
    transform: translateY(-50%);
  }
}
 
.fill {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: var(--sh-radius-pill);
  background: var(--sh-color-primary);
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}
 
// Both range inputs sit on top of each other; only their thumbs take pointer events.
.input {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: calc($thumb / -2);
  width: calc(100% + $thumb);
  height: $thumb;
  margin: 0;
  background: transparent;
  pointer-events: none;
  appearance: none;
 
  &::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
    background: transparent;
    appearance: none;
  }
 
  &::-moz-range-track {
    background: transparent;
  }
 
  &::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    width: $thumb;
    height: $thumb;
    border: 3px solid var(--sh-color-white);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--sh-color-navy);
    box-shadow: var(--sh-shadow-sm);
    cursor: grab;
    pointer-events: auto;
    appearance: none;
  }
 
  &::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: $thumb;
    height: $thumb;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    border: 3px solid var(--sh-color-white);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--sh-color-navy);
    box-shadow: var(--sh-shadow-sm);
    cursor: grab;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
 
  &:focus-visible {
    outline: none;
    box-shadow: none;
 
    &::-webkit-slider-thumb {
      box-shadow: var(--sh-focus-ring);
    }
 
    &::-moz-range-thumb {
      box-shadow: var(--sh-focus-ring);
    }
  }
}
 
.caption {
  margin: 0.25rem 0 0;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-xs);
}

```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Breadcrumbs from '@/components/molecules/Breadcrumbs'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import RatingStars from '@/components/molecules/RatingStars'
import ProductDetailsCard from '@/features/catalog/components/ProductDetailsCard'
import ProductDetailSkeleton from '@/features/catalog/components/ProductDetailSkeleton'
import ProductGallery from '@/features/catalog/components/ProductGallery'
import ProductNotFound from '@/features/catalog/components/ProductNotFound'
import ProductPrice from '@/features/catalog/components/ProductPrice'
import PurchasePanel from '@/features/catalog/components/PurchasePanel'
import RelatedProducts from '@/features/catalog/components/RelatedProducts'
import ReviewsCard from '@/features/catalog/components/ReviewsCard'
import VariantPicker from '@/features/catalog/components/VariantPicker'
import { useProduct } from '@/features/catalog/hooks/useCatalog'
import DeliveryCheck from '@/features/storefront/components/DeliveryCheck'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './ProductDetail.module.scss'
 
function ProductView({ product }) {
  return (
    <div className={clsx('sh-container', styles.page)}>
      <Breadcrumbs
        className={styles.breadcrumbs}
        items={[{ label: 'Home', to: paths.home }, { label: product.categoryLabel, to: paths.category(product.category) }, { label: product.name }]}
      />
 
      <div className={styles.layout}>
        <ProductGallery images={product.gallery} name={product.name} />
 
        <div className={styles.summary}>
          {product.badge && (
            <Badge tone="info" className={styles.badge}>
              {product.badge}
            </Badge>
          )}
          <h1 className={styles.title}>{product.name}</h1>
          <p className={styles.tagline}>{product.tagline}</p>
          <p className={styles.rating}>
            <RatingStars value={Math.round(product.rating)} tone="warning" />
            <span>{product.rating.toFixed(1)}</span>
            <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
            <span>{formatNumber(product.reviewCount)} verified reviews</span>
          </p>
 
          <ProductPrice product={product} />
          <p className={styles.description}>{product.description}</p>
 
          <VariantPicker variants={product.variants} />
          <PurchasePanel product={product} />
          <DeliveryCheck className={styles.delivery} />
          <p className={styles.assurance}>Secure payments · Quality checked · India-wide shipping</p>
        </div>
      </div>
 
      <div className={styles.info}>
        <ProductDetailsCard product={product} />
        <ReviewsCard reviews={product.reviews} />
      </div>
 
      <RelatedProducts slug={product.slug} />
    </div>
  )
}
 
/** Product page for a slug: gallery, price, purchase actions, delivery check, details, reviews and related products. */
export default function ProductDetail({ slug }) {
  const { data: product, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useProduct(slug)
 
  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <div className={clsx('sh-container', styles.page)}>
        <ProductDetailSkeleton />
      </div>
    )
  }
  if (isError) {
    return error.status === 404 ? (
      <ProductNotFound />
    ) : (
      <div className="sh-container py-5">
        <ErrorState message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} />
      </div>
    )
  }
 
  return <ProductView key={product.slug} product={product} />
}
```

import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import { formatPercent } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './ProductDetailsCard.module.scss'
 
/** "The details" table: what is in the pack, batch, tax and storage. */
export default function ProductDetailsCard({ product, className }) {
  const rows = [
    ['Product code', product.code],
    ['Ingredients', product.ingredients],
    ['Net quantity', product.netQuantity],
    ['Batch / best before', `${product.batch} / ${product.bestBefore}`],
    ['HSN / GST', `${product.hsn} / ${formatPercent(product.gstPercent)}`],
    ['Storage', product.storage],
  ]
 
  return (
    <Card title="The details" className={className}>
      <dl className={styles.rows}>
        {rows.map(([label, value]) => (
          <div key={label} className={styles.row}>
            <dt>{label}</dt>
            <dd>{value}</dd>
          </div>
        ))}
      </dl>
      <p className={styles.note}>
        Packed by {product.packedBy}. {product.careNote}
      </p>
    </Card>
  )
}

## `src/features/catalog/components/ProductGallery/ProductGallery.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import styles from './ProductGallery.module.scss'
 
const VISIBLE_THUMBNAILS = 3
 
/** Main photo with a thumbnail strip; photos beyond the first three sit behind a "+N photos" tile. */
export default function ProductGallery({ images, name }) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0)
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false)
  const hiddenCount = images.length - VISIBLE_THUMBNAILS
  const showAll = expanded || hiddenCount <= 0
  const thumbnails = showAll ? images : images.slice(0, VISIBLE_THUMBNAILS)
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.gallery}>
      <div className={styles.stage}>
        <img src={images[selected].url} alt={images[selected].alt} className={styles.image} />
      </div>
      <ul className={styles.thumbnails} aria-label={`${name} photos`}>
        {thumbnails.map((image, index) => (
          <li key={image.url}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={clsx(styles.thumbnail, index === selected && styles.active)}
              aria-label={`Show photo ${index + 1} of ${images.length}`}
              aria-current={index === selected ? 'true' : undefined}
              onClick={() => setSelected(index)}
            >
              <img src={image.url} alt="" loading="lazy" />
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
        {!showAll && (
          <li>
            <button type="button" className={styles.more} onClick={() => setExpanded(true)}>
              +{hiddenCount} {hiddenCount === 1 ? 'photo' : 'photos'}
            </button>
          </li>
        )}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/catalog/components/ProductGrid/ProductGrid.jsx`
 
```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import ProductCard from '@/components/organisms/ProductCard'
import styles from './ProductGrid.module.scss'
 
function ProductCardSkeleton() {
  return (
    <li className={styles.skeletonCard} aria-hidden="true">
      <Skeleton height="var(--card-image-height)" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
      <Skeleton width="40%" height="0.75rem" />
      <Skeleton width="80%" height="1.125rem" />
      <Skeleton width="55%" height="1.5rem" className={styles.skeletonPrice} />
      <Skeleton width="45%" height="0.75rem" />
      <Skeleton width="50%" height="2.125rem" />
    </li>
  )
}
 
/**
 * Responsive grid of product cards. variant: listing (shop and offers, beside the filter panel: 2 / 3 columns)
 * | shelf (home, offers and related products: 2 / 4 columns, the fourth from 1024px). `compactCodes` limits phones to those products, as the
 * home artboard shows two per shelf. Pass `onToggleSaved` (from useSaveProduct) with `isSaved` to add the heart.
 */
export default function ProductGrid({
  products,
  variant = 'listing',
  compactCodes,
  isSaved,
  onToggleSaved,
  loading = false,
  skeletonCount = 4,
  label,
}) {
  return (
    <ul className={clsx(styles.grid, styles[variant])} aria-label={label} aria-busy={loading || undefined}>
      {loading
        ? Array.from({ length: skeletonCount }, (_, index) => <ProductCardSkeleton key={index} />)
        : products.map((product) => (
            <li key={product.code} className={clsx(compactCodes && !compactCodes.includes(product.code) && styles.desktopOnly)}>
              <ProductCard
                product={product}
                isSaved={isSaved?.(product.code)}
                onToggleSaved={onToggleSaved}
                className={styles.card}
              />
            </li>
          ))}
    </ul>
  )
}
```
 
## `src/features/catalog/components/ProductGrid/ProductGrid.module.scss`
 
```scss
@use '@/styles/mixins' as *;
 
.grid {
  --card-image-height: 145px;
 
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
 
  @include up('md') {
    --card-image-height: 218px;
 
    gap: 1.125rem;
  }
}
 
.listing {
  @include up('md') {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}
 
.shelf {
  @include up('lg') {
    gap: 1.25rem;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}
 
.card {
  height: 100%;
}
 
.desktopOnly {
  @include down('md') {
    display: none;
  }
}
 
.skeletonCard {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.625rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--sh-color-border);
  border-radius: var(--sh-radius-lg);

```jsx
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import { formatINR, formatPercent } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './ProductPrice.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Product-page price block: ₹120  MRP ₹150  20% OFF, then the tax and savings line. Every figure,
 * including the savings, is supplied by the backend.
 */
export default function ProductPrice({ product }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <div className={styles.row}>
        <span className={styles.selling}>{formatINR(product.sellingPrice)}</span>
        {product.mrp > product.sellingPrice && <span className={styles.mrp}>MRP {formatINR(product.mrp)}</span>}
        {product.discountPercent > 0 && (
          <Badge tone="success" className={styles.discount}>
            {formatPercent(product.discountPercent, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })} off
          </Badge>
        )}
      </div>
      <p className={styles.note}>
        Inclusive of {formatPercent(product.gstPercent)} GST
        {product.savings > 0 && <> · You save {formatINR(product.savings)}</>}
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import ProductGrid from '@/features/catalog/components/ProductGrid'
import SectionHeader from '@/features/catalog/components/SectionHeader'
import { useProducts } from '@/features/catalog/hooks/useCatalog'
import styles from './ProductShelf.module.scss'
 
const SHELF_SIZE = 4
 
/**
 * A titled row of curated products from the catalogue API (`collection`). `compactCodes` are the
 * products phones show, `action` is the desktop button and `phoneActionLabel` the phone link (`null` hides it).
 */
export default function ProductShelf({ id, title, description, collection, compactCodes, action, phoneActionLabel = 'View all', className }) {
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useProducts({ collection, pageSize: SHELF_SIZE })
 
  return (
    <section className={clsx('sh-container', styles.section, className)} aria-labelledby={id}>
      <SectionHeader
        id={id}
        title={title}
        description={description}
        action={
          <>
            <Button as={Link} to={action.to} size="lg" rightIcon="arrow-right" className="d-none d-md-inline-flex">
              {action.label}
            </Button>
            {phoneActionLabel && (
              <Link to={action.to} className={styles.phoneAction}>
                {phoneActionLabel} <Icon name="arrow-right" />
              </Link>
            )}
          </>
        }
      />
      <div className={styles.grid}>
        {isError ? (
          <ErrorState compact message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} />
        ) : (
          <ProductGrid
            variant="shelf"
            products={data?.items ?? []}
            loading={isPending}
            skeletonCount={SHELF_SIZE}
            compactCodes={compactCodes}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/catalog/components/PurchasePanel/PurchasePanel.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import QuantityStepper from '@/components/molecules/QuantityStepper'
import { useAddToCart } from '@/components/organisms/ProductCard/useAddToCart'
import { useSaveProduct } from '@/features/catalog/hooks/useSaveProduct'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './PurchasePanel.module.scss'
 
const STOCK_BADGE = {
  in_stock: { tone: 'success', label: (product) => `In stock · ${formatNumber(product.availableQuantity)} available` },
  low_stock: { tone: 'warning', label: (product) => `Only ${product.lowStockLeft} left` },
  out_of_stock: { tone: 'danger', label: () => 'Out of stock' },
}
 
/** Availability, quantity, Add to Cart, Buy Now and the save heart for one product. */
export default function PurchasePanel({ product }) {
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1)
  const { addToCart, buyNow } = useAddToCart()
  const { isSaved, onToggleSaved } = useSaveProduct()
  const stock = STOCK_BADGE[product.stockStatus]
  const soldOut = product.stockStatus === 'out_of_stock'
  const saved = isSaved(product.code)
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.panel}>
      <div className={styles.stockRow}>
        <Badge tone={stock.tone} className={styles.stock}>
          {stock.label(product)}
        </Badge>
        <div className={styles.quantity}>
          <span className={styles.quantityLabel}>Quantity</span>
          <QuantityStepper value={quantity} onChange={setQuantity} max={product.purchaseLimit} disabled={soldOut} />
        </div>
      </div>
 
      <div className={styles.actions}>
        <Button variant="secondary" size="lg" leftIcon="bag" disabled={soldOut} onClick={() => addToCart(product, quantity)}>
          Add to Cart
        </Button>
        <Button size="lg" rightIcon="arrow-right" disabled={soldOut} onClick={() => buyNow(product, quantity)}>
          Buy Now
        </Button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={clsx(styles.save, saved && styles.saved)}
          aria-pressed={saved}
          aria-label={saved ? 'Remove from saved products' : 'Save for later'}
          onClick={() => onToggleSaved(product.code)}
        >
          <Icon name={saved ? 'heart-fill' : 'heart'} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

import ProductGrid from '@/features/catalog/components/ProductGrid'
import { useRelatedProducts } from '@/features/catalog/hooks/useCatalog'
import styles from './RelatedProducts.module.scss'
 
/** "A few more good things": complementary products for the one being viewed. Hidden when there are none. */
export default function RelatedProducts({ slug }) {
  const related = useRelatedProducts(slug)
 
  if (related.isError || (related.isSuccess && related.data.length === 0)) return null
 
  return (
    <section className={styles.section} aria-labelledby="related-heading">
      <h2 id="related-heading" className={styles.title}>
        A few more good things
      </h2>
      <p className={styles.description}>Complete your everyday essentials.</p>
      <div className={styles.grid}>
        <ProductGrid variant="shelf" products={related.data ?? []} loading={related.isPending} skeletonCount={4} />
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}

import clsx from 'clsx'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './ResultsSummary.module.scss'
 
/** "Showing 1–12 of 118 products". Announced politely when the results change. */
export default function ResultsSummary({ page, pageSize, totalItems, className }) {
  const from = (page - 1) * pageSize + 1
  const to = Math.min(page * pageSize, totalItems)
 
  return (
    <p className={clsx(styles.summary, className)} aria-live="polite">
      {totalItems === 0 ? 'No products found' : `Showing ${formatNumber(from)}–${formatNumber(to)} of ${formatNumber(totalItems)} products`}
    </p>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/catalog/components/ReviewsCard/ReviewsCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import { formatDate } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './ReviewsCard.module.scss'
 
/** Rating summary with the latest review; "Read all reviews" opens the rest of the sample. */
export default function ReviewsCard({ reviews, className }) {
  const [showAll, setShowAll] = useState(false)
  const visible = showAll ? reviews.highlights : reviews.highlights.slice(0, 1)
 
  return (
    <Card title="What our customers say" className={className}>
      <div className={styles.score}>
        <span className={styles.value}>{reviews.average.toFixed(1)} / 5</span>
        <span role="img" aria-label={`Rated ${reviews.average.toFixed(1)} out of 5`} className={styles.stars}>
          {Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, index) => (
            <Icon key={index} name="star-fill" />
          ))}
        </span>
      </div>
      <p className={styles.basis}>Based on {formatNumber(reviews.count)} verified purchases</p>
 
      <ul className={styles.list} id="product-reviews">
        {visible.map((review) => (
          <li key={`${review.author}-${review.reviewedAt}`} className={styles.review}>
            <blockquote className={styles.quote}>“{review.quote}”</blockquote>
            <p className={styles.author}>
              {review.author} · {formatDate(review.reviewedAt)}
            </p>
            {review.verified && (
              <Badge tone="success" className={styles.verified}>
                Verified purchase
              </Badge>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
 
      {reviews.highlights.length > 1 && (
        <Button
          variant="link"
          className={styles.toggle}
          rightIcon={showAll ? undefined : 'arrow-right'}
          aria-expanded={showAll}
          aria-controls="product-reviews"
          onClick={() => setShowAll((current) => !current)}
        >
          {showAll ? 'Show fewer reviews' : 'Read all reviews'}
        </Button>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}
```

import clsx from 'clsx'
import styles from './SectionHeader.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Home-page section heading: title, supporting line (desktop only, as designed) and an optional action
 * on the right. `title` and `action` may carry separate phone and desktop wording.
 */
export default function SectionHeader({ id, title, description, action, className }) {
  return (
    <header className={clsx(styles.header, className)}>
      <div className={styles.text}>
        <h2 id={id} className={styles.title}>
          {title}
        </h2>
        {description && <p className={styles.description}>{description}</p>}
      </div>
      {action}
    </header>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/catalog/components/ShopCatalog/ShopCatalog.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useRef } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { CATEGORIES } from '@/app/config/categories'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import { Pagination } from '@/components/molecules/Pagination'
import ActiveFilters from '@/features/catalog/components/ActiveFilters'
import CategoryChips from '@/features/catalog/components/CategoryChips'
import FilterPanel from '@/features/catalog/components/FilterPanel'
import FilterSheet from '@/features/catalog/components/FilterSheet'
import ProductGrid from '@/features/catalog/components/ProductGrid'
import ResultsSummary from '@/features/catalog/components/ResultsSummary'
import ShopIntro from '@/features/catalog/components/ShopIntro'
import ShopSearch from '@/features/catalog/components/ShopSearch'
import SortSelect from '@/features/catalog/components/SortSelect'
import { useCategories, useProducts } from '@/features/catalog/hooks/useCatalog'
import { useProductFilters } from '@/features/catalog/hooks/useProductFilters'
import { useSaveProduct } from '@/features/catalog/hooks/useSaveProduct'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import { useMediaQuery } from '@/hooks/useMediaQuery'
import styles from './ShopCatalog.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Catalogue browsing: filters, sort, search and paging, all held in the URL and answered by the API.
 * Desktop shows the filter panel beside the grid; below 1024px it opens as a bottom sheet.
 */
export default function ShopCatalog({ categorySlug }) {
  const category = CATEGORIES.find((entry) => entry.slug === categorySlug)
  const isDesktop = useMediaQuery('(min-width: 1024px)')
  const sheet = useDisclosure()
  const resultsRef = useRef(null)
  const filters = useProductFilters(category?.slug)
  const { query, appliedFilters } = filters
  const products = useProducts(query, { keepPrevious: true, enabled: !categorySlug || Boolean(category) })
  const { data: categories } = useCategories()
  const save = useSaveProduct()
 
  if (categorySlug && !category) {
    return (
      <div className="sh-container py-5">
        <EmptyState
          icon="search"
          title="We couldn’t find that category"
          description="It may have moved. Browse everything we have instead."
          action={
            <Button as={Link} to={paths.shop}>
              Shop all products
            </Button>
          }
        />
      </div>
    )
  }
 
  const { data } = products
  const goToPage = (page) => {
    filters.setPage(page)
    resultsRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' })
  }
 
  const panel = (
    <FilterPanel query={query} facets={data?.facets} onChange={filters.setFilters} onCategoryChange={filters.selectCategory} />
  )
  const sort = <SortSelect value={query.sort} onChange={filters.setSort} size={isDesktop ? 'lg' : 'sm'} />
 
  let results
  if (products.isError) {
    results = <ErrorState message={getErrorMessage(products.error)} onRetry={products.refetch} />
  } else if (products.isPending) {
    results = <ProductGrid loading skeletonCount={6} />
  } else if (data.items.length === 0) {
    results = (
      <EmptyState
        icon="search"
        title={query.q ? `No results for “${query.q}”` : 'No products match your filters'}
        description="Try removing a filter or searching for something else."
        action={
          (appliedFilters.length > 0 || query.q) && (
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={appliedFilters.length > 0 ? filters.clearFilters : () => filters.setSearch('')}>
              {appliedFilters.length > 0 ? 'Clear filters' : 'Clear search'}
            </Button>
          )
        }
      />
    )
  } else {
    results = (
      <ProductGrid
        label="Products"
        products={data.items}
        isSaved={save.isSaved}
        onToggleSaved={save.onToggleSaved}
      />
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <div className={clsx('sh-container', styles.page)}>
      <ShopIntro
        category={category}
        categoryDescription={categories?.find((entry) => entry.slug === category?.slug)?.description}
        searchText={query.q}
        totalItems={data?.totalItems}
      />
 
      {!isDesktop && <CategoryChips activeSlug={category?.slug} className={styles.chips} />}
 
      <div className={styles.toolbar}>
        {isDesktop ? (
          <>
            <ShopSearch className={styles.search} value={query.q} onSearch={filters.setSearch} />
            <div className={styles.sort}>{sort}</div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="lg" leftIcon="sliders" onClick={sheet.open} aria-haspopup="dialog">
              Filters
              {appliedFilters.length > 0 && <span className={styles.count}>{appliedFilters.length}</span>}
            </Button>
            <div className={styles.sort}>{sort}</div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
 
      {!isDesktop && (
        <ActiveFilters className={styles.chipsRow} filters={appliedFilters} onRemove={filters.removeFilter} onClear={filters.clearFilters} />
      )}
 
      <div className={styles.body}>
        {isDesktop && (
          <aside className={styles.sidebar} aria-label="Filters">
            <div className={styles.sidebarHeader}>
              <h2 className={styles.sidebarTitle}>Filters</h2>
              <button type="button" className={styles.reset} onClick={filters.resetAll}>
                Reset all
              </button>
            </div>
            {panel}
          </aside>
        )}
 
        <section ref={resultsRef} className={styles.results} aria-label="Search results">
          <div className={styles.resultsBar}>
            {data && <ResultsSummary page={data.page} pageSize={data.pageSize} totalItems={data.totalItems} />}
            {isDesktop && <ActiveFilters filters={appliedFilters} onRemove={filters.removeFilter} />}
          </div>
 
          <div className={clsx(products.isPlaceholderData && styles.refreshing)} aria-busy={products.isFetching || undefined}>
            {results}
          </div>
 
          {data && data.pageCount > 1 && (
            <div className={styles.footer}>
              {isDesktop && <ResultsSummary page={data.page} pageSize={data.pageSize} totalItems={data.totalItems} />}
              <Pagination page={data.page} pageCount={data.pageCount} onPageChange={goToPage} />
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
 
      {!isDesktop && (
        <FilterSheet
          open={sheet.isOpen}
          onClose={sheet.close}
          resultCount={data?.totalItems}
          canClear={appliedFilters.length > 0 || Boolean(category)}
          onClear={filters.resetAll}
        >
          {panel}
        </FilterSheet>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/catalog/components/ShopIntro/ShopIntro.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Breadcrumbs from '@/components/molecules/Breadcrumbs'
import ResponsiveText from '@/features/catalog/components/ResponsiveText'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './ShopIntro.module.scss'
 
/** Breadcrumbs, page title and supporting line for the catalogue, worded for browsing, a category or a search. */
export default function ShopIntro({ category, categoryDescription, searchText, totalItems }) {
  const countText = totalItems === undefined ? '' : `${formatNumber(totalItems)} thoughtful finds for your everyday.`
  let crumb = 'Everyday essentials'
  let title = <ResponsiveText desktop="Find your everyday favourites" mobile="Everyday essentials" />
  let description = <ResponsiveText desktop="Quality essentials. Thoughtful prices. All in one place." mobile={countText} />
 
  if (searchText) {
    crumb = 'Search results'
    title = `Results for “${searchText}”`
    description = totalItems === undefined ? '' : `${formatNumber(totalItems)} ${totalItems === 1 ? 'product' : 'products'} found.`
  } else if (category) {
    crumb = category.label
    title = category.label
    description = categoryDescription
  }
 
  return (
    <header className={styles.intro}>
      <Breadcrumbs
        className={styles.breadcrumbs}
        items={[{ label: 'Home', to: paths.home }, { label: 'Shop', to: paths.shop }, { label: crumb }]}
      />
      <h1 className={styles.title}>{title}</h1>
      {description && <p className={styles.description}>{description}</p>}
    </header>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import styles from './ShopSearch.module.scss'
 
/** In-page search for the catalogue ("Search products"). `value` follows the URL; submitting updates it. */
export default function ShopSearch({ value, onSearch, className }) {
  const { register, handleSubmit } = useForm({ values: { q: value ?? '' } })
 
  return (
    <form role="search" className={className} onSubmit={handleSubmit(({ q }) => onSearch(q))}>
      <FormField label="Search products">
        {(control) => (
          <div className={styles.row}>
            <Input {...control} type="search" placeholder="Search for haldi, shampoo, everyday essentials…" autoComplete="off" {...register('q')} />
            <Button type="submit" size="lg">
              Search
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </FormField>
    </form>
  )
}
```

import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import { SORT_OPTIONS } from '@/features/catalog/hooks/useProductFilters'
 
/** "Sort: Recommended" dropdown. */
export default function SortSelect({ value, onChange, size = 'lg' }) {
  return (
    <SelectField
      aria-label="Sort products"
      prefixLabel="Sort:"
      size={size}
      options={SORT_OPTIONS}
      value={value}
      onChange={(next) => onChange(next ?? 'recommended')}
    />
  )
}

import clsx from 'clsx'
import RatingStars from '@/components/molecules/RatingStars'
import { TESTIMONIALS } from '@/features/catalog/content/homeContent'
import styles from './Testimonials.module.scss'
 
/** "Small essentials. Happy homes.": three customer quotes on desktop, one on phones. */
export default function Testimonials() {
  return (
    <section className={styles.section} aria-labelledby="testimonials-title">
      <div className="sh-container">
        <header className={styles.header}>
          <h2 id="testimonials-title" className={styles.title}>
            Small essentials. Happy homes.
          </h2>
          <p className={styles.description}>A few words from our growing community.</p>
        </header>
        <ul className={styles.grid}>
          {TESTIMONIALS.map((testimonial) => (
            <li key={testimonial.author} className={clsx(styles.card, !testimonial.showOnPhone && styles.desktopOnly)}>
              <RatingStars value={5} />
              <blockquote className={styles.quote}>
                <span className="d-none d-md-inline">“{testimonial.quote}”</span>
                <span className="d-md-none">“{testimonial.compactQuote ?? testimonial.quote}”</span>
              </blockquote>
              <p className={styles.author}>
                {testimonial.author}
                <span className="d-none d-md-inline"> · {testimonial.city}</span>
                <span className="d-md-none"> · Verified purchase</span>
              </p>
              <p className={styles.verified}>Verified purchase</p>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}
```

import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import { TRUST_POINTS } from '@/features/catalog/content/homeContent'
import styles from './TrustStrip.module.scss'
 
/** Four reassurance points under the hero; phones get the three short ones. */
export default function TrustStrip() {
  return (
    <section className={styles.strip} aria-label="Why shop with us">
      <ul className={styles.list}>
        {TRUST_POINTS.map((point) => (
          <li key={point.title} className={point.shortTitle ? styles.item : styles.desktopOnly}>
            <span className={styles.full}>
              <Icon name={point.icon} className={styles.icon} />
              <span className={styles.text}>
                <span className={styles.title}>{point.title}</span>
                <span className={styles.detail}>{point.detail}</span>
              </span>
            </span>
            {point.shortTitle && (
              <span className={styles.short}>
                <Icon name={point.shortIcon} />
                {point.shortTitle}
              </span>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './VariantPicker.module.scss'
 
/** Pack sizes of the same product ("200 g · ₹120"); each is its own product page. */
export default function VariantPicker({ variants }) {
  if (variants.length < 2) return null
 
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Pack size">
      <ul className={styles.list}>
        {variants.map((variant) => (
          <li key={variant.code}>
            <Link
              to={paths.product(variant.slug)}
              className={clsx(styles.option, variant.isCurrent && styles.current, variant.stockStatus === 'out_of_stock' && styles.soldOut)}
              aria-current={variant.isCurrent ? 'true' : undefined}
            >
              {variant.unit} · {formatINR(variant.sellingPrice)}
              {variant.stockStatus === 'out_of_stock' && <span className="visually-hidden"> (out of stock)</span>}
            </Link>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </nav>
  )
}
```

```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useMutation, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import {
  getOffers,
  getProduct,
  listCategories,
  listProducts,
  listRelatedProducts,
  subscribeToNewsletter,
} from '@/features/catalog/services/catalogService'
 
export const catalogKeys = {
  all: ['catalog'],
  categories: () => ['catalog', 'categories'],
  products: (params) => ['catalog', 'products', params],
  product: (slug) => ['catalog', 'product', slug],
  related: (slug) => ['catalog', 'related', slug],
  offers: () => ['catalog', 'offers'],
}
 
export const useCategories = () => useQuery({ queryKey: catalogKeys.categories(), queryFn: listCategories })
 
/**
 * Catalogue page for the given filters. With `keepPrevious` the previous page stays on screen while
 * the next one loads (filtering and paging), so the grid does not collapse into skeletons each time.
 */
export function useProducts(params, { keepPrevious = false, enabled = true } = {}) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: catalogKeys.products(params),
    queryFn: () => listProducts(params),
    placeholderData: keepPrevious ? keepPreviousData : undefined,
    enabled,
  })
}
 
export const useProduct = (slug) => useQuery({ queryKey: catalogKeys.product(slug), queryFn: () => getProduct(slug) })
 
export const useRelatedProducts = (slug) =>
  useQuery({ queryKey: catalogKeys.related(slug), queryFn: () => listRelatedProducts(slug) })
 
export const useOffers = () => useQuery({ queryKey: catalogKeys.offers(), queryFn: getOffers })
 
export const useNewsletterSignup = () => useMutation({ mutationFn: subscribeToNewsletter })
```

import { useCallback } from 'react'
 
/** Returns `copy(text)`, which resolves true when the text reached the clipboard and false when the browser refused. */
export function useCopyToClipboard() {
  return useCallback(async (text) => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
      return true
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }, [])
}

## `src/features/catalog/hooks/useProductFilters.js`
 
```javascript
import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react'
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
 
// The listing design (p-02) shows two rows of three products per page ("Showing 1–6 of …").
export const PAGE_SIZE = 6
export const DEFAULT_SORT = 'recommended'
export const SORT_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'recommended', label: 'Recommended' },
  { value: 'price_asc', label: 'Price: Low to High' },
  { value: 'price_desc', label: 'Price: High to Low' },
  { value: 'discount', label: 'Biggest discount' },
  { value: 'newest', label: 'Newest' },
]
 
const FILTER_PARAMS = ['minPrice', 'maxPrice', 'inStock', 'minRating', 'minDiscount', 'walletRewards']
 
function readNumber(value) {
  if (value === null || value === '') return undefined
  const parsed = Number(value)
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= 0 ? parsed : undefined
}
 
function readQuery(searchParams, category) {
  const sort = searchParams.get('sort')
  return {
    q: searchParams.get('q')?.trim() || undefined,
    category,
    sort: SORT_OPTIONS.some((option) => option.value === sort) ? sort : DEFAULT_SORT,
    page: Math.max(1, Math.floor(readNumber(searchParams.get('page')) ?? 1)),
    pageSize: PAGE_SIZE,
    minPrice: readNumber(searchParams.get('minPrice')),
    maxPrice: readNumber(searchParams.get('maxPrice')),
    inStock: searchParams.get('inStock') === 'true' || undefined,
    minRating: readNumber(searchParams.get('minRating')),
    minDiscount: readNumber(searchParams.get('minDiscount')),
    walletRewards: searchParams.get('walletRewards') === 'true' || undefined,
  }
}
 
function priceLabel({ minPrice, maxPrice }) {
  if (minPrice !== undefined && maxPrice !== undefined) return `${formatINR(minPrice)} – ${formatINR(maxPrice)}`
  return minPrice !== undefined ? `${formatINR(minPrice)} & above` : `Up to ${formatINR(maxPrice)}`
}
 
// One entry per applied filter, with the URL patch that removes it. Category is not listed: it has its own navigation.
function describeFilters(query) {
  const filters = []
  if (query.inStock) filters.push({ id: 'inStock', label: 'In stock', remove: { inStock: undefined } })
  if (query.minPrice !== undefined || query.maxPrice !== undefined) {
    filters.push({ id: 'price', label: priceLabel(query), remove: { minPrice: undefined, maxPrice: undefined } })
  }
  if (query.minRating !== undefined) filters.push({ id: 'minRating', label: `${query.minRating}★ & above`, remove: { minRating: undefined } })
  if (query.minDiscount !== undefined) {
    filters.push({ id: 'minDiscount', label: `${query.minDiscount}% off or more`, remove: { minDiscount: undefined } })
  }
  if (query.walletRewards) filters.push({ id: 'walletRewards', label: 'Wallet rewards', remove: { walletRewards: undefined } })
  return filters
}
 
/**
 * The catalogue query lives in the URL (`/category/haldi?q=turmeric&sort=price_asc&inStock=true&page=2`) so every
 * view is shareable and survives a refresh. `query` is exactly what the API receives; the backend does the
 * filtering, sorting and paging. Any change other than a page change returns to page 1.
 */
export function useProductFilters(category) {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams()
  const query = useMemo(() => readQuery(searchParams, category), [searchParams, category])
  const appliedFilters = useMemo(() => describeFilters(query), [query])
 
  const update = useCallback(
    (patch) => {
      setSearchParams((previous) => {
        const next = new URLSearchParams(previous)
        Object.entries(patch).forEach(([key, value]) => {
          if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '' || value === false) next.delete(key)
          else next.set(key, String(value))
        })
        if (!('page' in patch)) next.delete('page')
        return next
      })
    },
    [setSearchParams],
  )
 
  const selectCategory = useCallback(
    (slug) => {
      const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams)
      next.delete('page')
      const search = next.toString()
      navigate({ pathname: slug ? paths.category(slug) : paths.shop, search: search ? `?${search}` : '' })
    },
    [navigate, searchParams],
  )
 
  const clearFilters = useCallback(() => {
    update(Object.fromEntries(FILTER_PARAMS.map((key) => [key, undefined])))
  }, [update])
 
  // Back to every category with no filters; the search text and sort order are kept.
  const resetAll = useCallback(() => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams)
    ;[...FILTER_PARAMS, 'page'].forEach((key) => next.delete(key))
    const search = next.toString()
    navigate({ pathname: paths.shop, search: search ? `?${search}` : '' })
  }, [navigate, searchParams])
 
  return {
    query,
    appliedFilters,
    setSearch: (q) => update({ q: q.trim() }),
    setSort: (sort) => update({ sort: sort === DEFAULT_SORT ? undefined : sort }),
    setPage: (page) => update({ page: page > 1 ? page : undefined }),
    setFilters: update,
    removeFilter: (filter) => update(filter.remove),
    clearFilters,
    resetAll,
    selectCategory,
  }
}
```
 
## `src/features/catalog/hooks/useSaveProduct.js`
 
```javascript
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { selectIsAuthenticated } from '@/app/store'
import { useSavedProductToggle } from '@/features/saved'
 
/**
 * Heart toggle for catalogue screens: signed-in customers save or unsave, signed-out visitors are
 * sent to the login page and brought back afterwards.
 */
export function useSaveProduct() {
  const isAuthenticated = useSelector(selectIsAuthenticated)
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const location = useLocation()
  const { isSaved, toggle } = useSavedProductToggle()
 
  const onToggleSaved = (productCode) => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      navigate(paths.login, { state: { from: location } })
      return
    }
    toggle(productCode)
  }
 
  return { isSaved, onToggleSaved }
}
```

## `src/features/catalog/services/catalogService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team (A-01 … A-06). The catalogue is read-only for customers and
// only ever returns active products.
//
// Product summary (list items, cards, related products):
//   { code, slug, name, unit, category, categoryLabel, image, mrp, sellingPrice, discountPercent, rating,
//     reviewCount, badge, walletRewards, purchaseLimit, stockStatus: 'in_stock' | 'low_stock' | 'out_of_stock',
//     lowStockLeft }
// `stockStatus`, `lowStockLeft` and `purchaseLimit` are decided by the backend; the UI never derives
// availability from stock numbers.
 
const omitEmpty = (params) =>
  Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(params).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '' && value !== false))
 
/**
 * Paged, filtered catalogue.
 * Params: q, category, collection, minPrice, maxPrice, inStock, minDiscount, minRating, walletRewards,
 *   sort ('recommended' | 'price_asc' | 'price_desc' | 'discount' | 'newest'), page, pageSize.
 * Response: { items[], page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount,
 *   facets: { categories: [{ slug, name, count }], priceBounds: { min, max } } }
 * Facet counts ignore the category filter and the price bounds ignore the price filter, so the filter
 * panel keeps offering the choices the customer just narrowed away.
 */
export async function listProducts(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.catalog.products, { params: omitEmpty(params) })
  return data
}
 
/** Categories with active product counts: { items: [{ slug, name, description, image, productCount }] } */
export async function listCategories() {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.catalog.categories)
  return data.items
}
 
/**
 * Product detail: the summary fields plus { tagline, description, ingredients, netQuantity, batch, bestBefore,
 *   hsn, gstPercent, storage, packedBy, careNote, availableQuantity, savings, gallery: [{ url, alt }],
 *   variants: [{ code, slug, unit, mrp, sellingPrice, stockStatus, isCurrent }],
 *   reviews: { average, count, highlights: [{ quote, author, reviewedAt, verified }] } }.
 * `savings` (MRP minus selling price) is calculated by the backend. 404 for unknown or inactive products.
 */
export async function getProduct(slug) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.catalog.product(slug))
  return data
}
 
/** Complementary products for a product page: { items: [summary] } */
export async function listRelatedProducts(slug) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.catalog.related(slug))
  return data.items
}
 
/**
 * Coupons and free-shipping rule shown on the offers page. Display only: the cart quote decides what
 * actually applies.
 * Response: { coupons: [{ code, title, description, maxDiscount, minOrderValue, firstOrderOnly }], freeShippingThreshold }
 */
export async function getOffers() {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.catalog.offers)
  return data
}
 
/** Newsletter sign-up. Request: { email }. Response 201: { email, status: 'subscribed' }. 422 for an invalid address. */
export async function subscribeToNewsletter(email) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.catalog.newsletter, { email })
  return data
}
```
 
## `src/features/checkout/components/AddressSection/AddressSection.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useId } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { useFormContext } from 'react-hook-form'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import Radio from '@/components/atoms/Radio'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import { ALTERNATE_MOBILE_COMPACT_ERROR, CHECKOUT_COPY } from '@/features/checkout/lib/checkoutCopy'
import { formatAddress, formatMobile } from '@/lib/address'
import styles from './AddressSection.module.scss'
 
function AddressOption({ address, selected, compact, onSelect, onEdit }) {
  const id = useId()
  return (
    <div className={clsx(styles.option, selected && styles.selected)}>
      <Radio id={id} name="deliveryAddress" checked={selected} onChange={() => onSelect(address.id)} />
      <label htmlFor={id} className={styles.body}>
        <span className={styles.heading}>
          {address.label}
          {address.isDefault && ' · Default'}
          {selected && <StatusBadge status={address.verified ? 'verified' : 'unverified'} className={styles.badge} />}
        </span>
        {selected && (
          <span className={styles.contact}>
            {address.name} · {formatMobile(address.mobile)}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className={styles.address}>{formatAddress(address)}</span>
      </label>
      {selected && !compact && (
        <Button variant="link" size="sm" className={styles.edit} onClick={() => onEdit(address)}>
          Edit<span className="visually-hidden"> {address.label} address</span>
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
 
/**
 * Saved addresses to deliver to (the customer picks one; the quote is re-priced for it), plus the delivery
 * notes and an alternate mobile number. Adding and editing go through the shared address drawer.
 */
export default function AddressSection({ compact, addresses, selectedId, onSelect, onAdd, onEdit }) {
  const copy = CHECKOUT_COPY[compact ? 'compact' : 'wide']
  const {
    register,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useFormContext()
  const selected = addresses.data?.find((address) => address.id === selectedId)
  const alternateMobileError = errors.alternateMobile && (compact ? ALTERNATE_MOBILE_COMPACT_ERROR : errors.alternateMobile.message)
 
  let list
  if (addresses.isPending) {
    list = (
      <div className={styles.loading} role="status" aria-label="Loading your addresses">
        <Skeleton width="40%" height="1.125rem" />
        <Skeleton width="85%" />
      </div>
    )
  } else if (addresses.isError) {
    list = <ErrorState compact title="We couldn’t load your addresses" message={getErrorMessage(addresses.error)} onRetry={addresses.refetch} />
  } else if (addresses.data.length === 0) {
    list = (
      <EmptyState
        compact
        icon="geo-alt"
        title="Add a delivery address"
        description="We need an address to show delivery dates and place your order."
        action={
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="plus-lg" onClick={onAdd}>
            Add new address
          </Button>
        }
      />
    )
  } else {
    list = (
      <>
        <fieldset className={styles.group}>
          <legend className="visually-hidden">Choose a delivery address</legend>
          {addresses.data.map((address) => (
            <AddressOption
              key={address.id}
              address={address}
              selected={address.id === selectedId}
              compact={compact}
              onSelect={onSelect}
              onEdit={onEdit}
            />
          ))}
        </fieldset>
        <div className={styles.actions}>
          {compact && (
            <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={!selected} onClick={() => onEdit(selected)}>
              Edit address
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={onAdd}>
            {compact ? '+ Add new' : '+ Add new address'}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </>
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <Card title={copy.addressTitle} padding={compact ? 'sm' : 'md'}>
      {list}
      <div className={styles.fields}>
        <FormField label="Delivery instructions (optional)" error={errors.deliveryInstructions?.message}>
          {(control) => <Input {...control} {...register('deliveryInstructions')} placeholder="For example: call on arrival" />}
        </FormField>
        <FormField label={copy.alternateMobileLabel} error={alternateMobileError}>
          {(control) => <Input {...control} {...register('alternateMobile')} type="tel" inputMode="tel" autoComplete="off" />}
        </FormField>
      </div>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

import { formatMobile } from '@/lib/address'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './CheckoutFlow.module.scss'
 
const SECURE_NOTE = 'Secure payments by Razorpay. Prices include all applicable taxes.'
 
/**
 * Delivery and payment for the cart. The customer's choices (address, wallet, coupon, payment method) go to
 * the backend, which prices the order; every amount on screen is read from that quote.
 */
export default function CheckoutFlow() {
  const wide = useMediaQuery(WIDE_CHECKOUT_QUERY)
  const copy = CHECKOUT_COPY[wide ? 'wide' : 'compact']
  const user = useSelector(selectCurrentUser)
  const cartItems = useSelector(selectActiveCartItems)
  const deliveryLocation = useSelector(selectDeliveryLocation)
  const [couponCode] = useCouponCode()
 
  const addresses = useAddresses()
  const [chosenAddressId, setChosenAddressId] = useState(null)
  const [editedAddress, setEditedAddress] = useState(null)
  const addressDrawer = useDisclosure()
  const [useWallet, setUseWallet] = useState(true)
  const payment = useCheckoutPayment()
 
  const address = addresses.data?.find((entry) => entry.id === chosenAddressId) ?? addresses.data?.[0] ?? null
  // Without a saved address the quote still shows delivery for the PIN picked in the header.
  const quote = useCartQuote({
    couponCode,
    useWallet,
    addressId: address?.id,
    pin: address ? undefined : deliveryLocation?.pin,
    enabled: addresses.isSuccess,
  })
 
  const form = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(checkoutSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      name: user?.name ?? '',
      mobile: formatMobile(user?.mobile),
      email: user?.email ?? '',
      deliveryInstructions: '',
      alternateMobile: '',
      paymentMethod: 'upi',
      upiId: '',
      acceptTerms: false,
    },
  })
 
  const openAddressDrawer = (toEdit = null) => {
    setEditedAddress(toEdit)
    addressDrawer.open()
  }
 
  const submit = form.handleSubmit((values) => {
    payment.mutate({
      order: {
        items: cartItems.map(({ productCode, quantity }) => ({ productCode, quantity })),
        couponCode: quote.data.coupon?.valid ? couponCode : undefined,
        useWallet,
        addressId: address.id,
        contact: { name: values.name, mobile: values.mobile, email: values.email },
        alternateMobile: values.alternateMobile || undefined,
        deliveryInstructions: values.deliveryInstructions || undefined,
        expectedPayable: quote.data.summary.payable,
      },
      payment: {
        method: values.paymentMethod,
        upiId: values.upiId,
        prefill: { name: values.name, email: values.email, contact: values.mobile },
      },
    })
  })
 
  if (payment.isSuccess) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.status} role="status">
        <Spinner decorative />
        Payment received. Taking you to your order…
      </div>
    )
  }
 
  if (cartItems.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.screen}>
        <EmptyState
          icon="bag"
          title="Your cart is empty"
          description="Add something to your cart before checking out."
          action={
            <Button as={Link} to={paths.shop}>
              Start shopping
            </Button>
          }
        />
      </div>
    )
  }
 
  const quantityOf = new Map(cartItems.map((item) => [item.productCode, item.quantity]))
  const lines = (quote.data?.lines ?? []).map((line) => ({ ...line, quantity: quantityOf.get(line.productCode) ?? line.quantity }))
  const stockProblem = lines.some((line) => lineHasStockProblem(line, line.quantity))
  const unserviceable = quote.data?.delivery.serviceable === false
 
  let blocker = null
  if (addresses.isSuccess && !address) blocker = 'Choose a delivery address to continue.'
  else if (unserviceable) blocker = 'We can’t deliver to this address yet. Choose another address.'
  else if (stockProblem) blocker = 'Some items are unavailable in the quantity you chose. Update your cart to continue.'
  const notReady = !quote.data || quote.isFetching || payment.isPending
 
  const cartSearch = couponSearch(couponCode)
  const payAction = (
    <PayAction
      payable={quote.data?.summary.payable}
      loading={payment.isPending}
      disabled={notReady}
      blocker={blocker}
      error={payment.error}
    />
  )
 
  let summary = null
  if (quote.data && wide) {
    summary = (
      <>
        <OrderSummaryCard quote={quote.data} busy={quote.isFetching}>
          <div className={styles.cta}>{payAction}</div>
          <p className={styles.note}>{SECURE_NOTE}</p>
        </OrderSummaryCard>
        <OrderItemsCard lines={lines} cartSearch={cartSearch} />
        <Badge tone="success" className={styles.secure}>
          100% secure checkout
        </Badge>
      </>
    )
  } else if (quote.data) {
    summary = (
      <>
        <OrderSummaryCard quote={quote.data} busy={quote.isFetching} title={`Your order · ${pluralize(quote.data.summary.units, 'unit')}`} showLines compact />
        <TermsConsent compact />
        {payAction}
        <p className={styles.footnote}>Encrypted payments. Quality essentials. Peace of mind.</p>
      </>
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <FormProvider {...form}>
      <form className={styles.screen} onSubmit={submit} noValidate aria-busy={payment.isPending || undefined}>
        {wide ? (
          <CheckoutSteps steps={copy.steps} currentIndex={1} />
        ) : (
          <Button as={Link} to={{ pathname: paths.cart, search: cartSearch }} variant="link" leftIcon="arrow-left" className={styles.back}>
            Back to cart
          </Button>
        )}
        <header className={styles.header}>
          <h1 className={styles.title}>Make it yours.</h1>
          {wide && <p className={styles.subtitle}>A secure checkout. A little everyday goodness on its way.</p>}
        </header>
        {!wide && <CheckoutSteps steps={copy.steps} currentIndex={1} />}
 
        <div className={styles.layout}>
          <div className={styles.main}>
            <ContactSection compact={!wide} />
            <AddressSection
              compact={!wide}
              addresses={addresses}
              selectedId={address?.id}
              onSelect={setChosenAddressId}
              onAdd={() => openAddressDrawer()}
              onEdit={openAddressDrawer}
            />
            <ShippingSection delivery={quote.data?.delivery} compact={!wide} />
            <PaymentSections
              compact={!wide}
              wallet={quote.data?.wallet}
              useWallet={useWallet}
              onWalletChange={setUseWallet}
              payable={quote.data?.summary.payable}
            />
            {!wide && summary}
          </div>
          {wide && <aside className={styles.aside}>{summary}</aside>}
        </div>
 
        {quote.isError && !quote.data && (
          <ErrorState title="We couldn’t price your order" message={getErrorMessage(quote.error)} onRetry={quote.refetch} compact />
        )}
      </form>
 
      <AddressDrawer
        open={addressDrawer.isOpen}
        onClose={addressDrawer.close}
        address={editedAddress}
        defaults={{ name: user?.name, mobile: user?.mobile }}
        onSaved={(saved) => setChosenAddressId(saved.id)}
      />
    </FormProvider>
  )
}
```

import CheckoutFlow from '@/features/checkout/components/CheckoutFlow'
import styles from './CheckoutScreen.module.scss'
 
/** Page body for /checkout: the full-width backdrop (a soft grey behind the cards on small screens) around the flow. */
export default function CheckoutScreen() {
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <div className="sh-container">
        <CheckoutFlow />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

## `src/features/checkout/components/CheckoutSteps/CheckoutSteps.jsx`
 
```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import styles from './CheckoutSteps.module.scss'
 
/** "Cart → Delivery & payment → Confirmation" progress line; `currentIndex` is zero-based. */
export default function CheckoutSteps({ steps, currentIndex }) {
  return (
    <ol className={styles.steps} aria-label="Checkout progress">
      {steps.map((label, index) => {
        const state = index < currentIndex ? 'done' : index === currentIndex ? 'current' : 'upcoming'
        return (
          <li key={label} className={clsx(styles.step, styles[state])} aria-current={state === 'current' ? 'step' : undefined}>
            {state === 'done' ? <Icon name="check2" /> : <span aria-hidden="true">{index + 1}</span>}
            {label}
            <span className="visually-hidden">{state === 'done' ? ' (completed)' : state === 'current' ? ' (current step)' : ''}</span>
          </li>
        )
      })}
    </ol>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/checkout/components/ContactSection/ContactSection.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useFormContext } from 'react-hook-form'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { selectCurrentUser } from '@/app/store'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import { CHECKOUT_COPY } from '@/features/checkout/lib/checkoutCopy'
import styles from './ContactSection.module.scss'
 
/** Who the order updates go to. Pre-filled from the signed-in account. */
export default function ContactSection({ compact }) {
  const copy = CHECKOUT_COPY[compact ? 'compact' : 'wide']
  const user = useSelector(selectCurrentUser)
  const {
    register,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useFormContext()
 
  return (
    <Card title={copy.contactTitle} padding={compact ? 'sm' : 'md'}>
      <div className={styles.fields}>
        <FormField label="Full name" error={errors.name?.message}>
          {(control) => <Input {...control} {...register('name')} autoComplete="name" />}
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Mobile number" error={errors.mobile?.message}>
          {(control) => <Input {...control} {...register('mobile')} type="tel" inputMode="tel" autoComplete="tel" />}
        </FormField>
        <FormField label={copy.emailLabel} error={errors.email?.message} className={styles.full}>
          {(control) => <Input {...control} {...register('email')} type="email" autoComplete="email" />}
        </FormField>
      </div>
      {!compact && (
        <p className={styles.signedIn}>
          <Icon name="check2" /> You’re signed in as {user?.name}
        </p>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/checkout/components/OrderConfirmation/OrderConfirmation.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import Thumbnail from '@/components/atoms/Thumbnail'
import AddressSummary from '@/components/molecules/AddressSummary'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import { QuoteSummary } from '@/features/cart'
import { useOrderConfirmation } from '@/features/checkout/hooks/useOrderConfirmation'
import { formatDate, formatShortDate, formatTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR, pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './OrderConfirmation.module.scss'
 
function ConfirmationSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div role="status" aria-label="Loading your order" className={styles.skeleton}>
      <Skeleton width="3.5rem" height="3.5rem" radius="50%" />
      <Skeleton width="min(24rem, 80%)" height="2rem" />
      <Skeleton width="min(16rem, 60%)" />
      <Skeleton height="16rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-lg)" />
    </div>
  )
}
 
/**
 * What happens after a customer pays: the order as the backend stored it, where and when it is going,
 * and what comes next. Rendered for /checkout/confirmation/:orderNumber.
 */
export default function OrderConfirmation({ orderNumber }) {
  const { data: order, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useOrderConfirmation(orderNumber)
 
  if (isPending) return <ConfirmationSkeleton />
  if (isError) {
    // Retrying cannot make an order that does not exist (or is not theirs) appear: point to their orders instead.
    if (error.status === 404) {
      return (
        <EmptyState
          icon="receipt"
          title="We couldn’t find this order"
          description={getErrorMessage(error)}
          action={
            <Button as={Link} to={paths.orders}>
              View my orders
            </Button>
          }
        />
      )
    }
    return <ErrorState title="We couldn’t load your order" message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} />
  }
 
  const paid = order.paymentStatus === 'paid'
  const arrival = order.delivery.etaFrom ? `${formatShortDate(order.delivery.etaFrom)} – ${formatShortDate(order.delivery.etaTo)}` : null
  const firstName = order.customerName.split(' ')[0]
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.confirmation}>
      <header className={styles.hero}>
        <span className={styles.check} aria-hidden="true">
          <Icon name="check-lg" />
        </span>
        <h1 className={styles.title}>{paid ? `Thank you, ${firstName}. Your order is confirmed.` : `Thanks, ${firstName}. We’ve received your order.`}</h1>
        <p className={styles.meta}>
          Order <strong>{order.orderNumber}</strong> · Placed <span className={styles.nowrap}>{formatDate(order.placedAt)}</span> at <span className={styles.nowrap}>{formatTime(order.placedAt)}</span>
        </p>
        <p className={styles.payment}>
          <StatusBadge status={order.paymentStatus} />
          {paid ? `Paid via ${order.paymentMethod}` : `Payment ${order.paymentStatus === 'failed' ? 'did not go through' : 'is pending'}`}
        </p>
      </header>
 
      {!paid && (
        <Alert tone="warning" title="Payment isn’t complete yet">
          We’ll start preparing your order as soon as the payment is confirmed. You can check its status from My orders.
        </Alert>
      )}
 
      <div className={styles.layout}>
        <Card title={`Your order · ${pluralize(order.summary.units, 'unit')}`}>
          <ul className={styles.lines}>
            {order.lines.map((line) => (
              <li key={line.productCode} className={styles.line}>
                <Thumbnail src={line.image} size="md" />
                <div className={styles.lineText}>
                  <p className={styles.lineName}>{line.name}</p>
                  <p className={styles.lineMeta}>
                    {line.unit} · Qty {line.quantity}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <p className={styles.lineTotal}>{formatINR(line.lineTotal)}</p>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <QuoteSummary quote={{ summary: order.summary }} totalLabel={paid ? 'Total paid' : 'To pay'} />
        </Card>
 
        <div className={styles.side}>
          <Card title="Delivering to">
            <AddressSummary address={order.address} includeLandmark />
            {order.address.alternateMobile && <p className={styles.note}>Alternate mobile: {order.address.alternateMobile}</p>}
            {order.deliveryInstructions && <p className={styles.note}>Note for the courier: {order.deliveryInstructions}</p>}
            {arrival && (
              <p className={styles.arrival}>
                <Icon name="truck" />
                <span>
                  Expected delivery <strong>{arrival}</strong> · {order.delivery.method}
                </span>
              </p>
            )}
          </Card>
 
          <Card title="What happens next">
            <ol className={styles.steps}>
              <li>
                <strong>We pack your order.</strong> Our Lucknow team picks, checks and packs your items.
              </li>
              <li>
                <strong>It ships with India Post.</strong> You’ll get a tracking number as soon as it is on its way.
              </li>
              <li>
                <strong>Track it anytime.</strong> Follow every step from My orders.
              </li>
            </ol>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
 
      <div className={styles.actions}>
        <Button as={Link} to={paths.order(order.orderNumber)} size="lg">
          View order
        </Button>
        <Button as={Link} to={paths.shop} variant="secondary" size="lg">
          Continue shopping
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```
