```scss
@use '@/styles/mixins' as m;
 
.confirmation {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  padding-block: 1.5rem 3rem;
 
  @include m.up('lg') {
    gap: 2rem;
    padding-block: 2.5rem 4rem;
  }
}
 
.skeleton {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-block: 3rem;
}
 
.hero {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 2rem 1.25rem;
  border-radius: var(--sh-radius-xl);
  background: var(--sh-color-success-tint);
  text-align: center;
 
  @include m.up('md') {
    padding: 2.5rem;
  }
}
 
.check {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 3.5rem;
  height: 3.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--sh-color-success);
  color: var(--sh-color-white);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-2xl);
}
 
.title {
  max-width: 36rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-2xl);
  font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-bold);
 
  @include m.up('md') {
    font-size: var(--sh-font-size-3xl);
  }
}
 
.meta {
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
  color: var(--sh-color-ink);
}
 
.payment {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-sm);
}
 
.layout {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1.5rem;
 
  @include m.up('lg') {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 380px;
    align-items: start;
    gap: 2rem;
  }
}
 
.side {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.25rem;
}
 
.lines {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  padding-bottom: 1.25rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sh-color-border);
}
 
.line {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
}
 
.lineText {
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
}
 
.lineName {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--sh-color-ink);
}
 
.lineMeta {
  margin: 0.125rem 0 0;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-sm);
}
 
.lineTotal {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--sh-color-ink);
  font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-medium);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
 
.note {
  margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-sm);
}
 
.arrival {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.625rem;
  margin: 1rem 0 0;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--sh-radius-md);
  background: var(--sh-color-primary-tint);
  color: var(--sh-color-ink);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-sm);
 
  i {
    margin-top: 0.125rem;
    color: var(--sh-color-primary);
  }
}
 
.steps {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.875rem;
  counter-reset: step;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-base);
 
  li {
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 2rem;
    counter-increment: step;
 
    &::before {
      content: counter(step);
      position: absolute;
      top: 0.0625rem;
      left: 0;
      display: inline-flex;
      width: 1.375rem;
      height: 1.375rem;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--sh-color-primary-tint);
      color: var(--sh-color-primary);
      font-size: var(--sh-font-size-xs);
      font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-semibold);
    }
  }
 
  strong {
    color: var(--sh-color-ink);
    font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-semibold);
  }
}
 
.actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}
 
// Keeps "11:30 AM" and "28 Oct 2026" from splitting across lines on a phone.
.nowrap {
  white-space: nowrap;
}

import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'

}

## `src/features/checkout/components/PayAction/PayAction.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useId } from 'react'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import { PaymentError } from '@/features/checkout/services/paymentService'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './PayAction.module.scss'
 
/**
 * The Pay button with what can go wrong around it: the reason it is unavailable (`blocker`, shown as text;
 * `disabled` covers the silent cases such as a quote that is still loading) and the last failed attempt
 * (`error`). The amount is the backend quote's "To pay".
 */
export default function PayAction({ payable, loading, disabled, blocker, error }) {
  const blockerId = useId()
  const failedPayment = error instanceof PaymentError
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.action}>
      {error && (
        <Alert tone="danger" title={failedPayment ? 'Your payment didn’t go through' : 'We couldn’t place your order'}>
          {failedPayment ? error.message : getErrorMessage(error)}
        </Alert>
      )}
      <Button type="submit" size="lg" leftIcon="lock" loading={loading} disabled={disabled || Boolean(blocker)} aria-describedby={blocker ? blockerId : undefined}>
        {loading ? 'Processing payment…' : `Pay ${formatINR(payable)} securely`}
      </Button>
      {blocker && (
        <p id={blockerId} className={styles.blocker}>
          {blocker}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/checkout/components/PaymentMethodPicker/PaymentMethodPicker.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useId } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form'
import { env } from '@/app/config/env'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import { PAYMENT_METHODS } from '@/features/checkout/schemas/checkoutSchema'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './PaymentMethodPicker.module.scss'
 
const METHOD_NOTES = {
  card: 'You’ll enter your card details in the secure Razorpay window.',
  netbanking: 'You’ll choose your bank in the secure Razorpay window.',
}
const COMPACT_UPI_HINT = 'Approve your payment in your UPI app. Card and netbanking options are also available securely.'
 
/**
 * UPI / Cards / Netbanking choice. Only the UPI ID is typed here; card and netbanking details are entered
 * in the payment window, so this app never handles them. `payable` is the backend quote's "To pay".
 */
export default function PaymentMethodPicker({ compact, payable }) {
  const headingId = useId()
  const {
    register,
    control: formControl,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useFormContext()
  const method = useWatch({ control: formControl, name: 'paymentMethod' })
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.picker}>
      {!compact && (
        <p id={headingId} className={styles.heading}>
          Choose a payment method · Powered by Razorpay
        </p>
      )}
      <div role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby={compact ? undefined : headingId} aria-label={compact ? 'Payment method' : undefined} className={styles.methods}>
        {PAYMENT_METHODS.map(({ value, label }) => (
          <label key={value} className={clsx(styles.method, method === value && styles.active)}>
            <input type="radio" value={value} className="visually-hidden" {...register('paymentMethod')} />
            <Icon name={method === value ? 'record-circle-fill' : 'circle'} />
            {label}
          </label>
        ))}
      </div>
 
      {method === 'upi' ? (
        <FormField
          label="UPI ID"
          error={errors.upiId?.message}
          hint={compact ? COMPACT_UPI_HINT : `You’ll approve ${formatINR(payable, { decimals: 2 })} securely in your UPI app.`}
        >
          {(control) => (
            <Input
              {...control}
              {...register('upiId')}
              placeholder="name@bank"
              inputMode="email"
              autoComplete="off"
              autoCapitalize="none"
              spellCheck={false}
            />
          )}
        </FormField>
      ) : (
        <p className={styles.note}>{METHOD_NOTES[method]}</p>
      )}
 
      {env.useMockApi && (
        <p className={styles.mock}>
          <Badge tone="warning" size="sm">
            Test payment (mock)
          </Badge>
          No money moves in this build. A UPI ID starting with fail@ shows a declined payment.
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import { CHECKOUT_COPY } from '@/features/checkout/lib/checkoutCopy'
import PaymentMethodPicker from '@/features/checkout/components/PaymentMethodPicker'
import TermsConsent from '@/features/checkout/components/TermsConsent'
import WalletOption from '@/features/checkout/components/WalletOption'
import styles from './PaymentSections.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Wallet and payment method. Desktop shows them as one "Wallet & payment" card that also holds the terms;
 * below that the wallet and the payment window are separate cards and the terms sit by the Pay button.
 */
export default function PaymentSections({ compact, wallet, useWallet, onWalletChange, payable }) {
  const walletOption = <WalletOption wallet={wallet} checked={useWallet} onChange={onWalletChange} compact={compact} />
  const picker = <PaymentMethodPicker compact={compact} payable={payable} />
 
  if (compact) {
    return (
      <>
        <Card title={CHECKOUT_COPY.compact.walletTitle} padding="sm">{walletOption}</Card>
        <Card title={CHECKOUT_COPY.compact.paymentTitle} padding="sm">{picker}</Card>
      </>
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <Card title={CHECKOUT_COPY.wide.walletPaymentTitle}>
      {walletOption}
      <div className={styles.divider} />
      {picker}
      <div className={styles.terms}>
        <TermsConsent />
      </div>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/checkout/components/ShippingSection/ShippingSection.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import { CHECKOUT_COPY } from '@/features/checkout/lib/checkoutCopy'
import { formatShortDate } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './ShippingSection.module.scss'
 
/**
 * The delivery option the backend quoted for the chosen address: carrier and service, fee and arrival
 * window (`quote.delivery`). There is a single method, so it is shown as the selected option, not a choice.
 */
export default function ShippingSection({ delivery, compact }) {
  const copy = CHECKOUT_COPY[compact ? 'compact' : 'wide']
  const fee = delivery?.fee > 0 ? formatINR(delivery.fee, { decimals: 2 }) : 'Free'
 
  let content
  if (!delivery) {
    content = (
      <div className={styles.loading}>
        <Skeleton width="45%" height="1.125rem" />
        <Skeleton width="60%" />
      </div>
    )
  } else if (delivery.serviceable === false) {
    content = (
      <Alert tone="warning" title="We can’t deliver to this address yet">
        Choose another address or add a new one to see delivery options.
      </Alert>
    )
  } else if (!delivery.serviceable) {
    content = <p className={styles.note}>Choose a delivery address to see delivery options.</p>
  } else {
    const arrival = `${formatShortDate(delivery.etaFrom)} – ${formatShortDate(delivery.etaTo)}`
    content = (
      <>
        <div className={styles.method}>
          <p className={styles.name}>
            <Icon name="record-circle-fill" className={styles.marker} />
            {delivery.method}
          </p>
          {!compact && <p className={styles.fee}>{fee}</p>}
        </div>
        <p className={styles.note}>
          {compact ? arrival : `Arrives ${arrival}`} · {compact ? 'Tracked shipping' : 'Tracked delivery'}
        </p>
        {compact && (
          <p className={styles.feeRow}>
            <span>Delivery fee</span>
            <span className={styles.feeValue}>{fee}</span>
          </p>
        )}
      </>
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <Card title={copy.shippingTitle} padding={compact ? 'sm' : 'md'} aria-live="polite">
      {content}
    </Card>
  )
}
```

import { useId } from 'react'
import { useFormContext } from 'react-hook-form'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import styles from './TermsConsent.module.scss'
 
/** Required consent. Starts unchecked: the customer has to agree before an order can be placed. */
export default function TermsConsent({ compact }) {
  const errorId = useId()
  const {
    register,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useFormContext()
  const error = errors.acceptTerms?.message
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.terms}>
      <Checkbox
        invalid={Boolean(error)}
        aria-describedby={error ? errorId : undefined}
        label={
          <>
            I agree to the{' '}
            <Link to={paths.policy('terms')} target="_blank" rel="noopener">
              terms of sale
            </Link>{' '}
            and{' '}
            <Link to={paths.policy('privacy')} target="_blank" rel="noopener">
              privacy policy
            </Link>
            .{!compact && ' Your payment details are encrypted and never stored by Shipper.com.'}
          </>
        }
        {...register('acceptTerms')}
      />
      {error && (
        <p id={errorId} role="alert" className={styles.error}>
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/checkout/components/WalletOption/WalletOption.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useId } from 'react'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './WalletOption.module.scss'
 
const money = (value) => formatINR(value, { decimals: 2 })
 
/**
 * "Use wallet" toggle. Every amount comes from the quote's `wallet` block: what applies to this order
 * (`applied`), the balance, the balance afterwards and whether a coupon rules the wallet out (`eligible`).
 */
export default function WalletOption({ wallet, checked, onChange, compact }) {
  const hintId = useId()
 
  if (!wallet) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loading}>
        <Skeleton width="55%" height="1.125rem" />
        <Skeleton width="70%" />
      </div>
    )
  }
 
  const empty = wallet.balance <= 0
  const unavailable = empty || !wallet.eligible
  const active = checked && !unavailable
 
  let hint
  if (empty) hint = 'Your wallet is empty. Rewards you earn will appear here.'
  else if (!wallet.eligible) hint = 'Wallet and coupon offers cannot be combined. Remove the coupon in your cart to use your wallet.'
  else if (active) hint = `Available ${money(wallet.balance)} · ${compact ? 'After this order' : 'Balance after order'} ${money(wallet.balanceAfter)}`
  else hint = `Available ${money(wallet.balance)} · Up to ${money(wallet.maxPerOrder)} per order`
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.option}>
      <div className={styles.row}>
        <Checkbox
          label={<strong>{active ? `Use ${money(wallet.applied)} from ${compact ? 'wallet' : 'your wallet'}` : 'Use wallet balance'}</strong>}
          checked={active}
          disabled={unavailable}
          onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.checked)}
          aria-describedby={hintId}
        />
        {active && !compact && <Badge tone="success">Applied</Badge>}
      </div>
      <p id={hintId} className={styles.hint}>
        {hint}
      </p>
      {active && compact && (
        <Badge tone="success" className={styles.applied}>
          {money(wallet.applied)} applied
        </Badge>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/checkout/hooks/useCheckoutPayment.js`
 
```javascript
import { useRef } from 'react'
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { itemRemoved } from '@/app/store'
import { cartKeys } from '@/features/cart'
import { placeOrder } from '@/features/checkout/services/checkoutService'
import { payForOrder } from '@/features/checkout/services/paymentService'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with the orders/wallet owners: these are the root keys of their query keys. A placed
// order changes the order history and, when the wallet was used, the wallet balance and ledger.
const ORDER_QUERY_ROOT = ['orders']
const WALLET_QUERY_ROOT = ['wallet']
 
/**
 * Place the order and pay for it: POST the order, open a payment session, collect the payment, confirm it.
 * Variables: { order, payment } where `order` is the checkout payload and `payment` the options for the
 * payment window. After a payment the purchased lines leave the cart (saved-for-later items stay) and the
 * customer lands on the confirmation page.
 *
 * An order whose payment failed stays unpaid on the backend; paying again with the same checkout payload
 * re-uses it instead of placing a duplicate.
 */
export function useCheckoutPayment() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const unpaidOrder = useRef(null) // { payloadKey, orderNumber }
 
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ order, payment }) => {
      const payloadKey = JSON.stringify(order)
      let orderNumber = unpaidOrder.current?.payloadKey === payloadKey ? unpaidOrder.current.orderNumber : null
 
      if (!orderNumber) {
        const placed = await placeOrder(order)
        orderNumber = placed.orderNumber
        unpaidOrder.current = { payloadKey, orderNumber }
        // Fully covered by the wallet: nothing left to collect.
        if (placed.paymentStatus === 'paid') return { orderNumber }
      }
 
      await payForOrder(orderNumber, payment)
      return { orderNumber }
    },
    onSuccess: ({ orderNumber }, { order }) => {
      unpaidOrder.current = null
      order.items.forEach(({ productCode }) => dispatch(itemRemoved(productCode)))
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: cartKeys.all })
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ORDER_QUERY_ROOT })
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: WALLET_QUERY_ROOT })
      navigate(paths.orderConfirmation(orderNumber), { replace: true })
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      // 409: the backend's prices or stock moved on; show the customer the current quote.
      if (error.status === 409) queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: cartKeys.all })
    },
  })
}
```
 
## `src/features/checkout/hooks/useOrderConfirmation.js`
 
```javascript
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { checkoutKeys } from '@/features/checkout/hooks/checkoutKeys'
import { getPlacedOrder } from '@/features/checkout/services/checkoutService'
 
/** The order just placed, for the confirmation page. */
export function useOrderConfirmation(orderNumber) {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: checkoutKeys.order(orderNumber), queryFn: () => getPlacedOrder(orderNumber) })
}
```

```javascript
// The checkout artboards word several headings differently on desktop and on mobile, so each variant
// keeps its own copy. `wide` is the two-column desktop layout, `compact` the single-column one below it.
export const WIDE_CHECKOUT_QUERY = '(min-width: 1024px)'
 
export const CHECKOUT_COPY = {
  wide: {
    steps: ['Cart', 'Delivery & payment', 'Confirmation'],

## `src/features/checkout/schemas/checkoutSchema.js`
 
```javascript
import { z } from 'zod'
import { emailSchema, mobileSchema, optionalMobileSchema, requiredText } from '@/lib/validation'
 
export const PAYMENT_METHODS = [
  { value: 'upi', label: 'UPI' },
  { value: 'card', label: 'Cards' },
  { value: 'netbanking', label: 'Netbanking' },
]
 
// name@bank: a handle of letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, then the bank's PSP name.
const UPI_ID_PATTERN = /^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{2,256}@[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{1,63}$/
 
/**
 * Checkout form fields. Shape and format checks for a better experience; the backend validates the order.
 * The delivery address and wallet choice live outside the form because they change the backend quote.
 * Card and netbanking details are never collected here: the payment window handles them.
 */
export const checkoutSchema = z
  .object({
    name: requiredText('Enter your full name'),
    mobile: mobileSchema,
    email: emailSchema,
    deliveryInstructions: z.string().trim().max(200, 'Use 200 characters or fewer'),
    alternateMobile: optionalMobileSchema,
    paymentMethod: z.enum(['upi', 'card', 'netbanking']),
    upiId: z.string().trim(),
    acceptTerms: z.boolean().refine((accepted) => accepted, 'Accept the terms of sale and privacy policy to place your order'),
  })
  .superRefine((values, context) => {
    if (values.paymentMethod !== 'upi') return
    if (values.upiId === '') {
      context.addIssue({ code: 'custom', path: ['upiId'], message: 'Enter your UPI ID' })
    } else if (!UPI_ID_PATTERN.test(values.upiId)) {
      context.addIssue({ code: 'custom', path: ['upiId'], message: 'Enter a valid UPI ID, for example name@bank' })
    }
  })
```
 
## `src/features/checkout/services/checkoutService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
/**
 * Places an order for the cart. The backend re-prices it and rejects it (409) when `expectedPayable` is no
 * longer what it would charge, so the customer never pays an amount they have not seen.
 * ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. Request:
 *   { items: [{ productCode, quantity }], couponCode?, useWallet, addressId, contact: { name, mobile, email },
 *     alternateMobile?, deliveryInstructions?, expectedPayable }
 * Response (201): { orderNumber, paymentStatus: 'pending' | 'paid', amountDue, currency }
 */
export async function placeOrder(payload) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.checkout.placeOrder, payload)
  return data
}
 
/**
 * The placed order for the confirmation page.
 * ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: the order shape of the orders API, plus `delivery`
 * { method, etaFrom, etaTo }. This can move to the shared orders endpoint once that returns the same data.
 */
export async function getPlacedOrder(orderNumber) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.checkout.order(orderNumber))
  return data
}
```
 
## `src/features/checkout/services/paymentService.js`
 
```javascript
import { env } from '@/app/config/env'
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
/** The customer's payment did not go through (declined, or the payment window was closed). */
export class PaymentError extends Error {
  constructor(message, { code = 'payment_failed' } = {}) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'PaymentError'
    this.code = code
  }
}
 
/**
 * ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. Opens a payment session for a placed order (Razorpay order).
 * `method` ('upi' | 'card' | 'netbanking') is the customer's choice, recorded on the order.
 * Response (201): { sessionId, orderNumber, gateway: 'razorpay', gatewayOrderId, keyId, amount, currency }
 */
export async function createPaymentSession(orderNumber, method) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.payments.createSession, { orderNumber, method })
  return data
}
 
/**
 * ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. Sends the gateway result for server-side signature
 * verification. Body: { razorpayPaymentId, razorpayOrderId, razorpaySignature }.
 * Response: { orderNumber, paymentStatus: 'paid' }
 */
export async function confirmPayment(sessionId, { razorpayPaymentId, razorpayOrderId, razorpaySignature }) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.payments.confirm(sessionId), { razorpayPaymentId, razorpayOrderId, razorpaySignature })
  return data
}
 
/** ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. Lets the backend record a failed or dismissed attempt. */
export async function reportPaymentFailure(sessionId, reason) {
  await http.post(endpoints.payments.reportFailure(sessionId), { reason })
}
 
/**
 * The payment window. Resolves with the gateway's outcome:
 *   { outcome: 'success', razorpayPaymentId, razorpayOrderId, razorpaySignature }
 *   { outcome: 'failed', reason }       the payment was declined
 *   { outcome: 'dismissed' }            the customer closed the window
 */
async function openPaymentWindow(session, options) {
  if (env.useMockApi) {
    // DEV FIXTURE: a fake gateway that approves immediately (and declines UPI IDs starting "fail@").
    // It is loaded only in mock mode and never talks to Razorpay.
    const { openMockCheckout } = await import('@/mocks/lib/paymentGateway')
    return openMockCheckout(session, options)
  }
 
  // INTEGRATION POINT — Razorpay Checkout.js (https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js). Once the script
  // is loaded, this is where the window opens and its three outcomes are mapped onto the result above:
  //   const checkout = new window.Razorpay({
  //     key: session.keyId,
  //     order_id: session.gatewayOrderId,
  //     amount: session.amount,
  //     currency: session.currency,
  //     prefill: options.prefill,
  //     handler: (response) => resolve({ outcome: 'success', razorpayPaymentId: response.razorpay_payment_id, ... }),
  //     modal: { ondismiss: () => resolve({ outcome: 'dismissed' }) },
  //   })
  //   checkout.on('payment.failed', (event) => resolve({ outcome: 'failed', reason: event.error.description }))
  //   checkout.open()
  throw new PaymentError('Online payments are not connected in this build yet. Please try again later.', { code: 'gateway_unavailable' })
}
 
/**
 * create session → payment window → confirm. Throws PaymentError when the customer's payment fails or is
 * abandoned (the order stays unpaid so they can try again), and ApiError when the backend refuses a step.
 * `options`: { method: 'upi' | 'card' | 'netbanking', upiId?, prefill?: { name, email, contact } }
 */
export async function payForOrder(orderNumber, options) {
  const session = await createPaymentSession(orderNumber, options.method)
  const result = await openPaymentWindow(session, options)
 
  if (result.outcome !== 'success') {
    const dismissed = result.outcome === 'dismissed'
    // Best effort: the customer needs the failure message even if recording it fails.
    await reportPaymentFailure(session.sessionId, dismissed ? 'dismissed' : result.reason).catch(() => {})
    throw new PaymentError(
      dismissed ? 'The payment window was closed before the payment finished. You have not been charged.' : result.reason,
      { code: dismissed ? 'payment_dismissed' : 'payment_failed' },
    )
  }
  return confirmPayment(session.sessionId, result)
}
```

```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import StatCard from '@/components/molecules/StatCard'
import { StatGrid } from '@/features/admin-lists'
import CustomerRecentOrdersCard from '@/features/customers/components/CustomerRecentOrdersCard'
import CustomerSidePanels from '@/features/customers/components/CustomerSidePanels'
import CustomerWalletCard from '@/features/customers/components/CustomerWalletCard'
import { useCustomer } from '@/features/customers/hooks/useCustomers'
import { formatDate } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR, formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './CustomerDetail.module.scss'
 
const money = (value) => formatINR(value, { decimals: 2 })
 
function DetailSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className={styles.page} aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading customer">
      <Skeleton height="4.5rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
      <div className={styles.columns}>
        <div className={styles.stack}>
          <Skeleton height="14rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
          <Skeleton height="12rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
        </div>
        <Skeleton height="18rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
 
/** Admin customer detail: profile, headline numbers, wallet ledger and recent orders. Read-only. */
export default function CustomerDetail({ code }) {
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useCustomer(code)
  const customer = data?.customer
 
  const header = (
    <PageHeader
      title={customer?.name ?? `Customer ${code}`}
      description={customer ? `${customer.code} · Customer since ${formatDate(customer.joinedAt)}` : undefined}
      actions={
        <>
          <Button as={Link} to={paths.admin.customers} variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="arrow-left">
            All customers
          </Button>
          {customer && (
            <Button as={Link} to={`${paths.admin.orders}?q=${encodeURIComponent(customer.code)}`} variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="bag">
              View orders
            </Button>
          )}
        </>
      }
    />
  )
 
  if (isError) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.page}>
        {header}
        <ErrorState
          title="We could not open this customer"
          message={getErrorMessage(error)}
          onRetry={error.status === 404 ? undefined : refetch}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }
 
  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.page}>
        {header}
        <DetailSkeleton />
      </div>
    )
  }
 
  const { stats } = data
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      {header}
 
      <StatGrid>
        <StatCard label="Orders" value={formatNumber(stats.ordersCount)} hint={stats.lastOrderAt ? `Last order ${formatDate(stats.lastOrderAt)}` : 'No orders yet'} />
        <StatCard label="Total spend" value={money(stats.totalSpend)} />
        <StatCard label="Average order value" value={money(stats.averageOrderValue)} />
        <StatCard label="Wallet balance" value={money(stats.walletBalance)} />
      </StatGrid>
 
      <div className={styles.columns}>
        <div className={styles.stack}>
          <CustomerRecentOrdersCard orders={data.recentOrders} customerCode={customer.code} />
          <CustomerWalletCard transactions={data.walletTransactions} />
        </div>
        <CustomerSidePanels customer={customer} addresses={data.addresses} />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import { formatDate } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR, formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './CustomerRecentOrdersCard.module.scss'
 
const COLUMNS = [
  {
    key: 'orderNumber',
    header: 'Order',
    cell: (row) => (
      <Link to={paths.admin.order(row.orderNumber)} className={styles.orderLink}>
        {row.orderNumber}
      </Link>
    ),
  },
  { key: 'placedAt', header: 'Placed', cell: (row) => formatDate(row.placedAt) },
  { key: 'units', header: 'Units', cell: (row) => formatNumber(row.units) },
  { key: 'grossAmount', header: 'Amount', align: 'right', cell: (row) => formatINR(row.grossAmount, { decimals: 2 }) },
  { key: 'paymentStatus', header: 'Payment', cell: (row) => <StatusBadge status={row.paymentStatus} /> },
  { key: 'status', header: 'Status', cell: (row) => <StatusBadge status={row.status} /> },
]
 
/** The customer's latest orders, each opening the admin order detail. */
export default function CustomerRecentOrdersCard({ orders, customerCode }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
 
  return (
    <Card
      title="Recent orders"
      padding="md"
      radius="md"
      actions={
        <Link to={`${paths.admin.orders}?q=${encodeURIComponent(customerCode)}`} className={styles.allLink}>
          View all orders
          <Icon name="arrow-right" />
        </Link>
      }
    >
      <DataTable
        caption="Recent orders"
        columns={COLUMNS}
        rows={orders}
        getRowId={(row) => row.orderNumber}
        onRowClick={(row) => navigate(paths.admin.order(row.orderNumber))}
        emptyState={<EmptyState compact icon="bag" title="No orders yet" description="Orders this customer places will show up here." />}
        minWidth="40rem"
      />
    </Card>
  )
}

```jsx
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import AddressSummary from '@/components/molecules/AddressSummary'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import SummaryRows from '@/components/molecules/SummaryRows'
import { formatMobile } from '@/lib/address'
import { formatDate } from '@/lib/date'
import styles from './CustomerSidePanels.module.scss'
 
const dash = (value) => value || '—'
 
function Profile({ customer }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Profile" padding="md" radius="md" actions={<StatusBadge status={customer.status} />}>
      <SummaryRows
        rows={[
          { label: 'Customer code', value: customer.code },
          { label: 'Mobile', value: customer.mobile ? formatMobile(customer.mobile) : '—' },
          { label: 'Email', value: dash(customer.email) },
          { label: 'City', value: [customer.city, customer.state].filter(Boolean).join(', ') || '—' },
          { label: 'PIN code', value: dash(customer.pin) },
          { label: 'Customer since', value: formatDate(customer.joinedAt) },
        ]}
      />
    </Card>
  )
}
 
function Addresses({ addresses }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Saved addresses" padding="md" radius="md">
      {addresses.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState compact icon="geo-alt" title="No saved addresses" description="Addresses the customer saves at checkout appear here." />
      ) : (
        <ul className={styles.addresses}>
          {addresses.map((address) => (
            <li key={address.id} className={styles.address}>
              <span className={styles.badges}>
                {address.label && <Badge tone="info">{address.label}</Badge>}
                {address.isDefault && <Badge tone="success">Default</Badge>}
              </span>
              <AddressSummary address={address} includeLandmark />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}
 
/** The right-hand column of the customer detail: profile and saved addresses (read-only). */
export default function CustomerSidePanels({ customer, addresses }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.stack}>
      <Profile customer={customer} />
      <Addresses addresses={addresses} />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/customers/components/CustomersList/CustomersList.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import StatCard from '@/components/molecules/StatCard'
import { EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE, fetchAllPages, ListToolbar, StatGrid, useExcelExport, useListParams } from '@/features/admin-lists'
import CustomersTable from '@/features/customers/components/CustomersTable'
import { CUSTOMER_STATUS_OPTIONS, WALLET_OPTIONS } from '@/features/customers/constants/customerOptions'
import { useCustomers } from '@/features/customers/hooks/useCustomers'
import { customersSheet, customersSheetRows } from '@/features/customers/lib/customersSheet'
import { listCustomers } from '@/features/customers/services/customerService'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './CustomersList.module.scss'
 
// The cards are shortcuts to the same Status / Wallet filters as the selects below them.
const SUMMARY_CARDS = [
  { label: 'All customers', count: 'all', filters: { status: '', wallet: '' } },
  { label: 'Active', count: 'active', filters: { status: 'active', wallet: '' } },
  { label: 'Inactive', count: 'inactive', filters: { status: 'inactive', wallet: '' } },
  { label: 'With wallet balance', count: 'withWallet', filters: { status: '', wallet: 'with' } },
]
 
/** Cities come from the backend (`facets.cities`); the selected one stays in the list while the data loads. */
function cityOptions(cities = [], selected) {
  const names = selected && !cities.includes(selected) ? [selected, ...cities] : cities
  return [{ value: '', label: 'All' }, ...names.map((city) => ({ value: city, label: city }))]
}
 
/** The admin Customers screen: search, filter, sort, page and export every customer. */
export default function CustomersList() {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const list = useListParams({ pageSize: 10, filters: { status: '', city: '', wallet: '' } })
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useCustomers(list.apiParams)
  const exporter = useExcelExport()
 
  const exportCustomers = () =>
    exporter.mutate({
      ...customersSheet,
      getRows: async () => customersSheetRows(await fetchAllPages((page) => listCustomers({ ...list.apiParams, page, pageSize: EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE }))),
    })
 
  const toolbarFilters = [
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Customer status',
      prefix: 'Status:',
      options: CUSTOMER_STATUS_OPTIONS,
      value: list.filters.status,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('status', value),
    },
    {
      key: 'city',
      label: 'City',
      prefix: 'City:',
      searchable: true,
      options: cityOptions(data?.facets.cities, list.filters.city),
      value: list.filters.city,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('city', value),
    },
    {
      key: 'wallet',
      label: 'Wallet balance',
      prefix: 'Wallet:',
      options: WALLET_OPTIONS,
      value: list.filters.wallet,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('wallet', value),
    },
  ]
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <PageHeader title="Customers" description="Look up a customer, their orders, wallet and saved addresses." />
 
      <StatGrid>
        {SUMMARY_CARDS.map((card) => {
          const selected = Object.entries(card.filters).every(([key, value]) => list.filters[key] === value)
          return (
            <StatCard
              key={card.label}
              layout="inline"
              label={card.label}
              value={data ? formatNumber(data.counts[card.count] ?? 0) : '—'}
              selected={selected}
              onClick={() => list.setFilters(selected ? { status: '', wallet: '' } : card.filters)}
            />
          )
        })}
      </StatGrid>
 
      <ListToolbar
        search={{ ...list.search, label: 'Search customers', placeholder: 'Search name, code, mobile or email' }}
        filters={toolbarFilters}
        hasActiveFilters={list.hasActiveFilters}
        onClear={list.reset}
      >
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="download" disabled={!data} loading={exporter.isPending} onClick={exportCustomers}>
          Export
        </Button>
      </ListToolbar>
 
      {isError ? (
        <ErrorState message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} />
      ) : (
        <CustomersTable
          rows={data?.items ?? []}
          loading={isPending}
          sort={list.sortState}
          onSortChange={list.setSort}
          onOpen={(code) => navigate(paths.admin.customer(code))}
          emptyState={
            <EmptyState
              compact
              icon="people"
              title="No customers match these filters"
              description="Try a different search, or clear the filters to see every customer."
              action={
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={list.reset}>
                  Clear filters
                </Button>
              }
            />
          }
          pagination={
            data && { page: data.page, pageSize: data.pageSize, totalItems: data.totalItems, onPageChange: list.setPage, itemLabel: 'customers' }
          }
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'

import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'

import styles from './CustomersTable.module.scss'
 
const COLUMNS = [
  {
    key: 'name',
    header: 'Customer',
    sortable: true,
    cell: (row) => (
      <span className={styles.stacked}>
        <Link to={paths.admin.customer(row.code)} className={styles.nameLink}>
          {row.name}
        </Link>
        <span className={styles.secondary}>{row.code}</span>
      </span>

        <span className={styles.secondary}>{row.email}</span>

  },
  { key: 'city', header: 'City', sortable: true, cell: (row) => row.city || '—' },
  { key: 'ordersCount', header: 'Orders', sortable: true, align: 'right', cell: (row) => formatNumber(row.ordersCount) },
  { key: 'totalSpend', header: 'Total spend', sortable: true, align: 'right', cell: (row) => formatINR(row.totalSpend, { decimals: 2 }) },
  { key: 'walletBalance', header: 'Wallet', sortable: true, align: 'right', cell: (row) => formatINR(row.walletBalance, { decimals: 2 }) },
  { key: 'status', header: 'Status', cell: (row) => <StatusBadge status={row.status} /> },
  { key: 'joinedAt', header: 'Joined', sortable: true, cell: (row) => formatDate(row.joinedAt) },
]
 
/** The admin customer list. Paging, sorting and filtering are the backend's; this shows the current page. */
export default function CustomersTable({ rows, loading, sort, onSortChange, pagination, emptyState, onOpen }) {
  return (
    <DataTable
      caption="Customers"
      columns={COLUMNS}
      rows={rows}
      getRowId={(row) => row.code}
      loading={loading}
      sort={sort}
      onSortChange={onSortChange}
      pagination={pagination}
      emptyState={emptyState}
      onRowClick={(row) => onOpen(row.code)}
      rowActions={(row) => (
        <Link to={paths.admin.customer(row.code)} className={styles.viewLink} aria-label={`View ${row.name}`}>
          View
          <Icon name="chevron-right" />
        </Link>
      )}
      actionsHeader="Details"
      minWidth="58rem"
    />
  )
}
```

import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './CustomerWalletCard.module.scss'
 
const money = (value) => formatINR(value, { decimals: 2 })
 
const COLUMNS = [
  { key: 'at', header: 'Date', cell: (row) => formatDateTime(row.at) },
  {
    key: 'reason',
    header: 'Description',
    cell: (row) =>
      row.reference ? (
        <Link to={paths.admin.order(row.reference)} className={styles.orderLink}>
          {row.reason}
        </Link>
      ) : (
        row.reason
      ),
  },
  {
    key: 'amount',
    header: 'Amount',
    align: 'right',
    cell: (row) => (
      <span className={clsx(styles.amount, row.type === 'credit' ? styles.credit : styles.debit)}>
        {row.type === 'credit' ? '+' : '−'}
        {money(row.amount)}
      </span>
    ),
  },
  { key: 'balanceAfter', header: 'Balance', align: 'right', cell: (row) => money(row.balanceAfter) },
]
 
/** Wallet ledger, newest first. Amounts and the running balance come from the backend. */
export default function CustomerWalletCard({ transactions }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Wallet ledger" padding="md" radius="md">
      <DataTable
        caption="Wallet ledger"
        columns={COLUMNS}
        rows={transactions}
        getRowId={(row) => row.id}
        emptyState={<EmptyState compact icon="wallet2" title="No wallet activity" description="Credits and payments from the wallet will be listed here." />}
        minWidth="38rem"
      />
    </Card>
  )
}

## `src/features/customers/hooks/useCustomers.js`
 
```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { getCustomer, listCustomerOptions, listCustomers } from '@/features/customers/services/customerService'
 
export const customerKeys = {
  all: ['admin', 'customers'],
  list: (params) => ['admin', 'customers', 'list', params],
  options: ['admin', 'customers', 'options'],
  detail: (code) => ['admin', 'customers', 'detail', code],
}
 
export const useCustomers = (params) =>
  useQuery({ queryKey: customerKeys.list(params), queryFn: () => listCustomers(params), placeholderData: keepPreviousData })
 
export const useCustomerOptions = () => useQuery({ queryKey: customerKeys.options, queryFn: listCustomerOptions, staleTime: 5 * 60_000 })
 
export const useCustomer = (code) => useQuery({ queryKey: customerKeys.detail(code), queryFn: () => getCustomer(code) })
```

## `src/features/customers/services/customerService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. A customer is
//   { code, name, email, mobile, city, state, pin, ordersCount, totalSpend, walletBalance, status: 'active' | 'inactive', joinedAt }
// ordersCount, totalSpend and walletBalance are backend aggregates; the browser never recalculates them.
 
/**
 * GET customers (q, status, city, wallet: with | none, sort: 'field' | '-field', page, pageSize) →
 *   { items, page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount,
 *     counts: { all, active, inactive, withWallet }, facets: { cities: string[] } }
 */
export async function listCustomers(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.customers.list, { params })
  return data
}
 
/** GET { items: [{ code, name }] } — every customer, for filter dropdowns. */
export async function listCustomerOptions() {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.customers.options)
  return data.items
}
 
/**
 * GET one customer →
 *   { customer, stats: { ordersCount, totalSpend, walletBalance, averageOrderValue, lastOrderAt },
 *     addresses: [address], walletTransactions: [{ id, type: 'credit' | 'debit', amount, reason, reference, at, balanceAfter }],
 *     recentOrders: [order list row] }   (wallet ledger newest first; balanceAfter is the running balance)
 */
export async function getCustomer(code) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.customers.item(code))
  return data
}
```

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { selectCurrentUser } from '@/app/store'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import FulfilmentCard from '@/features/dashboard/components/FulfilmentCard'
import KpiGrid from '@/features/dashboard/components/KpiGrid'
import PeriodMenu from '@/features/dashboard/components/PeriodMenu'
import RecentOrdersCard from '@/features/dashboard/components/RecentOrdersCard'
import SalesOverviewCard from '@/features/dashboard/components/SalesOverviewCard'
import { useDashboard } from '@/features/dashboard/hooks/useDashboard'
import { getGreeting } from '@/features/dashboard/utils/getGreeting'
import { formatDate } from '@/lib/date'
import styles from './DashboardOverview.module.scss'
 
const DEFAULT_PERIOD = 'this_month'
 
/** Admin home: greeting, headline figures, sales trend, fulfilment queue and recent orders. */
export default function DashboardOverview() {
  const user = useSelector(selectCurrentUser)
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState(DEFAULT_PERIOD)
  const { data, isError, error, refetch } = useDashboard(period)
 
  const firstName = user?.name?.split(' ')[0]
  const greeting = data ? getGreeting(data.asOf) : 'Welcome'
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <PageHeader
        title={
          <>
            {greeting}
            {firstName && `, ${firstName}`} <span aria-hidden="true">👋</span>
          </>
        }
        description={data ? `Here’s what’s happening across Shipper.com today, ${formatDate(data.asOf)}.` : 'Loading today’s figures…'}
        actions={
          <div className={styles.quickActions}>
            <Button as={Link} to={paths.admin.newPurchase} variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="cart-plus">
              Create purchase
            </Button>
            <Button as={Link} to={`${paths.admin.products}?stock=low`} variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="exclamation-triangle">
              Low-stock products
            </Button>
            {data && <PeriodMenu value={data.period.key} label={data.period.label} options={data.period.options} onChange={setPeriod} />}
          </div>
        }
      />
 
      {isError && !data ? (
        <ErrorState title="The dashboard could not be loaded" message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} />
      ) : (
        <>
          <KpiGrid kpis={data?.kpis} />
          <div className={styles.panels}>
            <SalesOverviewCard rangeLabel={data?.period.rangeLabel} series={data?.salesOverview} />
            <FulfilmentCard fulfilment={data?.fulfilment} />
          </div>
          <RecentOrdersCard orders={data?.recentOrders} />
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import { formatNumber, pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './FulfilmentCard.module.scss'
 
const SEVERITY_TONE = { critical: 'danger', warning: 'warning' }
 
const METRICS = [
  { key: 'pendingShipments', label: 'Pending shipments' },
  { key: 'readyToDispatch', label: 'Ready to dispatch' },
  { key: 'delayedOrders', label: 'Delayed orders' },
]
 
/** Queue counts and the stock alerts that need attention today. */
export default function FulfilmentCard({ fulfilment, className }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Fulfilment & inventory" radius="md" padding="md" className={className}>
      {fulfilment ? (
        <>
          <dl className={styles.metrics}>
            {METRICS.map(({ key, label }) => (
              <div key={key} className={styles.metric}>
                <dt>{label}</dt>
                <dd>{formatNumber(fulfilment[key])}</dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
 
          {fulfilment.stockAlerts.length > 0 && (
            <section className={styles.alerts} aria-label={`Low stock alerts: ${pluralize(fulfilment.lowStockCount, 'product')} at or below their threshold`}>
              <ul>
                {fulfilment.stockAlerts.map((alert) => (
                  <li key={alert.productCode} className={styles.alert}>
                    <span>{alert.name}</span>
                    <Badge tone={SEVERITY_TONE[alert.severity] ?? 'warning'}>{alert.stock} left</Badge>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </section>
          )}
 
          <Link to={paths.admin.storeOperation} className={styles.link}>
            Open Store Operation <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
          </Link>
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className={styles.loading} aria-hidden="true">
          <Skeleton height="1rem" />
          <Skeleton height="1rem" />
          <Skeleton height="1rem" />
        </div>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/dashboard/components/KpiGrid/KpiGrid.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import StatCard from '@/components/molecules/StatCard'
import { formatINR, formatNumber, formatPercent } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './KpiGrid.module.scss'
 
const KPI_DEFINITIONS = [
  { key: 'grossSales', label: 'Gross sales', format: formatINR },
  { key: 'netRevenue', label: 'Net revenue', format: formatINR },
  { key: 'orders', label: 'Orders', format: formatNumber },
  { key: 'customers', label: 'Customers', format: formatNumber },
]
 
const TREND = {
  up: { arrow: '↑', spoken: 'Up', tone: 'success' },
  down: { arrow: '↓', spoken: 'Down', tone: 'danger' },
  flat: { arrow: '→', spoken: 'Unchanged', tone: 'neutral' },
}
 
// "12.8% vs last month", "8.2% · 42 today", "186 new this month": percent and notes come from the backend.
function describeChange({ changePercent, comparisonLabel, extra }) {
  const change = changePercent === null ? null : [formatPercent(changePercent), comparisonLabel].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
  return [change, extra].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')
}
 
/** Headline figures for the selected period. `kpis` is null while the first response is loading. */
export default function KpiGrid({ kpis }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.grid}>
      {KPI_DEFINITIONS.map(({ key, label, format }) => {
        const kpi = kpis?.[key]
        if (!kpi) {
          return (
            <div key={key} className={styles.placeholder} aria-hidden="true">
              <Skeleton width="40%" height="0.875rem" />
              <Skeleton width="60%" height="1.75rem" />
              <Skeleton width="50%" height="0.75rem" />
            </div>
          )
        }
        const trend = TREND[kpi.trend] ?? TREND.flat
        return (
          <StatCard
            key={key}
            label={label}
            size="lg"
            value={format(kpi.value)}
            deltaTone={trend.tone}
            delta={
              <>
                <span aria-hidden="true">{trend.arrow}</span>
                <span className="visually-hidden">{trend.spoken} </span> {describeChange(kpi)}
              </>
            }
          />
        )
      })}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/dashboard/components/NotificationsMenu/NotificationsMenu.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import IconButton from '@/components/atoms/IconButton'
import Popover from '@/components/molecules/Popover'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import { formatShortDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { useNotifications } from '@/features/dashboard/hooks/useNotifications'
import styles from './NotificationsMenu.module.scss'
 
const TYPE_ICON = { low_stock: 'exclamation-triangle', delayed_order: 'clock-history', new_order: 'bag-check' }
 
/** Bell with an unread count and a list of operational alerts (low stock, delayed and new orders). */
export default function NotificationsMenu() {
  const { data, isPending, isError } = useNotifications()
  const unread = data?.unreadCount ?? 0
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.wrapper}>
      <Popover
        align="end"
        panelClassName={styles.panel}
        trigger={({ props }) => (
          <IconButton icon="bell" label={unread ? `Notifications, ${unread} unread` : 'Notifications'} size="lg" {...props} />
        )}
      >
        {({ close }) => (
          <section aria-label="Notifications">
            <h2 className={styles.title}>Notifications</h2>
            {isPending && <Skeleton height="3rem" radius="8px" />}
            {isError && <p className={styles.empty}>Notifications could not be loaded.</p>}
            {data && data.items.length === 0 && <p className={styles.empty}>You’re all caught up.</p>}
            {data && (
              <ul>
                {data.items.map((item) => (
                  <li key={item.id}>
                    <Link to={item.href} className={styles.item} onClick={close}>
                      <span className={styles.icon}>
                        <Icon name={TYPE_ICON[item.type] ?? 'bell'} />
                      </span>
                      <span>
                        <strong>{item.title}</strong>
                        <span className={styles.description}>{item.description}</span>
                        <span className={styles.time}>{formatShortDateTime(item.createdAt)}</span>
                      </span>
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </section>
        )}
      </Popover>
      {unread > 0 && (
        <span className={styles.count} aria-hidden="true">
          {unread}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Popover from '@/components/molecules/Popover'
import styles from './PeriodMenu.module.scss'
 
/** "This month ⌄" button that opens the list of reporting periods the backend offers. */
export default function PeriodMenu({ value, label, options, onChange }) {
  return (
    <Popover
      align="end"
      panelClassName={styles.panel}
      trigger={({ props }) => (
        <Button size="sm" rightIcon="chevron-down" {...props}>
          {label}
        </Button>
      )}
    >
      {({ close }) => (
        <ul aria-label="Reporting period">
          {options.map((option) => (
            <li key={option.key}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={styles.option}
                aria-pressed={option.key === value}
                onClick={() => {
                  onChange(option.key)
                  close()
                }}
              >
                {option.label}
                {option.key === value && <Icon name="check2" />}
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </Popover>
  )
}
```

const COLUMNS = [
  {
    key: 'orderNumber',
    header: 'Order',
    cell: (order) => (
      <Link to={paths.admin.order(order.orderNumber)} className={styles.orderLink}>
        {order.orderNumber}
      </Link>
    ),
  },
  { key: 'customerName', header: 'Customer' },
  { key: 'placedAt', header: 'Placed on', cell: (order) => formatDate(order.placedAt) },

  { key: 'status', header: 'Status', cell: (order) => <StatusBadge status={order.status} /> },
]
 
/** The latest orders across the store. `orders` is null while the first response is loading. */
export default function RecentOrdersCard({ orders }) {

    <Card title="Recent orders" radius="md" padding="sm" className={styles.card}>
      <DataTable
        className={styles.table}
        caption="Recent orders"
        columns={COLUMNS}
        rows={orders ?? []}
        loading={!orders}
        loadingRows={4}

      <div className={styles.footer}>
        <p className={styles.note}>

        </p>
        <Link to={paths.admin.orders} className={styles.link}>
          View all orders <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
        </Link>
      </div>
    </Card>
  )
}

## `src/features/dashboard/components/RevenueChart/monotonePath.js`
 
```javascript
/**
 * SVG path through `points` ([[x, y], …], x ascending) as a monotone cubic curve: smooth, but it never
 * overshoots between samples, so a smoothed revenue line cannot dip below a day's real value.
 */
export function monotonePath(points) {
  const count = points.length
  if (count === 0) return ''
  if (count === 1) return `M${points[0][0]},${points[0][1]}`
 
  const slopes = points.slice(1).map(([x, y], index) => (y - points[index][1]) / (x - points[index][0]))
  const tangents = points.map((_, index) => {
    if (index === 0) return slopes[0]
    if (index === count - 1) return slopes[count - 2]
    return slopes[index - 1] * slopes[index] <= 0 ? 0 : (slopes[index - 1] + slopes[index]) / 2
  })
 
  slopes.forEach((slope, index) => {
    if (slope === 0) {
      tangents[index] = 0
      tangents[index + 1] = 0
      return
    }
    const a = tangents[index] / slope
    const b = tangents[index + 1] / slope
    const magnitude = a * a + b * b
    if (magnitude > 9) {
      const scale = 3 / Math.sqrt(magnitude)
      tangents[index] = scale * a * slope
      tangents[index + 1] = scale * b * slope
    }
  })
 
  return points.slice(1).reduce((path, [x, y], index) => {
    const [fromX, fromY] = points[index]
    const third = (x - fromX) / 3
    return `${path} C${fromX + third},${fromY + tangents[index] * third} ${x - third},${y - tangents[index + 1] * third} ${x},${y}`
  }, `M${points[0][0]},${points[0][1]}`)
}
```
 
## `src/features/dashboard/components/RevenueChart/RevenueChart.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import { monotonePath } from './monotonePath'
import styles from './RevenueChart.module.scss'
 
const WIDTH = 1000
const HEIGHT = 200
const GRID_LINES = 4
 
/** x-axis labels: every 5th day on long ranges, every day on a week; the last label is always kept. */
function pickTickIndexes(count) {
  const step = count > 14 ? 5 : 1
  const indexes = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => index).filter((index) => index === 0 || (index + 1) % step === 0)
  const last = count - 1
  if (indexes.at(-1) !== last) {
    if (last - indexes.at(-1) < 3) indexes.pop()
    indexes.push(last)
  }
  return indexes
}
 
/**
 * Two-series line chart (current period vs the one before) drawn in SVG; there is no chart library.
 * Hover, touch or the arrow keys inspect a day; a visually hidden table carries the same figures for
 * screen readers. All values come from the backend and are only formatted here.
 *
 * points: [{ label, previousLabel, current, previous }]
 */
export default function RevenueChart({ points, currentLabel, previousLabel, metricLabel = 'Revenue' }) {
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(null)
  const last = points.length - 1
 
  const values = points.flatMap((point) => [point.current, point.previous])
  const floor = Math.min(...values) * 0.85
  const ceiling = Math.max(...values) * 1.04
  const xOf = (index) => (last === 0 ? WIDTH / 2 : (index / last) * WIDTH)
  const yOf = (value) => HEIGHT - ((value - floor) / (ceiling - floor)) * HEIGHT
  const pathOf = (key) => monotonePath(points.map((point, index) => [xOf(index), yOf(point[key])]))
 
  const active = activeIndex === null ? null : points[activeIndex]
  const percentOf = (index) => (last === 0 ? 50 : (index / last) * 100)
 
  const inspectFromPointer = (event) => {
    const box = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
    const ratio = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (event.clientX - box.left) / box.width))
    setActiveIndex(Math.round(ratio * last))
  }
 
  const handleKeyDown = (event) => {
    const moves = {
      ArrowLeft: Math.max(0, (activeIndex ?? last) - 1),
      ArrowRight: Math.min(last, (activeIndex ?? last) + 1),
      Home: 0,
      End: last,
    }
    if (moves[event.key] === undefined) return
    event.preventDefault()
    setActiveIndex(moves[event.key])
  }
 
  const tickIndexes = pickTickIndexes(points.length)
  const summary = `${metricLabel} by day. ${currentLabel}: ${formatINR(points[0].current)} on ${points[0].label} to ${formatINR(points[last].current)} on ${points[last].label}.`
 
  return (
    <figure className={styles.chart}>
      <div
        className={styles.plot}
        tabIndex={0}
        role="group"
        aria-label={`${summary} Use the left and right arrow keys to read each day.`}
        onPointerMove={inspectFromPointer}
        onPointerDown={inspectFromPointer}
        onPointerLeave={() => setActiveIndex(null)}
        onFocus={() => setActiveIndex((current) => current ?? last)}
        onBlur={() => setActiveIndex(null)}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
      >
        <svg className={styles.svg} viewBox={`0 0 ${WIDTH} ${HEIGHT}`} preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
          {Array.from({ length: GRID_LINES }, (_, index) => {
            const y = (index / (GRID_LINES - 1)) * HEIGHT
            return <line key={index} className={styles.grid} x1="0" x2={WIDTH} y1={y} y2={y} />
          })}
          <path className={styles.previousLine} d={pathOf('previous')} />
          <path className={styles.currentLine} d={pathOf('current')} />
        </svg>
 
        {active && (
          <>
            <span className={styles.guide} style={{ left: `${percentOf(activeIndex)}%` }} aria-hidden="true" />
            <span
              className={clsx(styles.dot, styles.previousDot)}
              style={{ left: `${percentOf(activeIndex)}%`, top: `${(yOf(active.previous) / HEIGHT) * 100}%` }}
              aria-hidden="true"
            />
            <span
              className={clsx(styles.dot, styles.currentDot)}
              style={{ left: `${percentOf(activeIndex)}%`, top: `${(yOf(active.current) / HEIGHT) * 100}%` }}
              aria-hidden="true"
            />
            <div
              className={clsx(styles.tooltip, activeIndex / Math.max(1, last) > 0.8 && styles.tooltipLeft, activeIndex / Math.max(1, last) < 0.2 && styles.tooltipRight)}
              style={{ left: `${percentOf(activeIndex)}%` }}
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              <strong className={styles.tooltipTitle}>{active.label}</strong>
              <span className={styles.tooltipRow}>
                <span className={clsx(styles.swatch, styles.currentSwatch)} />
                {currentLabel}
                <b>{formatINR(active.current)}</b>
              </span>
              <span className={styles.tooltipRow}>
                <span className={clsx(styles.swatch, styles.previousSwatch)} />
                {previousLabel} · {active.previousLabel}
                <b>{formatINR(active.previous)}</b>
              </span>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
 
      <div className={styles.axis} aria-hidden="true">
        {tickIndexes.map((index) => (
          <span
            key={index}
            className={clsx(styles.tick, index === 0 && styles.tickFirst, index === last && styles.tickLast)}
            style={{ left: `${percentOf(index)}%` }}
          >
            {points[index].label}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
 
      <p className="visually-hidden" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        {active && `${active.label}: ${currentLabel} ${formatINR(active.current)}, ${previousLabel} ${formatINR(active.previous)}.`}
      </p>
 
      <div className="visually-hidden">
        <table>
          <caption>
            {metricLabel} by day, {currentLabel} compared with {previousLabel}
          </caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">Day</th>
              <th scope="col">{currentLabel}</th>
              <th scope="col">{previousLabel}</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {points.map((point) => (
              <tr key={point.label}>
                <th scope="row">{point.label}</th>
                <td>{formatINR(point.current)}</td>
                <td>{formatINR(point.previous)}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </figure>
  )
}
```

}

}
 
.currentLine,
.previousLine {
  fill: none;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;

}

  stroke-width: 3;
}
 
.previousLine {
  stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sh-color-primary) 38%, var(--sh-color-white));

}
 
.previousDot {

}
 
.tooltip {

  bottom: calc(100% + 0.5rem);

  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--sh-color-border);

  background: var(--sh-color-white);

  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-xs);
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}
 
.tooltipLeft {

}
 
.tooltipRight {
  transform: none;
}
 
.tooltipTitle {
  color: var(--sh-color-navy);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-sm);
}
 
.tooltipRow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.375rem;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
 
  b {
    margin-left: auto;
    padding-left: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--sh-color-ink);
    font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-semibold);
  }
}
 
.swatch {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  flex: none;
  border-radius: 50%;
}
 
.currentSwatch {
  background: var(--sh-color-primary);
}

  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sh-color-primary) 55%, var(--sh-color-white));
}
 
.axis {
  position: relative;
  height: 1rem;
  margin-top: 1.1875rem;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-xs);
}
 
.tick {

  top: 0;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}
 
.tickFirst {
  transform: none;
}
 
.tickLast {
  transform: translateX(-100%);
}

import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'

import styles from './SalesOverviewCard.module.scss'
 
/** Revenue trend for the selected period against the period before it. */

    <Card title="Sales overview" radius="md" padding="md" className={className}>
      {series ? (
        <>
          <p className={styles.range}>{rangeLabel} · Gross sales include GST</p>
          <div className={styles.legendRow}>

            <ul className={styles.legend} aria-label="Chart legend">

              </li>
              <li>
                <span className={styles.previousKey} aria-hidden="true" />
                {series.previousLabel}
              </li>
            </ul>

          <Skeleton width="45%" height="0.875rem" />
          <Skeleton height="6.25rem" radius="8px" />
        </div>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}

## `src/features/dashboard/hooks/useDashboard.js`
 
```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { getDashboard } from '@/features/dashboard/services/dashboardService'
 
export const dashboardKeys = {
  all: ['admin', 'dashboard'],
  period: (period) => ['admin', 'dashboard', period],
}
 
/** Dashboard aggregates for a reporting period. Refreshes every minute; the previous period stays on screen while a new one loads. */
export function useDashboard(period) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: dashboardKeys.period(period),
    queryFn: () => getDashboard(period),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    refetchInterval: 60_000,
  })
}
```

## `src/features/dashboard/services/dashboardService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
/**
 * ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: GET /admin/dashboard?period=this_month|last_7_days|last_month.
 * Expected response (every figure is calculated by the backend; the UI only formats it):
 *   {
 *     asOf,
 *     period: { key, label, rangeLabel, options: [{ key, label }] },
 *     kpis: { grossSales | netRevenue | orders | customers:
 *             { value, changePercent | null, trend: 'up' | 'down' | 'flat', comparisonLabel | null, extra | null } },
 *     salesOverview: { currentLabel, previousLabel, points: [{ label, previousLabel, current, previous }] },
 *     fulfilment: { pendingShipments, readyToDispatch, delayedOrders, lowStockCount,
 *                   stockAlerts: [{ productCode, name, stock, severity: 'critical' | 'warning' }] },
 *     recentOrders: [{ orderNumber, customerName, placedAt, grossAmount, paymentStatus, status }]
 *   }
 */
export async function getDashboard(period) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.dashboard.summary, { params: { period } })
  return data
}
```

## `src/features/dashboard/utils/getGreeting.js`
 
```javascript
const IST = 'Asia/Kolkata'
 
/** "Good morning" / "Good afternoon" / "Good evening" for the hour of `isoTime` in India Standard Time. */
export function getGreeting(isoTime) {
  const hour = Number(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', hourCycle: 'h23', timeZone: IST }).format(new Date(isoTime)))
  if (hour < 12) return 'Good morning'
  return hour < 17 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening'
}
```

import { useState } from 'react'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'

import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'

import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import StatCard from '@/components/molecules/StatCard'
import { ListToolbar, StatGrid, useListParams } from '@/features/admin-lists'
import RestockTable from '@/features/inventory/components/RestockTable'
import { RESTOCK_CATEGORY_OPTIONS, RESTOCK_LEVEL_OPTIONS } from '@/features/inventory/constants/restockOptions'
import { useRestockItems } from '@/features/inventory/hooks/useRestock'
import { useRequestRestock } from '@/features/inventory/hooks/useRequestRestock'
import { parseQuantity } from '@/features/inventory/lib/quantity'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './RestockList.module.scss'
 
// The cards are shortcuts to the same "Status" filter as the select below them.
const SUMMARY_CARDS = [
  { level: '', label: 'Needs restock', count: 'all' },
  { level: 'low', label: 'Low stock', count: 'low' },
  { level: 'out', label: 'Out of stock', count: 'out' },
]
 
/** The admin Order restock screen: low and out-of-stock products with a suggested quantity to order. */
export default function RestockList() {
  const list = useListParams({ pageSize: 12, filters: { level: '', category: '' } })
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useRestockItems(list.apiParams)
  const requestRestock = useRequestRestock()
 
  // Typed quantities by product code; a row without an entry shows the backend's suggestion.
  const [quantities, setQuantities] = useState({})
  // Picked rows (code → item) belong to the filters they were picked under, so changing a filter starts afresh.
  const [selection, setSelection] = useState({ key: '', picked: {} })
  const filterKey = JSON.stringify({ ...list.apiParams, page: undefined, sort: undefined })
  const picked = selection.key === filterKey ? selection.picked : {}
  const pickedItems = Object.values(picked)
 
  const quantityOf = (item) => quantities[item.productCode] ?? String(item.suggestedQuantity)
  const setQuantity = (productCode, value) => setQuantities((current) => ({ ...current, [productCode]: value }))
 
  const changeSelection = (ids) =>
    setSelection({
      key: filterKey,
      picked: Object.fromEntries(ids.map((id) => [id, picked[id] ?? data.items.find((item) => item.productCode === id)])),
    })
 
  const restockLines = (items) => items.map((item) => ({ productCode: item.productCode, quantity: parseQuantity(quantityOf(item)) }))
  const bulkInvalid = pickedItems.some((item) => parseQuantity(quantityOf(item)) === null)
 
  const toolbarFilters = [
    {
      key: 'category',
      label: 'Category',
      prefix: 'Category:',
      options: RESTOCK_CATEGORY_OPTIONS,
      value: list.filters.category,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('category', value),
    },
    {
      key: 'level',
      label: 'Stock status',
      prefix: 'Status:',
      options: RESTOCK_LEVEL_OPTIONS,
      value: list.filters.level,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('level', value),
    },
  ]
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <PageHeader title="Order restock" description="Products at or below their reorder level, with the quantity we suggest restocking." />
 
      <StatGrid columns={3}>
        {SUMMARY_CARDS.map((card) => (
          <StatCard
            key={card.label}
            layout="inline"
            label={card.label}
            value={data ? formatNumber(data.counts[card.count] ?? 0) : '—'}
            selected={list.filters.level === card.level}
            onClick={() => list.setFilter('level', list.filters.level === card.level ? '' : card.level)}
          />
        ))}
      </StatGrid>
 
      <ListToolbar
        search={{ ...list.search, label: 'Search products', placeholder: 'Search product name or code' }}
        filters={toolbarFilters}
        hasActiveFilters={list.hasActiveFilters}
        onClear={list.reset}
      />
 
      <BulkActionBar selectedCount={pickedItems.length} itemLabel="product" onClear={() => setSelection({ key: filterKey, picked: {} })}>
        <Button
          size="sm"
          leftIcon="box-arrow-in-down"
          disabled={bulkInvalid}
          loading={requestRestock.isPending}
          onClick={() => requestRestock.mutate(restockLines(pickedItems), { onSuccess: () => setSelection({ key: filterKey, picked: {} }) })}
        >
          Request restock
        </Button>
      </BulkActionBar>
 
      {isError ? (
        <ErrorState message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} />
      ) : (
        <RestockTable
          rows={data?.items ?? []}
          loading={isPending}
          sort={list.sortState}
          onSortChange={list.setSort}
          selectedIds={Object.keys(picked)}
          onSelectionChange={changeSelection}
          quantityOf={quantityOf}
          onQuantityChange={setQuantity}
          onRequestRestock={(item) => requestRestock.mutate(restockLines([item]))}
          requesting={requestRestock.isPending}
          emptyState={
            <EmptyState
              compact
              icon="box-seam"
              title={list.hasActiveFilters ? 'No products match these filters' : 'Everything is well stocked'}
              description={list.hasActiveFilters ? 'Try a different search, or clear the filters.' : 'No product is at or below its reorder level right now.'}
              action={
                list.hasActiveFilters && (
                  <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={list.reset}>
                    Clear filters
                  </Button>
                )
              }
            />
          }
          pagination={data && { page: data.page, pageSize: data.pageSize, totalItems: data.totalItems, onPageChange: list.setPage, itemLabel: 'products' }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```
