## `src/features/inventory/components/RestockTable/RestockTable.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import Thumbnail from '@/components/atoms/Thumbnail'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import { parseQuantity } from '@/features/inventory/lib/quantity'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './RestockTable.module.scss'
 
const LEVEL_STATUS = { low: 'low_stock', out: 'out_of_stock' }
 
/**
 * Products at or below their reorder level. The order quantity starts at the backend's suggestion and can be
 * changed per row; "Request restock" raises a request for the purchasing team.
 */
export default function RestockTable({
  rows,
  loading,
  sort,
  onSortChange,
  pagination,
  emptyState,
  selectedIds,
  onSelectionChange,
  quantityOf,
  onQuantityChange,
  onRequestRestock,
  requesting,
}) {
  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'name',
      header: 'Product',
      sortable: true,
      className: styles.productColumn,
      cell: (row) => (
        <span className={styles.product}>
          <Thumbnail src={row.thumbnail} size="sm" />
          <span className={styles.stacked}>
            <span className={styles.name}>{row.name}</span>
            <span className={styles.secondary}>
              {row.unit} · {row.productCode}
            </span>
          </span>
        </span>
      ),
    },
    { key: 'categoryLabel', header: 'Category', sortable: true, className: styles.nowrap },
    { key: 'bin', header: 'Bin', className: styles.nowrap, cell: (row) => row.bin || '—' },
    { key: 'stock', header: 'In stock', sortable: true, align: 'right', cell: (row) => formatNumber(row.stock) },
    { key: 'lowStockThreshold', header: 'Reorder level', align: 'right', cell: (row) => formatNumber(row.lowStockThreshold) },
    { key: 'level', header: 'Status', cell: (row) => <StatusBadge status={LEVEL_STATUS[row.level]} /> },
    {
      key: 'quantity',
      header: 'Order quantity',
      cell: (row) => {
        const value = quantityOf(row)
        const invalid = parseQuantity(value) === null
        return (
          <Input
            size="sm"
            type="text"
            inputMode="numeric"
            wrapperClassName={styles.quantity}
            aria-label={`Order quantity for ${row.name}`}
            value={value}
            invalid={invalid}
            onChange={(event) => onQuantityChange(row.productCode, event.target.value)}
          />
        )
      },
    },
  ]
 
  return (
    <DataTable
      caption="Products to restock"
      columns={columns}
      rows={rows}
      getRowId={(row) => row.productCode}
      getRowLabel={(row) => row.name}
      selectable
      selectedIds={selectedIds}
      onSelectionChange={onSelectionChange}
      loading={loading}
      sort={sort}
      onSortChange={onSortChange}
      pagination={pagination}
      emptyState={emptyState}
      actionsHeader="Restock"
      minWidth="64rem"
      rowActions={(row) =>
        row.requestedQuantity ? (
          <Badge tone="info">Requested · {formatNumber(row.requestedQuantity)} units</Badge>
        ) : (
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            leftIcon="box-arrow-in-down"
            disabled={requesting || parseQuantity(quantityOf(row)) === null}
            onClick={() => onRequestRestock(row)}
          >
            Request restock
          </Button>
        )
      }
    />
  )
}
```

## `src/features/inventory/hooks/useRequestRestock.js`
 
```javascript
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { restockKeys } from '@/features/inventory/hooks/useRestock'
import { createRestockRequest } from '@/features/inventory/services/restockService'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
 
/** Raises a restock request for the given lines ([{ productCode, quantity }]) and refreshes the list. */
export function useRequestRestock() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: createRestockRequest,
    onSuccess: (request) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: restockKeys.all })
      toast.success(`Restock request ${request.id} raised for ${pluralize(request.items.length, 'product')}.`)
    },
    onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error)),
  })
}
```
 
## `src/features/inventory/hooks/useRestock.js`
 
```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { listRestockItems } from '@/features/inventory/services/restockService'
 
export const restockKeys = {
  all: ['admin', 'restock'],
  list: (params) => ['admin', 'restock', 'list', params],
}
 
export const useRestockItems = (params) =>
  useQuery({ queryKey: restockKeys.list(params), queryFn: () => listRestockItems(params), placeholderData: keepPreviousData })
```

## `src/features/inventory/lib/quantity.js`
 
```javascript
/** An order quantity typed into the restock table: a whole number of at least 1, or null when it is not valid. */
export function parseQuantity(text) {
  return /^[1-9]\d{0,5}$/.test(String(text).trim()) ? Number(String(text).trim()) : null
}
```
 
## `src/features/inventory/services/restockService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. A restock item is a product at or below its reorder level:
//   { productCode, name, unit, category, categoryLabel, thumbnail, bin, stock, lowStockThreshold,
//     level: 'low' | 'out', suggestedQuantity, requestedQuantity }
// `suggestedQuantity` is the backend's reorder recommendation; the browser never works it out.
 
/**
 * GET restock items (q: code or name · category: slug · level: low | out · sort: 'field' | '-field' · page · pageSize) →
 *   { items, page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount, counts: { all, low, out } }
 * Without `sort` the backend lists out-of-stock products first, then the emptiest shelves.
 * `counts` ignore the `level` filter so the summary cards stay stable.
 */
export async function listRestockItems(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.restock.list, { params })
  return data
}
 
/**
 * POST a restock request for one or more products: { items: [{ productCode, quantity }] } →
 *   { id, status: 'requested', requestedAt, items }
 * ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: restock is raised as a request that the purchasing team (outside this
 * app) turns into a supplier order. Listed items then carry `requestedQuantity` until the stock arrives.
 */
export async function createRestockRequest(items) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.admin.restock.requests, { items })
  return data
}
```

## `src/features/orders/components/OrderCard/OrderCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Thumbnail from '@/components/atoms/Thumbnail'
import OrderStatusBadge from '@/features/orders/components/OrderStatusBadge'
import { getCustomerOrderStatus } from '@/features/orders/constants/orderStatus'
import { getItemsLine, getOrderNote } from '@/features/orders/utils/orderCopy'
import { formatDate } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './OrderCard.module.scss'
 
const MAX_THUMBNAILS = 4
 
/**
 * One order in the history list: number, date and gross total, status, the items in it, a one-line status
 * note and the actions (track / view details, reorder; the invoice link sits in the header beside the status). Every figure is shown as the backend sent it.
 */
export default function OrderCard({ order, onReorder, onDownloadInvoice, invoiceLoading = false }) {
  const visibleItems = order.items.slice(0, MAX_THUMBNAILS)
  const hiddenCount = order.items.length - visibleItems.length
  const note = getOrderNote(order)
  const isShipped = getCustomerOrderStatus(order.status).stage === 'shipped'
 
  return (
    <article className={styles.card} aria-label={`Order ${order.orderNumber}`}>
      <header className={styles.header}>
        <h2 className={styles.number}>Order #{order.orderNumber}</h2>
        <p className={styles.meta}>
          Placed {formatDate(order.placedAt)} · Gross total {formatINR(order.grossAmount, { decimals: 2 })}
        </p>
        {order.hasInvoice && (
          <Button variant="link" size="sm" leftIcon="download" loading={invoiceLoading} className={styles.invoice} onClick={() => onDownloadInvoice(order.orderNumber)}>
            Download invoice
          </Button>
        )}
        <OrderStatusBadge status={order.status} className={styles.status} />
      </header>
 
      <div className={styles.body}>
        <ul className={styles.thumbnails} aria-label="Items in this order">
          {visibleItems.map((item) => (
            <li key={item.productCode}>
              <Thumbnail src={item.image} alt={item.name} size={82} />
            </li>
          ))}
          {hiddenCount > 0 && (
            <li className={styles.more} aria-label={`${hiddenCount} more items`}>
              +{hiddenCount}
            </li>
          )}
        </ul>
 
        <div className={styles.summary}>
          <p className={styles.items}>{getItemsLine(order)}</p>
          <p className={clsx(styles.note, styles[note.tone])}>{note.text}</p>
        </div>
 
        <div className={styles.actions}>
          <Button as={Link} to={paths.order(order.orderNumber)} size="sm" rightIcon="arrow-right">
            {isShipped ? 'Track order' : 'View details'}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => onReorder(order)}>
            Reorder
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  )
}
```

@use '@/styles/mixins' as m;
 
.card {
  border: 1px solid var(--sh-color-border);
  border-radius: var(--sh-radius-lg);
  background: var(--sh-color-white);
}
 
.header {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  grid-template-areas:
    'number status'
    'meta meta'
    'invoice invoice';
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem 1rem;
  margin: 0 1rem;
  padding: 1rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sh-color-border);
 
  @include m.up('md') {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto;
    grid-template-areas:
      'number invoice status'
      'meta meta meta';
    gap: 0.25rem 1.25rem;
    margin: 0 1.5rem;
    padding: 1.5rem 0 0.875rem;
  }
}
 
.number {
  grid-area: number;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--sh-color-navy);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-md);
  font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-medium);
 
  @include m.up('md') {
    font-size: var(--sh-font-size-lg);
  }
}
 
.meta {
  grid-area: meta;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-sm);
}
 
.invoice {
  grid-area: invoice;
  justify-self: start;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
 
  @include m.up('md') {
    justify-self: end;
    margin-top: 0;
  }
}
 
.status {
  grid-area: status;
  justify-self: end;
}
 
.body {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem;
 
  @include m.up('md') {
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    padding: 0.875rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;
  }
}
 
.thumbnails {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.625rem;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
 
// Block-level items so the inline-flex thumbnails leave no line-height gap under them.
.thumbnails > li {
  display: flex;
}
 
.more {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 3rem;
  height: 3rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--sh-color-surface);
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-sm);
  font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-semibold);
}
 
.summary {
  min-width: 0;
}
 
.items {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--sh-color-ink);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-base);
}
 
.note {
  margin: 0.625rem 0 0;
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-sm);
}
 
.success {
  color: var(--sh-color-success);
}
 
.danger {
  color: var(--sh-color-danger);
}
 
.muted {
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
}
 
// Buttons stack and share the left edge of the widest one, as in the design; on phones they sit in a row.
.actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.625rem;
 
  @include m.up('md') {
    flex-direction: column;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
}

## `src/features/orders/components/OrderDetail/OrderDetail.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import DeliveryAddressCard from '@/features/orders/components/DeliveryAddressCard'
import OrderHeroCard from '@/features/orders/components/OrderHeroCard'
import ParcelItemsCard from '@/features/orders/components/ParcelItemsCard'
import PaymentSummaryCard from '@/features/orders/components/PaymentSummaryCard'
import ReorderStrip from '@/features/orders/components/ReorderStrip'
import SupportCard from '@/features/orders/components/SupportCard'
import { useReorder } from '@/features/orders/hooks/useReorder'
import { ShipmentTracker } from '@/features/tracking'
import styles from './OrderDetail.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Everything on an order page below its heading: delivery status and tracking, the items, the delivery
 * address, the payment summary and reorder. Money and dates are displayed exactly as the backend stored them.
 * On phones the cards read as a single column (tracking, items, address, payment, reorder, help); from `lg`
 * the tracking and help cards form a left column beside the rest.
 */
export default function OrderDetail({ order }) {
  const reorder = useReorder()
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.layout}>
      <OrderHeroCard order={order} />
 
      <div className={styles.side}>
        <Card title="Track your delivery" padding="md" className={styles.track}>
          <ShipmentTracker shipment={order.shipment} timeline={order.timeline} />
        </Card>
        <SupportCard orderNumber={order.orderNumber} className={styles.support} />
      </div>
 
      <div className={styles.main}>
        <ParcelItemsCard lines={order.lines} className={styles.parcel} />
        <div className={styles.pair}>
          <DeliveryAddressCard address={order.address} instructions={order.deliveryInstructions} />
          <PaymentSummaryCard order={order} />
        </div>
        <ReorderStrip className={styles.reorder} disabled={!order.canReorder} onReorder={() => reorder(order.lines)} />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```
 
## `src/features/orders/components/OrderDetail/OrderDetail.module.scss`
```scss
@use '@/styles/mixins' as m;
 
// Phones: one column in reading order. The two column wrappers dissolve so each card can take its own position.
.layout {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.25rem;
}
 
.side,
.main {
  display: contents;
}
 
.track {
  order: 1;
}
 
.parcel {
  order: 2;
}
 
.pair {
  order: 3;
  display: grid;
  gap: 1.25rem;
}
 
.reorder {
  order: 4;
}
 
.support {
  order: 5;
}
 
@include m.up('lg') {
  .layout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr);
    align-items: start;
    gap: 1.875rem;
 
    > :first-child {

## `src/features/orders/components/OrderHistory/OrderHistory.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Link, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import { PaginationBar } from '@/components/molecules/Pagination'
import SearchField from '@/components/molecules/SearchField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import OrderCard from '@/features/orders/components/OrderCard'
import { DEFAULT_ORDER_FILTERS, ORDER_PERIOD_OPTIONS, ORDER_STATUS_OPTIONS, ORDERS_PAGE_SIZE } from '@/features/orders/constants/orderFilters'
import { useInvoiceDownload } from '@/features/orders/hooks/useInvoiceDownload'
import { useOrders } from '@/features/orders/hooks/useOrders'
import { useReorder } from '@/features/orders/hooks/useReorder'
import { useDebouncedValue } from '@/hooks/useDebouncedValue'
import styles from './OrderHistory.module.scss'
 
const URL_DEFAULTS = { ...DEFAULT_ORDER_FILTERS, page: 1 }
const isOption = (options, value) => options.some((option) => option.value === value)
 
function OrderCardSkeleton() {
  return (
    <Card padding="lg" aria-hidden="true">
      <Skeleton width="11rem" height="1.25rem" />
      <Skeleton width="16rem" height="0.875rem" className={styles.skeletonLine} />
      <div className={styles.skeletonBody}>
        <Skeleton width="5.125rem" height="5.125rem" radius="0.75rem" />
        <Skeleton width="5.125rem" height="5.125rem" radius="0.75rem" />
        <Skeleton width="min(22rem, 40%)" height="1rem" />
      </div>
    </Card>
  )
}
 
/**
 * My orders: search, status and date filters, the paged list of order cards, and its loading, empty and error
 * states. Status, period and page live in the URL so the browser Back button returns to the same view; the
 * search text is local and debounced. Filtering, searching and paging are done by the backend.
 */
export default function OrderHistory() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams()
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
  const query = useDebouncedValue(search.trim())
 
  const status = isOption(ORDER_STATUS_OPTIONS, searchParams.get('status')) ? searchParams.get('status') : URL_DEFAULTS.status
  const period = isOption(ORDER_PERIOD_OPTIONS, searchParams.get('period')) ? searchParams.get('period') : URL_DEFAULTS.period
  const page = Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(searchParams.get('page'), 10) || URL_DEFAULTS.page)
 
  const orders = useOrders({ page, pageSize: ORDERS_PAGE_SIZE, status, period, q: query })
  const reorder = useReorder()
  const invoice = useInvoiceDownload()
 
  const updateUrl = (changes) =>
    setSearchParams(
      (current) => {
        const next = new URLSearchParams(current)
        Object.entries(changes).forEach(([key, value]) => (value === URL_DEFAULTS[key] ? next.delete(key) : next.set(key, value)))
        return next
      },
      { replace: true },
    )
 
  const changeFilter = (key) => (value) => updateUrl({ [key]: value, page: 1 })
  const changeSearch = (value) => {
    setSearch(value)
    updateUrl({ page: 1 })
  }
  const showEverything = () => {
    setSearch('')
    setSearchParams({ period: 'all' }, { replace: true })
  }
 
  const isFiltered = query !== '' || status !== URL_DEFAULTS.status || period !== URL_DEFAULTS.period
  const items = orders.data?.items ?? []
 
  let content
  if (orders.isPending) {
    content = (
      <div className={styles.list} aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading your orders">
        {[0, 1, 2].map((key) => (
          <OrderCardSkeleton key={key} />
        ))}
      </div>
    )
  } else if (orders.isError) {
    content = <ErrorState title="We couldn’t load your orders" message={getErrorMessage(orders.error)} onRetry={orders.refetch} />
  } else if (items.length === 0) {
    content = isFiltered ? (
      <EmptyState
        icon="search"
        title="No orders found"
        description="Try a different search, or widen the date range to see older orders."
        action={<Button variant="secondary" onClick={showEverything}>Show all orders</Button>}
      />
    ) : (
      <EmptyState
        icon="bag"
        title="No orders yet"
        description="When you place an order, you’ll be able to track it and reorder your favourites here."
        action={<Button as={Link} to={paths.shop}>Start shopping</Button>}
      />
    )
  } else {
    content = (
      <>
        <ul className={styles.list} aria-label="Your orders">
          {items.map((order) => (
            <li key={order.orderNumber}>
              <OrderCard
                order={order}
                onReorder={(entry) => reorder(entry.items)}
                onDownloadInvoice={invoice.mutate}
                invoiceLoading={invoice.isPending && invoice.variables === order.orderNumber}
              />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <PaginationBar
          className={styles.pagination}
          page={orders.data.page}
          pageSize={orders.data.pageSize}
          totalItems={orders.data.totalItems}
          onPageChange={(next) => updateUrl({ page: next })}
          itemLabel="orders"
        />
      </>
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.history}>
      <div className={styles.toolbar}>
        <SearchField
          className={styles.search}
          size="sm"
          value={search}
          onChange={changeSearch}
          placeholder="Search your orders"
          aria-label="Search your orders by order number or product"
        />
        <SelectField
          size="sm"
          prefixLabel="Status:"
          aria-label="Filter orders by status"
          options={ORDER_STATUS_OPTIONS}
          value={status}
          onChange={changeFilter('status')}
        />
        <SelectField
          size="sm"
          prefixLabel="Date:"
          aria-label="Filter orders by date"
          options={ORDER_PERIOD_OPTIONS}
          value={period}
          onChange={changeFilter('period')}
        />
      </div>
      {content}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/orders/components/PaymentSummaryCard/PaymentSummaryCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import SummaryRows from '@/components/molecules/SummaryRows'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './PaymentSummaryCard.module.scss'
 
const money = (value) => formatINR(value, { decimals: 2 })
 
/** Label of the closing row, by payment state: "Paid via UPI". */
function paidLabel(order) {
  if (order.paymentStatus === 'paid') return `Paid via ${order.paymentMethod}`
  if (order.paymentStatus === 'refunded') return 'Refunded'
  if (order.paymentStatus === 'failed') return 'Payment failed'
  return 'Payment pending'
}
 
/**
 * "Payment summary". Every figure is the amount stored with the order by the backend, shown without any
 * arithmetic on this side; coupon and wallet rows appear only when they were used.
 */
export default function PaymentSummaryCard({ order }) {
  const { summary } = order
  const rows = [
    { label: 'Taxable subtotal', value: money(summary.taxableSubtotal) },
    { label: 'GST', value: money(summary.gstTotal) },
    { label: 'Shipping', value: money(summary.shipping) },
    { label: 'Gross amount', value: money(summary.grossAmount) },
    summary.couponDiscount > 0 && { label: 'Coupon', value: money(summary.couponDiscount) },
    summary.walletApplied > 0 && { label: 'Wallet', value: money(summary.walletApplied) },
    { label: paidLabel(order), value: money(summary.payable), emphasis: true },
  ].filter(Boolean)
 
  return (
    <Card title="Payment summary" padding="md">
      <SummaryRows rows={rows} />
      {(order.razorpayPaymentId || order.invoiceNumber) && (
        <p className={styles.references}>
          {order.razorpayPaymentId && <span>Razorpay · {order.razorpayPaymentId}</span>}
          {order.invoiceNumber && <span>Invoice: {order.invoiceNumber}</span>}
        </p>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/orders/constants/orderFilters.js`
  
```javascript
// Filter vocabulary of the My orders screen. The values are sent to the backend as query parameters.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: `status` is one of the stage keys below and `period` one of the
// period keys; "all" means no filter.
export const ORDER_STATUS_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'All' },
  { value: 'processing', label: 'Processing' },
  { value: 'shipped', label: 'Shipped' },
  { value: 'delivered', label: 'Delivered' },
  { value: 'returned', label: 'Returned' },
  { value: 'cancelled', label: 'Cancelled' },
]
 
export const ORDER_PERIOD_OPTIONS = [
  { value: '1m', label: 'Last month' },
  { value: '3m', label: 'Last 3 months' },
  { value: '6m', label: 'Last 6 months' },
  { value: 'all', label: 'All time' },
]
 
export const DEFAULT_ORDER_FILTERS = { status: 'all', period: '3m' }
 
// Four orders per page, as in the design ("Showing 1–4 of 12 orders").
export const ORDERS_PAGE_SIZE = 4
```
 
## `src/features/orders/constants/orderStatus.js`
 
```javascript
// Customer-facing wording for the fulfilment statuses the backend returns, and the stage each one belongs to.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: the customer order API returns the same status keys as the admin
// one (new → … → delivered, returned, cancelled) and groups them into the filter stages below.
export const CUSTOMER_ORDER_STATUS = {
  new: { label: 'Order placed', tone: 'info', stage: 'processing' },
  to_pick: { label: 'Processing', tone: 'warning', stage: 'processing' },
  to_pack: { label: 'Processing', tone: 'warning', stage: 'processing' },
  packed: { label: 'Packed', tone: 'info', stage: 'processing' },
  dispatched: { label: 'Dispatched', tone: 'info', stage: 'shipped' },
  in_transit: { label: 'In Transit', tone: 'info', stage: 'shipped' },
  out_for_delivery: { label: 'Out for delivery', tone: 'info', stage: 'shipped' },
  delivered: { label: 'Delivered', tone: 'success', stage: 'delivered' },
  returned: { label: 'Returned', tone: 'danger', stage: 'returned' },
  cancelled: { label: 'Cancelled', tone: 'neutral', stage: 'cancelled' },
}
 
const FALLBACK_STATUS = { label: 'Processing', tone: 'neutral', stage: 'processing' }
 
export const getCustomerOrderStatus = (status) => CUSTOMER_ORDER_STATUS[status] ?? FALLBACK_STATUS
```
 
## `src/features/orders/hooks/useInvoiceDownload.js`
 
```javascript
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { downloadInvoice } from '@/features/orders/services/documentService'
 
/** Downloads an order's invoice. `variables` holds the order number being fetched, for per-order busy states. */
export function useInvoiceDownload() {
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: downloadInvoice,
    onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error, 'We could not download the invoice. Please try again.')),
  })
}
```
 
## `src/features/orders/hooks/useOrders.js`
 
```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { getOrder, listOrders } from '@/features/orders/services/orderService'
 
export const orderKeys = {
  all: ['orders'],
  list: (filters) => ['orders', 'list', filters],
  detail: (orderNumber) => ['orders', 'detail', orderNumber],
}
 
/** One page of the signed-in customer's orders. The previous page stays visible while the next one loads. */
export function useOrders(filters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: orderKeys.list(filters),
    queryFn: () => listOrders(filters),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    // An order placed since the list was last shown must appear, so the list is always refreshed on entry.
    refetchOnMount: 'always',
  })
}
 
export function useOrder(orderNumber) {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: orderKeys.detail(orderNumber), queryFn: () => getOrder(orderNumber) })
}
```
 
## `src/features/orders/hooks/useReorder.js`
 
```javascript
import { useCallback } from 'react'
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { itemAdded } from '@/app/store'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
 
/**
 * Puts the lines of a past order back into the cart and opens it. Pass `[{ productCode, quantity, available? }]`;
 * lines the backend marked unavailable are skipped and the customer is told. Prices are never carried over:
 * the cart asks the backend for a fresh quote.
 */
export function useReorder() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
 
  return useCallback(
    (lines) => {
      const available = lines.filter((line) => line.available !== false)
      const skipped = lines.length - available.length
 
      if (available.length === 0) {
        toast.error('These items are not available right now.')
        return
      }
      available.forEach(({ productCode, quantity }) => dispatch(itemAdded({ productCode, quantity })))
      const units = available.reduce((total, line) => total + line.quantity, 0)
      toast.success(
        skipped > 0
          ? `${pluralize(units, 'item')} added to your cart. ${pluralize(skipped, 'product')} could not be added because it is unavailable.`
          : `${pluralize(units, 'item')} added to your cart.`,
      )
      navigate(paths.cart)
    },
    [dispatch, navigate],
  )
}
```

import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
import { saveBlob } from '@/lib/download'
 
// The file extension follows what the server returns. The real backend is expected to send PDFs
// (ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team); the mock API sends a simple HTML document instead.
const extensionFor = (blob) => (blob.type.includes('pdf') ? 'pdf' : 'html')
 
async function download(url, baseName) {
  const { data } = await http.get(url, { responseType: 'blob' })
  saveBlob(data, `${baseName}.${extensionFor(data)}`)
}
 
/** Downloads the tax invoice for an order the signed-in user may see. */
export const downloadInvoice = (orderNumber) => download(endpoints.documents.invoice(orderNumber), `Invoice-${orderNumber}`)
 
/** Downloads the shipping label for an order (admin store operation). */
export const downloadShippingLabel = (orderNumber) => download(endpoints.documents.label(orderNumber), `Label-${orderNumber}`)
```
 
## `src/features/orders/services/orderService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. The order list returns lightweight summaries:
//   { items: [{ orderNumber, placedAt, status, grossAmount, units, items: [{ productCode, name, shortName?, quantity, image }],
//                estimatedDelivery, carrier, deliveredAt, refund, hasInvoice, canReorder }],
//     page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount }
// and the detail returns the full order the customer may see:
//   { orderNumber, placedAt, status, paymentStatus, paymentMethod, razorpayPaymentId, invoiceNumber, estimatedDelivery,
//     deliveredAt, lines: [{ productCode, slug, name, unit, quantity, lineTotal, image, available }], summary, address,
//     deliveryInstructions, shipment: { carrier, service, consignmentId, trackingUrl, lastUpdate } | null,
//     timeline: [{ key, title, at, note, state }], refund, canReorder }
// `summary` holds the figures stored with the order (taxableSubtotal, gstTotal, shipping, grossAmount, couponDiscount,
// walletApplied, payable); the screens display them exactly as received. A customer asking for someone else's order gets 404.
 
export async function listOrders({ page, pageSize, status, period, q }) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.orders.list, {
    params: { page, pageSize, status: status === 'all' ? undefined : status, period, q: q || undefined },
  })
  return data
}
 
export async function getOrder(orderNumber) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.orders.detail(orderNumber))
  return data
}
```
 
## `src/features/orders/utils/orderCopy.js`
 
```javascript
import { formatINR, pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import { formatDate, formatLongDate, formatShortDate, formatShortDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { getCustomerOrderStatus } from '@/features/orders/constants/orderStatus'
 
// Wording that depends on how far an order has got. Everything shown is taken from the order the backend
// returned; nothing here decides what an order costs or when it arrives.
 
const HEADLINES = {
  processing: 'We’re getting your order ready.',
  shipped: 'Your everyday goodness is on its way.',
  delivered: 'Your everyday goodness has arrived.',
  returned: 'Your return is complete.',
  cancelled: 'This order was cancelled.',
}
 
export function getOrderHeadline(status) {
  if (status === 'out_for_delivery') return 'Your everyday goodness is out for delivery.'
  return HEADLINES[getCustomerOrderStatus(status).stage] ?? HEADLINES.processing
}
 
const refundDestination = (refund) => (refund.to === 'wallet' ? 'wallet' : 'your original payment method')
 
/** The one-line status note on an order card: { text, tone: 'success' | 'danger' | 'muted' }. */
export function getOrderNote(order) {
  const { stage } = getCustomerOrderStatus(order.status)
 
  if (stage === 'shipped') {
    return { text: [`Expected ${formatShortDate(order.estimatedDelivery)}`, order.carrier].filter(Boolean).join(' · '), tone: 'success' }
  }
  if (stage === 'delivered') return { text: 'Delivered with care · Thank you for shopping with us', tone: 'success' }
  if (stage === 'returned' || stage === 'cancelled') {
    const refund = order.refund
    if (refund) return { text: `Refunded ${formatINR(refund.amount)} to ${refundDestination(refund)} · ${formatShortDate(refund.at)}`, tone: 'danger' }
    return { text: stage === 'returned' ? 'Return received' : 'Cancelled', tone: 'muted' }
  }
  return { text: `Preparing your order · Expected ${formatShortDate(order.estimatedDelivery)}`, tone: 'muted' }
}
 
/** The one-line item summary on an order card: "4 units · Haldi ×2, Shampoo ×1, Aloe Face Wash ×1". */
export function getItemsLine(order) {
  const names = order.items.map((item) => `${item.shortName ?? item.name} ×${item.quantity}`).join(', ')
  return `${pluralize(order.units, 'unit')} · ${names}`
}
 
/** The tinted card at the top of an order: { eyebrow, title, detail }. */
export function getOrderHero(order) {
  const { stage } = getCustomerOrderStatus(order.status)
  const update = order.shipment?.lastUpdate
 
  if (stage === 'delivered') {
    return { eyebrow: 'Delivered', title: formatLongDate(order.deliveredAt), detail: 'Delivered with care. Thank you for shopping with Shipper.' }
  }
  if (stage === 'returned' || stage === 'cancelled') {
    const refund = order.refund
    return {
      eyebrow: stage === 'returned' ? 'Returned' : 'Cancelled',
      title: stage === 'returned' ? 'This order was returned' : 'This order was cancelled',
      detail: refund
        ? `Refunded ${formatINR(refund.amount, { decimals: 2 })} to ${refundDestination(refund)} on ${formatDate(refund.at)}.`
        : stage === 'returned'
          ? 'Your return has been received.'
          : 'This order will not be shipped.',
    }
  }
  if (stage === 'shipped') {
    return {
      eyebrow: 'Estimated delivery',
      title: formatLongDate(order.estimatedDelivery),
      detail: update ? `Last update: ${formatShortDateTime(update.at)} · ${update.note}` : 'Your parcel has been handed to the carrier.',
    }
  }
  return {
    eyebrow: 'Estimated delivery',
    title: formatLongDate(order.estimatedDelivery),
    detail: 'We’ll share tracking details as soon as your order is dispatched.',
  }
}
```

import { Link, NavLink } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { POLICY_PAGES, STOREFRONT } from '@/app/config/storefront'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import styles from './PolicyAside.module.scss'
 
/** Beside a policy: the other policies and how to reach support (the details shown in the footer). */
export default function PolicyAside() {
  return (
    <aside className={styles.aside} aria-label="More help">
      <nav aria-label="Policies" className={styles.policies}>
        <h2 className={styles.heading}>Our policies</h2>
        <ul>
          {POLICY_PAGES.map((page) => (
            <li key={page.slug}>
              <NavLink to={paths.policy(page.slug)} className={({ isActive }) => clsx(styles.link, isActive && styles.active)}>
                {page.label}
              </NavLink>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </nav>
 
      <Card title="Here to help" padding="md" titleAs="h2">
        <p className={styles.contact}>
          Questions about an order, a delivery or a refund? <a href={`mailto:${STOREFRONT.supportEmail}`}>{STOREFRONT.supportEmail}</a> or call{' '}
          <span className={styles.phone}>{STOREFRONT.supportPhone}</span>.
        </p>
        <Link to={paths.track} className={styles.trackLink}>
          Track a shipment
        </Link>
      </Card>
    </aside>
  )
}

import styles from './PolicyDocument.module.scss'
 
/** A policy as readable text: numbered sections of paragraphs and bullet points. */
export default function PolicyDocument({ policy }) {
  return (
    <article className={styles.document}>
      {policy.sections.map((section, index) => (
        <section key={section.heading} className={styles.section} aria-labelledby={`policy-section-${index}`}>
          <h2 id={`policy-section-${index}`} className={styles.heading}>
            {section.heading}
          </h2>
          {section.paragraphs?.map((paragraph) => (
            <p key={paragraph} className={styles.paragraph}>
              {paragraph}
            </p>
          ))}
          {section.points && (
            <ul className={styles.points}>
              {section.points.map((point) => (
                <li key={point}>{point}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </section>
      ))}
    </article>
  )
}
```

// ASSUMPTION — confirm with the business: placeholder policy text.
// The wording below is plausible filler so the screens can be reviewed. Legal copy for shipping, returns and
// refunds, privacy and terms must be written or approved by the business (and, for privacy and terms, by counsel)
// before launch. Time windows mentioned here (for example "7 days") are placeholders, not agreed rules.
//
// The slugs match the footer links in app/config/storefront.js (POLICY_PAGES). Every body is
// { heading, paragraphs?: string[], points?: string[] } so the page only has to render a list of sections.
export const POLICIES = {
  shipping: {
    title: 'Shipping policy',
    summary: 'Where we deliver, how long it takes and what you can expect once your order is on its way.',
    sections: [
      {
        heading: 'Where we deliver',
        paragraphs: [

        ],

      {
        heading: 'Delivery times',
        paragraphs: [
          'Most orders are packed within one to two working days of payment. Once dispatched, delivery usually takes a few working days depending on where you live.',

        ],
      },
      {
        heading: 'Shipping charges',

        ],
      },
      {
        heading: 'Tracking your order',
        paragraphs: [
          'When your order is dispatched we give you an India Post consignment ID. Follow your parcel from My orders, or use Track shipment with your order number and mobile number.',
        ],
      },
      {
        heading: 'Delays and failed deliveries',
        points: [
          'If your parcel is later than the estimate, contact us and we will follow it up with the carrier.',
          'Please keep your address and mobile number up to date. A parcel that cannot be delivered is returned to us, and we will refund your order.',
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
 
  returns: {
    title: 'Returns & refunds',
    summary: 'What you can return, how to ask for a refund and how long it takes.',

        heading: 'Return window',
        paragraphs: [
          'Tell us within 7 days of delivery if something arrives damaged, leaking, past its date or different from what you ordered, and we will make it right.',

      {
        heading: 'What can be returned',
        points: [
          'Products that arrive damaged, defective or incorrect.',

        ],
      },
      {
        heading: 'How to start a return',

      {
        heading: 'How refunds are paid',

      },
      {
        heading: 'Cancelling an order',
        paragraphs: [
          'You can ask us to cancel an order until it has been packed. After it has been dispatched an order cannot be cancelled, but you can return it once it is delivered.',
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
 
  privacy: {
    title: 'Privacy policy',
    summary: 'What we collect, why we collect it and the choices you have.',
    sections: [
      {
        heading: 'What we collect',
        points: [
          'Account details: your name, mobile number and email address.',
          'Delivery details: the addresses you save and the delivery instructions you give.',
          'Order details: what you buy, when, and how you pay. Payments are processed by Razorpay; we do not store your card or UPI details.',
          'Basic usage data that helps us keep the site fast and secure.',
        ],
      },
      {
        heading: 'How we use it',
        paragraphs: [
          'We use your information to process and deliver your orders, send order and delivery updates, give you support, prevent fraud and improve the store. We only send marketing messages if you have agreed to them.',
        ],
      },
      {
        heading: 'Who we share it with',
        paragraphs: [
          'We share what is needed to fulfil your order with our delivery partner, India Post, and with our payment provider. We do not sell your personal information.',
        ],
      },
      {
        heading: 'Your choices',
        paragraphs: [
          'You can view and update your details, addresses and password from your account at any time. To ask for a copy of your data or to have your account deleted, contact our support team.',
        ],
      },
      {
        heading: 'Keeping your data safe',
        paragraphs: [
          'We protect your information with technical and organisational safeguards and keep it only for as long as we need it for your orders, accounting and legal obligations.',
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
 
  terms: {
    title: 'Terms of service',
    summary: 'The ground rules for using Shipper.com and placing orders.',
    sections: [
      {
        heading: 'Using Shipper.com',
        paragraphs: [
          'By browsing or ordering on Shipper.com you agree to these terms. Please use the store lawfully and only for your own purchases.',
        ],
      },
      {
        heading: 'Your account',
        paragraphs: [
          'You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for what happens under your account. Tell us straight away if you think someone else has used it.',
        ],
      },
      {
        heading: 'Orders and prices',
        paragraphs: [
          'Prices are shown in Indian rupees and include GST. An order is confirmed when payment succeeds. If a product is unavailable or a price was shown in error, we may cancel the order and refund you in full.',
        ],
      },
      {
        heading: 'Payments',
        paragraphs: [
          'Payments are handled securely by Razorpay. If a payment fails or is declined, your order is not confirmed and no amount is kept.',
        ],
      },
      {
        heading: 'Wallet and coupons',
        paragraphs: [
          'Your Shipper wallet balance can be used towards eligible orders as shown at checkout. It has no cash value, cannot be transferred and may not be combined with every offer. Coupons are subject to the conditions shown with them.',
        ],
      },
      {
        heading: 'Liability and changes',
        paragraphs: [
          'We take care to describe products accurately, but we are not liable for losses beyond the value of your order, except where the law says otherwise. We may update these terms from time to time; the version on this page is the one that applies.',
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
}
 
/** The policy for a URL slug, or null for an unknown one. */
export const getPolicy = (slug) => (Object.hasOwn(POLICIES, slug) ? POLICIES[slug] : null)
```

## `src/features/products/components/BulkUpdateModal/BulkUpdateModal.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useId } from 'react'
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { Controller, useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Radio from '@/components/atoms/Radio'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import Modal from '@/components/organisms/Modal'
import { useBulkUpdateProducts, useProductOptions } from '@/features/products/hooks/useProducts'
import { bulkUpdateSchema } from '@/features/products/schemas/bulkUpdateSchema'
import { applyServerErrors } from '@/features/products/utils/applyServerErrors'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './BulkUpdateModal.module.scss'
 
const STATUS_OPTIONS = [
  { value: '', label: 'No change' },
  { value: 'active', label: 'Set to Active' },
  { value: 'inactive', label: 'Set to Inactive' },
]
 
/**
 * Applies one change to many products at once: their status (show or hide on the storefront) and/or
 * their GST rate. The change targets either the ticked rows or every product matching the current
 * filters; the backend applies it. Mount it only while open.
 */
export default function BulkUpdateModal({ selectedCodes, matchingCount, filters, onClose, onUpdated }) {
  const formId = useId()
  const { data: options } = useProductOptions()
  const update = useBulkUpdateProducts()
  const hasSelection = selectedCodes.length > 0
 
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(bulkUpdateSchema),
    defaultValues: { scope: hasSelection ? 'selected' : 'filtered', status: '', gstPercent: '' },
  })
 
  const [scope, status, gstPercent] = useWatch({ control, name: ['scope', 'status', 'gstPercent'] })
  const targetCount = scope === 'selected' ? selectedCodes.length : matchingCount
 
  const gstOptions = [{ value: '', label: 'No change' }, ...(options?.gstRates ?? []).map((rate) => ({ value: rate, label: `${rate}%` }))]
 
  const changeSummary = [
    status && `status to ${status === 'active' ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}`,
    gstPercent !== '' && `GST rate to ${gstPercent}%`,
  ].filter(Boolean)
 
  const onSubmit = (values) => {
    const changes = {}
    if (values.status) changes.status = values.status
    if (values.gstPercent !== '') changes.gstPercent = values.gstPercent
    update.mutate(
      { scope: values.scope === 'selected' ? { codes: selectedCodes } : { filters }, changes },
      {
        onSuccess: ({ updated }) => {
          toast.success(`${pluralize(updated, 'product')} updated.`)
          onUpdated()
          onClose()
        },
        onError: (error) => {
          if (!applyServerErrors(error, setError)) toast.error(getErrorMessage(error))
        },
      },
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <Modal
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      size="md"
      title="Bulk update"
      description="Change the status or GST rate of several products at once."
      closeOnBackdrop={!update.isPending}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" disabled={update.isPending} onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" form={formId} loading={update.isPending} disabled={targetCount === 0}>
            Apply to {pluralize(targetCount, 'product')}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form id={formId} noValidate onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className={styles.form}>
        <fieldset className={styles.scope}>
          <legend className={styles.legend}>Products to update</legend>
          {hasSelection && <Radio {...register('scope')} value="selected" label={`The ${pluralize(selectedCodes.length, 'selected product')}`} />}
          <Radio
            {...register('scope')}
            value="filtered"
            label={`All ${pluralize(matchingCount, 'product')} matching the current filters`}
          />
        </fieldset>
 
        <FormField label="Status" error={errors.status?.message}>
          {(field) => (
            <Controller
              name="status"
              control={control}
              render={({ field: { value, onChange } }) => (
                <SelectField id={field.id} invalid={field.invalid} options={STATUS_OPTIONS} value={value} onChange={onChange} />
              )}
            />
          )}
        </FormField>
 
        <FormField label="GST rate" hint="Prices stay GST-inclusive; only the tax portion changes.">
          {(field) => (
            <Controller
              name="gstPercent"
              control={control}
              render={({ field: { value, onChange } }) => <SelectField id={field.id} options={gstOptions} value={value} onChange={onChange} />}
            />
          )}
        </FormField>
 
        {changeSummary.length > 0 && (
          <p className={styles.summary}>
            This will set {changeSummary.join(' and ')} for {pluralize(targetCount, 'product')}.
          </p>
        )}
      </form>
    </Modal>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/products/components/ImportProductsModal/ImportProductsModal.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import Modal from '@/components/organisms/Modal'
import { useImportProducts } from '@/features/products/hooks/useProducts'
import { findMissingColumns, parseImportRows, PRODUCT_SHEET_COLUMNS, TEMPLATE_ROW } from '@/features/products/utils/productSheet'
import { exportToExcel, readExcelRows } from '@/lib/excel'
import { formatINR, pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './ImportProductsModal.module.scss'
 
const MAX_PREVIEW_ROWS = 50
 
const PREVIEW_COLUMNS = [
  { key: 'rowNumber', header: 'Row', width: '3.5rem' },
  { key: 'code', header: 'Code', cell: ({ values }) => values.code },
  { key: 'name', header: 'Product name', cell: ({ values }) => values.name },
  { key: 'category', header: 'Category', cell: ({ values }) => values.category },
  { key: 'stock', header: 'Stock', cell: ({ values }) => values.stock },
  { key: 'mrp', header: 'MRP', cell: ({ values }) => (typeof values.mrp === 'number' ? formatINR(values.mrp) : values.mrp) },
  {
    key: 'check',
    header: 'Check',
    cell: ({ errors }) =>
      errors.length === 0 ? <Badge tone="success">Ready</Badge> : <span className={styles.problem}>{errors.join('. ')}</span>,
  },
]
 
/**
 * Import products from an .xlsx file. The sheet is read in the browser, checked for shape (required
 * columns and values) and previewed; only the rows that pass are sent. The backend validates every row
 * again and reports which it created, updated or rejected. Mount it only while open.
 */
export default function ImportProductsModal({ onClose }) {
  const inputRef = useRef(null)
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState(null)
  const [reading, setReading] = useState(false)
  const [readError, setReadError] = useState(null)
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null)
  const importProducts = useImportProducts()
 
  const readyRows = sheet?.rows.filter((row) => row.errors.length === 0) ?? []
  const problemCount = (sheet?.rows.length ?? 0) - readyRows.length
 
  const handleFile = async (event) => {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0]
    event.target.value = ''
    if (!file) return
    setReadError(null)
    if (!file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.xlsx')) {
      setReadError('Choose an Excel (.xlsx) file.')
      return
    }
    setReading(true)
    try {
      const { headers, rows } = await readExcelRows(file)
      const missing = findMissingColumns(headers)
      if (missing.length > 0) setReadError(`The sheet is missing these columns: ${missing.join(', ')}.`)
      else if (rows.length === 0) setReadError('The sheet has no product rows.')
      else setSheet({ fileName: file.name, rows: parseImportRows(rows) })
    } catch {
      setReadError('This file could not be read. Check that it is a valid .xlsx workbook.')
    } finally {
      setReading(false)
    }
  }
 
  const downloadTemplate = async () => {
    try {
      await exportToExcel({ fileName: 'shipper-products-import-template', sheetName: 'Products', columns: PRODUCT_SHEET_COLUMNS, rows: [TEMPLATE_ROW] })
    } catch {
      toast.error('The template could not be downloaded. Please try again.')
    }
  }
 
  const submit = () => {
    importProducts.mutate(
      readyRows.map(({ rowNumber, values }) => ({ rowNumber, ...values })),
      {
        onSuccess: setResult,
        onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error)),
      },
    )
  }
 
  const footer = result ? (
    <Button onClick={onClose}>Done</Button>
  ) : (
    <>
      {sheet && (
        <Button variant="secondary" className={styles.chooseAnother} disabled={importProducts.isPending} onClick={() => setSheet(null)}>
          Choose another file
        </Button>
      )}
      <Button variant="secondary" disabled={importProducts.isPending} onClick={onClose}>
        Cancel
      </Button>
      <Button loading={importProducts.isPending} disabled={readyRows.length === 0} onClick={submit}>
        Import {pluralize(readyRows.length, 'row')}
      </Button>
    </>
  )
 
  return (
    <Modal
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      size="lg"
      title="Import Excel"
      description="Add or update products from a spreadsheet. Rows with an existing product code update that product."
      closeOnBackdrop={!importProducts.isPending}
      footer={footer}
    >
      {result && (
        <div className={styles.result}>
          <Alert tone={result.rejected.length === 0 ? 'success' : 'warning'} title="Import finished">
            {pluralize(result.created, 'product')} added, {pluralize(result.updated, 'product')} updated
            {result.rejected.length > 0 && `, ${pluralize(result.rejected.length, 'row')} rejected by the server`}.
          </Alert>
          {result.rejected.length > 0 && (
            <ul className={styles.rejected} aria-label="Rejected rows">
              {result.rejected.map((row) => (
                <li key={row.rowNumber}>
                  <strong>Row {row.rowNumber}</strong>
                  {row.code && ` · ${row.code}`}: {row.message}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
 
      {!result && !sheet && (
        <div className={styles.choose}>
          <Icon name="file-earmark-spreadsheet" className={styles.icon} />
          <p className={styles.lead}>Choose an .xlsx file with one product per row.</p>
          <p className={styles.help}>
            Use the template for the expected columns. Format the HSN and Code columns as text to keep leading zeros. The server checks every row
            again before anything changes.
          </p>
          <div className={styles.actions}>
            <Button leftIcon="upload" loading={reading} onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}>
              Choose file
            </Button>
            <Button variant="secondary" leftIcon="download" onClick={downloadTemplate}>
              Download template
            </Button>
          </div>
          <input ref={inputRef} type="file" accept=".xlsx" className="visually-hidden" tabIndex={-1} aria-hidden="true" onChange={handleFile} />
          {readError && (
            <Alert tone="danger" className={styles.readError}>
              {readError}
            </Alert>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
 
      {!result && sheet && (
        <div className={styles.preview}>
          <p className={styles.fileSummary}>
            <strong>{sheet.fileName}</strong> · {pluralize(readyRows.length, 'row')} ready
            {problemCount > 0 && `, ${pluralize(problemCount, 'row')} with problems (these will be skipped)`}
          </p>
          <DataTable
            caption="Rows found in the spreadsheet"
            columns={PREVIEW_COLUMNS}
            rows={sheet.rows.slice(0, MAX_PREVIEW_ROWS)}
            getRowId={(row) => row.rowNumber}
            maxHeight="18rem"
            minWidth="640px"
          />
          {sheet.rows.length > MAX_PREVIEW_ROWS && (
            <p className={styles.help}>Showing the first {MAX_PREVIEW_ROWS} of {sheet.rows.length} rows.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/products/components/ProductFilterCards/ProductFilterCards.jsx`
 
```jsx
import StatCard from '@/components/molecules/StatCard'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './ProductFilterCards.module.scss'
 
// Each card is a shortcut onto the Stock and Status filters, so the cards and the dropdowns never disagree.
const CARDS = [
  { key: 'all', label: 'All products', changes: { stock: 'all', status: 'all' }, isSelected: ({ stock, status }) => stock === 'all' && status === 'all' },
  { key: 'active', label: 'Active', changes: { stock: 'all', status: 'active' }, isSelected: ({ stock, status }) => stock === 'all' && status === 'active' },
  { key: 'low', label: 'Low stock', changes: { stock: 'low' }, isSelected: ({ stock }) => stock === 'low' },
  { key: 'out', label: 'Out of stock', changes: { stock: 'out' }, isSelected: ({ stock }) => stock === 'out' },
]
 
/** Catalogue-wide counts that double as quick filters. Selecting the active card again shows everything. */
export default function ProductFilterCards({ counts, filters, onChange }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.grid} role="group" aria-label="Quick filters">
      {CARDS.map((card) => {
        const selected = card.isSelected(filters)
        return (
          <StatCard
            key={card.key}
            layout="inline"
            className={styles.card}
            label={card.label}
            value={formatNumber(counts?.[card.key])}
            selected={selected}
            onClick={() => onChange(selected && card.key !== 'all' ? CARDS[0].changes : card.changes)}
          />
        )
      })}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/products/components/ProductFormModal/ProductFormModal.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useId, useState } from 'react'
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { Controller, useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import Modal from '@/components/organisms/Modal'
import { useProductOptions, useSaveProduct } from '@/features/products/hooks/useProducts'
import { emptyProductValues, productSchema, toProductFormValues } from '@/features/products/schemas/productSchema'
import { applyServerErrors } from '@/features/products/utils/applyServerErrors'
import { formatDate } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatPercent, pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import ProductImageField from './ProductImageField'
import styles from './ProductFormModal.module.scss'
 
const STATUS_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'active', label: 'Active' },
  { value: 'inactive', label: 'Inactive' },
]
 
const toOptions = (values, format = String) => values.map((value) => ({ value, label: format(value) }))
 
/**
 * Add Product / Edit Product dialog. Mount it only while open (pass `product` to edit, nothing to add)
 * so the form starts from the right values. Prices are entered as typed; the backend returns the
 * saved product including the discount it calculated.
 */
export default function ProductFormModal({ product = null, onClose }) {
  const formId = useId()
  const isEditing = Boolean(product)
  const [imageFile, setImageFile] = useState(null)
  const { data: options, isPending: optionsPending } = useProductOptions()
  const save = useSaveProduct()
 
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(productSchema),
    defaultValues: product ? toProductFormValues(product) : emptyProductValues,
    mode: 'onTouched',
  })
 
  const errorCount = Object.keys(errors).length
  const status = useWatch({ control, name: 'status' })
 
  // A product's own pack size stays selectable even if it is not in the backend's standard list.
  const unitValues = options ? [...new Set([...(product ? [product.unit] : []), ...options.units])] : []
 
  const onSubmit = (values) => {
    save.mutate(
      { code: product?.code, values, imageFile },
      {
        onSuccess: ({ product: saved, imageError }) => {
          toast.success(`${saved.name} ${isEditing ? 'saved' : 'added'}. Discount on the storefront: ${formatPercent(saved.discountPercent)}.`)
          if (imageError) toast.warning(`The product was saved, but its image was not uploaded: ${getErrorMessage(imageError)}`)
          onClose()
        },
        onError: (error) => {
          if (error.status === 409 && !applyServerErrors(error, setError)) setError('code', { type: 'server', message: error.message })
          else if (!applyServerErrors(error, setError)) toast.error(getErrorMessage(error))
        },
      },
    )
  }
 
  const selectField = (name, label, selectOptions, extra = {}) => (
    <FormField label={label} required error={errors[name]?.message}>
      {(field) => (
        <Controller
          name={name}
          control={control}
          render={({ field: { value, onChange } }) => (
            <SelectField
              id={field.id}
              invalid={field.invalid}
              aria-invalid={field['aria-invalid']}
              options={selectOptions}
              value={value}
              onChange={onChange}
              isLoading={optionsPending}
              placeholder="Select"
              {...extra}
            />
          )}
        />
      )}
    </FormField>
  )
 
  return (
    <Modal
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      size="lg"
      title={isEditing ? 'Edit Product' : 'Add Product'}
      description={
        isEditing
          ? `${product.code} · Last updated ${formatDate(product.updatedAt)} by ${product.updatedBy}`
          : 'Create a catalogue item. Prices include GST.'
      }
      closeOnBackdrop={!save.isPending}
      footer={
        <>
          {errorCount > 0 && (
            <p role="alert" className={styles.summary}>
              {errorCount === 1 ? '1 field needs' : `${errorCount} fields need`} attention before saving.
            </p>
          )}
          <Button variant="secondary" size="lg" disabled={save.isPending} onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" form={formId} size="lg" loading={save.isPending}>
            {isEditing ? 'Save changes' : 'Add product'}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form id={formId} noValidate onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className={styles.layout}>
        <aside className={styles.side}>
          <ProductImageField src={product?.image} alt={product ? `${product.name} photo` : 'Product photo preview'} onChange={setImageFile} />
          <FormField label="Product status">
            {(field) => (
              <Controller
                name="status"
                control={control}
                render={({ field: { value, onChange } }) => (
                  <SelectField id={field.id} options={STATUS_OPTIONS} value={value} onChange={onChange} />
                )}
              />
            )}
          </FormField>
          <Badge tone={status === 'active' ? 'success' : 'neutral'} className={styles.visibility}>
            {status === 'active' ? 'Visible on storefront' : 'Hidden from storefront'}
          </Badge>
        </aside>
 
        <div className={styles.main}>
          <section aria-labelledby={`${formId}-identity`}>
            <h3 id={`${formId}-identity`} className={styles.sectionTitle}>
              Identity &amp; classification
            </h3>
            <div className="row g-3">
              <div className="col-12 col-sm-6">
                <FormField label="Product code" required error={errors.code?.message} hint={isEditing ? 'The code cannot be changed.' : undefined}>
                  {(field) => (
                    <Input
                      {...field}
                      {...register('code')}
                      readOnly={isEditing}
                      variant={isEditing ? 'filled' : 'outline'}
                      autoCapitalize="characters"
                      autoComplete="off"
                    />
                  )}
                </FormField>
              </div>
              <div className="col-12 col-sm-6">{selectField('category', 'Category', options?.categories ?? [], { isSearchable: false })}</div>
              <div className="col-12">
                <FormField label="Product name" required error={errors.name?.message}>
                  {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('name')} autoComplete="off" />}
                </FormField>
              </div>
              <div className="col-12 col-sm-6">
                <FormField label="Batch" required error={errors.batch?.message}>
                  {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('batch')} autoComplete="off" />}
                </FormField>
              </div>
              <div className="col-12 col-sm-6">
                <FormField label="HSN code" required error={errors.hsn?.message}>
                  {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('hsn')} inputMode="numeric" autoComplete="off" />}
                </FormField>
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>
 
          <section aria-labelledby={`${formId}-pricing`}>
            <h3 id={`${formId}-pricing`} className={styles.sectionTitle}>
              Pricing, tax &amp; inventory
            </h3>
            <div className="row g-3">
              <div className="col-12 col-sm-4">
                <FormField label="MRP (₹)" required error={errors.mrp?.message}>
                  {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('mrp')} inputMode="decimal" autoComplete="off" />}
                </FormField>
              </div>
              <div className="col-12 col-sm-4">
                <FormField label="Selling price (₹)" required error={errors.sellingPrice?.message}>
                  {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('sellingPrice')} inputMode="decimal" autoComplete="off" />}
                </FormField>
              </div>
              <div className="col-12 col-sm-4">
                {selectField('gstPercent', 'GST %', toOptions(options?.gstRates ?? [], (rate) => `${rate}%`))}
              </div>
              <div className="col-12 col-sm-4">
                <FormField
                  label="Stock units"
                  required
                  error={errors.stock?.message}
                  hint={isEditing ? `Low-stock alert at ${pluralize(product.lowStockThreshold, 'unit')}.` : undefined}
                >
                  {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('stock')} inputMode="numeric" autoComplete="off" />}
                </FormField>
              </div>
              <div className="col-12 col-sm-4">
                <FormField label="PV" required error={errors.pv?.message}>
                  {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('pv')} inputMode="numeric" autoComplete="off" />}
                </FormField>
              </div>
              <div className="col-12 col-sm-4">{selectField('unit', 'Unit', toOptions(unitValues), { isSearchable: true })}</div>
              <div className="col-12">
                <FormField label="Description" error={errors.description?.message}>
                  {({ invalid, ...field }) => (
                    <textarea {...field} {...register('description')} rows={2} className={styles.textarea} data-invalid={invalid || undefined} />
                  )}
                </FormField>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p className={styles.note}>
              Prices include GST. The discount is calculated automatically when you save
              {isEditing && product.discountPercent > 0 ? ` (currently ${formatPercent(product.discountPercent)}).` : '.'}
            </p>
          </section>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/products/components/ProductFormModal/ProductImageField.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import styles from './ProductImageField.module.scss'
 
const MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024
const ACCEPTED_TYPES = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png']
 
/**
 * Product picture with a "Replace image" button. The chosen file is checked for type and size (the
 * backend checks again), previewed locally and handed to `onChange`; it is uploaded when the form is saved.
 */
export default function ProductImageField({ src, alt, onChange }) {
  const inputRef = useRef(null)
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState(null)
 
  useEffect(() => () => previewUrl && URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl), [previewUrl])
 
  const handleSelect = (event) => {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0]
    event.target.value = ''
    if (!file) return
    if (!ACCEPTED_TYPES.includes(file.type)) {
      setError('Choose a JPG or PNG image.')
      return
    }
    if (file.size > MAX_BYTES) {
      setError('The image must be 5 MB or smaller.')
      return
    }
    setError(null)
    setPreviewUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file))
    onChange(file)
  }
 
  const shownSrc = previewUrl ?? src
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.field}>
      <div className={styles.frame}>
        {shownSrc ? <img src={shownSrc} alt={alt} className={styles.image} /> : <Icon name="image" className={styles.placeholder} />}
      </div>
      <input ref={inputRef} type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png" className="visually-hidden" tabIndex={-1} aria-hidden="true" onChange={handleSelect} />
      <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" className={styles.button} onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}>
        {src || previewUrl ? 'Replace image' : 'Upload image'}
      </Button>
      <p className={styles.hint}>JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB. Recommended 1200 × 1200 px.</p>
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className={styles.error}>
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/products/components/ProductsTableCard/ProductsTableCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import IconButton from '@/components/atoms/IconButton'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import Thumbnail from '@/components/atoms/Thumbnail'
import BulkActionBar from '@/components/molecules/BulkActionBar'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { formatINR, formatPercent } from '@/lib/format'
import { PRODUCT_PAGE_SIZE } from '@/features/products/hooks/useProductFilters'
import styles from './ProductsTableCard.module.scss'
 
/** Badge key for a product: hidden products read Inactive, otherwise the stock level the backend reports. */
function statusKeyOf(product) {
  if (product.status === 'inactive') return 'inactive'
  if (product.stockStatus === 'out_of_stock') return 'out_of_stock'
  return product.stockStatus === 'low_stock' ? 'low_stock' : 'active'
}
 
const toSortState = (sort) => (sort ? { key: sort.replace(/^-/, ''), direction: sort.startsWith('-') ? 'desc' : 'asc' } : null)
const toSortParam = (sort) => (sort ? `${sort.direction === 'desc' ? '-' : ''}${sort.key}` : '')
 
/**
 * The products table with its toolbar: select-all, Bulk update and Import Excel above, sortable
 * columns, edit and delete per row, and paging. Paging, sorting and filtering are done by the backend.
 */
export default function ProductsTableCard({
  query,
  page,
  sort,
  selectedCodes,
  onSelectionChange,
  onSortChange,
  onPageChange,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onBulkUpdate,
  onImport,
  onClearFilters,
}) {
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = query
  const rows = data?.items ?? []
  const pageCodes = rows.map((product) => product.code)
  const selected = new Set(selectedCodes)
  const selectedOnPage = pageCodes.filter((code) => selected.has(code)).length
  const allOnPageSelected = pageCodes.length > 0 && selectedOnPage === pageCodes.length
 
  const toggleAllOnPage = () => {
    const next = new Set(selected)
    pageCodes.forEach((code) => (allOnPageSelected ? next.delete(code) : next.add(code)))
    onSelectionChange([...next])
  }
 
  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'thumbnail',
      header: 'Image',
      cell: (product) => (
        <div className={styles.thumb}>
          <Thumbnail src={product.thumbnail} size="sm" />
        </div>
      ),
    },
    { key: 'code', header: 'Code', sortable: true, cell: (product) => <strong>{product.code}</strong> },
    { key: 'name', header: 'Product name', sortable: true },
    { key: 'batch', header: 'Batch' },
    { key: 'hsn', header: 'HSN' },
    { key: 'gstPercent', header: 'GST%', cell: (product) => formatPercent(product.gstPercent) },
    {
      key: 'stock',
      header: 'Stock',
      sortable: true,
      cell: (product) => <span className={clsx(product.stockStatus !== 'in_stock' && styles.lowStock)}>{product.stock}</span>,
    },
    { key: 'pv', header: 'PV', sortable: true },
    { key: 'mrp', header: 'MRP', sortable: true, cell: (product) => formatINR(product.mrp) },
    { key: 'unit', header: 'Unit' },
    { key: 'status', header: 'Status', cell: (product) => <StatusBadge status={statusKeyOf(product)} /> },
    {
      key: 'edit',
      header: 'Edit',
      cell: (product) => <IconButton icon="pencil" tone="primary" size="sm" label={`Edit ${product.name}`} onClick={() => onEdit(product)} />,
    },
    {
      key: 'delete',
      header: (
        <>
          <span aria-hidden="true">Del.</span>
          <span className="visually-hidden">Delete</span>
        </>
      ),
      cell: (product) => <IconButton icon="trash" tone="danger" size="sm" label={`Delete ${product.name}`} onClick={() => onDelete(product)} />,
    },
  ]
 
  return (
    <Card padding="sm" radius="md" className={styles.card} aria-label="Products">
      <div className={styles.toolbar}>
        <Checkbox
          label="Select all products"
          checked={allOnPageSelected}
          indeterminate={selectedOnPage > 0 && !allOnPageSelected}
          disabled={pageCodes.length === 0}
          onChange={toggleAllOnPage}
        />
        <div className={styles.actions}>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={onBulkUpdate}>
            Bulk update
          </Button>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={onImport}>
            Import Excel
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
 
      <BulkActionBar selectedCount={selectedCodes.length} itemLabel="product" onClear={() => onSelectionChange([])} />
 
      {isError && !data ? (
        <ErrorState title="Products could not be loaded" message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} compact />
      ) : (
        <DataTable
          className={styles.table}
          caption="Products"
          columns={columns}
          rows={rows}
          loading={isPending}
          loadingRows={PRODUCT_PAGE_SIZE}
          getRowId={(product) => product.code}
          getRowLabel={(product) => product.name}
          selectable
          selectedIds={selectedCodes}
          onSelectionChange={onSelectionChange}
          sort={toSortState(sort)}
          onSortChange={(next) => onSortChange(toSortParam(next))}
          minWidth="980px"
          emptyState={
            <EmptyState
              compact
              icon="search"
              title="No products match these filters"
              description="Try a different search or clear the filters."
              action={
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={onClearFilters}>
                  Clear filters
                </Button>
              }
            />
          }
          pagination={{ page, pageSize: PRODUCT_PAGE_SIZE, totalItems: data?.totalItems ?? 0, onPageChange, itemLabel: 'products' }}
        />
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}
```
