## `src/features/products/components/ProductsWorkspace/ProductsWorkspace.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import ConfirmDialog from '@/components/organisms/ConfirmDialog'
import { useDebouncedValue } from '@/hooks/useDebouncedValue'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import BulkUpdateModal from '@/features/products/components/BulkUpdateModal'
import ImportProductsModal from '@/features/products/components/ImportProductsModal'
import ProductFilterCards from '@/features/products/components/ProductFilterCards'
import ProductFormModal from '@/features/products/components/ProductFormModal'
import ProductsTableCard from '@/features/products/components/ProductsTableCard'
import ProductToolbar from '@/features/products/components/ProductToolbar'
import { PRODUCT_PAGE_SIZE, useProductFilters } from '@/features/products/hooks/useProductFilters'
import { useDeleteProduct, useExportProducts, useProductOptions, useProducts } from '@/features/products/hooks/useProducts'
import { EXPORT_COLUMNS, toExportRow } from '@/features/products/utils/productSheet'
import { exportToExcel } from '@/lib/excel'
import { formatDate, formatDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import styles from './ProductsWorkspace.module.scss'
 
/** Admin product management: filters, table, add/edit, delete, bulk update, import and export. */
export default function ProductsWorkspace() {
  const { filters, update, initialSearch } = useProductFilters()
  const [searchText, setSearchText] = useState(initialSearch)
  const [selectedCodes, setSelectedCodes] = useState([])
  const [formTarget, setFormTarget] = useState(null) // null (closed) | 'new' | a product
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState(null)
  const bulkModal = useDisclosure()
  const importModal = useDisclosure()
 
  const search = useDebouncedValue(searchText.trim(), 300)
  const listFilters = { q: search, category: filters.category, stock: filters.stock, status: filters.status }
  const query = useProducts({ ...listFilters, page: filters.page, pageSize: PRODUCT_PAGE_SIZE, sort: filters.sort })
  const { data: options } = useProductOptions()
  const deleteProduct = useDeleteProduct()
  const exportProducts = useExportProducts()
 
  const changeFilters = (changes) => {
    setSelectedCodes([])
    update(changes)
  }
 
  const changeSearch = (value) => {
    setSelectedCodes([])
    setSearchText(value)
    update({})
  }
 
  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearchText('')
    changeFilters({ category: 'all', stock: 'all', status: 'all' })
  }
 
  const handleExport = () => {
    exportProducts.mutate(
      { ...listFilters, sort: filters.sort },
      {
        onSuccess: async ({ generatedAt, items }) => {
          try {
            await exportToExcel({
              fileName: `shipper-products-${formatDate(generatedAt).replaceAll(' ', '-')}`,
              sheetName: 'Products',
              title: `Shipper.com products · ${formatDateTime(generatedAt)}`,
              columns: EXPORT_COLUMNS,
              rows: items.map(toExportRow),
            })
            toast.success(`Exported ${items.length} products to Excel.`)
          } catch {
            toast.error('The Excel file could not be created. Please try again.')
          }
        },
        onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error)),
      },
    )
  }
 
  const confirmDelete = () => {
    deleteProduct.mutate(deleteTarget.code, {
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(`${deleteTarget.name} deleted.`)
        setSelectedCodes((codes) => codes.filter((code) => code !== deleteTarget.code))
        setDeleteTarget(null)
      },
      onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error)),
    })
  }
 
  const stockInfo = query.data?.stock
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Products"
        description="Manage product information, pricing, tax and inventory."
        actions={
          <Button leftIcon="plus-lg" size="sm" onClick={() => setFormTarget('new')}>
            Add Product
          </Button>
        }
      />
 
      <ProductFilterCards counts={query.data?.counts} filters={filters} onChange={changeFilters} />
 
      <ProductToolbar
        searchText={searchText}
        onSearchChange={changeSearch}
        filters={filters}
        categories={options?.categories}
        onFilterChange={changeFilters}
        onExport={handleExport}
        exporting={exportProducts.isPending}
      />
 
      <ProductsTableCard
        query={query}
        page={filters.page}
        sort={filters.sort}
        selectedCodes={selectedCodes}
        onSelectionChange={setSelectedCodes}
        onSortChange={(sort) => update({ sort })}
        onPageChange={(page) => update({ page })}
        onEdit={setFormTarget}
        onDelete={setDeleteTarget}
        onBulkUpdate={bulkModal.open}
        onImport={importModal.open}
        onClearFilters={clearFilters}
      />
 
      <footer className={styles.footer}>
        <p>{stockInfo ? `Stock updated ${formatDateTime(stockInfo.updatedAt)} · ${stockInfo.warehouse}` : ' '}</p>
        <Link to={paths.admin.restock} className={styles.link}>
          View inventory movement <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
        </Link>
      </footer>
 
      {formTarget && (
        <ProductFormModal
          key={formTarget === 'new' ? 'new' : formTarget.code}
          product={formTarget === 'new' ? null : formTarget}
          onClose={() => setFormTarget(null)}
        />
      )}
 
      {bulkModal.isOpen && (
        <BulkUpdateModal
          selectedCodes={selectedCodes}
          matchingCount={query.data?.totalItems ?? 0}
          filters={listFilters}
          onClose={bulkModal.close}
          onUpdated={() => setSelectedCodes([])}
        />
      )}
 
      {importModal.isOpen && <ImportProductsModal onClose={importModal.close} />}
 
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={Boolean(deleteTarget)}
        onClose={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}
        onConfirm={confirmDelete}
        loading={deleteProduct.isPending}
        tone="danger"
        title={`Delete ${deleteTarget?.name ?? 'product'}?`}
        message={
          <p>
            {deleteTarget?.code} will be removed from the catalogue and hidden from the storefront. Past orders keep their record of it.
          </p>
        }
        confirmLabel="Delete product"
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import SearchField from '@/components/molecules/SearchField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import styles from './ProductToolbar.module.scss'
 
const STOCK_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'All' },
  { value: 'in', label: 'In stock' },
  { value: 'low', label: 'Low stock' },
  { value: 'out', label: 'Out of stock' },
]
 
const STATUS_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'All' },
  { value: 'active', label: 'Active' },
  { value: 'inactive', label: 'Inactive' },
]
 
/** Search, Category / Stock / Status filters and the Excel export for the product list. */
export default function ProductToolbar({ searchText, onSearchChange, filters, categories = [], onFilterChange, onExport, exporting }) {
  const categoryOptions = [{ value: 'all', label: 'All' }, ...categories]
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.toolbar}>
      <SearchField
        className={styles.search}
        size="sm"
        value={searchText}
        onChange={onSearchChange}
        placeholder="Search code, name, HSN or batch"
        aria-label="Search products by code, name, HSN or batch"
      />
      <div className={styles.filters}>
        <div className={styles.filter}>
          <SelectField
            size="sm"
            fit
            prefixLabel="Category:"
            aria-label="Filter by category"
            options={categoryOptions}
            value={filters.category}
            onChange={(value) => onFilterChange({ category: value })}
          />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.filter}>
          <SelectField
            size="sm"
            fit
            prefixLabel="Stock:"
            aria-label="Filter by stock level"
            options={STOCK_OPTIONS}
            value={filters.stock}
            onChange={(value) => onFilterChange({ stock: value })}
          />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.filter}>
          <SelectField
            size="sm"
            fit
            prefixLabel="Status:"
            aria-label="Filter by status"
            options={STATUS_OPTIONS}
            value={filters.status}
            onChange={(value) => onFilterChange({ status: value })}
          />
        </div>
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="download" loading={exporting} onClick={onExport}>
          Export
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

## `src/features/products/hooks/useProductFilters.js`
 
```javascript
import { useCallback, useState } from 'react'
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
 
export const PRODUCT_PAGE_SIZE = 6
 
const STOCK_VALUES = ['all', 'in', 'low', 'out']
const STATUS_VALUES = ['all', 'active', 'inactive']
const DEFAULTS = { category: 'all', stock: 'all', status: 'all', sort: '', page: 1 }
 
const oneOf = (value, allowed, fallback) => (allowed.includes(value) ? value : fallback)
 
/**
 * Product list filters kept in the URL (?category=&stock=&status=&sort=&page=) so a filtered view can
 * be bookmarked or linked from a notification (for example /admin/products?stock=low). Changing any
 * filter returns to page 1. The search text is local state, seeded from ?q= once.
 */
export function useProductFilters() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams()
  const [initialSearch] = useState(() => searchParams.get('q') ?? '')
 
  const filters = {
    category: searchParams.get('category') ?? DEFAULTS.category,
    stock: oneOf(searchParams.get('stock'), STOCK_VALUES, DEFAULTS.stock),
    status: oneOf(searchParams.get('status'), STATUS_VALUES, DEFAULTS.status),
    sort: searchParams.get('sort') ?? DEFAULTS.sort,
    page: Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(searchParams.get('page') ?? '1', 10) || 1),
  }
 
  const update = useCallback(
    (changes) => {
      setSearchParams(
        (current) => {
          const next = new URLSearchParams(current)
          if (!('page' in changes)) next.delete('page')
          Object.entries(changes).forEach(([key, value]) => {
            if (value === undefined || value === null || value === DEFAULTS[key]) next.delete(key)
            else next.set(key, String(value))
          })
          return next
        },
        { replace: true },
      )
    },
    [setSearchParams],
  )
 
  return { filters, update, initialSearch }
}
```
 
## `src/features/products/hooks/useProducts.js`
 
```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { dashboardKeys } from '@/features/dashboard/hooks/useDashboard'
import {
  bulkUpdateProducts,
  createProduct,
  deleteProduct,
  exportProducts,
  getProductOptions,
  importProducts,
  listProducts,
  updateProduct,
  uploadProductImage,
} from '@/features/products/services/productService'
 
export const productKeys = {
  all: ['admin', 'products'],
  list: (params) => ['admin', 'products', 'list', params],
  options: ['admin', 'products', 'options'],
}
 
export function useProducts(params) {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: productKeys.list(params), queryFn: () => listProducts(params), placeholderData: keepPreviousData })
}
 
/** Categories, pack sizes and GST rates the backend accepts; they change rarely. */
export function useProductOptions() {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: productKeys.options, queryFn: getProductOptions, staleTime: 10 * 60_000 })
}
 
// Stock, counts and alerts on other screens depend on the catalogue, so every change refreshes them too.
function useRefreshCatalogue() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  return () =>
    Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: productKeys.all }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: dashboardKeys.all }),
    ])
}
 
/**
 * Creates or updates a product, then uploads the chosen image. A failed upload does not undo the
 * saved product: the result reports it as `imageError` so the form can say so.
 */
export function useSaveProduct() {
  const refresh = useRefreshCatalogue()
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ code, values, imageFile }) => {
      const saved = code ? await updateProduct(code, values) : await createProduct(values)
      if (!imageFile) return { product: saved, imageError: null }
      try {
        return { product: await uploadProductImage(saved.code, imageFile), imageError: null }
      } catch (error) {
        return { product: saved, imageError: error }
      }
    },
    onSuccess: refresh,
  })
}
 
export function useDeleteProduct() {
  const refresh = useRefreshCatalogue()
  return useMutation({ mutationFn: deleteProduct, onSuccess: refresh })
}
 
export function useBulkUpdateProducts() {
  const refresh = useRefreshCatalogue()
  return useMutation({ mutationFn: bulkUpdateProducts, onSuccess: refresh })
}
 
export function useImportProducts() {
  const refresh = useRefreshCatalogue()
  return useMutation({ mutationFn: importProducts, onSuccess: refresh })
}
 
/** Fetches every product matching the filters (not just the visible page) for an Excel export. */
export function useExportProducts() {
  return useMutation({ mutationFn: exportProducts })
}
```

## `src/features/products/schemas/bulkUpdateSchema.js`
 
```javascript
import { z } from 'zod'
 
// "" means "leave unchanged" for both selects.
export const bulkUpdateSchema = z
  .object({
    scope: z.enum(['selected', 'filtered']),
    status: z.enum(['', 'active', 'inactive']),
    gstPercent: z.union([z.literal(''), z.number()]),
  })
  .refine((values) => values.status !== '' || values.gstPercent !== '', {
    path: ['status'],
    message: 'Choose at least one change to apply',
  })
```
 
## `src/features/products/schemas/productSchema.js`
 
```javascript
import { z } from 'zod'
import { hsnSchema, requiredText } from '@/lib/validation'
 
// Shape checks for a better form experience. The backend validates everything again and owns the
// derived values (discount %, stock status); nothing here computes a price.
 
const amount = (label) =>
  z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, `Enter the ${label}`)
    .regex(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/, 'Enter an amount such as 150.00')
    .transform(Number)
    .refine((value) => value > 0, `The ${label} must be more than 0`)
 
const wholeNumber = (label) =>
  z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, `Enter the ${label}`)
    .regex(/^\d+$/, 'Use a whole number, 0 or more')
    .transform(Number)
 
export const productSchema = z
  .object({
    code: z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9-]{3,16}$/, 'Use 3–16 letters, numbers or hyphens'),
    category: z.string().min(1, 'Select a category'),
    name: requiredText('Enter the product name'),
    batch: requiredText('Enter the batch number'),
    hsn: hsnSchema,
    mrp: amount('MRP'),
    sellingPrice: amount('selling price'),
    gstPercent: z.number({ error: 'Select a GST rate' }),
    stock: wholeNumber('stock'),
    pv: wholeNumber('PV'),
    unit: z.string().min(1, 'Select the pack size'),
    status: z.enum(['active', 'inactive']),
    description: z.string().trim().max(500, 'Keep the description under 500 characters'),
  })
  .refine((product) => product.sellingPrice <= product.mrp, {
    path: ['sellingPrice'],
    message: 'Selling price cannot be higher than the MRP',
  })
 
export const emptyProductValues = {
  code: '',
  category: '',
  name: '',
  batch: '',
  hsn: '',
  mrp: '',
  sellingPrice: '',
  gstPercent: null,
  stock: '',
  pv: '',
  unit: '',
  status: 'active',
  description: '',
}
 
/** Form values (strings, as typed into the inputs) for an existing product. */
export function toProductFormValues(product) {
  return {
    code: product.code,
    category: product.category,
    name: product.name,
    batch: product.batch,
    hsn: product.hsn,
    mrp: Number(product.mrp).toFixed(2),
    sellingPrice: Number(product.sellingPrice).toFixed(2),
    gstPercent: product.gstPercent,
    stock: String(product.stock),
    pv: String(product.pv),
    unit: product.unit,
    status: product.status,
    description: product.description ?? '',
  }
}
```
 
## `src/features/products/services/productService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: every path, query parameter, payload and response below.
//
// GET  /admin/products?page&pageSize&q&category&stock=all|in|low|out&status=all|active|inactive&sort=[-]field
//      → { items: Product[], page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount,
//          counts: { all, active, low, out }, stock: { updatedAt, warehouse } }
//      Product = { code, slug, name, category, categoryLabel, unit, batch, hsn, gstPercent, stock,
//                  lowStockThreshold, pv, mrp, sellingPrice, discountPercent, status: 'active' | 'inactive',
//                  stockStatus: 'in_stock' | 'low_stock' | 'out_of_stock', image, thumbnail, description,
//                  updatedAt, updatedBy }
//      `counts`, `stockStatus` and `discountPercent` are calculated by the backend.
// GET  /admin/products/options → { categories: [{ value, label }], units: string[], gstRates: number[] }
// GET  /admin/products/export  (same filters, no paging) → { generatedAt, items: Product[] }
// POST /admin/products | PUT /admin/products/:code → Product; field errors arrive as 422 { message, errors: { field: message } }
// POST /admin/products/:code/image (multipart, field "image": JPG or PNG up to 5 MB) → Product
// DELETE /admin/products/:code → 204
// POST /admin/products/bulk-update { scope: { codes } | { filters }, changes: { status?, gstPercent? } } → { updated }
// POST /admin/products/import { rows } → { created, updated, rejected: [{ rowNumber, code, message }] }
 
export async function listProducts(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.products.list, { params })
  return data
}
 
export async function getProductOptions() {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.products.options)
  return data
}
 
export async function exportProducts(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.products.export, { params })
  return data
}
 
export async function createProduct(payload) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.admin.products.list, payload)
  return data
}
 
export async function updateProduct(code, payload) {
  const { data } = await http.put(endpoints.admin.products.item(code), payload)
  return data
}
 
export async function uploadProductImage(code, file) {
  const body = new FormData()
  body.append('image', file)
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.admin.products.image(code), body)
  return data
}
 
export async function deleteProduct(code) {
  await http.delete(endpoints.admin.products.item(code))
}
 
export async function bulkUpdateProducts(payload) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.admin.products.bulkUpdate, payload)
  return data
}
 
export async function importProducts(rows) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.admin.products.import, { rows })
  return data
}
```
 
## `src/features/products/utils/applyServerErrors.js`
 
```javascript
/**
 * Shows the backend's per-field validation messages (422 { errors: { field: message } }) on the form.
 * Returns true when at least one field message was applied.
 * ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: the shape of field errors.
 */
export function applyServerErrors(error, setError) {
  const fields = error?.status === 422 && error.details && typeof error.details === 'object' ? Object.entries(error.details) : []
  fields.forEach(([field, message]) => setError(field, { type: 'server', message: String(message) }))
  return fields.length > 0
}
```

```javascript
import { hsnSchema } from '@/lib/validation'
 
// One column set for the Excel export, the import template and the import parser, so an exported
// file can be edited and imported again.
export const PRODUCT_SHEET_COLUMNS = [
  { header: 'Code', key: 'code', width: 12, format: 'text', required: true },
  { header: 'Product name', key: 'name', width: 34, required: true },
  { header: 'Category', key: 'category', width: 16, required: true },
  { header: 'Unit', key: 'unit', width: 12, format: 'text', required: true },
  { header: 'Batch', key: 'batch', width: 12, format: 'text', required: true },
  { header: 'HSN', key: 'hsn', width: 12, format: 'text', required: true },
  { header: 'GST %', key: 'gstPercent', width: 9, format: 'number', required: true },
  { header: 'MRP', key: 'mrp', width: 12, format: 'inr', required: true },
  { header: 'Selling price', key: 'sellingPrice', width: 14, format: 'inr', required: true },
  { header: 'Stock', key: 'stock', width: 10, format: 'number', required: true },
  { header: 'PV', key: 'pv', width: 8, format: 'number', required: true },
  { header: 'Status', key: 'status', width: 10 },
  { header: 'Description', key: 'description', width: 40 },
]
 
/** Columns of the downloaded list: the importable ones plus the stock status the backend reports. */
export const EXPORT_COLUMNS = [...PRODUCT_SHEET_COLUMNS, { header: 'Stock status', key: 'stockStatus', width: 14 }]
 
const STATUS_LABELS = { active: 'Active', inactive: 'Inactive' }
const STOCK_STATUS_LABELS = { in_stock: 'In stock', low_stock: 'Low stock', out_of_stock: 'Out of stock' }
 
export function toExportRow(product) {
  return {
    code: product.code,
    name: product.name,
    category: product.categoryLabel,
    unit: product.unit,
    batch: product.batch,
    hsn: product.hsn,
    gstPercent: product.gstPercent,
    mrp: product.mrp,
    sellingPrice: product.sellingPrice,
    stock: product.stock,
    pv: product.pv,
    status: STATUS_LABELS[product.status] ?? product.status,
    description: product.description,
    stockStatus: STOCK_STATUS_LABELS[product.stockStatus] ?? product.stockStatus,
  }
}
 
export const TEMPLATE_ROW = {
  code: 'HL999',
  name: 'Sample Haldi Powder',
  category: 'Haldi',
  unit: '200 g',
  batch: 'HL1026',
  hsn: '091030',
  gstPercent: 5,
  mrp: 150,
  sellingPrice: 120,
  stock: 100,
  pv: 12,
  status: 'Active',
  description: 'Replace this sample row with your products.',
}
 
const normalizeHeader = (header) => String(header).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')
const HEADER_LOOKUP = Object.fromEntries(PRODUCT_SHEET_COLUMNS.map((column) => [normalizeHeader(column.header), column.key]))
HEADER_LOOKUP.gst = 'gstPercent'
 
const NUMBER_FIELDS = [
  { key: 'gstPercent', label: 'GST %', integer: false },
  { key: 'mrp', label: 'MRP', integer: false },
  { key: 'sellingPrice', label: 'Selling price', integer: false },
  { key: 'stock', label: 'Stock', integer: true },
  { key: 'pv', label: 'PV', integer: true },
]
 
/** Header texts of required columns that the sheet does not have (by normalised name). */
export function findMissingColumns(headers) {
  const present = new Set(headers.map((header) => HEADER_LOOKUP[normalizeHeader(header)]).filter(Boolean))
  return PRODUCT_SHEET_COLUMNS.filter((column) => column.required && !present.has(column.key)).map((column) => column.header)
}
 
/**
 * Turns rows read from the sheet into import rows and checks their shape (required text, 6/8-digit
 * HSN, numbers). The backend validates again and has the final say (known categories, GST rates, prices).
 * Returns [{ rowNumber, values, errors: string[] }] where rowNumber is the row in the sheet.
 */
export function parseImportRows(rows) {
  return rows.map((raw, index) => {
    const values = {}
    Object.entries(raw).forEach(([header, value]) => {
      const key = HEADER_LOOKUP[normalizeHeader(header)]
      if (key) values[key] = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : value
    })
 
    const errors = []
    PRODUCT_SHEET_COLUMNS.filter((column) => column.required && !NUMBER_FIELDS.some((field) => field.key === column.key)).forEach((column) => {
      if (String(values[column.key] ?? '').trim() === '') errors.push(`${column.header} is required`)
    })
    if (values.hsn !== undefined && String(values.hsn).trim() !== '' && !hsnSchema.safeParse(String(values.hsn)).success) {
      errors.push('HSN must contain 6 or 8 digits (format the column as text to keep leading zeros)')
    }
    NUMBER_FIELDS.forEach(({ key, label, integer }) => {
      const text = String(values[key] ?? '').trim()
      if (text === '') {
        errors.push(`${label} is required`)
        return
      }
      const number = Number(text)
      if (!Number.isFinite(number) || number < 0 || (integer && !Number.isInteger(number))) {
        errors.push(`${label} must be ${integer ? 'a whole number' : 'a number'}, 0 or more`)
      } else {
        values[key] = number
      }
    })
    if (values.hsn !== undefined) values.hsn = String(values.hsn).trim()
 
    return { rowNumber: index + 2, values, errors }
  })
}
```
 
## `src/features/profile/components/AccountNav/AccountNav.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { NavLink, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { useLogout } from '@/features/auth'
import styles from './AccountNav.module.scss'
 
const ITEMS = [
  { key: 'profile', label: 'Profile & addresses', to: paths.profile },
  { key: 'orders', label: 'My orders', to: paths.orders },
  { key: 'wallet', label: 'Wallet & rewards', to: paths.wallet },
  { key: 'saved', label: 'Saved products', to: paths.saved },
]
 
/**
 * Navigation between the account screens, ending in Log out. A vertical list from `lg`; on smaller screens
 * the same links become a row of pills that scrolls sideways instead of wrapping.
 */
export default function AccountNav({ className }) {
  const logout = useLogout({ redirectTo: paths.home })
  const listRef = useRef(null)
  const { pathname } = useLocation()
 
  // In the sideways-scrolling pill row, bring the current page's pill into view without moving the page itself.
  useEffect(() => {
    const list = listRef.current
    const active = list?.querySelector('[aria-current="page"]')
    if (!list || !active || list.scrollWidth <= list.clientWidth) return
    const offset = active.getBoundingClientRect().left - list.getBoundingClientRect().left + list.scrollLeft
    list.scrollLeft = offset - (list.clientWidth - active.offsetWidth) / 2
  }, [pathname])
 
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Account" className={clsx(styles.nav, className)}>
      <ul ref={listRef} className={styles.list}>
        {ITEMS.map((item) => (
          <li key={item.key}>
            <NavLink to={item.to} className={({ isActive }) => clsx(styles.link, isActive && styles.active)}>
              {item.label}
            </NavLink>
          </li>
        ))}
        <li className={styles.logoutItem}>
          <button type="button" className={clsx(styles.link, styles.logout)} disabled={logout.isPending} onClick={() => logout.mutate()}>
            Log out
          </button>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </nav>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Breadcrumbs from '@/components/molecules/Breadcrumbs'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import AccountNav from '@/features/profile/components/AccountNav'
import styles from './AccountShell.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Frame of every signed-in account screen: optional breadcrumbs, the page heading and the account navigation.
 *   layout="sidebar" (profile, wallet, saved): navigation in a column beside a content column of reading width
 *   layout="wide" (order list and order detail, as designed): full-width content; the navigation is a row of pills
 *     on small screens only, because the design reaches these pages through breadcrumbs
 *   showNav={false}: no navigation at all (a single order, where the breadcrumbs lead back)
 */
export default function AccountShell({ title, description, actions, breadcrumbs, layout = 'sidebar', showNav = true, children }) {
  const isSidebar = layout === 'sidebar'
 
  return (
    <div className={clsx('sh-container', styles.page)}>
      {breadcrumbs && <Breadcrumbs items={breadcrumbs} className={styles.breadcrumbs} />}
      <PageHeader variant="storefront" title={title} description={description} actions={actions} className={styles.header} />
 
      <div className={clsx(styles.body, isSidebar && styles.withSidebar)}>
        {showNav && <AccountNav className={clsx(styles.nav, !isSidebar && styles.mobileOnly)} />}
        <div className={clsx(styles.content, isSidebar && styles.readingWidth)}>{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/profile/components/ChangePasswordModal/ChangePasswordModal.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import PasswordInput from '@/components/molecules/PasswordInput'
import Modal from '@/components/organisms/Modal'
import { useChangePassword } from '@/features/profile/hooks/useProfile'
import { changePasswordSchema } from '@/features/profile/schemas/profileSchema'
import { applyFieldErrors } from '@/features/profile/utils/serverErrors'
import styles from './ChangePasswordModal.module.scss'
 
const FORM_ID = 'change-password-form'
const EMPTY = { currentPassword: '', newPassword: '', confirmPassword: '' }
 
/** Change password: the current password and a new one entered twice. The backend checks the current password. */
export default function ChangePasswordModal({ open, onClose }) {
  const change = useChangePassword()
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    reset,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(changePasswordSchema), defaultValues: EMPTY })
 
  // Closing clears what was typed, so a password never lingers in a dialog that is out of sight.
  const close = () => {
    reset(EMPTY)
    change.reset()
    onClose()
  }
 
  const onSubmit = handleSubmit(({ currentPassword, newPassword }) => {
    change.mutate(
      { currentPassword, newPassword },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          toast.success('Your password has been changed.')
          close()
        },
        onError: (error) => {
          if (!applyFieldErrors(error, setError, ['currentPassword', 'newPassword'])) {
            toast.error(getErrorMessage(error, 'We could not change your password. Please try again.'))
          }
        },
      },
    )
  })
 
  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={close}
      size="sm"
      title="Change password"
      description="Choose a new password you don’t use anywhere else."
      closeOnBackdrop={!change.isPending}
      closeOnEscape={!change.isPending}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" disabled={change.isPending} onClick={close}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" form={FORM_ID} loading={change.isPending}>
            Update password
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form id={FORM_ID} className={styles.form} onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
        <FormField label="Current password" error={errors.currentPassword?.message}>
          {(field) => <PasswordInput {...field} {...register('currentPassword')} autoComplete="current-password" />}
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="New password" error={errors.newPassword?.message} hint="Use 8+ characters, including a number and a special character.">
          {(field) => <PasswordInput {...field} {...register('newPassword')} autoComplete="new-password" />}
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Confirm new password" error={errors.confirmPassword?.message}>
          {(field) => <PasswordInput {...field} {...register('confirmPassword')} autoComplete="new-password" />}
        </FormField>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/profile/components/PersonalDetailsCard/PersonalDetailsCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import ChangePasswordModal from '@/features/profile/components/ChangePasswordModal'
import { useProfile, useUpdateProfile } from '@/features/profile/hooks/useProfile'
import { profileSchema } from '@/features/profile/schemas/profileSchema'
import { applyFieldErrors } from '@/features/profile/utils/serverErrors'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import { formatMobile } from '@/lib/address'
import styles from './PersonalDetailsCard.module.scss'
 
const FIELDS = ['name', 'mobile', 'email']
 
const toFormValues = (profile) => ({ name: profile.name, mobile: formatMobile(profile.mobile), email: profile.email })
 
function PersonalDetailsForm({ profile, onChangePassword }) {
  const update = useUpdateProfile()
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    reset,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(profileSchema), defaultValues: toFormValues(profile) })
 
  const onSubmit = handleSubmit((values) => {
    update.mutate(values, {
      onSuccess: (saved) => {
        reset(toFormValues(saved))
        toast.success('Your details have been saved.')
      },
      onError: (error) => {
        if (!applyFieldErrors(error, setError, FIELDS)) toast.error(getErrorMessage(error, 'We could not save your details. Please try again.'))
      },
    })
  })
 
  return (
    <form className={styles.form} onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
      <div className={styles.row}>
        <FormField label="Full name" error={errors.name?.message}>
          {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('name')} autoComplete="name" />}
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Mobile" error={errors.mobile?.message}>
          {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('mobile')} type="tel" inputMode="tel" autoComplete="tel" />}
        </FormField>
      </div>
      <FormField label="Email" error={errors.email?.message}>
        {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('email')} type="email" autoComplete="email" />}
      </FormField>
      <div className={styles.actions}>
        <Button type="submit" size="sm" loading={update.isPending}>
          Save changes
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={onChangePassword}>
          Change password
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  )
}
 
/** "Personal details": name, mobile and email of the signed-in customer, and the entry to Change password. */
export default function PersonalDetailsCard() {
  const profile = useProfile()
  const passwordModal = useDisclosure()
 
  return (
    <Card title="Personal details" padding="md">
      {profile.isPending && (
        <div className={styles.form} aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading your details">
          <Skeleton height="2.75rem" />
          <Skeleton height="2.75rem" />
          <Skeleton width="12rem" height="2.125rem" />
        </div>
      )}
      {profile.isError && <ErrorState compact title="We couldn’t load your details" message={getErrorMessage(profile.error)} onRetry={profile.refetch} />}
      {profile.data && <PersonalDetailsForm profile={profile.data} onChangePassword={passwordModal.open} />}
      <ChangePasswordModal open={passwordModal.isOpen} onClose={passwordModal.close} />
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/profile/components/SavedAddressesCard/SavedAddressesCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { selectCurrentUser } from '@/app/store'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import ConfirmDialog from '@/components/organisms/ConfirmDialog'
import { AddressDrawer, useAddresses, useDeleteAddress, useSetDefaultAddress } from '@/features/addresses'
import AddressListItem from '@/features/profile/components/AddressListItem'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import { formatAddress } from '@/lib/address'
import styles from './SavedAddressesCard.module.scss'
 
/** "Saved addresses": the customer's addresses with add, edit, set-as-default and remove. */
export default function SavedAddressesCard() {
  const user = useSelector(selectCurrentUser)
  const addresses = useAddresses()
  const removeAddress = useDeleteAddress()
  const setDefaultAddress = useSetDefaultAddress()
  const drawer = useDisclosure()
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null)
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState(null)
 
  const openDrawer = (address = null) => {
    setEditing(address)
    drawer.open()
  }
 
  const makeDefault = (address) =>
    setDefaultAddress.mutate(address.id, {
      onSuccess: () => toast.success(`${address.label} is now your default address.`),
      onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error, 'We could not change your default address. Please try again.')),
    })
 
  const confirmRemove = () =>
    removeAddress.mutate(removing.id, {
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success('Address removed.')
        setRemoving(null)
      },
      onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error, 'We could not remove this address. Please try again.')),
    })
 
  const addButton = (
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="plus-lg" onClick={() => openDrawer()}>
      Add new address
    </Button>
  )
 
  let content
  if (addresses.isPending) {
    content = (
      <div className={styles.skeleton} aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading your addresses">
        <Skeleton width="9rem" height="1.25rem" />
        <Skeleton width="60%" height="1rem" />
        <Skeleton width="85%" height="1rem" />
      </div>
    )
  } else if (addresses.isError) {
    content = <ErrorState compact title="We couldn’t load your addresses" message={getErrorMessage(addresses.error)} onRetry={addresses.refetch} />
  } else if (addresses.data.length === 0) {
    content = <EmptyState compact icon="geo-alt" title="No saved addresses yet" description="Add one to check out faster." action={addButton} />
  } else {
    content = (
      <>
        <div className={styles.list}>
          {addresses.data.map((address) => (
            <AddressListItem
              key={address.id}
              address={address}
              busy={setDefaultAddress.isPending}
              onEdit={openDrawer}
              onSetDefault={makeDefault}
              onRemove={setRemoving}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
        {addButton}
      </>
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <Card title="Saved addresses" padding="md">
      {content}
 
      <AddressDrawer open={drawer.isOpen} onClose={drawer.close} address={editing} defaults={{ name: user?.name ?? '', mobile: user?.mobile ?? '' }} />
 
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={Boolean(removing)}
        onClose={() => setRemoving(null)}
        onConfirm={confirmRemove}
        tone="danger"
        title="Remove this address?"
        message={removing && `${removing.label} · ${formatAddress(removing)} will be removed from your saved addresses.`}
        confirmLabel="Remove address"
        loading={removeAddress.isPending}
      />
    </Card>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { itemAdded } from '@/app/store'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import Thumbnail from '@/components/atoms/Thumbnail'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PriceDisplay from '@/components/molecules/PriceDisplay'
import { useSavedProducts, useSavedProductToggle } from '@/features/saved'
import styles from './SavedProductList.module.scss'
 
function SavedProductSkeleton() {
  return (
    <li className={styles.item} aria-hidden="true">
      <Skeleton width="6rem" height="6rem" radius="0.75rem" />
      <div className={styles.skeletonText}>
        <Skeleton width="55%" height="1.125rem" />
        <Skeleton width="30%" height="0.875rem" />
        <Skeleton width="25%" height="1.25rem" />
      </div>
    </li>
  )
}
 
/**
 * "Saved products": the customer's saved list with a picture, price, stock state, Add to cart and Remove.
 * Prices come from the backend's saved-product summaries; adding to the cart only records the product and
 * quantity, the cart asks the backend for the price.
 */
export default function SavedProductList() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const saved = useSavedProducts()
  const { toggle } = useSavedProductToggle()
 
  const addToCart = (product) => {
    dispatch(itemAdded({ productCode: product.productCode, quantity: 1 }))
    toast.success(`${product.name} added to your cart.`)
  }
 
  const remove = (product) => {
    toggle(product.productCode)
    toast.info(`${product.name} removed from saved products.`)
  }
 
  if (saved.isError) {
    return <ErrorState title="We couldn’t load your saved products" message={getErrorMessage(saved.error)} onRetry={saved.refetch} />
  }
 
  if (saved.isSuccess && saved.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        icon="heart"
        title="Nothing saved yet"
        description="Tap the heart on any product to keep it here for later."
        action={
          <Button as={Link} to={paths.shop}>
            Shop everyday essentials
          </Button>
        }
      />
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <Card padding="none" aria-label="Saved products" aria-busy={saved.isPending || undefined}>
      <ul className={styles.list}>
        {saved.isPending
          ? [0, 1, 2].map((key) => <SavedProductSkeleton key={key} />)
          : saved.data.map((product) => {
              const unavailable = product.stockStatus === 'out_of_stock'
              return (
                <li key={product.productCode} className={styles.item}>
                  <Link to={paths.product(product.slug)} tabIndex={-1} aria-hidden="true">
                    <Thumbnail src={product.image} size={96} />
                  </Link>
                  <div className={styles.info}>
                    <Link to={paths.product(product.slug)} className={styles.name}>
                      {product.name}
                    </Link>
                    <p className={styles.meta}>
                      {product.unit} · {product.categoryLabel}
                    </p>
                    <div className={styles.priceRow}>
                      <PriceDisplay sellingPrice={product.sellingPrice} mrp={product.mrp} discountPercent={product.discountPercent} />
                      {product.stockStatus !== 'in_stock' && <StatusBadge status={product.stockStatus} />}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className={styles.actions}>
                    <Button size="sm" leftIcon="bag-plus" disabled={unavailable} onClick={() => addToCart(product)}>
                      Add to cart
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="heart-fill" onClick={() => remove(product)}>
                      Remove<span className="visually-hidden"> {product.name} from saved products</span>
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </li>
              )
            })}
      </ul>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/profile/hooks/useProfile.js`
 
```javascript
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux'
import { userUpdated } from '@/app/store'
import { changePassword, getProfile, updateProfile } from '@/features/profile/services/profileService'
 
export const profileKeys = {
  all: ['profile'],
  detail: () => ['profile', 'detail'],
}
 
export function useProfile() {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: profileKeys.detail(), queryFn: getProfile })
}
 
/** Saves the personal details and mirrors them into the signed-in user the header and greeting read from. */
export function useUpdateProfile() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
 
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: updateProfile,
    onSuccess: (profile) => {
      queryClient.setQueryData(profileKeys.detail(), profile)
      dispatch(userUpdated({ name: profile.name, email: profile.email, mobile: profile.mobile }))
    },
  })
}
 
export const useChangePassword = () => useMutation({ mutationFn: changePassword })
```

## `src/features/profile/schemas/profileSchema.js`
 
```javascript
import { z } from 'zod'
import { emailSchema, mobileSchema, passwordSchema, requiredText } from '@/lib/validation'
 
// Shape and length checks for a better form experience; the backend validates and owns uniqueness.
export const profileSchema = z.object({
  name: requiredText('Enter your full name').max(60, 'Use 60 characters or fewer'),
  mobile: mobileSchema,
  email: emailSchema,
})
 
export const changePasswordSchema = z
  .object({
    currentPassword: z.string().min(1, 'Enter your current password'),
    newPassword: passwordSchema,
    confirmPassword: z.string().min(1, 'Confirm your new password'),
  })
  .refine((values) => values.newPassword === values.confirmPassword, {
    path: ['confirmPassword'],
    message: 'The passwords do not match',
  })
  .refine((values) => values.newPassword !== values.currentPassword, {
    path: ['newPassword'],
    message: 'Choose a password that is different from your current one',
  })
```
 
## `src/features/profile/services/profileService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. The profile is { id, name, email, mobile } with the mobile as 10 digits.
// Saving returns the stored profile. Failures that belong to a field answer 409 / 422 with
// `errors: { name?, email?, mobile? }` (for example a mobile number already used by another account).
// Changing the mobile number would normally need an OTP check on the backend; the UI only collects the value.
 
export async function getProfile() {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.account.profile)
  return data
}
 
export async function updateProfile(payload) {
  const { data } = await http.put(endpoints.account.profile, payload)
  return data
}
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: POST { currentPassword, newPassword } → 204; a wrong current password
// is a 422 with `errors: { currentPassword }`.
export async function changePassword(payload) {
  await http.post(endpoints.account.password, payload)
}
```
 
## `src/features/profile/utils/serverErrors.js`
 
```javascript
/**
 * Shows the backend's per-field messages (ApiError.details = { field: message }) under the matching inputs.
 * Returns true when at least one field was marked, so the caller can fall back to a toast otherwise.
 */
export function applyFieldErrors(error, setError, fields) {
  const details = error?.details
  if (!details || typeof details !== 'object') return false
 
  const known = fields.filter((field) => typeof details[field] === 'string')
  known.forEach((field) => setError(field, { type: 'server', message: details[field] }))
  return known.length > 0
}
```

import { useState } from 'react'

import Modal from '@/components/organisms/Modal'

/** Lists the customer's saved addresses and returns the one chosen. Mount it only while open. */
export default function AddressPickerModal({ addresses, selectedId, onSelect, onClose }) {

    <Modal
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      size="md"
      title="Change delivery address"
      description="Choose one of the customer’s saved addresses."
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            disabled={!choice}
            onClick={() => {
              onSelect(choice)
              onClose()
            }}
          >
            Use this address
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <fieldset className={styles.list}>
        <legend className="visually-hidden">Saved addresses</legend>
        {addresses.map((address) => (
          <div key={address.id} className={styles.option}>
            <Radio
              name="delivery-address"
              checked={choice === address.id}
              onChange={() => setChoice(address.id)}
              label={
                <span className={styles.heading}>
                  {address.label}
                  {address.isDefault && ' · Default'}
                  {address.verified && <Badge tone="success">Verified</Badge>}
                </span>
              }
            />
            <AddressSummary address={address} className={styles.summary} />
          </div>
        ))}

  )
}

## `src/features/purchases/components/CreatePurchaseWorkspace/CreatePurchaseWorkspace.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import PurchaseForm from '@/features/purchases/components/PurchaseForm'
import { usePurchase, usePurchaseDraft } from '@/features/purchases/hooks/usePurchases'
import styles from './CreatePurchaseWorkspace.module.scss'
 
/** Create purchase page content. `?draft=PUR-…` continues a saved draft; otherwise it starts a new one. */
export default function CreatePurchaseWorkspace() {
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams()
  const resumeNumber = searchParams.get('draft')
  const context = usePurchaseDraft()
  const saved = usePurchase(resumeNumber)
 
  const failed = context.isError || (resumeNumber && saved.isError)
  const ready = context.data && (!resumeNumber || saved.data)
  const draftNumber = resumeNumber ?? context.data?.purchaseNumber
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Create purchase"
        description={draftNumber ? `Draft #${draftNumber} · Add a customer, verify items, and confirm the gross amount.` : 'Add a customer, verify items, and confirm the gross amount.'}
      />
      {failed && (
        <ErrorState
          title="This purchase could not be opened"
          message={getErrorMessage(context.error ?? saved.error)}
          onRetry={() => (context.isError ? context.refetch() : saved.refetch())}
        />
      )}
      {!failed && !ready && (
        <div className={styles.loading} aria-hidden="true">
          <Skeleton height="11rem" radius="8px" />
          <Skeleton height="22rem" radius="8px" />
        </div>
      )}
      {!failed && ready && (
        <PurchaseForm key={draftNumber} draftNumber={draftNumber} paymentMethods={context.data.paymentMethods} purchase={saved.data ?? null} />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import { useCustomerLookup } from '@/features/purchases/hooks/usePurchases'
import styles from './CustomerCard.module.scss'
 
const labelOf = (customer) => `${customer.code} · ${customer.name}`
const groupMobile = (mobile) => (mobile?.length === 10 ? `${mobile.slice(0, 5)} ${mobile.slice(5)}` : (mobile ?? ''))
 
/**
 * Finds the customer by code, name, mobile or email. One match is selected straight away; several
 * are listed to pick from (two customers can share a name). The form keeps the chosen customer.
 */
export default function CustomerCard() {
  const { control, setValue, formState } = useFormContext()
  const customer = useWatch({ control, name: 'customer' })
  const lookup = useCustomerLookup()
  const [text, setText] = useState(customer ? labelOf(customer) : '')
  const [matches, setMatches] = useState([])
  const [notFound, setNotFound] = useState(null)
 
  const choose = (selected) => {
    const address = selected.addresses.find((entry) => entry.isDefault) ?? selected.addresses[0]
    setValue('customer', selected, { shouldValidate: true })
    setValue('addressId', address?.id ?? '', { shouldValidate: true })
    setValue('useWallet', selected.walletBalance > 0)
    setText(labelOf(selected))
    setMatches([])
    setNotFound(null)
  }
 
  const find = () => {
    const query = text.trim()
    if (query.length < 2) {
      setNotFound('Enter at least 2 characters of the customer code, name or mobile number.')
      return
    }
    lookup.mutate(query, {
      onSuccess: (items) => {
        setMatches(items.length > 1 ? items : [])
        setNotFound(items.length === 0 ? `No customer found for “${query}”.` : null)
        if (items.length === 1) choose(items[0])
      },
      onError: () => setNotFound('The customer search failed. Please try again.'),
    })
  }
 
  const handleChange = (event) => {
    setText(event.target.value)
    setNotFound(null)
    if (customer) {
      setValue('customer', null)
      setValue('addressId', '')
    }
  }
 
  const error = notFound ?? formState.errors.customer?.message
 
  return (
    <Card title="Customer details" radius="md" padding="sm">
      <div className={styles.lookup}>
        <FormField label="Customer lookup / code" error={error} className={styles.lookupField}>
          {(field) => (
            <Input
              {...field}
              value={text}
              onChange={handleChange}
              onKeyDown={(event) => {
                if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                  event.preventDefault()
                  find()
                }
              }}
              placeholder="Customer code, name or mobile"
              autoComplete="off"
            />
          )}
        </FormField>
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" className={styles.find} loading={lookup.isPending} onClick={find}>
          Find
        </Button>
      </div>
 
      {matches.length > 0 && (
        <ul className={styles.matches} aria-label="Matching customers">
          {matches.map((match) => (
            <li key={match.code}>
              <button type="button" className={styles.match} onClick={() => choose(match)}>
                <strong>{labelOf(match)}</strong>
                <span>
                  {groupMobile(match.mobile)} · {match.addresses[0]?.city ?? 'No saved address'}
                </span>
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
 
      <div className="row gx-3 gy-0">
        <div className="col-12 col-md-5">
          <FormField label="Mobile">{(field) => <Input {...field} readOnly value={groupMobile(customer?.mobile)} />}</FormField>
        </div>
        <div className="col-12 col-md-7">
          <FormField label="Email">{(field) => <Input {...field} readOnly value={customer?.email ?? ''} />}</FormField>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

import { useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import AddressSummary from '@/components/molecules/AddressSummary'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import AddressPickerModal from '@/features/purchases/components/AddressPickerModal'
import styles from './DeliveryAddressCard.module.scss'
 
const SUPPLY_LABELS = { intra_state: 'Intra-state supply', inter_state: 'Inter-state supply' }
 
/** The address the purchase ships to, with the PIN serviceability and GST supply type the backend reports for it. */
export default function DeliveryAddressCard({ delivery }) {
  const { control, setValue, formState } = useFormContext()
  const customer = useWatch({ control, name: 'customer' })
  const addressId = useWatch({ control, name: 'addressId' })
  const picker = useDisclosure()
  const address = customer?.addresses.find((entry) => entry.id === addressId)
 
  return (
    <Card title="Delivery address" radius="md" padding="sm">
      {address ? (
        <div className={styles.address}>
          <p className={styles.heading}>
            {address.label}
            {address.isDefault && ' · Default'}
            {address.verified && <Badge tone="success">Verified</Badge>}
          </p>
          <AddressSummary address={address} className={styles.summary} />
          <div className={styles.meta}>
            {delivery && (
              <Badge tone={delivery.serviceable ? 'success' : 'danger'}>
                {delivery.serviceable ? `PIN ${delivery.pin} serviceable` : `PIN ${delivery.pin} not serviceable`}
              </Badge>
            )}
            {customer.addresses.length > 1 && (
              <Button variant="link" size="sm" onClick={picker.open}>
                Change address
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
          {delivery && (
            <p className={styles.gst}>
              GST state code: {delivery.gstStateCode} · {SUPPLY_LABELS[delivery.supply] ?? delivery.supply}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className={styles.empty}>
          {customer ? 'This customer has no saved delivery address.' : 'Find a customer to see their saved delivery address.'}
        </p>
      )}
      {formState.errors.addressId && !address && customer && (
        <p role="alert" className={styles.error}>
          {formState.errors.addressId.message}
        </p>
      )}
 
      {picker.isOpen && (
        <AddressPickerModal
          addresses={customer.addresses}
          selectedId={addressId}
          onSelect={(id) => setValue('addressId', id, { shouldValidate: true })}
          onClose={picker.close}
        />
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/purchases/components/LineItemsCard/LineItemsCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Controller, useFieldArray, useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import IconButton from '@/components/atoms/IconButton'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import QuantityStepper from '@/components/molecules/QuantityStepper'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import { useSellableProducts } from '@/features/purchases/hooks/usePurchases'
import { formatINR, formatNumber, formatPercent, pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './LineItemsCard.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Product picker, editable line items and the payment method. Prices, PV, GST and availability for
 * each line come from the backend quote; the screen only shows them. Until the quote arrives a new
 * line shows placeholders.
 */
export default function LineItemsCard({ quote, paymentMethods, reference }) {
  const { control, formState } = useFormContext()
  const { fields, append, update, remove } = useFieldArray({ control, name: 'lines' })
  const lines = useWatch({ control, name: 'lines' })
  const { data: products = [], isPending: productsPending } = useSellableProducts()
  const [pendingCode, setPendingCode] = useState(null)
 
  const quoted = Object.fromEntries((quote?.lines ?? []).map((line) => [line.productCode, line]))
  const options = products.map((product) => ({ value: product.code, label: `${product.code} · ${product.name} (${product.unit})` }))
  const rows = fields.map((field, index) => ({ ...field, index, quantity: lines?.[index]?.quantity ?? field.quantity }))
  const lineError = formState.errors.lines?.message ?? formState.errors.lines?.root?.message
 
  const addItem = () => {
    const product = products.find((entry) => entry.code === pendingCode)
    if (!product) return
    const index = fields.findIndex((field) => field.productCode === product.code)
    if (index >= 0) {
      const current = lines[index].quantity
      update(index, { productCode: product.code, name: product.name, quantity: Math.min(current + 1, product.stock) })
    } else {
      append({ productCode: product.code, name: product.name, quantity: 1 })
    }
    setPendingCode(null)
  }
 
  const units = rows.reduce((total, row) => total + row.quantity, 0)
  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'product',
      header: 'Code / product',
      cell: (row) => (
        <>
          {row.productCode} · {row.name}
          {quoted[row.productCode] && !quoted[row.productCode].available && (
            <span className={styles.shortage}>Only {formatNumber(quoted[row.productCode].availableStock)} in stock</span>
          )}
        </>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'quantity',
      header: 'Qty',
      cell: (row) => (
        <QuantityStepper
          size="sm"
          label={`Quantity of ${row.name}`}
          value={row.quantity}
          max={quoted[row.productCode]?.maxQuantity}
          onChange={(quantity) => update(row.index, { productCode: row.productCode, name: row.name, quantity })}
        />
      ),
    },
    { key: 'pv', header: 'PV', cell: (row) => (quoted[row.productCode] ? formatNumber(quoted[row.productCode].linePv) : '—') },
    { key: 'mrp', header: 'MRP', cell: (row) => (quoted[row.productCode] ? formatINR(quoted[row.productCode].mrp) : '—') },
    { key: 'unitPrice', header: 'Unit incl. tax', cell: (row) => (quoted[row.productCode] ? formatINR(quoted[row.productCode].unitPrice) : '—') },
    { key: 'gst', header: 'GST', cell: (row) => (quoted[row.productCode] ? formatPercent(quoted[row.productCode].gstPercent) : '—') },
    { key: 'amount', header: 'Amount', cell: (row) => (quoted[row.productCode] ? formatINR(quoted[row.productCode].lineTotal) : '—') },
  ]
 
  const availability = quote?.availability
 
  return (
    <Card title="Purchase line items" radius="md" padding="sm" className={styles.card}>
      <div className={styles.picker}>
        <FormField label="Product code / name" className={styles.pickerField}>
          {(field) => (
            <SelectField
              id={field.id}
              size="md"
              isSearchable
              isLoading={productsPending}
              options={options}
              value={pendingCode}
              onChange={setPendingCode}
              placeholder="Search HL001, shampoo…"
              noOptionsMessage={() => 'No matching product in stock'}
            />
          )}
        </FormField>
        <Button leftIcon="plus-lg" disabled={!pendingCode} onClick={addItem}>
          Add item
        </Button>
      </div>
 
      <DataTable
        className={styles.table}
        caption="Purchase line items"
        columns={columns}
        rows={rows}
        minWidth="640px"
        actionsHeader={<span className="visually-hidden">Remove</span>}
        rowActions={(row) => <IconButton icon="x-lg" size="sm" label={`Remove ${row.name}`} onClick={() => remove(row.index)} />}
        emptyState={<EmptyState compact icon="cart-plus" title="No items yet" description="Search for a product above and add it to this purchase." />}
      />
      {lineError && (
        <p role="alert" className={styles.error}>
          {lineError}
        </p>
      )}
 
      <div className={styles.totals}>
        <p>
          {quote
            ? `${pluralize(quote.summary.products, 'product')} · ${pluralize(quote.summary.units, 'unit')} · Total PV ${formatNumber(quote.summary.totalPv)}`
            : `${pluralize(rows.length, 'product')} · ${pluralize(units, 'unit')}`}
        </p>
        {quote && <p className={styles.items}>Items {formatINR(quote.summary.itemsTotal, { decimals: 2 })}</p>}
      </div>
 
      <div className="row g-3">
        <div className="col-12 col-md-6">
          <FormField label="Payment method" error={formState.errors.paymentMethod?.message}>
            {(field) => (
              <Controller
                name="paymentMethod"
                control={control}
                render={({ field: { value, onChange } }) => (
                  <SelectField id={field.id} size="md" invalid={field.invalid} options={paymentMethods} value={value} onChange={onChange} />
                )}
              />
            )}
          </FormField>
        </div>
        <div className="col-12 col-md-6">
          <FormField label="Reference">{(field) => <Input {...field} size="md" readOnly value={reference ?? 'To be generated'} />}</FormField>
        </div>
      </div>
 
      <p className={availability && !availability.allAvailable ? styles.unavailable : styles.available} role="status">
        <Icon name={availability && !availability.allAvailable ? 'exclamation-circle' : 'check2'} />{' '}
        {availability && !availability.allAvailable ? availability.message : 'All quantities are available. Prices are GST-inclusive.'}
      </p>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/purchases/components/PurchaseForm/PurchaseForm.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { FormProvider, useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { selectCurrentUser } from '@/app/store'
import CustomerCard from '@/features/purchases/components/CustomerCard'
import DeliveryAddressCard from '@/features/purchases/components/DeliveryAddressCard'
import LineItemsCard from '@/features/purchases/components/LineItemsCard'
import PurchaseSummaryCard from '@/features/purchases/components/PurchaseSummaryCard'
import { usePurchaseQuote, useSavePurchase } from '@/features/purchases/hooks/usePurchases'
import { purchaseSchema } from '@/features/purchases/schemas/purchaseSchema'
import styles from './PurchaseForm.module.scss'
 
function toDefaultValues(purchase, paymentMethods) {
  if (!purchase) return { customer: null, addressId: '', lines: [], useWallet: false, paymentMethod: paymentMethods[0]?.value ?? '' }
  return {
    customer: purchase.customer,
    addressId: purchase.address.id,
    lines: purchase.lines.map(({ productCode, name, quantity }) => ({ productCode, name, quantity })),
    useWallet: purchase.useWallet,
    paymentMethod: purchase.paymentMethod,
  }
}
 
/**
 * The create-purchase form: customer, delivery address, line items and the backend quote. A new quote
 * is requested whenever the customer, address, items or wallet choice changes. `purchase` is a saved
 * draft being continued. "Save draft" keeps it for later; "Create purchase" raises the payment request.
 */
export default function PurchaseForm({ draftNumber, paymentMethods, purchase = null }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const user = useSelector(selectCurrentUser)
  const save = useSavePurchase()
  const methods = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(purchaseSchema), defaultValues: toDefaultValues(purchase, paymentMethods) })
  const [customer, addressId, lines, useWallet, paymentMethod] = useWatch({
    control: methods.control,
    name: ['customer', 'addressId', 'lines', 'useWallet', 'paymentMethod'],
  })
 
  const request =
    customer && addressId
      ? { customerCode: customer.code, addressId, lines: lines.map(({ productCode, quantity }) => ({ productCode, quantity })), useWallet }
      : null
  const { data: quote, isError: quoteFailed, error: quoteError } = usePurchaseQuote(request)
 
  const pendingAction = save.isPending ? save.variables.action : null
  const collectLabel = paymentMethods.find((method) => method.value === paymentMethod)?.collectLabel ?? 'Collect payment'
  const canSubmit = Boolean(quote) && quote.delivery.serviceable && quote.availability.allAvailable && lines.length > 0
 
  const saveAs = (action) =>
    methods.handleSubmit((values) => {
      save.mutate(
        {
          action,
          purchaseNumber: draftNumber,
          customerCode: values.customer.code,
          addressId: values.addressId,
          lines: values.lines.map(({ productCode, quantity }) => ({ productCode, quantity })),
          useWallet: values.useWallet,
          paymentMethod: values.paymentMethod,
        },
        {
          onSuccess: (saved) => {
            toast.success(
              action === 'submit'
                ? `${saved.purchaseNumber} created. Payment request sent to ${saved.customer.name}.`
                : `${saved.purchaseNumber} saved as a draft.`,
            )
            navigate(paths.admin.purchases)
          },
        },
      )
    })
 
  const serverError = save.isError ? getErrorMessage(save.error) : quoteFailed ? getErrorMessage(quoteError) : null
 
  return (
    <FormProvider {...methods}>
      <form noValidate className={styles.form} onSubmit={(event) => event.preventDefault()}>
        <div className={styles.topRow}>
          <CustomerCard />
          <DeliveryAddressCard delivery={quote?.delivery} />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.bottomRow}>
          <LineItemsCard quote={quote} paymentMethods={paymentMethods} reference={purchase?.reference} />
          <PurchaseSummaryCard
            quote={quote}
            collectLabel={collectLabel}
            pendingAction={pendingAction}
            canSubmit={canSubmit}
            serverError={serverError}
            onSave={(action) => saveAs(action)()}
          />
        </div>
        <p className={styles.footnote}>
          Purchase will reserve stock and send the payment request to {customer?.name ?? 'the customer'}. Created by{' '}
          {purchase?.createdBy ?? user?.name}.
        </p>
      </form>
    </FormProvider>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/purchases/components/PurchaseSummaryCard/PurchaseSummaryCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useFormContext } from 'react-hook-form'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import SummaryRows from '@/components/molecules/SummaryRows'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './PurchaseSummaryCard.module.scss'
 
const money = (value) => formatINR(value, { decimals: 2 })
 
function taxRows(summary) {
  const split =
    summary.gstType === 'inter_state'
      ? [{ label: 'IGST', value: money(summary.igst) }]
      : [
          { label: 'CGST', value: money(summary.cgst) },
          { label: 'SGST', value: money(summary.sgst) },
        ]
  return [{ label: 'Taxable value', value: money(summary.taxableSubtotal) }, ...split, { label: 'Shipping', value: money(summary.shipping) }]
}
 
/**
 * Backend-calculated totals (taxable value, CGST/SGST or IGST, shipping, gross, wallet, amount to
 * collect) and the two ways to save the purchase. Nothing here is added up on the client.
 */
export default function PurchaseSummaryCard({ quote, collectLabel, pendingAction, canSubmit, serverError, onSave }) {
  const { register } = useFormContext()
  const summary = quote?.summary
  const wallet = quote?.wallet
  const busy = pendingAction !== null
 
  return (
    <Card title="Purchase summary" radius="md" padding="sm" className={styles.card}>
      {summary ? (
        <>
          <SummaryRows rows={taxRows(summary)} />
          <div className={styles.block}>
            <div className={styles.gross}>
              <span>Gross amount</span>
              <strong>{money(summary.grossAmount)}</strong>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.walletRow}>
              <Checkbox label="Apply wallet" disabled={!wallet.eligible || wallet.balance <= 0} {...register('useWallet')} />
              <span className={styles.walletAmount}>{money(wallet.applicable)}</span>
            </div>
            <p className={styles.walletNote}>
              Available {formatINR(wallet.balance)} · Closing balance {formatINR(wallet.balanceAfter)}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.collect}>
            <span>{collectLabel}</span>
            <strong>{money(summary.payable)}</strong>
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <p className={styles.placeholder}>Totals appear once a customer and at least one item are added.</p>
      )}
 
      {serverError && <Alert tone="danger">{serverError}</Alert>}
 
      <div className={styles.actions}>
        <Button size="lg" className={styles.primary} loading={pendingAction === 'submit'} disabled={busy || !canSubmit} onClick={() => onSave('submit')}>
          Create purchase
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" loading={pendingAction === 'draft'} disabled={busy} onClick={() => onSave('draft')}>
          Save draft
        </Button>
      </div>
    </Card>
  )
}
```
