## `src/features/purchases/components/PurchasesWorkspace/PurchasesWorkspace.jsx`
 
  
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import IconButton from '@/components/atoms/IconButton'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import SearchField from '@/components/molecules/SearchField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import ConfirmDialog from '@/components/organisms/ConfirmDialog'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import { PURCHASE_PAGE_SIZE, usePurchaseFilters } from '@/features/purchases/hooks/usePurchaseFilters'
import { useCancelPurchase, usePurchases } from '@/features/purchases/hooks/usePurchases'
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR, pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import { useDebouncedValue } from '@/hooks/useDebouncedValue'
import styles from './PurchasesWorkspace.module.scss'
 
const STATUS_FILTER_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'All' },
  { value: 'draft', label: 'Draft' },
  { value: 'payment_pending', label: 'Payment pending' },
  { value: 'paid', label: 'Paid' },
  { value: 'cancelled', label: 'Cancelled' },
]
 
const OPEN_STATUSES = ['draft', 'payment_pending']
 
const toSortState = (sort) => (sort ? { key: sort.replace(/^-/, ''), direction: sort.startsWith('-') ? 'desc' : 'asc' } : null)
const toSortParam = (sort) => (sort ? `${sort.direction === 'desc' ? '-' : ''}${sort.key}` : '')
 
/** Admin purchase list: search, status filter, sortable table, continue a draft and cancel an open purchase. */
export default function PurchasesWorkspace() {
  const { filters, update, initialSearch } = usePurchaseFilters()
  const [searchText, setSearchText] = useState(initialSearch)
  const [cancelTarget, setCancelTarget] = useState(null)
  const search = useDebouncedValue(searchText.trim(), 300)
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = usePurchases({
    q: search,
    status: filters.status,
    sort: filters.sort || undefined,
    page: filters.page,
    pageSize: PURCHASE_PAGE_SIZE,
  })
  const cancelPurchase = useCancelPurchase()
 
  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearchText('')
    update({ status: 'all' })
  }
 
  const confirmCancel = () => {
    cancelPurchase.mutate(cancelTarget.purchaseNumber, {
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(`${cancelTarget.purchaseNumber} cancelled.`)
        setCancelTarget(null)
      },
      onError: (failure) => {
        toast.error(getErrorMessage(failure))
        setCancelTarget(null)
      },
    })
  }
 
  const columns = [
    { key: 'purchaseNumber', header: 'Purchase no.', cell: (row) => <strong>{row.purchaseNumber}</strong> },
    {
      key: 'customerName',
      header: 'Customer',
      sortable: true,
      cell: (row) => (
        <>
          {row.customerName}
          <span className={styles.code}>{row.customerCode}</span>
        </>
      ),
    },
    { key: 'createdAt', header: 'Created', sortable: true, cell: (row) => formatDateTime(row.createdAt) },
    {
      key: 'items',
      header: 'Items',
      cell: (row) => `${pluralize(row.products, 'product')} · ${pluralize(row.units, 'unit')}`,
    },
    { key: 'grossAmount', header: 'Total', sortable: true, align: 'right', cell: (row) => formatINR(row.grossAmount, { decimals: 2 }) },
    { key: 'paymentLabel', header: 'Payment', cell: (row) => row.paymentLabel },
    { key: 'status', header: 'Status', cell: (row) => <StatusBadge status={row.status} /> },
  ]
 
  const rows = data?.items ?? []
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Purchases"
        description="Purchases created for customers, with their payment status."
        actions={
          <Button as={Link} to={paths.admin.newPurchase} leftIcon="plus-lg" size="sm">
            Create purchase
          </Button>
        }
      />
 
      <div className={styles.toolbar}>
        <SearchField
          className={styles.search}
          size="sm"
          value={searchText}
          onChange={(value) => {
            setSearchText(value)
            update({})
          }}
          placeholder="Search purchase no., customer or reference"
          aria-label="Search purchases by number, customer or reference"
        />
        <div className={styles.status}>
          <SelectField
            size="sm"
            prefixLabel="Status:"
            aria-label="Filter by status"
            options={STATUS_FILTER_OPTIONS}
            value={filters.status}
            onChange={(value) => update({ status: value })}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
 
      <Card padding="md" radius="md" className={styles.card} aria-label="Purchases">
        {isError && !data ? (
          <ErrorState title="Purchases could not be loaded" message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} compact />
        ) : (
          <DataTable
            className={styles.table}
            caption="Purchases"
            columns={columns}
            rows={rows}
            loading={isPending}
            loadingRows={PURCHASE_PAGE_SIZE}
            getRowId={(row) => row.purchaseNumber}
            sort={toSortState(filters.sort)}
            onSortChange={(next) => update({ sort: toSortParam(next) })}
            minWidth="860px"
            actionsHeader={<span className="visually-hidden">Actions</span>}
            rowActions={(row) =>
              OPEN_STATUSES.includes(row.status) ? (
                <div className={styles.actions}>
                  {row.status === 'draft' && (
                    <Button as={Link} to={`${paths.admin.newPurchase}?draft=${row.purchaseNumber}`} variant="secondary" size="sm">
                      Continue
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  <IconButton icon="x-circle" tone="danger" size="sm" label={`Cancel ${row.purchaseNumber}`} onClick={() => setCancelTarget(row)} />
                </div>
              ) : null
            }
            emptyState={
              <EmptyState
                compact
                icon="receipt"
                title="No purchases match these filters"
                description="Try a different search or clear the filters."
                action={
                  <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={clearFilters}>
                    Clear filters
                  </Button>
                }
              />
            }
            pagination={{
              page: filters.page,
              pageSize: PURCHASE_PAGE_SIZE,
              totalItems: data?.totalItems ?? 0,
              onPageChange: (page) => update({ page }),
              itemLabel: 'purchases',
            }}
          />
        )}
      </Card>
 
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={Boolean(cancelTarget)}
        onClose={() => setCancelTarget(null)}
        onConfirm={confirmCancel}
        loading={cancelPurchase.isPending}
        tone="danger"
        title={`Cancel ${cancelTarget?.purchaseNumber ?? 'purchase'}?`}
        message={
          <p>
            {cancelTarget && `${cancelTarget.purchaseNumber} for ${cancelTarget.customerName} will be closed and any payment request withdrawn. This cannot be undone.`}
          </p>
        }
        confirmLabel="Cancel purchase"
        cancelLabel="Keep purchase"
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/purchases/hooks/usePurchaseFilters.js`
 
```javascript
import { useCallback, useState } from 'react'
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
 
export const PURCHASE_PAGE_SIZE = 8
 
const STATUS_VALUES = ['all', 'draft', 'payment_pending', 'paid', 'cancelled']
const DEFAULTS = { status: 'all', sort: '', page: 1 }
 
/**
 * Purchase list filters kept in the URL (?status=&sort=&page=) so a view can be linked. Changing a
 * filter returns to page 1. The search text is local state, seeded from ?q= once.
 */
export function usePurchaseFilters() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams()
  const [initialSearch] = useState(() => searchParams.get('q') ?? '')
 
  const status = searchParams.get('status')
  const filters = {
    status: STATUS_VALUES.includes(status) ? status : DEFAULTS.status,
    sort: searchParams.get('sort') ?? DEFAULTS.sort,
    page: Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(searchParams.get('page') ?? '1', 10) || 1),
  }
 
  const update = useCallback(
    (changes) => {
      setSearchParams(
        (current) => {
          const next = new URLSearchParams(current)
          if (!('page' in changes)) next.delete('page')
          Object.entries(changes).forEach(([key, value]) => {
            if (value === undefined || value === null || value === DEFAULTS[key]) next.delete(key)
            else next.set(key, String(value))
          })
          return next
        },
        { replace: true },
      )
    },
    [setSearchParams],
  )
 
  return { filters, update, initialSearch }
}
```
 
## `src/features/purchases/hooks/usePurchases.js`
 
```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import {
  cancelPurchase,
  findCustomers,
  getPurchase,
  getPurchaseDraft,
  getPurchaseQuote,
  listPurchases,
  listSellableProducts,
  savePurchase,
} from '@/features/purchases/services/purchaseService'
 
export const purchaseKeys = {
  all: ['admin', 'purchases'],
  lists: ['admin', 'purchases', 'list'],
  list: (params) => ['admin', 'purchases', 'list', params],
  draft: ['admin', 'purchases', 'draft'],
  items: ['admin', 'purchases', 'item'],
  item: (purchaseNumber) => ['admin', 'purchases', 'item', purchaseNumber],
  products: ['admin', 'purchases', 'products'],
  quote: (request) => ['admin', 'purchases', 'quote', request],
}
 
export function usePurchases(params) {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: purchaseKeys.list(params), queryFn: () => listPurchases(params), placeholderData: keepPreviousData })
}
 
/**
 * The next draft number and the payment methods the backend offers. It is fetched once per visit to the
 * form and never refreshed underneath it (a new number mid-edit would reset the form), so it is dropped
 * as soon as the form closes and saving does not invalidate it.
 */
export function usePurchaseDraft() {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: purchaseKeys.draft, queryFn: getPurchaseDraft, gcTime: 0, staleTime: Infinity, refetchOnWindowFocus: false })
}
 
/** A saved purchase, loaded to continue editing a draft. */
export function usePurchase(purchaseNumber) {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: purchaseKeys.item(purchaseNumber), queryFn: () => getPurchase(purchaseNumber), enabled: Boolean(purchaseNumber) })
}
 
export function useCustomerLookup() {
  return useMutation({ mutationFn: findCustomers })
}
 
/** Products an admin can add to a purchase right now (active and in stock). */
export function useSellableProducts() {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: purchaseKeys.products, queryFn: listSellableProducts, staleTime: 60_000 })
}
 
/**
 * Backend price quote for the current form. Nothing is added up on the client; the previous quote
 * stays on screen while a new one loads. `request` is null until a customer and address are chosen.
 */
export function usePurchaseQuote(request) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: purchaseKeys.quote(request),
    queryFn: () => getPurchaseQuote(request),
    enabled: request !== null,
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    staleTime: 0,
  })
}
 
// The purchase list and any open draft are refreshed; the form's own draft number is left alone (see above).
function refreshPurchases(queryClient) {
  return Promise.all([
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: purchaseKeys.lists }),
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: purchaseKeys.items }),
  ])
}
 
export function useSavePurchase() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  return useMutation({ mutationFn: savePurchase, onSuccess: () => refreshPurchases(queryClient) })
}
 
export function useCancelPurchase() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  return useMutation({ mutationFn: cancelPurchase, onSuccess: () => refreshPurchases(queryClient) })
}
```

  customer: z
    .object({ code: z.string() })
    .loose()
    .nullable()
    .refine(Boolean, 'Find the customer first'),

  lines: z

        productCode: z.string().min(1),
        name: z.string(),
        quantity: z.number().int().min(1, 'Quantity must be at least 1'),
      }),
    )
    .min(1, 'Add at least one item'),
  useWallet: z.boolean(),
  paymentMethod: z.string().min(1, 'Choose a payment method'),
})

## `src/features/purchases/services/purchaseService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: every path, payload and response below. A "purchase" is an
// assisted purchase an admin creates for a customer (design p-14), not a supplier purchase order.
//
// GET  /admin/purchases?page&pageSize&q&status=all|draft|payment_pending|paid|cancelled&sort=[-]createdAt|grossAmount|customerName
//      → { items: [{ purchaseNumber, status, customerCode, customerName, createdAt, createdBy, products,
//          units, grossAmount, payable, paymentLabel, reference }], page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount,
//          statusOptions: [{ value, label }] }
// GET  /admin/purchases/draft → { purchaseNumber, createdBy, paymentMethods: [{ value, label, collectLabel }] }
// GET  /admin/purchases/:purchaseNumber → Purchase (below), used to resume a draft
// GET  /admin/purchases/customers?q= → { items: Customer[] }
//      Customer = { code, name, mobile, email, walletBalance, addresses: [{ id, label, name, mobile, line1,
//                   line2, landmark, city, state, pin, isDefault, verified }] }
// GET  /admin/purchases/products → { items: [{ code, name, unit, stock }] } (products that can be sold now)
// POST /admin/purchases/quote { customerCode, addressId, lines: [{ productCode, quantity }], useWallet } → Quote
//      Quote = { lines: [{ productCode, name, unit, quantity, pv, linePv, mrp, unitPrice, gstPercent, lineTotal,
//                          availableStock, maxQuantity, available }],
//                summary: { products, units, totalPv, itemsTotal, taxableSubtotal, gstTotal, cgst, sgst, igst,
//                           gstType: 'intra_state' | 'inter_state', gstStateCode, shipping, grossAmount,
//                           couponDiscount, walletApplied, payable },
//                wallet: { balance, eligible, applicable, applied, balanceAfter },
//                delivery: { addressId, pin, city, state, serviceable, gstStateCode, supply },
//                availability: { allAvailable, message } }
//      Every amount, tax split and availability flag is calculated by the backend.
// POST /admin/purchases { action: 'draft' | 'submit', purchaseNumber, customerCode, addressId, lines, useWallet,
//      paymentMethod } → Purchase = { purchaseNumber, status, customer, address, lines, summary, wallet,
//      delivery, useWallet, paymentMethod, paymentLabel, collectLabel, reference, createdAt, createdBy }
//      "submit" raises the payment request through the payment provider (Razorpay) on the backend.
// POST /admin/purchases/:purchaseNumber/cancel → the cancelled list item
 
export async function listPurchases(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.purchases.list, { params })
  return data
}
 
export async function getPurchaseDraft() {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.purchases.draft)
  return data
}
 
export async function getPurchase(purchaseNumber) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.purchases.item(purchaseNumber))
  return data
}
 
export async function findCustomers(q) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.purchases.customers, { params: { q } })
  return data.items
}
 
export async function listSellableProducts() {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.purchases.productOptions)
  return data.items
}
 
export async function getPurchaseQuote(request) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.admin.purchases.quote, request)
  return data
}
 
export async function savePurchase(payload) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.admin.purchases.list, payload)
  return data
}
 
export async function cancelPurchase(purchaseNumber) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.admin.purchases.cancel(purchaseNumber))
  return data
}
```

```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { formatNumber, formatPercent } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './BreakdownBars.module.scss'
 
// Colour follows the status, never its position, so a bar keeps its colour whatever the mix.
const TONES = { delivered: 'success', in_transit: 'primary', pending: 'warning', returned: 'danger' }
 
/**
 * Share-of-orders bars. items: [{ key, label, count, percent }] — counts and percentages come from the
 * backend. The bar is decoration: the label, count and percentage beside it carry the information.
 */
export default function BreakdownBars({ items, className }) {
  return (
    <ul className={clsx(styles.list, className)}>
      {items.map((item) => (
        <li key={item.key} className={styles.item}>
          <p className={styles.row}>
            <span>{item.label}</span>
            <span>
              {formatNumber(item.count)} · {formatPercent(item.percent)}
            </span>
          </p>
          <span className={styles.track} aria-hidden="true">
            <span className={clsx(styles.bar, styles[TONES[item.key] ?? 'primary'])} style={{ width: `${item.percent}%` }} />
          </span>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import Popover from '@/components/molecules/Popover'
import styles from './ColumnsMenu.module.scss'
 
/**
 * "Columns" button with a checklist of optional table columns.
 *   options: [{ key, label }]   visible: string[] of the keys currently shown   onChange(nextKeys)
 */
export default function ColumnsMenu({ options, visible, onChange }) {
  const toggle = (key) => onChange(visible.includes(key) ? visible.filter((entry) => entry !== key) : [...visible, key])
 
  return (
    <Popover
      align="end"
      trigger={({ props }) => (
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" rightIcon="chevron-down" {...props}>
          Columns
        </Button>
      )}
    >
      <fieldset className={styles.menu}>
        <legend className={styles.legend}>Show more columns</legend>
        {options.map((option) => (
          <Checkbox key={option.key} label={option.label} checked={visible.includes(option.key)} onChange={() => toggle(option.key)} />
        ))}
      </fieldset>
    </Popover>
  )
}

import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import { formatDate } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR, formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import { OPTIONAL_COLUMNS } from './optionalColumns'
import styles from './FinancialLinesTable.module.scss'
 
const money = (key) => (row) => formatINR(row[key], { decimals: 2 })
 
const twoLines = (first, second) => (
  <span className={styles.twoLines}>
    <span>{first}</span>
    <span>{second}</span>
  </span>
)
 
/** Columns shown by default (as in the design). */
const CORE_COLUMNS = {
  orderDate: {
    key: 'orderDate',
    header: 'Order / date',
    sortable: true,
    cell: (row) =>
      twoLines(
        <Link to={paths.admin.order(row.orderNumber)} className={styles.orderLink}>
          {row.orderNumber}
        </Link>,
        formatDate(row.orderDate),
      ),
  },
  customerName: { key: 'customerName', header: 'Customer', sortable: true },
  product: { key: 'product', header: 'Product / HSN', cell: (row) => twoLines(`${row.productCode} · ${row.productName}`, `${row.hsn} · GST ${row.gstPercent}%`) },
  quantity: { key: 'quantity', header: 'Qty', sortable: true, cell: (row) => formatNumber(row.quantity) },
  taxable: { key: 'taxable', header: 'Taxable', sortable: true, cell: money('taxable') },
  gst: { key: 'gst', header: 'GST', sortable: true, cell: money('gst') },
  lineTotal: { key: 'lineTotal', header: 'Line total', sortable: true, cell: money('lineTotal') },
  status: { key: 'status', header: 'Status', cell: (row) => <StatusBadge status={row.status} /> },
}
 
// A table column without the menu-only `label`.
const optional = (key) => {
  const { label: _label, ...column } = OPTIONAL_COLUMNS.find((entry) => entry.key === key)
  return column
}
 
/**
 * The line-item table of the financial report. Order of columns: taxable value and the GST split next to
 * it, then the line total with shipping, wallet and net payable, then status.
 */
export default function FinancialLinesTable({ rows, visibleOptional, loading, sort, onSortChange, selectedIds, onSelectionChange, pagination, className }) {
  const has = (key) => visibleOptional.includes(key)
  const columns = [
    CORE_COLUMNS.orderDate,
    CORE_COLUMNS.customerName,
    CORE_COLUMNS.product,
    CORE_COLUMNS.quantity,
    CORE_COLUMNS.taxable,
    CORE_COLUMNS.gst,
    ...['cgst', 'sgst', 'igst'].filter(has).map(optional),
    CORE_COLUMNS.lineTotal,
    ...['shipping', 'wallet', 'net'].filter(has).map(optional),
    CORE_COLUMNS.status,
  ]
 
  return (
    <DataTable
      className={className}
      caption="Financial report: one row per product line, with taxable value, GST and line total"
      columns={columns}
      rows={rows}
      getRowId={(row) => row.id}
      getRowLabel={(row) => `${row.productCode} on order ${row.orderNumber}`}
      selectable
      selectedIds={selectedIds}
      onSelectionChange={onSelectionChange}
      sort={sort}
      onSortChange={onSortChange}
      loading={loading}
      loadingRows={4}
      pagination={pagination}
      minWidth="62rem"
    />
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import { DateRangeFilter, EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE, fetchAllPages, ListToolbar, REPORT_DATE_RANGES, StatGrid, useExcelExport, useListParams } from '@/features/admin-lists'
import { ORDER_STATUS_OPTIONS } from '@/features/admin-orders/constants/orderOptions'
import { useCustomerOptions } from '@/features/customers'
import ColumnsMenu from '@/features/reports/components/ColumnsMenu'
import FinancialLinesTable from '@/features/reports/components/FinancialLinesTable'
import { OPTIONAL_COLUMNS } from '@/features/reports/components/FinancialLinesTable/optionalColumns'
import FinancialSummary from '@/features/reports/components/FinancialSummary'
import ReconciliationCards from '@/features/reports/components/ReconciliationCards'
import { useFinancialReport, useOrderReconciliation } from '@/features/reports/hooks/useReports'
import { financialSheet, financialSheetRows } from '@/features/reports/lib/financialSheet'
import { getFinancialReport } from '@/features/reports/services/reportService'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './FinancialReport.module.scss'
 
// Matches the design's 4-row page; the pager reaches every line.
const PAGE_SIZE = 4
 
/** The Customer & order financial report screen (filters, summary, selectable line table, reconciliation). */
export default function FinancialReport() {
  const list = useListParams({ pageSize: PAGE_SIZE, filters: { range: 'this_month', from: '', to: '', status: '', customer: '' } })
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useFinancialReport(list.apiParams)
  const customerOptions = useCustomerOptions()
  const exporter = useExcelExport()
  const [visibleOptional, setVisibleOptional] = useState([])
  const [selection, setSelection] = useState({ scope: '', rows: [] })
 
  // A selection belongs to the filters it was made under; changing them starts a new one.
  const scope = JSON.stringify({ ...list.apiParams, page: undefined, sort: undefined })
  const selectedRows = selection.scope === scope ? selection.rows : []
  const rows = data?.items ?? []
 
  const changeSelection = (ids) => {
    const known = new Map([...selectedRows, ...rows].map((row) => [row.id, row]))
    setSelection({ scope, rows: ids.map((id) => known.get(id)).filter(Boolean) })
  }
 
  const focusedOrder = selectedRows[0]?.orderNumber ?? rows[0]?.orderNumber
  const reconciliation = useOrderReconciliation(focusedOrder)
  const selectedOrders = new Set(selectedRows.map((row) => row.orderNumber))
 
  // Export Excel covers every line matching the filters; Export selected only the ticked lines.
  const exportAll = () =>
    exporter.mutate({
      ...financialSheet(data.period),
      getRows: async () => financialSheetRows(await fetchAllPages((page) => getFinancialReport({ ...list.apiParams, page, pageSize: EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE }))),
    })
 
  const exportSelected = () => exporter.mutate({ ...financialSheet(data.period), getRows: async () => financialSheetRows(selectedRows) })
 
  const toolbarFilters = [
    {
      key: 'range',
      node: (
        <DateRangeFilter
          compact
          label="Report period"
          value={{ range: list.filters.range, from: list.filters.from, to: list.filters.to }}
          period={data?.period}
          presets={REPORT_DATE_RANGES}
          onChange={list.setFilters}
        />
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Order status',
      prefix: 'Status:',
      options: ORDER_STATUS_OPTIONS,
      value: list.filters.status,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('status', value),
    },
    {
      key: 'customer',
      label: 'Customer',
      prefix: 'Customer:',
      searchable: true,
      options: [{ value: '', label: 'All' }, ...(customerOptions.data ?? []).map((customer) => ({ value: customer.code, label: `${customer.name} · ${customer.code}` }))],
      value: list.filters.customer,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('customer', value),
    },
  ]
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Customer & order financial report"
        description={
          <>
            <Link to={paths.admin.reports} className={styles.crumb}>
              Reports
            </Link>{' '}
            / Detailed report · GST-inclusive line items with wallet reconciliation.
          </>
        }
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" disabled={!data} loading={exporter.isPending && !selectedRows.length} onClick={exportAll}>
            Export Excel
          </Button>
        }
      />
 
      <ListToolbar
        search={{ ...list.search, label: 'Search customer, product or order ID', placeholder: 'Search customer, product or order ID' }}
        filters={toolbarFilters}
        hasActiveFilters={list.hasActiveFilters}
        onClear={list.reset}
      />
 
      {isError && <ErrorState message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} />}
 
      {!isError && (
        <>
          {data ? (
            <FinancialSummary summary={data.summary} />
          ) : (
            <StatGrid>
              {Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, index) => (
                <Skeleton key={index} height="7.1rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
              ))}
            </StatGrid>
          )}
 
          <Card padding="sm" radius="md" className={styles.tableCard} aria-label="Financial report lines">
            <div className={styles.tableHeader}>
              <p className={styles.selection}>
                {selectedRows.length > 0 ? (
                  <>
                    <span className={styles.selectedCount}>{formatNumber(selectedRows.length)} selected</span>
                    <span className={styles.selectionNote}>
                      Order {selectedRows[0].orderNumber}
                      {selectedOrders.size > 1 && ` +${selectedOrders.size - 1} more`} · Product-line view
                    </span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <span className={styles.selectionNote}>Product-line view · select lines to export them or see an order&rsquo;s reconciliation</span>
                )}
              </p>
              <div className={styles.tableActions}>
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={selectedRows.length === 0}
                  loading={exporter.isPending && selectedRows.length > 0}
                  onClick={exportSelected}
                >
                  Export selected
                </Button>
                <ColumnsMenu options={OPTIONAL_COLUMNS} visible={visibleOptional} onChange={setVisibleOptional} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <FinancialLinesTable
              className={styles.table}
              rows={rows}
              visibleOptional={visibleOptional}
              loading={isPending}
              sort={list.sortState}
              onSortChange={list.setSort}
              selectedIds={selectedRows.map((row) => row.id)}
              onSelectionChange={changeSelection}
              pagination={
                data && {
                  page: data.page,
                  pageSize: data.pageSize,
                  totalItems: data.totalItems,
                  onPageChange: list.setPage,
                  itemLabel: 'product lines',
                }
              }
            />
          </Card>
 
          {reconciliation.data && <ReconciliationCards data={reconciliation.data} selected={selectedRows.length > 0} />}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/reports/components/LineChart/chartMath.js`
 ```javascript
/** Round tick values from 0 up to the first "nice" step that covers `max`: niceTicks(22000) → [0, 5000 … 25000]. */
export function niceTicks(max, intervals = 5) {
  const rawStep = Math.max(max, 1) / intervals
  const magnitude = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(rawStep))
  const step = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map((factor) => factor * magnitude).find((candidate) => candidate >= rawStep)
  const count = Math.ceil(max / step)
  return Array.from({ length: count + 1 }, (_, index) => index * step)
}
 
/**
 * Smooth path through `points` ({ x, y }) that never overshoots the data (monotone cubic, Fritsch–Carlson),
 * so a curve cannot dip below a low day or peak above a high one.
 */
export function monotonePath(points) {
  const count = points.length
  if (count === 0) return ''
  if (count === 1) return `M${points[0].x},${points[0].y}`
 
  const widths = []
  const slopes = []
  for (let i = 0; i < count - 1; i += 1) {
    widths[i] = points[i + 1].x - points[i].x
    slopes[i] = (points[i + 1].y - points[i].y) / widths[i]
  }
  const tangents = [slopes[0]]
  for (let i = 1; i < count - 1; i += 1) {
    tangents[i] = slopes[i - 1] * slopes[i] <= 0 ? 0 : (slopes[i - 1] + slopes[i]) / 2
  }
  tangents[count - 1] = slopes[count - 2]
 
  for (let i = 0; i < count - 1; i += 1) {
    if (slopes[i] === 0) {
      tangents[i] = 0
      tangents[i + 1] = 0
      continue
    }
    const a = tangents[i] / slopes[i]
    const b = tangents[i + 1] / slopes[i]
    const magnitude = a * a + b * b
    if (magnitude > 9) {
      const scale = 3 / Math.sqrt(magnitude)
      tangents[i] = scale * a * slopes[i]
      tangents[i + 1] = scale * b * slopes[i]
    }
  }
 
  let path = `M${points[0].x},${points[0].y}`
  for (let i = 0; i < count - 1; i += 1) {
    const third = widths[i] / 3
    path += ` C${points[i].x + third},${points[i].y + tangents[i] * third} ${points[i + 1].x - third},${points[i + 1].y - tangents[i + 1] * third} ${points[i + 1].x},${points[i + 1].y}`
  }
  return path
}
 
/** Which x-axis labels to print: every day for a short range, otherwise the 5th, 10th … plus the first and last. */
export function axisLabelIndexes(count) {
  if (count <= 10) return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => index)
  const step = count <= 35 ? 5 : Math.ceil(count / 6)
  const indexes = [0]
  for (let index = step - 1; index < count - 1; index += step) indexes.push(index)
  if (count - 1 - indexes[indexes.length - 1] < Math.ceil(step / 2)) indexes.pop()
  indexes.push(count - 1)
  return indexes
}
```

## `src/features/reports/components/LineChart/LineChart.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { axisLabelIndexes, monotonePath, niceTicks } from './chartMath'
import styles from './LineChart.module.scss'
 
const MARGIN = { top: 12, right: 12, bottom: 30, left: 48 }
const compactNumber = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1 })
const formatTick = (value) => (value === 0 ? '₹0' : `₹${compactNumber.format(value)}`)
 
function useElementWidth() {
  const ref = useRef(null)
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(0)
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = ref.current
    if (!element) return undefined
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => setWidth(Math.round(entry.contentRect.width)))
    observer.observe(element)
    return () => observer.disconnect()
  }, [])
  return [ref, width]
}
 
const extremes = (points) => ({
  high: points.reduce((best, point) => (point.value > best.value ? point : best), points[0]),
  low: points.reduce((best, point) => (point.value < best.value ? point : best), points[0]),
})
 
/**
 * Accessible line chart drawn in SVG (the project has no chart library).
 *
 *   series: [{ key, label, variant: 'current' | 'previous', total?, points: [{ label, axisLabel, value }] }]
 * Every series has the same number of points, aligned by index. `value`s and `total` come from the backend;
 * the chart only positions them. `formatValue` renders money in the tooltip, the summary and the table.
 *
 * Reading the data without a mouse: the chart is focusable and ←/→/Home/End step through the days, the
 * values are announced, and a visually hidden table lists every point. Tooltips only repeat what the table says.
 */
export default function LineChart({ title, yAxisLabel, series, formatValue, busy = false, height = 240, className }) {
  const [containerRef, width] = useElementWidth()
  const [active, setActive] = useState(null)
  const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = useState('')
 
  const primary = series[0]
  const count = primary.points.length
  const plotWidth = Math.max(width - MARGIN.left - MARGIN.right, 0)
  const plotHeight = height - MARGIN.top - MARGIN.bottom
  const maxValue = Math.max(...series.flatMap((entry) => entry.points.map((point) => point.value)))
  const ticks = niceTicks(maxValue)
  const top = ticks[ticks.length - 1]
 
  const xAt = (index) => MARGIN.left + (count === 1 ? plotWidth / 2 : (index * plotWidth) / (count - 1))
  const yAt = (value) => MARGIN.top + plotHeight * (1 - value / top)
 
  const summary = [
    title,
    ...series.map((entry) => {
      const { high, low } = extremes(entry.points)
      const total = entry.total === undefined ? '' : `total ${formatValue(entry.total)}, `
      return `${entry.label}: ${total}highest ${formatValue(high.value)} on ${high.label}, lowest ${formatValue(low.value)} on ${low.label}.`
    }),
  ].join(' ')
 
  const describe = (index) =>
    series.map((entry) => `${entry.label} ${entry.points[index].label}: ${formatValue(entry.points[index].value)}`).join('. ')
 
  const handlePointerMove = (event) => {
    // The hit area starts at the left edge of the plot, so its own box is the reference.
    const box = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
    const ratio = plotWidth === 0 ? 0 : (event.clientX - box.left) / plotWidth
    setActive(Math.min(count - 1, Math.max(0, Math.round(ratio * (count - 1)))))
  }
 
  const handleKeyDown = (event) => {
    const current = active ?? count - 1
    const next = { ArrowLeft: current - 1, ArrowRight: current + 1, Home: 0, End: count - 1 }[event.key]
    if (next === undefined) return
    event.preventDefault()
    const index = Math.min(count - 1, Math.max(0, next))
    setActive(index)
    setAnnouncement(describe(index))
  }
 
  const tooltipOnLeft = active !== null && xAt(active) > width * 0.6
 
  return (
    <div className={clsx(styles.root, className)}>
      <div className={styles.legendRow}>
        <p className={styles.axisTitle}>{yAxisLabel}</p>
        <ul className={styles.legend}>
          {series.map((entry) => (
            <li key={entry.key} className={styles.legendItem}>
              <span className={clsx(styles.legendKey, styles[entry.variant])} aria-hidden="true" />
              {entry.label}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
 
      <div
        ref={containerRef}
        className={clsx(styles.chart, busy && styles.busy)}
        style={{ height }}
        role="group"
        aria-label={`${summary} Use the left and right arrow keys to read each day.`}
        aria-busy={busy || undefined}
        tabIndex={0}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        onFocus={() => setActive((current) => current ?? count - 1)}
        onBlur={() => setActive(null)}
      >
        {width > 0 && (
          <svg width={width} height={height} aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
            {ticks.map((tick) => (
              <g key={tick}>
                <line className={styles.grid} x1={MARGIN.left} x2={width - MARGIN.right} y1={yAt(tick)} y2={yAt(tick)} />
                <text className={styles.tick} x={MARGIN.left - 8} y={yAt(tick)} textAnchor="end" dominantBaseline="middle">
                  {formatTick(tick)}
                </text>
              </g>
            ))}
            {axisLabelIndexes(count).map((index, position, all) => (
              <text
                key={index}
                className={styles.tick}
                x={xAt(index)}
                y={height - 8}
                textAnchor={position === 0 ? 'start' : position === all.length - 1 ? 'end' : 'middle'}
              >
                {primary.points[index].axisLabel}
              </text>
            ))}
            {[...series].reverse().map((entry) => (
              <path
                key={entry.key}
                className={clsx(styles.line, styles[entry.variant])}
                d={monotonePath(entry.points.map((point, index) => ({ x: xAt(index), y: yAt(point.value) })))}
              />
            ))}
            {active !== null && (
              <g>
                <line className={styles.crosshair} x1={xAt(active)} x2={xAt(active)} y1={MARGIN.top} y2={MARGIN.top + plotHeight} />
                {series.map((entry) => (
                  <circle key={entry.key} className={clsx(styles.marker, styles[entry.variant])} cx={xAt(active)} cy={yAt(entry.points[active].value)} r={5} />
                ))}
              </g>
            )}
            <rect
              className={styles.hit}
              x={MARGIN.left}
              y={0}
              width={plotWidth}
              height={height}
              onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
              onPointerLeave={() => setActive(null)}
            />
          </svg>
        )}
 
        {active !== null && width > 0 && (
          <div
            className={clsx(styles.tooltip, tooltipOnLeft && styles.tooltipLeft)}
            style={{ left: xAt(active) }}
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <p className={styles.tooltipTitle}>{primary.points[active].label}</p>
            {series.map((entry) => (
              <p key={entry.key} className={styles.tooltipRow}>
                <span className={clsx(styles.tooltipKey, styles[entry.variant])} />
                <strong className={styles.tooltipValue}>{formatValue(entry.points[active].value)}</strong>
                <span className={styles.tooltipSeries}>
                  {entry.label}
                  {entry.points[active].label !== primary.points[active].label && ` · ${entry.points[active].label}`}
                </span>
              </p>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
 
      <p className="visually-hidden" aria-live="polite">
        {announcement}
      </p>
      {/* The wrapper does the clipping: a 1px table would still grow the page. */}
      <div className="visually-hidden">
        <table>
          <caption>{title}</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">Date</th>
              {series.map((entry) => (
                <th key={entry.key} scope="col">
                  {entry.label}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {primary.points.map((point, index) => (
              <tr key={point.label}>
                <th scope="row">{point.label}</th>
                {series.map((entry) => (
                  <td key={entry.key}>{formatValue(entry.points[index].value)}</td>
                ))}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

// The last-period line is a lighter tint of the same blue, as in the design. Its contrast against white is
// low by design, so every value is also in the tooltip, the keyboard readout and the hidden data table.
.root {
  --chart-current: var(--sh-color-primary);
  --chart-previous: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sh-color-primary) 42%, var(--sh-color-white));
}
 
.legendRow {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.25rem 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}
 
.axisTitle {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-sm);
}
 
.legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.25rem 1rem;
  margin: 0;
}
 
.legendItem {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.375rem;
  color: var(--sh-color-primary);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-xs);
  font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-medium);
}
 
.legendKey {
  width: 0.625rem;
  height: 0.625rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--chart-current);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--chart-current);
 
  &.previous {
    border-color: var(--chart-previous);
    background: var(--sh-color-white);
  }
}
 
.chart {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: var(--sh-radius-sm);
  transition: opacity var(--sh-transition);
 
  svg {
    display: block;
    overflow: visible;
  }
}
 
// While the next report loads the chart keeps its shape and dims, instead of flashing a skeleton.
.busy {
  opacity: 0.55;
}
 
.grid {
  stroke: var(--sh-color-border);
  stroke-width: 1;
}
 
.tick {
  fill: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-2xs);
}
 
.line {
  fill: none;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
 
  &.current {
    stroke: var(--chart-current);
    stroke-width: 2.5;
  }
 
  &.previous {
    stroke: var(--chart-previous);
    stroke-width: 2;
  }
}
 
.crosshair {
  stroke: var(--sh-color-muted);
  stroke-opacity: 0.45;
  stroke-width: 1;
}
 
.marker {
  stroke: var(--sh-color-white);
  stroke-width: 2;
 
  &.current {
    fill: var(--chart-current);
  }
 
  &.previous {
    fill: var(--chart-previous);
  }
}
 
.hit {
  fill: transparent;
  cursor: crosshair;
}
 
.tooltip {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.25rem;
  z-index: 2;
  min-width: 11rem;
  padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem;
  transform: translateX(0.75rem);
  border: 1px solid var(--sh-color-border);
  border-radius: var(--sh-radius-md);
  background: var(--sh-color-white);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-shadow-md);
  pointer-events: none;
}
 
.tooltipLeft {
  transform: translateX(calc(-100% - 0.75rem));
}
 
.tooltipTitle {
  margin: 0 0 0.375rem;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-xs);
  font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-medium);
}
 
.tooltipRow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-xs);
 
  & + & {
    margin-top: 0.25rem;
  }
}
 
.tooltipKey {
  width: 0.875rem;
  height: 0.125rem;
  flex: none;
  border-radius: 1px;
  background: var(--chart-current);
 
  &.previous {
    background: var(--chart-previous);
  }
}
 
.tooltipValue {
  color: var(--sh-color-ink);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-base);
  font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-semibold);
}
 
.tooltipSeries {
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
}

```jsx
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './ReconciliationCards.module.scss'
 
const money = (value) => formatINR(value, { decimals: 2 })
 
/**
 * The two panels under the financial table: how one order's amounts reconcile, and the customer's wallet
 * for it. `data` is the reconciliation response; the backend states whether the order is balanced.
 */
export default function ReconciliationCards({ data, selected }) {
  const { reconciliation: r, wallet } = data
  return (
    <div className={styles.row}>
      <Card title={`${selected ? 'Selected order' : 'Order'} reconciliation · ${data.orderNumber}`} padding="sm" radius="md">
        <div className={styles.reconciliation}>
          <div className={styles.lines}>
            <p>
              Taxable {money(r.taxable)} + GST {money(r.gst)} + Shipping {money(r.shipping)}
            </p>
            <p>
              Gross {money(r.gross)} = Wallet {money(r.wallet)} + {r.gatewayLabel} {money(r.gateway)}
            </p>
          </div>
          <Badge tone={r.balanced ? 'success' : 'danger'}>{r.balanced ? 'Balanced' : 'Needs review'}</Badge>
        </div>
      </Card>
      <Card title={`Customer wallet · ${wallet.customerCode}`} padding="sm" radius="md">
        <div className={styles.wallet}>
          <p className={styles.walletLine}>
            Opening {formatINR(wallet.opening)} · Used {formatINR(wallet.used)}
          </p>
          <p className={styles.closing}>Closing {formatINR(wallet.closing)}</p>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/reports/components/ReportKpis/ReportKpis.jsx`
 
```jsx
import StatCard from '@/components/molecules/StatCard'
import { StatGrid } from '@/features/admin-lists'
import { formatINR, formatNumber, formatPercent } from '@/lib/format'
 
/** "↑ 12.8% vs previous period" — the change is calculated by the backend; null means no comparison. */
function changeText(changePercent) {
  if (changePercent === null || changePercent === undefined) return undefined
  return `${changePercent >= 0 ? '↑' : '↓'} ${formatPercent(Math.abs(changePercent))} vs previous period`
}
 
/** The four headline figures of the Reports overview. */
export default function ReportKpis({ summary }) {
  const gross = summary.grossSales
  const average = summary.averageOrderValue
  const wallet = summary.walletLiability
 
  return (
    <StatGrid>
      <StatCard label="Gross sales" value={formatINR(gross.value)} delta={changeText(gross.changePercent)} deltaTone={gross.changePercent < 0 ? 'danger' : 'success'} />
      <StatCard label="GST collected" value={formatINR(summary.gstCollected.value)} delta="Tax-inclusive reporting" deltaTone="success" />
      <StatCard label="Average order value" value={formatINR(average.value)} delta={changeText(average.changePercent)} deltaTone={average.changePercent < 0 ? 'danger' : 'success'} />
      <StatCard
        label="Wallet liability"
        value={formatINR(wallet.value)}
        delta={`${formatNumber(wallet.customersWithBalance)} customers with balance`}
        deltaTone="success"
      />
    </StatGrid>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/reports/components/ReportsOverview/ReportsOverview.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import { DateRangeFilter, ListToolbar, REPORT_DATE_RANGES, StatGrid, useExcelExport, useListParams } from '@/features/admin-lists'
import OrderStatusCard from '@/features/reports/components/OrderStatusCard'
import ReportKpis from '@/features/reports/components/ReportKpis'
import ReportTableCard from '@/features/reports/components/ReportTableCard'
import SalesAnalyticsCard from '@/features/reports/components/SalesAnalyticsCard'
import { useReportOverview } from '@/features/reports/hooks/useReports'
import { buildOverviewSheet } from '@/features/reports/lib/overviewSheet'
import { formatINR, formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './ReportsOverview.module.scss'
 
const COMPARE_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'previous_month', label: 'Previous month' },
  { value: 'previous_period', label: 'Previous period' },
  { value: 'last_year', label: 'Same period last year' },
  { value: 'none', label: 'No comparison' },
]
 
const CUSTOMER_COLUMNS = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Customer' },
  { key: 'ordersCount', header: 'Orders', cell: (row) => formatNumber(row.ordersCount) },
  { key: 'totalSpend', header: 'Sales', cell: (row) => formatINR(row.totalSpend) },
  { key: 'walletBalance', header: 'Wallet', cell: (row) => formatINR(row.walletBalance) },
]
 
const PRODUCT_COLUMNS = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Product / code', cell: (row) => `${row.name} · ${row.code}` },
  { key: 'units', header: 'Units', cell: (row) => formatNumber(row.units) },
  { key: 'grossSales', header: 'Gross sales', cell: (row) => formatINR(row.grossSales) },
  { key: 'stock', header: 'Stock', cell: (row) => formatNumber(row.stock) },
]
 
function OverviewSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className={styles.stack} aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading reports">
      <StatGrid>
        {Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, index) => (
          <Skeleton key={index} height="7.1rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
        ))}
      </StatGrid>
      <Skeleton height="19rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
      <Skeleton height="14rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
    </div>
  )
}
 
/** The Reports overview screen: filters, headline figures, sales chart, order mix and two top-lists. */
export default function ReportsOverview() {
  const list = useListParams({ pageSize: null, filters: { range: 'this_month', from: '', to: '', compare: 'previous_month' } })
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch, isPlaceholderData } = useReportOverview(list.apiParams)
  const exporter = useExcelExport()
 
  const toolbarFilters = [
    {
      key: 'range',
      node: (
        <DateRangeFilter
          label="Report period"
          value={{ range: list.filters.range, from: list.filters.from, to: list.filters.to }}
          period={data?.period}
          presets={REPORT_DATE_RANGES}
          onChange={list.setFilters}
        />
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'compare',
      label: 'Compare with',
      prefix: 'Compare:',
      options: COMPARE_OPTIONS,
      value: list.filters.compare,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('compare', value),
    },
  ]
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Reports overview"
        description="A clear view of sales, customers, products and wallet activity."
        actions={
          <Button
            size="sm"
            disabled={!data}
            loading={exporter.isPending}
            onClick={() => {
              const { rows, ...sheet } = buildOverviewSheet(data)
              exporter.mutate({ ...sheet, getRows: async () => rows })
            }}
          >
            Export Excel
          </Button>
        }
      />
 
      <ListToolbar
        search={{ ...list.search, label: 'Search a report', placeholder: 'Search a report' }}
        filters={toolbarFilters}
        hasActiveFilters={list.hasActiveFilters}
        onClear={list.reset}
      />
 
      {isPending && <OverviewSkeleton />}
      {isError && <ErrorState message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} />}
      {data && (
        <div className={styles.stack}>
          <ReportKpis summary={data.summary} />
          <div className={styles.chartRow}>
            <SalesAnalyticsCard sales={data.sales} period={data.period} busy={isPlaceholderData} />
            <OrderStatusCard orderStatus={data.orderStatus} />
          </div>
          <div className={styles.tableRow}>
            <ReportTableCard
              title="Customers & wallet balances"
              caption="Customers with their orders, sales and wallet balance"
              columns={CUSTOMER_COLUMNS}
              rows={data.customers}
              getRowId={(row) => row.code}
              emptyState={<EmptyState compact icon="people" title="No matching customers" description="Try a different search." />}
              linkLabel="View customer financial report"
              linkTo={paths.admin.financialReport}
            />
            <ReportTableCard
              title="Product performance"
              caption="Products with units sold, gross sales and stock"
              columns={PRODUCT_COLUMNS}
              rows={data.products}
              getRowId={(row) => row.code}
              emptyState={<EmptyState compact icon="box-seam" title="No matching products" description="Try a different search." />}
              linkLabel="View product details & GST"
              linkTo={paths.admin.products}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'

import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import styles from './ReportTableCard.module.scss'
 
/** A titled card holding a small read-only table and a "view more" link (Reports overview). */
export default function ReportTableCard({ title, caption, columns, rows, getRowId, emptyState, linkLabel, linkTo, loading = false }) {
  return (
    <Card title={title} padding="sm" radius="md" className={styles.card}>
      <DataTable
        className={styles.table}
        caption={caption}
        columns={columns}
        rows={rows}
        getRowId={getRowId}
        loading={loading}
        loadingRows={3}
        emptyState={emptyState}
        minWidth="26rem"
      />
      <Link to={linkTo} className={styles.link}>
        {linkLabel}
        <Icon name="arrow-right" />
      </Link>
    </Card>
  )
}

## `src/features/reports/components/SalesAnalyticsCard/SalesAnalyticsCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import { formatDate, formatDateRange, formatShortDate } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import LineChart from '@/features/reports/components/LineChart'
import styles from './SalesAnalyticsCard.module.scss'
 
/** Daily gross sales for the period against its comparison. `sales` and `period` come from the overview API. */
export default function SalesAnalyticsCard({ sales, period, busy }) {
  const periodText = period.label ?? formatDateRange(period.from, period.to)
  const series = sales.series.map((entry) => ({
    key: entry.key,
    variant: entry.key,
    label: entry.label,
    total: entry.total,
    points: entry.points.map((point) => ({ label: formatDate(point.date), axisLabel: formatShortDate(point.date), value: point.value })),
  }))
 
  return (
    <Card title="Sales analytics" padding="md" radius="md" className={styles.card}>
      <p className={styles.subtitle}>Daily gross sales · {periodText}</p>
      <LineChart
        title={`Daily gross sales, ${periodText}.`}
        yAxisLabel="Revenue (₹)"
        series={series}
        formatValue={(value) => formatINR(value)}
        height={156}
        busy={busy}
      />
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/reports/hooks/useReports.js`
 
```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { getFinancialReport, getOrderReconciliation, getReportOverview } from '@/features/reports/services/reportService'
 
export const reportKeys = {
  all: ['admin', 'reports'],
  overview: (params) => ['admin', 'reports', 'overview', params],
  financial: (params) => ['admin', 'reports', 'financial', params],
  reconciliation: (orderNumber) => ['admin', 'reports', 'reconciliation', orderNumber],
}
 
// Filters keep showing the previous report while the next one loads, so the screen does not jump.
export const useReportOverview = (params) =>
  useQuery({ queryKey: reportKeys.overview(params), queryFn: () => getReportOverview(params), placeholderData: keepPreviousData })
 
export const useFinancialReport = (params) =>
  useQuery({ queryKey: reportKeys.financial(params), queryFn: () => getFinancialReport(params), placeholderData: keepPreviousData })
 
export const useOrderReconciliation = (orderNumber) =>
  useQuery({
    queryKey: reportKeys.reconciliation(orderNumber),
    queryFn: () => getOrderReconciliation(orderNumber),
    enabled: Boolean(orderNumber),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
  })
```

const COLUMNS = [

  { header: 'GST', key: 'gst', format: 'inr', width: 12 },
  { header: 'Shipping', key: 'shipping', format: 'inr', width: 12 },
  { header: 'Wallet used', key: 'wallet', format: 'inr', width: 13 },

  { header: 'Net payable', key: 'net', format: 'inr', width: 14 },
  { header: 'Status', key: 'status', width: 18 },
]
 
/**
 * Excel sheet definition for the financial report. The sheet always carries every column (GST split, shipping,
 * wallet, net) whichever columns the table currently shows; figures are written as the backend sent them.
 */
export function financialSheet(period) {
  return {
    fileName: `Shipper-financial-report-${period.from}-to-${period.to}`,
    sheetName: 'Financial report',
    title: `Customer & order financial report · ${formatDateRange(period.from, period.to)}`,
    columns: COLUMNS,
  }
}
 
/** Report lines as sheet rows (the status shown as its label, not its key). */
export const financialSheetRows = (rows) => rows.map((row) => ({ ...row, status: statusLabel(row.status) }))

```javascript
import { formatDate, formatDateRange } from '@/lib/date'
 
// One flat sheet holds every section of the overview, so each row names its section.
const COLUMNS = [
  { header: 'Section', key: 'section', width: 34 },
  { header: 'Item', key: 'item', width: 40 },
  { header: 'Count', key: 'count', format: 'number', width: 12 },
  { header: 'Amount', key: 'amount', format: 'inr', width: 16 },
  { header: 'Wallet balance', key: 'wallet', format: 'inr', width: 16 },
  { header: 'Stock', key: 'stock', format: 'number', width: 10 },
  { header: 'Share', key: 'share', format: 'percent', width: 10 },
]
 
/** The rows currently on the Reports overview, as an Excel sheet definition for exportToExcel. */
export function buildOverviewSheet(report) {
  const { summary, sales, orderStatus, customers, products, period } = report
  const rows = [
    { section: 'Summary', item: 'Gross sales', amount: summary.grossSales.value },
    { section: 'Summary', item: 'GST collected', amount: summary.gstCollected.value },
    { section: 'Summary', item: 'Average order value', amount: summary.averageOrderValue.value },
    { section: 'Summary', item: 'Wallet liability', amount: summary.walletLiability.value, count: summary.walletLiability.customersWithBalance },
    ...sales.series.flatMap((series) =>
      series.points.map((point) => ({ section: `Daily gross sales · ${series.label}`, item: formatDate(point.date), amount: point.value })),
    ),
    ...orderStatus.items.map((item) => ({ section: 'Order status', item: item.label, count: item.count, share: item.percent })),
    ...customers.map((customer) => ({
      section: 'Customers and wallet balances',
      item: `${customer.name} · ${customer.code}`,
      count: customer.ordersCount,
      amount: customer.totalSpend,
      wallet: customer.walletBalance,
    })),
    ...products.map((product) => ({
      section: 'Product performance',
      item: `${product.name} · ${product.code}`,
      count: product.units,
      amount: product.grossSales,
      stock: product.stock,
    })),
  ]
  return {
    fileName: `Shipper-reports-overview-${period.from}-to-${period.to}`,
    sheetName: 'Reports overview',
    title: `Reports overview · ${formatDateRange(period.from, period.to)}`,
    columns: COLUMNS,
    rows,
  }
}
```
 
## `src/features/reports/services/reportService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. Query parameters shared by both reports:
//   range      today | yesterday | last_7_days | last_30_days | this_month | last_month | custom
//   from, to   ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD), only with range=custom
//   q          free-text search
// The backend resolves `range` against its own calendar and echoes the result as `period`.
 
/**
 * GET overview (+ compare: previous_month | previous_period | last_year | none) →
 *   { period: { preset, from, to, label|null }, compare: { key, label } | null,
 *     summary: { grossSales: { value, changePercent|null }, gstCollected: { value },
 *                averageOrderValue: { value, changePercent|null }, walletLiability: { value, customersWithBalance } },
 *     sales: { series: [{ key: 'current' | 'previous', label, total, points: [{ date, value }] }] },
 *     orderStatus: { totalOrders, items: [{ key, label, count, percent }] },
 *     customers: [{ code, name, ordersCount, totalSpend, walletBalance }],
 *     products: [{ code, name, units, grossSales, stock }] }
 * Every figure, share and total is computed by the backend.
 */
export async function getReportOverview(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.reports.overview, { params })
  return data
}
 
/**
 * GET financial report (+ status, customer code, sort, page, pageSize) →
 *   { period, summary: { orders, lineItems, taxableValue, gstTotal, shippingTotal, grossAmount, walletUsed },
 *     items: [{ id, orderNumber, orderDate, customerCode, customerName, productCode, productName, hsn, gstPercent,
 *               quantity, taxable, gst, cgst, sgst, igst, shipping, wallet, lineTotal, net, status }],
 *     page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount }
 * One item per order line; an order's shipping and wallet use sit on its first line.
 */
export async function getFinancialReport(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.reports.financial, { params })
  return data
}
 
/**
 * GET reconciliation of one order →
 *   { orderNumber, reconciliation: { taxable, gst, shipping, gross, wallet, gateway, gatewayLabel, balanced },
 *     wallet: { customerCode, opening, used, closing } }
 */
export async function getOrderReconciliation(orderNumber) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.reports.financialOrder(orderNumber))
  return data
}

## `src/features/saved/hooks/useSavedProducts.js`
 
```javascript
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { selectIsAuthenticated } from '@/app/store'
import { listSavedProducts, saveProduct, unsaveProduct } from '@/features/saved/services/savedService'
 
export const savedKeys = {
  all: ['saved-products'],
  list: () => ['saved-products', 'list'],
}
 
/** Saved products of the signed-in customer (disabled, and empty, for signed-out visitors). */
export function useSavedProducts() {
  const isAuthenticated = useSelector(selectIsAuthenticated)
  return useQuery({ queryKey: savedKeys.list(), queryFn: listSavedProducts, enabled: isAuthenticated })
}
 
/**
 * Heart toggle: `isSaved(code)` and `toggle(code)`. The list is updated optimistically so the heart
 * responds instantly, and refetched if the request fails. Callers redirect signed-out visitors to
 * the login page before calling `toggle`.
 */
export function useSavedProductToggle() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const { data: items = [] } = useSavedProducts()
  const saved = new Set(items.map((item) => item.productCode))
 
  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ productCode, shouldSave }) => (shouldSave ? saveProduct(productCode) : unsaveProduct(productCode)),
    onMutate: async ({ productCode, shouldSave }) => {
      await queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey: savedKeys.list() })
      queryClient.setQueryData(savedKeys.list(), (current = []) =>
        shouldSave ? [...current, { productCode, savedAt: new Date().toISOString() }] : current.filter((item) => item.productCode !== productCode),
      )
    },
    onSettled: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: savedKeys.all }),
  })
 
  return {
    isSaved: (productCode) => saved.has(productCode),
    toggle: (productCode) => mutation.mutate({ productCode, shouldSave: !saved.has(productCode) }),
    isPending: mutation.isPending,
  }
}
```

```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. A saved product summary is
//   { productCode, slug, name, unit, category, categoryLabel, image, mrp, sellingPrice, discountPercent,
//     stockStatus: 'in_stock' | 'low_stock' | 'out_of_stock', savedAt }
// Saving is idempotent (PUT), removing too (DELETE).
 
export async function listSavedProducts() {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.savedProducts.list)
  return data.items
}
 
export async function saveProduct(productCode) {
  await http.put(endpoints.savedProducts.item(productCode))
}
 
export async function unsaveProduct(productCode) {
  await http.delete(endpoints.savedProducts.item(productCode))
}

```jsx
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import Drawer from '@/components/organisms/Drawer'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { ShipmentDetails, useWorkOrder } from '@/features/store-operations'
import styles from './ShipmentDrawer.module.scss'
 
/** Status, expected delivery and tracking timeline of the shipment chosen in the list. */
export default function ShipmentDrawer({ orderNumber, onClose }) {
  const query = useWorkOrder(orderNumber)
 
  let body
  if (query.isError) {
    body = <ErrorState compact title="Couldn't load this shipment" message={getErrorMessage(query.error)} onRetry={query.refetch} />
  } else if (!query.data) {
    body = (
      <div className={styles.loading} role="status" aria-label="Loading shipment">
        <Skeleton height="1rem" width="55%" />
        <Skeleton height="1rem" />
        <Skeleton height="8rem" />
      </div>
    )
  } else {
    body = <ShipmentDetails order={query.data} />
  }
 
  return (
    <Drawer open={Boolean(orderNumber)} onClose={onClose} title={`Shipment · #${orderNumber ?? ''}`} description="Follow this parcel with India Post.">
      {body}
    </Drawer>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/shipping/components/ShipmentsCard/ShipmentsCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import { formatShortDate } from '@/lib/date'
import { QueueCard, useDocumentDownloads } from '@/features/store-operations'
 
/**
 * The searchable shipment table: consignment, order, customer, city, status and dates, a "Print label"
 * button per row and a bulk "Download labels" for the checked rows. Labels come from the shared
 * shipping-label download used by the order screens.
 */
export default function ShipmentsCard({ queue, page, pageSize, selection, searching, onPageChange, onOpen }) {
  const documents = useDocumentDownloads()
  const printing = documents.isPending ? documents.variables.orderNumbers : []
  const { selectedIds } = selection
  const rows = queue.data?.items ?? []
 
  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'consignment',
      header: 'Consignment ID',
      cell: (row) => (
        <Button variant="link" size="sm" onClick={() => onOpen(row.orderNumber)} aria-label={`View shipment ${row.shipment.consignmentId}`}>
          {row.shipment.consignmentId}
        </Button>
      ),
    },
    { key: 'order', header: 'Order', cell: (row) => row.orderNumber },
    { key: 'customer', header: 'Customer', cell: (row) => row.customerName },
    { key: 'city', header: 'City', cell: (row) => row.city },
    {
      key: 'status',
      header: 'Status',
      cell: (row) => (
        <span className="d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-2">
          <StatusBadge status={row.shipment.status} />
          {row.delay && <StatusBadge status="delayed" />}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    { key: 'dispatched', header: 'Dispatched', cell: (row) => formatShortDate(row.shipment.dispatchedAt) },
    { key: 'expected', header: 'Expected delivery', cell: (row) => formatShortDate(row.shipment.expectedDelivery) },
  ]
 
  return (
    <QueueCard
      title={`Shipments · ${queue.data?.totalItems ?? '…'}`}
      caption="Shipments handed to India Post, newest first"
      itemLabel="shipments"
      selectLabel="Select shipments"
      columns={columns}
      rows={rows}
      loading={queue.isPending}
      error={queue.error}
      onRetry={queue.refetch}
      selectedIds={selectedIds}
      onSelectionChange={selection.setSelectedIds}
      onRowClick={(row) => onOpen(row.orderNumber)}
      rowActions={(row) => (
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          size="sm"
          leftIcon="printer"
          loading={printing.includes(row.orderNumber)}
          aria-label={`Print label for ${row.orderNumber}`}
          onClick={() => documents.mutate({ kind: 'label', orderNumbers: [row.orderNumber] })}
        >
          Print label
        </Button>
      )}
      actionsHeader="Label"
      getRowLabel={(row) => `${row.shipment.consignmentId} ${row.orderNumber}`}
      page={page}
      pageSize={pageSize}
      totalItems={queue.data?.totalItems ?? 0}
      onPageChange={onPageChange}
      emptyState={
        <EmptyState
          compact
          icon="truck"
          title="No shipments found"
          description={searching ? 'Try a different consignment ID, order, customer or city.' : 'Shipments appear here once an order is dispatched.'}
        />
      }
      actions={
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          size="sm"
          leftIcon="download"
          disabled={selectedIds.length === 0}
          loading={documents.isPending && printing.length > 1}
          onClick={() => documents.mutate({ kind: 'label', orderNumbers: selectedIds })}
        >
          Download labels{selectedIds.length > 0 ? ` (${selectedIds.length})` : ''}
        </Button>
      }
    />
  )
}
```

import StatCard from '@/components/molecules/StatCard'
import { STATUS_META } from '@/app/config/statuses'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './ShipmentStatusCards.module.scss'
 
const SHIPMENT_STATUSES = ['dispatched', 'in_transit', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered', 'returned']
 
/**
 * One card per shipment status with the number the backend reports. Choosing a card filters the list to
 * that status; choosing it again shows every status.
 */
export default function ShipmentStatusCards({ byStatus, selected, onSelect }) {
  return (
    <ul className={styles.cards} aria-label="Shipments by status">
      {SHIPMENT_STATUSES.map((status) => (
        <li key={status}>
          <StatCard
            layout="inline"
            className={styles.card}
            label={STATUS_META[status].label}
            value={byStatus ? formatNumber(byStatus[status] ?? 0) : '—'}
            selected={selected === status}
            onClick={() => onSelect(selected === status ? 'all' : status)}
          />
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import { QueueToolbar, useQueueQuery, useQueueSelection } from '@/features/store-operations'
import ShipmentDrawer from '@/features/shipping/components/ShipmentDrawer'
import ShipmentStatusCards from '@/features/shipping/components/ShipmentStatusCards'
import ShipmentsCard from '@/features/shipping/components/ShipmentsCard'
import { useShipments } from '@/features/shipping/hooks/useShipments'
import styles from './ShippingWorkspace.module.scss'
 
const PAGE_SIZE = 10
 
/** Shipping: every parcel handed to India Post, filterable by status, with label printing and tracking details. */
export default function ShippingWorkspace() {
  const { state, params, filterKey, update, setPage } = useQueueQuery({ defaults: { status: 'all' }, pageSize: PAGE_SIZE })
  const shipments = useShipments(params)
  const selection = useQueueSelection(shipments.data?.items ?? [], filterKey, { selectFirst: false })
  const [openOrder, setOpenOrder] = useState(null)
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.workspace}>
      <PageHeader title="Shipping" description="Follow every parcel handed to India Post and print shipping labels." />
      <ShipmentStatusCards byStatus={shipments.data?.summary.byStatus} selected={state.status} onSelect={(status) => update({ status })} />
      <QueueToolbar
        search={state.search}
        onSearchChange={(search) => update({ search })}
        searchPlaceholder="Search consignment ID, order, customer or city"
        searchLabel="Search shipments by consignment ID, order number, customer or city"
      />
      <ShipmentsCard
        queue={shipments}
        page={state.page}
        pageSize={PAGE_SIZE}
        selection={selection}
        searching={Boolean(params.search) || state.status !== 'all'}
        onPageChange={setPage}
        onOpen={setOpenOrder}
      />
      <ShipmentDrawer orderNumber={openOrder} onClose={() => setOpenOrder(null)} />
    </div>
  )
}
```

```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. GET /admin/shipments?search&status&page&pageSize answers
//   { items: QueueRow[] (see store-operations service), page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount,
//     summary: { total, byStatus: { dispatched, in_transit, out_for_delivery, delivered, returned },
//                windowDays, carrier, syncedAt } }
// covering shipments dispatched in the last `windowDays` days, newest first.
export async function getShipments(params) {
  const cleaned = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(params).filter(([, value]) => value !== '' && value !== null && value !== 'all'))
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.shipping.shipments, { params: cleaned })
  return data
}

```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { Controller, useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import Modal from '@/components/organisms/Modal'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import { useAssignOwner } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useFulfilmentActions'
import { ownerSchema } from '@/features/store-operations/schemas/ownerSchema'
import { reportBulkResult } from '@/features/store-operations/utils/bulkResult'
 
const FORM_ID = 'assign-owner-form'
 
function AssignOwnerForm({ orderNumbers, owners, mutation, onClose }) {
  const {
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(ownerSchema), defaultValues: { owner: '' } })
 
  const submit = handleSubmit(({ owner }) =>
    mutation.mutate(
      { orderNumbers, owner },
      {
        onSuccess: (result) => {
          reportBulkResult(result, { done: `assigned to ${owner}` })
          onClose()
        },
        onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error)),
      },
    ),
  )
 
  return (
    <form id={FORM_ID} noValidate onSubmit={submit}>
      <FormField label="Resolution owner" required error={errors.owner?.message}>
        {(field) => (
          <Controller
            name="owner"
            control={control}
            render={({ field: owner }) => (
              <SelectField {...field} options={owners.map((name) => ({ value: name, label: name }))} placeholder="Choose a team member" value={owner.value} onChange={owner.onChange} />
            )}
          />
        )}
      </FormField>
    </form>
  )
}
 
/** Assigns one resolution owner to every checked exception. */
export default function AssignOwnerModal({ open, onClose, orderNumbers, owners }) {
  const mutation = useAssignOwner()
 
  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      size="sm"
      title="Assign owner"
      description={`The owner takes over ${pluralize(orderNumbers.length, 'delayed order')}.`}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" form={FORM_ID} loading={mutation.isPending}>
            Assign owner
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <AssignOwnerForm orderNumbers={orderNumbers} owners={owners} mutation={mutation} onClose={onClose} />
    </Modal>
  )
}
```
