  fileName: 'Delayed-orders',
  sheetName: 'Exceptions',
  title: 'Delayed orders and exceptions',
  columns: [
    { header: 'Order', key: 'orderNumber', width: 14 },
    { header: 'Customer', key: 'customerName', width: 24 },
    { header: 'Age (hours)', key: 'ageHours', width: 12, format: 'number' },
    { header: 'Issue', key: 'issue', width: 26 },
    { header: 'Owner', key: 'owner', width: 18 },
    { header: 'Priority', key: 'priority', width: 12 },
  ],
  rows: rows.map((row) => ({
    orderNumber: row.orderNumber,
    customerName: row.customerName,
    ageHours: row.delay.ageHours,
    issue: row.delay.label,
    owner: row.delay.owner,
    priority: PRIORITY_LABELS[row.delay.priority] ?? row.delay.priority,
  })),
})
 
/** Delayed Orders: every order with an open exception, and the panel to assign, schedule and resolve it. */
export default function DelayedStage() {
  const options = useStoreOptions()
  const { state, params, filterKey, update, setPage } = useQueueQuery({ defaults: { issue: 'all', age: 'all', owner: 'all' }, fixed: { stage: 'delayed' }, pageSize: PAGE_SIZE })
  const queue = useStageQueue(params)
  const rows = queue.data?.items ?? []
  const selection = useQueueSelection(rows, filterKey)
  const exporter = useQueueExport(exceptionsSheet)
  const notify = useNotifyCustomers()
  const [assigning, setAssigning] = useState(false)
  const [notifying, setNotifying] = useState(false)
 
  const groups = queue.data?.summary.groups
  const summaryItems = [...ISSUE_GROUPS, ...(groups?.other > 0 ? [OTHER_ISSUE] : [])].map((group) => ({
    key: group.key,
    label: group.cardLabel,
    value: groups?.[group.key],
    tone: group.cardTone,
  }))
  const ownerOptions = [{ value: 'all', label: 'All' }, ...(options.data?.owners ?? []).map((owner) => ({ value: owner, label: owner }))]
  const nothingSelected = selection.selectedIds.length === 0
 
  const notifySelected = () =>
    notify.mutate(selection.selectedIds, {
      onSuccess: (result) => {
        reportBulkResult(result, { done: 'notified about the delay' })
        setNotifying(false)
      },
      onError: (error) => {
        setNotifying(false)
        toast.error(getErrorMessage(error))
      },
    })
 
  return (
    <>
      <HeaderActions>
        <Button loading={exporter.isPending} onClick={() => exporter.mutate(params)}>
          Export exceptions
        </Button>
      </HeaderActions>
      <StageSummary label="Delayed orders by issue" items={summaryItems} />
      <QueueToolbar
        search={state.search}
        onSearchChange={(search) => update({ search })}
        searchPlaceholder="Search delayed order, customer or issue"
        searchLabel="Search delayed orders by order number, customer or issue"
        filters={[
          { key: 'issue', label: 'Issue', prefix: 'Issue:', options: ISSUE_OPTIONS, value: state.issue, onChange: (issue) => update({ issue }) },
          { key: 'age', label: 'Age', prefix: 'Age:', options: AGE_OPTIONS, value: state.age, onChange: (age) => update({ age }) },
          { key: 'owner', label: 'Owner', prefix: 'Owner:', options: ownerOptions, value: state.owner, onChange: (owner) => update({ owner }) },
        ]}
      />
      <StageGrid
        panelWidth="27.5rem"
        main={
          <QueueCard
            title="Exception queue"
            caption="Orders with an open exception"
            itemLabel="delayed orders"
            selectLabel="Select orders"
            columns={COLUMNS}
            rows={rows}
            loading={queue.isPending}
            error={queue.error}
            onRetry={queue.refetch}
            selectedIds={selection.selectedIds}
            onSelectionChange={selection.setSelectedIds}
            onRowClick={selection.focusRow}
            getRowLabel={(row) => `${row.orderNumber} ${row.customerName}`}
            page={state.page}
            pageSize={PAGE_SIZE}
            totalItems={queue.data?.totalItems ?? 0}
            onPageChange={setPage}
            actions={
              <>
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={nothingSelected} onClick={() => setAssigning(true)}>
                  Assign owner
                </Button>
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={nothingSelected} onClick={() => setNotifying(true)}>
                  Notify customers
                </Button>
              </>
            }
          />
        }
        aside={<ResolvePanel orderNumber={selection.activeId} onDone={selection.reset} />}
      />
      <AssignOwnerModal open={assigning} onClose={() => setAssigning(false)} orderNumbers={selection.selectedIds} owners={options.data?.owners ?? []} />
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={notifying}
        onClose={() => setNotifying(false)}
        onConfirm={notifySelected}
        loading={notify.isPending}
        title="Notify customers?"
        message={`${selection.selectedIds.length} ${selection.selectedIds.length === 1 ? 'customer' : 'customers'} will be told their order is delayed and that you are working on it.`}
        confirmLabel="Send notifications"
      />
    </>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/DelayedStage/ResolvePanel.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { Controller, useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import ConfirmDialog from '@/components/organisms/ConfirmDialog'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import { formatINR, pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import { DELAY_ACTIONS, findIssueGroup } from '@/features/store-operations/config/delays'
import WorkPanel, { PanelNote, PanelSection } from '@/features/store-operations/components/WorkPanel'
import { useResolveDelay, useSaveResolution } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useFulfilmentActions'
import { useStoreOptions, useWorkOrder } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useStoreOperations'
import { resolutionSchema } from '@/features/store-operations/schemas/resolutionSchema'
import { fromDateTimeInput, toDateTimeInput } from '@/features/store-operations/utils/dateInput'
import styles from './ResolvePanel.module.scss'
 
const ACTION_OPTIONS = DELAY_ACTIONS.map(({ value, label }) => ({ value, label }))
 
/** The two lines under the badge: what was paid for, and what exactly is wrong. */
function IssueSummary({ order }) {
  const { payment, delay, stock, lines } = order
  const shortage = delay.issue === 'stock_shortage' ? stock.shortages[0] : null
  const paid = payment.status === 'paid' ? `Paid ${formatINR(payment.paid)}` : `Payment ${payment.status}`
 
  return (
    <>
      <p className={styles.customer}>
        {order.customer.name} · {order.address.city} {order.address.pin}
      </p>
      <PanelNote>{shortage ? `${paid} · ${shortage.productCode} ${shortage.name}` : `${paid} · ${pluralize(lines.length, 'product')}`}</PanelNote>
      <p className={styles.detail}>
        {shortage ? `Requested ${shortage.requested} · Available ${shortage.available} · Shortage ${pluralize(shortage.shortage, 'unit')}` : delay.detail}
      </p>
    </>
  )
}
 
function ResolveForm({ order, owners, onDone }) {
  const { delay } = order
  const save = useSaveResolution()
  const resolve = useResolveDelay()
  const confirm = useDisclosure()
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    reset,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(resolutionSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      owner: delay.owner,
      action: delay.action,
      expectedResolutionAt: toDateTimeInput(delay.expectedResolutionAt),
      note: delay.note,
      notifyCustomer: true,
    },
  })
 
  const submit = handleSubmit((values) =>
    save.mutate(
      { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, ...values, expectedResolutionAt: fromDateTimeInput(values.expectedResolutionAt) },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          toast.success(values.notifyCustomer ? `Resolution saved for ${order.orderNumber}. The customer has been notified.` : `Resolution saved for ${order.orderNumber}.`)
          reset(values)
        },
        onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error)),
      },
    ),
  )
 
  const markResolved = () =>
    resolve.mutate(order.orderNumber, {
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(`${order.orderNumber} resolved. It is back in its queue.`)
        confirm.close()
        onDone()
      },
      onError: (error) => {
        confirm.close()
        toast.error(getErrorMessage(error))
      },
    })
 
  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className={styles.form}>
      <div className="row g-3">
        <div className="col-6">
          <FormField label="Resolution owner" error={errors.owner?.message}>
            {(field) => (
              <Controller
                name="owner"
                control={control}
                render={({ field: owner }) => (
                  <SelectField {...field} options={owners.map((name) => ({ value: name, label: name }))} value={owner.value} onChange={owner.onChange} />
                )}
              />
            )}
          </FormField>
        </div>
        <div className="col-6">
          <FormField label="Action" error={errors.action?.message}>
            {(field) => (
              <Controller
                name="action"
                control={control}
                render={({ field: action }) => <SelectField {...field} options={ACTION_OPTIONS} value={action.value} onChange={action.onChange} />}
              />
            )}
          </FormField>
        </div>
      </div>
 
      <FormField label="Expected resolution" error={errors.expectedResolutionAt?.message}>
        {(field) => <Input {...field} type="datetime-local" {...register('expectedResolutionAt')} />}
      </FormField>
 
      <FormField label="Internal note" error={errors.note?.message}>
        {(field) => <Input {...field} placeholder="Add a note for the team" autoComplete="off" {...register('note')} />}
      </FormField>
 
      <Checkbox label="Notify customer about revised timeline" {...register('notifyCustomer')} />
 
      <div className={styles.actions}>
        <Button type="submit" size="lg" loading={save.isPending}>
          Save resolution &amp; assign
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" size="lg" onClick={confirm.open}>
          Mark as resolved
        </Button>
      </div>
      {order.delay.group === 'stock' && (
        <Link className={styles.link} to={paths.admin.restock}>
          Create restock request <i className="bi bi-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true" />
        </Link>
      )}
 
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirm.isOpen}
        onClose={confirm.close}
        onConfirm={markResolved}
        loading={resolve.isPending}
        title={`Mark ${order.orderNumber} as resolved?`}
        message={
          delay.issue === 'stock_shortage'
            ? 'The restock is taken to have arrived. The delay is cleared and the order goes back to its queue.'
            : 'The delay is cleared and the order goes back to its queue.'
        }
        confirmLabel="Mark as resolved"
      />
    </form>
  )
}
 
/** The Resolve panel: owner, action, schedule and note for one delayed order, plus closing the exception. */
export default function ResolvePanel({ orderNumber, onDone }) {
  const query = useWorkOrder(orderNumber)
  const options = useStoreOptions()
 
  return (
    <WorkPanel
      title={orderNumber ? `Resolve #${orderNumber}` : 'Resolve order'}
      orderNumber={orderNumber}
      query={query}
      emptyTitle="Select a delayed order"
      emptyDescription="Choose an order from the exception queue to resolve it."
    >
      {(order) => {
        if (!order.delay) {
          return <PanelNote>This order no longer has an open exception.</PanelNote>
        }
        const group = findIssueGroup(order.delay.group)
        return (
          <>
            <PanelSection>
              <Badge tone={group.badgeTone} className="align-self-start">
                {group.badgeLabel} · {order.delay.ageHours}h
              </Badge>
              <IssueSummary order={order} />
            </PanelSection>
            <PanelSection divided className={styles.formSection}>
              {/* Keyed so choosing another order, or another exception on the same order, starts a fresh form. */}
              <ResolveForm key={`${order.orderNumber}:${order.delay.issue}`} order={order} owners={options.data?.owners ?? []} onDone={onDone} />
            </PanelSection>
          </>
        )
      }}
    </WorkPanel>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/DispatchedStage/DispatchedStage.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { formatDate, formatShortDate, formatTime } from '@/lib/date'
import HeaderActions from '@/features/store-operations/components/HeaderActions'
import QueueCard from '@/features/store-operations/components/QueueCard'
import QueueToolbar from '@/features/store-operations/components/QueueToolbar'
import StageGrid from '@/features/store-operations/components/StageGrid'
import { useRefreshTracking } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useFulfilmentActions'
import { useQueueExport } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useQueueExport'
import { useQueueQuery } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useQueueQuery'
import { useQueueSelection } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useQueueSelection'
import { useStageQueue, useStoreOptions } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useStoreOperations'
import ShipmentPanel from './ShipmentPanel'
import styles from './DispatchedStage.module.scss'
 
const PAGE_SIZE = 7
const STATUS_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'All' },
  { value: 'dispatched', label: 'Dispatched' },
  { value: 'in_transit', label: 'In transit' },
  { value: 'out_for_delivery', label: 'Out for delivery' },
  { value: 'delivered', label: 'Delivered' },
  { value: 'returned', label: 'Returned' },
]
 
const COLUMNS = [
  { key: 'order', header: 'Order / customer', cell: (row) => `${row.orderNumber} · ${row.customerName}` },
  { key: 'consignment', header: 'India Post ID', cell: (row) => row.shipment.consignmentId },
  { key: 'dispatched', header: 'Dispatch', cell: (row) => formatShortDate(row.shipment.dispatchedAt) },
  {
    key: 'status',
    header: 'Status',
    cell: (row) => (
      <span className="d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-2">
        <StatusBadge status={row.shipment.status} />
        {row.delay && <StatusBadge status="delayed" />}
      </span>
    ),
  },
]
 
const shipmentsSheet = (rows) => ({
  fileName: 'Shipments',
  sheetName: 'Shipments',
  title: 'Shipments dispatched in the last 14 days',
  columns: [
    { header: 'Order', key: 'orderNumber', width: 14 },
    { header: 'Customer', key: 'customerName', width: 24 },
    { header: 'India Post ID', key: 'consignmentId', width: 18 },
    { header: 'Service', key: 'service', width: 18 },
    { header: 'Dispatched', key: 'dispatchedAt', width: 14, format: 'date' },
    { header: 'Expected delivery', key: 'expectedDelivery', width: 18, format: 'date' },
    { header: 'Status', key: 'status', width: 16 },
  ],
  rows: rows.map((row) => ({
    orderNumber: row.orderNumber,
    customerName: row.customerName,
    consignmentId: row.shipment.consignmentId,
    service: row.shipment.service,
    dispatchedAt: row.shipment.dispatchedAt,
    expectedDelivery: row.shipment.expectedDelivery,
    status: row.shipment.status,
  })),
})
 
/** Dispatched: shipments handed to India Post in the last 14 days, with the tracking timeline of the selected one. */
export default function DispatchedStage() {
  const options = useStoreOptions()
  const { state, params, filterKey, update, setPage } = useQueueQuery({ defaults: { status: 'all' }, fixed: { stage: 'dispatched' }, pageSize: PAGE_SIZE })
  const queue = useStageQueue(params)
  const rows = queue.data?.items ?? []
  const selection = useQueueSelection(rows, filterKey)
  const refresh = useRefreshTracking()
  const exporter = useQueueExport(shipmentsSheet)
 
  const carrierOptions = (options.data?.carriers ?? []).map(({ value, label }) => ({ value, label }))
  const syncedAt = queue.data?.summary.trackingSyncedAt
 
  return (
    <>
      <HeaderActions>
        <Button loading={exporter.isPending} onClick={() => exporter.mutate(params)}>
          Export shipments
        </Button>
      </HeaderActions>
      <QueueToolbar
        search={state.search}
        onSearchChange={(search) => update({ search })}
        searchPlaceholder="Search order or tracking ID"
        searchLabel="Search shipments by order number, customer or tracking ID"
        filters={[
          { key: 'status', label: 'Shipment status', prefix: 'Status:', options: STATUS_OPTIONS, value: state.status, onChange: (status) => update({ status }) },
          { key: 'carrier', label: 'Carrier', prefix: 'Carrier:', options: carrierOptions, value: carrierOptions[0]?.value ?? null, disabled: carrierOptions.length < 2 },
        ]}
      />
      <StageGrid
        panelWidth="24.375rem"
        main={
          <QueueCard
            title={`Shipment list · ${queue.data?.totalItems ?? '…'}`}
            caption="Shipments dispatched in the last 14 days"
            itemLabel="shipments"
            selectLabel="Select shipments"
            columns={COLUMNS}
            rows={rows}
            loading={queue.isPending}
            error={queue.error}
            onRetry={queue.refetch}
            selectedIds={selection.selectedIds}
            onSelectionChange={selection.setSelectedIds}
            onRowClick={selection.focusRow}
            getRowLabel={(row) => `${row.orderNumber} ${row.customerName}`}
            page={state.page}
            pageSize={PAGE_SIZE}
            totalItems={queue.data?.totalItems ?? 0}
            onPageChange={setPage}
            actions={
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                size="sm"
                loading={refresh.isPending}
                onClick={() =>
                  refresh.mutate(undefined, {
                    onSuccess: () => toast.success('Tracking refreshed.'),
                    onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error)),
                  })
                }
              >
                Refresh tracking
              </Button>
            }
          >
            {syncedAt && (
              <p className={styles.synced}>
                Tracking synced {formatDate(syncedAt)} at {formatTime(syncedAt)}
              </p>
            )}
          </QueueCard>
        }
        aside={<ShipmentPanel orderNumber={selection.activeId} />}
      />
    </>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/DispatchedStage/ShipmentPanel.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import SummaryRows from '@/components/molecules/SummaryRows'
import Timeline from '@/components/molecules/Timeline'
import { env } from '@/app/config/env'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { formatDate, formatShortDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import WorkPanel, { PanelNote, PanelSection } from '@/features/store-operations/components/WorkPanel'
import { useWorkOrder } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useStoreOperations'
import { formatParcelWeight } from '@/features/store-operations/utils/formatParcel'
import styles from './ShipmentPanel.module.scss'
 
const toTimelineItems = (steps) =>
  steps.map((step) => ({
    key: step.key,
    title: step.title,
    timestamp: [step.at ? formatShortDateTime(step.at) : null, step.note].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
    status: step.state,
  }))
 
/** Status, consignment, expected delivery and tracking timeline of one dispatched order. Also used in the Shipping page's drawer. */
export function ShipmentDetails({ order }) {
  const { shipment } = order
 
  return (
    <>
      <PanelSection>
        <div className={styles.status}>
          <StatusBadge status={shipment.status} />
          <span className={styles.service}>
            {formatParcelWeight(shipment.weightKg)} · {shipment.service}
          </span>
        </div>
        <a className={styles.tracking} href={shipment.trackingUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
          {shipment.consignmentId}
          <Icon name="arrow-up-right" />
          <span className="visually-hidden"> (opens India Post tracking in a new tab)</span>
        </a>
        <SummaryRows rows={[{ label: 'Expected delivery', value: formatDate(shipment.expectedDelivery) }]} />
        {order.delay && (
          <Alert tone="warning" action={<Link to={paths.admin.storeTab('delayed')}>View exception</Link>}>
            {order.delay.detail}
          </Alert>
        )}
      </PanelSection>
 
      <PanelSection divided className={styles.timeline}>
        <Timeline items={toTimelineItems(order.tracking)} />
        {env.useMockApi && <PanelNote>Tracking events are development fixtures: India Post tracking sync is not integrated.</PanelNote>}
      </PanelSection>
 
      <div className={styles.actions}>
        <Button as={Link} to={paths.admin.order(order.orderNumber)} variant="secondary" size="sm">
          View order
        </Button>
        <Button as="a" href={`mailto:${order.customer.email}`} variant="secondary" size="sm">
          Contact customer
        </Button>
      </div>
    </>
  )
}
 
/** The Shipment details panel of the Dispatched tab. */
export default function ShipmentPanel({ orderNumber }) {
  const query = useWorkOrder(orderNumber)
 
  return (
    <WorkPanel
      title={orderNumber ? `Shipment details · #${orderNumber}` : 'Shipment details'}
      orderNumber={orderNumber}
      query={query}
      emptyTitle="Select a shipment"
      emptyDescription="Choose a shipment from the list to follow it with India Post."
    >
      {(order) => <ShipmentDetails order={order} />}
    </WorkPanel>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/FlatTable/FlatTable.jsx`
 
```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import styles from './FlatTable.module.scss'
 
/**
 * DataTable drawn flat inside a card, as on the Store Operation design: no outer frame, a tighter header
 * and column rhythm. Takes the same props as DataTable. When the table is selectable, "select all" is the
 * selection summary the card shows above it, so the header checkbox is not repeated.
 */
export default function FlatTable({ className, ...props }) {
  return <DataTable className={clsx(styles.flat, className)} minWidth="30rem" {...props} />
}
```
 
## `src/features/store-operations/components/FlatTable/FlatTable.module.scss`
 
```scss
.flat.flat {
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
 
  table {
    th,
    td {
      padding: 0.6875rem 0.75rem;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
 
    th {
      padding-block: 0.5rem;
      font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-medium);
    }
 
    th:first-child,
    td:first-child {
      padding-left: 0.75rem;
    }
 
    thead input[type='checkbox'] {
      display: none;
    }
  }
}
 
// With a selection column the checkbox sits flush left and the first text column follows closely. The
// selection cell keeps `padding-right: 0 !important` from DataTable, so the gap belongs to the next column.
.flat:has(thead input[type='checkbox']) table {
  th:first-child,
  td:first-child {
    width: 1px;
  }
 
  th:nth-child(2),
  td:nth-child(2) {
    padding-left: 0.6875rem;
  }
}
```

```jsx
import { createContext, use } from 'react'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
 
const HeaderActionsContext = createContext(null)
 
/** Provided by the workspace: the element inside the page header where stage actions are shown. */
export const HeaderActionsProvider = HeaderActionsContext
 
/**
 * Renders its children into the page header's action area. Each stage owns its header buttons (Print pick
 * list, Export shipments, …) because they act on the stage's own filters and selection, while the header
 * and tabs stay mounted across stages so keyboard focus is not lost when switching tabs.
 */
export default function HeaderActions({ children }) {
  const slot = use(HeaderActionsContext)
  return slot ? createPortal(children, slot) : null
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/NewOrdersStage/NewOrdersStage.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { formatDate, formatTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import StageGrid from '@/features/store-operations/components/StageGrid'
import QueueCard from '@/features/store-operations/components/QueueCard'
import QueueToolbar from '@/features/store-operations/components/QueueToolbar'
import { useVerifyOrders } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useFulfilmentActions'
import { useQueueQuery } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useQueueQuery'
import { useQueueSelection } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useQueueSelection'
import { useStageQueue, useStoreOptions } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useStoreOperations'
import { reportBulkResult } from '@/features/store-operations/utils/bulkResult'
import VerifyPanel from './VerifyPanel'
 
const PAGE_SIZE = 6
const PAYMENT_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'All' },
  { value: 'paid', label: 'Paid' },
  { value: 'pending', label: 'Pending' },
  { value: 'failed', label: 'Failed' },
]
 
const COLUMNS = [
  { key: 'order', header: 'Order / customer', cell: (row) => `${row.orderNumber} · ${row.customerName}` },
  { key: 'time', header: 'Time', cell: (row) => formatTime(row.placedAt) },
  { key: 'units', header: 'Units', cell: (row) => row.units },
  { key: 'gross', header: 'Gross', cell: (row) => formatINR(row.grossAmount) },
  {
    key: 'payment',
    header: 'Payment',
    cell: (row) => (
      <span className="d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-2">
        <StatusBadge status={row.paymentStatus} />
        {row.onHold && <StatusBadge status="on_hold" />}
      </span>
    ),
  },
]
 
/** New Orders: verify payment and stock, then release the order to the warehouse (it moves to To Pick). */
export default function NewOrdersStage() {
  const options = useStoreOptions()
  const { state, params, filterKey, update, setPage } = useQueueQuery({ defaults: { payment: 'all', asOf: null }, fixed: { stage: 'new' }, pageSize: PAGE_SIZE })
  const queue = useStageQueue(params)
  const rows = queue.data?.items ?? []
  const selection = useQueueSelection(rows, filterKey)
  const verifyMany = useVerifyOrders()
 
  const asOfDates = options.data?.asOfDates ?? []
  const asOfOptions = asOfDates.map((date) => ({ value: date, label: formatDate(date) }))
 
  const verifySelected = () =>
    verifyMany.mutate(selection.selectedIds, {
      onSuccess: (result) => {
        reportBulkResult(result, { done: 'verified and moved to To Pick' })
        selection.reset()
      },
      onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error)),
    })
 
  return (
    <>
      <QueueToolbar
        search={state.search}
        onSearchChange={(search) => update({ search })}
        searchPlaceholder="Search order, customer or PIN"
        searchLabel="Search new orders by order number, customer or PIN"
        filters={[
          { key: 'payment', label: 'Payment status', prefix: 'Payment:', options: PAYMENT_OPTIONS, value: state.payment, onChange: (payment) => update({ payment }) },
          {
            key: 'asOf',
            label: 'Orders placed on or before',
            options: asOfOptions,
            value: state.asOf ?? asOfDates[0] ?? null,
            onChange: (asOf) => update({ asOf }),
          },
        ]}
      />
      <StageGrid
        panelWidth="23.875rem"
        main={
          <QueueCard
            title={`New Orders · ${queue.data?.totalItems ?? '…'}`}
            caption="New orders waiting for verification"
            itemLabel="orders"
            selectLabel="Select orders"
            columns={COLUMNS}
            rows={rows}
            loading={queue.isPending}
            error={queue.error}
            onRetry={queue.refetch}
            selectedIds={selection.selectedIds}
            onSelectionChange={selection.setSelectedIds}
            onRowClick={selection.focusRow}
            getRowLabel={(row) => `${row.orderNumber} ${row.customerName}`}
            page={state.page}
            pageSize={PAGE_SIZE}
            totalItems={queue.data?.totalItems ?? 0}
            onPageChange={setPage}
            actions={
              <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={selection.selectedIds.length === 0} loading={verifyMany.isPending} onClick={verifySelected}>
                Bulk verify
              </Button>
            }
          />
        }
        aside={<VerifyPanel orderNumber={selection.activeId} onDone={selection.reset} />}
      />
    </>
  )
}
```
 
## `src/features/store-operations/components/NewOrdersStage/VerifyPanel.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import SummaryRows from '@/components/molecules/SummaryRows'
import ConfirmDialog from '@/components/organisms/ConfirmDialog'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import { formatDate, formatTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR, pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import WorkPanel, { PanelNote, PanelSection } from '@/features/store-operations/components/WorkPanel'
import { useHoldOrder, useVerifyOrder } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useFulfilmentActions'
import { useWorkOrder } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useStoreOperations'
import styles from './VerifyPanel.module.scss'
 
const PAYMENT_BADGES = {
  paid: (id) => (
    <Badge tone="success" className="align-self-start">
      {id ? `Verified · ${id}` : 'Verified'}
    </Badge>
  ),
  pending: () => (
    <Badge tone="warning" className="align-self-start">
      Payment pending
    </Badge>
  ),
  failed: () => (
    <Badge tone="danger" className="align-self-start">
      Payment failed
    </Badge>
  ),
}
 
function PaymentVerification({ order }) {
  const { payment } = order
  const rows = [{ label: `Razorpay · ${payment.method}`, value: formatINR(payment.paid, { decimals: 2 }) }]
  if (payment.walletApplied > 0) rows.push({ label: 'Wallet applied', value: formatINR(payment.walletApplied, { decimals: 2 }) })
  const renderBadge = PAYMENT_BADGES[payment.status]
 
  return (
    <PanelSection title="Payment verification">
      <SummaryRows rows={rows} />
      {renderBadge ? renderBadge(payment.razorpayPaymentId) : <StatusBadge status={payment.status} className="align-self-start" />}
    </PanelSection>
  )
}
 
function StockCheck({ order }) {
  const { lines, stock, summary } = order
  const shortCodes = new Set(stock.shortages.map((shortage) => shortage.productCode))
 
  return (
    <PanelSection title={`Stock check · ${pluralize(summary.units, 'unit')}`} divided>
      <table className={styles.stock}>
        <caption className="visually-hidden">Stock needed against stock available</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th scope="col">Product</th>
            <th scope="col">Need</th>
            <th scope="col">Available</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {lines.map((line) => (
            <tr key={line.productCode}>
              <td>
                {line.productCode} · {line.name}
              </td>
              <td>{line.quantity}</td>
              <td className={shortCodes.has(line.productCode) ? styles.short : undefined}>
                {line.available} <Icon name={shortCodes.has(line.productCode) ? 'x-lg' : 'check2'} label={shortCodes.has(line.productCode) ? 'Short' : 'Enough'} />
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      {stock.allAvailable ? (
        <PanelNote tone="success">
          <Icon name="check2" /> All items available in {stock.warehouse.split(' · ')[0]} warehouse.
        </PanelNote>
      ) : (
        <PanelNote tone="danger">
          Short on {pluralize(stock.shortages.length, 'item')}. The picker will need to report a discrepancy.
        </PanelNote>
      )}
    </PanelSection>
  )
}
 
function AddressCheck({ order }) {
  const { address, customer } = order
  return (
    <PanelNote>
      Deliver to {customer.name} · {address.city} {address.pin}. {address.verified ? 'PIN and address verified.' : 'The address has not been verified yet.'}
    </PanelNote>
  )
}
 
/** The Verify panel: payment, stock and address checks for one new order, then release it to the warehouse. */
export default function VerifyPanel({ orderNumber, onDone }) {
  const query = useWorkOrder(orderNumber)
  const verify = useVerifyOrder()
  const hold = useHoldOrder()
  const holdDialog = useDisclosure()
 
  const verifyOrder = () =>
    verify.mutate(orderNumber, {
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(`${orderNumber} verified and moved to To Pick.`)
        onDone()
      },
      onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error)),
    })
 
  const holdOrder = () =>
    hold.mutate(orderNumber, {
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(`${orderNumber} is on hold and listed under Delayed Orders.`)
        holdDialog.close()
      },
      onError: (error) => {
        holdDialog.close()
        toast.error(getErrorMessage(error))
      },
    })
 
  return (
    <WorkPanel
      title={orderNumber ? `Verify #${orderNumber}` : 'Verify order'}
      orderNumber={orderNumber}
      query={query}
      emptyTitle="Select an order"
      emptyDescription="Choose an order from the list to verify its payment and stock."
    >
      {(order) => {
        const cannotVerify = order.stage !== 'new' || order.onHold || order.payment.status !== 'paid'
        return (
          <>
            <div className={styles.meta}>
              <p className={styles.placed}>
                {formatDate(order.placedAt)} · {formatTime(order.placedAt)}
              </p>
              <StatusBadge status={order.stage === 'new' ? 'new' : order.status} />
            </div>
 
            {order.onHold && (
              <Alert tone="warning" className={styles.alert} action={<Link to={paths.admin.storeTab('delayed')}>View exception</Link>}>
                This order is on hold. Resolve the exception before verifying it.
              </Alert>
            )}
 
            <PaymentVerification order={order} />
            <StockCheck order={order} />
            <PanelSection>
              <AddressCheck order={order} />
            </PanelSection>
 
            <div className={styles.actions}>
              <Button size="lg" rightIcon="arrow-right" disabled={cannotVerify} loading={verify.isPending} onClick={verifyOrder}>
                Verify &amp; move to To Pick
              </Button>
              {order.payment.status !== 'paid' && <PanelNote tone="warning">Payment is {order.payment.status}. Verify once it is confirmed.</PanelNote>}
              {!order.onHold && order.stage === 'new' && (
                <Button variant="link" className={styles.hold} onClick={holdDialog.open}>
                  Put order on hold
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
 
            <ConfirmDialog
              open={holdDialog.isOpen}
              onClose={holdDialog.close}
              onConfirm={holdOrder}
              loading={hold.isPending}
              title={`Put ${order.orderNumber} on hold?`}
              message="The order stays in New Orders but is flagged as delayed until someone resolves it under Delayed Orders."
              confirmLabel="Put on hold"
            />
          </>
        )
      }}
    </WorkPanel>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/QueueCard/QueueCard.jsx`
 
```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import { Pagination } from '@/components/molecules/Pagination'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import FlatTable from '@/features/store-operations/components/FlatTable'
import styles from './QueueCard.module.scss'
 
const orderNumberOf = (row) => row.orderNumber
 
function footerSummary({ page, pageSize, totalItems, itemLabel }) {
  if (totalItems === 0) return `No ${itemLabel}`
  if (totalItems <= pageSize) return `Showing all ${formatNumber(totalItems)} ${itemLabel}`
  const from = (page - 1) * pageSize + 1
  return `${formatNumber(from)}–${formatNumber(Math.min(page * pageSize, totalItems))} of ${formatNumber(totalItems)} ${itemLabel}`
}
 
/**
 * The queue table card shared by New Orders, Ready to Dispatch, Dispatched and Delayed Orders.
 *
 * Checking rows selects them for the bulk `actions`; clicking a row (outside its checkbox) focuses just that
 * row. The selection summary under the title doubles as "select all on this page" / "clear".
 * Paging, search and filters are owned by the backend; this card shows the page it is given.
 */
export default function QueueCard({
  title,
  caption,
  itemLabel,
  selectLabel,
  columns,
  rows,
  loading = false,
  error = null,
  onRetry,
  selectedIds,
  onSelectionChange,
  onRowClick,
  rowActions,
  actionsHeader,
  getRowLabel,
  page,
  pageSize,
  totalItems,
  onPageChange,
  actions,
  emptyState,
  children,
  className,
}) {
  const selected = new Set(selectedIds)
  const pageIds = rows.map(orderNumberOf)
  const selectedOnPage = pageIds.filter((id) => selected.has(id)).length
  const allSelected = pageIds.length > 0 && selectedOnPage === pageIds.length
 
  const toggleAll = () => {
    const next = new Set(selected)
    pageIds.forEach((id) => (allSelected ? next.delete(id) : next.add(id)))
    onSelectionChange([...next])
  }
 
  return (
    <Card title={title} padding="sm" className={clsx(styles.card, className)}>
      {error ? (
        <ErrorState compact title="Couldn't load this queue" message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={onRetry} />
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className={styles.controls}>
            <Checkbox
              className={clsx(styles.selection, selectedIds.length > 0 && styles.active)}
              label={selectedIds.length > 0 ? `${formatNumber(selectedIds.length)} selected` : selectLabel}
              checked={allSelected}
              indeterminate={selectedOnPage > 0 && !allSelected}
              disabled={loading || rows.length === 0}
              onChange={toggleAll}
            />
            {actions && <div className={styles.actions}>{actions}</div>}
          </div>
 
          <FlatTable
            caption={caption}
            columns={columns}
            rows={rows}
            getRowId={orderNumberOf}
            getRowLabel={getRowLabel}
            selectable
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onSelectionChange={onSelectionChange}
            onRowClick={onRowClick}
            rowActions={rowActions}
            actionsHeader={actionsHeader}
            loading={loading}
            loadingRows={Math.min(pageSize, 6)}
            emptyState={emptyState}
          />
 
          <div className={styles.footer}>
            <p className={styles.summary} aria-live="polite">
              {footerSummary({ page, pageSize, totalItems, itemLabel })}
            </p>
            <Pagination page={page} pageCount={Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalItems / pageSize))} onPageChange={onPageChange} />
          </div>
          {children}
        </>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/QueueDrawer/QueueDrawer.jsx`
 
```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import Drawer from '@/components/organisms/Drawer'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './QueueDrawer.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Every order waiting in a stage, for jumping to one out of turn (To Pick and To Pack work one order at a
 * time, so the queue itself is not on screen). Choosing an order closes the drawer.
 */
export default function QueueDrawer({ open, onClose, title, description, rows, loading, activeOrderNumber, onSelect }) {
  return (
    <Drawer open={open} onClose={onClose} title={title} description={description}>
      {loading ? (
        <div className={styles.loading}>
          {Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, index) => (
            <Skeleton key={index} height="3.25rem" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState compact icon="inbox" title="Queue is empty" description="No orders are waiting here." />
      ) : (
        <ul className={styles.list}>
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <li key={row.orderNumber}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={clsx(styles.item, row.orderNumber === activeOrderNumber && styles.active)}
                aria-current={row.orderNumber === activeOrderNumber ? 'true' : undefined}
                onClick={() => {
                  onSelect(row.orderNumber)
                  onClose()
                }}
              >
                <span className={styles.main}>
                  <span className={styles.order}>{row.orderNumber} · {row.customerName}</span>
                  <span className={styles.meta}>
                    {pluralize(row.units, 'unit')} · {row.assignee}
                  </span>
                </span>
                {row.onHold ? <StatusBadge status="on_hold" /> : row.priority !== 'standard' && <StatusBadge status={row.priority} />}
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </Drawer>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/QueueToolbar/QueueToolbar.jsx`
 
```jsx
import SearchField from '@/components/molecules/SearchField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import styles from './QueueToolbar.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Search box plus compact filter selects, as shown above every queue.
 *   filters: [{ key, label, prefix?, options: [{ value, label }], value, onChange, disabled? }]
 * `label` names the select for assistive technology; `prefix` is the visible "Payment:" lead-in.
 */
export default function QueueToolbar({ search, onSearchChange, searchLabel, searchPlaceholder, filters = [] }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.toolbar}>
      <SearchField
        className={styles.search}
        size="md"
        value={search}
        onChange={onSearchChange}
        placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
        aria-label={searchLabel ?? searchPlaceholder}
      />
      {filters.map((filter) => (
        <div key={filter.key} className={styles.filter}>
          <SelectField
            size="md"
            fit
            aria-label={filter.label}
            prefixLabel={filter.prefix}
            options={filter.options}
            value={filter.value}
            onChange={filter.onChange}
            isDisabled={filter.disabled}
          />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```scss
// The design's filter row is 36px tall, between the small (34px) and medium (40px) control sizes, so the
// medium size is re-scoped here instead of hard-coding heights on each control.
.toolbar {
  --sh-control-h-md: 36px;
 
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}
 
.search {
  flex: 1 1 14rem;
  min-width: 0;
}
 
.filter {
  flex: none;

## `src/features/store-operations/components/ReadyToDispatchStage/DispatchManifestModal.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { Controller, useFieldArray, useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import Modal from '@/components/organisms/Modal'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { reportBulkResult } from '@/features/store-operations/utils/bulkResult'
import { useDispatchOrders } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useFulfilmentActions'
import { useStageQueue, useStoreOptions } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useStoreOperations'
import { manifestSchema } from '@/features/store-operations/schemas/dispatchSchema'
import { formatParcelWeight } from '@/features/store-operations/utils/formatParcel'
import styles from './DispatchManifestModal.module.scss'
 
const FORM_ID = 'dispatch-manifest-form'
// Every order waiting for dispatch; at most 50 are shown in one manifest.
const MANIFEST_QUERY = { stage: 'ready', page: 1, pageSize: 50 }
 
function ManifestForm({ rows, options, mutation, onClose, onDone }) {
  const carrier = options.carriers[0]
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(manifestSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      service: carrier?.services[0] ?? 'Speed Post',
      dispatchDate: options.today,
      entries: rows.map((row) => ({ orderNumber: row.orderNumber, consignmentId: '' })),
    },
  })
  const { fields, remove } = useFieldArray({ control, name: 'entries' })
 
  const submit = handleSubmit(({ service, dispatchDate, entries }) => {
    const filled = entries.map((entry, index) => ({ ...entry, index })).filter((entry) => entry.consignmentId)
    mutation.mutate(
      filled.map(({ orderNumber, consignmentId }) => ({ orderNumber, consignmentId, service, dispatchDate, carrier: carrier?.value })),
      {
        onSuccess: (result) => {
          reportBulkResult(result, { done: 'dispatched' })
          if (result.failed.length === 0) {
            onClose()
            onDone()
            return
          }
          // Keep the refused orders on screen with the reason; the dispatched ones are done.
          const failedByOrder = new Map(result.failed.map((failure) => [failure.orderNumber, failure.reason]))
          result.succeeded
            .map((orderNumber) => filled.find((entry) => entry.orderNumber === orderNumber).index)
            .sort((a, b) => b - a)
            .forEach(remove)
          const remaining = entries.filter((entry) => !result.succeeded.includes(entry.orderNumber))
          remaining.forEach((entry, index) => {
            if (failedByOrder.has(entry.orderNumber)) setError(`entries.${index}.consignmentId`, { message: failedByOrder.get(entry.orderNumber) })
          })
        },
      },
    )
  })
 
  return (
    <form id={FORM_ID} noValidate onSubmit={submit} className={styles.form}>
      <div className="row g-3">
        <div className="col-12 col-md-6">
          <FormField label="Service" required error={errors.service?.message}>
            {(field) => (
              <Controller
                name="service"
                control={control}
                render={({ field: service }) => (
                  <SelectField {...field} options={(carrier?.services ?? []).map((value) => ({ value, label: value }))} value={service.value} onChange={service.onChange} />
                )}
              />
            )}
          </FormField>
        </div>
        <div className="col-12 col-md-6">
          <FormField label="Dispatch date" required error={errors.dispatchDate?.message}>
            {(field) => <Input {...field} type="date" max={options.today} {...register('dispatchDate')} />}
          </FormField>
        </div>
      </div>
 
      <p className={styles.hint}>Enter the India Post consignment ID of each parcel handed over. Orders left blank stay in the queue.</p>
      {errors.entries?.message && <Alert tone="danger">{errors.entries.message}</Alert>}
 
      <table className={styles.table}>
        <caption className="visually-hidden">Orders in this dispatch manifest</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th scope="col">Order / customer</th>
            <th scope="col">Weight</th>
            <th scope="col">Consignment ID</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {fields.map((field, index) => {
            const row = rows.find((candidate) => candidate.orderNumber === field.orderNumber)
            return (
              <tr key={field.id}>
                <td>
                  {row.orderNumber} · {row.customerName}
                </td>
                <td>{formatParcelWeight(row.weightKg)}</td>
                <td>
                  <FormField error={errors.entries?.[index]?.consignmentId?.message}>
                    {(input) => (
                      <Input
                        {...input}
                        size="md"
                        aria-label={`Consignment ID for ${row.orderNumber}`}
                        placeholder="EU483920218IN"
                        autoComplete="off"
                        spellCheck={false}
                        {...register(`entries.${index}.consignmentId`)}
                      />
                    )}
                  </FormField>
                </td>
              </tr>
            )
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </form>
  )
}
 
/**
 * Create dispatch manifest: assign India Post consignment IDs to several packed orders at once and hand
 * them over together. Limited to the checked orders when any are checked, otherwise every packed order.
 */
export default function DispatchManifestModal({ open, onClose, selectedOrderNumbers, onDone }) {
  const options = useStoreOptions()
  const queue = useStageQueue(MANIFEST_QUERY, { enabled: open })
  const mutation = useDispatchOrders()
 
  const rows = (queue.data?.items ?? []).filter((row) => !row.onHold && (selectedOrderNumbers.length === 0 || selectedOrderNumbers.includes(row.orderNumber)))
  const ready = Boolean(queue.data && options.data)
 
  let body = (
    <div className={styles.loading} role="status" aria-label="Loading orders">
      <Skeleton height="2.75rem" />
      <Skeleton height="2.75rem" />
      <Skeleton height="2.75rem" />
    </div>
  )
  if (queue.isError || options.isError) {
    body = <ErrorState compact message={getErrorMessage(queue.error ?? options.error)} onRetry={queue.refetch} />
  } else if (ready && rows.length === 0) {
    body = <Alert tone="info">There are no packed orders that can be dispatched right now.</Alert>
  } else if (ready) {
    body = <ManifestForm rows={rows} options={options.data} mutation={mutation} onClose={onClose} onDone={onDone} />
  }
 
  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      size="md"
      title="Create dispatch manifest"
      description="Hand a batch of packed parcels to India Post in one go."
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" form={FORM_ID} loading={mutation.isPending} disabled={!ready || rows.length === 0}>
            Mark dispatched
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      {body}
    </Modal>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/ReadyToDispatchStage/DispatchPanel.jsx`
 
  
```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { Controller, useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { CONSIGNMENT_ID_PATTERN } from '@/lib/validation'
import WorkPanel, { PanelNote, PanelSection } from '@/features/store-operations/components/WorkPanel'
import { useDispatchOrder } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useFulfilmentActions'
import { useStoreOptions, useWorkOrder } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useStoreOperations'
import { dispatchSchema } from '@/features/store-operations/schemas/dispatchSchema'
import { formatDimensions, formatParcelWeight } from '@/features/store-operations/utils/formatParcel'
import styles from './DispatchPanel.module.scss'
 
const toOptions = (values = []) => values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value }))
 
function DispatchForm({ order, carriers, onDone }) {
  const dispatch = useDispatchOrder()
  const defaultCarrier = carriers[0]
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    setValue,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(dispatchSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      carrier: defaultCarrier?.value ?? 'India Post',
      service: defaultCarrier?.services[0] ?? 'Speed Post',
      consignmentId: '',
      dispatchDate: order.dispatch.suggestedDate,
      documentsAttached: false,
      weightVerified: false,
    },
  })
 
  const [carrierValue, consignmentId] = useWatch({ control, name: ['carrier', 'consignmentId'] })
  const carrier = carriers.find((candidate) => candidate.value === carrierValue)
  const looksValid = CONSIGNMENT_ID_PATTERN.test(consignmentId.trim().toUpperCase())
 
  const submit = handleSubmit((values) =>
    dispatch.mutate(
      {
        orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
        carrier: values.carrier,
        service: values.service,
        consignmentId: values.consignmentId,
        dispatchDate: values.dispatchDate,
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          toast.success(`${order.orderNumber} dispatched with ${values.consignmentId}.`)
          onDone()
        },
        onError: (error) => {
          const fieldErrors = Object.entries(error.details ?? {})
          if (fieldErrors.length === 0) {
            toast.error(getErrorMessage(error))
            return
          }
          fieldErrors.forEach(([field, message]) => setError(field, { message }))
        },
      },
    ),
  )
 
  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className={styles.form}>
      <div className="row g-3">
        <div className="col-6">
          <FormField label="Carrier" required error={errors.carrier?.message}>
            {(control_) => (
              <Controller
                name="carrier"
                control={control}
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <SelectField
                    {...control_}
                    options={carriers.map(({ value, label }) => ({ value, label }))}
                    value={field.value}
                    onChange={(value) => {
                      field.onChange(value)
                      setValue('service', carriers.find((candidate) => candidate.value === value)?.services[0] ?? '')
                    }}
                  />
                )}
              />
            )}
          </FormField>
        </div>
        <div className="col-6">
          <FormField label="Service" required error={errors.service?.message}>
            {(control_) => (
              <Controller
                name="service"
                control={control}
                render={({ field }) => <SelectField {...control_} options={toOptions(carrier?.services)} value={field.value} onChange={field.onChange} />}
              />
            )}
          </FormField>
        </div>
      </div>
 
      <FormField
        label="Consignment / tracking ID"
        required
        error={errors.consignmentId?.message}
        hint="2 letters, 9 digits, IN. For example EU483920218IN."
        success={looksValid ? 'Valid format: 2 letters, 9 digits, IN' : undefined}
      >
        {(control_) => <Input {...control_} {...register('consignmentId')} autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false} placeholder="EU483920218IN" />}
      </FormField>
 
      <FormField label="Dispatch date" required error={errors.dispatchDate?.message}>
        {(control_) => <Input {...control_} type="date" max={order.dispatch.suggestedDate} {...register('dispatchDate')} />}
      </FormField>
 
      <div className={styles.checks}>
        <FormField error={errors.documentsAttached?.message}>
          {(control_) => <Checkbox {...control_} label="Invoice printed & label attached" {...register('documentsAttached')} />}
        </FormField>
        <FormField error={errors.weightVerified?.message}>
          {(control_) => <Checkbox {...control_} label="Weight verified against manifest" {...register('weightVerified')} />}
        </FormField>
      </div>
 
      <Button type="submit" size="lg" rightIcon="arrow-right" loading={dispatch.isPending} disabled={order.onHold} className={styles.submit}>
        Confirm dispatch handoff
      </Button>
      <PanelNote>Customer receives a shipment update once the handoff is confirmed.</PanelNote>
    </form>
  )
}
 
/** The Assign tracking panel: carrier, service, consignment ID and handoff checks for one packed order. */
export default function DispatchPanel({ orderNumber, onDone }) {
  const query = useWorkOrder(orderNumber)
  const options = useStoreOptions()
 
  return (
    <WorkPanel
      title={orderNumber ? `Assign tracking · #${orderNumber}` : 'Assign tracking'}
      orderNumber={orderNumber}
      query={query}
      emptyTitle="Select a packed order"
      emptyDescription="Choose an order from the queue to assign its India Post tracking ID."
    >
      {(order) => (
        <>
          <PanelSection>
            <StatusBadge status="packed" label="Packed · Ready for handoff" className="align-self-start" />
            <p className={styles.customer}>
              {order.customer.name} · {order.address.city} {order.address.pin}
            </p>
            {order.pack.recorded && (
              <PanelNote>
                Package: {formatParcelWeight(order.pack.recorded.weightKg)} · {formatDimensions(order.pack.recorded.dimensionsCm)}
              </PanelNote>
            )}
            {order.onHold && <Alert tone="warning">This order is on hold. Resolve the exception under Delayed Orders before dispatching it.</Alert>}
          </PanelSection>
          <PanelSection divided className={styles.formSection}>
            <DispatchForm key={order.orderNumber} order={order} carriers={options.data?.carriers ?? []} onDone={onDone} />
          </PanelSection>
        </>
      )}
    </WorkPanel>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/ReadyToDispatchStage/ReadyToDispatchStage.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import { formatDate, formatTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import HeaderActions from '@/features/store-operations/components/HeaderActions'
import QueueCard from '@/features/store-operations/components/QueueCard'
import QueueToolbar from '@/features/store-operations/components/QueueToolbar'
import StageGrid from '@/features/store-operations/components/StageGrid'
import { useDocumentDownloads } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useDocumentDownloads'
import { useQueueQuery } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useQueueQuery'
import { useQueueSelection } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useQueueSelection'
import { useStageQueue, useStoreOptions } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useStoreOperations'
import { formatParcelWeight } from '@/features/store-operations/utils/formatParcel'
import DispatchManifestModal from './DispatchManifestModal'
import DispatchPanel from './DispatchPanel'
import styles from './ReadyToDispatchStage.module.scss'
 
const PAGE_SIZE = 6
 
const COLUMNS = [
  { key: 'order', header: 'Order / customer', cell: (row) => `${row.orderNumber} · ${row.customerName}` },
  { key: 'weight', header: 'Weight', cell: (row) => formatParcelWeight(row.weightKg) },
  { key: 'invoice', header: 'Invoice', cell: (row) => row.invoiceNumber },
  {
    key: 'status',
    header: 'Status',
    cell: (row) => (
      <span className="d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-2">
        <StatusBadge status="packed" />
        {row.delay && <StatusBadge status="delayed" />}
        {row.onHold && <StatusBadge status="on_hold" />}
      </span>
    ),
  },
]
 
function pickupText({ at, parcels, weightKg }, today) {
  const day = formatDate(at) === formatDate(today) ? 'Today' : formatDate(at)
  return `Next India Post pickup: ${day}, ${formatTime(at)} · ${pluralize(parcels, 'parcel')} / ${formatParcelWeight(weightKg)}`
}
 
/** Ready to Dispatch: packed orders waiting for an India Post consignment ID and handoff. */
export default function ReadyToDispatchStage() {
  const options = useStoreOptions()
  const { state, params, filterKey, update, setPage } = useQueueQuery({ defaults: { asOf: null }, fixed: { stage: 'ready' }, pageSize: PAGE_SIZE })
  const queue = useStageQueue(params)
  const rows = queue.data?.items ?? []
  const selection = useQueueSelection(rows, filterKey)
  const documents = useDocumentDownloads()
  const [manifestOpen, setManifestOpen] = useState(false)
 
  const asOfDates = options.data?.asOfDates ?? []
  const asOfOptions = asOfDates.map((date, index) => ({ value: date, label: index === 0 ? 'Today' : index === 1 ? 'Yesterday' : formatDate(date) }))
  const carrierOptions = (options.data?.carriers ?? []).map(({ value, label }) => ({ value, label }))
  const print = (kind) => documents.mutate({ kind, orderNumbers: selection.selectedIds })
  const nothingSelected = selection.selectedIds.length === 0
 
  return (
    <>
      <HeaderActions>
        <Button onClick={() => setManifestOpen(true)}>Create dispatch manifest</Button>
      </HeaderActions>
      <QueueToolbar
        search={state.search}
        onSearchChange={(search) => update({ search })}
        searchPlaceholder="Search packed orders or invoice"
        searchLabel="Search packed orders by order number, customer or invoice"
        filters={[
          { key: 'carrier', label: 'Carrier', prefix: 'Carrier:', options: carrierOptions, value: carrierOptions[0]?.value ?? null, disabled: carrierOptions.length < 2 },
          {
            key: 'asOf',
            label: 'Packed on or before',
            prefix: 'Packed:',
            options: asOfOptions,
            value: state.asOf ?? asOfDates[0] ?? null,
            onChange: (asOf) => update({ asOf }),
          },
        ]}
      />
      <StageGrid
        panelWidth="24.375rem"
        main={
          <QueueCard
            title={`Packed queue · ${queue.data?.totalItems ?? '…'} orders`}
            caption="Packed orders ready for dispatch"
            itemLabel="packed orders"
            selectLabel="Select orders"
            columns={COLUMNS}
            rows={rows}
            loading={queue.isPending}
            error={queue.error}
            onRetry={queue.refetch}
            selectedIds={selection.selectedIds}
            onSelectionChange={selection.setSelectedIds}
            onRowClick={selection.focusRow}
            getRowLabel={(row) => `${row.orderNumber} ${row.customerName}`}
            page={state.page}
            pageSize={PAGE_SIZE}
            totalItems={queue.data?.totalItems ?? 0}
            onPageChange={setPage}
            actions={
              <>
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={nothingSelected} loading={documents.isPending && documents.variables.kind === 'invoice'} onClick={() => print('invoice')}>
                  Print invoices
                </Button>
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={nothingSelected} loading={documents.isPending && documents.variables.kind === 'label'} onClick={() => print('label')}>
                  Print labels
                </Button>
              </>
            }
          >
            {queue.data?.summary.nextPickup && <p className={styles.pickup}>{pickupText(queue.data.summary.nextPickup, options.data?.today)}</p>}
          </QueueCard>
        }
        aside={<DispatchPanel orderNumber={selection.activeId} onDone={selection.reset} />}
      />
      <DispatchManifestModal open={manifestOpen} onClose={() => setManifestOpen(false)} selectedOrderNumbers={selection.selectedIds} onDone={selection.reset} />
    </>
  )
}
```

import styles from './StageGrid.module.scss'
 
/**
 * The two-column work area of a stage: the queue (or the order being worked) on the left and the side
 * panels on the right. `panelWidth` is the width the design gives the right column on desktop; below
 * 1280px the panels stack under the main column.
 */
export default function StageGrid({ panelWidth, main, aside }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.grid} style={{ '--panel-width': panelWidth }}>
      <div className={styles.column}>{main}</div>
      <div className={styles.column}>{aside}</div>
    </div>
  )
}

```jsx
import StatCard from '@/components/molecules/StatCard'
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import styles from './StageSummary.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Row of four label / number cards above a queue.
 *   items: [{ key, label, value, tone?: 'warning' | 'danger' | 'info' | 'neutral' }]
 * `value` is the count the backend reports; `tone` colours the number as on the Delayed Orders design.
 */
export default function StageSummary({ items, label }) {
  return (
    <ul className={styles.cards} aria-label={label}>
      {items.map((item) => (
        <li key={item.key}>
          <StatCard
            layout="inline"
            className={styles.card}
            label={item.label}
            value={<span className={clsx(styles.value, item.tone && styles[item.tone])}>{formatNumber(item.value)}</span>}
          />
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/StageTabs/StageTabs.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Tabs from '@/components/molecules/Tabs'
import { STAGES } from '@/features/store-operations/config/stages'
import styles from './StageTabs.module.scss'
 
/**
 * The six stage tabs with live counts. They are real in-page tabs (tablist, arrow keys) whose selection
 * is the URL, so a stage can be bookmarked and the browser's back button works.
 */
export default function StageTabs({ id, value, counts, onChange }) {
  const items = STAGES.map((stage) => ({ key: stage.key, label: stage.label, count: counts?.[stage.countKey] }))
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.root}>
      <Tabs id={id} variant="pill" label="Store operation stages" items={items} value={value} onChange={onChange} />
    </div>
  )
}
```
 
## `src/features/store-operations/components/StageTabs/StageTabs.module.scss`
 
```scss
// The design stretches the six tabs across the bar and shows each count as plain text beside the label.
// Tabs already provides the pill look; this only spreads it and tones the count down. The selectors use
// ARIA roles because those are the stable contract of the shared component.
.root {
  > div {
    border-radius: var(--sh-radius-lg);
  }
 
  [role='tablist'] {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(max-content, 1fr));
  }
 
  button[role='tab'] {
    height: 40px;
    justify-content: center;
    border-radius: var(--sh-radius-md);
    font-size: var(--sh-font-size-xs);
    font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-semibold);
 
    span {
      min-width: 0;
      height: auto;
      padding: 0;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--sh-color-muted);
      font-size: var(--sh-font-size-2xs);
      font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-medium);
    }
  }
 
  button[role='tab'][aria-selected='true'] span {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--sh-color-white);
  }
}
```

```javascript
import DelayedStage from '@/features/store-operations/components/DelayedStage'
import DispatchedStage from '@/features/store-operations/components/DispatchedStage'
import NewOrdersStage from '@/features/store-operations/components/NewOrdersStage'
import ReadyToDispatchStage from '@/features/store-operations/components/ReadyToDispatchStage'
import ToPackStage from '@/features/store-operations/components/ToPackStage'
import ToPickStage from '@/features/store-operations/components/ToPickStage'
 
/** Stage key (URL segment) → the component that renders it. */
export const STAGE_VIEWS = {
  'new-orders': NewOrdersStage,
  'to-pick': ToPickStage,
  'to-pack': ToPackStage,
  'ready-to-dispatch': ReadyToDispatchStage,
  dispatched: DispatchedStage,
  delayed: DelayedStage,
}
```
 
## `src/features/store-operations/components/StoreOperationWorkspace/StoreOperationWorkspace.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import { TabPanel } from '@/components/molecules/Tabs'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import { HeaderActionsProvider } from '@/features/store-operations/components/HeaderActions'
import StageTabs from '@/features/store-operations/components/StageTabs'
import { useStageCounts } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useStoreOperations'
import { STAGE_VIEWS } from './stageViews'
import styles from './StoreOperationWorkspace.module.scss'
 
const TABS_ID = 'store-operation'
 
function describe(stage, counts) {
  if (stage.stage !== 'delayed' || !counts) return stage.description
  return `${stage.description} ${pluralize(counts.delayed, 'order')} need${counts.delayed === 1 ? 's' : ''} attention · ${counts.delayedBeyondSla} beyond SLA.`
}
 
/** Header, stage tabs and the view of the selected stage. The tabs stay mounted while the stage changes. */
export default function StoreOperationWorkspace({ stage }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const counts = useStageCounts()
  const [actionsSlot, setActionsSlot] = useState(null)
  const StageView = STAGE_VIEWS[stage.key]
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.workspace}>
      <PageHeader
        className={styles.header}
        title={stage.title}
        description={describe(stage, counts.data)}
        actions={<div ref={setActionsSlot} className={styles.actions} />}
      />
      <StageTabs id={TABS_ID} value={stage.key} counts={counts.data} onChange={(key) => navigate(paths.admin.storeTab(key))} />
      <TabPanel id={TABS_ID} tabKey={stage.key} value={stage.key} className={styles.stage}>
        <HeaderActionsProvider value={actionsSlot}>
          <StageView />
        </HeaderActionsProvider>
      </TabPanel>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/ToPackStage/FinalVerification.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import AddressSummary from '@/components/molecules/AddressSummary'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import { PanelNote, PanelSection } from '@/features/store-operations/components/WorkPanel'
import styles from './FinalVerification.module.scss'
 
function paymentNote({ method, paid, walletApplied }) {
  const parts = [`${method} ${formatINR(paid)}`]
  if (walletApplied > 0) parts.push(`Wallet ${formatINR(walletApplied)}`)
  return `${parts.join(' + ')}${method === 'COD' ? '' : ' · No COD collection'}`
}
 
/** Last look at what was paid and where the parcel is going before it is sealed. */
export default function FinalVerification({ order }) {
  const { payment, address } = order
 
  return (
    <Card title="Final verification" padding="sm">
      <PanelSection>
        <div className={styles.row}>
          <p className={styles.heading}>Payment · {formatINR(payment.gross)} gross</p>
          {payment.status === 'paid' ? <Badge tone="success">Verified</Badge> : <StatusBadge status={payment.status} />}
        </div>
        <PanelNote>{paymentNote(payment)}</PanelNote>
      </PanelSection>
      <PanelSection divided>
        <div className={styles.row}>
          <p className={styles.heading}>{address.label ?? 'Delivery address'}</p>
          {address.verified && <Badge tone="success">Verified</Badge>}
        </div>
        <AddressSummary address={{ ...address, name: address.name ?? order.customer.name }} />
        {address.verified ? (
          <Badge tone="success" className="align-self-start">
            Address verified · {address.pin}
          </Badge>
        ) : (
          <Badge tone="warning" className="align-self-start">
            Address not verified · {address.pin}
          </Badge>
        )}
      </PanelSection>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import { formatDate } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import { PanelNote, PanelSection } from '@/features/store-operations/components/WorkPanel'
import { useDocumentDownloads } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useDocumentDownloads'
import styles from './InvoicePanel.module.scss'
 
/** Preview of the tax invoice that goes into the parcel, with buttons for the invoice and the shipping label. */
export default function InvoicePanel({ order }) {
  const { invoice } = order
  const documents = useDocumentDownloads()
  const print = (kind) => documents.mutate({ kind, orderNumbers: [order.orderNumber] })
 
  return (
    <Card title="Invoice & shipping label" padding="sm">
      <PanelSection>
        <div className={styles.preview}>
          <div className={styles.header}>
            <p className={styles.brand}>Shipper.com</p>
            <p className={styles.kind}>TAX INVOICE</p>
          </div>
          <p className={styles.number}>
            {invoice.number} · {formatDate(invoice.date)}
          </p>
          <dl className={styles.amounts}>
            <div>
              <dt>Taxable / GST</dt>
              <dd>
                {formatINR(invoice.taxable, { decimals: 2 })} / {formatINR(invoice.gst, { decimals: 2 })}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Gross amount</dt>
              <dd>{formatINR(invoice.gross, { decimals: 2 })}</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
          <p className={styles.gstin}>
            GSTIN {invoice.gstin} · State {invoice.stateCode}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.buttons}>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" loading={documents.isPending && documents.variables?.kind === 'invoice'} onClick={() => print('invoice')}>
            Print invoice
          </Button>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" loading={documents.isPending && documents.variables?.kind === 'label'} onClick={() => print('label')}>
            Print label
          </Button>
        </div>
        <PanelNote>Carrier: India Post · Tracking will be assigned before dispatch.</PanelNote>
      </PanelSection>
    </Card>
  )
}
```
