## `src/features/store-operations/components/ToPackStage/PackageDetails.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Controller } from 'react-hook-form'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import styles from './PackageDetails.module.scss'
 
const toOptions = (values) => values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value }))
 
/** Weight, dimensions, packaging and the three seal-up confirmations for the parcel. */
export default function PackageDetails({ register, control, errors, packers, packagingTypes }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Package details" padding="sm">
      <div className="row g-3">
        <div className="col-6 col-md-3">
          <FormField label="Weight (kg)" required error={errors.weightKg?.message}>
            {(field) => <Input {...field} type="number" inputMode="decimal" step="0.01" min="0" {...register('weightKg')} />}
          </FormField>
        </div>
        <div className="col-6 col-md-3">
          <FormField label="Length (cm)" error={errors.length?.message}>
            {(field) => <Input {...field} type="number" inputMode="decimal" step="0.1" min="0" {...register('length')} />}
          </FormField>
        </div>
        <div className="col-6 col-md-3">
          <FormField label="Width (cm)" error={errors.width?.message}>
            {(field) => <Input {...field} type="number" inputMode="decimal" step="0.1" min="0" {...register('width')} />}
          </FormField>
        </div>
        <div className="col-6 col-md-3">
          <FormField label="Height (cm)" error={errors.height?.message}>
            {(field) => <Input {...field} type="number" inputMode="decimal" step="0.1" min="0" {...register('height')} />}
          </FormField>
        </div>
        <div className="col-12 col-md-6">
          <FormField label="Packaging type" error={errors.packaging?.message}>
            {(field) => (
              <Controller
                name="packaging"
                control={control}
                render={({ field: packaging }) => <SelectField {...field} options={toOptions(packagingTypes)} value={packaging.value} onChange={packaging.onChange} />}
              />
            )}
          </FormField>
        </div>
        <div className="col-12 col-md-6">
          <FormField label="Packed by" error={errors.packedBy?.message}>
            {(field) => (
              <Controller
                name="packedBy"
                control={control}
                render={({ field: packedBy }) => <SelectField {...field} options={toOptions(packers)} value={packedBy.value} onChange={packedBy.onChange} />}
              />
            )}
          </FormField>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.checks}>
        <FormField error={errors.protectiveWrap?.message}>
          {(field) => <Checkbox {...field} label="Protective wrap added" {...register('protectiveWrap')} />}
        </FormField>
        <FormField error={errors.invoiceEnclosed?.message}>
          {(field) => <Checkbox {...field} label="Invoice enclosed" {...register('invoiceEnclosed')} />}
        </FormField>
        <FormField error={errors.boxSealed?.message}>
          {(field) => <Checkbox {...field} label="Box sealed" {...register('boxSealed')} />}
        </FormField>
      </div>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/ToPackStage/PackChecklist.jsx`
 
```jsx
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import FlatTable from '@/features/store-operations/components/FlatTable'
import styles from './PackChecklist.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Contents of the order, ticked off as each product is checked against the parcel. "Condition" is what
 * the packer looks for on that product.
 */
export default function PackChecklist({ order, checked, onToggleLine, showError }) {
  const checkedUnits = order.lines.filter((line) => checked.includes(line.productCode)).reduce((total, line) => total + line.quantity, 0)
  const allChecked = checkedUnits === order.summary.units
 
  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'check',
      header: 'Check',
      width: '1%',
      cell: (line) => <Checkbox aria-label={`Check ${line.productCode}`} checked={checked.includes(line.productCode)} onChange={() => onToggleLine(line.productCode)} />,
    },
    { key: 'product', header: 'Product / batch', cell: (line) => `${line.productCode} · ${line.name} / ${line.batch}` },
    { key: 'quantity', header: 'Qty', cell: (line) => line.quantity },
    {
      key: 'condition',
      header: 'Condition',
      cell: (line) => (
        <span>
          <Icon name="check2" /> {line.inspection}
        </span>
      ),
    },
  ]
 
  return (
    <>
      <FlatTable className={styles.table} caption={`Contents of ${order.orderNumber}`} columns={columns} rows={order.lines} getRowId={(line) => line.productCode} />
      {allChecked ? (
        <p className={styles.success}>
          <Icon name="check2" /> {checkedUnits} of {pluralize(order.summary.units, 'unit')} checked · Correct batches confirmed
        </p>
      ) : (
        <p className={styles.summary}>
          {checkedUnits} of {pluralize(order.summary.units, 'unit')} checked
        </p>
      )}
      {showError && (
        <p role="alert" className={styles.error}>
          Check every product against the parcel before marking the order packed.
        </p>
      )}
    </>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/ToPackStage/PackWorkbench.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { formatShortDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { useMarkPacked } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useFulfilmentActions'
import { packSchema } from '@/features/store-operations/schemas/packSchema'
import PackageDetails from './PackageDetails'
import PackChecklist from './PackChecklist'
import styles from './PackWorkbench.module.scss'
 
const PARCEL_FIELDS = ['weightKg', 'length', 'width', 'height', 'packaging', 'packedBy']
 
/**
 * The packing bench for one order: contents checklist, parcel details and the buttons that finish it.
 * The checklist is a physical check kept on screen only; the parcel details and the three confirmations
 * are what the backend receives.
 */
export default function PackWorkbench({ order, queueSize, packers, packagingTypes, hasPrevious, onPrevious, onViewQueue, onPacked }) {
  const markPacked = useMarkPacked()
  const { suggested } = order.pack
  const [checked, setChecked] = useState([])
  const [attempted, setAttempted] = useState(false)
  const allChecked = order.lines.every((line) => checked.includes(line.productCode))
 
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(packSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      weightKg: suggested.weightKg,
      length: suggested.dimensionsCm.length,
      width: suggested.dimensionsCm.width,
      height: suggested.dimensionsCm.height,
      packaging: suggested.packaging,
      packedBy: suggested.packedBy,
      protectiveWrap: false,
      invoiceEnclosed: false,
      boxSealed: false,
    },
  })
 
  const submit = handleSubmit((values) => {
    if (!allChecked) return
    markPacked.mutate(
      {
        orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
        weightKg: values.weightKg,
        dimensionsCm: { length: values.length, width: values.width, height: values.height },
        packaging: values.packaging,
        packedBy: values.packedBy,
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          toast.success(`${order.orderNumber} packed and moved to Ready to Dispatch.`)
          onPacked()
        },
        onError: (error) => {
          const fieldErrors = Object.entries(error.details ?? {})
          if (fieldErrors.length === 0) toast.error(getErrorMessage(error))
          fieldErrors.forEach(([field, message]) => setError(PARCEL_FIELDS.includes(field) ? field : 'root', { message }))
        },
      },
    )
  })
 
  const handleFormSubmit = (event) => {
    setAttempted(true)
    return submit(event)
  }
 
  const toggleLine = (code) => setChecked((current) => (current.includes(code) ? current.filter((candidate) => candidate !== code) : [...current, code]))
 
  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={handleFormSubmit} className={styles.form} aria-label={`Pack order ${order.orderNumber}`}>
      <Card title={`Pack order #${order.orderNumber}`} padding="sm">
        <p className={styles.meta}>
          {order.customer.name} · Picked by {order.fulfilment.assignee}
          {order.timestamps.pickedAt && ` · ${formatShortDateTime(order.timestamps.pickedAt)}`}
        </p>
        <div className={styles.status}>
          <StatusBadge status="to_pack" />
          <Button variant="link" size="sm" onClick={onViewQueue}>
            {queueSize} {queueSize === 1 ? 'order' : 'orders'} in queue
          </Button>
        </div>
        {order.onHold && (
          <Alert tone="warning" className={styles.alert}>
            This order is on hold. Resolve the exception under Delayed Orders before packing it.
          </Alert>
        )}
        <PackChecklist order={order} checked={checked} onToggleLine={toggleLine} showError={attempted && !allChecked} />
      </Card>
 
      <PackageDetails register={register} control={control} errors={errors} packers={packers} packagingTypes={packagingTypes} />
 
      {errors.root && <Alert tone="danger">{errors.root.message}</Alert>}
 
      <div className={styles.actions}>
        <Button variant="secondary" size="md" leftIcon="arrow-left" disabled={!hasPrevious} onClick={onPrevious}>
          Previous order
        </Button>
        <Button type="submit" size="lg" rightIcon="arrow-right" loading={markPacked.isPending} disabled={order.onHold}>
          Mark Packed &amp; continue
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/ToPackStage/ToPackStage.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import QueueDrawer from '@/features/store-operations/components/QueueDrawer'
import StageGrid from '@/features/store-operations/components/StageGrid'
import { useStageQueue, useStoreOptions, useWorkOrder } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useStoreOperations'
import FinalVerification from './FinalVerification'
import InvoicePanel from './InvoicePanel'
import PackWorkbench from './PackWorkbench'
 
// Packing is done one order at a time, so the whole queue is loaded and the first order is shown.
const QUEUE_SIZE = 50
const QUEUE_PARAMS = { stage: 'to_pack', page: 1, pageSize: QUEUE_SIZE }
 
/** To Pack: check the contents of one order, record the parcel and seal it, then move on to the next. */
export default function ToPackStage() {
  const options = useStoreOptions()
  const queue = useStageQueue(QUEUE_PARAMS)
  const queueDrawer = useDisclosure()
 
  const rows = queue.data?.items ?? []
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState(null)
  const active = rows.find((row) => row.orderNumber === chosen) ?? rows[0] ?? null
  const activeNumber = active?.orderNumber ?? null
  const activeIndex = active ? rows.indexOf(active) : -1
  const order = useWorkOrder(activeNumber)
 
  const previous = rows[activeIndex - 1]
  // The packed order leaves the queue, so the order that followed it takes its place on screen.
  const afterPacked = () => setChosen((rows[activeIndex + 1] ?? previous)?.orderNumber ?? null)
 
  let message
  if (queue.isError) {
    message = <ErrorState compact title="Couldn't load the pack queue" message={getErrorMessage(queue.error)} onRetry={queue.refetch} />
  } else if (queue.isPending || (activeNumber && order.isPending)) {
    message = <Skeleton height="18rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-lg)" />
  } else if (!active) {
    message = <EmptyState icon="check2-circle" title="Nothing to pack" description="Every picked order has been packed." />
  } else if (order.isError) {
    message = <ErrorState compact title="Couldn't load this order" message={getErrorMessage(order.error)} onRetry={order.refetch} />
  }
 
  return (
    <>
      {message ? (
        <Card padding="sm">{message}</Card>
      ) : (
        <StageGrid
          panelWidth="23.125rem"
          main={
            <PackWorkbench
              key={order.data.orderNumber}
              order={order.data}
              queueSize={queue.data.totalItems}
              packers={options.data?.packers ?? []}
              packagingTypes={options.data?.packagingTypes ?? []}
              hasPrevious={Boolean(previous)}
              onPrevious={() => setChosen(previous.orderNumber)}
              onViewQueue={queueDrawer.open}
              onPacked={afterPacked}
            />
          }
          aside={
            <>
              <FinalVerification order={order.data} />
              <InvoicePanel order={order.data} />
            </>
          }
        />
      )}
      <QueueDrawer
        open={queueDrawer.isOpen}
        onClose={queueDrawer.close}
        title="Pack queue"
        description="Open any order waiting to be packed."
        rows={rows}
        loading={queue.isPending}
        activeOrderNumber={activeNumber}
        onSelect={setChosen}
      />
    </>
  )
}
```
 
## `src/features/store-operations/components/ToPickStage/DiscrepancyModal.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useMemo } from 'react'
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { Controller, useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import SelectField from '@/components/molecules/SelectField'
import Modal from '@/components/organisms/Modal'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { useReportStockException } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useFulfilmentActions'
import { createDiscrepancySchema } from '@/features/store-operations/schemas/discrepancySchema'
 
const FORM_ID = 'stock-discrepancy-form'
 
function DiscrepancyForm({ order, mutation, onClose }) {
  const schema = useMemo(() => createDiscrepancySchema(order.lines), [order.lines])
  const shortLine = order.lines.find((line) => line.available < line.quantity) ?? order.lines[0]
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(schema), defaultValues: { productCode: shortLine.productCode, availableQuantity: '', note: '' } })
 
  const submit = handleSubmit((values) =>
    mutation.mutate(
      { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, ...values },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          toast.success(`${order.orderNumber} is on hold and listed under Delayed Orders.`)
          onClose()
        },
        onError: (error) => {
          const fieldErrors = Object.entries(error.details ?? {})
          if (fieldErrors.length === 0) toast.error(getErrorMessage(error))
          fieldErrors.forEach(([field, message]) => setError(field, { message }))
        },
      },
    ),
  )
 
  return (
    <form id={FORM_ID} noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="d-flex flex-column gap-3">
      <FormField label="Product" required error={errors.productCode?.message}>
        {(field) => (
          <Controller
            name="productCode"
            control={control}
            render={({ field: product }) => (
              <SelectField
                {...field}
                options={order.lines.map((line) => ({ value: line.productCode, label: `${line.productCode} · ${line.name} (requested ${line.quantity})` }))}
                value={product.value}
                onChange={product.onChange}
              />
            )}
          />
        )}
      </FormField>
      <FormField label="Quantity found in the bin" required error={errors.availableQuantity?.message}>
        {(field) => <Input {...field} type="number" inputMode="numeric" min="0" {...register('availableQuantity')} />}
      </FormField>
      <FormField label="Note" error={errors.note?.message}>
        {(field) => <Input {...field} placeholder="What did you see on the shelf?" autoComplete="off" {...register('note')} />}
      </FormField>
    </form>
  )
}
 
/** Short-pick report: records what was actually found, holds the order and sends it to Delayed Orders. */
export default function DiscrepancyModal({ open, onClose, order }) {
  const mutation = useReportStockException()
 
  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      size="sm"
      title="Report stock discrepancy"
      description={`${order.orderNumber} is put on hold and moved to Delayed Orders until the stock is sorted out.`}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" form={FORM_ID} loading={mutation.isPending}>
            Report and hold order
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <DiscrepancyForm key={order.orderNumber} order={order} mutation={mutation} onClose={onClose} />
    </Modal>
  )
}
```

import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './NextInQueue.module.scss'
 
function PriorityBadge({ row }) {
  if (row.onHold) return <StatusBadge status="on_hold" />
  return <StatusBadge status={row.priority} label={row.priority === 'high' ? 'High priority' : undefined} />
}
 
/** The next orders in line; choosing one makes it the order being picked. */
export default function NextInQueue({ rows, totalItems, onSelect, onViewAll }) {
  return (
    <Card
      title="Next in queue"
      padding="sm"
      actions={
        <Button variant="link" size="sm" onClick={onViewAll}>
          View all {totalItems}
        </Button>
      }
    >
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={styles.empty}>No other orders are waiting to be picked.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className={styles.list}>
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <li key={row.orderNumber}>
              <button type="button" className={styles.item} onClick={() => onSelect(row.orderNumber)}>
                <span>
                  {row.orderNumber} · {row.customerName} · {pluralize(row.units, 'unit')}
                </span>
                <PriorityBadge row={row} />
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}

## `src/features/store-operations/components/ToPickStage/PickConfirmation.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import SummaryRows from '@/components/molecules/SummaryRows'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import { PanelNote, PanelSection } from '@/features/store-operations/components/WorkPanel'
import { useMarkPicked } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useFulfilmentActions'
import styles from './PickConfirmation.module.scss'
 
/** Who is picking, from where, how far along they are, and the buttons that finish or flag the pick. */
export default function PickConfirmation({ order, pickedCodes, onPicked, onReportDiscrepancy }) {
  const markPicked = useMarkPicked()
  const pickedUnits = order.lines.filter((line) => pickedCodes.has(line.productCode)).reduce((total, line) => total + line.quantity, 0)
  const allPicked = order.lines.every((line) => pickedCodes.has(line.productCode))
 
  const finish = () =>
    markPicked.mutate(
      { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, lines: order.lines.map((line) => ({ productCode: line.productCode, pickedQuantity: pickedCodes.has(line.productCode) ? line.quantity : 0 })) },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          toast.success(`${order.orderNumber} picked and moved to To Pack.`)
          onPicked()
        },
        onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error)),
      },
    )
 
  return (
    <Card title="Pick confirmation" padding="sm">
      <PanelSection>
        <SummaryRows
          rows={[
            { label: 'Assigned to', value: order.fulfilment.assignee },
            { label: 'Location', value: order.fulfilment.warehouse },
            { label: 'Pick batch', value: order.fulfilment.pickBatch ?? '—' },
            { label: 'Progress', value: `${pickedUnits} / ${pluralize(order.summary.units, 'unit')}` },
          ]}
        />
        {order.stock.allAvailable ? (
          <Badge tone="success" className="align-self-start">
            Stock verified
          </Badge>
        ) : (
          <Badge tone="danger" className="align-self-start">
            Stock short
          </Badge>
        )}
      </PanelSection>
      <PanelSection divided className={styles.actions}>
        <PanelNote>Check batch, expiry and product condition before handing over to packing.</PanelNote>
        <div className={styles.buttons}>
          <Button size="lg" rightIcon="arrow-right" disabled={!allPicked || order.onHold} loading={markPicked.isPending} onClick={finish}>
            Move to To Pack
          </Button>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={onReportDiscrepancy} disabled={order.onHold}>
            Report discrepancy
          </Button>
        </div>
      </PanelSection>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/ToPickStage/PickList.jsx`
 
```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import FlatTable from '@/features/store-operations/components/FlatTable'
import styles from './PickList.module.scss'
 
const hasStock = (line) => line.available >= line.quantity
 
function PickStatus({ order, pickedUnits, allPicked }) {
  const shortLines = order.lines.filter((line) => !hasStock(line))
 
  if (order.onHold && order.delay) return <p className={clsx(styles.status, styles.warning)}>On hold. {order.delay.detail}</p>
  if (shortLines.length > 0) {
    const [line] = shortLines
    return (
      <p className={clsx(styles.status, styles.danger)}>
        Stock is short for {line.productCode}: requested {line.quantity}, available {line.available}. Report a discrepancy to hold the order.
      </p>
    )
  }
  if (allPicked) {
    return (
      <p className={clsx(styles.status, styles.success)}>
        <Icon name="check2" /> Stock matched. All {pluralize(order.summary.units, 'unit')} picked and reserved.
      </p>
    )
  }
  return <p className={styles.status}>{pickedUnits} of {pluralize(order.summary.units, 'unit')} picked.</p>
}
 
/**
 * Pick list of the order being worked: where each product is, how many are needed and what is on the
 * shelf. Lines are ticked as they are picked; a line the warehouse cannot cover is flagged instead.
 */
export default function PickList({ order, pickedCodes, onPickedChange, onScan }) {
  const pickable = order.lines.filter(hasStock)
  const allPicked = order.lines.length > 0 && pickable.length === order.lines.length && pickable.every((line) => pickedCodes.has(line.productCode))
  const pickedUnits = order.lines.filter((line) => pickedCodes.has(line.productCode)).reduce((total, line) => total + line.quantity, 0)
 
  const toggleLine = (code) => {
    const next = new Set(pickedCodes)
    if (next.has(code)) next.delete(code)
    else next.add(code)
    onPickedChange(next)
  }
 
  const toggleAll = () => onPickedChange(allPicked ? [] : pickable.map((line) => line.productCode))
 
  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'pick',
      header: <span className="visually-hidden">Picked</span>,
      width: '1%',
      cell: (line) => (
        <Checkbox
          aria-label={`Mark ${line.productCode} as picked`}
          checked={pickedCodes.has(line.productCode)}
          disabled={!hasStock(line)}
          onChange={() => toggleLine(line.productCode)}
        />
      ),
    },
    { key: 'product', header: 'SKU / product', cell: (line) => `${line.productCode} · ${line.name}` },
    { key: 'bin', header: 'Bin', cell: (line) => line.bin },
    { key: 'requested', header: 'Requested', cell: (line) => line.quantity },
    { key: 'available', header: 'Available', cell: (line) => <span className={hasStock(line) ? undefined : styles.short}>{line.available}</span> },
    {
      key: 'picked',
      header: 'Picked',
      cell: (line) =>
        pickedCodes.has(line.productCode) ? (
          <span>
            {line.quantity} <Icon name="check2" label="Picked" />
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span className={styles.muted}>0</span>
        ),
    },
  ]
 
  return (
    <Card title={`Pick list · #${order.orderNumber}`} padding="sm">
      <p className={styles.meta}>
        {order.customer.name} · {pluralize(order.summary.units, 'unit')} · Payment {order.payment.status === 'paid' ? 'verified' : order.payment.status}
      </p>
      <div className={styles.controls}>
        <Checkbox
          className={clsx(styles.selection, pickedCodes.size > 0 && styles.active)}
          label={allPicked ? `All ${order.lines.length} products selected` : `${pickedCodes.size} of ${order.lines.length} products selected`}
          checked={allPicked}
          indeterminate={pickedCodes.size > 0 && !allPicked}
          disabled={pickable.length === 0}
          onChange={toggleAll}
        />
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="upc-scan" onClick={onScan}>
          Scan product
        </Button>
      </div>
      <FlatTable className={styles.table} caption={`Pick list for ${order.orderNumber}`} columns={columns} rows={order.lines} getRowId={(line) => line.productCode} />
      <PickStatus order={order} pickedUnits={pickedUnits} allPicked={allPicked} />
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/ToPickStage/ScanProductModal.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { z } from 'zod'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import Modal from '@/components/organisms/Modal'
import { requiredText } from '@/lib/validation'
import styles from './ScanProductModal.module.scss'
 
const FORM_ID = 'scan-product-form'
const scanSchema = z.object({ code: requiredText('Scan or enter a product code') })
 
function ScanForm({ lines, pickedCodes, onPickedChange }) {
  const [lastPicked, setLastPicked] = useState(null)
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    reset,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(scanSchema), defaultValues: { code: '' } })
 
  // A hand scanner types the code and presses Enter, so the field is submitted like any form.
  const submit = handleSubmit(({ code }) => {
    setLastPicked(null)
    const line = lines.find((candidate) => candidate.productCode.toLowerCase() === code.toLowerCase())
    if (!line) return setError('code', { message: `${code.toUpperCase()} is not on this pick list.` })
    if (line.available < line.quantity) return setError('code', { message: `${line.productCode} is short in stock. Report a discrepancy instead.` })
    if (pickedCodes.has(line.productCode)) return setError('code', { message: `${line.productCode} is already picked.` })
    onPickedChange(new Set([...pickedCodes, line.productCode]))
    setLastPicked(line.productCode)
    return reset({ code: '' })
  })
 
  return (
    <form id={FORM_ID} noValidate onSubmit={submit} className={styles.form}>
      <FormField label="Product code" hint="For example HL001. Point the scanner at the label or type the code." error={errors.code?.message}>
        {(field) => <Input {...field} autoFocus autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false} placeholder="HL001" {...register('code')} />}
      </FormField>
      {lastPicked && (
        <p className={styles.success} role="status">
          <Icon name="check2" /> {lastPicked} marked as picked.
        </p>
      )}
    </form>
  )
}
 
/** Marks a pick-list line as picked from a scanned or typed product code. */
export default function ScanProductModal({ open, onClose, lines, pickedCodes, onPickedChange }) {
  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      size="sm"
      title="Scan product"
      description="Each scan ticks the matching line on the pick list."
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>
            Done
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" form={FORM_ID}>
            Mark as picked
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <ScanForm lines={lines} pickedCodes={pickedCodes} onPickedChange={onPickedChange} />
    </Modal>
  )
}
```

import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'

  return (

      <ul className={styles.list}>

          <li key={exception.orderNumber} className={styles.item}>
            <button type="button" className={styles.badge} onClick={() => onSelect(exception.orderNumber)}>
              {exception.orderNumber}
              {exception.onHold && ' · On hold'}
            </button>
            <p className={styles.detail}>{exception.detail}</p>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <Link className={styles.link} to={paths.admin.restock}>
        Raise restock request <Icon name="arrow-right" />
      </Link>
    </Card>
  )
}

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import HeaderActions from '@/features/store-operations/components/HeaderActions'
import QueueDrawer from '@/features/store-operations/components/QueueDrawer'
import QueueToolbar from '@/features/store-operations/components/QueueToolbar'
import StageGrid from '@/features/store-operations/components/StageGrid'
import StageSummary from '@/features/store-operations/components/StageSummary'
import { usePickListDownload } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useDocumentDownloads'
import { useQueueQuery } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useQueueQuery'
import { useStageQueue, useStoreOptions, useWorkOrder } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useStoreOperations'
import DiscrepancyModal from './DiscrepancyModal'
import NextInQueue from './NextInQueue'
import PickConfirmation from './PickConfirmation'
import PickList from './PickList'
import ScanProductModal from './ScanProductModal'
import StockExceptions from './StockExceptions'
 
// The picker works one order at a time, so the whole queue is loaded and the first one is shown.
const QUEUE_SIZE = 50
 
/** To Pick: the pick list of one order at a time, in queue order, with a way to report stock discrepancies. */
export default function ToPickStage() {
  const options = useStoreOptions()
  const { state, params, update } = useQueueQuery({ defaults: { warehouse: 'lucknow', assignee: 'all' }, fixed: { stage: 'to_pick' }, pageSize: QUEUE_SIZE })
  const queue = useStageQueue(params)
  const pickListDownload = usePickListDownload()
  const queueDrawer = useDisclosure()
  const scanDialog = useDisclosure()
  const discrepancyDialog = useDisclosure()
 
  const rows = queue.data?.items ?? []
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState(null)
  const active = rows.find((row) => row.orderNumber === chosen) ?? rows[0] ?? null
  const activeNumber = active?.orderNumber ?? null
  const activeIndex = active ? rows.indexOf(active) : -1
  const upcoming = rows.slice(activeIndex + 1, activeIndex + 3)
  const order = useWorkOrder(activeNumber)
 
  // Ticked lines belong to one order; choosing another starts from an empty list.
  const [picks, setPicks] = useState({ orderNumber: null, codes: [] })
  const pickedCodes = new Set(picks.orderNumber === activeNumber ? picks.codes : [])
  const setPicked = (codes) => setPicks({ orderNumber: activeNumber, codes: [...codes] })
 
  const summary = queue.data?.summary
  const summaryItems = [
    { key: 'orders', label: 'Orders to pick', value: summary?.ordersToPick },
    { key: 'units', label: 'Units requested', value: summary?.unitsRequested },
    { key: 'passed', label: 'Stock checks passed', value: summary?.stockChecksPassed },
    { key: 'attention', label: 'Needs attention', value: summary?.needsAttention },
  ]
  const warehouseOptions = (options.data?.warehouses ?? []).map((name) => ({ value: name.toLowerCase(), label: name }))
  const assigneeOptions = [{ value: 'all', label: 'All' }, ...(options.data?.assignees ?? []).map((name) => ({ value: name, label: name }))]
  const afterPicked = () => setChosen((upcoming[0] ?? rows[activeIndex - 1])?.orderNumber ?? null)
 
  let work
  if (queue.isError) {
    work = <ErrorState compact title="Couldn't load the pick queue" message={getErrorMessage(queue.error)} onRetry={queue.refetch} />
  } else if (queue.isPending || (activeNumber && order.isPending)) {
    work = <Skeleton height="16rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-lg)" />
  } else if (!active) {
    work = (
      <EmptyState
        icon="check2-circle"
        title="Nothing to pick"
        description={state.search ? 'No order in the pick queue matches your search.' : 'Every verified order has been picked.'}
      />
    )
  } else if (order.isError) {
    work = <ErrorState compact title="Couldn't load this order" message={getErrorMessage(order.error)} onRetry={order.refetch} />
  }
 
  return (
    <>
      <HeaderActions>
        <Button loading={pickListDownload.isPending} onClick={() => pickListDownload.mutate(params)}>
          Print pick list
        </Button>
      </HeaderActions>
      <QueueToolbar
        search={state.search}
        onSearchChange={(search) => update({ search })}
        searchPlaceholder="Search SKU, order or bin location"
        searchLabel="Search the pick queue by SKU, order number or bin location"
        filters={[
          { key: 'warehouse', label: 'Warehouse', prefix: 'Warehouse:', options: warehouseOptions, value: state.warehouse, onChange: (warehouse) => update({ warehouse }), disabled: warehouseOptions.length < 2 },
          { key: 'assignee', label: 'Assignee', prefix: 'Assignee:', options: assigneeOptions, value: state.assignee, onChange: (assignee) => update({ assignee }) },
        ]}
      />
      <StageSummary label="To pick summary" items={summaryItems} />
 
      {work ? (
        <Card padding="sm">{work}</Card>
      ) : (
        <StageGrid
          panelWidth="20rem"
          main={
            <>
              <PickList order={order.data} pickedCodes={pickedCodes} onPickedChange={setPicked} onScan={scanDialog.open} />
              <NextInQueue rows={upcoming} totalItems={queue.data.totalItems} onSelect={setChosen} onViewAll={queueDrawer.open} />
            </>
          }
          aside={
            <>
              <PickConfirmation order={order.data} pickedCodes={pickedCodes} onPicked={afterPicked} onReportDiscrepancy={discrepancyDialog.open} />
              <StockExceptions exceptions={summary?.stockExceptions ?? []} onSelect={setChosen} />
            </>
          }
        />
      )}
 
      {order.data && (
        <>
          <ScanProductModal open={scanDialog.isOpen} onClose={scanDialog.close} lines={order.data.lines} pickedCodes={pickedCodes} onPickedChange={setPicked} />
          <DiscrepancyModal open={discrepancyDialog.isOpen} onClose={discrepancyDialog.close} order={order.data} />
        </>
      )}
      <QueueDrawer
        open={queueDrawer.isOpen}
        onClose={queueDrawer.close}
        title="Pick queue"
        description="Open any order waiting to be picked."
        rows={rows}
        loading={queue.isPending}
        activeOrderNumber={activeNumber}
        onSelect={setChosen}
      />
    </>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/components/WorkPanel/WorkPanel.jsx`
 
```jsx
import clsx from 'clsx'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import styles from './WorkPanel.module.scss'
 
/** A block inside a panel: optional heading, optional divider above, content spaced consistently. */
export function PanelSection({ title, divided = false, className, children }) {
  return (
    <div className={clsx(styles.section, divided && styles.divided, className)}>
      {title && <h3 className={styles.sectionTitle}>{title}</h3>}
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}
 
/** Small muted explanatory line used in panels. */
export function PanelNote({ tone, className, children }) {
  return <p className={clsx(styles.note, tone && styles[tone], className)}>{children}</p>
}
 
/**
 * Card for the right-hand work area. It owns the three states every panel shares: nothing selected,
 * loading and failed; `children` receives the loaded work order.
 *   query: the result of useWorkOrder(orderNumber)
 */
export default function WorkPanel({ title, orderNumber, query, emptyTitle, emptyDescription, children, className }) {
  let body
  if (!orderNumber) {
    body = <EmptyState compact icon="box-seam" title={emptyTitle} description={emptyDescription} />
  } else if (query.isError) {
    body = <ErrorState compact title="Couldn't load this order" message={getErrorMessage(query.error)} onRetry={query.refetch} />
  } else if (!query.data) {
    body = (
      <div className={styles.skeleton} role="status" aria-label="Loading order">
        <Skeleton height="1rem" width="55%" />
        <Skeleton height="1rem" />
        <Skeleton height="1rem" width="80%" />
        <Skeleton height="6rem" />
        <Skeleton height="2.75rem" width="60%" />
      </div>
    )
  } else {
    body = children(query.data)
  }
 
  return (
    <Card title={title} padding="sm" className={clsx(styles.panel, className)}>
      {body}
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/hooks/useDocumentDownloads.js`
 
```javascript
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { downloadInvoice, downloadShippingLabel } from '@/features/orders'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import { downloadPickList } from '@/features/store-operations/services/storeOperationService'
 
const DOCUMENTS = {
  invoice: { download: downloadInvoice, noun: 'invoice' },
  label: { download: downloadShippingLabel, noun: 'label' },
}
 
/**
 * Downloads the invoice or shipping label of one or more orders through the shared document services.
 *   const documents = useDocumentDownloads()
 *   documents.mutate({ kind: 'label', orderNumbers: ['SH10488'] })
 * Files are fetched one after another so the browser is not flooded with simultaneous downloads.
 */
export function useDocumentDownloads() {
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ kind, orderNumbers }) => {
      for (const orderNumber of orderNumbers) await DOCUMENTS[kind].download(orderNumber)
    },
    onSuccess: (_result, { kind, orderNumbers }) => {
      toast.success(`${pluralize(orderNumbers.length, DOCUMENTS[kind].noun)} downloaded.`)
    },
    onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error)),
  })
}
 
/** Downloads the consolidated pick list of the To Pick queue for the current filters. */
export function usePickListDownload() {
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: downloadPickList,
    onSuccess: () => toast.success('Pick list downloaded.'),
    onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error)),
  })
}
```
 
## `src/features/store-operations/hooks/useFulfilmentActions.js`
 
```javascript
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { shippingKeys } from '@/features/shipping/hooks/useShipments'
import { storeOperationKeys } from '@/features/store-operations/hooks/useStoreOperations'
import {
  assignOwner,
  dispatchOrder,
  dispatchOrders,
  holdOrder,
  markPacked,
  markPicked,
  notifyCustomers,
  refreshTracking,
  reportStockException,
  resolveDelay,
  saveResolution,
  verifyOrder,
  verifyOrders,
} from '@/features/store-operations/services/storeOperationService'
 
// Every fulfilment action can move an order between queues, so counts, queues, panels and the shipments
// list are all refreshed afterwards.
function useFulfilmentMutation(mutationFn) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn,
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: storeOperationKeys.all })
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: shippingKeys.all })
    },
  })
}
 
export const useVerifyOrder = () => useFulfilmentMutation(verifyOrder)
export const useVerifyOrders = () => useFulfilmentMutation(verifyOrders)
export const useHoldOrder = () => useFulfilmentMutation(holdOrder)
export const useReportStockException = () => useFulfilmentMutation(reportStockException)
export const useMarkPicked = () => useFulfilmentMutation(markPicked)
export const useMarkPacked = () => useFulfilmentMutation(markPacked)
export const useDispatchOrder = () => useFulfilmentMutation(dispatchOrder)
export const useDispatchOrders = () => useFulfilmentMutation(dispatchOrders)
export const useSaveResolution = () => useFulfilmentMutation(saveResolution)
export const useResolveDelay = () => useFulfilmentMutation(resolveDelay)
export const useAssignOwner = () => useFulfilmentMutation(assignOwner)
export const useNotifyCustomers = () => useFulfilmentMutation(notifyCustomers)
export const useRefreshTracking = () => useFulfilmentMutation(refreshTracking)
```
 
## `src/features/store-operations/hooks/useQueueExport.js`
 
```javascript
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { exportToExcel } from '@/lib/excel'
import { getAllQueueRows } from '@/features/store-operations/services/storeOperationService'
 
/**
 * Exports every row matching a stage's current search and filters to an Excel file.
 *   const exporter = useQueueExport((rows) => ({ fileName, columns, rows: rows.map(…) }))
 *   exporter.mutate(params)
 * `buildSheet` receives the queue rows and returns the exportToExcel options. Figures are written as the
 * API supplied them.
 */
export function useQueueExport(buildSheet) {
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (params) => {
      const rows = await getAllQueueRows(params)
      await exportToExcel(buildSheet(rows))
      return rows.length
    },
    onSuccess: (count) => toast.success(`Exported ${count} ${count === 1 ? 'row' : 'rows'} to Excel.`),
    onError: (error) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(error)),
  })
}
```
 
## `src/features/store-operations/hooks/useQueueQuery.js`
 
```javascript
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useDebouncedValue } from '@/hooks/useDebouncedValue'
 
/**
 * Search, filter and page state of one queue. `state` drives the inputs; `params` (search debounced, merged
 * with `fixed`) is what is sent to the API. Any change to the search or a filter returns to page 1.
 */
export function useQueueQuery({ defaults = {}, fixed = {}, pageSize }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState({ search: '', ...defaults, page: 1 })
  const search = useDebouncedValue(state.search, 300)
 
  const update = (patch) => setState((current) => ({ ...current, page: 1, ...patch }))
  const setPage = (page) => setState((current) => ({ ...current, page }))
 
  const { page, ...filters } = state
  const params = { ...filters, ...fixed, search: search.trim(), page, pageSize }
  // Selections and the focused order are only meaningful for one set of filters.
  const filterKey = JSON.stringify({ ...filters, search: search.trim() })
 
  return { state, params, filterKey, update, setPage }
}
```
 
## `src/features/store-operations/hooks/useQueueSelection.js`
 
```javascript
import { useState } from 'react'
 
/**
 * Checked rows of a queue and the order the side panel shows (the most recently checked one).
 * Until the user chooses, the first row is selected, as on the design (`selectFirst: false` starts empty,
 * for lists with no side panel). The selection is dropped when `resetKey` changes (new search or filter)
 * and after an action via `reset()`.
 */
export function useQueueSelection(rows, resetKey, { selectFirst = true } = {}) {
  const [state, setState] = useState({ key: resetKey, ids: null })
  const chosen = state.key === resetKey ? state.ids : null
  const selectedIds = chosen ?? (selectFirst && rows[0] ? [rows[0].orderNumber] : [])
 
  return {
    selectedIds,
    activeId: selectedIds.at(-1) ?? null,
    setSelectedIds: (ids) => setState({ key: resetKey, ids }),
    focusRow: (row) => setState({ key: resetKey, ids: [row.orderNumber] }),
    reset: () => setState({ key: resetKey, ids: null }),
  }
}
```
 
## `src/features/store-operations/hooks/useStoreOperations.js`
 
```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { getQueue, getStageCounts, getStoreOptions, getWorkOrder } from '@/features/store-operations/services/storeOperationService'
 
export const storeOperationKeys = {
  all: ['admin', 'store-operations'],
  counts: () => [...storeOperationKeys.all, 'counts'],
  options: () => [...storeOperationKeys.all, 'options'],
  queue: (params) => [...storeOperationKeys.all, 'queue', params],
  order: (orderNumber) => [...storeOperationKeys.all, 'order', orderNumber],
}
 
/** Live order counts for the stage tabs (and the "beyond SLA" figure of the delayed header). */
export function useStageCounts() {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: storeOperationKeys.counts(), queryFn: getStageCounts, refetchInterval: 60_000 })
}
 
/** Team members, packaging types, carriers and calendar choices that populate the selects. */
export function useStoreOptions() {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: storeOperationKeys.options(), queryFn: getStoreOptions, staleTime: Infinity })
}
 
/** One page of a stage queue. The previous page stays on screen while the next one loads. */
export function useStageQueue(params, { enabled = true } = {}) {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: storeOperationKeys.queue(params), queryFn: () => getQueue(params), placeholderData: keepPreviousData, enabled })
}
 
/** The full work order behind a side panel. */
export function useWorkOrder(orderNumber) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: storeOperationKeys.order(orderNumber),
    queryFn: () => getWorkOrder(orderNumber),
    enabled: Boolean(orderNumber),
  })
}
```

## `src/features/store-operations/schemas/discrepancySchema.js`
 
```javascript
import { z } from 'zod'
import { requiredText } from '@/lib/validation'
 
/** Short-pick report. `lines` is the pick list, so the counted quantity can be checked against what was requested. */
export const createDiscrepancySchema = (lines) =>
  z
    .object({
      productCode: requiredText('Choose the product that is short'),
      // An empty field would coerce to 0, so it is rejected before the number is read.
      availableQuantity: z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(1, 'Enter the quantity you found')
        .pipe(z.coerce.number('Enter the quantity you found').int('Enter a whole number').min(0, 'The quantity cannot be negative')),
      note: z.string().trim().max(160, 'Use 160 characters or fewer'),
    })
    .superRefine((value, context) => {
      const line = lines.find((candidate) => candidate.productCode === value.productCode)
      if (line && value.availableQuantity >= line.quantity) {
        context.addIssue({ code: 'custom', path: ['availableQuantity'], message: `Enter fewer than the ${line.quantity} requested.` })
      }
    })
```
 
## `src/features/store-operations/schemas/dispatchSchema.js`
 
```javascript
import { z } from 'zod'
import { CONSIGNMENT_ID_PATTERN, consignmentIdSchema, requiredText } from '@/lib/validation'
 
const mustBeChecked = (message) => z.boolean().refine(Boolean, message)
 
// Shape checks for a better form experience; the backend validates the consignment ID again and rejects duplicates.
export const dispatchSchema = z.object({
  carrier: requiredText('Choose a carrier'),
  service: requiredText('Choose a service'),
  consignmentId: consignmentIdSchema,
  dispatchDate: requiredText('Choose the dispatch date'),
  documentsAttached: mustBeChecked('Confirm the invoice is printed and the label attached'),
  weightVerified: mustBeChecked('Confirm the weight against the manifest'),
})
 
/** Several orders at once (Create dispatch manifest): an ID per order dispatched, none repeated. Blank rows are skipped. */
export const manifestSchema = z.object({
  service: requiredText('Choose a service'),
  dispatchDate: requiredText('Choose the dispatch date'),
  entries: z
    .array(
      z.object({
        orderNumber: z.string(),
        consignmentId: z
          .string()
          .trim()
          .toUpperCase()
          .refine((value) => value === '' || CONSIGNMENT_ID_PATTERN.test(value), 'Enter a valid ID: 2 letters, 9 digits, IN.'),
      }),
    )
    .superRefine((entries, context) => {
      const firstSeen = new Map()
      entries.forEach(({ consignmentId }, index) => {
        if (!consignmentId) return
        if (firstSeen.has(consignmentId)) {
          context.addIssue({ code: 'custom', path: [index, 'consignmentId'], message: 'This ID is used twice in the manifest.' })
        }
        firstSeen.set(consignmentId, index)
      })
      if (firstSeen.size === 0) context.addIssue({ code: 'custom', path: [], message: 'Enter a consignment ID for at least one order.' })
    }),
})
```

## `src/features/store-operations/services/storeOperationService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
import { saveBlob } from '@/lib/download'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. The API groups warehouse work into stages:
//   new | to_pick | to_pack | ready (packed, waiting for India Post) | dispatched (last 14 days) | delayed
// and exposes, per stage, a paged queue plus a "work order" with everything the side panel needs.
//
//   counts → { new, to_pick, to_pack, ready, dispatched, delayed, delayedBeyondSla, slaHours }
//   queue  → { items: QueueRow[], page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount, summary }   (summary differs per stage)
//   QueueRow  → { orderNumber, customerName, city, pin, placedAt, units, grossAmount, paymentStatus, paymentMethod,
//                 status, onHold, priority, assignee, pickBatch, hasShortage, invoiceNumber, weightKg,
//                 shipment: { carrier, service, consignmentId, dispatchedAt, expectedDelivery, status, trackingUrl } | null,
//                 delay: { issue, group, label, ageHours, owner, priority } | null }
//   WorkOrder → see mocks/lib/fulfilment.js (toWorkOrder): customer, address, payment, lines with bin/batch/available,
//               stock, fulfilment, pack.suggested/recorded, invoice, shipment, tracking[], delay, dispatch
//   Mutations answer with the updated WorkOrder (single) or { succeeded: string[], failed: [{ orderNumber, reason }] } (bulk).
//   Business-rule refusals are 409 (wrong stage, on hold, unpaid) or 422 with { errors: { field: message } }.
const urls = endpoints.admin.storeOperations
 
/** Drops empty and "all" values so only real filters reach the query string. */
const toParams = (params = {}) =>
  Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(params).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '' && value !== 'all'))
 
export async function getStageCounts() {
  const { data } = await http.get(urls.counts)
  return data
}
 
export async function getStoreOptions() {
  const { data } = await http.get(urls.options)
  return data
}
 
export async function getQueue(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(urls.queue, { params: toParams(params) })
  return data
}
 
/** Every row matching the filters, for the Excel exports (the real backend may generate the file itself). */
export async function getAllQueueRows(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(urls.export, { params: toParams(params) })
  return data.items
}
 
export async function getWorkOrder(orderNumber) {
  const { data } = await http.get(urls.order(orderNumber))
  return data
}
 
/** Downloads the consolidated pick list of the To Pick queue (the mock API returns an HTML page, the real one a PDF). */
export async function downloadPickList(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(urls.pickList, { params: toParams(params), responseType: 'blob' })
  saveBlob(data, `Pick-list.${data.type.includes('pdf') ? 'pdf' : 'html'}`)
}
 
const post = async (url, payload) => (await http.post(url, payload)).data
 
export const verifyOrder = (orderNumber) => post(urls.verify(orderNumber))
export const verifyOrders = (orderNumbers) => post(urls.bulkVerify, { orderNumbers })
export const holdOrder = (orderNumber) => post(urls.hold(orderNumber))
export const reportStockException = ({ orderNumber, ...payload }) => post(urls.stockException(orderNumber), payload)
export const markPicked = ({ orderNumber, lines }) => post(urls.picked(orderNumber), { lines })
export const markPacked = ({ orderNumber, ...payload }) => post(urls.packed(orderNumber), payload)
export const dispatchOrder = ({ orderNumber, ...payload }) => post(urls.dispatch(orderNumber), payload)
export const dispatchOrders = (entries) => post(urls.bulkDispatch, { entries })
export const resolveDelay = (orderNumber) => post(urls.resolve(orderNumber))
export const assignOwner = ({ orderNumbers, owner }) => post(urls.assignOwner, { orderNumbers, owner })
export const notifyCustomers = (orderNumbers) => post(urls.notifyCustomers, { orderNumbers })
export const refreshTracking = () => post(urls.refreshTracking)
 
export async function saveResolution({ orderNumber, ...payload }) {
  const { data } = await http.put(urls.resolution(orderNumber), payload)
  return data
}
```

```javascript
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
 
/**
 * Tells the user how a bulk action went. `result` is { succeeded: string[], failed: [{ orderNumber, reason }] };
 * `done` finishes the sentence "3 orders …".
 */
export function reportBulkResult({ succeeded, failed }, { done }) {
  if (succeeded.length > 0) toast.success(`${pluralize(succeeded.length, 'order')} ${done}.`)
  if (failed.length > 0) {
    toast.warning(`${pluralize(failed.length, 'order')} skipped. ${failed[0].orderNumber}: ${failed[0].reason}`)
  }
}
```
 
## `src/features/store-operations/utils/dateInput.js`
 
```javascript
import { DISPLAY_TIME_ZONE } from '@/lib/date'
 
// <input type="datetime-local"> holds a wall-clock value without a zone. Store operation works in
// India time (DISPLAY_TIME_ZONE), which has no daylight saving, so the offset is a constant.
const IST_OFFSET = '+05:30'
const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('sv-SE', {
  timeZone: DISPLAY_TIME_ZONE,
  year: 'numeric',
  month: '2-digit',
  day: '2-digit',
  hour: '2-digit',
  minute: '2-digit',
  hourCycle: 'h23',
})
 
/** "2026-10-29T12:00:00+05:30" → "2026-10-29T12:00" (empty for a missing or invalid date). */
export function toDateTimeInput(iso) {
  if (!iso || Number.isNaN(Date.parse(iso))) return ''
  return formatter.format(new Date(iso)).replace(' ', 'T')
}
 
/** "2026-10-29T12:00" → "2026-10-29T12:00:00+05:30". */
export const fromDateTimeInput = (value) => (value ? `${value}:00${IST_OFFSET}` : null)
```

import { toNumber } from '@/lib/format'
 
/** "0.85 kg", "1.20 kg": a parcel weight always shows two decimals on the dispatch screens. */
export function formatParcelWeight(weightKg) {
  const value = toNumber(weightKg)
  return value === null ? '—' : `${value.toFixed(2)} kg`
}
 
/** "24 × 18 × 12 cm" */
export function formatDimensions({ length, width, height } = {}) {
  return `${length} × ${width} × ${height} cm`
}

## `src/features/storefront/components/DeliveryCheck/DeliveryCheck.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { z } from 'zod'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { deliveryLocationSet, selectDeliveryLocation } from '@/app/store'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import { useServiceabilityCheck } from '@/features/storefront/hooks/useServiceabilityCheck'
import { formatShortDate } from '@/lib/date'
import { pinCodeSchema } from '@/lib/validation'
import styles from './DeliveryCheck.module.scss'
 
const schema = z.object({ pin: pinCodeSchema })
 
function resultMessage(check) {
  if (check.isError) return { error: getErrorMessage(check.error) }
  if (!check.data) return {}
  if (!check.data.serviceable) return { error: 'We don’t deliver to this PIN code yet.' }
  const { etaFrom, etaTo } = check.data
  return { success: `Delivery available · Arrives ${formatShortDate(etaFrom)} – ${formatShortDate(etaTo)}` }
}
 
/**
 * Inline "Delivery PIN code" check for product pages. It starts from the customer's chosen delivery
 * location (checked straight away, so the estimate is already there) and a serviceable PIN becomes the
 * new delivery location shown in the header.
 */
export default function DeliveryCheck({ className }) {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const location = useSelector(selectDeliveryLocation)
  const check = useServiceabilityCheck()
  const hasAutoChecked = useRef(false)
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(schema), defaultValues: { pin: location?.pin ?? '' } })
 
  useEffect(() => {
    if (hasAutoChecked.current || !location?.pin) return
    hasAutoChecked.current = true
    check.mutate(location.pin)
  }, [check, location?.pin])
 
  const submit = ({ pin }) =>
    check.mutate(pin, {
      onSuccess: (result) => {
        if (result.serviceable) dispatch(deliveryLocationSet({ pin: result.pin, city: result.city }))
      },
    })
 
  const { error, success } = resultMessage(check)
 
  return (
    <form className={className} onSubmit={handleSubmit(submit)} noValidate>
      <FormField label="Delivery PIN code" error={errors.pin?.message ?? error} success={success}>
        {(control) => (
          <div className={styles.row}>
            <Input {...control} inputMode="numeric" maxLength={6} autoComplete="postal-code" {...register('pin')} />
            <Button type="submit" variant="secondary" size="lg" loading={check.isPending}>
              Check
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </FormField>
    </form>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { z } from 'zod'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import { deliveryLocationSet, selectDeliveryLocation } from '@/app/store'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import Popover from '@/components/molecules/Popover'
import { useServiceabilityCheck } from '@/features/storefront/hooks/useServiceabilityCheck'
import { pinCodeSchema } from '@/lib/validation'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import styles from './DeliveryLocation.module.scss'
 
const schema = z.object({ pin: pinCodeSchema })
 
function PinForm({ onDone }) {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const check = useServiceabilityCheck()
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(schema), defaultValues: { pin: '' } })
 
  const submit = ({ pin }) =>
    check.mutate(pin, {
      onSuccess: (result) => {
        if (!result.serviceable) return
        dispatch(deliveryLocationSet({ pin: result.pin, city: result.city }))
        onDone()
      },
    })
 
  const notServiceable = check.data && !check.data.serviceable
  const serverError = check.isError ? getErrorMessage(check.error) : null
 
  return (
    <form className={styles.form} onSubmit={handleSubmit(submit)} noValidate>
      <FormField
        label="Delivery PIN code"
        hint="We'll show delivery options for this address."
        error={errors.pin?.message ?? serverError ?? (notServiceable ? "We don't deliver to this PIN code yet." : undefined)}
      >
        {(control) => (
          <div className={styles.row}>
            <Input {...control} size="md" inputMode="numeric" maxLength={6} placeholder="e.g. 226010" autoComplete="postal-code" {...register('pin')} />
            <Button type="submit" size="md" loading={check.isPending}>
              Check
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </FormField>
    </form>
  )
}
 
/**
 * "Deliver to Lucknow 226010" control. The chosen PIN is a UI preference (Redux `ui`), confirmed
 * against the backend serviceability check. variant: header (two-line, desktop) | inline (mobile).
 */
export default function DeliveryLocation({ variant = 'header' }) {
  const location = useSelector(selectDeliveryLocation)
 
  return (
    <Popover
      align={variant === 'header' ? 'end' : 'start'}
      panelClassName={styles.panel}
      trigger={({ props, isOpen }) =>
        variant === 'header' ? (
          <button type="button" className={clsx(styles.headerTrigger, isOpen && styles.open)} {...props}>
            <span className={styles.small}>{location ? `Deliver to ${location.city}` : 'Deliver to'}</span>
            <span className={styles.pin}>
              {location?.pin ?? 'Select PIN'}
              <Icon name="chevron-down" />
            </span>
          </button>
        ) : (
          <button type="button" className={styles.inlineTrigger} {...props}>
            <Icon name="geo-alt" />
            {location ? `Deliver to ${location.city} ${location.pin}` : 'Select delivery PIN'}
            <span aria-hidden="true"> · </span>
            <span className={styles.change}>Change</span>
          </button>
        )
      }
    >
      {({ close }) => <PinForm onDone={close} />}
    </Popover>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Timeline from '@/components/molecules/Timeline'
import { toTimelineItems } from '@/features/tracking/utils/timeline'
import styles from './ShipmentTracker.module.scss'
 
function ExternalLinkHint() {
  return <span className="visually-hidden"> (opens in a new tab)</span>
}
 
/**
 * Carrier, consignment link, the progress timeline and a "Track on India Post" button. Shared by the order
 * detail page and the public Track shipment page. `shipment` is null until the order is dispatched.
 *   shipment: { carrier, service, consignmentId, trackingUrl } | null
 *   timeline: [{ key, title, at, note, state }] as returned by the backend
 */
export default function ShipmentTracker({ shipment, timeline }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.tracker}>
      {shipment && (
        <div className={styles.carrier}>
          <p className={styles.service}>
            {shipment.carrier} · {shipment.service}
          </p>
          <a href={shipment.trackingUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className={styles.consignment}>
            Consignment ID: {shipment.consignmentId} <Icon name="arrow-up-right" />
            <ExternalLinkHint />
          </a>
        </div>
      )}
 
      <Timeline items={toTimelineItems(timeline)} />
 
      {shipment && (
        <Button as="a" variant="secondary" href={shipment.trackingUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" rightIcon="arrow-up-right" className={styles.action}>
          Track on {shipment.carrier}
          <ExternalLinkHint />
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'

/**
 * The outcome of a lookup: the order, where it is and the progress so far. Focus moves here when a result
 * appears, so keyboard and screen-reader users land on it (it sits below the form on phones).
 */
export default function TrackingResult({ tracking }) {

    headingRef.current?.focus()
  }, [])
 
  return (
    <section className={styles.result} aria-labelledby="tracking-result-heading">
      <header>
        <h2 id="tracking-result-heading" ref={headingRef} tabIndex={-1} className={styles.heading}>
          Order #{tracking.orderNumber}

        <p className={styles.meta}>

        </p>
      </header>
      <OrderHeroCard order={tracking} />
      <Card title="Shipment progress" padding="lg">
        <ShipmentTracker shipment={tracking.shipment} timeline={tracking.timeline} />
      </Card>
    </section>
  )
}

import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import Tabs, { TabPanel } from '@/components/molecules/Tabs'
import { TRACKING_MODES, trackingSchema } from '@/features/tracking/schemas/trackingSchema'
import styles from './TrackShipmentForm.module.scss'
 
const TABS_ID = 'track-mode'
 
const toPayload = (values) =>
  values.mode === 'order' ? { orderNumber: values.orderNumber, mobile: values.mobile } : { consignmentId: values.consignmentId }
 
/**
 * Lookup form: an order number with the mobile number on the order, or a consignment ID on its own.
 *   onSubmit(payload): { orderNumber, mobile } | { consignmentId }, already trimmed and normalised
 *   error: the failed lookup's ApiError, shown above the button
 */
export default function TrackShipmentForm({ onSubmit, isPending = false, error, defaultMobile = '' }) {
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setValue,
    clearErrors,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(trackingSchema),
    defaultValues: { mode: 'order', orderNumber: '', mobile: defaultMobile, consignmentId: '' },
  })
  const mode = useWatch({ control, name: 'mode' })
 
  const changeMode = (next) => {
    setValue('mode', next)
    clearErrors()
  }
 
  return (
    <Card title="Find your parcel" padding="lg">
      <form className={styles.form} onSubmit={handleSubmit((values) => onSubmit(toPayload(values)))} noValidate>
        <Tabs id={TABS_ID} variant="pill" label="Look up by" items={TRACKING_MODES} value={mode} onChange={changeMode} />
 
        <TabPanel id={TABS_ID} tabKey="order" value={mode} className={styles.panel}>
          <FormField label="Order number" error={errors.orderNumber?.message} hint="It’s in your order confirmation, for example SH10482.">
            {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('orderNumber')} placeholder="SH10482" autoComplete="off" autoCapitalize="characters" />}
          </FormField>
          <FormField label="Mobile number" error={errors.mobile?.message} hint="The number you used when you placed the order.">
            {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('mobile')} inputMode="tel" autoComplete="tel-national" placeholder="98765 43210" />}
          </FormField>
        </TabPanel>
 
        <TabPanel id={TABS_ID} tabKey="consignment" value={mode} className={styles.panel}>
          <FormField label="Consignment ID" error={errors.consignmentId?.message} hint="Printed on your dispatch update, for example EU483920175IN.">
            {(field) => <Input {...field} {...register('consignmentId')} placeholder="EU483920175IN" autoComplete="off" autoCapitalize="characters" />}
          </FormField>
        </TabPanel>
 
        {error && <Alert tone="danger">{error.message}</Alert>}
 
        <Button type="submit" size="lg" loading={isPending} leftIcon="search">
          Track shipment
        </Button>
      </form>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/tracking/schemas/trackingSchema.js`
 
```javascript
import { z } from 'zod'
import { consignmentIdSchema, mobileSchema } from '@/lib/validation'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: order numbers look like SH10482 (SH plus 4–6 digits).
const orderNumberSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(1, 'Enter your order number')
  .transform((value) => value.toUpperCase().replace(/^#/, ''))
  .pipe(z.string().regex(/^SH\d{4,6}$/, 'Order numbers look like SH10482'))
 
const consignmentSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(1, 'Enter the consignment ID')
  .pipe(consignmentIdSchema)
 
// A shipment is found either by order number + the mobile number on the order, or by its consignment ID.
export const trackingSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('mode', [
  z.object({ mode: z.literal('order'), orderNumber: orderNumberSchema, mobile: mobileSchema }),
  z.object({ mode: z.literal('consignment'), consignmentId: consignmentSchema }),
])
 
export const TRACKING_MODES = [
  { key: 'order', label: 'Order number' },
  { key: 'consignment', label: 'Consignment ID' },
]
```
 
## `src/features/tracking/services/trackingService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. Public lookup, no sign-in: send either
//   { orderNumber, mobile }  (the mobile number on the order) or { consignmentId }
// and receive only the shipment's progress — never names, addresses or prices:
//   { orderNumber, placedAt, status, units, estimatedDelivery, deliveredAt,
//     shipment: { carrier, service, consignmentId, trackingUrl, lastUpdate } | null,
//     timeline: [{ key, title, at, note, state: 'done' | 'current' | 'upcoming' }] }
// A wrong combination is a 404 with a generic message, so the lookup does not reveal which orders exist.
// POST rather than GET keeps the mobile number out of URLs and server logs.
export async function trackShipment(payload) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.orders.track, payload)
  return data
}
```
 
## `src/features/tracking/utils/timeline.js`
 
```javascript
import { formatShortDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
 
/**
 * Turns the backend's customer timeline into what the Timeline component renders.
 *   [{ key, title, at, note, state }] → [{ key, title, timestamp: "24 Oct, 10:42 AM · Payment received", status }]
 * Steps that have not happened yet have no time, so only their note ("Expected 29 Oct") is shown.
 */
export function toTimelineItems(timeline) {
  return timeline.map(({ key, title, at, note, state }) => ({
    key,
    title,
    timestamp: [at ? formatShortDateTime(at) : null, note].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
    status: state,
  }))
}
```

## `src/features/users/components/PermissionMatrix/PermissionMatrix.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Fragment } from 'react'
import Checkbox from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox'
import { groupModules, groupState, toggleGroup, toggleModule, atLeast } from '@/features/users/lib/permissions'
import styles from './PermissionMatrix.module.scss'
 
const ACCESS = [
  { key: 'read', label: 'Read' },
  { key: 'write', label: 'Write' },
]
 
/**
 * Read / Write checkboxes per module, grouped by area, with a toggle per group.
 * Display and editing UI only: it edits a draft of the role's permissions; authorization is backend work.
 *   modules: [{ key, group, label, description }]   permissions: { [moduleKey]: 'none' | 'read' | 'write' }
 *   onChange(nextPermissions)   readOnly: shows the matrix without letting it be edited (built-in role)
 */
export default function PermissionMatrix({ modules, permissions, onChange, readOnly = false }) {
  const groups = groupModules(modules)
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.root}>
      <div className={styles.scroll}>
        <table className={styles.table}>
          <caption className="visually-hidden">Module permissions</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">Module</th>
              {ACCESS.map((access) => (
                <th key={access.key} scope="col" className={styles.check}>
                  {access.label}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          {groups.map(({ group, modules: groupItems }) => (
            <Fragment key={group}>
              <tbody>
                <tr className={styles.groupRow}>
                  <th scope="colgroup" className={styles.groupName}>
                    {group}
                  </th>
                  {ACCESS.map((access) => {
                    const state = groupState(permissions, groupItems, access.key)
                    return (
                      <td key={access.key} className={styles.check}>
                        <Checkbox
                          aria-label={`${access.label} all ${group} modules`}
                          checked={state === 'all'}
                          indeterminate={state === 'some'}
                          disabled={readOnly}
                          onChange={() => onChange(toggleGroup(permissions, groupItems, access.key, state !== 'all'))}
                        />
                      </td>
                    )
                  })}
                </tr>
                {groupItems.map((module) => (
                  <tr key={module.key}>
                    <th scope="row" className={styles.moduleCell}>
                      <span className={styles.moduleText}>
                        <span className={styles.moduleName}>{module.label}</span>
                        <span className={styles.moduleHint}>{module.description}</span>
                      </span>
                    </th>
                    {ACCESS.map((access) => (
                      <td key={access.key} className={styles.check}>
                        <Checkbox
                          aria-label={`${access.label} ${module.label}`}
                          checked={atLeast(permissions[module.key], access.key)}
                          disabled={readOnly}
                          onChange={(event) => onChange(toggleModule(permissions, module.key, access.key, event.target.checked))}
                        />
                      </td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </Fragment>
          ))}
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```
