## `src/features/users/components/RoleDetailsModal/RoleDetailsModal.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import Select from '@/components/atoms/Select'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import Modal from '@/components/organisms/Modal'
import { useCreateRole, useUpdateRole } from '@/features/users/hooks/useRoles'
import { roleSchema } from '@/features/users/schemas/roleSchema'
 
const FORM_ID = 'role-details-form'
 
function RoleDetailsForm({ role, roles, mutation, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(roleSchema),
    defaultValues: { name: role?.name ?? '', description: role?.description ?? '', copyFrom: '' },
  })
 
  const onSubmit = handleSubmit(({ name, description, copyFrom }) => {
    const payload = role ? { id: role.id, name, description } : { name, description, ...(copyFrom ? { copyFrom } : {}) }
    mutation.mutate(payload, {
      onSuccess: (saved) => {
        toast.success(role ? `${saved.name} was updated.` : `${saved.name} was created. Choose its permissions next.`)
        onSaved(saved)
        onClose()
      },
      onError: (error) => {
        const fieldErrors = Object.entries(error.details ?? {})
        if (fieldErrors.length === 0) return toast.error(error.message)
        fieldErrors.forEach(([field, message], index) => setError(field, { type: 'server', message }, { shouldFocus: index === 0 }))
      },
    })
  })
 
  return (
    <form id={FORM_ID} className="row g-3" onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
      <div className="col-12">
        <FormField label="Role name" required error={errors.name?.message}>
          {(control) => <Input {...control} {...register('name')} autoComplete="off" placeholder="For example, Catalogue Editor" />}
        </FormField>
      </div>
      <div className="col-12">
        <FormField label="Description" hint="Optional. Shown on the role list." error={errors.description?.message}>
          {(control) => <Input {...control} {...register('description')} autoComplete="off" placeholder="What this role is for" />}
        </FormField>
      </div>
      {!role && (
        <div className="col-12">
          <FormField label="Start from" hint="Copies another role's permissions. You can change them afterwards.">
            {(control) => (
              <Select {...control} {...register('copyFrom')}>
                <option value="">No access (start blank)</option>
                {roles.map((entry) => (
                  <option key={entry.id} value={entry.id}>
                    {entry.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            )}
          </FormField>
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  )
}
 
/** Create a role (no `role`) or edit a role's name and description. Permissions are edited in the matrix. */
export default function RoleDetailsModal({ open, role, roles, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const create = useCreateRole()
  const update = useUpdateRole()
  const mutation = role ? update : create
 
  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      size="sm"
      title={role ? 'Edit role details' : 'New role'}
      closeOnBackdrop={!mutation.isPending}
      closeOnEscape={!mutation.isPending}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" disabled={mutation.isPending} onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" form={FORM_ID} loading={mutation.isPending}>
            {role ? 'Save details' : 'Create role'}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <RoleDetailsForm key={role?.id ?? 'new'} role={role} roles={roles} mutation={mutation} onClose={onClose} onSaved={onSaved} />
    </Modal>
  )
}
```

import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Badge from '@/components/atoms/Badge'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './RoleList.module.scss'
 
/** The roles to pick from, with how many users hold each (a link to the Users list filtered by that role). */
export default function RoleList({ roles, loading, selectedId, draftIds, onSelect }) {
  return (
    <Card title="Roles" padding="sm" radius="md">
      {loading ? (
        <div className={styles.skeletons} aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading roles">
          {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((index) => (
            <Skeleton key={index} height="4.25rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ul className={styles.list}>
          {roles.map((role) => {
            const selected = role.id === selectedId
            return (
              <li key={role.id} className={clsx(styles.item, selected && styles.selected)}>
                <button type="button" className={styles.select} aria-pressed={selected} onClick={() => onSelect(role.id)}>
                  <span className={styles.name}>
                    {role.name}
                    {role.system && <Badge tone="neutral">Built in</Badge>}
                    {draftIds.has(role.id) && <Badge tone="warning">Unsaved</Badge>}
                  </span>
                  <span className={styles.description}>{role.description || 'No description'}</span>
                </button>
                <Link to={`${paths.admin.users}?role=${encodeURIComponent(role.id)}`} className={styles.users}>
                  {pluralize(role.usersCount, 'user')}
                </Link>
              </li>
            )
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/users/components/RolesManager/RolesManager.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import ConfirmDialog from '@/components/organisms/ConfirmDialog'
import PermissionMatrix from '@/features/users/components/PermissionMatrix'
import RoleDetailsModal from '@/features/users/components/RoleDetailsModal'
import RoleList from '@/features/users/components/RoleList'
import { useDeleteRole, useRoles, useUpdateRole } from '@/features/users/hooks/useRoles'
import { samePermissions } from '@/features/users/lib/permissions'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import styles from './RolesManager.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Roles and their permissions. This is display and editing UI only: the matrix edits a role's permissions and
 * saves them through the API, but nothing here authorizes anything. Authorization is backend work: the backend
 * checks every request against the signed-in user's role.
 *
 * Edits live in a local draft keyed by role id, so switching roles keeps unsaved changes until they are saved
 * or discarded.
 */
export default function RolesManager() {
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useRoles()
  const updateRole = useUpdateRole()
  const deleteRole = useDeleteRole()
 
  const [chosenId, setChosenId] = useState(null)
  const [drafts, setDrafts] = useState({})
  const [detailsTarget, setDetailsTarget] = useState(null) // null = closed, { role: null } = create, { role } = edit
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false)
 
  const roles = data?.items ?? []
  const modules = data?.modules ?? []
  const role = roles.find((entry) => entry.id === chosenId) ?? roles[0]
  const draft = role ? drafts[role.id] : undefined
  const permissions = draft ?? role?.permissions
  const dirty = Boolean(role && draft && !samePermissions(draft, role.permissions))
  const draftIds = new Set(roles.filter((entry) => drafts[entry.id] && !samePermissions(drafts[entry.id], entry.permissions)).map((entry) => entry.id))
 
  const clearDraft = (id) =>
    setDrafts((current) => {
      const { [id]: _removed, ...rest } = current
      return rest
    })
 
  const save = () =>
    updateRole.mutate(
      { id: role.id, permissions: draft },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          toast.success(`Permissions for ${role.name} were saved.`)
          clearDraft(role.id)
        },
        onError: (failure) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(failure)),
      },
    )
 
  const confirmDelete = () =>
    deleteRole.mutate(role.id, {
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(`${role.name} was deleted.`)
        clearDraft(role.id)
        setChosenId(null)
        setDeleting(false)
      },
      onError: (failure) => {
        toast.error(getErrorMessage(failure))
        setDeleting(false)
      },
    })
 
  const header = (
    <PageHeader
      title="User roles"
      description="Choose what each role can read and change across the dashboard."
      actions={
        <Button size="sm" leftIcon="plus-lg" disabled={!data} onClick={() => setDetailsTarget({ role: null })}>
          New role
        </Button>
      }
    />
  )
 
  if (isError) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.page}>
        {header}
        <ErrorState message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} />
      </div>
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      {header}
 
      <div className={styles.columns}>
        <RoleList roles={roles} loading={isPending} selectedId={role?.id} draftIds={draftIds} onSelect={setChosenId} />
 
        {isPending || !role ? (
          <Skeleton height="30rem" radius="var(--sh-radius-md)" />
        ) : (
          <Card
            title={`${role.name} permissions`}
            padding="md"
            radius="md"
            actions={
              !role.system && (
                <>
                  <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" leftIcon="pencil" onClick={() => setDetailsTarget({ role })}>
                    Edit details
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="sm"
                    leftIcon="trash"
                    disabled={role.usersCount > 0}
                    title={role.usersCount > 0 ? 'Reassign its users before deleting this role' : undefined}
                    onClick={() => setDeleting(true)}
                  >
                    Delete
                  </Button>
                </>
              )
            }
          >
            <div className={styles.editor}>
              <p className={styles.meta}>
                {role.description || 'No description.'}{' '}
                <Link to={`${paths.admin.users}?role=${encodeURIComponent(role.id)}`} className={styles.link}>
                  {pluralize(role.usersCount, 'user')} assigned
                </Link>
                {' · '}Updated {formatDateTime(role.updatedAt)}
              </p>
 
              {role.system && (
                <Alert tone="info">The Administrator role is built in. It always has full access, so it cannot be changed or deleted.</Alert>
              )}
 
              <PermissionMatrix modules={modules} permissions={permissions} readOnly={role.system} onChange={(next) => setDrafts((current) => ({ ...current, [role.id]: next }))} />
 
              {dirty && (
                <div className={styles.saveBar} role="region" aria-label="Unsaved permission changes">
                  <p className={styles.saveText}>You have unsaved changes to {role.name}.</p>
                  <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={updateRole.isPending} onClick={() => clearDraft(role.id)}>
                    Discard
                  </Button>
                  <Button size="sm" loading={updateRole.isPending} onClick={save}>
                    Save permissions
                  </Button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>
 
      <RoleDetailsModal
        open={detailsTarget !== null}
        role={detailsTarget?.role ?? null}
        roles={roles}
        onClose={() => setDetailsTarget(null)}
        onSaved={(saved) => setChosenId(saved.id)}
      />
 
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={deleting}
        onClose={() => setDeleting(false)}
        onConfirm={confirmDelete}
        loading={deleteRole.isPending}
        tone="danger"
        title={`Delete ${role?.name ?? 'role'}?`}
        message="The role and its permissions will be removed. This cannot be undone."
        confirmLabel="Delete role"
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/users/components/UserFormModal/UserFormModal.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import Input from '@/components/atoms/Input'
import Select from '@/components/atoms/Select'
import FormField from '@/components/molecules/FormField'
import Modal from '@/components/organisms/Modal'
import { USER_FORM_STATUS_OPTIONS } from '@/features/users/constants/userOptions'
import { useCreateUser, useUpdateUser } from '@/features/users/hooks/useUsers'
import { userSchema } from '@/features/users/schemas/userSchema'
 
const FORM_ID = 'user-form'
 
const toFormValues = (user) => ({
  name: user?.name ?? '',
  email: user?.email ?? '',
  mobile: user?.mobile ?? '',
  roleId: user?.roleId ?? '',
  status: user?.status ?? 'active',
})
 
function UserForm({ user, roles, isSelf, mutation, onClose }) {
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(userSchema), defaultValues: toFormValues(user) })
 
  const onSubmit = handleSubmit((values) =>
    mutation.mutate(user ? { id: user.id, ...values } : values, {
      onSuccess: (saved) => {
        toast.success(user ? `${saved.name} was updated.` : `${saved.name} was added as ${saved.roleName}.`)
        onClose()
      },
      onError: (error) => {
        // Field-level problems from the backend (for example a duplicate email) are shown on the field itself.
        const fieldErrors = Object.entries(error.details ?? {})
        if (fieldErrors.length === 0) return toast.error(error.message)
        fieldErrors.forEach(([field, message], index) => setError(field, { type: 'server', message }, { shouldFocus: index === 0 }))
      },
    }),
  )
 
  return (
    <form id={FORM_ID} className="row g-3" onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
      <div className="col-12 col-md-6">
        <FormField label="Full name" required error={errors.name?.message}>
          {(control) => <Input {...control} {...register('name')} autoComplete="off" placeholder="For example, Neha Joshi" />}
        </FormField>
      </div>
      <div className="col-12 col-md-6">
        <FormField label="Email" required error={errors.email?.message}>
          {(control) => <Input {...control} {...register('email')} type="email" autoComplete="off" placeholder="name@shipper.com" />}
        </FormField>
      </div>
      <div className="col-12 col-md-6">
        <FormField label="Mobile" hint="Optional. 10-digit Indian mobile number." error={errors.mobile?.message}>
          {(control) => <Input {...control} {...register('mobile')} type="tel" inputMode="numeric" autoComplete="off" placeholder="98765 43210" />}
        </FormField>
      </div>
      <div className="col-12 col-md-6">
        <FormField label="Role" required error={errors.roleId?.message}>
          {(control) => (
            <Select {...control} {...register('roleId')}>
              <option value="">Choose a role</option>
              {roles.map((role) => (
                <option key={role.id} value={role.id}>
                  {role.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          )}
        </FormField>
      </div>
      <div className="col-12 col-md-6">
        <FormField label="Status" required hint={isSelf ? "You can't deactivate your own account." : undefined} error={errors.status?.message}>
          {(control) => (
            <Select {...control} {...register('status')}>
              {USER_FORM_STATUS_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                <option key={option.value} value={option.value} disabled={isSelf && option.value === 'inactive'}>
                  {option.label}
                </option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          )}
        </FormField>
      </div>
    </form>
  )
}
 
/** Add user (no `user`) or edit user. Validation here is for convenience; the backend decides what is accepted. */
export default function UserFormModal({ open, user, roles, currentUserId, onClose }) {
  const create = useCreateUser()
  const update = useUpdateUser()
  const mutation = user ? update : create
 
  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      size="md"
      title={user ? `Edit ${user.name}` : 'Add user'}
      description={user ? 'Change their details, role or status.' : 'They will be able to sign in to the admin dashboard with this role.'}
      closeOnBackdrop={!mutation.isPending}
      closeOnEscape={!mutation.isPending}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" disabled={mutation.isPending} onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" form={FORM_ID} loading={mutation.isPending}>
            {user ? 'Save changes' : 'Add user'}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <UserForm key={user?.id ?? 'new'} user={user} roles={roles} isSelf={Boolean(user) && user.id === currentUserId} mutation={mutation} onClose={onClose} />
    </Modal>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/users/components/UsersList/UsersList.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { toast } from 'react-toastify'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { selectCurrentUser } from '@/app/store'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import PageHeader from '@/components/molecules/PageHeader'
import ConfirmDialog from '@/components/organisms/ConfirmDialog'
import { ListToolbar, useListParams } from '@/features/admin-lists'
import UserFormModal from '@/features/users/components/UserFormModal'
import UsersTable from '@/features/users/components/UsersTable'
import { USER_STATUS_OPTIONS } from '@/features/users/constants/userOptions'
import { useRoles } from '@/features/users/hooks/useRoles'
import { useDeleteUser, useSetUserStatus, useUsers } from '@/features/users/hooks/useUsers'
import styles from './UsersList.module.scss'
 
/** The admin Users screen: who can sign in to the dashboard, with their role and status. */
export default function UsersList() {
  const currentUser = useSelector(selectCurrentUser)
  const list = useListParams({ pageSize: 10, filters: { role: '', status: '' } })
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useUsers(list.apiParams)
  const { data: roleData } = useRoles()
  const roles = roleData?.items ?? []
  const setStatus = useSetUserStatus()
  const remove = useDeleteUser()
 
  // null = closed, { user: null } = add, { user } = edit
  const [formTarget, setFormTarget] = useState(null)
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState(null)
 
  const toggleStatus = (user) => {
    const status = user.status === 'active' ? 'inactive' : 'active'
    setStatus.mutate(
      { id: user.id, status },
      {
        onSuccess: () => toast.success(`${user.name} is now ${status}.`),
        onError: (failure) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(failure)),
      },
    )
  }
 
  const confirmDelete = () =>
    remove.mutate(deleteTarget.id, {
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(`${deleteTarget.name} was deleted.`)
        setDeleteTarget(null)
      },
      onError: (failure) => {
        toast.error(getErrorMessage(failure))
        setDeleteTarget(null)
      },
    })
 
  const toolbarFilters = [
    {
      key: 'role',
      label: 'Role',
      prefix: 'Role:',
      options: [{ value: '', label: 'All' }, ...roles.map((role) => ({ value: role.id, label: role.name }))],
      value: list.filters.role,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('role', value),
    },
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      prefix: 'Status:',
      options: USER_STATUS_OPTIONS,
      value: list.filters.status,
      onChange: (value) => list.setFilter('status', value),
    },
  ]
 
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Users"
        description="People who can sign in to the admin dashboard. Their role decides what they can see and change."
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" leftIcon="plus-lg" onClick={() => setFormTarget({ user: null })}>
            Add user
          </Button>
        }
      />
 
      <ListToolbar
        search={{ ...list.search, label: 'Search users', placeholder: 'Search name, email or mobile' }}
        filters={toolbarFilters}
        hasActiveFilters={list.hasActiveFilters}
        onClear={list.reset}
      />
 
      {isError ? (
        <ErrorState message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} />
      ) : (
        <UsersTable
          rows={data?.items ?? []}
          loading={isPending}
          sort={list.sortState}
          onSortChange={list.setSort}
          currentUserId={currentUser?.id}
          busyUserId={setStatus.isPending ? setStatus.variables?.id : null}
          onEdit={(user) => setFormTarget({ user })}
          onToggleStatus={toggleStatus}
          onDelete={setDeleteTarget}
          emptyState={
            <EmptyState
              compact
              icon="person-x"
              title="No users match these filters"
              description="Try a different search, or clear the filters to see every user."
              action={
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={list.reset}>
                  Clear filters
                </Button>
              }
            />
          }
          pagination={data && { page: data.page, pageSize: data.pageSize, totalItems: data.totalItems, onPageChange: list.setPage, itemLabel: 'users' }}
        />
      )}
 
      <UserFormModal
        open={formTarget !== null}
        user={formTarget?.user ?? null}
        roles={roles}
        currentUserId={currentUser?.id}
        onClose={() => setFormTarget(null)}
      />
 
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={deleteTarget !== null}
        onClose={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}
        onConfirm={confirmDelete}
        loading={remove.isPending}
        tone="danger"
        title={`Delete ${deleteTarget?.name ?? 'user'}?`}
        message="They will no longer be able to sign in. This cannot be undone. To keep their history, deactivate the account instead."
        confirmLabel="Delete user"
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import Avatar from '@/components/atoms/Avatar'
import IconButton from '@/components/atoms/IconButton'
import StatusBadge from '@/components/atoms/StatusBadge'
import DataTable from '@/components/organisms/DataTable'
import { formatMobile } from '@/lib/address'
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import styles from './UsersTable.module.scss'
 
/**
 * The admin user list. Paging, sorting and filtering are the backend's; this shows the current page.
 * `currentUserId` is the signed-in admin: their row cannot be deactivated or deleted (the backend refuses it too).
 */
export default function UsersTable({ rows, loading, sort, onSortChange, pagination, emptyState, currentUserId, busyUserId, onEdit, onToggleStatus, onDelete }) {
  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'name',
      header: 'User',
      sortable: true,
      cell: (row) => (
        <span className={styles.user}>
          <Avatar name={row.name} size="sm" />
          <span className={styles.stacked}>
            <span className={styles.name}>
              {row.name}
              {row.id === currentUserId && <span className={styles.you}>You</span>}
            </span>
            <span className={styles.secondary}>{row.email}</span>
          </span>
        </span>
      ),
    },
    { key: 'mobile', header: 'Mobile', cell: (row) => (row.mobile ? formatMobile(row.mobile) : '—') },
    { key: 'roleName', header: 'Role', sortable: true },
    { key: 'status', header: 'Status', sortable: true, cell: (row) => <StatusBadge status={row.status} /> },
    { key: 'lastActiveAt', header: 'Last active', sortable: true, cell: (row) => (row.lastActiveAt ? formatDateTime(row.lastActiveAt) : 'Never') },
  ]
 
  return (
    <DataTable
      caption="Admin users"
      columns={columns}
      rows={rows}
      getRowId={(row) => row.id}
      loading={loading}
      sort={sort}
      onSortChange={onSortChange}
      pagination={pagination}
      emptyState={emptyState}
      actionsHeader="Actions"
      minWidth="52rem"
      rowActions={(row) => {
        const isSelf = row.id === currentUserId
        const active = row.status === 'active'
        return (
          <span className={styles.actions}>
            <IconButton icon="pencil" label={`Edit ${row.name}`} size="sm" onClick={() => onEdit(row)} />
            <IconButton
              icon={active ? 'person-dash' : 'person-check'}
              label={active ? `Deactivate ${row.name}` : `Activate ${row.name}`}
              size="sm"
              disabled={(isSelf && active) || busyUserId === row.id}
              title={isSelf && active ? "You can't deactivate your own account" : undefined}
              onClick={() => onToggleStatus(row)}
            />
            <IconButton
              icon="trash"
              label={`Delete ${row.name}`}
              size="sm"
              tone="danger"
              disabled={isSelf}
              title={isSelf ? "You can't delete your own account" : undefined}
              onClick={() => onDelete(row)}
            />
          </span>
        )
      }}
    />
  )
}
```

```javascript
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createRole, deleteRole, listRoles, updateRole } from '@/features/users/services/roleService'
 
export const roleKeys = {
  all: ['admin', 'roles'],
}
 
export const useRoles = () => useQuery({ queryKey: roleKeys.all, queryFn: listRoles })
 
/** A role change can rename the role on user rows, so the users list is refreshed too. */
function useRoleMutation(mutationFn) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn,
    onSuccess: () => Promise.all([queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: roleKeys.all }), queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['admin', 'users'] })]),
  })
}
 
export const useCreateRole = () => useRoleMutation(createRole)
export const useUpdateRole = () => useRoleMutation(updateRole)
export const useDeleteRole = () => useRoleMutation(deleteRole)
```
 
## `src/features/users/hooks/useUsers.js`
 
```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createUser, deleteUser, listUsers, setUserStatus, updateUser } from '@/features/users/services/userService'
 
export const userKeys = {
  all: ['admin', 'users'],
  list: (params) => ['admin', 'users', 'list', params],
}
 
export const useUsers = (params) => useQuery({ queryKey: userKeys.list(params), queryFn: () => listUsers(params), placeholderData: keepPreviousData })
 
/** Users and the roles' assigned counts change together, so every user mutation refreshes both. */
function useUserMutation(mutationFn) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn,
    onSuccess: () => Promise.all([queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: userKeys.all }), queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['admin', 'roles'] })]),
  })
}
 
export const useCreateUser = () => useUserMutation(createUser)
export const useUpdateUser = () => useUserMutation(updateUser)
export const useSetUserStatus = () => useUserMutation(setUserStatus)
export const useDeleteUser = () => useUserMutation(deleteUser)
```

## `src/features/users/lib/permissions.js`
 
```javascript
// Editing helpers for the role permission matrix.
//
// Permissions here are display and editing UI only. Nothing in the browser authorizes anything: the backend
// checks every request against the signed-in user's role. These helpers only keep the checkboxes consistent
// (write includes read) before the draft is saved.
 
const RANK = { none: 0, read: 1, write: 2 }
 
export const atLeast = (level, minimum) => RANK[level ?? 'none'] >= RANK[minimum]
 
/** Modules in the order the backend lists them, split by `group`: [{ group, modules }]. */
export function groupModules(modules) {
  const groups = []
  modules.forEach((module) => {
    const current = groups.find((entry) => entry.group === module.group)
    if (current) current.modules.push(module)
    else groups.push({ group: module.group, modules: [module] })
  })
  return groups
}
 
function nextLevel(current, access, enabled) {
  if (access === 'write') return enabled ? 'write' : atLeast(current, 'read') ? 'read' : 'none'
  if (!enabled) return 'none'
  return atLeast(current, 'write') ? 'write' : 'read'
}
 
/** Ticking Write also grants Read; unticking Read also removes Write. */
export const toggleModule = (permissions, key, access, enabled) => ({ ...permissions, [key]: nextLevel(permissions[key], access, enabled) })
 
export function toggleGroup(permissions, modules, access, enabled) {
  return { ...permissions, ...Object.fromEntries(modules.map(({ key }) => [key, nextLevel(permissions[key], access, enabled)])) }
}
 
/** 'all' | 'some' | 'none' of the group's modules grant at least this access. */
export function groupState(permissions, modules, access) {
  const granted = modules.filter(({ key }) => atLeast(permissions[key], access)).length
  if (granted === 0) return 'none'
  return granted === modules.length ? 'all' : 'some'
}
 
export const samePermissions = (a, b) => Object.keys({ ...a, ...b }).every((key) => (a[key] ?? 'none') === (b[key] ?? 'none'))
```

## `src/features/users/services/roleService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. Roles and permissions are display and editing UI only; the backend
// authorizes every request against the signed-in user's role. A role is
//   { id, name, description, system, permissions: { [moduleKey]: 'none' | 'read' | 'write' }, usersCount, updatedAt }
// and a module is { key, group, label, description }. The built-in Administrator role (`system: true`) is read-only.
 
/** GET roles → { items: [role], modules: [module] } (modules are listed in display order, grouped by `group`) */
export async function listRoles() {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.roles.list)
  return data
}
 
/** POST { name, description, copyFrom?: role id } → the created role (permissions copied from `copyFrom`, else none) */
export async function createRole(values) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.admin.roles.list, values)
  return data
}
 
/** PUT { name?, description?, permissions? } → the updated role */
export async function updateRole({ id, ...values }) {
  const { data } = await http.put(endpoints.admin.roles.item(id), values)
  return data
}
 
/** DELETE → 204 (refused while users are assigned to the role) */
export async function deleteRole(id) {
  await http.delete(endpoints.admin.roles.item(id))
}
```
 
## `src/features/users/services/userService.js`
 
```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. An admin user is
//   { id, name, email, mobile, roleId, roleName, status: 'active' | 'inactive', lastActiveAt, createdAt }
// Field-level problems come back as 409/422 with { message, errors: { field: message } }.
 
/** GET users (q, role: role id, status, sort: 'field' | '-field', page, pageSize) → { items, page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount, counts: { all, active } } */
export async function listUsers(params) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.admin.users.list, { params })
  return data
}
 
/** POST { name, email, mobile, roleId, status } → the created user */
export async function createUser(values) {
  const { data } = await http.post(endpoints.admin.users.list, values)
  return data
}
 
/** PUT { name, email, mobile, roleId, status } → the updated user */
export async function updateUser({ id, ...values }) {
  const { data } = await http.put(endpoints.admin.users.item(id), values)
  return data
}
 
/** PATCH { status: 'active' | 'inactive' } → the updated user (a user cannot deactivate themselves) */
export async function setUserStatus({ id, status }) {
  const { data } = await http.patch(endpoints.admin.users.status(id), { status })
  return data
}
 
/** DELETE → 204 (a user cannot delete themselves) */
export async function deleteUser(id) {
  await http.delete(endpoints.admin.users.item(id))
}
```

```jsx
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import Alert from '@/components/molecules/Alert'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import { useWallet } from '@/features/wallet/hooks/useWallet'
import { describeLastCredit } from '@/features/wallet/utils/lastCredit'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './WalletBalanceCard.module.scss'
 
/**
 * The wallet page's balance card with the rules in force. The rules are information from the backend ("up to
 * ₹100 per order, not combinable with a coupon"); the checkout applies them, this screen only explains them.
 */
export default function WalletBalanceCard() {
  const wallet = useWallet()
 
  if (wallet.isPending) {
    return (
      <Card padding="lg" aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading your wallet">
        <Skeleton width="8rem" height="0.875rem" />
        <Skeleton width="11rem" height="2.5rem" className={styles.skeletonAmount} />
      </Card>
    )
  }
  if (wallet.isError) return <ErrorState title="We couldn’t load your wallet" message={getErrorMessage(wallet.error)} onRetry={wallet.refetch} />
 
  const { balance, lastCredit, rules } = wallet.data
  return (
    <Card padding="lg" aria-label="Wallet balance">
      <div className={styles.balanceBlock}>
        <span className={styles.icon}>
          <Icon name="wallet2" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p className={styles.label}>Available balance</p>
          <p className={styles.balance}>{formatINR(balance, { decimals: 2 })}</p>
          <p className={styles.lastCredit}>{describeLastCredit(lastCredit)}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Alert tone="info" title="How your wallet works" className={styles.rules}>
        <ul className={styles.ruleList}>
          <li>
            Use your wallet balance at checkout to cover up to {formatINR(rules.maxPerOrder)} on each order.
          </li>
          {!rules.combinableWithCoupon && <li>A wallet can’t be combined with a coupon on the same order.</li>}
        </ul>
      </Alert>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/wallet/components/WalletTransactions/WalletTransactions.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Card from '@/components/atoms/Card'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Skeleton from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import { PaginationBar } from '@/components/molecules/Pagination'
import { useWalletTransactions } from '@/features/wallet/hooks/useWallet'
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
import { formatINR } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './WalletTransactions.module.scss'
 
/** The wallet ledger, newest first: what moved the balance, when, the order it relates to and the amount. */
export default function WalletTransactions() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1)
  const ledger = useWalletTransactions({ page })
 
  let content
  if (ledger.isPending) {
    content = (
      <div className={styles.skeleton} aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading wallet activity">
        {[0, 1, 2].map((key) => (
          <Skeleton key={key} height="2.5rem" />
        ))}
      </div>
    )
  } else if (ledger.isError) {
    content = <ErrorState compact title="We couldn’t load your wallet activity" message={getErrorMessage(ledger.error)} onRetry={ledger.refetch} />
  } else if (ledger.data.items.length === 0) {
    content = <EmptyState compact icon="wallet2" title="No wallet activity yet" description="Refunds, cashback and wallet payments will appear here." />
  } else {
    content = (
      <>
        <ul className={styles.list}>
          {ledger.data.items.map((entry) => {
            const isCredit = entry.type === 'credit'
            return (
              <li key={entry.id} className={styles.entry}>
                <span className={clsx(styles.icon, isCredit ? styles.credit : styles.debit)}>
                  <Icon name={isCredit ? 'arrow-down-left' : 'arrow-up-right'} />
                </span>
                <div className={styles.text}>
                  <p className={styles.reason}>{entry.reason}</p>
                  <p className={styles.meta}>
                    {formatDateTime(entry.at)}
                    {entry.orderNumber && (
                      <>
                        {' · '}
                        <Link to={paths.order(entry.orderNumber)} className={styles.orderLink}>
                          Order #{entry.orderNumber}
                        </Link>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <p className={clsx(styles.amount, isCredit && styles.creditAmount)}>
                  <span className="visually-hidden">{isCredit ? 'Credit of ' : 'Debit of '}</span>
                  {isCredit ? '+' : '−'}
                  {formatINR(entry.amount, { decimals: 2 })}
                </p>
              </li>
            )
          })}
        </ul>
        <PaginationBar
          className={styles.pagination}
          page={ledger.data.page}
          pageSize={ledger.data.pageSize}
          totalItems={ledger.data.totalItems}
          onPageChange={setPage}
          itemLabel="transactions"
        />
      </>
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <Card title="Wallet activity" padding="md">
      {content}
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## `src/features/wallet/hooks/useWallet.js`
 
```javascript
import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { getWallet, listWalletTransactions } from '@/features/wallet/services/walletService'
 
export const walletKeys = {
  all: ['wallet'],
  summary: () => ['wallet', 'summary'],
  transactions: (paging) => ['wallet', 'transactions', paging],
}
 
export const WALLET_PAGE_SIZE = 8
 
/** Balance, last credit and the rules the backend applies at checkout. */
export function useWallet() {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: walletKeys.summary(), queryFn: getWallet })
}
 
export function useWalletTransactions({ page, pageSize = WALLET_PAGE_SIZE }) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: walletKeys.transactions({ page, pageSize }),
    queryFn: () => listWalletTransactions({ page, pageSize }),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
  })
}
```

```javascript
import { endpoints, http } from '@/app/services'
 
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team. The wallet summary is
//   { balance, lastCredit: { amount, kind: 'refund' | 'cashback' | 'bonus' | 'credit', at } | null,
//     rules: { maxPerOrder, combinableWithCoupon } }
// `rules` only describes what the backend enforces at checkout; the screens never apply them.
// A ledger entry is { id, type: 'credit' | 'debit', kind, amount, reason, orderNumber | null, at } and the ledger
// is paged, newest first: { items, page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount }.
 
export async function getWallet() {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.account.wallet)
  return data
}
 
export async function listWalletTransactions({ page, pageSize }) {
  const { data } = await http.get(endpoints.account.walletTransactions, { params: { page, pageSize } })
  return data
}

## `src/hooks/useDebouncedValue.js`
 
```javascript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
 
/** Returns `value` after it has stopped changing for `delay` ms (search boxes, filters). */
export function useDebouncedValue(value, delay = 300) {
  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState(value)
 
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(value), delay)
    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [value, delay])
 
  return debounced
}
```
 
## `src/hooks/useDisclosure.js`
 
```javascript
import { useCallback, useState } from 'react'
 
/** Open/close state for modals, drawers and menus. */
export function useDisclosure(initialOpen = false) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(initialOpen)
  const open = useCallback(() => setIsOpen(true), [])
  const close = useCallback(() => setIsOpen(false), [])
  const toggle = useCallback(() => setIsOpen((current) => !current), [])
  return { isOpen, open, close, toggle }
}
```
 
## `src/hooks/useLockBodyScroll.js`
 
```javascript
import { useEffect } from 'react'
 
// Reference-counted so stacked overlays (a confirm dialog over a drawer) lock and unlock once.
let lockCount = 0
let savedStyles = null
 
function lock() {
  if (lockCount === 0) {
    const { body, documentElement } = document
    const scrollbarWidth = window.innerWidth - documentElement.clientWidth
    savedStyles = { overflow: body.style.overflow, paddingRight: body.style.paddingRight }
    body.style.overflow = 'hidden'
    // Keep the layout from shifting when the page scrollbar disappears.
    if (scrollbarWidth > 0) body.style.paddingRight = `${scrollbarWidth}px`
  }
  lockCount += 1
}
 
function unlock() {
  lockCount = Math.max(0, lockCount - 1)
  if (lockCount === 0 && savedStyles) {
    document.body.style.overflow = savedStyles.overflow
    document.body.style.paddingRight = savedStyles.paddingRight
    savedStyles = null
  }
}
 
/** Disables page scrolling while `locked` is true. */
export function useLockBodyScroll(locked = true) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!locked) return undefined
    lock()
    return unlock
  }, [locked])
}
```
 
## `src/hooks/useMediaQuery.js`
 
```javascript
import { useCallback, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'
 
/** Subscribes to a CSS media query, e.g. useMediaQuery('(min-width: 1024px)'). */
export function useMediaQuery(query) {
  const subscribe = useCallback(
    (onChange) => {
      const list = window.matchMedia(query)
      list.addEventListener('change', onChange)
      return () => list.removeEventListener('change', onChange)
    },
    [query],
  )
  return useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribe,
    () => window.matchMedia(query).matches,
    () => false,
  )
}
```
 
## `src/hooks/useOnClickOutside.js`
 
```javascript
import { useEffect } from 'react'
 
/** Calls `handler` on a pointer press outside the element held by `ref`. */
export function useOnClickOutside(ref, handler, enabled = true) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return undefined
    const onPointerDown = (event) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(event.target)) handler(event)
    }
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown)
  }, [ref, handler, enabled])
}
```
 
## `src/hooks/useOverlay.js`
 
```javascript
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { useLockBodyScroll } from './useLockBodyScroll'
 
const FOCUSABLE = [
  'a[href]',
  'button:not([disabled])',
  'input:not([disabled]):not([type="hidden"])',
  'select:not([disabled])',
  'textarea:not([disabled])',
  '[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
].join(',')
 
// Open overlays, innermost last. Only the top one reacts to Escape and Tab.
const overlayStack = []
 
const isVisible = (element) => element.getClientRects().length > 0
 
// A combobox with its list open (react-select, native-like pickers) owns the next Escape: it closes
// the list, and only a further Escape closes the overlay.
const isExpandedCombobox = (target) => target instanceof Element && target.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true'
 
/**
 * Behaviour shared by Modal and Drawer: page scroll lock, initial focus, Tab focus containment,
 * Escape to close (innermost overlay only) and focus restoration on close.
 *
 * The key handler runs in the capture phase on purpose: libraries such as react-select call
 * preventDefault() on every Escape they see, even with their menu closed, which would otherwise
 * make an overlay impossible to dismiss while a select has focus.
 *
 * Initial focus goes to [data-autofocus], else the first control in [data-overlay-body], else the
 * first focusable element, else the panel itself.
 */
export function useOverlay({ open, onClose, containerRef, closeOnEscape = true }) {
  useLockBodyScroll(open)
 
  const onCloseRef = useRef(onClose)
  useEffect(() => {
    onCloseRef.current = onClose
  })
 
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = containerRef.current
    if (!open || !container) return undefined
 
    const token = Symbol('overlay')
    overlayStack.push(token)
    const previouslyFocused = document.activeElement
 
    const initialTarget =
      container.querySelector('[data-autofocus]') ??
      container.querySelector(`[data-overlay-body] :is(${FOCUSABLE})`) ??
      container.querySelector(FOCUSABLE) ??
      container
    initialTarget.focus({ preventScroll: true })
 
    const handleKeyDown = (event) => {
      if (overlayStack[overlayStack.length - 1] !== token) return
 
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        if (!closeOnEscape || isExpandedCombobox(event.target)) return
        event.preventDefault()
        event.stopPropagation()
        onCloseRef.current?.()
        return
      }
      if (event.key !== 'Tab') return
 
      const focusable = [...container.querySelectorAll(FOCUSABLE)].filter(isVisible)
      if (focusable.length === 0) {
        event.preventDefault()
        container.focus()
        return
      }
      const first = focusable[0]
      const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1]
      const active = document.activeElement
 
      if (!container.contains(active)) {
        event.preventDefault()
        first.focus()
      } else if (event.shiftKey && (active === first || active === container)) {
        event.preventDefault()
        last.focus()
      } else if (!event.shiftKey && active === last) {
        event.preventDefault()
        first.focus()
      }
    }
 
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown, true)
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown, true)
      overlayStack.splice(overlayStack.indexOf(token), 1)
      if (previouslyFocused instanceof HTMLElement && document.contains(previouslyFocused)) {
        previouslyFocused.focus({ preventScroll: true })
      }
    }
  }, [open, containerRef, closeOnEscape])
}
```
 
## `src/layouts/AdminLayout/AdminHeader.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { Link, useMatches, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { selectCurrentUser } from '@/app/store'
import Avatar from '@/components/atoms/Avatar'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import IconButton from '@/components/atoms/IconButton'
import Popover from '@/components/molecules/Popover'
import SearchField from '@/components/molecules/SearchField'
import { useLogout } from '@/features/auth'
import NotificationsMenu from '@/features/dashboard/components/NotificationsMenu'
import styles from './AdminHeader.module.scss'
 
const ROLE_LABELS = { admin: 'Administrator' }
 
function Breadcrumb() {
  const matches = useMatches()
  const crumbs = matches.flatMap((match) => (match.handle?.crumb ? [match.handle.crumb] : []))
 
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" className={styles.breadcrumb}>
      <ol>
        <li>Workspace</li>
        {crumbs.map((crumb, index) => (
          <li key={`${crumb}-${index}`} aria-current={index === crumbs.length - 1 ? 'page' : undefined}>
            {crumb}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  )
}
 
export default function AdminHeader({ onOpenMenu, menuExpanded }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const user = useSelector(selectCurrentUser)
  const logout = useLogout({ redirectTo: paths.admin.login })
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
 
  // ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team (B-15): global search is handled by the Orders list
  // (?q=) until a cross-entity search endpoint exists.
  const search = (value) => {
    const trimmed = value.trim()
    if (trimmed) navigate({ pathname: paths.admin.orders, search: `?q=${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}` })
  }
 
  return (
    <header className={styles.header}>
      <IconButton
        icon="list"
        label="Open menu"
        size="lg"
        className={styles.menuButton}
        aria-controls="admin-sidebar"
        aria-expanded={menuExpanded}
        onClick={onOpenMenu}
      />
      <Breadcrumb />
      <SearchField
        className={styles.search}
        variant="filled"
        size="md"
        value={query}
        onChange={setQuery}
        onSubmit={search}
        placeholder="Search orders, products, customers"
        aria-label="Search orders, products, customers"
      />
 
      <div className={styles.actions}>
        <NotificationsMenu />
        <Popover
          align="end"
          panelClassName={styles.menuPanel}
          trigger={({ props }) => (
            <button type="button" className={styles.user} {...props}>
              <Avatar name={user?.name} />
              <span className={styles.identity}>
                <span className={styles.name}>{user?.name}</span>
                <span className={styles.role}>
                  {ROLE_LABELS[user?.role] ?? user?.role}
                  <Icon name="chevron-down" />
                </span>
              </span>
            </button>
          )}
        >
          {({ close }) => (
            <ul>
              <li>
                <Link to={paths.admin.profile} className={styles.menuItem} onClick={close}>
                  <Icon name="person" /> Profile
                </Link>
              </li>
              <li>
                <button type="button" className={styles.menuItem} onClick={() => logout.mutate()}>
                  <Icon name="box-arrow-right" /> Log out
                </button>
              </li>
            </ul>
          )}
        </Popover>
      </div>
    </header>
  )
}
```

## `src/layouts/AdminLayout/AdminLayout.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { Outlet } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { adminSidebarToggled, selectAdminSidebarCollapsed } from '@/app/store'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import { useOverlay } from '@/hooks/useOverlay'
import AdminHeader from './AdminHeader'
import AdminSidebar from './AdminSidebar'
import styles from './AdminLayout.module.scss'
 
/** Admin shell: collapsible sidebar (off-canvas on small screens), sticky header and the page outlet. */
export default function AdminLayout() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch()
  const collapsed = useSelector(selectAdminSidebarCollapsed)
  const mobileMenu = useDisclosure()
  const sidebarRef = useRef(null)
 
  // The off-canvas menu behaves like a dialog: focus stays inside, Escape closes, page scroll locks.
  useOverlay({ open: mobileMenu.isOpen, onClose: mobileMenu.close, containerRef: sidebarRef })
 
  // Admin screens use the denser form-control scale (styles/_root.scss). The attribute sits on <html> so
  // modals and drawers rendered through portals, outside this shell, follow suit.
  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.area = 'admin'
    return () => {
      delete document.documentElement.dataset.area
    }
  }, [])
 
  return (
    <div className={clsx(styles.shell, collapsed && styles.collapsed)}>
      <AdminSidebar
        ref={sidebarRef}
        collapsed={collapsed}
        open={mobileMenu.isOpen}
        onToggleCollapse={() => dispatch(adminSidebarToggled())}
        onNavigate={mobileMenu.close}
      />
      {mobileMenu.isOpen && <div className={styles.scrim} onClick={mobileMenu.close} aria-hidden="true" />}
      <div className={styles.body}>
        <AdminHeader onOpenMenu={mobileMenu.open} menuExpanded={mobileMenu.isOpen} />
        <main id="main-content" className={styles.content} tabIndex={-1}>
          <Outlet />
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/layouts/AdminLayout/AdminSidebar.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Link, NavLink } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Logo from '@/components/atoms/Logo'
import { useLogout } from '@/features/auth'
import { ADMIN_NAV } from './navigation'
import styles from './AdminSidebar.module.scss'
 
/**
 * Admin navigation. `collapsed` (desktop preference) shows icons only; on small screens the sidebar
 * is an off-canvas panel controlled by `open`, and always shows labels.
 */
export default function AdminSidebar({ ref, collapsed, open, onToggleCollapse, onNavigate }) {
  const logout = useLogout({ redirectTo: paths.admin.login })
 
  return (
    <aside ref={ref} id="admin-sidebar" aria-label="Admin" className={clsx(styles.sidebar, collapsed && styles.collapsed, open && styles.open)}>
      <div className={styles.brand}>
        {collapsed ? (
          <Link to={paths.admin.dashboard} className={styles.collapsedMark} aria-label="Shipper.com admin home">
            <Icon name="box-seam" />
          </Link>
        ) : (
          <Logo as={Link} to={paths.admin.dashboard} size="md" aria-label="Shipper.com admin home" />
        )}
        <p className={styles.workspace}>{collapsed ? 'OPS' : 'WORKSPACE / ADMIN'}</p>
      </div>
 
      <nav aria-label="Admin sections">
        <ul className={styles.list}>
          {ADMIN_NAV.map((item) => (
            <li key={item.key}>
              <NavLink
                to={item.to}
                className={({ isActive }) => clsx(styles.item, isActive && styles.active)}
                title={collapsed ? item.label : undefined}
                onClick={onNavigate}
              >
                <Icon name={item.icon} />
                <span className={styles.label}>{item.label}</span>
              </NavLink>
            </li>
          ))}
          <li>
            <button type="button" className={styles.item} title={collapsed ? 'Logout' : undefined} onClick={() => logout.mutate()}>
              <Icon name="box-arrow-right" />
              <span className={styles.label}>Logout</span>
            </button>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </nav>
 
      <button
        type="button"
        className={clsx(styles.item, styles.collapseToggle)}
        onClick={onToggleCollapse}
        aria-pressed={collapsed}
        title={collapsed ? 'Expand menu' : undefined}
      >
        <Icon name={collapsed ? 'layout-sidebar-inset-reverse' : 'layout-sidebar-inset'} />
        <span className={styles.label}>{collapsed ? 'Expand menu' : 'Collapse menu'}</span>
      </button>
    </aside>
  )
}
```

```scss
@use '@/styles/mixins' as *;
 
.sidebar {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: var(--sh-z-modal);
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  display: flex;
  width: var(--sh-admin-sidebar-w);
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 1rem;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--sh-color-border);
  background: var(--sh-color-white);
  transform: translateX(-100%);
  transition:
    transform 200ms ease,
    width 200ms ease;
 
  &.open {
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: var(--sh-shadow-lg);
  }
 
  @include up('lg') {
    z-index: var(--sh-z-sticky);
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
}
 
.brand {
  padding: 0 0.25rem;
}
 
.workspace {
  margin: 1.25rem 0 0.875rem;
  padding-left: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-2xs);
  font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-semibold);
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}
 
.list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3125rem;
}
 
.item {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  height: 42px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.875rem;
  padding: 0 0.75rem;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--sh-radius-md);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--sh-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-sm);
  font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-medium);
  text-align: left;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition:
    background-color var(--sh-transition),
    color var(--sh-transition);
 
  i {
    flex: none;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
  }
 
  &:hover:not(.active) {
    background: var(--sh-color-surface);
    color: var(--sh-color-ink);
  }
}
 
.active {
  background: var(--sh-color-primary-tint);
  color: var(--sh-color-primary);
}
 
.collapseToggle {
  height: 36px;
  margin-top: 0.875rem;
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-xs);
 
  // Collapsing is a desktop preference; the off-canvas menu below lg has nothing to collapse.
  display: none;
 
  @include up('lg') {
    display: flex;
  }
}
 
// ── Collapsed (desktop only): icons, centred ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
@include up('lg') {
  .collapsed {
    width: var(--sh-admin-sidebar-w-collapsed);
    padding-inline: 0.75rem;
 
    .brand {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0;
    }
 
    .workspace {
      margin: 0.625rem 0 0.875rem;
      padding: 0;
    }
 
    .item {
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
    }
 
    .label {
      @include sr-only;
    }
  }
}
 
.collapsedMark {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 2.25rem;
  height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--sh-color-primary);
  font-size: 1.75rem;
}

import { Link, NavLink } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { CATEGORIES } from '@/app/config/categories'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Popover from '@/components/molecules/Popover'
import styles from './CategoryNav.module.scss'
 
const linkClass = ({ isActive }) => clsx(styles.link, isActive && styles.active)
 
export default function CategoryNav() {
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Categories" className={styles.nav}>
      <div className={clsx('sh-container', styles.inner)}>
        <ul className={styles.list}>
          <li>
            <Popover
              trigger={({ props, isOpen }) => (
                <button type="button" className={clsx(styles.link, styles.trigger, isOpen && styles.active)} {...props}>
                  All categories
                  <Icon name="chevron-down" />
                </button>
              )}
            >
              {({ close }) => (
                <ul className={styles.menu}>
                  <li>
                    <Link to={paths.shop} className={styles.menuLink} onClick={close}>
                      All products
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                  {CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
                    <li key={category.slug}>
                      <Link to={paths.category(category.slug)} className={styles.menuLink} onClick={close}>
                        {category.label}
                      </Link>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </Popover>
          </li>
          {CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
            <li key={category.slug}>
              <NavLink to={paths.category(category.slug)} className={linkClass}>
                {category.label}
              </NavLink>
            </li>
          ))}
          <li>
            <NavLink to={paths.offers} className={({ isActive }) => clsx(styles.link, styles.offers, isActive && styles.active)}>
              Today’s offers
            </NavLink>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </nav>
  )
}

## `src/layouts/StorefrontLayout/MobileTabBar.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { Link, NavLink, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { CATEGORIES } from '@/app/config/categories'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { selectCartUnitCount, selectIsAuthenticated } from '@/app/store'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Drawer from '@/components/organisms/Drawer'
import { useDisclosure } from '@/hooks/useDisclosure'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import styles from './MobileTabBar.module.scss'
 
const tabClass = ({ isActive }) => clsx(styles.tab, isActive && styles.active)
 
/** Bottom navigation for phones and tablets: Home, Categories, Cart, Account. */
export default function MobileTabBar() {
  const location = useLocation()
  const categories = useDisclosure()
  const cartUnits = useSelector(selectCartUnitCount)
  const isAuthenticated = useSelector(selectIsAuthenticated)
  const inCatalog = location.pathname.startsWith('/category') || location.pathname === paths.shop
 
  return (
    <>
      <nav aria-label="Primary" className={styles.bar}>
        <NavLink to={paths.home} end className={tabClass}>
          <Icon name="house" />
          Home
        </NavLink>
        <button type="button" className={clsx(styles.tab, inCatalog && styles.active)} onClick={categories.open}>
          <Icon name="grid" />
          Categories
        </button>
        <NavLink to={paths.cart} className={tabClass} aria-label={`Cart, ${pluralize(cartUnits, 'item')}`}>
          <Icon name="bag" />
          Cart
        </NavLink>
        <NavLink to={isAuthenticated ? paths.account : paths.login} className={tabClass}>
          <Icon name="person" />
          Account
        </NavLink>
      </nav>
 
      <Drawer open={categories.isOpen} onClose={categories.close} placement="bottom" title="Shop by category">
        <ul className={styles.categoryList}>
          <li>
            <Link to={paths.shop} className={styles.categoryLink} onClick={categories.close}>
              All products
              <Icon name="chevron-right" />
            </Link>
          </li>
          {CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
            <li key={category.slug}>
              <Link to={paths.category(category.slug)} className={styles.categoryLink} onClick={categories.close}>
                {category.label}
                <Icon name="chevron-right" />
              </Link>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </Drawer>
    </>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { CATEGORIES } from '@/app/config/categories'
import { POLICY_PAGES, STOREFRONT } from '@/app/config/storefront'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Logo from '@/components/atoms/Logo'
import styles from './StorefrontFooter.module.scss'
 
export default function StorefrontFooter() {
  return (
    <footer className={styles.footer}>
      <div className="sh-container">
        <div className={styles.grid}>
          <div className={styles.brand}>
            <Logo as={Link} to={paths.home} inverted aria-label="Shipper.com home" />
            <p className={styles.tagline}>{STOREFRONT.tagline}</p>
            <p className={styles.contact}>
              <a href={`mailto:${STOREFRONT.supportEmail}`}>{STOREFRONT.supportEmail}</a> · {STOREFRONT.supportPhone}
            </p>
          </div>
 
          <nav aria-label="Shop" className={styles.links}>
            <h2 className={styles.heading}>
              <Link to={paths.shop}>Shop</Link>
            </h2>
            <ul>
              {CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
                <li key={category.slug}>
                  <Link to={paths.category(category.slug)}>{category.label}</Link>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>

            {STOREFRONT.paymentMethods.map((method) => (
              <li key={method}>{method}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </footer>
  )
}

## `src/layouts/StorefrontLayout/StorefrontHeader.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { Link, useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { selectCartUnitCount, selectIsAuthenticated } from '@/app/store'
import Icon from '@/components/atoms/Icon'
import Logo from '@/components/atoms/Logo'
import SearchField from '@/components/molecules/SearchField'
import DeliveryLocation from '@/features/storefront/components/DeliveryLocation'
import { pluralize } from '@/lib/format'
import CategoryNav from './CategoryNav'
import styles from './StorefrontHeader.module.scss'
 
export default function StorefrontHeader() {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams()
  // The field shows the active ?q= search; text typed since then wins until the URL's query changes.
  const urlQuery = searchParams.get('q') ?? ''
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(null)
  const query = draft && draft.base === urlQuery ? draft.text : urlQuery
  const cartUnits = useSelector(selectCartUnitCount)
  const isAuthenticated = useSelector(selectIsAuthenticated)
 
  const search = (value) => {
    const trimmed = value.trim()
    navigate({ pathname: paths.shop, search: trimmed ? `?q=${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}` : '' })
  }
 
  return (
    <header className={styles.header}>
      <div className={`sh-container ${styles.bar}`}>
        <Logo as={Link} to={paths.home} aria-label="Shipper.com home" className={styles.logo} />
 
        <SearchField
          className={styles.search}
          variant="filled"
          value={query}
          onChange={(text) => setDraft({ text, base: urlQuery })}
          onSubmit={search}
          placeholder="Search for haldi, shampoo, everyday essentials…"
          aria-label="Search products"
        />
 
        <div className={styles.deliver}>
          <span className={styles.desktopOnly}>
            <DeliveryLocation variant="header" />
          </span>
        </div>
 
        <Link
          to={isAuthenticated ? paths.profile : paths.login}
          className={styles.iconLink}
          aria-label={isAuthenticated ? 'My account' : 'Log in or sign up'}
        >
          <Icon name="person" />
        </Link>
 
        <Link to={paths.cart} className={styles.cartLink} aria-label={`Cart, ${pluralize(cartUnits, 'item')}`}>
          <Icon name="bag" />
          <span className={styles.cartLabel}>Cart ({cartUnits})</span>
        </Link>
 
        <div className={styles.deliverInline}>
          <DeliveryLocation variant="inline" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <CategoryNav />
    </header>
  )
}
```

## `src/lib/address.js`
 
```javascript
// Display helpers for the address shape the backend returns (ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team):
// { label?, name?, mobile?, line1, line2?, landmark?, city, state, pin }
 
/** "24, Gomti Greens, Vibhuti Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh – 226010" */
export function formatAddress(address, { includeLandmark = false } = {}) {
  if (!address) return ''
  const street = [address.line1, address.line2, includeLandmark ? address.landmark : null].filter(Boolean).join(', ')
  const region = [address.city, address.state].filter(Boolean).join(', ')
  const regionWithPin = address.pin ? `${region} – ${address.pin}` : region
  return [street, regionWithPin].filter(Boolean).join(', ')
}
 
/** "+91 98765 43210" from a 10-digit mobile number; anything else is returned unchanged. */
export function formatMobile(mobile) {
  const digits = String(mobile ?? '').replace(/\D/g, '')
  const local = digits.length === 12 && digits.startsWith('91') ? digits.slice(2) : digits
  return local.length === 10 ? `+91 ${local.slice(0, 5)} ${local.slice(5)}` : String(mobile ?? '')
}

## `src/lib/date.js`
 
```javascript
import dayjs from 'dayjs'
import utc from 'dayjs/plugin/utc.js'
import timezone from 'dayjs/plugin/timezone.js'
 
dayjs.extend(utc)
dayjs.extend(timezone)
 
// Shipper operates from India: order, packing and dispatch times are shown in IST for every viewer.
export const DISPLAY_TIME_ZONE = 'Asia/Kolkata'
 
const DATE_ONLY = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/
 
function toDisplayDate(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null
  // Date-only strings carry no time zone; converting them would shift the calendar day.
  const parsed = typeof value === 'string' && DATE_ONLY.test(value) ? dayjs(value) : dayjs(value).tz(DISPLAY_TIME_ZONE)
  return parsed.isValid() ? parsed : null
}
 
function formatWith(pattern) {
  return (value, fallback = '—') => {
    const date = toDisplayDate(value)
    return date ? date.format(pattern) : fallback
  }
}
 
/** 24 Oct 2026 */
export const formatDate = formatWith('DD MMM YYYY')
/** 24 Oct */
export const formatShortDate = formatWith('DD MMM')
/** 10:42 AM */
export const formatTime = formatWith('hh:mm A')
/** 24 Oct 2026, 10:42 AM */
export const formatDateTime = formatWith('DD MMM YYYY, hh:mm A')
/** 24 Oct, 10:42 AM (timelines) */
export const formatShortDateTime = formatWith('DD MMM, hh:mm A')
/** Thursday, 29 October */
export const formatLongDate = formatWith('dddd, D MMMM')
 
/** 01 Oct – 28 Oct 2026 */
export function formatDateRange(from, to, fallback = '—') {
  const start = toDisplayDate(from)
  const end = toDisplayDate(to)
  if (!start || !end) return fallback
  if (start.isSame(end, 'day')) return end.format('DD MMM YYYY')
  if (start.isSame(end, 'year')) return `${start.format('DD MMM')} – ${end.format('DD MMM YYYY')}`
  return `${start.format('DD MMM YYYY')} – ${end.format('DD MMM YYYY')}`
}
```
 
## `src/lib/download.js`
 
```javascript
/** Saves a Blob as a file download (Excel exports, invoices, labels). */
export function saveBlob(blob, fileName) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
  const link = document.createElement('a')
  link.href = url
  link.download = fileName
  document.body.appendChild(link)
  link.click()
  link.remove()
  // Revoke on the next tick so the browser has started the download.
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 0)
}
```
 
## `src/lib/excel.js`
 
```javascript
import { saveBlob } from './download'
 
// Real .xlsx files via exceljs (approved dependency). The library is large and only needed when
// someone exports or imports a sheet, so it is loaded on demand.
const XLSX_MIME = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'
const NUMBER_FORMATS = { inr: '"₹"#,##0.00', number: '#,##0', percent: '0.0"%"', text: '@', date: 'dd mmm yyyy' }
 
async function loadExcelJs() {
  const module = await import('exceljs')
  return module.default ?? module
}
 
/**
 * Builds a one-sheet workbook and downloads it.
 *   columns: [{ header: 'Order', key: 'orderNumber', width?: 14, format?: 'inr' | 'number' | 'percent' | 'date' | 'text' }]
 *   rows:    array of objects keyed by `key` (dates may be ISO strings or Date objects)
 * Every figure is written exactly as supplied by the backend; nothing is recalculated here.
 */
export async function exportToExcel({ fileName, sheetName = 'Sheet1', title, columns, rows }) {
  const ExcelJS = await loadExcelJs()
  const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook()
  workbook.creator = 'Shipper.com'
  workbook.created = new Date()
  const sheet = workbook.addWorksheet(sheetName.slice(0, 31))
 
  if (title) {
    sheet.addRow([title]).font = { bold: true, size: 14 }
    sheet.addRow([])
  }
  const headerRow = sheet.addRow(columns.map((column) => column.header))
  headerRow.font = { bold: true }
  headerRow.eachCell((cell) => {
    cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF5F7FB' } }
    cell.border = { bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFE3E9F1' } } }
  })
 
  rows.forEach((row) => {
    sheet.addRow(
      columns.map((column) => {
        const value = row[column.key]
        return column.format === 'date' && typeof value === 'string' ? new Date(value) : (value ?? '')
      }),
    )
  })
 
  columns.forEach((column, index) => {
    const target = sheet.getColumn(index + 1)
    target.width = column.width ?? Math.max(12, String(column.header).length + 4)
    if (column.format && NUMBER_FORMATS[column.format]) target.numFmt = NUMBER_FORMATS[column.format]
  })
  headerRow.eachCell((cell) => {
    cell.numFmt = '@'
  })
 
  const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer()
  saveBlob(new Blob([buffer], { type: XLSX_MIME }), fileName.endsWith('.xlsx') ? fileName : `${fileName}.xlsx`)
}
 
/**
 * Reads the first sheet of an .xlsx File chosen by the user.
 * Returns { headers: string[], rows: object[] } with each row keyed by its header text.
 */
export async function readExcelRows(file) {
  const ExcelJS = await loadExcelJs()
  const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook()
  await workbook.xlsx.load(await file.arrayBuffer())
  const sheet = workbook.worksheets[0]
  if (!sheet) return { headers: [], rows: [] }
 
  const cellText = (cell) => {
    const value = cell.value
    if (value === null || value === undefined) return ''
    if (typeof value === 'object') return value.text ?? value.result ?? (value instanceof Date ? value.toISOString() : String(value))
    return value
  }
  const headers = []
  sheet.getRow(1).eachCell((cell, column) => {
    headers[column - 1] = String(cellText(cell)).trim()
  })
  const rows = []
  sheet.eachRow((row, rowNumber) => {
    if (rowNumber === 1) return
    const entry = {}
    headers.forEach((header, index) => {
      if (header) entry[header] = cellText(row.getCell(index + 1))
    })
    if (Object.values(entry).some((value) => value !== '')) rows.push(entry)
  })
  return { headers: headers.filter(Boolean), rows }
}
```
 
## `src/lib/format.js`
 
```javascript
// Display formatting only. These helpers present values supplied by the backend; they must never be
// used to derive authoritative prices, GST, discounts, shipping, wallet deductions or totals.
 
const LOCALE = 'en-IN'
 
const inrFormatters = new Map()
const numberFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(LOCALE)
 
function getInrFormatter(fractionDigits) {
  if (!inrFormatters.has(fractionDigits)) {
    inrFormatters.set(
      fractionDigits,
      new Intl.NumberFormat(LOCALE, {
        style: 'currency',
        currency: 'INR',
        minimumFractionDigits: fractionDigits,
        maximumFractionDigits: fractionDigits,
      }),
    )
  }
  return inrFormatters.get(fractionDigits)
}
 
/** Coerces a number or numeric string (the backend may send decimal strings) to a number, or null. */
export function toNumber(value) {
  if (typeof value === 'number') return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null
  if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() !== '') {
    const parsed = Number(value.replace(/,/g, ''))
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null
  }
  return null
}
 
/**
 * Indian rupee display with lakh/crore grouping: ₹4,82,560.
 * decimals: 'auto' shows fraction digits only when needed (cards, tables);
 *           2 forces ₹800.00 (order summaries, reconciliation); 0 rounds for display.
 */
export function formatINR(value, { decimals = 'auto', fallback = '—' } = {}) {
  const amount = toNumber(value)
  if (amount === null) return fallback
  const fractionDigits = decimals === 'auto' ? (Number.isInteger(amount) ? 0 : 2) : decimals
  return getInrFormatter(fractionDigits).format(amount)
}
 
export function formatNumber(value, { fallback = '—' } = {}) {
  const amount = toNumber(value)
  return amount === null ? fallback : numberFormatter.format(amount)
}
 
/** Formats a percentage that is already expressed as a percent (20 -> "20%", 12.8 -> "12.8%"). */
export function formatPercent(value, { maximumFractionDigits = 1, fallback = '—' } = {}) {
  const amount = toNumber(value)
  if (amount === null) return fallback
  return `${new Intl.NumberFormat(LOCALE, { maximumFractionDigits }).format(amount)}%`
}
 
export function formatWeightKg(value, { fallback = '—' } = {}) {
  const amount = toNumber(value)
  return amount === null ? fallback : `${amount.toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, '')} kg`
}
 
/** pluralize(4, 'unit') -> "4 units"; pluralize(1, 'unit') -> "1 unit". */
export function pluralize(count, singular, plural = `${singular}s`) {
  return `${formatNumber(count)} ${toNumber(count) === 1 ? singular : plural}`
}
```

/** Combines several refs (callback or object) into one callback ref. */
export function mergeRefs(...refs) {
  return (node) => {
    refs.forEach((ref) => {
      if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(node)
      else if (ref) ref.current = node
    })
  }
}
