## `src/lib/pagination.js`
 
```javascript
const range = (from, to) => Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, to - from + 1) }, (_, index) => from + index)
 
/**
 * Page numbers with ellipses, always the same number of slots so the control does not jump:
 * getPageRange(5, 10) -> [1, 'ellipsis-start', 4, 5, 6, 'ellipsis-end', 10]
 */
export function getPageRange(page, pageCount, siblingCount = 1) {
  const totalSlots = siblingCount * 2 + 5
  if (pageCount <= totalSlots) return range(1, pageCount)
 
  const left = Math.max(page - siblingCount, 1)
  const right = Math.min(page + siblingCount, pageCount)
  const showLeftEllipsis = left > 2
  const showRightEllipsis = right < pageCount - 1
  const edgeCount = 3 + siblingCount * 2
 
  if (!showLeftEllipsis && showRightEllipsis) return [...range(1, edgeCount), 'ellipsis-end', pageCount]
  if (showLeftEllipsis && !showRightEllipsis) return [1, 'ellipsis-start', ...range(pageCount - edgeCount + 1, pageCount)]
  return [1, 'ellipsis-start', ...range(left, right), 'ellipsis-end', pageCount]
}
```
 
## `src/lib/storage.js`
 
```javascript
// Guarded wrappers around localStorage. Storage can be unavailable (private browsing, blocked site
// data) or throw when full, so every access is wrapped and the app must work without it.
 
export function readJson(key, fallback = null) {
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key)
    return raw === null ? fallback : JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return fallback
  }
}
 
export function writeJson(key, value) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value))
    return true
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}
 
export function removeItem(key) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.removeItem(key)
  } catch {
    // Nothing useful to do: storage is unavailable.
  }
}
 
// Tab-scoped storage, used only for the demo session in mock mode (see app/store/persistence.js).
export function readSessionJson(key, fallback = null) {
  try {
    const raw = window.sessionStorage.getItem(key)
    return raw === null ? fallback : JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return fallback
  }
}
 
export function writeSessionJson(key, value) {
  try {
    window.sessionStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value))
    return true
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}
 
export function removeSessionItem(key) {
  try {
    window.sessionStorage.removeItem(key)
  } catch {
    // Nothing useful to do: storage is unavailable.
  }
}
```
 
## `src/lib/validation.js`
 
```javascript
import { z } from 'zod'
 
// Reusable Zod primitives for forms. These validate input shape for user experience only (format,
// length, required fields). The backend remains the authority for every rule.
 
const MOBILE_PATTERN = /^[6-9]\d{9}$/
 
/** Strips spaces, dashes and a leading +91 / 91 so "+91 98765 43210" becomes "9876543210". */
export function normalizeMobile(value) {
  return String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/[\s-]/g, '')
    .replace(/^(?:\+?91)(?=\d{10}$)/, '')
}
 
export const requiredText = (message) => z.string().trim().min(1, message)
 
export const mobileSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(1, 'Enter your mobile number')
  .transform(normalizeMobile)
  .pipe(z.string().regex(MOBILE_PATTERN, 'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number'))
 
export const optionalMobileSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .transform(normalizeMobile)
  .refine(
    (value) => value === '' || MOBILE_PATTERN.test(value),
    'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number, or leave this optional field blank.',
  )
 
export const emailSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(1, 'Enter your email address')
  .pipe(z.email('Enter a valid email address'))
 
const PASSWORD_RULE = 'Use 8+ characters, including a number and a special character.'
 
export const passwordSchema = z
  .string()
  .min(8, PASSWORD_RULE)
  .regex(/\d/, PASSWORD_RULE)
  .regex(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/, PASSWORD_RULE)
 
export const pinCodeSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .regex(/^[1-9]\d{5}$/, 'Enter a valid 6-digit PIN code')
 
export const hsnSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .regex(/^(?:\d{6}|\d{8})$/, 'HSN must contain 6 or 8 digits.')
 
/** India Post consignment ID: 2 letters, 9 digits, "IN" (for example EU483920218IN). */
export const CONSIGNMENT_ID_PATTERN = /^[A-Z]{2}\d{9}IN$/
 
export const consignmentIdSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .toUpperCase()
  .regex(CONSIGNMENT_ID_PATTERN, 'Enter a valid ID: 2 letters, 9 digits, IN.')
```

## `src/mocks/adapter.js`
 
  
```javascript
import axios, { AxiosError } from 'axios'
 
// DEVELOPMENT FIXTURES — NOT AN INTEGRATION.
// A custom Axios adapter that answers requests from in-memory handlers so screens can be built and
// demonstrated before the backend exists. Nothing here is production-ready, and every URL, request
// and response shape is an ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team.
 
const MOCK_ORIGIN = 'http://mock.local'
const DEFAULT_LATENCY = { min: 180, max: 420 }
 
const STATUS_TEXT = {
  200: 'OK',
  201: 'Created',
  204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request',
  401: 'Unauthorized',
  403: 'Forbidden',
  404: 'Not Found',
  409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity',
  500: 'Internal Server Error',
}
 
/** Throw from a resolver to answer with an error status: throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Not found'). */
export class MockHttpError extends Error {
  constructor(status, message, data = { message }) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'MockHttpError'
    this.status = status
    this.data = data
  }
}
 
function compilePath(path) {
  const keys = []
  const pattern = path
    .replace(/\/+$/, '')
    .split('/')
    .map((segment) => {
      if (segment.startsWith(':')) {
        keys.push(segment.slice(1))
        return '([^/]+)'
      }
      return segment.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')
    })
    .join('/')
  return { keys, regex: new RegExp(`^${pattern}/?$`) }
}
 
/**
 * defineHandler('get', '/products/:code', ({ params, query, body }) => ({ data: {...} }))
 * The resolver returns { status = 200, data, headers } or throws MockHttpError.
 */
export function defineHandler(method, path, resolver) {
  return { method: method.toLowerCase(), path, resolver, ...compilePath(path) }
}
 
const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms))
 
function parseBody(data) {
  if (typeof data !== 'string') return data
  try {
    return JSON.parse(data)
  } catch {
    return data
  }
}
 
function buildResponse(config, status, data, headers = {}) {
  return { data, status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers, config, request: {} }
}
 
export function createMockAdapter(handlers, { latency = DEFAULT_LATENCY } = {}) {
  return async function mockAdapter(config) {
    const method = (config.method ?? 'get').toLowerCase()
    const url = new URL(axios.getUri(config), MOCK_ORIGIN)
    const basePath = new URL(config.baseURL ?? '', MOCK_ORIGIN).pathname.replace(/\/$/, '')
    const path = url.pathname.startsWith(basePath) ? url.pathname.slice(basePath.length) || '/' : url.pathname
 
    await wait(latency.min + Math.random() * (latency.max - latency.min))
    if (config.signal?.aborted) throw new axios.CanceledError(undefined, config)
 
    let status = 404
    let data = { message: `No mock handler for ${method.toUpperCase()} ${path}` }
    let headers = {}
 
    const handler = handlers.find((candidate) => candidate.method === method && candidate.regex.test(path))
    if (handler) {
      const values = path.match(handler.regex).slice(1)
      const params = Object.fromEntries(handler.keys.map((key, index) => [key, decodeURIComponent(values[index])]))
      try {
        const result = await handler.resolver({
          params,
          query: Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams),
          body: parseBody(config.data),
          headers: config.headers,
          config,
        })
        status = result?.status ?? 200
        data = result?.data
        headers = result?.headers ?? {}
      } catch (error) {
        if (!(error instanceof MockHttpError)) throw error
        status = error.status
        data = error.data
      }
    } else {
      console.warn(`[mock-api] ${data.message}`)
    }
 
    const response = buildResponse(config, status, data, headers)
    if (!config.validateStatus || config.validateStatus(status)) return response
    throw new AxiosError(
      `Request failed with status code ${status}`,
      status >= 500 ? AxiosError.ERR_BAD_RESPONSE : AxiosError.ERR_BAD_REQUEST,
      config,
      null,
      response,
    )
  }
}
```

## `src/mocks/db.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — the in-memory "database" behind the mock API.
//
// Built once when the mock API is first imported and mutated by the mock handlers (adding to a cart
// does not touch it, placing an order, verifying or dispatching one does). A page reload resets it.
// Nothing here is persistent or production-ready; every shape is an ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team.
import { productImage } from '@/mocks/assets'
import { buildCatalogData, CATEGORY_META, CATEGORY_ORDER } from '@/mocks/fixtures/catalogData'
import { buildAddresses, buildCustomers, WALLET_TRANSACTIONS } from '@/mocks/fixtures/customersData'
import { buildOrders } from '@/mocks/fixtures/ordersData'
import { demoUsers } from '@/mocks/fixtures/users'
 
const products = buildCatalogData().map((product) => ({
  ...product,
  image: productImage(product.imageKey),
  thumbnail: productImage(product.thumbnailKey),
  gallery: product.galleryKeys.map(productImage),
}))
 
const categories = CATEGORY_ORDER.map((slug) => ({
  slug,
  name: CATEGORY_META[slug].name,
  description: CATEGORY_META[slug].description,
  image: productImage(CATEGORY_META[slug].tile),
}))
 
const customers = buildCustomers()
const addresses = buildAddresses(customers)
 
export const db = {
  /** Login accounts (storefront customers and admins). Signed-up accounts are appended at runtime. */
  accounts: demoUsers.map((user) => ({ ...user })),
  products,
  categories,
  customers,
  /** { [customerId]: Address[] } */
  addresses,
  walletTransactions: WALLET_TRANSACTIONS.map((transaction) => ({ ...transaction })),
  /** { [customerId]: string[] } product codes saved for later (the "Saved products" page) */
  savedProducts: { cus_aditi: ['PC006', 'CO004', 'GR005'] },
  orders: buildOrders({ products, customers, addresses }),
}
 
// ── Lookups ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const getProduct = (code) => db.products.find((product) => product.code === code) ?? null
export const getProductBySlug = (slug) => db.products.find((product) => product.slug === slug) ?? null
export const getCustomer = (id) => db.customers.find((customer) => customer.id === id) ?? null
export const getCustomerByCode = (code) => db.customers.find((customer) => customer.code === code) ?? null
export const getOrder = (orderNumber) => db.orders.find((order) => order.orderNumber === orderNumber) ?? null
export const ordersOfCustomer = (customerId) => db.orders.filter((order) => order.customerId === customerId)
 
/**
 * The customer record behind a signed-in storefront user. Accounts created through sign-up get a
 * customer record the first time they are needed.
 */
export function ensureCustomer(user) {
  let customer = getCustomer(user.id)
  if (!customer) {
    const highest = Math.max(...db.customers.map((entry) => Number(entry.code.replace('CUS', ''))))
    customer = {
      id: user.id,
      code: `CUS${String(highest + 1).padStart(5, '0')}`,
      name: user.name,
      email: user.email,
      mobile: user.mobile,
      city: '',
      state: '',
      pin: '',
      ordersCount: 0,
      totalSpend: 0,
      walletBalance: 0,
      status: 'active',
      joinedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    }
    db.customers.push(customer)
    db.addresses[user.id] = []
  }
  return customer
}
 
export const walletBalanceOf = (customerId) => getCustomer(customerId)?.walletBalance ?? 0
 
/** Next free order number: SH10xxx counting up from the highest existing one. */
export function nextOrderNumber() {
  const highest = Math.max(...db.orders.map((order) => Number(order.orderNumber.slice(2))))
  return `SH${highest + 1}`
}
 
/** Adds the product thumbnail and slug to each order line, for views that show pictures. */
export function withLineImages(order) {
  return {
    ...order,
    lines: order.lines.map((line) => {
      const product = getProduct(line.productCode)
      return { ...line, slug: product?.slug ?? null, image: product?.thumbnail ?? null }
    }),
  }
}
```

  ['Raw Turmeric Root', '250 g', 180, 150],
  ['Golden Milk Haldi Blend', '150 g', 260, 210],
  ['Haldi Chandan Ubtan', '100 g', 220, 175],
  ['Haldi & Honey Wellness Jar', '250 g', 380, 320],

  ['Haldi Kumkum Pooja Pack', '100 g', 50, 40],
  ['Haldi Neem Face Pack', '80 g', 260, 220],
]
 
const roundToFive = (value) => Math.round(value / 5) * 5
 
// Facts taken from the design for the six hero products (admin table, product page, cart, store operation).
const DESIGN = {
  HL001: { stock: 148, pv: 12, batch: 'HL1026', hsn: '091030', rating: 4.8, reviewCount: 128, bin: 'A-01-03', weightKg: 0.2 },
  SH002: { stock: 86, pv: 28, batch: 'SH0926', hsn: '330510', rating: 4.7, reviewCount: 96, bin: 'B-02-01', weightKg: 0.3 },
  PC003: { stock: 64, pv: 24, batch: 'PC1026', hsn: '330499', rating: 4.6, reviewCount: 84, bin: 'B-04-02', weightKg: 0.15 },
  CO004: { stock: 42, pv: 36, batch: 'CO0926', hsn: '330410', rating: 4.8, reviewCount: 142, bin: 'C-01-02', weightKg: 0.05 },
  GR005: { stock: 215, pv: 18, batch: 'GR1026', hsn: '100630', rating: 4.9, reviewCount: 211, bin: 'D-03-01', weightKg: 1.05 },
  PC006: { stock: 8, pv: 32, batch: 'PC0926', hsn: '330499', rating: 4.5, reviewCount: 73, bin: 'B-04-03', weightKg: 0.25 },
}
 
// Deterministic pseudo-random numbers so the catalogue is identical on every load.
function createRandom(seed) {
  let state = seed >>> 0
  return () => {
    state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0
    let t = state
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1)
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61)
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296
  }
}
 
const kebab = (text) =>
  text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/&/g, 'and')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, '')
 
const DESIGN_ORDER = [
  { category: 'haldi', name: 'Lakadong Haldi Powder', unit: '200 g', code: 'HL001' },
  { category: 'shampoo', name: 'Botanical Repair Shampoo', unit: '250 ml', code: 'SH002' },
  { category: 'personal-care', name: 'Gentle Aloe Face Wash', unit: '100 ml', code: 'PC003' },
  { category: 'cosmetics', name: 'Everyday Rose Lip Tint', unit: '4 g', code: 'CO004' },
  { category: 'grocery', name: 'Wholegrain Basmati Rice', unit: '1 kg', code: 'GR005' },
  { category: 'personal-care', name: 'Coconut Nourish Body Lotion', unit: '200 ml', code: 'PC006' },
]
 
function expandRows() {
  const rows = []
  HALDI.forEach(([name, unit, mrp, sellingPrice], index) => {
    rows.push({ category: 'haldi', name, unit, mrp, sellingPrice, baseIndex: index, sizeIndex: 0, family: 'haldi' })
  })
  const pairs = (category, list) =>
    list.forEach(([name, unitA, mrpA, unitB, mrpB, discount, extra], baseIndex) => {
      const family = CATEGORY_META[category].family
      const resolvedFamily = category === 'personal-care' ? extra : family[0]
      ;[
        [unitA, mrpA],
        [unitB, mrpB],
      ].forEach(([unit, mrp], sizeIndex) => {
        const price = category === 'personal-care' || category === 'shampoo' || category === 'cosmetics' || category === 'grocery' ? roundToFive((mrp * (100 - discount)) / 100) : mrp
        rows.push({
          category,
          name,
          unit,
          mrp,
          sellingPrice: price,
          baseIndex,
          sizeIndex,
          family: resolvedFamily,
          hsn: category === 'grocery' ? extra : undefined,
        })
      })
    })
  pairs('shampoo', SHAMPOO)
  pairs('cosmetics', COSMETICS)
  pairs('grocery', GROCERY)
  pairs('personal-care', PERSONAL_CARE)
  return rows
}
 
const BLURBS = {
  haldi: 'Naturally vibrant and aromatic, sourced from trusted growers. No added colour. No fillers.',
  shampoo: 'A gentle, plant-based formula that cleanses without stripping, for hair that feels soft and looks healthy.',
  cosmetics: 'A comfortable, buildable formula designed for everyday wear, with colours that suit most skin tones.',
  grocery: 'Honest ingredients, carefully sourced and packed fresh. Everyday nourishment for your kitchen.',
  'personal-care': 'Thoughtfully formulated for daily rituals, kind to skin and free from harsh additives.',
}
 
const INGREDIENTS = {
  haldi: '100% natural, no additives',
  shampoo: 'Aqua, plant-derived cleansers, botanical extracts, glycerin',
  cosmetics: 'Plant waxes, natural pigments, vitamin E, jojoba oil',
  grocery: '100% natural, no preservatives',
  'personal-care': 'Aqua, aloe vera, plant oils, glycerin',
}
 
const STORAGE = {
  haldi: 'Cool, dry place',
  shampoo: 'Store below 30°C, away from direct sunlight',
  cosmetics: 'Store in a cool place, close the cap tightly',
  grocery: 'Cool, dry place. Keep sealed after use',
  'personal-care': 'Store below 30°C, away from direct sunlight',
}
 
/** Builds the catalogue source rows (image *keys*, not URLs). */
export function buildCatalogData() {
  const random = createRandom(2610)
  const rows = expandRows()
 
  // Order: six design products first (codes fixed), then the rest in category order.
  const isDesignRow = (row) => DESIGN_ORDER.some((d) => d.name === row.name && d.unit === row.unit && d.category === row.category)
  const designRows = DESIGN_ORDER.map((d) => rows.find((row) => row.name === d.name && row.unit === d.unit && row.category === d.category))
  const rest = rows.filter((row) => !isDesignRow(row))
  const ordered = [...designRows, ...rest]
 
  // Overrides by position in the final list (design products 0–5 are never touched).
  const LOW_STOCK = new Set([33, 47, 58, 77, 90, 104])
  const OUT_OF_STOCK = new Set([20, 66, 85, 111])
  const INACTIVE = new Set([14, 28, 49, 63, 79, 95, 109, 121])
 
  const counters = {}
  const products = ordered.map((row, index) => {
    const meta = CATEGORY_META[row.category]
    const design = index < 6 ? DESIGN_ORDER[index] : null
    const sequence = index + 1
    const code = design ? design.code : `${meta.prefix}${String(sequence).padStart(3, '0')}`
    counters[row.category] = (counters[row.category] ?? 0) + 1
 
    const familyKey = row.family
    const family = IMAGE_FAMILIES[familyKey]
    const alt = (row.baseIndex + row.sizeIndex) % 2 === 1
    const facts = DESIGN[code]
 
    let stock = facts ? facts.stock : Math.round(30 + random() * 220)
    if (LOW_STOCK.has(index)) stock = 2 + Math.floor(random() * 8)
    if (OUT_OF_STOCK.has(index)) stock = 0
    if (row.name === 'Rose Water Toner' && row.sizeIndex === 0) stock = 5
 
    const discountPercent = Math.round(((row.mrp - row.sellingPrice) / row.mrp) * 100)
    const status = INACTIVE.has(index) ? 'inactive' : 'active'
    const slugBase = kebab(row.name)
 
    return {
      code,
      id: code,
      slug: row.sizeIndex === 0 && row.baseIndex !== undefined && !(row.category === 'haldi' && row.name === 'Lakadong Haldi Powder' && row.unit !== '200 g') ? slugBase : `${slugBase}-${kebab(row.unit)}`,
      group: slugBase,
      name: row.name,
      unit: row.unit,
      category: row.category,
      categoryLabel: meta.name,
      mrp: row.mrp,
      sellingPrice: row.sellingPrice,
      discountPercent,
      gstPercent: meta.gst,
      hsn: facts?.hsn ?? row.hsn ?? meta.hsn,
      batch: facts?.batch ?? `${meta.prefix}${String(1 + (index % 12)).padStart(2, '0')}26`,
      stock,
      lowStockThreshold: 10,
      pv: facts?.pv ?? Math.max(6, Math.round(row.sellingPrice / 10 / 2) * 2),
      status,
      rating: facts?.rating ?? Math.round((3.9 + random() * 1) * 10) / 10,
      reviewCount: facts?.reviewCount ?? Math.round(8 + random() * 230),
      weightKg: facts?.weightKg ?? 0.2,
      bin: facts?.bin ?? `${'ABCD'[index % 4]}-0${1 + (index % 4)}-0${1 + (index % 3)}`,
      imageKey: alt ? family.cardAlt : family.card,
      thumbnailKey: alt ? family.squareAlt : family.square,
      galleryKeys: [alt ? family.cardAlt : family.card, alt ? family.square : family.squareAlt, ...family.extra],
      tagline:
        code === 'HL001'
          ? 'Pure turmeric · Meghalaya origin · 200 g'
          : `${row.name.replace(/ (Shampoo|Powder|Rice)$/, '')} · ${row.unit}`,
      description:
        code === 'HL001'
          ? 'A pinch of pure goodness. Naturally vibrant, aromatic haldi sourced from the hills of Meghalaya. No added colour. No fillers.'
          : BLURBS[row.category],
      badge: code === 'HL001' ? 'Pantry favourite' : code === 'SH002' ? 'Bestseller' : null,
      ingredients: code === 'HL001' ? '100% Lakadong turmeric' : INGREDIENTS[row.category],
      storage: STORAGE[row.category],
      packedBy: 'Shipper Naturals, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh',
      bestBefore: 'Sep 2027',
      walletRewards: index % 5 === 0,
      updatedAt: '2026-10-26T10:32:00+05:30',
      updatedBy: 'Pawan Yadav',
    }
  })
 
  return products
}
 
export const CATEGORY_ORDER = ['haldi', 'shampoo', 'cosmetics', 'grocery', 'personal-care']

// DEV FIXTURE: a fixed "now" so dates match the design (28 Oct 2026) whenever the demo is opened.
export const FIXTURE_NOW = '2026-10-28T11:30:00+05:30'
 
/** ISO timestamp `days` days, `hours` hours and `minutes` minutes before the fixture clock. */
export function ago({ days = 0, hours = 0, minutes = 0 } = {}) {
  const date = new Date(FIXTURE_NOW)
  date.setMinutes(date.getMinutes() - (days * 24 * 60 + hours * 60 + minutes))
  return date.toISOString()
}
 
/** ISO timestamp `days` days and `hours` hours after the fixture clock. */
export function fromNow({ days = 0, hours = 0 } = {}) {
  const date = new Date(FIXTURE_NOW)
  date.setMinutes(date.getMinutes() + (days * 24 * 60 + hours * 60))
  return date.toISOString()
}

// DEV FIXTURES — admin dashboard aggregates (pure data, no imports).
//
// Real aggregates (sales, revenue, order and customer counts, trend lines) are computed by the backend
// from orders and payments. Here they are static constants that reproduce the dashboard in the design
// (This month: ₹4,82,560 gross, ₹4,12,780 net, 1,284 orders, 3,856 customers); queue and stock counts
// are read live from the mock db by the handler. Every shape is an ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team.
 
export const DASHBOARD_PERIODS = [
  { key: 'last_7_days', label: 'Last 7 days' },
  { key: 'this_month', label: 'This month' },
  { key: 'last_month', label: 'Last month' },
]
 
export const DEFAULT_DASHBOARD_PERIOD = 'this_month'
 
/** Orders shown under "Recent orders" (the four in the design). */
export const RECENT_ORDER_NUMBERS = ['SH10482', 'SH10483', 'SH10484', 'SH10485']
 
/**
 * Stock alerts raised for the dashboard panel, most recent first. The handler reads the live stock
 * from the db, so an alert disappears once the product is restocked. Severity is the backend's
 * judgement (for example days of cover at the current sales rate), not derived from the count.
 */
export const STOCK_ALERT_QUEUE = [
  { productCode: 'PC006', severity: 'critical' },
  { productCode: 'CO068', severity: 'warning' },
]
 
const SHAPES = {
  // [day, relative height 0–1] control points traced from the revenue chart in the design.
  thisMonth: [[1, 0.07], [4, 0.31], [5.5, 0.25], [9, 0.45], [9.5, 0.44], [12.5, 0.68], [16, 0.56], [17.3, 0.6], [19, 0.86], [21.5, 0.78], [24, 0.95], [28, 0.96]],
  lastMonth: [[1, 0.01], [4, 0.03], [6.7, 0.39], [9.5, 0.31], [12.5, 0.52], [16, 0.46], [19, 0.72], [21.5, 0.61], [24, 0.76], [28, 0.81]],
  week: [[1, 0.4], [2, 0.55], [3, 0.5], [4, 0.7], [5, 0.65], [6, 0.85], [7, 0.9]],
  previousWeek: [[1, 0.35], [2, 0.45], [3, 0.5], [4, 0.55], [5, 0.6], [6, 0.7], [7, 0.75]],
  september: [[1, 0.2], [5, 0.35], [9, 0.3], [14, 0.55], [18, 0.5], [23, 0.75], [27, 0.7], [30, 0.85]],
  august: [[1, 0.15], [6, 0.3], [11, 0.28], [16, 0.5], [21, 0.45], [26, 0.62], [30, 0.7]],
}
 
const MONTH_NAMES = { 8: 'Aug', 9: 'Sep', 10: 'Oct' }
const dayLabel = (month, day) => `${String(day).padStart(2, '0')} ${MONTH_NAMES[month]}`
 
function interpolate(controlPoints, count) {
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => {
    const day = 1 + (index * (controlPoints.at(-1)[0] - 1)) / Math.max(1, count - 1)
    const upper = controlPoints.findIndex(([at]) => at >= day)
    if (upper <= 0) return controlPoints[0][1]
    const [fromAt, fromValue] = controlPoints[upper - 1]
    const [toAt, toValue] = controlPoints[upper]
    return fromValue + ((toValue - fromValue) * (day - fromAt)) / (toAt - fromAt)
  })
}
 
/** Whole-rupee daily values that follow `shape` and add up to exactly `total` (the last day absorbs rounding). */
function distribute(shape, count, total) {
  const weights = interpolate(shape, count).map((value) => 0.35 + value)
  const weightSum = weights.reduce((sum, weight) => sum + weight, 0)
  const values = weights.map((weight) => Math.round((total * weight) / weightSum))
  values[count - 1] += total - values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0)
  return values
}
 
function buildSeries({ count, currentShape, previousShape, currentTotal, previousTotal, currentLabelOf, previousLabelOf, currentName, previousName }) {
  const current = distribute(currentShape, count, currentTotal)
  const previous = distribute(previousShape, count, previousTotal)
  return {
    currentLabel: currentName,
    previousLabel: previousName,
    points: current.map((value, index) => ({
      label: currentLabelOf(index + 1),
      previousLabel: previousLabelOf(index + 1),
      current: value,
      previous: previous[index],
    })),
  }
}
 
const PERIODS = {

        previousName: 'Previous month',
      }),
  },
}
 
/** The period's figures, or null for an unknown key. */
export function getDashboardPeriod(key) {
  const period = PERIODS[key]
  if (!period) return null
  return { key, label: period.label, rangeLabel: period.rangeLabel, kpis: period.kpis, series: period.series() }
}

function createRandom(seed) {
  let state = seed >>> 0
  return () => {
    state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0
    let t = state
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1)
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61)
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296

  shipRow('SH10473', 'Kavya Shah', 'EU483920144IN', '2026-10-23', 'returned', [['CO004', 1]], '2026-10-22')
  shipRow('SH10465', 'Ankit Jain', 'EU483920135IN', '2026-10-22', 'delivered', [['HL001', 2], ['SH002', 1]], '2026-10-21')
  shipRow('SH10461', 'Pooja Reddy', 'EU483920127IN', '2026-10-22', 'in_transit', [['PC006', 1], ['PC003', 1]], '2026-10-21')
  shipRow('SH10458', 'Riya Das', 'EU483920113IN', '2026-10-21', 'delivered', [['SH002', 2]], '2026-10-20')
 
  // ── Generated orders ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const buyable = products.filter((product) => product.status === 'active' && product.stock > 20)
  const otherCustomers = customers.filter((customer) => !['cus_aditi', 'cus_aditi_2'].includes(customer.id))
  const randomItems = (count) => {
    const chosen = new Set()
    const items = []
    while (items.length < count) {
      const product = pick(buyable)
      if (chosen.has(product.code)) continue
      chosen.add(product.code)
      items.push([product.code, 1 + Math.floor(random() * 3)])
    }
    return items
  }
  const itemsForUnits = (units) => {
    const items = []
    let left = units
    const chosen = new Set()
    while (left > 0) {
      const product = pick(buyable)
      if (chosen.has(product.code)) continue
      chosen.add(product.code)
      const quantity = Math.min(left, 1 + Math.floor(random() * 3))
      items.push([product.code, quantity])
      left -= quantity
    }
    return items
  }
 
  let todaySeq = 10512
  const nextToday = () => {
    while (used.has(`SH${todaySeq}`)) todaySeq += 1
    return `SH${todaySeq++}`
  }
  let pastSeq = 10457
  const nextPast = () => {
    while (used.has(`SH${pastSeq}`)) pastSeq -= 1
    return `SH${pastSeq--}`
  }
 
  // New: 24 total = 10 named so far (10488–10493, 10484, 10471, 10479, 10480) + 14 generated, earlier today.
  for (let index = 0; index < 14; index += 1) {
    make({
      number: nextToday(),
      customerId: pick(otherCustomers).id,
      placedAt: plusHours(stamp('2026-10-28', '09:30'), -(0.2 + index * 0.35)),
      items: randomItems(1 + Math.floor(random() * 3)),
      status: 'new',
      paymentStatus: random() < 0.15 ? 'pending' : 'paid',
      queueRank: 100 + index,
    })
  }
 
  // To Pick: 18 total = 4 named (10500, 10487, 10497, 10494) + 14 generated with 54 units between them.
  ;[3, 4, 5, 2, 6, 3, 4, 5, 3, 4, 5, 3, 4, 3].forEach((units, index) => {
    make({
      number: nextToday(),
      customerId: pick(otherCustomers).id,
      placedAt: plusHours(stamp('2026-10-28', '08:40'), -(0.3 + index * 0.4)),
      items: itemsForUnits(units),
      status: 'to_pick',
      fulfilment: { assignee: ASSIGNEES[index % 3], pickBatch: 'PICK-2810-04', priority: index === 2 ? 'high' : 'standard' },
      queueRank: 100 + index,
    })
  })
 
  // To Pack: 12 total = 1 named + 11 generated.
  for (let index = 0; index < 11; index += 1) {
    make({
      number: nextToday(),
      customerId: pick(otherCustomers).id,
      placedAt: plusHours(stamp('2026-10-28', '07:50'), -(0.3 + index * 0.5)),
      items: randomItems(1 + Math.floor(random() * 3)),
      status: 'to_pack',
      timestamps: { pickedAt: plusHours(stamp('2026-10-28', '10:50'), -index * 0.4) },
      fulfilment: { assignee: ASSIGNEES[index % 3], pickBatch: 'PICK-2810-03' },
      queueRank: 100 + index,
    })
  }
 
  // Ready to dispatch: 8 total = 7 named (10502, 10483, 10503, 10504, 10495, 10496, 10481) + 1 generated (1.20 kg).
  make({ number: nextToday(), customerId: pick(otherCustomers).id, placedAt: stamp('2026-10-27', '10:30'), items: randomItems(2), status: 'packed', weightKg: 1.2, queueRank: 100 })
 
  // Dispatched in the last 14 days: 148 total = 8 named (10482, 10485, 10486, 10473, 10465, 10461, 10458, 10470) + 140 generated.
  for (let index = 0; index < 140; index += 1) {
    const dayOffset = 1 + (index % 14) // 1..14 days before 28 Oct → 27 Oct … 14 Oct
    const dispatchDay = new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 28 - dayOffset))
    const date = dispatchDay.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
    const dispatchedAt = stamp(date, '16:30')
    const ageDays = dayOffset
    const roll = random()
    let status
    if (ageDays >= 6) status = roll < 0.88 ? 'delivered' : roll < 0.94 ? 'returned' : 'in_transit'
    else if (ageDays >= 3) status = roll < 0.45 ? 'delivered' : 'in_transit'
    else status = roll < 0.3 ? 'dispatched' : 'in_transit'
    make({
      number: nextPast(),
      customerId: pick(otherCustomers).id,
      placedAt: plusHours(dispatchedAt, -(26 + Math.floor(random() * 6))),
      items: randomItems(1 + Math.floor(random() * 3)),
      status,
      timestamps: { dispatchedAt },
      queueRank: 200 + index,
    })
  }
 
  // History: older delivered orders for other customers (not part of any queue).
  for (let index = 0; index < 70; index += 1) {
    const daysBack = 16 + Math.floor(random() * 80)
    const date = new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 28 - daysBack)).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
    make({
      number: nextPast(),
      customerId: pick(otherCustomers).id,
      placedAt: stamp(date, '13:10'),
      items: randomItems(1 + Math.floor(random() * 3)),
      status: random() < 0.04 ? 'cancelled' : 'delivered',
      timestamps: { dispatchedAt: stamp(date, '17:00') },
      queueRank: 500 + index,
    })
  }
 
  return orders
}

## `src/mocks/handlers/account.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — profile, password and wallet endpoints of the signed-in customer for the mock API.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: paths and payloads (see features/profile and features/wallet services).
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, ensureCustomer, walletBalanceOf } from '@/mocks/db'
import { DEMO_PASSWORD } from '@/mocks/fixtures/users'
import { requireUser } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
import { paginate } from '@/mocks/lib/paginate'
import { WALLET_ORDER_CAP } from '@/mocks/lib/quote'
 
const MOBILE_PATTERN = /^[6-9]\d{9}$/
const EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/
 
const normalizeMobile = (value = '') => String(value).replace(/[\s-]/g, '').replace(/^\+?91(?=\d{10}$)/, '')
const publicProfile = ({ id, name, email, mobile }) => ({ id, name, email, mobile })
 
function requireCustomer(headers) {
  const user = requireUser(headers)
  if (user.role !== 'customer') throw new MockHttpError(403, 'This area is for customer accounts.')
  return user
}
 
const fieldErrors = (status, message, errors) => new MockHttpError(status, message, { message, errors })
 
// A ledger line is either money in (refund, cashback, bonus) or the wallet used to pay for an order.
const CREDIT_KINDS = [
  ['refund', /^refund/i],
  ['cashback', /cashback/i],
  ['bonus', /bonus/i],
]
const kindOf = (transaction) =>
  transaction.type === 'debit' ? 'order_payment' : (CREDIT_KINDS.find(([, pattern]) => pattern.test(transaction.reason))?.[0] ?? 'credit')
 
const toTransaction = (transaction) => ({
  id: transaction.id,
  type: transaction.type,
  kind: kindOf(transaction),
  amount: transaction.amount,
  reason: transaction.reason,
  orderNumber: transaction.reference,
  at: transaction.at,
})
 
const ledgerOf = (customerId) =>
  db.walletTransactions.filter((transaction) => transaction.customerId === customerId).sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.at) - Date.parse(a.at))
 
export const accountHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/account/profile', ({ headers }) => ({ data: publicProfile(requireCustomer(headers)) })),
 
  defineHandler('put', '/account/profile', ({ body, headers }) => {
    const account = requireCustomer(headers)
    const name = String(body?.name ?? '').trim()
    const email = String(body?.email ?? '').trim()
    const mobile = normalizeMobile(body?.mobile)
 
    const errors = {}
    if (!name) errors.name = 'Enter your full name.'
    if (!MOBILE_PATTERN.test(mobile)) errors.mobile = 'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.'
    if (!EMAIL_PATTERN.test(email)) errors.email = 'Enter a valid email address.'
    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) throw fieldErrors(422, 'Please check the highlighted fields and try again.', errors)
 
    const others = db.accounts.filter((entry) => entry.id !== account.id)
    if (others.some((entry) => entry.mobile === mobile)) {
      throw fieldErrors(409, 'This mobile number is already linked to another account.', { mobile: 'This mobile number is already linked to another account.' })
    }
    if (others.some((entry) => entry.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase())) {
      throw fieldErrors(409, 'This email address is already linked to another account.', { email: 'This email address is already linked to another account.' })
    }
 
    Object.assign(account, { name, email, mobile })
    Object.assign(ensureCustomer(account), { name, email, mobile })
    return { data: publicProfile(account) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/account/password', ({ body, headers }) => {
    const account = requireCustomer(headers)
    if ((account.password ?? DEMO_PASSWORD) !== body?.currentPassword) {
      throw fieldErrors(422, 'Your current password is incorrect.', { currentPassword: 'Your current password is incorrect.' })
    }
    if (String(body?.newPassword ?? '').length < 8) {
      throw fieldErrors(422, 'The new password is too short.', { newPassword: 'Use 8+ characters, including a number and a special character.' })
    }
    account.password = body.newPassword
    return { status: 204 }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/account/wallet', ({ headers }) => {
    const account = requireCustomer(headers)
    const { id } = ensureCustomer(account)
    const lastCredit = ledgerOf(id).find((transaction) => transaction.type === 'credit')
    return {
      data: {
        balance: walletBalanceOf(id),
        lastCredit: lastCredit ? { amount: lastCredit.amount, kind: kindOf(lastCredit), at: lastCredit.at } : null,
        // Rules are enforced by the backend at checkout; the screen only describes them.
        rules: { maxPerOrder: WALLET_ORDER_CAP, combinableWithCoupon: false },
      },
    }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/account/wallet/transactions', ({ query, headers }) => {
    const { id } = requireCustomer(headers)
    const { items, ...paging } = paginate(ledgerOf(id), { page: query.page, pageSize: query.pageSize ?? 10 })
    return { data: { items: items.map(toTransaction), ...paging } }
  }),
]
```
 
## `src/mocks/handlers/addresses.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — saved addresses of the signed-in customer for the mock API.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: paths and payloads (see features/addresses/services).
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, ensureCustomer } from '@/mocks/db'
import { SERVICEABLE_PINS } from '@/mocks/fixtures/serviceability'
import { requireUser } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
 
function customerAddresses(headers) {
  const user = requireUser(headers)
  if (user.role !== 'customer') throw new MockHttpError(403, 'Addresses belong to customer accounts.')
  const customer = ensureCustomer(user)
  return (db.addresses[customer.id] ??= [])
}
 
const toRecord = (body, id) => {
  const pin = String(body?.pin ?? '').trim()
  return {
    id,
    label: String(body?.label ?? '').trim(),
    name: String(body?.name ?? '').trim(),
    mobile: String(body?.mobile ?? '').trim(),
    line1: String(body?.line1 ?? '').trim(),
    line2: String(body?.line2 ?? '').trim(),
    landmark: String(body?.landmark ?? '').trim(),
    city: String(body?.city ?? '').trim(),
    state: String(body?.state ?? '').trim(),
    pin,
    isDefault: Boolean(body?.isDefault),
    verified: Boolean(SERVICEABLE_PINS[pin]),
  }
}
 
const assertComplete = (record) => {
  const missing = ['label', 'name', 'mobile', 'line1', 'line2', 'city', 'state', 'pin'].filter((field) => !record[field])
  if (missing.length > 0) throw new MockHttpError(422, `Missing ${missing.join(', ')}.`)
}
 
/** Exactly one default address while the customer has any. */
function normalizeDefaults(addresses, preferredId) {
  if (addresses.length === 0) return
  const chosen = addresses.find((address) => address.id === preferredId && address.isDefault) ?? addresses.find((address) => address.isDefault) ?? addresses[0]
  addresses.forEach((address) => {
    address.isDefault = address === chosen
  })
}
 
export const addressHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/addresses', ({ headers }) => ({ data: { items: customerAddresses(headers) } })),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/addresses', ({ body, headers }) => {
    const addresses = customerAddresses(headers)
    const record = toRecord(body, `addr_${Date.now().toString(36)}`)
    assertComplete(record)
    if (addresses.length === 0) record.isDefault = true
    addresses.push(record)
    normalizeDefaults(addresses, record.isDefault ? record.id : undefined)
    return { status: 201, data: record }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('put', '/addresses/:id', ({ params, body, headers }) => {
    const addresses = customerAddresses(headers)
    const index = addresses.findIndex((address) => address.id === params.id)
    if (index === -1) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Address not found.')
    const record = toRecord(body, params.id)
    assertComplete(record)
    addresses[index] = record
    normalizeDefaults(addresses, record.isDefault ? record.id : undefined)
    return { data: addresses[index] }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('delete', '/addresses/:id', ({ params, headers }) => {
    const addresses = customerAddresses(headers)
    const index = addresses.findIndex((address) => address.id === params.id)
    if (index === -1) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Address not found.')
    addresses.splice(index, 1)
    normalizeDefaults(addresses)
    return { status: 204 }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/addresses/:id/default', ({ params, headers }) => {
    const addresses = customerAddresses(headers)
    const address = addresses.find((entry) => entry.id === params.id)
    if (!address) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Address not found.')
    addresses.forEach((entry) => {
      entry.isDefault = entry === address
    })
    return { data: address }
  }),
]
```

```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — admin dashboard aggregates. Sales figures are static constants (see
// fixtures/dashboardData.js); queue and stock numbers are counted live from the mock db.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: GET /admin/dashboard?period=… and its response shape.
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, getOrder, getProduct } from '@/mocks/db'
import { FIXTURE_NOW } from '@/mocks/fixtures/clock'
import {
  DASHBOARD_PERIODS,
  DEFAULT_DASHBOARD_PERIOD,
  getDashboardPeriod,
  RECENT_ORDER_NUMBERS,
  STOCK_ALERT_QUEUE,
} from '@/mocks/fixtures/dashboardData'
import { requireAdmin } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
import { stockStatusOf } from './adminCoreProducts'
 
// New 24 + To pick 18 + To pack 12 + Ready to dispatch 8 = 62 pending shipments.
const PENDING_SHIPMENT_STATUSES = ['new', 'to_pick', 'to_pack', 'packed']
 
function buildFulfilment() {
  const countOf = (predicate) => db.orders.filter(predicate).length
  const stockAlerts = STOCK_ALERT_QUEUE.flatMap(({ productCode, severity }) => {
    const product = getProduct(productCode)
    return product && stockStatusOf(product) === 'low_stock'
      ? [{ productCode, name: product.name, stock: product.stock, severity }]
      : []
  })
  return {
    pendingShipments: countOf((order) => PENDING_SHIPMENT_STATUSES.includes(order.status)),
    readyToDispatch: countOf((order) => order.status === 'packed'),
    delayedOrders: countOf((order) => order.delay),
    lowStockCount: db.products.filter((product) => !product.deletedAt && stockStatusOf(product) === 'low_stock').length,
    stockAlerts,
  }
}
 
function buildRecentOrders() {
  return RECENT_ORDER_NUMBERS.map(getOrder)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((order) => ({
      orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
      customerName: order.customerName,
      placedAt: order.placedAt,
      grossAmount: order.summary.grossAmount,
      paymentStatus: order.paymentStatus,
      status: order.status,
    }))
}
 
export const adminDashboardHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/dashboard', ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const period = getDashboardPeriod(query.period ?? DEFAULT_DASHBOARD_PERIOD)
    if (!period) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Choose a valid reporting period.')
 
    return {
      data: {
        asOf: FIXTURE_NOW,
        period: { key: period.key, label: period.label, rangeLabel: period.rangeLabel, options: DASHBOARD_PERIODS },
        kpis: period.kpis,
        salesOverview: period.series,
        fulfilment: buildFulfilment(),
        recentOrders: buildRecentOrders(),
      },
    }
  }),
]

## `src/mocks/handlers/adminCoreProducts.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — admin product management handlers (list, create, edit, delete, bulk update, import,
// export). They mutate `db.products`, the same records the storefront catalogue reads, so an admin
// edit is visible to customers. The fake backend owns derived values (discount %, stock status,
// counts); the frontend only displays them.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: every path, payload and response shape in this file.
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, getProduct } from '@/mocks/db'
import { FIXTURE_NOW } from '@/mocks/fixtures/clock'
import { requireAdmin } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
import { matchesText, paginate, sortBy } from '@/mocks/lib/paginate'
 
const GST_RATES = [0, 5, 12, 18, 28]
const STOCK_FILTERS = { in: 'in_stock', low: 'low_stock', out: 'out_of_stock' }
const STOCK_SNAPSHOT = { updatedAt: '2026-10-28T10:32:00+05:30', warehouse: 'Lucknow warehouse' }
const MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024
 
/** Backend rule: out of stock at 0, low stock at or below the product's own threshold. */
export const stockStatusOf = (product) => {
  if (product.stock <= 0) return 'out_of_stock'
  return product.stock <= product.lowStockThreshold ? 'low_stock' : 'in_stock'
}
 
const isListed = (product) => !product.deletedAt
const listedProducts = () => db.products.filter(isListed)
const discountOf = (mrp, sellingPrice) => Math.round(((mrp - sellingPrice) / mrp) * 100)
const kebab = (text) =>
  String(text)
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/&/g, 'and')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, '')
 
const toAdminProduct = (product) => ({
  code: product.code,
  slug: product.slug,
  name: product.name,
  category: product.category,
  categoryLabel: product.categoryLabel,
  unit: product.unit,
  batch: product.batch,
  hsn: product.hsn,
  gstPercent: product.gstPercent,
  stock: product.stock,
  lowStockThreshold: product.lowStockThreshold,
  pv: product.pv,
  mrp: product.mrp,
  sellingPrice: product.sellingPrice,
  discountPercent: product.discountPercent,
  status: product.status,
  stockStatus: stockStatusOf(product),
  image: product.image,
  thumbnail: product.thumbnail,
  description: product.description,
  updatedAt: product.updatedAt,
  updatedBy: product.updatedBy,
})
 
function filterProducts({ q, category = 'all', stock = 'all', status = 'all' }) {
  return listedProducts().filter(
    (product) =>
      matchesText(q, product.code, product.name, product.hsn, product.batch) &&
      (category === 'all' || product.category === category) &&
      (stock === 'all' || stockStatusOf(product) === STOCK_FILTERS[stock]) &&
      (status === 'all' || product.status === status),
  )
}
 
function countProducts() {
  const products = listedProducts()
  return {
    all: products.length,
    active: products.filter((product) => product.status === 'active').length,
    low: products.filter((product) => stockStatusOf(product) === 'low_stock').length,
    out: products.filter((product) => stockStatusOf(product) === 'out_of_stock').length,
  }
}
 
const toNumber = (value) => (typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(String(value ?? '').trim()))
 
/** Server-side rules for a product payload. Returns { field: message } (empty when valid). */
function validateProduct(input, { creating }) {
  const errors = {}
  const text = (value) => String(value ?? '').trim()
  const mrp = toNumber(input.mrp)
  const sellingPrice = toNumber(input.sellingPrice)
 
  if (creating && !/^[A-Za-z0-9-]{3,16}$/.test(text(input.code))) errors.code = 'Use 3–16 letters, numbers or hyphens.'
  if (!text(input.name)) errors.name = 'Enter the product name.'
  if (!db.categories.some((category) => category.slug === input.category)) errors.category = 'Select a category.'
  if (!text(input.unit)) errors.unit = 'Select the pack size.'
  if (!text(input.batch)) errors.batch = 'Enter the batch number.'
  if (!/^(?:\d{6}|\d{8})$/.test(text(input.hsn))) errors.hsn = 'HSN must contain 6 or 8 digits.'
  if (!GST_RATES.includes(toNumber(input.gstPercent))) errors.gstPercent = 'Select a valid GST rate.'
  if (!(mrp > 0)) errors.mrp = 'MRP must be greater than 0.'
  if (!(sellingPrice > 0)) errors.sellingPrice = 'Selling price must be greater than 0.'
  else if (mrp > 0 && sellingPrice > mrp) errors.sellingPrice = 'Selling price cannot be higher than the MRP.'
  if (!Number.isInteger(toNumber(input.stock)) || toNumber(input.stock) < 0) errors.stock = 'Stock must be a whole number, 0 or more.'
  if (!Number.isInteger(toNumber(input.pv)) || toNumber(input.pv) < 0) errors.pv = 'PV must be a whole number, 0 or more.'
  if (input.status !== undefined && !['active', 'inactive'].includes(input.status)) errors.status = 'Choose Active or Inactive.'
  return errors
}
 
function rejectInvalid(errors) {
  if (Object.keys(errors).length === 0) return
  throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Please check the highlighted fields and try again.', {
    message: 'Please check the highlighted fields and try again.',
    errors,
  })
}
 
function applyFields(product, input, admin) {
  const category = db.categories.find((entry) => entry.slug === input.category)
  const mrp = toNumber(input.mrp)
  const sellingPrice = toNumber(input.sellingPrice)
  Object.assign(product, {
    name: String(input.name).trim(),
    category: category.slug,
    categoryLabel: category.name,
    unit: String(input.unit).trim(),
    batch: String(input.batch).trim(),
    hsn: String(input.hsn).trim(),
    gstPercent: toNumber(input.gstPercent),
    mrp,
    sellingPrice,
    discountPercent: discountOf(mrp, sellingPrice),
    stock: toNumber(input.stock),
    pv: toNumber(input.pv),
    status: input.status ?? product.status,
    description: String(input.description ?? '').trim(),
    updatedAt: FIXTURE_NOW,
    updatedBy: admin.name,
  })
  return product
}
 
function addProduct(input, admin) {
  const category = db.categories.find((entry) => entry.slug === input.category)
  const code = String(input.code).trim().toUpperCase()
  const sibling = db.products.find((product) => product.category === category.slug)
  const baseSlug = kebab(`${input.name} ${input.unit}`)
  let slug = baseSlug
  for (let suffix = 2; db.products.some((product) => product.slug === slug); suffix += 1) slug = `${baseSlug}-${suffix}`
 
  const product = {
    id: code,
    code,
    slug,
    group: kebab(input.name),
    lowStockThreshold: 10,
    rating: 0,
    reviewCount: 0,
    weightKg: 0.2,
    bin: 'UNASSIGNED',
    // A new product has no photography yet: the category tile stands in until an image is uploaded.
    image: category.image,
    thumbnail: category.image,
    gallery: [category.image],
    tagline: `${String(input.name).trim()} · ${String(input.unit).trim()}`,
    badge: null,
    ingredients: sibling?.ingredients ?? '',
    storage: sibling?.storage ?? '',
    packedBy: sibling?.packedBy ?? '',
    bestBefore: sibling?.bestBefore ?? '',
    walletRewards: false,
  }
  applyFields(product, { ...input, status: input.status ?? 'active' }, admin)
  db.products.push(product)
  return product
}
 
function findListedProduct(code) {
  const product = getProduct(code)
  if (!product || !isListed(product)) throw new MockHttpError(404, `Product ${code} was not found.`)
  return product
}
 
export const adminProductHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/products/options', ({ headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const units = [...new Set(listedProducts().map((product) => product.unit))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, 'en', { numeric: true }))
    return {
      data: {
        categories: db.categories.map((category) => ({ value: category.slug, label: category.name })),
        units,
        gstRates: GST_RATES,
      },
    }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/products/export', ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const items = sortBy(filterProducts(query), query.sort).map(toAdminProduct)
    return { data: { generatedAt: FIXTURE_NOW, items } }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/products', ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const page = paginate(sortBy(filterProducts(query), query.sort), query)
    return { data: { ...page, items: page.items.map(toAdminProduct), counts: countProducts(), stock: STOCK_SNAPSHOT } }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/admin/products/bulk-update', ({ body, headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    const { scope, changes = {} } = body ?? {}
    const errors = {}
    if (changes.status === undefined && changes.gstPercent === undefined) errors.changes = 'Choose at least one change to apply.'
    if (changes.status !== undefined && !['active', 'inactive'].includes(changes.status)) errors.status = 'Choose Active or Inactive.'
    if (changes.gstPercent !== undefined && !GST_RATES.includes(toNumber(changes.gstPercent))) errors.gstPercent = 'Select a valid GST rate.'
    rejectInvalid(errors)
 
    const targets = Array.isArray(scope?.codes)
      ? scope.codes.map(findListedProduct)
      : filterProducts(scope?.filters ?? {})
    targets.forEach((product) => {
      if (changes.status !== undefined) product.status = changes.status
      if (changes.gstPercent !== undefined) product.gstPercent = toNumber(changes.gstPercent)
      product.updatedAt = FIXTURE_NOW
      product.updatedBy = admin.name
    })
    return { data: { updated: targets.length } }
  }),
 
  // DEV FIXTURES: the real import runs server-side (validation, stock movements, audit log).
  defineHandler('post', '/admin/products/import', ({ body, headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    const rows = Array.isArray(body?.rows) ? body.rows : []
    if (rows.length === 0) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'The file has no product rows.')
 
    const result = { created: 0, updated: 0, rejected: [] }
    rows.forEach((row) => {
      const categoryText = String(row.category ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()
      const category = db.categories.find((entry) => entry.slug === categoryText || entry.name.toLowerCase() === categoryText)
      const input = { ...row, category: category?.slug, status: row.status ? String(row.status).toLowerCase() : undefined }
      const existing = getProduct(String(row.code ?? '').trim().toUpperCase())
      const errors = validateProduct(input, { creating: !existing })
      if (existing && !isListed(existing)) errors.code = 'This product was deleted.'
      const [firstError] = Object.values(errors)
      if (firstError) {
        result.rejected.push({ rowNumber: row.rowNumber, code: row.code ?? '', message: firstError })
        return
      }
      if (existing) {
        applyFields(existing, input, admin)
        result.updated += 1
      } else {
        addProduct(input, admin)
        result.created += 1
      }
    })
    return { data: result }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/admin/products', ({ body, headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    const errors = validateProduct(body ?? {}, { creating: true })
    rejectInvalid(errors)
    const code = String(body.code).trim().toUpperCase()
    if (getProduct(code)) rejectInvalid({ code: `A product with code ${code} already exists.` })
    return { status: 201, data: toAdminProduct(addProduct(body, admin)) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('put', '/admin/products/:code', ({ params, body, headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    const product = findListedProduct(params.code)
    rejectInvalid(validateProduct(body ?? {}, { creating: false }))
    return { data: toAdminProduct(applyFields(product, body, admin)) }
  }),
 
  // DEV FIXTURES: the image stays in the browser (object URL) until the page is reloaded.
  defineHandler('post', '/admin/products/:code/image', ({ params, body, headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    const product = findListedProduct(params.code)
    const file = typeof body?.get === 'function' ? body.get('image') : null
    if (!file || typeof file === 'string') throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Choose an image to upload.')
    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png'].includes(file.type)) throw new MockHttpError(415, 'Upload a JPG or PNG image.')
    if (file.size > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) throw new MockHttpError(413, 'The image must be 5 MB or smaller.')
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file)
    Object.assign(product, { image: url, thumbnail: url, gallery: [url], updatedAt: FIXTURE_NOW, updatedBy: admin.name })
    return { data: toAdminProduct(product) }
  }),
 
  // Deleting hides the product everywhere but keeps the record, so past orders still resolve it.
  defineHandler('delete', '/admin/products/:code', ({ params, headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    const product = findListedProduct(params.code)
    Object.assign(product, { status: 'inactive', deletedAt: FIXTURE_NOW, updatedAt: FIXTURE_NOW, updatedBy: admin.name })
    return { status: 204 }
  }),
]

## `src/mocks/handlers/adminCoreProfile.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — the signed-in admin's own profile. Edits write to `db.accounts`, so the next mock
// sign-in returns the updated details. Passwords are plain text here because this is a fake backend.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: paths, payloads, password rules and the "last login" fields.
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db } from '@/mocks/db'
import { ago } from '@/mocks/fixtures/clock'
import { DEMO_PASSWORD } from '@/mocks/fixtures/users'
import { requireAdmin } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
 
const ROLE_LABELS = { admin: 'Administrator' }
const MOBILE_PATTERN = /^[6-9]\d{9}$/
const EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/
const PASSWORD_PATTERN = /^(?=.*\d)(?=.*[^A-Za-z0-9]).{8,}$/
 
// Sign-in history and join date are backend records; fixed here.
const ACTIVITY = {
  adm_pawan: { lastLoginAt: ago({ hours: 2, minutes: 12 }), lastLoginPlace: 'Lucknow · Chrome on Windows', memberSince: '2025-04-07T10:00:00+05:30' },
}
 
const normalizeMobile = (value) => String(value ?? '').replace(/[\s-]/g, '').replace(/^\+?91(?=\d{10}$)/, '')
 
const toProfile = (account) => ({
  id: account.id,
  name: account.name,
  email: account.email,
  mobile: account.mobile,
  role: account.role,
  roleLabel: ROLE_LABELS[account.role] ?? account.role,
  ...ACTIVITY[account.id],
})
 
const failValidation = (message, errors) => {
  throw new MockHttpError(422, message, { message, errors })
}
 
export const adminProfileHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/profile', ({ headers }) => ({ data: toProfile(requireAdmin(headers)) })),
 
  defineHandler('patch', '/admin/profile', ({ body, headers }) => {
    const account = requireAdmin(headers)
    const name = String(body?.name ?? '').trim()
    const email = String(body?.email ?? '').trim()
    const mobile = normalizeMobile(body?.mobile)
 
    const errors = {}
    if (!name) errors.name = 'Enter your name.'
    if (!EMAIL_PATTERN.test(email)) errors.email = 'Enter a valid email address.'
    if (!MOBILE_PATTERN.test(mobile)) errors.mobile = 'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.'
    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) failValidation('Please check the highlighted fields and try again.', errors)
 
    const clash = db.accounts.find((other) => other.id !== account.id && (other.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase() || other.mobile === mobile))
    if (clash) {
      const field = clash.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase() ? 'email' : 'mobile'
      failValidation('Another account already uses these details.', { [field]: `This ${field === 'email' ? 'email address' : 'mobile number'} belongs to another account.` })
    }
 
    Object.assign(account, { name, email, mobile })
    return { data: toProfile(account) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('put', '/admin/profile/password', ({ body, headers }) => {
    const account = requireAdmin(headers)
    if ((account.password ?? DEMO_PASSWORD) !== body?.currentPassword) {
      failValidation('Your current password is incorrect.', { currentPassword: 'Your current password is incorrect.' })
    }
    if (!PASSWORD_PATTERN.test(String(body?.newPassword ?? ''))) {
      failValidation('Use 8+ characters, including a number and a special character.', {
        newPassword: 'Use 8+ characters, including a number and a special character.',
      })
    }
    account.password = body.newPassword
    return { status: 204 }
  }),
]

## `src/mocks/handlers/adminCorePurchases.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — admin purchases: an assisted purchase an admin creates for a customer. Totals come
// from the fake backend's pricing rules (mocks/lib/quote.js); the frontend only displays them.
// Payment is simulated: "submitting" a purchase records a pending payment request, nothing is charged
// and no Razorpay API is called. The purchases live in memory and reset on reload.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: every path, payload and response shape in this file, and
// that a paid purchase becomes an order on the backend (not modelled here).
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, getCustomerByCode, getProduct } from '@/mocks/db'
import { FIXTURE_NOW } from '@/mocks/fixtures/clock'
import { PAYMENT_METHODS, PURCHASE_SEEDS, PURCHASE_STATUS_OPTIONS } from '@/mocks/fixtures/purchasesData'
import { SERVICEABLE_PINS } from '@/mocks/fixtures/serviceability'
import { requireAdmin } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
import { matchesText, paginate, sortBy } from '@/mocks/lib/paginate'
import { computeQuote, round2, WALLET_ORDER_CAP } from '@/mocks/lib/quote'
 
const OPEN_STATUSES = ['draft', 'payment_pending']
 
const toCustomerView = (customer) => ({
  code: customer.code,
  name: customer.name,
  mobile: customer.mobile,
  email: customer.email,
  walletBalance: customer.walletBalance,
  addresses: (db.addresses[customer.id] ?? []).map((address) => ({ ...address })),
})
 
function resolveCustomerAndAddress({ customerCode, addressId }) {
  const customer = getCustomerByCode(customerCode)
  if (!customer) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Find the customer first.', { message: 'Find the customer first.', errors: { customer: 'Find the customer first.' } })
  const address = (db.addresses[customer.id] ?? []).find((entry) => entry.id === addressId)
  if (!address) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Choose a delivery address.', { message: 'Choose a delivery address.', errors: { address: 'Choose a delivery address.' } })
  return { customer, address }
}
 
/** Prices the lines for the customer and address, and reports delivery and stock availability. */
function priceLines({ customer, address, lines = [], useWallet }) {
  const resolved = lines.map(({ productCode, quantity }) => {
    const product = getProduct(productCode)
    if (!product || product.deletedAt) throw new MockHttpError(422, `Product ${productCode} is not available.`)
    return { product, quantity: Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(quantity)) || 1) }
  })
  const quote = computeQuote({ lines: resolved, destinationState: address.state, useWallet, walletBalance: customer.walletBalance })
 
  const quoteLines = quote.lines.map((line) => {
    const product = getProduct(line.productCode)
    const available = product.status === 'active' && line.quantity <= product.stock
    return {
      productCode: line.productCode,
      name: line.name,
      unit: line.unit,
      quantity: line.quantity,
      pv: line.pv,
      linePv: line.pv * line.quantity,
      mrp: line.mrp,
      unitPrice: line.unitPrice,
      gstPercent: line.gstPercent,
      lineTotal: line.lineTotal,
      availableStock: product.stock,
      maxQuantity: product.stock,
      available,
    }
  })
  const unavailable = quoteLines.filter((line) => !line.available)
  const area = SERVICEABLE_PINS[address.pin]
 
  return {
    lines: quoteLines,
    summary: {
      ...quote.summary,
      totalPv: quoteLines.reduce((total, line) => total + line.linePv, 0),
    },
    wallet: {
      ...quote.wallet,
      applicable: round2(Math.min(customer.walletBalance, WALLET_ORDER_CAP, quote.summary.grossAmount)),
    },
    delivery: {
      addressId: address.id,
      pin: address.pin,
      city: area?.city ?? address.city,
      state: address.state,
      serviceable: Boolean(area),
      gstStateCode: quote.summary.gstStateCode,
      supply: quote.summary.gstType,
    },
    availability: {
      allAvailable: unavailable.length === 0,
      message:
        unavailable.length === 0
          ? null
          : `Not enough stock for ${unavailable.map((line) => line.productCode).join(', ')}.`,
    },
  }
}
 
function buildRecord({ purchaseNumber, status, customer, address, lines, useWallet, paymentMethod, createdAt, createdBy, reference }) {
  const priced = priceLines({ customer, address, lines, useWallet })
  const method = PAYMENT_METHODS.find((entry) => entry.value === paymentMethod) ?? PAYMENT_METHODS[0]
  return {
    purchaseNumber,
    status,
    customer: toCustomerView(customer),
    address: { ...address },
    lines: priced.lines,
    summary: priced.summary,
    wallet: priced.wallet,
    delivery: priced.delivery,
    useWallet,
    paymentMethod: method.value,
    paymentLabel: method.label,
    collectLabel: method.collectLabel,
    reference,
    createdAt,
    createdBy,
    updatedAt: createdAt,
  }
}
 
let store = null
 
function purchases() {
  if (!store) {
    store = PURCHASE_SEEDS.map(([purchaseNumber, customerCode, createdAt, createdBy, status, paymentMethod, items, useWallet]) => {
      const customer = getCustomerByCode(customerCode)
      const address = (db.addresses[customer.id] ?? []).find((entry) => entry.isDefault) ?? db.addresses[customer.id][0]
      return buildRecord({
        purchaseNumber,
        status,
        customer,
        address,
        lines: items.map(([productCode, quantity]) => ({ productCode, quantity })),
        useWallet,
        paymentMethod,
        createdAt,
        createdBy,
        reference: status === 'draft' ? null : `RZP-${purchaseNumber.slice(4)}`,
      })
    })
  }
  return store
}
 
const toListItem = (purchase) => ({
  purchaseNumber: purchase.purchaseNumber,
  status: purchase.status,
  customerCode: purchase.customer.code,
  customerName: purchase.customer.name,
  createdAt: purchase.createdAt,
  createdBy: purchase.createdBy,
  products: purchase.summary.products,
  units: purchase.summary.units,
  grossAmount: purchase.summary.grossAmount,
  payable: purchase.summary.payable,
  paymentLabel: purchase.paymentLabel,
  reference: purchase.reference,
})
 
/** PUR-<MMDD>-<NN>: the next free draft number for the fixture day. */
function nextPurchaseNumber() {
  const [day, month] = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata', day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit' })
    .format(new Date(FIXTURE_NOW))
    .split('/')
  const prefix = `PUR-${month}${day}-`
  const used = purchases()
    .filter((purchase) => purchase.purchaseNumber.startsWith(prefix))
    .map((purchase) => Number(purchase.purchaseNumber.slice(prefix.length)))
  return `${prefix}${String(Math.max(0, ...used) + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`
}
 
function findPurchase(purchaseNumber) {
  const purchase = purchases().find((entry) => entry.purchaseNumber === purchaseNumber)
  if (!purchase) throw new MockHttpError(404, `Purchase ${purchaseNumber} was not found.`)
  return purchase
}
 
const failValidation = (message, errors = {}) => {
  throw new MockHttpError(422, message, { message, errors })
}
 
export const adminPurchaseHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/purchases/draft', ({ headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: { purchaseNumber: nextPurchaseNumber(), createdBy: admin.name, paymentMethods: PAYMENT_METHODS } }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/purchases/customers', ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    // The field shows "CUS00128 · Aditi Sharma" after a pick; only the part before the dot is a search term.
    const term = String(query.q ?? '').split('·')[0].trim()
    if (term.length < 2) return { data: { items: [] } }
    const items = db.customers
      .filter((customer) => matchesText(term, customer.code, customer.name, customer.mobile, customer.email))
      .slice(0, 5)
      .map(toCustomerView)
    return { data: { items } }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/purchases/products', ({ headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const items = db.products
      .filter((product) => !product.deletedAt && product.status === 'active' && product.stock > 0)
      .map((product) => ({ code: product.code, name: product.name, unit: product.unit, stock: product.stock }))
    return { data: { items } }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/admin/purchases/quote', ({ body, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const { customer, address } = resolveCustomerAndAddress(body ?? {})
    return { data: priceLines({ customer, address, lines: body.lines, useWallet: Boolean(body.useWallet) }) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/purchases', ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const matching = purchases().filter(
      (purchase) =>
        (!query.status || query.status === 'all' || purchase.status === query.status) &&
        matchesText(query.q, purchase.purchaseNumber, purchase.customer.name, purchase.customer.code, purchase.reference),
    )
    const sorted = sortBy(matching, query.sort ?? '-createdAt', {
      grossAmount: (purchase) => purchase.summary.grossAmount,
      customerName: (purchase) => purchase.customer.name,
    })
    const page = paginate(sorted, query)
    return { data: { ...page, items: page.items.map(toListItem), statusOptions: PURCHASE_STATUS_OPTIONS } }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/purchases/:purchaseNumber', ({ params, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: findPurchase(params.purchaseNumber) }
  }),
 
  // Saves a draft, or submits it: "submit" records a pending payment request (simulated).
  defineHandler('post', '/admin/purchases', ({ body, headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    const input = body ?? {}
    const submitting = input.action === 'submit'
    const { customer, address } = resolveCustomerAndAddress(input)
    const lines = Array.isArray(input.lines) ? input.lines : []
    if (submitting && lines.length === 0) failValidation('Add at least one item.', { lines: 'Add at least one item.' })
    if (!PAYMENT_METHODS.some((method) => method.value === input.paymentMethod)) failValidation('Choose a payment method.', { paymentMethod: 'Choose a payment method.' })
 
    const priced = priceLines({ customer, address, lines, useWallet: Boolean(input.useWallet) })
    if (submitting && !priced.delivery.serviceable) failValidation(`PIN ${address.pin} is not serviceable.`)
    if (submitting && !priced.availability.allAvailable) failValidation(priced.availability.message)
 
    const existing = purchases().find((entry) => entry.purchaseNumber === input.purchaseNumber)
    if (existing && existing.status !== 'draft') throw new MockHttpError(409, `${existing.purchaseNumber} can no longer be edited.`)
 
    const purchaseNumber = existing?.purchaseNumber ?? input.purchaseNumber ?? nextPurchaseNumber()
    const record = buildRecord({
      purchaseNumber,
      status: submitting ? 'payment_pending' : 'draft',
      customer,
      address,
      lines,
      useWallet: Boolean(input.useWallet),
      paymentMethod: input.paymentMethod,
      createdAt: existing?.createdAt ?? FIXTURE_NOW,
      createdBy: existing?.createdBy ?? admin.name,
      reference: submitting ? `RZP-${purchaseNumber.slice(4)}` : null,
    })
    record.updatedAt = FIXTURE_NOW
 
    if (existing) Object.assign(existing, record)
    else purchases().unshift(record)
    return { status: existing ? 200 : 201, data: record }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/admin/purchases/:purchaseNumber/cancel', ({ params, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const purchase = findPurchase(params.purchaseNumber)
    if (!OPEN_STATUSES.includes(purchase.status)) throw new MockHttpError(409, `${purchase.purchaseNumber} is ${purchase.status.replace('_', ' ')} and can no longer be cancelled.`)
    purchase.status = 'cancelled'
    purchase.updatedAt = FIXTURE_NOW
    return { data: toListItem(purchase) }
  }),
]
