## `src/mocks/handlers/adminModules/customerHandlers.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — admin customer management for the mock API.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: paths, query parameters and payloads (see features/customers/services).
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, getCustomerByCode, ordersOfCustomer } from '@/mocks/db'
import { requireAdmin } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
import { round2 } from '@/mocks/lib/quote'
import { matchesText, sortBy } from '@/mocks/lib/paginate'
import { listResponse } from './shared'
import { toOrderListItem } from './orderHandlers'
 
// The db marks every customer active; two are shown as inactive so the status filter has something to find.
const INACTIVE_CODES = new Set(['CUS00111', 'CUS00137'])
 
const present = (customer) => ({
  code: customer.code,
  name: customer.name,
  email: customer.email,
  mobile: customer.mobile,
  city: customer.city,
  state: customer.state,
  pin: customer.pin,
  // ordersCount, totalSpend and walletBalance are backend aggregates (static in the mock db).
  ordersCount: customer.ordersCount,
  totalSpend: customer.totalSpend,
  walletBalance: customer.walletBalance,
  status: INACTIVE_CODES.has(customer.code) ? 'inactive' : customer.status,
  joinedAt: customer.joinedAt,
})
 
const SORT = {
  joinedAt: (customer) => new Date(customer.joinedAt).getTime(),
}
 
const newestFirst = (a, b) => new Date(b.placedAt) - new Date(a.placedAt)
 
/** Stored wallet transactions, or a plausible ledger that adds up to the balance for customers with none. */
function ledgerEntries(customer) {
  const stored = db.walletTransactions.filter((transaction) => transaction.customerId === customer.id)
  if (stored.length > 0) return stored
  if (customer.walletBalance <= 0) return []
  const bonus = Math.min(customer.walletBalance, 50)
  const cashback = round2(customer.walletBalance - bonus)
  const latestOrder = ordersOfCustomer(customer.id).filter((order) => order.status === 'delivered').sort(newestFirst)[0]
  const entries = [{ id: `wtx_${customer.code}_1`, customerId: customer.id, type: 'credit', amount: bonus, reason: 'Welcome bonus', reference: null, at: customer.joinedAt }]
  if (cashback > 0) {
    entries.push({
      id: `wtx_${customer.code}_2`,
      customerId: customer.id,
      type: 'credit',
      amount: cashback,
      reason: latestOrder ? `Cashback on order ${latestOrder.orderNumber}` : 'Cashback',
      reference: latestOrder?.orderNumber ?? null,
      at: latestOrder?.placedAt ?? customer.joinedAt,
    })
  }
  return entries
}
 
function walletLedger(customer) {
  let balance = 0
  return [...ledgerEntries(customer)]
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.at) - new Date(b.at))
    .map((entry) => {
      balance = round2(balance + (entry.type === 'credit' ? entry.amount : -entry.amount))
      return { ...entry, balanceAfter: balance }
    })
    .reverse()
}
 
function buildList(query) {
  const all = db.customers.map(present)
  const matching = all.filter(
    (customer) =>
      matchesText(query.q, customer.name, customer.code, customer.mobile, customer.email, customer.city) &&
      (!query.status || customer.status === query.status) &&
      (!query.city || customer.city === query.city) &&
      (!query.wallet || (query.wallet === 'with' ? customer.walletBalance > 0 : customer.walletBalance === 0)),
  )
  return listResponse(sortBy(matching, query.sort || 'code', SORT), query, {
    counts: {
      all: all.length,
      active: all.filter((customer) => customer.status === 'active').length,
      inactive: all.filter((customer) => customer.status === 'inactive').length,
      withWallet: all.filter((customer) => customer.walletBalance > 0).length,
    },
    facets: { cities: [...new Set(all.map((customer) => customer.city).filter(Boolean))].sort() },
  })
}
 
function buildDetail(code) {
  const raw = getCustomerByCode(code)
  if (!raw) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Customer not found.')
  const customer = present(raw)
  const orders = [...ordersOfCustomer(raw.id)].sort(newestFirst)
  return {
    customer,
    stats: {
      ordersCount: customer.ordersCount,
      totalSpend: customer.totalSpend,
      walletBalance: customer.walletBalance,
      averageOrderValue: customer.ordersCount > 0 ? round2(customer.totalSpend / customer.ordersCount) : 0,
      lastOrderAt: orders[0]?.placedAt ?? null,
    },
    addresses: db.addresses[raw.id] ?? [],
    walletTransactions: walletLedger(raw),
    recentOrders: orders.slice(0, 6).map(toOrderListItem),
  }
}
 
export const customerHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/customers', ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: buildList(query) }
  }),
 
  // Registered before `:code` so "options" is not read as a customer code.
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/customers/options', ({ headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: { items: sortBy(db.customers, 'name').map((customer) => ({ code: customer.code, name: customer.name })) } }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/customers/:code', ({ params, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: buildDetail(params.code) }
  }),
]
```
 
## `src/mocks/handlers/adminModules/orderHandlers.js`
 
  
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — admin order management for the mock API. Read-only except cancelling a new or to-pick order;
// every other fulfilment step (verify, pick, pack, dispatch) belongs to the Store Operation endpoints.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: paths, query parameters, payloads and the cancellation rule.
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, getCustomer, getOrder, withLineImages } from '@/mocks/db'
import { requireAdmin } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
import { matchesText, sortBy } from '@/mocks/lib/paginate'
import { buildCustomerTimeline } from '@/mocks/lib/timeline'
import { inRange, listResponse, nowIso, resolveRange } from './shared'
 
const CANCELLABLE = ['new', 'to_pick']
const CANCEL_REASONS = ['customer_request', 'payment_issue', 'out_of_stock', 'duplicate_order', 'other']
 
/** The Store Operation tab an order currently sits in (ASSUMPTION: tab keys follow the design's tab names). */
function fulfilmentTab(order) {
  if (order.delay) return 'delayed'
  const tabs = {
    new: 'new-orders',
    to_pick: 'to-pick',
    to_pack: 'to-pack',
    packed: 'ready-to-dispatch',
    dispatched: 'dispatched',
    in_transit: 'dispatched',
    out_for_delivery: 'dispatched',
    delivered: 'dispatched',
    returned: 'dispatched',
  }
  return tabs[order.status] ?? null
}
 
/** The row shown in admin order lists (and in a customer's recent orders). */
export const toOrderListItem = (order) => ({
  orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
  placedAt: order.placedAt,
  customerCode: order.customerCode,
  customerName: order.customerName,
  customerMobile: order.customerMobile,
  units: order.summary.units,
  grossAmount: order.summary.grossAmount,
  walletApplied: order.summary.walletApplied,
  payable: order.summary.payable,
  paymentStatus: order.paymentStatus,
  paymentMethod: order.paymentMethod,
  status: order.status,
  delayed: Boolean(order.delay),
  onHold: order.onHold,
})
 
const SORT = {
  placedAt: (order) => new Date(order.placedAt).getTime(),
  grossAmount: (order) => order.grossAmount,
}
 
function buildList(query) {
  const range = resolveRange(query, 'all')
  const base = db.orders.filter(
    (order) =>
      inRange(order.placedAt, range) &&
      (!query.payment || order.paymentStatus === query.payment) &&
      matchesText(query.q, order.orderNumber, order.customerName, order.customerCode, order.customerMobile),
  )
  const counts = { all: base.length }
  base.forEach((order) => {
    counts[order.status] = (counts[order.status] ?? 0) + 1
  })
  const rows = base.filter((order) => !query.status || order.status === query.status).map(toOrderListItem)
  return listResponse(sortBy(rows, query.sort || '-placedAt', SORT), query, { counts })
}
 
/** Orders cancelled before a refund was recorded still show one: the paid amount back to the payment method. */
function refundOf(order) {
  if (order.refund) return order.refund
  if (order.status !== 'cancelled' || order.paymentStatus !== 'refunded') return null
  return { amount: order.summary.payable, to: 'original payment method', at: order.timestamps.cancelledAt ?? order.placedAt, reason: null, walletAmount: order.summary.walletApplied }
}
 
function buildDetail(orderNumber) {
  const order = getOrder(orderNumber)
  if (!order) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Order not found.')
  return {
    ...withLineImages(order),
    timeline: buildCustomerTimeline(order),
    refund: refundOf(order),
    canCancel: CANCELLABLE.includes(order.status),
    fulfilmentTab: fulfilmentTab(order),
  }
}
 
function cancelOrder(orderNumber, body) {
  const order = getOrder(orderNumber)
  if (!order) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Order not found.')
  if (!CANCELLABLE.includes(order.status)) {
    throw new MockHttpError(409, 'Only new or to-pick orders can be cancelled. Later orders are handled in Store Operation.')
  }
  if (!CANCEL_REASONS.includes(body?.reason)) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Choose a reason for the cancellation.')
 
  const at = nowIso()
  const paid = order.paymentStatus === 'paid'
  order.status = 'cancelled'
  order.onHold = false
  order.delay = null
  order.timestamps.cancelledAt = at
  if (paid) {
    order.paymentStatus = 'refunded'
    order.refund = { amount: order.summary.payable, to: 'original payment method', at, reason: body.reason, walletAmount: order.summary.walletApplied }
    // The part paid from the wallet goes back to the wallet; the rest returns through Razorpay.
    const customer = getCustomer(order.customerId)
    if (customer && order.summary.walletApplied > 0) {
      customer.walletBalance += order.summary.walletApplied
      db.walletTransactions.push({
        id: `wtx_${order.orderNumber}_refund`,
        customerId: customer.id,
        type: 'credit',
        amount: order.summary.walletApplied,
        reason: `Refund · order ${order.orderNumber}`,
        reference: order.orderNumber,
        at,
      })
    }
  }
  return buildDetail(orderNumber)
}
 
export const orderHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/orders', ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: buildList(query) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/orders/:orderNumber', ({ params, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: buildDetail(params.orderNumber) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/admin/orders/:orderNumber/cancel', ({ params, body, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: cancelOrder(params.orderNumber, body) }
  }),
]
```
 
## `src/mocks/handlers/adminModules/reportHandlers.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — reports overview and financial report for the mock API.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: paths, query parameters and payloads (see endpointGroups/adminModules.js
// and features/reports/services/reportService.js for the contract the screens expect).
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, getCustomer, getOrder, getProduct } from '@/mocks/db'
import {
  COMPARE_MODES,
  FEATURED_CUSTOMER_IDS,
  FEATURED_PRODUCTS,
  FINANCIAL_DEFAULTS,
  ORDER_STATUS_MIX,
  OVERVIEW_DEFAULTS,
} from '@/mocks/fixtures/reportsData'
import { requireAdmin } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
import { round2 } from '@/mocks/lib/quote'
import { matchesText, sortBy } from '@/mocks/lib/paginate'
import { addDays, addMonths, daysBetween, eachDay, inRange, listResponse, monthLabel, resolveRange } from './shared'
 
const sum = (values) => values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0)
 
// ── Daily sales curve ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// A deterministic, gently rising curve with weekly waves. It is calibrated once so the default period adds up
// to the design's ₹4,82,560; every other day keeps the same value whichever range is asked for.
const CURVE_ORIGIN = '2026-09-01'
const noise = (n) => {
  const x = Math.sin(n * 12.9898) * 43758.5453
  return (x - Math.floor(x)) * 2 - 1
}
const rawDaily = (iso) => {
  const n = daysBetween(CURVE_ORIGIN, iso)
  return Math.max(2500, 6500 + 260 * n + 1500 * Math.sin(n * 0.85) + 700 * noise(n))
}
 
const DEFAULT_RANGE = resolveRange({}, 'this_month')
const DEFAULT_DAYS = eachDay(DEFAULT_RANGE.from, DEFAULT_RANGE.to)
const CURVE_SCALE = OVERVIEW_DEFAULTS.grossSales / sum(DEFAULT_DAYS.map(rawDaily))
const ROUNDING_FIX = OVERVIEW_DEFAULTS.grossSales - sum(DEFAULT_DAYS.map((day) => Math.round(rawDaily(day) * CURVE_SCALE)))
const DEFAULT_ORDER_COUNT = Math.round(OVERVIEW_DEFAULTS.grossSales / OVERVIEW_DEFAULTS.averageOrderValue)
 
const dailyGross = (iso) => Math.round(rawDaily(iso) * CURVE_SCALE) + (iso === DEFAULT_RANGE.to ? ROUNDING_FIX : 0)
 
function comparisonDays(days, mode) {
  if (mode === 'previous_month') return days.map((day) => addMonths(day, -1))
  if (mode === 'last_year') return days.map((day) => addMonths(day, -12))
  return days.map((day) => addDays(day, -days.length))
}
 
/** Largest-remainder split of `total` in the proportions of `weights`, so the parts always add up. */
function allocate(total, weights) {
  const weightSum = sum(weights)
  const exact = weights.map((weight) => (weight * total) / weightSum)
  const parts = exact.map(Math.floor)
  exact
    .map((value, index) => [value - Math.floor(value), index])
    .sort((a, b) => b[0] - a[0])
    .slice(0, total - sum(parts))
    .forEach(([, index]) => (parts[index] += 1))
  return parts
}
 
const seriesLabels = (range, mode) => ({
  current: range.preset === 'this_month' ? 'This month' : 'This period',
  previous: { previous_month: range.preset === 'this_month' ? 'Last month' : 'Previous month', previous_period: 'Previous period', last_year: 'Last year' }[mode],
})
 
function overviewSeries(range, days, mode, grossSales) {
  const labels = seriesLabels(range, mode)
  const series = [{ key: 'current', label: labels.current, total: grossSales, points: days.map((day) => ({ date: day, value: dailyGross(day) })) }]
  if (!mode) return series
 
  const previousDays = comparisonDays(days, mode)
  const raw = previousDays.map(rawDaily)
  const target = grossSales / (1 + COMPARE_MODES[mode].grossGrowth / 100)
  const scale = target / sum(raw)
  const points = previousDays.map((day, index) => ({ date: day, value: Math.round(raw[index] * scale) }))
  series.push({ key: 'previous', label: labels.previous, total: sum(points.map((point) => point.value)), points })
  return series
}
 
// Units sold per product for the default period; products that are not featured get a stable made-up figure.
const unitsFor = (code) => {
  const featured = FEATURED_PRODUCTS.find((entry) => entry.code === code)
  if (featured) return featured.units
  return 30 + ([...code].reduce((total, char) => total + char.charCodeAt(0) * 7, 0) % 220)
}
 
function overviewCustomers(q) {
  if (!q) return FEATURED_CUSTOMER_IDS.map(getCustomer).filter(Boolean)
  return sortBy(db.customers.filter((customer) => matchesText(q, customer.name, customer.code)), '-totalSpend').slice(0, 5)
}
 
function overviewProducts(q, factor) {
  const pool = q
    ? db.products.filter((product) => matchesText(q, product.name, product.code)).slice(0, 5)
    : FEATURED_PRODUCTS.map((entry) => getProduct(entry.code))
  return pool.map((product) => {
    const units = Math.max(1, Math.round(unitsFor(product.code) * factor))
    return { code: product.code, name: product.name, units, grossSales: units * product.sellingPrice, stock: product.stock }
  })
}
 
function buildOverview(query) {
  const range = resolveRange(query, 'this_month')
  const days = eachDay(range.from, range.to)
  if (days.length > 366) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Choose a range of up to one year.')
  const mode = query.compare === 'none' ? null : (query.compare ?? 'previous_month')
  if (mode && !COMPARE_MODES[mode]) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Unknown comparison.')
 
  const grossSales = sum(days.map(dailyGross))
  const orders = Math.max(1, Math.round(grossSales / OVERVIEW_DEFAULTS.averageOrderValue))
  const factor = grossSales / OVERVIEW_DEFAULTS.grossSales
  const counts = orders === DEFAULT_ORDER_COUNT ? ORDER_STATUS_MIX.map((entry) => entry.count) : allocate(orders, ORDER_STATUS_MIX.map((entry) => entry.count))
  const percents = orders === DEFAULT_ORDER_COUNT ? ORDER_STATUS_MIX.map((entry) => entry.percent) : allocate(100, counts)
 
  return {
    period: {
      preset: range.preset,
      from: range.from,
      to: range.to,
      label: range.preset === 'this_month' || range.preset === 'last_month' ? monthLabel(range.from) : null,
    },
    compare: mode ? { key: mode, label: COMPARE_MODES[mode].label } : null,
    summary: {
      grossSales: { value: grossSales, changePercent: mode ? COMPARE_MODES[mode].grossGrowth : null },
      gstCollected: { value: round2((grossSales * OVERVIEW_DEFAULTS.gstCollected) / OVERVIEW_DEFAULTS.grossSales) },
      averageOrderValue: { value: round2(grossSales / orders), changePercent: mode ? COMPARE_MODES[mode].averageOrderValueGrowth : null },
      walletLiability: { value: OVERVIEW_DEFAULTS.walletLiability, customersWithBalance: OVERVIEW_DEFAULTS.customersWithBalance },
    },
    sales: { series: overviewSeries(range, days, mode, grossSales) },
    orderStatus: { totalOrders: orders, items: ORDER_STATUS_MIX.map((entry, index) => ({ key: entry.key, label: entry.label, count: counts[index], percent: percents[index] })) },
    customers: overviewCustomers(query.q).map((customer) => ({
      code: customer.code,
      name: customer.name,
      ordersCount: customer.ordersCount,
      totalSpend: customer.totalSpend,
      walletBalance: customer.walletBalance,
    })),
    products: overviewProducts(query.q, factor),
  }
}
 
// ── Financial report ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// One row per order line. Order-level shipping and wallet use are shown on the first line of each order, so an
// order's rows add up to its invoice without rounding drift.
function lineItems() {
  return db.orders.flatMap((order) =>
    order.lines.map((line, index) => {
      const cgst = order.summary.igst > 0 ? 0 : round2(line.gst / 2)
      const shipping = index === 0 ? order.summary.shipping : 0
      const wallet = index === 0 ? order.summary.walletApplied : 0
      return {
        id: `${order.orderNumber}-${line.productCode}`,
        orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
        orderDate: order.placedAt,
        customerCode: order.customerCode,
        customerName: order.customerName,
        productCode: line.productCode,
        productName: line.name,
        hsn: line.hsn,
        gstPercent: line.gstPercent,
        quantity: line.quantity,
        taxable: line.taxable,
        gst: line.gst,
        cgst,
        sgst: order.summary.igst > 0 ? 0 : round2(line.gst - cgst),
        igst: order.summary.igst > 0 ? line.gst : 0,
        shipping,
        wallet,
        lineTotal: line.lineTotal,
        net: round2(line.lineTotal + shipping - wallet),
        status: order.status,
      }
    }),
  )
}
 
const FINANCIAL_SORT = {
  orderDate: (row) => new Date(row.orderDate).getTime(),
  customerName: (row) => row.customerName,
  quantity: (row) => row.quantity,
  taxable: (row) => row.taxable,
  gst: (row) => row.gst,
  lineTotal: (row) => row.lineTotal,
}
 
function financialSummary(rows, unfiltered) {
  if (unfiltered) return FINANCIAL_DEFAULTS
  const taxableValue = round2(sum(rows.map((row) => row.taxable)))
  const gstTotal = round2(sum(rows.map((row) => row.gst)))
  const shippingTotal = round2(sum(rows.map((row) => row.shipping)))
  return {
    orders: new Set(rows.map((row) => row.orderNumber)).size,
    lineItems: rows.length,
    taxableValue,
    gstTotal,
    shippingTotal,
    grossAmount: round2(taxableValue + gstTotal + shippingTotal),
    walletUsed: round2(sum(rows.map((row) => row.wallet))),
  }
}
 
function buildFinancialReport(query) {
  const range = resolveRange(query, 'this_month')
  const rows = lineItems().filter(
    (row) =>
      inRange(row.orderDate, range) &&
      (!query.status || row.status === query.status) &&
      (!query.customer || row.customerCode === query.customer) &&
      matchesText(query.q, row.orderNumber, row.customerName, row.customerCode, row.productCode, row.productName, row.hsn),
  )
  // Only the unfiltered default period reports the design's backend aggregates; any narrower view is
  // summed from its own rows so the cards always describe what the table lists.
  const unfiltered = range.preset === 'this_month' && !query.status && !query.customer && !query.q
  return listResponse(
    sortBy(rows, query.sort || '-orderDate', FINANCIAL_SORT),
    query,
    { period: { preset: range.preset, from: range.from, to: range.to }, summary: financialSummary(rows, unfiltered) },
    4,
  )
}
 
function buildReconciliation(orderNumber) {
  const order = getOrder(orderNumber)
  if (!order) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Order not found.')
  const s = order.summary
  const customer = getCustomer(order.customerId)
  const closing = customer?.walletBalance ?? 0
  const balanced =
    Math.abs(round2(s.taxableSubtotal + s.gstTotal + s.shipping) - s.grossAmount) < 0.01 &&
    Math.abs(round2(s.grossAmount - s.couponDiscount - s.walletApplied) - s.payable) < 0.01
  return {
    orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
    reconciliation: {
      taxable: s.taxableSubtotal,
      gst: s.gstTotal,
      shipping: s.shipping,
      gross: s.grossAmount,
      wallet: s.walletApplied,
      gateway: s.payable,
      gatewayLabel: 'Razorpay',
      balanced,
    },
    wallet: { customerCode: order.customerCode, opening: round2(closing + s.walletApplied), used: s.walletApplied, closing },
  }
}
 
export const reportHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/reports/overview', ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: buildOverview(query) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/reports/financial', ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: buildFinancialReport(query) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/reports/financial/orders/:orderNumber', ({ params, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: buildReconciliation(params.orderNumber) }
  }),
]
```
 
## `src/mocks/handlers/adminModules/restockHandlers.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — low and out-of-stock list for the mock API.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: the path, query parameters, payload and the reorder-quantity rule.
// The suggested quantity is a backend decision; the rule here (about three times the reorder level, in packs
// of six) is only a stand-in so the screen has realistic numbers to show.
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, getProduct } from '@/mocks/db'
import { FIXTURE_NOW } from '@/mocks/fixtures/clock'
import { requireAdmin } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
import { matchesText, sortBy } from '@/mocks/lib/paginate'
import { listResponse } from './shared'
 
const PACK_SIZE = 6
 
/** Open restock requests raised during this session (resets on reload): [{ id, requestedAt, items }]. */
const requests = []
const requestedQuantity = (productCode) =>
  requests.reduce((total, request) => total + (request.items.find((item) => item.productCode === productCode)?.quantity ?? 0), 0)
 
const levelOf = (product) => (product.stock === 0 ? 'out' : 'low')
 
const suggestedQuantity = (product) => Math.ceil((product.lowStockThreshold * 3 - product.stock) / PACK_SIZE) * PACK_SIZE
 
const toItem = (product) => ({
  productCode: product.code,
  name: product.name,
  unit: product.unit,
  category: product.category,
  categoryLabel: product.categoryLabel,
  thumbnail: product.thumbnail,
  bin: product.bin,
  stock: product.stock,
  lowStockThreshold: product.lowStockThreshold,
  level: levelOf(product),
  suggestedQuantity: suggestedQuantity(product),
  requestedQuantity: requestedQuantity(product.code),
})
 
// Out of stock first, then the emptiest shelves.
const byUrgency = (a, b) => (a.level === b.level ? a.stock - b.stock : a.level === 'out' ? -1 : 1)
 
function buildList(query) {
  const base = db.products
    .filter((product) => product.stock <= product.lowStockThreshold)
    .map(toItem)
    .filter((item) => (!query.category || item.category === query.category) && matchesText(query.q, item.productCode, item.name))
  const counts = { all: base.length, low: base.filter((item) => item.level === 'low').length, out: base.filter((item) => item.level === 'out').length }
  const rows = base.filter((item) => !query.level || item.level === query.level)
  const sorted = query.sort ? sortBy(rows, query.sort) : [...rows].sort(byUrgency)
  return listResponse(sorted, query, { counts }, 12)
}
 
export const restockHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/restock', ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: buildList(query) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/admin/restock/requests', ({ body, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const items = (body?.items ?? []).map((item) => ({ productCode: item.productCode, quantity: Math.floor(Number(item.quantity)) }))
    if (items.length === 0 || items.some((item) => !getProduct(item.productCode) || !(item.quantity >= 1))) {
      throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Choose at least one product and a whole-number quantity of 1 or more.')
    }
    const request = { id: `RST-${String(requests.length + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`, status: 'requested', requestedAt: FIXTURE_NOW, items }
    requests.push(request)
    return { status: 201, data: request }
  }),
]

## `src/mocks/handlers/adminModules/shared.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — helpers shared by the admin module mock handlers (reports, customers, users, orders, restock).
// The real backend owns date ranges, paging and filtering; every shape here is an ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team.
import { MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { FIXTURE_NOW } from '@/mocks/fixtures/clock'
import { paginate } from '@/mocks/lib/paginate'
 
const IST = 'Asia/Kolkata'
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000
const ISO_DATE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/
 
/** The calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD, India time) of a timestamp. */
export const istDate = (value) => new Date(value).toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: IST })
 
/** "Today" for the fixture clock. */
export const TODAY = istDate(FIXTURE_NOW)
 
/** The fixture clock as an ISO timestamp, for records the handlers create. */
export const nowIso = () => new Date(FIXTURE_NOW).toISOString()
 
const toUtc = (iso) => {
  const [year, month, day] = iso.split('-').map(Number)
  return new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day))
}
const toIso = (date) => date.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
 
export const addDays = (iso, days) => toIso(new Date(toUtc(iso).getTime() + days * DAY_MS))
 
export function addMonths(iso, months) {
  const date = toUtc(iso)
  const day = date.getUTCDate()
  date.setUTCDate(1)
  date.setUTCMonth(date.getUTCMonth() + months)
  const lastDay = new Date(Date.UTC(date.getUTCFullYear(), date.getUTCMonth() + 1, 0)).getUTCDate()
  date.setUTCDate(Math.min(day, lastDay))
  return toIso(date)
}
 
const monthStart = (iso) => `${iso.slice(0, 8)}01`
const monthEnd = (iso) => addDays(addMonths(monthStart(iso), 1), -1)
 
export const daysBetween = (from, to) => Math.round((toUtc(to) - toUtc(from)) / DAY_MS)
 
/** Every calendar day from `from` to `to` inclusive. */
export const eachDay = (from, to) => Array.from({ length: daysBetween(from, to) + 1 }, (_, index) => addDays(from, index))
 
export const monthLabel = (iso) => toUtc(iso).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' })
 
const PRESETS = {
  today: () => [TODAY, TODAY],
  yesterday: () => [addDays(TODAY, -1), addDays(TODAY, -1)],
  last_7_days: () => [addDays(TODAY, -6), TODAY],
  last_30_days: () => [addDays(TODAY, -29), TODAY],
  this_month: () => [monthStart(TODAY), TODAY],
  last_month: () => [monthStart(addMonths(TODAY, -1)), monthEnd(addMonths(TODAY, -1))],
}
 
/**
 * Turns the `range` preset (or `range=custom` with `from` and `to`) of a query into
 * { preset, from, to }, or null for `range=all`. The backend, not the browser, knows what "today" is.
 */
export function resolveRange({ range, from, to }, fallback) {
  const key = range || fallback
  if (key === 'all') return null
  if (key === 'custom') {
    if (!ISO_DATE.test(from ?? '') || !ISO_DATE.test(to ?? '')) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Choose both a start and an end date.')
    if (from > to) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'The start date must be on or before the end date.')
    return { preset: 'custom', from, to }
  }
  const preset = PRESETS[key]
  if (!preset) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Unknown date range.')
  const [start, end] = preset()
  return { preset: key, from: start, to: end }
}
 
export const inRange = (timestamp, range) => {
  if (!range) return true
  const day = istDate(timestamp)
  return day >= range.from && day <= range.to
}
 
/** The paging envelope every admin list returns. */
export function listResponse(items, query, extra = {}, defaultPageSize = 10) {
  return { ...paginate(items, { page: query.page, pageSize: query.pageSize ?? defaultPageSize }), ...extra }
}

## `src/mocks/handlers/adminModules/userRoleHandlers.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — admin users and roles for the mock API. State lives in this module and resets on reload.
// Permissions are display and editing only: nothing here authorises a request. Authorization is backend work.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: paths, payloads, the validation rules and the error body
// `{ message, errors: { field: message } }` used for field-level problems.
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { buildRoles, buildUsers, PERMISSION_MODULES } from '@/mocks/fixtures/adminUsers'
import { requireAdmin } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
import { matchesText, sortBy } from '@/mocks/lib/paginate'
import { listResponse, nowIso } from './shared'
 
const state = { users: buildUsers(), roles: buildRoles() }
 
const ACCESS_LEVELS = ['none', 'read', 'write']
const MODULE_KEYS = PERMISSION_MODULES.map((module) => module.key)
const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/
 
const fieldError = (status, field, message) => new MockHttpError(status, message, { message, errors: { [field]: message } })
 
const findRole = (id) => state.roles.find((role) => role.id === id)
const findUser = (id) => {
  const user = state.users.find((entry) => entry.id === id)
  if (!user) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'User not found.')
  return user
}
const usersWithRole = (roleId) => state.users.filter((user) => user.roleId === roleId).length
 
const presentUser = (user) => ({ ...user, roleName: findRole(user.roleId)?.name ?? '—' })
const presentRole = (role) => ({ ...role, usersCount: usersWithRole(role.id) })
 
// ── Users ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function readUserBody(body, { id } = {}) {
  const name = String(body?.name ?? '').trim()
  const email = String(body?.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()
  const mobile = String(body?.mobile ?? '').trim()
  if (!name) throw fieldError(422, 'name', 'Enter the full name.')
  if (!EMAIL.test(email)) throw fieldError(422, 'email', 'Enter a valid email address.')
  if (state.users.some((user) => user.email === email && user.id !== id)) throw fieldError(409, 'email', 'Another user already has this email address.')
  if (!findRole(body?.roleId)) throw fieldError(422, 'roleId', 'Choose a role.')
  if (!['active', 'inactive'].includes(body?.status)) throw fieldError(422, 'status', 'Choose a status.')
  return { name, email, mobile, roleId: body.roleId, status: body.status }
}
 
function buildUserList(query) {
  const rows = state.users
    .map(presentUser)
    .filter(
      (user) =>
        matchesText(query.q, user.name, user.email, user.mobile) &&
        (!query.role || user.roleId === query.role) &&
        (!query.status || user.status === query.status),
    )
  const sorted = sortBy(rows, query.sort || 'name', { lastActiveAt: (user) => (user.lastActiveAt ? new Date(user.lastActiveAt).getTime() : 0) })
  return listResponse(sorted, query, { counts: { all: state.users.length, active: state.users.filter((user) => user.status === 'active').length } })
}
 
// ── Roles ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function readPermissions(permissions) {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    MODULE_KEYS.map((key) => {
      const level = permissions?.[key] ?? 'none'
      if (!ACCESS_LEVELS.includes(level)) throw new MockHttpError(422, `Unknown access level for ${key}.`)
      return [key, level]
    }),
  )
}
 
function readRoleName(body, { id } = {}) {
  const name = String(body?.name ?? '').trim()
  if (!name) throw fieldError(422, 'name', 'Enter a role name.')
  if (name.length > 40) throw fieldError(422, 'name', 'Use 40 characters or fewer.')
  if (state.roles.some((role) => role.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase() && role.id !== id)) {
    throw fieldError(409, 'name', 'A role with this name already exists.')
  }
  return name
}
 
function editableRole(id) {
  const role = findRole(id)
  if (!role) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Role not found.')
  if (role.system) throw new MockHttpError(409, 'The Administrator role is built in and cannot be changed or deleted.')
  return role
}
 
export const userRoleHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/users', ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: buildUserList(query) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/admin/users', ({ body, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const user = { id: `adm_${Date.now().toString(36)}`, ...readUserBody(body), lastActiveAt: null, createdAt: nowIso() }
    state.users.push(user)
    return { status: 201, data: presentUser(user) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('put', '/admin/users/:id', ({ params, body, headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    const user = findUser(params.id)
    const next = readUserBody(body, { id: user.id })
    if (user.id === admin.id && next.status === 'inactive') throw new MockHttpError(409, "You can't deactivate your own account.")
    Object.assign(user, next)
    return { data: presentUser(user) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('patch', '/admin/users/:id/status', ({ params, body, headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    const user = findUser(params.id)
    if (!['active', 'inactive'].includes(body?.status)) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Choose a status.')
    if (user.id === admin.id && body.status === 'inactive') throw new MockHttpError(409, "You can't deactivate your own account.")
    user.status = body.status
    return { data: presentUser(user) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('delete', '/admin/users/:id', ({ params, headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    const user = findUser(params.id)
    if (user.id === admin.id) throw new MockHttpError(409, "You can't delete your own account.")
    state.users = state.users.filter((entry) => entry.id !== user.id)
    return { status: 204, data: null }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/roles', ({ headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: { items: state.roles.map(presentRole), modules: PERMISSION_MODULES } }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/admin/roles', ({ body, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const name = readRoleName(body)
    const source = body?.copyFrom ? findRole(body.copyFrom) : null
    const role = {
      id: `role_${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
      name,
      description: String(body?.description ?? '').trim().slice(0, 120),
      system: false,
      permissions: readPermissions(source?.permissions),
      updatedAt: nowIso(),
    }
    state.roles.push(role)
    return { status: 201, data: presentRole(role) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('put', '/admin/roles/:id', ({ params, body, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const role = editableRole(params.id)
    if (body?.name !== undefined) role.name = readRoleName(body, { id: role.id })
    if (body?.description !== undefined) role.description = String(body.description).trim().slice(0, 120)
    if (body?.permissions !== undefined) role.permissions = readPermissions(body.permissions)
    role.updatedAt = nowIso()
    return { data: presentRole(role) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('delete', '/admin/roles/:id', ({ params, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const role = editableRole(params.id)
    const assigned = usersWithRole(role.id)
    if (assigned > 0) throw new MockHttpError(409, `Reassign the ${assigned} ${assigned === 1 ? 'user' : 'users'} with this role before deleting it.`)
    state.roles = state.roles.filter((entry) => entry.id !== role.id)
    return { status: 204, data: null }
  }),
]

## `src/mocks/handlers/auth.js`
 
```javascript
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, ensureCustomer } from '@/mocks/db'
import { DEMO_PASSWORD } from '@/mocks/fixtures/users'
 
const normalizeIdentifier = (value = '') => String(value).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[\s-]/g, '').replace(/^\+?91(?=\d{10}$)/, '')
 
const publicUser = ({ id, name, email, mobile, role }) => ({ id, name, email, mobile, role })
const toSession = (account) => ({ user: publicUser(account), accessToken: `mock-token-${account.id}` })
 
export const authHandlers = [
  defineHandler('post', '/auth/login', ({ body }) => {
    const identifier = normalizeIdentifier(body?.identifier)
    const account = db.accounts.find((candidate) => candidate.email.toLowerCase() === identifier || candidate.mobile === identifier)
    if (!account || (account.password ?? DEMO_PASSWORD) !== body?.password) {
      throw new MockHttpError(401, 'Incorrect mobile number, email or password.')
    }
    if (body?.scope === 'admin' && account.role !== 'admin') {
      throw new MockHttpError(403, 'This account does not have admin access.')
    }
    return { data: toSession(account) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/auth/logout', () => ({ status: 204 })),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/auth/mobile-availability', ({ query }) => {
    const mobile = normalizeIdentifier(query.mobile)
    return { data: { mobile, available: !db.accounts.some((account) => account.mobile === mobile) } }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/auth/signup', ({ body }) => {
    const mobile = normalizeIdentifier(body?.mobile)
    if (db.accounts.some((account) => account.mobile === mobile)) {
      throw new MockHttpError(409, 'An account with this mobile number already exists.')
    }
    const account = { id: `cus_${mobile}`, name: body.name, email: body.email, mobile, role: 'customer', password: body.password }
    db.accounts.push(account)
    ensureCustomer(account)
    return { status: 201, data: toSession(account) }
  }),
]

## `src/mocks/handlers/cart.js`
 
```javascript
import { defineHandler } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, getProduct, ordersOfCustomer } from '@/mocks/db'
import { fromNow } from '@/mocks/fixtures/clock'
import { SERVICEABLE_PINS, SHIPPING_METHOD } from '@/mocks/fixtures/serviceability'
import { getRequestUser } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
import { computeQuote } from '@/mocks/lib/quote'
 
/**
 * POST /cart/quote — the single source of every figure shown in the cart and checkout summary.
 * Body: { items: [{ productCode, quantity }], couponCode?, useWallet?, pin?, addressId? }
 * ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team (B-01, B-03, B-04): request and response shape.
 */
export const cartHandlers = [
  defineHandler('post', '/cart/quote', ({ body, headers }) => {
    const user = getRequestUser(headers)
    const customer = user?.role === 'customer' ? db.customers.find((entry) => entry.id === user.id) : null
 
    const address = customer && body?.addressId ? (db.addresses[customer.id] ?? []).find((entry) => entry.id === body.addressId) : null
    const pin = address?.pin ?? body?.pin ?? null
    const area = pin ? SERVICEABLE_PINS[pin] : null
 
    const lines = (body?.items ?? [])
      .map((item) => ({ product: getProduct(item.productCode), quantity: Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(item.quantity)) || 1) }))
      .filter((line) => line.product)
 
    const quote = computeQuote({
      lines,
      destinationState: address?.state ?? area?.state,
      useWallet: Boolean(body?.useWallet),
      walletBalance: customer?.walletBalance ?? 0,
      couponCode: body?.couponCode || undefined,
      hasPriorOrders: customer ? ordersOfCustomer(customer.id).length > 0 : false,
    })
 
    return {
      data: {
        ...quote,
        lines: quote.lines.map((line) => {
          const product = getProduct(line.productCode)
          return { ...line, categoryLabel: product.categoryLabel, image: product.thumbnail }
        }),
        delivery: {
          pin,
          serviceable: pin ? Boolean(area) : null,
          city: area?.city ?? null,
          method: SHIPPING_METHOD,
          fee: quote.summary.shipping,
          etaFrom: area ? fromNow({ days: area.etaMinDays }) : null,
          etaTo: area ? fromNow({ days: area.etaMaxDays }) : null,
        },
      },
    }
  }),
]

```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — storefront catalogue, offers and newsletter for the mock API. Not an integration.
//
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: every path, query parameter and response shape below.
// The backend owns filtering, sorting, paging, availability and the savings figure; the storefront

import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'

const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 12
const MAX_PURCHASE_QUANTITY = 10
const RELATED_COUNT = 4
 
// Curated merchandising lists for the home page. The backend would manage these.
const COLLECTIONS = {
  bestsellers: ['HL001', 'SH002', 'PC003', 'CO004'],
  'daily-care': ['SH002', 'PC003', 'CO004', 'PC006'],

// "A few more good things" on the flagship product page, as designed.
const CURATED_RELATED = { HL001: ['GR005', 'SH002', 'PC003', 'PC006'] }
 
// Extra photography for the flagship product page; the catalogue fixtures hold only card crops.
const HERO_IMAGES = { haldi: 'haldi-hero' }
 
// Sample reviews: one written for each category plus two general ones. The real review list is paged by the backend.
const CATEGORY_REVIEWS = {
  haldi: {
    quote: 'Beautiful colour and a lovely fresh aroma. A small pinch goes a long way in our everyday cooking.',
    author: 'Aditi Sharma',
    reviewedAt: '2026-10-20',
  },
  shampoo: {
    quote: 'Gentle on my scalp and the fragrance is lovely. My hair feels softer after just a couple of washes.',
    author: 'Rohit Verma',
    reviewedAt: '2026-10-18',
  },
  cosmetics: {
    quote: 'Comfortable all day and the colour is just right. It has become part of my daily routine.',
    author: 'Meera Nair',
    reviewedAt: '2026-10-22',
  },
  grocery: {
    quote: 'Fresh, clean and well packed. The quality is clearly better than what I used to buy.',
    author: 'Meera Nair',
    reviewedAt: '2026-10-19',
  },
  'personal-care': {
    quote: 'Light, kind to my skin and not sticky at all. I have already ordered it again.',
    author: 'Aditi Sharma',
    reviewedAt: '2026-10-21',
  },
}
 
const GENERAL_REVIEWS = [
  { quote: 'Arrived well packed and on time. Exactly as described, and good value for the price.', author: 'Rohit Verma', reviewedAt: '2026-10-15' },
  { quote: 'I have reordered twice now. Genuine product and honest pricing.', author: 'Meera Nair', reviewedAt: '2026-10-09' },
]
 
const CARE_NOTES = {
  haldi: 'Keep the pouch sealed after every use.',
  shampoo: 'Close the cap tightly after every use.',
  cosmetics: 'Close the cap tightly after every use.',
  grocery: 'Keep the pack sealed after every use.',
  'personal-care': 'Close the cap tightly after every use.',
}
 
const activeProducts = () => db.products.filter((product) => product.status === 'active')
 
function availabilityOf(product) {
  if (product.status !== 'active' || product.stock <= 0) return { stockStatus: 'out_of_stock', lowStockLeft: null }
  if (product.stock <= product.lowStockThreshold) return { stockStatus: 'low_stock', lowStockLeft: product.stock }
  return { stockStatus: 'in_stock', lowStockLeft: null }
}
 
function toListItem(product) {
  return {
    code: product.code,
    slug: product.slug,
    name: product.name,
    unit: product.unit,
    category: product.category,
    categoryLabel: product.categoryLabel,
    image: product.image,
    mrp: product.mrp,
    sellingPrice: product.sellingPrice,
    discountPercent: product.discountPercent,
    rating: product.rating,
    reviewCount: product.reviewCount,
    badge: product.badge,
    walletRewards: product.walletRewards,
    purchaseLimit: Math.max(0, Math.min(product.stock, MAX_PURCHASE_QUANTITY)),
    ...availabilityOf(product),
  }
}
 
// Hero shot first, then the detail shots (bowl, field…), then the product's card crops.
function galleryOf(product) {
  const hero = HERO_IMAGES[product.category] && productImage(HERO_IMAGES[product.category])
  const urls = [hero ?? product.thumbnail, ...product.gallery.slice(2), product.image, product.gallery[1]]
  return [...new Set(urls.filter(Boolean))].map((url, index) => ({ url, alt: `${product.name}, photo ${index + 1}` }))
}
 
function toDetail(product) {
  const variants = activeProducts()
    .filter((entry) => entry.group === product.group)
    .map((entry) => ({
      code: entry.code,
      slug: entry.slug,
      unit: entry.unit,
      mrp: entry.mrp,
      sellingPrice: entry.sellingPrice,
      stockStatus: availabilityOf(entry).stockStatus,
      isCurrent: entry.code === product.code,
    }))
 
  return {
    ...toListItem(product),
    tagline: product.tagline,
    description: product.description,
    ingredients: product.ingredients,
    netQuantity: product.unit,
    batch: product.batch,
    bestBefore: product.bestBefore,
    hsn: product.hsn,
    gstPercent: product.gstPercent,
    storage: product.storage,
    packedBy: product.packedBy,
    careNote: CARE_NOTES[product.category],
    availableQuantity: Math.max(0, product.stock),
    savings: product.mrp - product.sellingPrice,
    gallery: galleryOf(product),
    variants,
    reviews: {
      average: product.rating,
      count: product.reviewCount,
      highlights: [CATEGORY_REVIEWS[product.category], ...GENERAL_REVIEWS].map((review) => ({ ...review, verified: true })),
    },
  }
}
 
function parseNumber(value) {
  const parsed = Number(value)
  return value === undefined || value === '' || !Number.isFinite(parsed) ? null : parsed
}
 
// Every filter except category and price is applied here; those two are applied by the callers so
// the facets can be computed "as if" the facet's own filter were not set.
function applyBaseFilters(list, query) {
  const minDiscount = parseNumber(query.minDiscount)
  const minRating = parseNumber(query.minRating)
  const collection = COLLECTIONS[query.collection]
 
  return list.filter((product) => {
    if (!matchesText(query.q, product.name, product.categoryLabel, product.code, product.tagline)) return false
    if (collection && !collection.includes(product.code)) return false
    if (toFlag(query.inStock) && availabilityOf(product).stockStatus === 'out_of_stock') return false
    if (minDiscount !== null && product.discountPercent < minDiscount) return false
    if (minRating !== null && product.rating < minRating) return false
    if (toFlag(query.walletRewards) && !product.walletRewards) return false
    return true
  })
}
 
function applyPriceFilter(list, query) {
  const min = parseNumber(query.minPrice)
  const max = parseNumber(query.maxPrice)
  return list.filter((product) => (min === null || product.sellingPrice >= min) && (max === null || product.sellingPrice <= max))
}
 
const applyCategoryFilter = (list, category) => (category ? list.filter((product) => product.category === category) : list)
 
function sortProducts(list, query) {
  const collection = COLLECTIONS[query.collection]
  switch (query.sort) {
    case 'price_asc':
      return sortBy(list, 'sellingPrice')
    case 'price_desc':
      return sortBy(list, '-sellingPrice')
    case 'discount':
      return sortBy(list, '-discountPercent')
    case 'newest':
      return [...list].reverse()
    default:
      return collection ? [...list].sort((a, b) => collection.indexOf(a.code) - collection.indexOf(b.code)) : [...list]
  }
}
 
function buildFacets(base, query) {
  const withoutCategory = applyPriceFilter(base, query)
  const withoutPrice = applyCategoryFilter(base, query.category)
  const prices = withoutPrice.map((product) => product.sellingPrice)
  return {
    categories: db.categories.map((category) => ({
      slug: category.slug,
      name: category.name,
      count: withoutCategory.filter((product) => product.category === category.slug).length,
    })),
    priceBounds: prices.length ? { min: Math.floor(Math.min(...prices)), max: Math.ceil(Math.max(...prices)) } : { min: 0, max: 0 },
  }
}
 
function relatedTo(product) {
  const curated = CURATED_RELATED[product.code]
  const pool = activeProducts().filter((entry) => entry.group !== product.group && availabilityOf(entry).stockStatus !== 'out_of_stock')
  if (curated) return curated.map((code) => pool.find((entry) => entry.code === code)).filter(Boolean)
 
  // One product from each other category first, then more from the same category.
  const otherCategories = db.categories.filter((category) => category.slug !== product.category)
  const spread = otherCategories.map((category) => pool.find((entry) => entry.category === category.slug)).filter(Boolean)
  const sameCategory = pool.filter((entry) => entry.category === product.category)
  return [...spread, ...sameCategory].slice(0, RELATED_COUNT)
}
 
function offerFromCoupon(coupon) {
  return {
    code: coupon.code,
    title: coupon.percent
      ? `${coupon.percent}% off ${coupon.firstOrderOnly ? 'your first order' : 'your order'}`
      : `₹${coupon.flat} off your order`,
    description: coupon.description,
    maxDiscount: coupon.cap ?? null,
    minOrderValue: coupon.minItemsTotal,
    firstOrderOnly: coupon.firstOrderOnly,
  }
}
 
const EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/
 
export const catalogHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/categories', () => {
    const products = activeProducts()
    return {
      data: {
        items: db.categories.map((category) => ({
          slug: category.slug,
          name: category.name,
          description: category.description,
          image: category.image,
          productCount: products.filter((product) => product.category === category.slug).length,
        })),
      },
    }
  }),
 
  // Query: q, category, collection, minPrice, maxPrice, inStock, minDiscount, minRating, walletRewards,
  //        sort (recommended | price_asc | price_desc | discount | newest), page, pageSize.
  // Customers only ever see active products.
  defineHandler('get', '/products', ({ query }) => {
    const base = applyBaseFilters(activeProducts(), query)
    const matches = sortProducts(applyPriceFilter(applyCategoryFilter(base, query.category), query), query)
    const page = paginate(matches, { page: query.page, pageSize: query.pageSize ?? DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE })
    return { data: { ...page, items: page.items.map(toListItem), facets: buildFacets(base, query) } }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/products/:slug', ({ params }) => {
    const product = getProductBySlug(params.slug)
    if (!product || product.status !== 'active') throw new MockHttpError(404, 'This product is no longer available.')
    return { data: toDetail(product) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/products/:slug/related', ({ params }) => {
    const product = getProductBySlug(params.slug)
    if (!product || product.status !== 'active') throw new MockHttpError(404, 'This product is no longer available.')
    return { data: { items: relatedTo(product).map(toListItem) } }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/offers', () => ({
    data: { coupons: Object.values(COUPONS).map(offerFromCoupon), freeShippingThreshold: FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD },
  })),
 
  defineHandler('post', '/newsletter/subscriptions', ({ body }) => {
    const email = String(body?.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!EMAIL_PATTERN.test(email)) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Enter a valid email address.')
    return { status: 201, data: { email, status: 'subscribed' } }
  }),
]
```
 
## `src/mocks/handlers/checkout.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — checkout and payment handlers for the mock API (owned by the cart/checkout feature).
//
// Placing an order validates the cart with the same fake pricing rules as POST /cart/quote, debits the
// customer's wallet, and adds an order to `db.orders` in exactly the shape the fixtures use, so it shows
// up in the customer's order history and in the admin "New orders" queue. Payment is simulated end to
// end: nothing here talks to Razorpay and none of it is production-ready.
//
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: every path, payload and response below, and that
//  - the wallet is held (debited) when the order is placed and released if the order expires unpaid,
//  - an order awaits payment with paymentStatus "pending" ("failed" after a failed attempt),
//  - the backend rejects a stale `expectedPayable` with 409 so the customer never pays an unseen amount.
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, ensureCustomer, getOrder, getProduct, nextOrderNumber, ordersOfCustomer, withLineImages } from '@/mocks/db'
import { FIXTURE_NOW, fromNow } from '@/mocks/fixtures/clock'
import { SERVICEABLE_PINS, SHIPPING_METHOD } from '@/mocks/fixtures/serviceability'
import { requireUser } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
import { computeQuote, round2 } from '@/mocks/lib/quote'
 
const ASSIGNEES = ['Suresh Kumar', 'Anjali Singh', 'Aman Singh', 'Neha Joshi']
const PAYMENT_METHODS = { upi: 'UPI', card: 'Card', netbanking: 'Netbanking' }
 
// Payment sessions opened by this tab: { [sessionId]: { orderNumber, gatewayOrderId } }
const sessions = new Map()
 
function requireCustomer(headers) {
  const user = requireUser(headers)
  if (user.role !== 'customer') throw new MockHttpError(403, 'Only customer accounts can place orders.')
  return ensureCustomer(user)
}
 
function ownedOrder(customer, orderNumber) {
  const order = getOrder(orderNumber)
  if (!order || order.customerId !== customer.id) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Order not found.')
  return order
}
 
function readLines(items) {
  if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Your cart is empty.')
  return items.map((item) => {
    const product = getProduct(item?.productCode)
    if (!product || product.status !== 'active') throw new MockHttpError(409, 'An item in your cart is no longer available.')
    return { product, quantity: Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(item.quantity)) || 1) }
  })
}
 
function assertAvailable(quoteLines) {
  quoteLines.forEach((line) => {
    if (line.maxQuantity === 0) throw new MockHttpError(409, `${line.name} is out of stock. Remove it from your cart to continue.`)
    if (line.quantity > line.maxQuantity) {
      throw new MockHttpError(409, `You can order up to ${line.maxQuantity} of ${line.name}. Update the quantity to continue.`)
    }
  })
}
 
/** Marks the order paid and books what a paid order changes: the wallet debit and the customer's totals. */
function settleOrder(customer, order, razorpayPaymentId = null) {
  const { walletApplied, itemsTotal } = order.summary
  if (walletApplied > customer.walletBalance) {
    throw new MockHttpError(409, 'Your wallet balance changed since you last looked. Please review your order and try again.')
  }
 
  order.paymentStatus = 'paid'
  order.razorpayPaymentId = razorpayPaymentId
  customer.ordersCount += 1
  customer.totalSpend = round2(customer.totalSpend + itemsTotal)
  if (walletApplied > 0) {
    customer.walletBalance = round2(customer.walletBalance - walletApplied)
    db.walletTransactions.push({
      id: `wtx_${db.walletTransactions.length + 1}`,
      customerId: customer.id,
      type: 'debit',
      amount: walletApplied,
      reason: `Used on order ${order.orderNumber}`,
      reference: order.orderNumber,
      at: FIXTURE_NOW,
    })
  }
}
 
function nextQueueRank() {
  const ranks = db.orders.filter((order) => order.status === 'new').map((order) => order.fulfilment.queueRank)
  return Math.min(...ranks, 1) - 1
}
 
function buildOrder({ orderNumber, customer, contact, address, alternateMobile, deliveryInstructions, quote }) {
  const digits = orderNumber.slice(2)
  const { summary } = quote
  return {
    orderNumber,
    customerId: customer.id,
    customerCode: customer.code,
    customerName: contact.name || customer.name,
    customerMobile: contact.mobile || customer.mobile,
    customerEmail: contact.email || customer.email,
    placedAt: FIXTURE_NOW,
    channel: 'web',
    status: 'new',
    paymentStatus: 'pending',
    paymentMethod: PAYMENT_METHODS.upi,
    razorpayPaymentId: null,
    invoiceNumber: `INV-26-${digits}`,
    lines: quote.lines.map((line) => ({
      productCode: line.productCode,
      name: line.name,
      unit: line.unit,
      quantity: line.quantity,
      unitPrice: line.unitPrice,
      mrp: line.mrp,
      gstPercent: line.gstPercent,
      hsn: line.hsn,
      batch: line.batch,
      pv: line.pv,
      bin: getProduct(line.productCode).bin,
      taxable: line.taxable,
      gst: line.gst,
      lineTotal: line.lineTotal,
    })),
    summary: {
      units: summary.units,
      itemsTotal: summary.itemsTotal,
      taxableSubtotal: summary.taxableSubtotal,
      gstTotal: summary.gstTotal,
      cgst: summary.cgst,
      sgst: summary.sgst,
      igst: summary.igst,
      shipping: summary.shipping,
      grossAmount: summary.grossAmount,
      couponDiscount: summary.couponDiscount,
      walletApplied: summary.walletApplied,
      payable: summary.payable,
    },
    address: {
      label: address.label,
      name: address.name,
      mobile: address.mobile,
      line1: address.line1,
      line2: address.line2,
      landmark: address.landmark,
      city: address.city,
      state: address.state,
      pin: address.pin,
      verified: address.verified,
      ...(alternateMobile ? { alternateMobile } : {}),
    },
    deliveryInstructions,
    timestamps: { confirmedAt: FIXTURE_NOW },
    shipment: null,
    refund: null,
    onHold: false,
    delay: null,
    fulfilment: {
      warehouse: 'Lucknow · WH01',
      assignee: ASSIGNEES[db.orders.length % ASSIGNEES.length],
      pickBatch: null,
      priority: 'standard',
      packedBy: null,
      packaging: null,
      queueRank: nextQueueRank(),
    },
  }
}
 
export const checkoutHandlers = [
  // Body: { items: [{ productCode, quantity }], couponCode?, useWallet, addressId, contact: { name, mobile, email },
  //         alternateMobile?, deliveryInstructions?, expectedPayable }
  defineHandler('post', '/checkout/orders', ({ body, headers }) => {
    const customer = requireCustomer(headers)
    const lines = readLines(body?.items)
 
    const address = (db.addresses[customer.id] ?? []).find((entry) => entry.id === body?.addressId)
    if (!address) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Choose a delivery address to continue.')
    if (!SERVICEABLE_PINS[address.pin]) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'We do not deliver to this address yet.')
 
    const quote = computeQuote({
      lines,
      destinationState: address.state,
      useWallet: Boolean(body?.useWallet),
      walletBalance: customer.walletBalance,
      couponCode: body?.couponCode || undefined,
      hasPriorOrders: ordersOfCustomer(customer.id).length > 0,
    })
    assertAvailable(quote.lines)
    if (quote.coupon && !quote.coupon.valid) throw new MockHttpError(422, quote.coupon.message)
    if (round2(Number(body?.expectedPayable)) !== quote.summary.payable) {
      throw new MockHttpError(409, 'Prices or offers changed since you last looked. Please review your order and try again.')
    }
 
    const order = buildOrder({
      orderNumber: nextOrderNumber(),
      customer,
      contact: body?.contact ?? {},
      address,
      alternateMobile: String(body?.alternateMobile ?? '').trim(),
      deliveryInstructions: String(body?.deliveryInstructions ?? '').trim(),
      quote,
    })
    db.orders.push(order)
 
    // Nothing left to collect when the wallet covers the whole order.
    if (quote.summary.payable === 0) {
      order.paymentMethod = 'Wallet'
      settleOrder(customer, order)
    }
 
    return {
      status: 201,
      data: { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, paymentStatus: order.paymentStatus, amountDue: quote.summary.payable, currency: 'INR' },
    }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/checkout/orders/:orderNumber', ({ params, headers }) => {
    const order = ownedOrder(requireCustomer(headers), params.orderNumber)
    const area = SERVICEABLE_PINS[order.address.pin]
    return {
      data: {
        ...withLineImages(order),
        delivery: {
          method: SHIPPING_METHOD,
          etaFrom: area ? fromNow({ days: area.etaMinDays }) : null,
          etaTo: area ? fromNow({ days: area.etaMaxDays }) : null,
        },
      },
    }
  }),
 
  // Body: { orderNumber, method: 'upi' | 'card' | 'netbanking' }
  defineHandler('post', '/payments/sessions', ({ body, headers }) => {
    const order = ownedOrder(requireCustomer(headers), body?.orderNumber)
    if (order.paymentStatus === 'paid') throw new MockHttpError(409, 'This order has already been paid.')
    if (!PAYMENT_METHODS[body?.method]) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Choose a payment method to continue.')
 
    order.paymentStatus = 'pending'
    order.paymentMethod = PAYMENT_METHODS[body.method]
    const sessionId = `ps_${order.orderNumber}_${sessions.size + 1}`
    const gatewayOrderId = `order_MOCK${order.orderNumber.slice(2)}${sessions.size + 1}`
    sessions.set(sessionId, { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, gatewayOrderId })
 
    return {
      status: 201,
      data: {
        sessionId,
        orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
        gateway: 'razorpay',
        gatewayOrderId,
        keyId: 'rzp_test_DEV_FIXTURE',
        amount: order.summary.payable,
        currency: 'INR',
      },
    }
  }),
 
  // Body: { razorpayPaymentId, razorpayOrderId, razorpaySignature }. The real backend verifies the signature
  // with its Razorpay secret; this fixture only checks that the gateway answered for this session.
  defineHandler('post', '/payments/sessions/:sessionId/confirm', ({ params, body, headers }) => {
    const customer = requireCustomer(headers)
    const session = sessions.get(params.sessionId)
    if (!session) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Payment session not found.')
    const order = ownedOrder(customer, session.orderNumber)
    if (body?.razorpayOrderId !== session.gatewayOrderId || !body?.razorpayPaymentId || !body?.razorpaySignature) {
      throw new MockHttpError(400, 'We could not verify this payment. If money was deducted it will be refunded.')
    }
 
    settleOrder(customer, order, body.razorpayPaymentId)
    return { data: { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, paymentStatus: order.paymentStatus } }
  }),
 
  // Body: { reason }
  defineHandler('post', '/payments/sessions/:sessionId/failure', ({ params, headers }) => {
    const customer = requireCustomer(headers)
    const session = sessions.get(params.sessionId)
    if (!session) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Payment session not found.')
    const order = ownedOrder(customer, session.orderNumber)
    if (order.paymentStatus !== 'paid') order.paymentStatus = 'failed'
    return { status: 204 }
  }),
]

```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — invoice and label "documents" for the mock API. They are plain HTML pages so the
// download buttons have something real to hand over; they are NOT tax invoices or carrier labels.
// The real backend generates the PDFs (ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team).
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { getOrder } from '@/mocks/db'
import { requireUser } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
 
const escapeHtml = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (char) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[char])
const money = (value) => `₹${Number(value).toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`
const asBlob = (html) => ({ data: new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' }) })
 
const PAGE_STYLE = `body{font:14px/1.5 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#172b44;margin:32px auto;max-width:760px}
h1{font-size:22px;margin:0}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:16px 0}th,td{padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid #e3e9f1;text-align:left}
td.n,th.n{text-align:right}.muted{color:#64748b}.note{margin-top:24px;padding:8px 12px;background:#fff5df;color:#9b620b;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px}`
 
function loadOrder(headers, orderNumber) {
  const user = requireUser(headers)
  const order = getOrder(orderNumber)
  if (!order || (user.role !== 'admin' && order.customerId !== user.id)) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Order not found.')
  return order
}
 
export const documentHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/orders/:orderNumber/invoice', ({ params, headers }) => {
    const order = loadOrder(headers, params.orderNumber)
    const rows = order.lines
      .map(
        (line) =>
          `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(line.name)} <span class="muted">${escapeHtml(line.unit)} · ${escapeHtml(line.productCode)}</span></td><td>${escapeHtml(line.hsn)}</td><td class="n">${line.quantity}</td><td class="n">${money(line.taxable)}</td><td class="n">${line.gstPercent}%</td><td class="n">${money(line.lineTotal)}</td></tr>`,
      )
      .join('')
    const s = order.summary
    const html = `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Invoice ${escapeHtml(order.invoiceNumber ?? order.orderNumber)}</title><style>${PAGE_STYLE}</style></head><body>
<h1>Shipper.com · Invoice</h1><p class="muted">${escapeHtml(order.invoiceNumber ?? '—')} · Order ${escapeHtml(order.orderNumber)}</p>
<p><strong>${escapeHtml(order.address.name)}</strong><br>${escapeHtml(order.address.line1)}, ${escapeHtml(order.address.line2)}<br>${escapeHtml(order.address.city)}, ${escapeHtml(order.address.state)} – ${escapeHtml(order.address.pin)}</p>
<table><thead><tr><th>Item</th><th>HSN</th><th class="n">Qty</th><th class="n">Taxable</th><th class="n">GST</th><th class="n">Amount</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>
<p class="n" style="text-align:right">Taxable subtotal ${money(s.taxableSubtotal)} · GST ${money(s.gstTotal)} · Shipping ${money(s.shipping)} · Wallet −${money(s.walletApplied)}<br><strong>Paid ${money(s.payable)}</strong></p>
<p class="note">DEV FIXTURE — a simulated document from the mock API, not a tax invoice.</p></body></html>`
    return asBlob(html)
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/orders/:orderNumber/shipping-label', ({ params, headers }) => {
    const order = loadOrder(headers, params.orderNumber)
    const consignment = order.shipment?.consignmentId ?? 'To be assigned'
    const html = `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Label ${escapeHtml(order.orderNumber)}</title><style>${PAGE_STYLE}</style></head><body>
<h1>India Post · ${escapeHtml(order.shipment?.service ?? 'Speed Post')}</h1><p class="muted">Consignment ${escapeHtml(consignment)} · Order ${escapeHtml(order.orderNumber)}</p>
<p><strong>Deliver to</strong><br>${escapeHtml(order.address.name)} · ${escapeHtml(order.address.mobile)}<br>${escapeHtml(order.address.line1)}, ${escapeHtml(order.address.line2)}<br>${escapeHtml(order.address.city)}, ${escapeHtml(order.address.state)} – <strong>${escapeHtml(order.address.pin)}</strong></p>
<p class="muted">From Shipper.com · ${escapeHtml(order.fulfilment.warehouse)} · Weight ${order.shipment?.weightKg ?? '—'} kg</p>
<p class="note">DEV FIXTURE — a simulated label from the mock API, not a carrier label.</p></body></html>`
    return asBlob(html)
  }),
]

## `src/mocks/handlers/orders.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — a customer's order history, order detail and the public shipment lookup for the mock API.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: paths, query parameters and payloads (see features/orders and
// features/tracking services). Customers only ever receive their own orders, and only the fields below:
// internal fulfilment data (bins, batches, PV, assignees, delays) never leaves the backend.
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, getOrder, getProduct, ordersOfCustomer, withLineImages } from '@/mocks/db'
import { FIXTURE_NOW } from '@/mocks/fixtures/clock'
import { requireUser } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
import { matchesText, paginate } from '@/mocks/lib/paginate'
import { buildCustomerTimeline } from '@/mocks/lib/timeline'
 
// DEV FIXTURE: the carrier's public tracking page. The real backend supplies the link per shipment.
const INDIA_POST_TRACKING_URL = 'https://www.indiapost.gov.in/_layouts/15/dop.portal.tracking/trackconsignment.aspx'
 
// DEV FIXTURE: compact labels the order list uses ("Haldi ×2, Shampoo ×1"). Products without one use their name.
const SHORT_NAMES = { HL001: 'Haldi', SH002: 'Shampoo', PC003: 'Aloe Face Wash', CO004: 'Rose Lip Tint' }
 
// The "Status" filter on My orders groups the fulfilment statuses the way a customer thinks about them.
const STATUS_GROUPS = {
  processing: ['new', 'to_pick', 'to_pack', 'packed'],
  shipped: ['dispatched', 'in_transit', 'out_for_delivery'],
  delivered: ['delivered'],
  returned: ['returned'],
  cancelled: ['cancelled'],
}
const OPEN_STATUSES = [...STATUS_GROUPS.processing, ...STATUS_GROUPS.shipped]
const PERIOD_MONTHS = { '1m': 1, '3m': 3, '6m': 6 }
const TRACK_NOT_FOUND = "We couldn't find a shipment for those details. Check the order number, mobile number or consignment ID and try again."
 
const normalizeMobile = (value = '') => String(value).replace(/[\s-]/g, '').replace(/^\+?91(?=\d{10}$)/, '')
const periodStart = (period) => {
  const months = PERIOD_MONTHS[period]
  if (!months) return null
  const start = new Date(FIXTURE_NOW)
  start.setMonth(start.getMonth() - months)
  return start
}
 
/** The backend's promise for open orders without a carrier date yet: five days after the order was placed. */
function estimatedDeliveryOf(order) {
  if (order.shipment?.expectedDelivery) return order.shipment.expectedDelivery
  return OPEN_STATUSES.includes(order.status) ? new Date(Date.parse(order.placedAt) + 5 * 24 * 3_600_000).toISOString() : null
}
 
const isAvailable = (productCode) => {
  const product = getProduct(productCode)
  return Boolean(product && product.status === 'active' && product.stock > 0)
}
const canReorder = (order) => order.lines.some((line) => isAvailable(line.productCode))
 
const toShipment = (order) =>
  order.shipment
    ? {
        carrier: order.shipment.carrier,
        service: order.shipment.service,
        consignmentId: order.shipment.consignmentId,
        trackingUrl: INDIA_POST_TRACKING_URL,
        lastUpdate: order.shipment.lastUpdate,
      }
    : null
 
function toSummary(order) {
  return {
    orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
    placedAt: order.placedAt,
    status: order.status,
    grossAmount: order.summary.grossAmount,
    units: order.summary.units,
    items: withLineImages(order).lines.map((line) => ({
      productCode: line.productCode,
      name: line.name,
      shortName: SHORT_NAMES[line.productCode] ?? line.name,
      quantity: line.quantity,
      image: line.image,
    })),
    estimatedDelivery: estimatedDeliveryOf(order),
    carrier: order.shipment?.carrier ?? null,
    deliveredAt: order.timestamps.deliveredAt ?? null,
    refund: order.refund,
    hasInvoice: Boolean(order.invoiceNumber),
    canReorder: canReorder(order),
  }
}
 
function toDetail(order) {
  const savedAddresses = db.addresses[order.customerId] ?? []
  const isDefault = savedAddresses.some((saved) => saved.isDefault && saved.line1 === order.address.line1 && saved.pin === order.address.pin)
  return {
    orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
    placedAt: order.placedAt,
    status: order.status,
    paymentStatus: order.paymentStatus,
    paymentMethod: order.paymentMethod,
    razorpayPaymentId: order.razorpayPaymentId,
    invoiceNumber: order.invoiceNumber,
    estimatedDelivery: estimatedDeliveryOf(order),
    deliveredAt: order.timestamps.deliveredAt ?? null,
    lines: withLineImages(order).lines.map((line) => ({
      productCode: line.productCode,
      slug: line.slug,
      name: line.name,
      unit: line.unit,
      quantity: line.quantity,
      lineTotal: line.lineTotal,
      image: line.image,
      available: isAvailable(line.productCode),
    })),
    summary: order.summary,
    address: { ...order.address, isDefault },
    deliveryInstructions: order.deliveryInstructions,
    shipment: toShipment(order),
    timeline: buildCustomerTimeline(order),
    refund: order.refund,
    canReorder: canReorder(order),
  }
}
 
export const orderHandlers = [
  // Query: page, pageSize, status (a key of STATUS_GROUPS), period ('1m' | '3m' | '6m' | 'all'), q.
  defineHandler('get', '/orders', ({ query, headers }) => {
    const user = requireUser(headers)
    const since = periodStart(query.period)
    const status = STATUS_GROUPS[query.status]
    const needle = String(query.q ?? '').replace(/^#/, '')
 
    const matching = ordersOfCustomer(user.id)
      .filter((order) => !since || Date.parse(order.placedAt) >= since.getTime())
      .filter((order) => !status || status.includes(order.status))
      .filter((order) => matchesText(needle, order.orderNumber, ...order.lines.flatMap((line) => [line.name, line.productCode])))
      .sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.placedAt) - Date.parse(a.placedAt))
 
    const { items, ...paging } = paginate(matching, { page: query.page, pageSize: query.pageSize ?? 4 })
    return { data: { items: items.map(toSummary), ...paging } }
  }),
 
  // Public, so the visitor has no session: the order number must come with the mobile number on the
  // order, or the consignment ID must match. Only shipment progress is returned, never names or addresses.
  // ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: rate limiting / bot protection on this endpoint.
  defineHandler('post', '/orders/track', ({ body }) => {
    const consignmentId = String(body?.consignmentId ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()
    const orderNumber = String(body?.orderNumber ?? '').trim().toUpperCase().replace(/^#/, '')
    const mobile = normalizeMobile(body?.mobile)
 
    const order = consignmentId
      ? db.orders.find((candidate) => candidate.shipment?.consignmentId === consignmentId)
      : getOrder(orderNumber)
    const mobileMatches = Boolean(order && mobile && [order.customerMobile, order.address.mobile].map(normalizeMobile).includes(mobile))
    if (!order || (!consignmentId && !mobileMatches)) throw new MockHttpError(404, TRACK_NOT_FOUND)
 
    return {
      data: {
        orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
        placedAt: order.placedAt,
        status: order.status,
        units: order.summary.units,
        estimatedDelivery: estimatedDeliveryOf(order),
        deliveredAt: order.timestamps.deliveredAt ?? null,
        shipment: toShipment(order),
        timeline: buildCustomerTimeline(order),
      },
    }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/orders/:orderNumber', ({ params, headers }) => {
    const user = requireUser(headers)
    const order = getOrder(params.orderNumber.toUpperCase())
    if (!order || order.customerId !== user.id) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Order not found.')
    return { data: toDetail(order) }
  }),
]
```
 
## `src/mocks/handlers/saved.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — saved products of the signed-in customer for the mock API.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: paths and payloads (see features/saved/services).
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, getProduct } from '@/mocks/db'
import { requireUser } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
 
const stockStatusOf = (product) =>
  product.status !== 'active' || product.stock <= 0 ? 'out_of_stock' : product.stock <= product.lowStockThreshold ? 'low_stock' : 'in_stock'
 
function savedCodes(headers) {
  const user = requireUser(headers)
  return (db.savedProducts[user.id] ??= [])
}
 
export const savedHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', '/saved-products', ({ headers }) => {
    const items = savedCodes(headers)
      .map((productCode, index) => ({ product: getProduct(productCode), index }))
      .filter(({ product }) => product)
      .map(({ product, index }) => ({
        productCode: product.code,
        slug: product.slug,
        name: product.name,
        unit: product.unit,
        category: product.category,
        categoryLabel: product.categoryLabel,
        image: product.thumbnail,
        mrp: product.mrp,
        sellingPrice: product.sellingPrice,
        discountPercent: product.discountPercent,
        stockStatus: stockStatusOf(product),
        // Newest first: later entries in the list were saved later.
        savedAt: new Date(Date.parse('2026-10-20T10:00:00+05:30') + index * 3_600_000).toISOString(),
      }))
      .reverse()
    return { data: { items } }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('put', '/saved-products/:productCode', ({ params, headers }) => {
    if (!getProduct(params.productCode)) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Product not found.')
    const codes = savedCodes(headers)
    if (!codes.includes(params.productCode)) codes.push(params.productCode)
    return { status: 204 }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('delete', '/saved-products/:productCode', ({ params, headers }) => {
    const codes = savedCodes(headers)
    const index = codes.indexOf(params.productCode)
    if (index !== -1) codes.splice(index, 1)
    return { status: 204 }
  }),
]
