## `src/mocks/handlers/storeOperations.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — warehouse fulfilment (Store Operation) and shipping for the mock API. Every handler is
// admin-only and mutates the in-memory `db.orders`, which resets on reload. Nothing here talks to
// India Post, a warehouse system or an inventory service; carrier tracking events are simulated.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: every path, payload and response shape in this file.
import { defineHandler, MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db, getOrder, getProduct } from '@/mocks/db'
import { FIXTURE_NOW } from '@/mocks/fixtures/clock'
import {
  addDays,
  DEFAULT_DIMENSIONS_CM,
  DEFAULT_PACKAGING,
  DISPATCH_WINDOW_DAYS,
  filterStage,
  getTrackingSyncedAt,
  istDate,
  markTrackingSynced,
  nextSequence,
  ordersInStage,
  packageOf,
  shortagesOf,
  STAGE_LABELS,
  STAGE_MATCHERS,
  stageCounts,
  stageSummary,
  TEAM,
  TODAY,
  toQueueRow,
  toWorkOrder,
} from '@/mocks/lib/fulfilment'
import { requireAdmin } from '@/mocks/lib/auth'
import { paginate, sortBy } from '@/mocks/lib/paginate'
 
const STORE = '/admin/store-operations'
const CONSIGNMENT_ID = /^[A-Z]{2}\d{9}IN$/
const PACKAGING_TYPES = ['Corrugated box · S', 'Corrugated box · M', 'Corrugated box · L', 'Poly mailer']
const SERVICES = ['Speed Post', 'Registered Parcel', 'Business Parcel']
const HOLDABLE_STAGES = ['new', 'to_pick', 'to_pack', 'ready']
 
const escapeHtml = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (char) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[char])
 
const ok = (data) => ({ data })
 
function loadOrder(orderNumber, stage) {
  const order = getOrder(orderNumber)
  if (!order) throw new MockHttpError(404, 'Order not found.')
  if (stage && !STAGE_MATCHERS[stage](order)) {
    throw new MockHttpError(409, `${order.orderNumber} is no longer in ${STAGE_LABELS[stage]}. Refresh the queue and try again.`)
  }
  return order
}
 
function assertNotOnHold(order) {
  if (order.onHold) throw new MockHttpError(409, `${order.orderNumber} is on hold. Resolve the exception first.`)
}
 
// ── Transitions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function verifyOrder(order) {
  if (order.status !== 'new') throw new MockHttpError(409, `${order.orderNumber} is no longer in New orders. Refresh the queue and try again.`)
  assertNotOnHold(order)
  if (order.paymentStatus !== 'paid') {
    throw new MockHttpError(409, `Payment for ${order.orderNumber} is ${order.paymentStatus}. Verify the order once the payment is confirmed.`)
  }
  order.status = 'to_pick'
  order.timestamps.verifiedAt = FIXTURE_NOW
  order.fulfilment.pickBatch ??= 'PICK-2810-04'
}
 
function pickOrder(order, lines) {
  assertNotOnHold(order)
  const picked = new Map((lines ?? []).map((line) => [line.productCode, Number(line.pickedQuantity)]))
  order.lines.forEach((line) => {
    if (picked.get(line.productCode) !== line.quantity) throw new MockHttpError(409, `The pick list is incomplete: ${line.productCode} is not fully picked.`)
    if ((getProduct(line.productCode)?.stock ?? 0) < line.quantity) {
      throw new MockHttpError(409, `Stock is short for ${line.productCode}. Report the discrepancy instead.`)
    }
  })
  order.status = 'to_pack'
  order.timestamps.pickedAt = FIXTURE_NOW
}
 
function packOrder(order, body, adminName) {
  assertNotOnHold(order)
  const weightKg = Number(body.weightKg)
  if (!(weightKg > 0)) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Enter the parcel weight.', { message: 'Enter the parcel weight.', errors: { weightKg: 'Enter the parcel weight.' } })
  const dimensionsCm = { ...DEFAULT_DIMENSIONS_CM, ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(body.dimensionsCm ?? {}).map(([key, value]) => [key, Number(value)])) }
  order.status = 'packed'
  order.timestamps.packedAt = FIXTURE_NOW
  order.invoiceNumber ??= `INV-26-${order.orderNumber.slice(2)}`
  order.fulfilment.packedBy = body.packedBy || adminName
  order.fulfilment.packaging = body.packaging || DEFAULT_PACKAGING
  order.fulfilment.package = { weightKg, dimensionsCm }
}
 
function dispatchOrder(order, entry) {
  if (order.status !== 'packed') throw new MockHttpError(409, `${order.orderNumber} is no longer in Ready to dispatch. Refresh the queue and try again.`)
  const consignmentId = String(entry.consignmentId ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()
  const fieldError = (field, message) => new MockHttpError(422, message, { message, errors: { [field]: message } })
  if (!CONSIGNMENT_ID.test(consignmentId)) throw fieldError('consignmentId', 'Enter a valid ID: 2 letters, 9 digits, IN.')
  const duplicate = db.orders.find((other) => other !== order && other.shipment?.consignmentId === consignmentId)
  if (duplicate) throw fieldError('consignmentId', `This ID is already assigned to ${duplicate.orderNumber}.`)
 
  const dispatchDate = entry.dispatchDate || TODAY
  if (dispatchDate > TODAY || dispatchDate < istDate(order.timestamps.packedAt)) {
    throw fieldError('dispatchDate', 'Choose a date between the day the order was packed and today.')
  }
  const dispatchedAt = dispatchDate === TODAY ? FIXTURE_NOW : `${dispatchDate}T16:30:00+05:30`
  const parcel = packageOf(order) ?? { weightKg: 1, dimensionsCm: { ...DEFAULT_DIMENSIONS_CM } }
 
  order.status = 'dispatched'
  order.timestamps.dispatchedAt = dispatchedAt
  order.shipment = {
    carrier: entry.carrier || 'India Post',
    service: entry.service || SERVICES[0],
    consignmentId,
    dispatchedAt,
    expectedDelivery: `${addDays(dispatchDate, 4)}T18:00:00+05:30`,
    deliveredAt: null,
    weightKg: parcel.weightKg,
    dimensionsCm: parcel.dimensionsCm,
    status: 'dispatched',
    lastUpdate: null,
  }
  order.fulfilment.moveSeq = nextSequence()
  // Handing the parcel to India Post settles a missed pickup.
  if (order.delay?.issue === 'pickup_missed') {
    order.delay = null
    order.onHold = false
  }
}
 
function raiseDelay(order, delay) {
  order.onHold = true
  order.delay = { ageHours: 0, note: '', ...delay }
  order.fulfilment.moveSeq = nextSequence()
}
 
/** Runs `action` for each order number and reports which ones moved and which were refused. */
function runBulk(orderNumbers, action) {
  const succeeded = []
  const failed = []
  ;(orderNumbers ?? []).forEach((orderNumber) => {
    try {
      action(loadOrder(orderNumber))
      succeeded.push(orderNumber)
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof MockHttpError)) throw error
      failed.push({ orderNumber, reason: error.message })
    }
  })
  return { succeeded, failed }
}
 
// ── Documents and exports ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function pickListDocument(orders) {
  const rows = orders
    .flatMap((order) => order.lines.map((line) => ({ order, line })))
    .sort((a, b) => a.line.bin.localeCompare(b.line.bin) || a.order.orderNumber.localeCompare(b.order.orderNumber))
    .map(
      ({ order, line }) =>
        `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(line.bin)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(line.productCode)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(line.name)}</td><td>${line.quantity}</td><td>${escapeHtml(order.orderNumber)}</td></tr>`,
    )
    .join('')
  const html = `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Pick list</title><style>body{font:14px/1.5 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#172b44;margin:32px auto;max-width:760px}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:16px 0}th,td{padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid #e3e9f1;text-align:left}.note{margin-top:24px;padding:8px 12px;background:#fff5df;color:#9b620b;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px}</style></head><body>
<h1>Pick list · ${orders.length} orders</h1><p>Sorted by bin location.</p>
<table><thead><tr><th>Bin</th><th>SKU</th><th>Product</th><th>Qty</th><th>Order</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>
<p class="note">DEV FIXTURE — a simulated document from the mock API, not a warehouse system print-out.</p></body></html>`
  return new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' })
}
 
// ── Handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const storeOperationHandlers = [
  defineHandler('get', `${STORE}/options`, ({ headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return ok({
      today: TODAY,
      asOfDates: [TODAY, addDays(TODAY, -1), addDays(TODAY, -2)],
      owners: TEAM,
      packers: TEAM,
      assignees: TEAM,
      warehouses: ['Lucknow'],
      packagingTypes: PACKAGING_TYPES,
      carriers: [{ value: 'India Post', label: 'India Post', services: SERVICES }],
    })
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', `${STORE}/counts`, ({ headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return ok(stageCounts())
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', `${STORE}/queue`, ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    if (!STAGE_MATCHERS[query.stage]) throw new MockHttpError(400, 'Unknown stage.')
    const page = paginate(filterStage(query.stage, query).map(toQueueRow), { page: query.page, pageSize: query.pageSize })
    return ok({ ...page, summary: stageSummary(query.stage) })
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', `${STORE}/export`, ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    if (!STAGE_MATCHERS[query.stage]) throw new MockHttpError(400, 'Unknown stage.')
    return ok({ items: filterStage(query.stage, query).map(toQueueRow) })
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', `${STORE}/pick-list`, ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return { data: pickListDocument(filterStage('to_pick', query)) }
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', `${STORE}/orders/:orderNumber`, ({ params, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return ok(toWorkOrder(loadOrder(params.orderNumber)))
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', `${STORE}/orders/:orderNumber/verify`, ({ params, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const order = loadOrder(params.orderNumber)
    verifyOrder(order)
    return ok(toWorkOrder(order))
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', `${STORE}/verify`, ({ body, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return ok(runBulk(body?.orderNumbers, verifyOrder))
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', `${STORE}/orders/:orderNumber/hold`, ({ params, headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    const order = loadOrder(params.orderNumber)
    if (!HOLDABLE_STAGES.some((stage) => STAGE_MATCHERS[stage](order))) throw new MockHttpError(409, `${order.orderNumber} can no longer be put on hold.`)
    if (order.onHold) throw new MockHttpError(409, `${order.orderNumber} is already on hold.`)
    if (order.delay) {
      order.onHold = true
    } else {
      raiseDelay(order, {
        issue: 'manual_hold',
        label: 'On hold',
        detail: `Held by ${admin.name} before release.`,
        owner: admin.name,
        priority: 'medium',
        action: 'notify_customer',
        expectedResolutionAt: `${addDays(TODAY, 1)}T12:00:00+05:30`,
      })
    }
    return ok(toWorkOrder(order))
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', `${STORE}/orders/:orderNumber/stock-exception`, ({ params, body, headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    const order = loadOrder(params.orderNumber, 'to_pick')
    const line = order.lines.find((candidate) => candidate.productCode === body?.productCode)
    const available = Number(body?.availableQuantity)
    if (!line) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Choose a product from this pick list.')
    if (!Number.isInteger(available) || available < 0 || available >= line.quantity) {
      const message = `Enter the quantity found in the bin, fewer than the ${line.quantity} requested.`
      throw new MockHttpError(422, message, { message, errors: { availableQuantity: message } })
    }
    // The bin count replaces the system stock figure.
    getProduct(line.productCode).stock = available
    raiseDelay(order, {
      issue: 'stock_shortage',
      label: `Stock: ${line.productCode} −${line.quantity - available}`,
      detail: `${line.productCode} ${line.name}: requested ${line.quantity}, available ${available}. Shortage: ${line.quantity - available} units.`,
      owner: admin.name,
      priority: 'high',
      action: 'wait_for_restock',
      expectedResolutionAt: `${addDays(TODAY, 1)}T12:00:00+05:30`,
      note: body?.note ?? '',
    })
    return ok(toWorkOrder(order))
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', `${STORE}/orders/:orderNumber/picked`, ({ params, body, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const order = loadOrder(params.orderNumber, 'to_pick')
    pickOrder(order, body?.lines)
    return ok(toWorkOrder(order))
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', `${STORE}/orders/:orderNumber/packed`, ({ params, body, headers }) => {
    const admin = requireAdmin(headers)
    const order = loadOrder(params.orderNumber, 'to_pack')
    packOrder(order, body ?? {}, admin.name)
    return ok(toWorkOrder(order))
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', `${STORE}/orders/:orderNumber/dispatch`, ({ params, body, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const order = loadOrder(params.orderNumber)
    dispatchOrder(order, body ?? {})
    return ok(toWorkOrder(order))
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', `${STORE}/dispatch`, ({ body, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const entries = new Map((body?.entries ?? []).map((entry) => [entry.orderNumber, entry]))
    return ok(runBulk([...entries.keys()], (order) => dispatchOrder(order, entries.get(order.orderNumber))))
  }),
 
  defineHandler('put', `${STORE}/orders/:orderNumber/resolution`, ({ params, body, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const order = loadOrder(params.orderNumber, 'delayed')
    order.delay = {
      ...order.delay,
      owner: body?.owner ?? order.delay.owner,
      action: body?.action ?? order.delay.action,
      expectedResolutionAt: body?.expectedResolutionAt ?? order.delay.expectedResolutionAt,
      note: body?.note ?? order.delay.note,
      ...(body?.notifyCustomer ? { lastNotifiedAt: FIXTURE_NOW } : {}),
    }
    return ok(toWorkOrder(order))
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', `${STORE}/orders/:orderNumber/resolve`, ({ params, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const order = loadOrder(params.orderNumber, 'delayed')
    if (order.delay.issue === 'stock_shortage') {
      // The restock the shortage was waiting for is assumed to have arrived.
      shortagesOf(order).forEach((shortage) => {
        getProduct(shortage.productCode).stock = shortage.requested
      })
    }
    order.delay = null
    order.onHold = false
    return ok(toWorkOrder(order))
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', `${STORE}/assign-owner`, ({ body, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    if (!TEAM.includes(body?.owner)) throw new MockHttpError(422, 'Choose a team member.')
    return ok(
      runBulk(body.orderNumbers, (order) => {
        if (!order.delay) throw new MockHttpError(409, `${order.orderNumber} has no open exception.`)
        order.delay = { ...order.delay, owner: body.owner }
      }),
    )
  }),
 
  defineHandler('post', `${STORE}/notify-customers`, ({ body, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return ok(
      runBulk(body?.orderNumbers, (order) => {
        if (!order.delay) throw new MockHttpError(409, `${order.orderNumber} has no open exception.`)
        order.delay = { ...order.delay, lastNotifiedAt: FIXTURE_NOW }
      }),
    )
  }),
 
  // DEV FIXTURES — India Post tracking sync is not integrated; this only moves the "synced" clock.
  defineHandler('post', `${STORE}/tracking/refresh`, ({ headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    return ok({ syncedAt: markTrackingSynced() })
  }),
 
  defineHandler('get', '/admin/shipments', ({ query, headers }) => {
    requireAdmin(headers)
    const windowed = ordersInStage('dispatched')
    const byStatus = { dispatched: 0, in_transit: 0, out_for_delivery: 0, delivered: 0, returned: 0 }
    windowed.forEach((order) => {
      byStatus[order.shipment.status] = (byStatus[order.shipment.status] ?? 0) + 1
    })
    const search = String(query.search ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()
    const matching = windowed
      .filter((order) => !query.status || query.status === 'all' || order.shipment.status === query.status)
      .map(toQueueRow)
      .filter((row) =>
        [row.orderNumber, row.customerName, row.city, row.shipment.consignmentId].some((field) => String(field).toLowerCase().includes(search)),
      )
    const sorted = sortBy(matching, '-dispatchedAt', { dispatchedAt: (row) => Date.parse(row.shipment.dispatchedAt) })
    return ok({
      ...paginate(sorted, { page: query.page, pageSize: query.pageSize }),
      summary: { total: windowed.length, byStatus, windowDays: DISPATCH_WINDOW_DAYS, carrier: 'India Post', syncedAt: getTrackingSyncedAt() },
    })
  }),
]

```javascript
import { MockHttpError } from '@/mocks/adapter'
import { db } from '@/mocks/db'
 
// DEV FIXTURES: the mock sign-in hands out `mock-token-<userId>`; these helpers turn it back into a user.
function readAuthorization(headers) {
  const value = headers?.Authorization ?? headers?.authorization ?? headers?.get?.('Authorization')
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : ''
}
 
/** The signed-in account, or null for an anonymous request. */
export function getRequestUser(headers) {
  const match = /^Bearer mock-token-(.+)$/.exec(readAuthorization(headers))
  return match ? (db.accounts.find((account) => account.id === match[1]) ?? null) : null
}
 
export function requireUser(headers) {
  const user = getRequestUser(headers)
  if (!user) throw new MockHttpError(401, 'Please log in to continue.')
  return user
}
 
export function requireAdmin(headers) {
  const user = requireUser(headers)
  if (user.role !== 'admin') throw new MockHttpError(403, "You don't have permission to do that.")
  return user
}

```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — the warehouse fulfilment rules of the *fake* backend: which orders sit in which
// stage, how queues are ordered, and the work-order view the Store Operation panels read.
// The frontend only renders what it is given.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: stage names, queue ordering, group names and every shape below.
import { db, getProduct } from '@/mocks/db'
import { FIXTURE_NOW } from '@/mocks/fixtures/clock'
import { buildCustomerTimeline } from '@/mocks/lib/timeline'
import { ORIGIN_STATE_CODE, round2 } from '@/mocks/lib/quote'
 
export const DISPATCH_WINDOW_DAYS = 14
/** Delayed orders older than this are "beyond SLA". */
export const SLA_HOURS = 48
export const SELLER_GSTIN = '09AAXCS1048K1Z6'
export const DEFAULT_DIMENSIONS_CM = { length: 24, width: 18, height: 12 }
export const DEFAULT_PACKAGING = 'Corrugated box · M'
export const DEFAULT_PACKER = 'Anjali Singh'
export const TEAM = ['Pawan Yadav', 'Aman Singh', 'Neha Joshi', 'Suresh Kumar', 'Anjali Singh']
 
const IST_OFFSET_MS = 5.5 * 3_600_000
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000
const SHIPPED_STATUSES = ['dispatched', 'in_transit', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered', 'returned']
 
/** The calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD) of an instant in India. */
export const istDate = (iso) => new Date(Date.parse(iso) + IST_OFFSET_MS).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
export const TODAY = istDate(FIXTURE_NOW)
export const addDays = (isoDate, days) => new Date(Date.parse(`${isoDate}T00:00:00Z`) + days * DAY_MS).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
export const plusHours = (iso, hours) => new Date(Date.parse(iso) + hours * 3_600_000).toISOString()
 
export const STAGE_LABELS = { new: 'New orders', to_pick: 'To pick', to_pack: 'To pack', ready: 'Ready to dispatch', dispatched: 'Dispatched', delayed: 'Delayed orders' }
 
function dispatchedRecently(order) {
  const at = order.timestamps.dispatchedAt
  if (!at || !order.shipment || !SHIPPED_STATUSES.includes(order.status)) return false
  const age = Date.parse(FIXTURE_NOW) - Date.parse(at)
  return age >= 0 && age <= DISPATCH_WINDOW_DAYS * DAY_MS
}
 
export const STAGE_MATCHERS = {
  new: (order) => order.status === 'new',
  to_pick: (order) => order.status === 'to_pick',
  to_pack: (order) => order.status === 'to_pack',
  ready: (order) => order.status === 'packed',
  dispatched: dispatchedRecently,
  delayed: (order) => Boolean(order.delay),
}
 
// Moves of an order made through the API are numbered so they can be listed ahead of (dispatched) or
// after (delayed) the seeded rows, which keep their fixture order.
let sequence = 0
export const nextSequence = () => (sequence += 1)
 
const byQueue = (a, b) =>
  a.fulfilment.queueRank - b.fulfilment.queueRank || Date.parse(a.placedAt) - Date.parse(b.placedAt) || a.orderNumber.localeCompare(b.orderNumber)
const newestMoveFirst = (a, b) => (b.fulfilment.moveSeq ?? 0) - (a.fulfilment.moveSeq ?? 0)
const oldestMoveFirst = (a, b) => (a.fulfilment.moveSeq ?? 0) - (b.fulfilment.moveSeq ?? 0)
const STAGE_ORDER = { dispatched: newestMoveFirst, delayed: oldestMoveFirst }
 
/** Orders of one stage in queue order (`db.orders` keeps the fixture order for the stable sorts). */
export const ordersInStage = (stage) => db.orders.filter(STAGE_MATCHERS[stage]).sort(STAGE_ORDER[stage] ?? byQueue)
 
export const stageOf = (order) => ['new', 'to_pick', 'to_pack', 'ready', 'dispatched'].find((stage) => STAGE_MATCHERS[stage](order)) ?? null
 
const ISSUE_GROUPS = {
  payment_pending: 'payment',
  payment_failed: 'payment',
  stock_shortage: 'stock',
  shipping_delay: 'shipping',
  pickup_missed: 'shipping',
  pin_mismatch: 'address',
}
export const groupOfIssue = (issue) => ISSUE_GROUPS[issue] ?? 'other'
 
// ── Parcels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// The base order fixtures keep a parcel's weight only on shipped orders. The eight seeded packed orders
// get the weights shown on the design (9.15 kg in total), in queue order.
const SEEDED_PARCEL_WEIGHTS = [0.85, 1.2, 1.1, 2.4, 0.6, 0.75, 1.05, 1.2]
ordersInStage('ready').forEach((order, index) => {
  order.fulfilment.package ??= { weightKg: SEEDED_PARCEL_WEIGHTS[index] ?? 1, dimensionsCm: { ...DEFAULT_DIMENSIONS_CM } }
})
 
export const packageOf = (order) =>
  order.fulfilment.package ?? (order.shipment ? { weightKg: order.shipment.weightKg, dimensionsCm: order.shipment.dimensionsCm } : null)
 
const unitsWeightKg = (order) => round2(order.lines.reduce((total, line) => total + (getProduct(line.productCode)?.weightKg ?? 0) * line.quantity, 0))
 
// ── Stock ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const availableStock = (line) => getProduct(line.productCode)?.stock ?? 0
export const shortagesOf = (order) =>
  order.lines
    .filter((line) => availableStock(line) < line.quantity)
    .map((line) => ({ productCode: line.productCode, name: line.name, requested: line.quantity, available: availableStock(line), shortage: line.quantity - availableStock(line) }))
 
// ── Views ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const shipmentView = (order) =>
  order.shipment && {
    ...order.shipment,
    // ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: the API supplies the carrier's public tracking page.
    trackingUrl: 'https://www.indiapost.gov.in/_layouts/15/dop.portal.tracking/trackconsignment.aspx',
  }
 
/** One row of a queue table. All stages share the shape; each table reads the columns it needs. */
export function toQueueRow(order) {
  return {
    orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
    customerName: order.customerName,
    city: order.address.city,
    state: order.address.state,
    pin: order.address.pin,
    placedAt: order.placedAt,
    units: order.summary.units,
    grossAmount: order.summary.grossAmount,
    paymentStatus: order.paymentStatus,
    paymentMethod: order.paymentMethod,
    status: order.status,
    onHold: order.onHold,
    priority: order.fulfilment.priority,
    assignee: order.fulfilment.assignee,
    pickBatch: order.fulfilment.pickBatch,
    hasShortage: order.status === 'to_pick' && shortagesOf(order).length > 0,
    invoiceNumber: order.invoiceNumber,
    weightKg: packageOf(order)?.weightKg ?? null,
    shipment: shipmentView(order),
    delay: order.delay && {
      issue: order.delay.issue,
      group: groupOfIssue(order.delay.issue),
      label: order.delay.label,
      ageHours: order.delay.ageHours,
      owner: order.delay.owner,
      priority: order.delay.priority,
    },
  }
}
 
/** Everything the right-hand panels need about one order. */
export function toWorkOrder(order) {
  const { summary } = order
  const shortages = shortagesOf(order)
  const recorded = order.fulfilment.package ?? null
  return {
    orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
    status: order.status,
    stage: stageOf(order),
    onHold: order.onHold,
    placedAt: order.placedAt,
    customer: { name: order.customerName, code: order.customerCode, mobile: order.customerMobile, email: order.customerEmail },
    address: order.address,
    deliveryInstructions: order.deliveryInstructions,
    payment: {
      status: order.paymentStatus,
      method: order.paymentMethod,
      razorpayPaymentId: order.razorpayPaymentId,
      gross: summary.grossAmount,
      walletApplied: summary.walletApplied,
      paid: summary.payable,
    },
    summary: { units: summary.units, grossAmount: summary.grossAmount, payable: summary.payable, walletApplied: summary.walletApplied },
    lines: order.lines.map((line) => ({
      productCode: line.productCode,
      name: line.name,
      unit: line.unit,
      quantity: line.quantity,
      batch: line.batch,
      bin: line.bin,
      available: availableStock(line),
      // What the packer checks on arrival at the packing bench.
      inspection: getProduct(line.productCode)?.category === 'shampoo' ? 'No leakage' : 'Seal intact',
    })),
    stock: { warehouse: order.fulfilment.warehouse, allAvailable: shortages.length === 0, shortages },
    fulfilment: {
      warehouse: order.fulfilment.warehouse,
      assignee: order.fulfilment.assignee,
      pickBatch: order.fulfilment.pickBatch,
      priority: order.fulfilment.priority,
      packedBy: order.fulfilment.packedBy,
      packaging: order.fulfilment.packaging,
    },
    timestamps: order.timestamps,
    pack: {
      suggested: { weightKg: unitsWeightKg(order), dimensionsCm: { ...DEFAULT_DIMENSIONS_CM }, packaging: DEFAULT_PACKAGING, packedBy: DEFAULT_PACKER },
      recorded: recorded && { ...recorded, packaging: order.fulfilment.packaging, packedBy: order.fulfilment.packedBy },
    },
    invoice: {
      number: order.invoiceNumber ?? `INV-26-${order.orderNumber.slice(2)}`,
      date: order.placedAt,
      taxable: order.summary.taxableSubtotal,
      gst: order.summary.gstTotal,
      gross: summary.grossAmount,
      gstin: SELLER_GSTIN,
      stateCode: ORIGIN_STATE_CODE,
    },
    dispatch: { suggestedDate: TODAY },
    shipment: shipmentView(order),
    tracking: order.shipment ? buildCustomerTimeline(order) : [],
    delay: order.delay && { ...order.delay, group: groupOfIssue(order.delay.issue) },
  }
}
 
// ── Filtering ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const includesText = (needle, ...fields) => {
  const text = String(needle ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()
  return text === '' || fields.some((field) => String(field ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(text))
}
const isSet = (value) => value && value !== 'all'
 
const STAGE_FILTERS = {
  new: (order, q) =>
    includesText(q.search, order.orderNumber, order.customerName, order.address.pin) &&
    (!isSet(q.payment) || order.paymentStatus === q.payment) &&
    (!q.asOf || istDate(order.placedAt) <= q.asOf),
  to_pick: (order, q) =>
    includesText(q.search, order.orderNumber, order.customerName, ...order.lines.flatMap((line) => [line.productCode, line.bin, line.name])) &&
    (!isSet(q.warehouse) || order.fulfilment.warehouse.toLowerCase().includes(q.warehouse)) &&
    (!isSet(q.assignee) || order.fulfilment.assignee === q.assignee),
  to_pack: (order, q) => includesText(q.search, order.orderNumber, order.customerName, order.invoiceNumber),
  ready: (order, q) =>
    includesText(q.search, order.orderNumber, order.customerName, order.invoiceNumber) &&
    (!q.asOf || istDate(order.timestamps.packedAt) <= q.asOf),
  dispatched: (order, q) =>
    includesText(q.search, order.orderNumber, order.customerName, order.shipment?.consignmentId) &&
    (!isSet(q.status) || order.shipment?.status === q.status),
  delayed: (order, q) =>
    includesText(q.search, order.orderNumber, order.customerName, order.delay.label, order.delay.detail) &&
    (!isSet(q.issue) || groupOfIssue(order.delay.issue) === q.issue) &&
    (!isSet(q.age) || order.delay.ageHours >= Number(q.age)) &&
    (!isSet(q.owner) || order.delay.owner === q.owner),
}
 
export const filterStage = (stage, query) => ordersInStage(stage).filter((order) => STAGE_FILTERS[stage](order, query))
 
// ── Summaries ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function stageCounts() {
  const counts = Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(STAGE_MATCHERS).map((stage) => [stage, db.orders.filter(STAGE_MATCHERS[stage]).length]))
  const beyondSla = db.orders.filter((order) => order.delay && order.delay.ageHours >= SLA_HOURS).length
  return { ...counts, delayedBeyondSla: beyondSla, slaHours: SLA_HOURS }
}
 
let trackingSyncedAt = '2026-10-28T10:30:00+05:30'
export const getTrackingSyncedAt = () => trackingSyncedAt
export const markTrackingSynced = () => (trackingSyncedAt = FIXTURE_NOW)
 
export function stageSummary(stage) {
  if (stage === 'to_pick') {
    const orders = ordersInStage('to_pick')
    const needsAttention = orders.filter((order) => order.onHold || shortagesOf(order).length > 0).length
    return {
      ordersToPick: orders.length,
      unitsRequested: orders.reduce((total, order) => total + order.summary.units, 0),
      stockChecksPassed: orders.length - needsAttention,
      needsAttention,
      stockExceptions: orders
        .filter((order) => order.delay?.issue === 'stock_shortage')
        .map((order) => ({ orderNumber: order.orderNumber, onHold: order.onHold, detail: order.delay.detail })),
    }
  }
  if (stage === 'ready') {
    const orders = ordersInStage('ready')
    return {
      nextPickup: {
        at: '2026-10-28T16:30:00+05:30',
        parcels: orders.length,
        weightKg: round2(orders.reduce((total, order) => total + (packageOf(order)?.weightKg ?? 0), 0)),
      },
    }
  }
  if (stage === 'dispatched') return { trackingSyncedAt }
  if (stage === 'delayed') {
    const orders = ordersInStage('delayed')
    const inGroup = (group) => orders.filter((order) => groupOfIssue(order.delay.issue) === group).length
    return {
      total: orders.length,
      beyondSla: orders.filter((order) => order.delay.ageHours >= SLA_HOURS).length,
      slaHours: SLA_HOURS,
      groups: { payment: inGroup('payment'), stock: inGroup('stock'), shipping: inGroup('shipping'), address: inGroup('address'), other: inGroup('other') },
    }
  }
  return {}
}

## `src/mocks/lib/paginate.js`
 
```javascript
// Helpers shared by the mock list endpoints (the real backend owns paging, sorting and filtering).
 
/** paginate(list, { page: '2', pageSize: '6' }) → { items, page, pageSize, totalItems, pageCount } */
export function paginate(list, { page = 1, pageSize = 10 } = {}) {
  const size = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(pageSize, 10) || 10))
  const totalItems = list.length
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalItems / size))
  const current = Math.min(pageCount, Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(page, 10) || 1))
  return { items: list.slice((current - 1) * size, current * size), page: current, pageSize: size, totalItems, pageCount }
}
 
/** Query-string flags arrive as strings: 'true', '1', 'on' → true. */
export const toFlag = (value) => ['true', '1', 'on', 'yes'].includes(String(value).toLowerCase())
 
/** Case-insensitive "contains" match across several text fields. */
export const matchesText = (text, ...fields) => {
  const needle = String(text ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()
  return needle === '' || fields.some((field) => String(field ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(needle))
}
 
/** Sorts a copy of `list` by `key` ('field' ascending, '-field' descending). */
export function sortBy(list, key, accessors = {}) {
  if (!key) return [...list]
  const descending = key.startsWith('-')
  const field = descending ? key.slice(1) : key
  const read = accessors[field] ?? ((item) => item[field])
  return [...list].sort((a, b) => {
    const left = read(a)
    const right = read(b)
    const result = typeof left === 'number' && typeof right === 'number' ? left - right : String(left ?? '').localeCompare(String(right ?? ''))
    return descending ? -result : result
  })
}
```

```javascript
// DEV FIXTURE — a fake stand-in for the Razorpay Checkout window. NOT an integration and NOT
// production-ready: no money moves, no signature is produced, and the "bank" is a few lines below.
//
// It answers the way Checkout.js reports back to the page (success handler, `payment.failed` event,
// or the window being dismissed), so the checkout flow around it is the same one a real gateway needs.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: the result shape handed to POST /payments/sessions/:id/confirm.
 
const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms))
 
/** Any UPI ID starting with "fail@" is declined, to exercise the failure state. */
const DECLINED_UPI = /^fail@/i
 
/**
 * @param {{ gatewayOrderId: string, orderNumber: string }} session  from POST /payments/sessions
 * @param {{ method: 'upi' | 'card' | 'netbanking', upiId?: string }} options
 * @returns {Promise<{ outcome: 'success', razorpayPaymentId: string, razorpayOrderId: string, razorpaySignature: string }
 *   | { outcome: 'failed', reason: string }>}
 */
export async function openMockCheckout(session, { method, upiId }) {
  await wait(350)
  if (method === 'upi' && DECLINED_UPI.test(String(upiId ?? '').trim())) {
    return { outcome: 'failed', reason: 'Your bank declined this payment. Try another UPI ID or payment method.' }
  }
  return {
    outcome: 'success',
    razorpayPaymentId: `pay_RZP${session.orderNumber.slice(2)}`,
    razorpayOrderId: session.gatewayOrderId,
    razorpaySignature: 'dev_fixture_signature',
  }
}

## `src/mocks/lib/quote.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — the pricing rules of the *fake* backend.
//
// The frontend never calculates prices, GST, shipping, wallet deductions or totals. This module
// stands in for the backend so the mock API can answer quote and order requests with plausible,
// internally consistent numbers (they reproduce the cart in the design: ₹760 items, ₹669.25
// taxable, ₹90.75 GST, ₹40 shipping, ₹800 gross, ₹100 wallet, ₹700 to pay).
//
// Every rule below is an ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team:
//  - catalogue prices are GST-inclusive; taxable value and GST are derived per line and rounded to paise
//  - shipping is a flat ₹40, free when the items total reaches ₹999
//  - GST is split into CGST + SGST for deliveries inside Uttar Pradesh (state code 09), IGST elsewhere
//  - a wallet can pay up to ₹100 per order, and cannot be combined with a coupon
export const SHIPPING_FLAT_FEE = 40
export const FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD = 999
export const WALLET_ORDER_CAP = 100
export const ORIGIN_STATE = 'Uttar Pradesh'
export const ORIGIN_STATE_CODE = '09'
 
export const COUPONS = {
  HELLO10: {
    code: 'HELLO10',
    description: '10% off your first order, up to ₹100 off (minimum ₹699).',
    percent: 10,
    cap: 100,
    minItemsTotal: 699,
    firstOrderOnly: true,
  },
  SHIPPER50: {
    code: 'SHIPPER50',
    description: '₹50 off orders of ₹499 or more.',
    flat: 50,
    minItemsTotal: 499,
    firstOrderOnly: false,
  },
}
 
export const round2 = (value) => Math.round((value + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
 
/**
 * @param {object} input
 * @param {{product: object, quantity: number}[]} input.lines  product = catalogue record
 * @param {string} [input.destinationState]  state of the delivery address (decides CGST+SGST vs IGST)
 * @param {boolean} [input.useWallet]
 * @param {number} [input.walletBalance]
 * @param {string} [input.couponCode]
 * @param {boolean} [input.hasPriorOrders]
 */
export function computeQuote({ lines, destinationState = ORIGIN_STATE, useWallet = false, walletBalance = 0, couponCode, hasPriorOrders = true }) {
  const quoteLines = lines.map(({ product, quantity }) => {
    const lineTotal = round2(product.sellingPrice * quantity)
    const taxable = round2(lineTotal / (1 + product.gstPercent / 100))
    const gst = round2(lineTotal - taxable)
    const available = product.stock
    const stockStatus = product.status !== 'active' || available <= 0 ? 'out_of_stock' : available <= product.lowStockThreshold ? 'low_stock' : 'in_stock'
    return {
      productCode: product.code,
      slug: product.slug,
      name: product.name,
      unit: product.unit,
      category: product.category,
      quantity,
      unitPrice: product.sellingPrice,
      mrp: product.mrp,
      discountPercent: product.discountPercent,
      gstPercent: product.gstPercent,
      hsn: product.hsn,
      batch: product.batch,
      pv: product.pv,
      taxable,
      gst,
      lineTotal,
      stockStatus,
      availableStock: available,
      lowStockLeft: stockStatus === 'low_stock' ? available : null,
      maxQuantity: Math.max(0, Math.min(10, available)),
    }
  })
 
  const units = quoteLines.reduce((total, line) => total + line.quantity, 0)
  const itemsTotal = round2(quoteLines.reduce((total, line) => total + line.lineTotal, 0))
  const taxableSubtotal = round2(quoteLines.reduce((total, line) => total + line.taxable, 0))
  const gstTotal = round2(quoteLines.reduce((total, line) => total + line.gst, 0))
  const shipping = itemsTotal === 0 || itemsTotal >= FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD ? 0 : SHIPPING_FLAT_FEE
  const grossAmount = round2(itemsTotal + shipping)
 
  const intraState = destinationState === ORIGIN_STATE
  const cgst = intraState ? round2(gstTotal / 2) : 0
  const sgst = intraState ? round2(gstTotal - cgst) : 0
  const igst = intraState ? 0 : gstTotal
 
  // Coupon
  let coupon = null
  let couponDiscount = 0
  if (couponCode) {
    const definition = COUPONS[String(couponCode).trim().toUpperCase()]
    if (!definition) {
      coupon = { code: String(couponCode).trim().toUpperCase(), valid: false, message: 'This coupon code is not valid.' }
    } else if (definition.firstOrderOnly && hasPriorOrders) {
      coupon = { code: definition.code, valid: false, message: `${definition.code} is valid on your first order only.` }
    } else if (itemsTotal < definition.minItemsTotal) {
      coupon = { code: definition.code, valid: false, message: `Add items worth ₹${definition.minItemsTotal} or more to use ${definition.code}.` }
    } else {
      couponDiscount = definition.percent ? Math.min(definition.cap, round2((itemsTotal * definition.percent) / 100)) : definition.flat
      coupon = { code: definition.code, valid: true, message: `${definition.code} applied.`, discount: couponDiscount }
    }
  }
 
  // Wallet cannot be combined with a coupon.
  const walletEligible = !coupon?.valid
  const walletApplied = useWallet && walletEligible ? round2(Math.min(walletBalance, WALLET_ORDER_CAP, grossAmount)) : 0
  const payable = round2(grossAmount - couponDiscount - walletApplied)
  const awayFromFreeShipping = itemsTotal > 0 && itemsTotal < FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD ? round2(FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD - itemsTotal) : null
 
  return {
    lines: quoteLines,
    summary: {
      products: quoteLines.length,
      units,
      itemsTotal,
      taxableSubtotal,
      gstTotal,
      cgst,
      sgst,
      igst,
      gstType: intraState ? 'intra_state' : 'inter_state',
      gstStateCode: ORIGIN_STATE_CODE,
      shipping,
      grossAmount,
      couponDiscount,
      walletApplied,
      payable,
      freeShippingThreshold: FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD,
      awayFromFreeShipping,
    },
    wallet: {
      balance: walletBalance,
      eligible: walletEligible,
      maxPerOrder: WALLET_ORDER_CAP,
      applied: walletApplied,
      balanceAfter: round2(walletBalance - walletApplied),
    },
    coupon,
  }
}
```
 
## `src/mocks/lib/timeline.js`
 
```javascript
// DEV FIXTURES — the customer-facing tracking timeline the fake backend derives from an order's
// timestamps. The frontend only renders what it is given.
// ASSUMPTION — confirm with backend team: step names, notes and the `state` values.
//
//   [{ key, title, at: ISO | null, note, state: 'done' | 'current' | 'upcoming' }]
const shortDate = (iso) => new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' })
const minusHours = (iso, hours) => new Date(new Date(iso).getTime() - hours * 3_600_000).toISOString()
 
export function buildCustomerTimeline(order) {
  const { timestamps: t, shipment, status } = order
  const afterDispatch = ['in_transit', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered', 'returned'].includes(status)
  const reachedOutForDelivery = ['out_for_delivery', 'delivered', 'returned'].includes(status)
  const expected = shipment?.expectedDelivery ? `Expected ${shortDate(shipment.expectedDelivery)}` : 'Expected soon'
 
  if (status === 'cancelled') {
    return [
      { key: 'confirmed', title: 'Order confirmed', at: t.confirmedAt, note: 'Payment received', state: 'done' },
      { key: 'cancelled', title: 'Cancelled', at: t.cancelledAt ?? null, note: 'Refund issued to the original payment method', state: 'current' },
    ]
  }
 
  const steps = [
    { key: 'confirmed', title: 'Order confirmed', at: t.confirmedAt, note: order.paymentStatus === 'paid' ? 'Payment received' : 'Awaiting payment' },
    { key: 'packed', title: 'Packed', at: t.packedAt ?? null, note: t.packedAt ? 'Lucknow warehouse' : 'We’ll pack it with care' },
    { key: 'dispatched', title: 'Dispatched', at: t.dispatchedAt ?? null, note: t.dispatchedAt ? 'India Post pickup' : 'Handed to India Post next' },
    {
      key: 'in_transit',
      title: 'In Transit',
      at: afterDispatch ? (t.inTransitAt ?? null) : null,
      note: afterDispatch ? (shipment?.lastUpdate?.note ?? 'On the way') : 'On the way to your city',
    },
    {
      key: 'out_for_delivery',
      title: 'Out for delivery',
      at: reachedOutForDelivery ? (t.outForDeliveryAt ?? (t.deliveredAt ? minusHours(t.deliveredAt, 5) : null)) : null,
      note: reachedOutForDelivery ? 'With the delivery agent' : expected,
    },
    {
      key: 'delivered',
      title: 'Delivered',
      at: t.deliveredAt ?? null,
      note: t.deliveredAt ? `Delivered to ${order.address.city}` : 'We’ll update you when it arrives',
    },
  ]
  if (status === 'returned') {
    steps.push({ key: 'returned', title: 'Returned', at: t.returnedAt ?? null, note: order.refund ? `Refund of ₹${order.refund.amount} to your ${order.refund.to}` : 'Return received', state: 'current' })
  }
 
  const lastDone = steps.reduce((last, step, index) => (step.at ? index : last), 0)
  const finished = status === 'delivered'
  return steps.map((step, index) => ({
    ...step,
    state: step.state ?? (index < lastDone || (finished && index === lastDone) ? 'done' : index === lastDone ? 'current' : 'upcoming'),
  }))
}
```

import { Navigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom'

import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
 
/** Unknown URL inside a shell. Pass `homeTo`/`homeLabel` to point the admin 404 back at the dashboard. */
export default function NotFoundPage({ homeTo = paths.home, homeLabel = 'Back to home' }) {
  return (
    <div className="sh-container py-5">
      <EmptyState
        icon="compass"
        title="We can’t find that page"
        description="The link may be broken or the page may have moved."
        action={
          <Button as={Link} to={homeTo}>
            {homeLabel}
          </Button>
        }
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```
 
## `src/pages/RouteErrorPage.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { isRouteErrorResponse, Link, useRouteError } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
 
/** Root error boundary for the router: a route failed to load or a page threw while rendering. */
export default function RouteErrorPage() {
  const error = useRouteError()
  const isNotFound = isRouteErrorResponse(error) && error.status === 404
 
  if (import.meta.env.DEV) console.error(error)
 
  return (
    <div className="sh-container py-5">
      <ErrorState
        title={isNotFound ? 'We can’t find that page' : 'Something went wrong'}
        message={
          isNotFound
            ? 'The link may be broken or the page may have moved.'
            : 'The page could not be displayed. Reload to try again, or head back to the home page.'
        }
        onRetry={isNotFound ? undefined : () => window.location.reload()}
      />
      <div className="d-flex justify-content-center">
        <Button as={Link} to={paths.home} variant="secondary">
          Back to home
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## `src/pages/storefront/OrderDetailPage.jsx`
 
```jsx
import { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import { paths } from '@/app/router/paths'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/app/services'
import Button from '@/components/atoms/Button'
import EmptyState from '@/components/molecules/EmptyState'
import ErrorState from '@/components/molecules/ErrorState'
import { getOrderHeadline, OrderDetail, OrderDetailSkeleton, useInvoiceDownload, useOrder } from '@/features/orders'
import { AccountShell } from '@/features/profile'
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/date'
 
export default function OrderDetailPage() {
  const { orderNumber } = useParams()
  const { data: order, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useOrder(orderNumber)
  const invoice = useInvoiceDownload()
 
  const breadcrumbs = [{ label: 'My account', to: paths.profile }, { label: 'Orders', to: paths.orders }, { label: orderNumber }]
  const shell = { layout: 'wide', showNav: false, breadcrumbs }
 
  if (isError && error.status === 404) {
    return (
      <AccountShell {...shell} title="We can’t find that order">
        <EmptyState
          icon="bag-x"
          title={`Order ${orderNumber} isn’t on your account`}
          description="Check the order number, or head back to your orders to find it."
          action={
            <Button as={Link} to={paths.orders}>
              Back to my orders
            </Button>
          }
        />
      </AccountShell>
    )
  }
  if (isError) {
    return (
      <AccountShell {...shell} title="Order details">
        <ErrorState title="We couldn’t load this order" message={getErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={refetch} />
      </AccountShell>
    )
  }
  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <AccountShell {...shell} title="Order details" description={`Order #${orderNumber}`}>
        <OrderDetailSkeleton />
      </AccountShell>
    )
  }
 
  return (
    <AccountShell
      {...shell}
      title={getOrderHeadline(order.status)}
      description={`Order #${order.orderNumber} · Placed ${formatDateTime(order.placedAt).replace(', ', ' at ')}`}
      actions={
        order.invoiceNumber && (
          <Button size="lg" loading={invoice.isPending} onClick={() => invoice.mutate(order.orderNumber)}>
            Download invoice
          </Button>
        )
      }
    >
      <OrderDetail order={order} />
    </AccountShell>
  )
}
```

          <PolicyDocument policy={policy} />
        </div>
        <div className="col-12 col-lg-4">

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

## `src/styles/_base.scss`
 
```scss
@use 'mixins' as *;
 
// Minimal reset and global defaults. Bootstrap's Reboot is intentionally not used.
 
*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
 
html {
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  text-size-adjust: 100%;
}
 
body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--sh-color-white);
  color: var(--sh-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sh-font-sans);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-base);
  line-height: 1.5;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}
 
h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
h5,
h6,
p,
figure,
blockquote {
  margin: 0;
}
 
h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
h5,
h6 {
  color: var(--sh-color-navy);
  font-weight: var(--sh-font-weight-semibold);
  line-height: 1.25;
}
 
ul,
ol {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
 
a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}
 
img,
svg,
video {
  display: block;
  max-width: 100%;
}
 
button,
input,
select,
textarea {
  margin: 0;
  color: inherit;
  font: inherit;
}
 
button {
  cursor: pointer;
}
 
button:disabled,
[aria-disabled='true'] {
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
 
table {
  border-collapse: collapse;
}
 
// Visible keyboard focus everywhere; pointer clicks do not show the ring.
:focus-visible {
  @include focus-ring;
}
 
// Page gutter used by storefront sections (content is 1312px wide inside a 1440px viewport).
.sh-container {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--sh-container-max);
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-inline: var(--sh-gutter-mobile);
 
  @include up('md') {
    padding-inline: var(--sh-gutter-tablet);
  }
 
  @include up('xl') {
    padding-inline: var(--sh-gutter-desktop);
  }
}
 
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}
```

@use 'tokens' as t;
 
// Bootstrap, grid and utilities only: no Reboot, no component CSS, no Bootstrap JavaScript.
// Configuration must be declared before the Bootstrap partials are imported.
 
$enable-dark-mode: false;
$enable-shadows: false;
$enable-gradients: false;
$enable-negative-margins: false;
$enable-cssgrid: false;
 
$grid-breakpoints: t.$breakpoints;
$grid-gutter-width: 1.25rem; // 20px — matches the product grid gap in the design
$container-max-widths: (
  sm: 540px,
  md: 720px,
  lg: 960px,
  xl: 1200px,
  xxl: 1312px,
);
 
// Map Bootstrap's theme colours onto the Shipper palette so utilities such as .text-primary,
// .bg-light and .border resolve to design values.
$primary: t.$color-primary;
$secondary: t.$color-muted;
$success: t.$color-success;
$info: t.$color-primary;
$warning: t.$color-warning;
$danger: t.$color-danger;
$light: t.$color-surface;
$dark: t.$color-navy;
 
$body-color: t.$color-ink;
$body-bg: t.$color-white;
$border-color: t.$color-border;
$font-family-sans-serif: t.$font-family-sans;
$font-size-base: 0.875rem;
 
@import 'bootstrap/scss/functions';
@import 'bootstrap/scss/variables';
@import 'bootstrap/scss/variables-dark';
@import 'bootstrap/scss/maps';
@import 'bootstrap/scss/mixins';
@import 'bootstrap/scss/utilities';
@import 'bootstrap/scss/root';
@import 'bootstrap/scss/containers';
@import 'bootstrap/scss/grid';
@import 'bootstrap/scss/helpers/visually-hidden';
@import 'bootstrap/scss/helpers/stretched-link';
@import 'bootstrap/scss/utilities/api';

## `src/styles/_mixins.scss`
 
```scss
@use 'sass:map';
@use 'tokens' as t;
 
// Mobile-first breakpoint helpers. Usage: @include up('lg') { … } / @include down('md') { … }
@mixin up($breakpoint) {
  @media (min-width: map.get(t.$breakpoints, $breakpoint)) {
    @content;
  }
}
 
@mixin down($breakpoint) {
  @media (max-width: calc(#{map.get(t.$breakpoints, $breakpoint)} - 0.02px)) {
    @content;
  }
}
 
@mixin focus-ring {
  outline: 2px solid transparent;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-focus-ring);
}
 
@mixin sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  margin: -1px;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}
 
@mixin truncate {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
 
@mixin line-clamp($lines: 2) {
  display: -webkit-box;
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  -webkit-line-clamp: $lines;
  line-clamp: $lines;
}
 
// ── Text-like controls (Input, Select, SearchField) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// The wrapper carries the border, radius, focus ring and invalid state; the inner field is bare.
@mixin control-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid var(--sh-color-border);
  border-radius: var(--sh-radius-sm);
  background: var(--sh-color-white);
  color: var(--sh-color-ink);
  transition:
    border-color var(--sh-transition),
    box-shadow var(--sh-transition),
    background-color var(--sh-transition);
 
  &:hover {
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sh-color-primary) 35%, var(--sh-color-border));
  }
 
  &:focus-within {
    border-color: var(--sh-color-primary);
    box-shadow: var(--sh-focus-ring);
  }
}
 
@mixin control-variant-filled {
  border-color: transparent;
  background: var(--sh-color-surface);
}
 
@mixin control-invalid {
  border-color: var(--sh-color-danger);
 
  &:hover,
  &:focus-within {
    border-color: var(--sh-color-danger);
  }
 
  &:focus-within {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--sh-color-danger) 28%, transparent);
  }
}
 
@mixin control-field {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 0 0.75rem;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  outline: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--sh-control-font-size, var(--sh-font-size-base));
 
  &::placeholder {
    color: var(--sh-color-muted);
    opacity: 0.85;
  }
 
  &:focus-visible {
    box-shadow: none;
  }
 
  &:disabled {
    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: 0.6;
  }
}
```
 
## `src/styles/_root.scss`
 
```scss
@use 'sass:map';
@use 'tokens' as t;
 
// Publishes the Sass tokens as CSS custom properties (--sh-*). Component styles read these at
// runtime instead of importing Sass values, so a theme change never needs a component edit.
:root {
  // Colour
  --sh-color-navy: #{t.$color-navy};
  --sh-color-ink: #{t.$color-ink};
  --sh-color-muted: #{t.$color-muted};
  --sh-color-primary: #{t.$color-primary};
  --sh-color-primary-hover: #{t.$color-primary-hover};
  --sh-color-primary-tint: #{t.$color-primary-tint};
  --sh-color-hero-tint: #{t.$color-hero-tint};
  --sh-color-sand: #{t.$color-sand};
  --sh-color-surface: #{t.$color-surface};
  --sh-color-border: #{t.$color-border};
  --sh-color-white: #{t.$color-white};
  --sh-color-footer-link: #{t.$color-footer-link};
  --sh-color-success: #{t.$color-success};
  --sh-color-success-tint: #{t.$color-success-tint};
  --sh-color-warning: #{t.$color-warning};
  --sh-color-warning-tint: #{t.$color-warning-tint};
  --sh-color-danger: #{t.$color-danger};
  --sh-color-danger-tint: #{t.$color-danger-tint};
  --sh-color-scrim: #{t.$color-scrim};
 
  // Typography
  --sh-font-sans: #{t.$font-family-sans};
  @each $name, $size in t.$font-sizes {
    --sh-font-size-#{$name}: #{$size};
  }
  @each $name, $weight in t.$font-weights {
    --sh-font-weight-#{$name}: #{$weight};
  }
 
  // Shape and elevation
  @each $name, $radius in t.$radii {
    --sh-radius-#{$name}: #{$radius};
  }
  @each $name, $shadow in t.$shadows {
    --sh-shadow-#{$name}: #{$shadow};
  }
  --sh-focus-ring: #{t.$focus-ring};
 
  // Layout
  @each $name, $value in t.$layout {
    --sh-#{$name}: #{$value};
  }
 
  // Stacking
  @each $name, $value in t.$z-index {
    --sh-z-#{$name}: #{$value};
  }
 
  --sh-transition: #{t.$transition};
}
 
// The admin dashboard is denser than the storefront in the Figma design (design pages p-13..p-24): body copy, tables,
// panels and controls read at 12px, table headers and small captions at 10px, and headline figures at 22px. Re-pointing the type tokens here
// keeps every admin component on the shared scale instead of hard-coding sizes in each one. AdminLayout sets
// data-area="admin" on <html> so modals and drawers rendered through portals follow suit.
:root[data-area='admin'] {
  --sh-font-size-2xs: 0.625rem; // 10px
  --sh-font-size-sm: 0.75rem; // 12px
  --sh-font-size-base: 0.75rem; // 12px
  --sh-font-size-xl: 1.375rem; // 22px
  --sh-control-font-size: var(--sh-font-size-sm);
}
 
```
 
## `src/styles/_tokens.scss`
 
```scss
// Design tokens — single source of truth for the storefront and the admin dashboard.
//
// Colours were sampled from the Figma export (design/shipper-figma.pdf). Radii, shadows, the type
// scale and layout measures were measured or estimated from the artboards and may be refined
// per component. Plain Sass values live here; _root.scss publishes them as CSS custom properties
// (--sh-*) which components consume at runtime.
 
// ── Brand and neutrals ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$color-navy: #102b50; // announcement bar, footer, display headings
$color-ink: #172b44; // body text, table values, KPI values
$color-muted: #64748b; // secondary text, labels, inactive navigation
$color-primary: #1558d6; // primary actions, links, active states
$color-primary-hover: #114bb3; // DERIVED (not in the design): hover/pressed state of primary
$color-primary-tint: #edf4ff; // selected rows, active nav pill, info badge, newsletter band
$color-hero-tint: #eaf1f7; // storefront hero background
$color-sand: #f5f0e9; // warm promo and editorial cards
$color-surface: #f5f7fb; // admin page background, filter panel, table header, search field
$color-border: #e3e9f1;
$color-white: #ffffff;
$color-footer-link: #d9e4f1;
 
// ── Status ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$color-success: #16724d;
$color-success-tint: #eaf7f0;
$color-warning: #9b620b;
$color-warning-tint: #fff5df;
$color-danger: #c13e43;
$color-danger-tint: #fff0f0;
 
// ── Overlay ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$color-scrim: rgba(16, 43, 80, 0.44); // modal and drawer backdrop (navy at 44%)
 
// ── Typography ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$font-family-sans: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial,
  sans-serif;
 
$font-sizes: (
  '2xs': 0.6875rem,
  // 11px
  'xs': 0.75rem,
  // 12px — captions, badges, helper text
  'sm': 0.8125rem,
  // 13px
  'base': 0.875rem,
  // 14px — body copy, tables, form controls
  'md': 1rem,
  // 16px — product titles
  'lg': 1.125rem,
  // 18px
  'xl': 1.25rem,
  // 20px
  '2xl': 1.5rem,
  // 24px — admin page titles
  '3xl': 1.75rem,
  // 28px — storefront section titles
  '4xl': 2.25rem,
  // 36px
  'display': 4rem,
  // 64px — storefront hero (smaller on mobile)
);
 
$font-weights: (
  'regular': 400,
  'medium': 500,
  'semibold': 600,
  'bold': 700,
);
 
// ── Shape and elevation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$radii: (
  'xs': 4px,
  'sm': 6px,
  // buttons, inputs, pagination, badges
  'md': 8px,
  // admin cards, tables
  'lg': 12px,
  // storefront product cards, promo cards
  'xl': 16px,
  // modals, hero imagery
  'pill': 999px,
);
 
$shadows: (
  'sm': 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 43, 80, 0.06),
  'md': 0 4px 12px rgba(16, 43, 80, 0.08),
  'lg': 0 16px 40px rgba(16, 43, 80, 0.18),
);
 
$focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px rgba(21, 88, 214, 0.35);
 
// ── Layout (measured at the 1440px and 390px artboards) ────────────────────────────────────────
$breakpoints: (
  'xs': 0,
  'sm': 576px,
  'md': 768px,
  'lg': 1024px,
  'xl': 1280px,
  'xxl': 1440px,
);
 
$layout: (
  'container-max': 1440px,
  'gutter-mobile': 18px,
  'gutter-tablet': 32px,
  'gutter-desktop': 64px,
  'announcement-h': 30px,
  'header-h': 92px,
  'category-nav-h': 48px,
  'admin-sidebar-w': 224px,
  'admin-sidebar-w-collapsed': 76px,
  'admin-header-h': 66px,
  'admin-content-padding': 20px,
  'modal-w': 900px,
  'drawer-w': 440px,
  'control-h-sm': 34px,
  'control-h-md': 40px,
  'control-h-lg': 44px,
);
 
// ── Stacking ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$z-index: (
  'dropdown': 1000,
  'sticky': 1020,
  'drawer': 1040,
  'modal': 1050,
  'popover': 1100,
  'toast': 1200,
);
 
$transition: 160ms ease;
```
 
## `src/styles/_vendor.scss`
 
```scss
// Maps third-party widgets onto the Shipper tokens. The variables are set on the .Toastify wrapper
// (not :root) because react-toastify injects its own :root values at runtime, after this stylesheet.
.Toastify {
  --toastify-font-family: var(--sh-font-sans);
  --toastify-color-light: var(--sh-color-white);
  --toastify-text-color-light: var(--sh-color-ink);
  --toastify-color-info: var(--sh-color-primary);
  --toastify-color-success: var(--sh-color-success);
  --toastify-color-warning: var(--sh-color-warning);
  --toastify-color-error: var(--sh-color-danger);
  --toastify-z-index: var(--sh-z-toast);
}
 
.Toastify__toast {
  border: 1px solid var(--sh-color-border);
  border-radius: var(--sh-radius-md);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-shadow-md);
  font-size: var(--sh-font-size-base);
}
```
